1 / shāsteng tshi— — 4 1—1 8)jiXstu rto gaXsno muts+tsha rdo te(7༄pha ga8sto( gaX ༄ ༷ ༄ ༄ she sa lo 44 sngar gru bsda (mi nga sru la / ji/tre ri snarngosnokā kyestor ༷/ kau zhes doXnyu dzaXsnyol ri

dpe skrun gsal bshad/༄ga /'dir dpe skrun khang gis dpe rnying sdud sgrig byed skabs bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po gser ri'i phreng ba lta bur brgyud pa'i khrod nas/ ches khyad du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag po rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i rnam thar rang rnam zhal gsung ma 'di lag 'byor byung bar brten/ deng 'dir bod kyi rig gzhung snyi dang sgos su snga rabs mkhas pa rnams kyi rnam thar dag la thos pa slob gnyer mdzad pa'i dpyod ldan rnams la dgos mkho'i cha rkyen du par sgrun byed rgyu'i mthun rkyen legs 'grig byung ba yin/ 'di'i nang don rags tsam ngo sbyor byas na/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po nyid kyi rnam thar zhal gsung ma dang /rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi dkyil 'khor zab mor zhugs pa'i rigs kyi brda rtags su gyur pa'i zhal slob/ pad+ma dbang chen rol pa rtsal gyis rang rnam mjug mthud kyi tshul du mdzad pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa ji ltar bsgrubs tshul sogs zin thor bkod pa bcas so/ /rnam par thar pa'i gta / rin po che'i phreng ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi don ni sa bcad chen po gsum gyi khongs su bsdus te bstan yod/de yang klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo dang / spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo bcas 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi tshul rnams gdul bya rnams 1kyi

mos ngor dang 'tshams pa'idon bzang po/tshig 'bru bzang po/ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa/sgro skur zol sbyor gyi g.yon tshig gang gis kyang ma bslad paranyid kyi mgur bum bzang po nas ji ltar rim par bka' stsal ba bzhin bkod yod pa las/ tshig gdangs dang yi ge gcig gi dbri bsnan kyang byas med ces rang rnam mjug sgril gyi gtam du gsal po bris 'dug pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i dgongs bzhed du snying thig dum nyes las/ gsang rnam rtogs brjod chu sgra'i gar mkhan yang 'dir 'khod thub na phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam thar cha tshang bar 'dug gsung ba bzhin 'dir phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa yin no /de la rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i 'od zeraram kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1729)lor dbus g.yon ru bkra shis srong btsan bang so dang nye ba'i yul lho phyogs 'phyongs rgyas su sku 'khrungs/dgung lo drug nas gsang mchog dpal gyi ri 'od zer theg mchog gling du thos pa slob gnyer gyi dbu bzung / grub brnyes kyi skyes chen dam pa du ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten/ de nas mkhyen rtsal rab tu rgyas par gyur nas yon tan mdzod sogs yongs grags su 'jigs gling pod dgu zhes bstan bcos pod chen bcu lhag mdzad yod pa deng dus sde dge par khang na shing par du bzhugs/ de las 'jigs gling gtam tshogs zhes pod chen gcig bod ljongs dpe rnying dpe skrun khang gis 1993lo par skrun byas yod/ de nas sgrub pa nyams len la thugs gzhol ba'i tshul dang /dbus gtsang khams gsum dang lho mon sogs su slob tshogs grangs kyis mi 2

langs pa smin par byas pa dang / rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi bka' babs ji ltar byung tshul/ rten bzhengs dge sgrub kyi bya ba ji ltar mdzad tshul bcas bod spyi'i phan bde'i bya ba rlabs poche 'grub nas/ mthar dgung grangs bdun cu pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'is rta (spyi lo1798)lodagongs rdzu /sa /rdongs su thim pa'i mdzad pa bstan tshul bcas rnam thar gyi mjug da lan dpe kun byed skabs dpe rnying ma phyi 'bu srin gyis 'bigs skyon thebs pa zhig las lag son ma byung ba dang / par zhu byed skabs yi ge'i cha la ci nus kyis zhus dag bgyis khul byas kyang / rang nyid la skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan ches zhan pa bcas byis blo'i skyon dang lhag chad nor 'khrul ci mchis gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyis 'khrul sel dag thon gnang bar zhu zhu/spyi lo1997lor sgrig pa pos/

dkar chagardzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi rnam thar (3)1 skabs dang po klog pa thos bsam dang 'brel ba'i skor/ (35)2 skabs gnyis pa sgrub pa nan tan dang 'brel ba'i skor (37)3 skabs gsum pa bya ba las kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i skor/ (137)4 pad+ma dbang chen rol pa rtsal gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar mjug mthud kyi skor dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul/ ( 3)5 rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rje'i don gyi rnam thar do ha'i rgyan zhes pa/ (462)6 rtogs brjod chu zla'i gar mkhan/ (470)
yul lho rgyud du byung ba'i rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi rnam par thar pa legs byas yongs 'du'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

sa/snyi/ri ma ride spyi stob ///yul lho rgyu/ du sdu /rmi /rngo na shā dā byungan rdo r+sām lta ho' bo mi semaṭā /phyo ༵༵༵༵ / gyi ༵ 88 / pa le/bye sdu 〉ltamo r+sā4ji zhes yo 'ihā///snom har rwa//gengs 'du ma sa bya ba bzhugs pa da/

—zug 310 lha zu rme / // sna((༄ kru/ār+ya〈bshārnyad non tsarasamabrasā/mār/ga //gdod nas srid na mnyam par bdal yang tsha rol mthong ba'i yul min la//sa chamaṅgā ra za' ma'am mazar+sā lhagakāyamūladharman/rānupa r+shanāyakār+ya'itsa/lhun gyis grub pa'i sku dang ye shes chos mchog gzhan du mi 'gyur pa /khrimasam zamams sgrozamaṅgāṅgāmasa'i(brgyasogatahri dayisarba'ibatsamasgrubasnyulasalha/rig pa bde gshegs nying po'i ngo bo tshog kyi dam pa kun gyi dngos/ /glu'ag ma byu'i za'achar zar+sā050rtsi kā sa kālabisam/lhasprikāsha2kyibedz+raya//dus gsum dus med kum tu bzang po gsal 'grib zad par rgyal gyur cig/

༄༅/ /de la srid zhi ma lus pa'i mgon po/ khyab gdal yongs grub chen po chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba'i rnam thar bzang po 'phel ba dang 'grib pa'i gnas mongs su spangs ba gang /rnam par byang ba'ibams la ni rtag tu mnyam par bzhag go snyam pa'am/ ngas 'gro ba'i gnas rigs 'di lta bur sprul pa 'di lta bu bkye bar bya'o/ /sems can 'di lta bu smin par byed dosnyam byed kyi rtog pa rang mtshan pa zhig ma grub mod kyi/ rgyu skar gyi bdag po la gzugs brnyan kun tu 'gro ba'i rnam rtog gi bya ba dang byed pa pos stongs bzhin du chu snod tha dad pa'i rjes su 'jug pa ltar/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos khams rgya mtsho'i snyingapo dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi dang bzhin las phyi rol tu ma gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems chos dbyings dri ma med pa'i snying po can gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rigs yongs su sad pa na/ bsod nams dang bcas pa'i sems can gyi khams la rang bzhin gyi phan rlabs po che rnam pa cir yang shar nas thogs pa sha stag go//de las bdag dang bcas pa'i sems can gyi khams ni 'di tsam nas 'khrul dang / 'di tsam nas ma 'khrul dang /'di tsam nas grol gyi gtan tshigs brjod du mi snang ste/gdod ma'i ye shes de dang glo bur du mdza' bar byas pa'i srid pa'i bdag po kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa bag la nyal lam/ gnyis su snang ba'i rtog pa bkod pa tsam nas tshor ba sna tshogs pa/ tha dad pa'i 'du shes can rnam par shes pa'i tshogs/ 'du byed kyi rlabs phreng dang bcas pas 'khor ba'i thog ma bkod cing / srid pa'i nyes dmigs de dag gi dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang ngo ma 3

nyams par yod pas/ de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /ces so/ /gang tshe sgra gcan 'dzin gyis yum la bstod pa ltar smra bsam brjod du med pa la sogs chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings su spros pa nye bar zhi ba na mya ngan las 'das pa zhes rnam 'gyur gnyis su ming gi grub pa yang 'khrul grol gyi bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig la snang ba rjes la thob pa'i shes rab kyi mtshang rig pa zhig yin no/ /mtshan nyid de lta dus thog mtha' mi 'tshal ba'i 'khor ba la ji ltar brgyud pa'i rabs 'god du ga la zhig /sems dang bcas pa'i ma rig pa'i bzhon pa can dag gis sngon rabs dran pa'i lam nas brjod zer ba ni las kyi sgrib pa mchog tu lci ba'ang shes so/ /'on tang gnas lugs 'di bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la bzhag bdo ba'i tshe da ltar ba'i snang ba mngon sum par gdags pa 'di yang gdags gzhi rang gi steng na yod med gnyis char las ma grub kyang rjes la thob pa'i snang cha la srog dang bral ba'i seng ge bzhin rmi lam dang dod mnyam pa'i mtshang phugs nas rig pas/ 'di ni mngon sum pa'i snang ba'o zhes bden bden por blta ba'i byis pa so so skye bos rnam pa rtog pa'i nyer len can kyi rjes su 'brangs na nying 'khrul gyi bkod pa la gsal ba 'ga' zhig gsang ba chen po nyams snang gi rtogs brjod du bkod pa de gar gda'/de la da res kyi srid pa 'di ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i thugs bskyed las chos rje 'brug pa zhes rgyal khams ku su lu pa'i brtul zhugs kyi grol bar mdzad pa'i slob brgyud la/dang por che ba sba rkyang gnyis/ /bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/ /tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis/ /gzhan ras pa gsum/ rnal 4

'byor pa gsum/ zhig po gsum sogs dbu che gdugs theg pa nyis stong brgyad brgya byung bar grags pa'i nang tshan rgyal ba'i dbang po klong chen zhabs dang cho 'brang gcig cing /de nyid sku bltams pa'i gnas g.yo ru gra'i phu stod grong zhes pa dang ha cang mi ring ba'i gnas zar bo chos rjes rgya yags pa'i khyim du bdag gi mes po chos rje smon lam bzang po de byung bar gda'/ chos rje de ni rang bzhin bzang la/ ma bcos pa'i ngang tshul/ chos spyod dang bzlas brjod smra zhing / tshe'i bcud len grub pa lta bu zhig yod/ khong gzhon nu'i dus gter bdag gling pa mdzad pa phrin las rgyas pa'i skabs yin pa nas rigs rus sogs la gzigs te/ rdzogs chen pa 'od gsal klong yangs dang / ḍāk+ki ras chen gyi gdan sa mig bzhi dpal gyi dgon pa dang / 'od gsal gling /gzhan yang snyan cha/ skal ldan/ dpal 'byor chos sdings/ byar gyi cang mo dgon sogs kyi bla mar bsko 'ja' mdzad/ re zhig na ma sangs spun dgu'i rgyud las byung ba'i sked med ma dang 'dus pa las bdag gi pha de btsas par gda'/de la mes po tshun chad rigs rus kyi chos tshugs ma zhig pa zhig yin/ma ni rgyal po gri bkum btsan po'i blon po lo ngam ta zig las chad pa mdo sribs steng khang pa'i rigs dang cho 'brang gnubs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa mdong chung rnying ma'i khungs te phyi mo dang mes po sogs phrugs kyi bdun pa tshun chad kyi nye du nged kyi yang mes kyi char gtogs pa la'ang dge slong grags dbang dang / ljang phreng ba lhun grub rnam rol sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' re byung bar gda'/ lar bod na deng sang rigs bzhi'i bye brag rtog dpyod byed pa med mod/ dmangs rje'i khyad par 'jig rten gyi 'byor rgya kho

nas dbye ba las rigs rus kyi gtan tshigs dgos pa'i gnas cang med/chos kyi donani gang zag rang gi shes rgyud dang byed las gtso che ba don la gnas pa de kur gda' ste rlangs kyi po ti bse rur/ lar skyes pa'i mi'i rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na nags khung gi spre'u dang 'dra/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs te gnas tshul tsam mo/ /de la btsas pa'i yul ni/ dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal pos/ /'phyongs rgyas nang du nga sprul don byed 'ong / /su yin mi shes cig car smra ba 'byung / /'phying dbar mdo'am bang so dmar po'i stor/ /lha bab mchod rten dgon sde 'cha' yang srid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'phying dbar bang so dmar po'i lho phyogs/ ri brag dang bcas pa'i grong rnal gyi stod na rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde/ smad na dpal lha las bab pa'i mchod rten ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa can gyi yongs su brten pa'i gnas su zhi ba zhes pas mo bya'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad de rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma las grol zhi ba chen po'i grong khyer dusanal ba'idus tshes bzang po'i snga dro'i cha na mngal gyi pad+mo las grol bar 'dug /de la 'di snyam du/ sngon gyi tshe dbon mchog gsum la bla mar byas shing / smon lam dag pa'i las kyi 'phro 'ga' tsam mchis pa 'dra ste/ 'di ltar 'jig rten na dpal dang stobs kyi mngon par mtho ba'i gnas rnams su nying mtshams sbyar na de dag gi rang bzhinaphal mo che rnams ni tshe rabs snga mar thabs kyis ma zin pa'i dge brgyad pas tshe 'dir bltar snang gi bsod nams dang mnga' thang ji tsam che ba desrid du srog gcod pa dang / 'bangs mnar ba la sogs phyi mar ngan 'gro rlabs po che ba/ba pa'irgyur 'dug pa rig pas shes shing dpal /bon chen poku sgrub

zhabs kyi smon lam du'ang btab pa'i phyir ro//shin tu gud par gyur pa rnams ni myang bya mi bzad pas snying shin tu rje ba'i gnas su nyam thag cing chos dang mjal ba'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tsam yang tshogs pa shin tu dka' bar snang ngo //de'i phyir mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar chos kyi bya ba bsgrub pa la bar chad kyi sgo med pa'i khyim du skyes shing / de'ang legs smon dang bcas pas bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa phal gyi don du gnyer bya sde che la bza' btung mod pa nyid dang /gzhan yang zhang po dang phu bo la sogs pa'i grwa rgyun dang stabs gcig pa'i dbang du ri bo bde chen du chos sgor 'jug pa'i rnam cha shar ba na shri par+sha ta'i gling du khams pa rdza yul ba'i grwa rgyun 'chos rgyu mi bcu tham pa 'ongs pa nas gcig lam bar du 'das pa'i stes dbang gis/ grwa gsar dgu stabs gcig tu 'chos pa rten 'brel lam btub zer sne mo ba dag nas snang ba blo rdeg tu bsgyur ba'i brda bskul dang / kho bo cag mno shes mi shes tsam nas rab tu byung ba'i rtags can mthong na der smon shing rings pa'i sgra 'dab phal mo che mdzub mo la bkon te phyung ba'i ngang thung gnyis rten 'brel 'grig pa'i rgyu rkyen las rang lo drug pa'i tshe/ gsang mchog dpal gyi ri 'od gsal theg pa chen po'i gling du dngos dang bcas pa'i gsar bu ba me bcu tham pa chos sgor zhugs/ sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang blo bzang pad+ma las gtsug phud phyung ste rab tu byung ba'i rtags ma yin pa dor/ dge tshogs rin po che mtha' yas pa'i rten gzhi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yang dag par nod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtags kyi che zhing / 'jig rten gsum du thob par dka' ba'i gnas ngur thig gi rgyal mtshan drang srong gi cha lugs dag gis brgyan par byas so/ /gis

ma thag tu dam pa'i chos dang mjal zer ba de byung 'dug na'ang / dngos gnas la byis pa mno mi shes pa'i khrod du lo bcu gsum tsam lon lon du thal rtsed 'ba' zhig la g.yengs shing / ha cang byis pa'i rnam thar bskyangs drags pas rgan pa 'dras 'di yang na dang yang na gcig yong zer ba thos/ de tshe grub mtha'i phyogs snga sogs gang yang mi shes mod kyi rdo rje theg pa snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs su zhugs pa la spro ba chen po brtas pa dang / spyir dkon mchog gsum gyi snang brnyan la mchog tu dad cing / khyad par slob dpon chen po'i snang brnyan mthong ba'am/ mtshan thos pa'am/ yid la dran pa tsam nas dad mos shin tu 'phel ba dang / mtshan mo'i rmi lam na 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad la rim bzhin me shor nas rang gi byang drangs 'gro ba 'ga' zhig dang bcas me las rgyang grags tsam gyi pha rol tu 'bros pa'i rmi lam snga ma ji lta ba lo nyi shu ma lon tshun lo re la thengs gnyis gnyis star chags 'ong ba dang /khyad par chung ngu'i dus sems zhes pa 'di ji 'dra zhig yod 'ong snyam pa'i snang ba 'gol sar rtag tu shar nas rang gis rtog dpyod byas pa'i tshe rang sar ha phyad de lus/ des ma rims nas rgan pa 'dra la dri ba byas tsam na khog pa'i nang na rang nyid ji lta ba yod zer/ yod zer ba de la rtog dpyod zhugs tsa na de yang sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i mtshang rig nas rnam pa kun tu de ka 'tshol ba dang / tho rengs sam/ snga zhogs sogs gnyid srab mo'am/ sad ma thag pa'i gnas skabs na tshogs dung gi sgra thos pas rkyen byas dung gson ma dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i snang ba mu mtha' med par shar nas snang ba mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / chos spyong bslab pa'i tshe sngon 8

gyi las dbang las dge rgan gyi rigs ji snyed pa drag shul can 'ba' zhig dang thug pas brdung 'thag gi rnam pa nyi ma re tsam med pa ma byung na'ang nub mo nyal ba'i tshe sems dga' yal le yong bas gzhon nu'i dus skyid bsam pa ma dran/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags mang po byung / rkyen de dag gis byis pa bsran mi bzod pa'i snang ba skyo shas dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam char shar nas/ gdong brtsigs drug la bstan 'du shes gang yang med pa'i skyor sbyangs la yod pa'i tshe/da lta'i snang ba rmi lam ltar nub nas srid pa snga ma'i bag chags 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdo rjer yang nas yang du gsal zhing / skabs shig chu klung chen po'i 'gram pha wang khang pa tsam gyi steng na rgya ban rnams kyi chas la 'ong ba'i stod le ser po de 'dra mnabs nas nyams 'ur ba'i spyod pa byung rgyal du bskyangs pa'ang dran/ bstan pa byer zug skabs su nga'i sprul pa/ /za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin rjes bzung / /sems can gang gi don byed ma 'ongs dus/ /de wa a kur tsan+d+ra ri rgyal gling / de nas tshe 'phos yid gnyis cha ma mchis/ /phyi rabs 'byung 'gyur sangs rgyas bla ma ste/ de nas tshe 'phos rgya yi lo tsā zhes/ /de nas nyi ma seng ge stod gter dbang / /gshed ma brgya yis bskor kyang nyam mi nga //gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum len//zhes pa'i skabs su snang /gzhan yang bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i brjod pa gleng ba'am/ cho ga dang bzlas brjod sogs byed pa la shin tu spro zhing gzhan dag byed pa mthong na yang snang ba gting nas 'gyur ba dang / khyad par sems can gyi srog gcod pa mthong zhing thos pa'ang / khyi ra ba sogs kyi byed spyod yid la dran pa tsam nas rang yang shin tu sdug bsngal zhing /sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal 'di las kā lta

nyid du thar na snyam pa dang / nyadi thams cad kyi srog bskyab pa'i gnyer kha nga la yod na snyam pa dang / sems can gsod pa'i nam zla shar ba tsam nas rnam pa kun tu gnas skabs 'di na mi bzad pa'i las 'di lta bu zhig yod 'ong snyam nas snying rje'i blo bcos min du skye ba 'di da lta'i bar du yod pas tshad med bzhi'i blo sbyong gi tshig tsam 'bum ther gsog pa po las bcos min gyi snying rje shugs drag skye ba 'di don gyi chod che bar 'gyur grang snyam pa 'di bdag gi rnam thar bzang shos yin/ gzhan du ni bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa skal ba ni bzang mod de/ dus kyi dbang las 'dus pa'i sde rnams su'ang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni zhung / sdig pa'i grogs po ni mod/ rtag par byis dang 'du 'dzi'i nyes dmigs dang 'grogs brtag pas/de dag gi rang bzhin rmongs pa'i gos kyis ni g.yogs/ nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du ni bying / sred pa'i lcags sgrog gis 'khyad/ bdag lta'i ri bo dang dzoragrogs pa can sha stag yin pas/ de las byung ba'i rang gzhan gyi rnam thar ya ma zung brjod las 'das pas yid 'byung nas rnam pa kun tu bya bral kun spangs kyi spyod pa can la smon na'ang / khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes bstan pa'i gzhi brtan pa la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gces shing / rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug ngogs sam/ 'bab stegs kyang nges par yin pas kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po pan chen shākya shrī'i sdom rgyun las/ gnas gsar ba a nan+ta'i zhal snga nas kyi mkhan po/gzhan dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i las chog las ji ltar bstan pa'i nges pa las bslab phyir/ slob dpon/ dus bsgo ba/ grogs dan pa khrims ldan gyi las 10

gral dang bcas dbus su/ thur grib kyis legs par btsal ba'i nyi ma'i bzhi cha 'char ba'i skyes bu gcig dang / rkang pa gnyis kyi tshe na dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag pa nod/ de yang dpal mgon dbyig gnyen gyis/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes kha na ma tho ba med pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas rten phun sum tshogs par byas nas/ bstan pa rang gi ngo bo lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid la 'dris shing byang chub pas thar pa don dang ldan par bya ba'i slad du shes rab gsum gyi gnas gang yin pa la rig pa'i sgo kun nas 'jug dgos pa de lta na'ang / bdag cag ni rnam par shes pa'i khams la skyid pa bsgyur sgrib byed dang bcas lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon lon chos dang mthun pa'i bya bar gtogs pa chos spyod blo 'dzin dang za chog nyi tshe ba'i bslab gnyer spyi mthun tsam las gzhung lugs la thos bsam byed pa sogs btang snyoms kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de kur gda'/ shākya thub pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag de'i grib bsil la legs smon dang bcas pa'i bla gos thun mtshams gsar pa'i 'jo sgeg la kun gyi bkur bas phyin chad dkor gyi la g.yogs mdor na nged dang 'dra ba'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa tsho gnas skabs su skyid po yin/ ris 'gre mnyam po'i nang nas dngos cag gis tshong dang / so nam/ khyim gyi 'tsho 'dzin la sogs chos dang 'gal ba'i bya ba rlabs po che ni rmi lam tsam du'ang ma dran pas/ dge sbyong shākya'i dang na yod/ /kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong med/ /ces pa'i gras su tshud pa tsam snang / skabs de dag tu slob dpon ni med/ sbyangs shing khar yig dpe la bltas pa'i sug sa kyi 'bras bu 'di tsam du zad/ zla ba gzas 'dzin la ngo mtshar skyes nas sa ris 11

bslabs pas zhag bdun la le'u tho sbyor dgrol thebs pa shes/ 'gyang tsam nas legs ldan gza' lnga nyin zhag me'i dal myur dang / dus sbyor gyi tāskal la'i 'gro lugs kyang 'bad pa chung ngus rig /'di dag gi tshe nyin mo gaṇ+ḍal bsgyur dgod byas pa'i bag chags rmi lam la 'thas ches pa'i rkyen gyis ras dkar gyi wasta gyon pa'i gzhon nu zhig gis thur shing btsugs nas dus sbyor gyi srang tshad bslab pa byung / zhag gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa dper brjod gtan tshigs la brten nas brgyab pas ri mo'i 'gro lugs dga' mos shes/nyi zla gzas 'dzin la sgo yig lan kha yar byas shing nyi 'dzin 'di zla 'dzin las ri mo'i 'gro lugs kyang cung dog par ma tshad man ngag gi yi ge dang /gtan tshigs rnying pa'i sgo nas cha rgyus 'tshol ba la sogs rtog pa zhib mo dgos te phu mi lon pa'i yon tan du mi snang / sman dpe dum bu gsum bzung kyang lag len la sbyor ba ma byung / slob dpon dbyug pa can gyi gzhung snyan dngags me long gi dpe cha zhig ster mkhan byung ba drung dam chos pa la/ /khyod kyi zhal ni khyod nyid las/ /mthong zhing zla ba mkha' la mthong / /zhes sho lo ka gcig po'i rgyan gyi nges brjod dri brtsad byas pas bod kyi snyan dngags rtsing ral can rnams kyi lad mo sho ba la dka' tshegs ma byung / sngar lo bcu tsam 'gro ba'i tshe slob dpon bon btsan pas blo gsal gsar bu ba 'dra la mtshams sbyor lnga ba khrid pa mthong bas/ rgya gar skad du/ kā la pa sru tra/ bod skad du/ tā la pa'i mdo/ gnyis su med par gsung pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa'i yi ge yang dag pa'i man ngag go/ /zhes pa'i tshig rigs 'di mthong zhing thos pa tsam nas gzhung 'di la spro ba chen po zhig yod de ha 12

cang na gzhon pas go ba chags po mi 'dug /phyis slob dpon ni med/ 'di skor la shes zer ba 'drar dpe cha'i kha byang bsgrub bcug pas mkhar gong khrigs de 'dra bas ni gzhung ma mo'i kyang dma' dbab par 'dug /skad dod la skyabs bcol/ byings rkyen rnam dbye'i phrad kyi bya ba byed pa'i gnas la ha cang 'jug pa dog pa yod du mi sems te/ rjod byed gang yin pa de'i brjod don dbyings 'jal ma shes na skad dod 'dra chos su sdeb pas don rlabs po che 'chol ba'i mtshang shes dgos par gda'/ lar bar skabs kyi lo tsā ba dag gis rgya dpe'i tshig gi rim pa tsam du bkral nas bstan pa snga dar gyi tshe na byon pa'i sprul pa'i lo paṇa chen po rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing don 'gyur sgra ji bzhin pas gsung rab chud mi gsan pa rnams la bsteng tshig tu smra mod kyi/ lo tsā ba chen po blo ldan shes rab lta bus kyang rgyan la gzhi 'gyur mdzad pas/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la/ skye med kyi yi gis 'go drangs pa'i rak+ta'i sgra san gsum bsgyur ba'i skabs ma rnyed/ ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis snga 'gyur la ma chags mi chags chags pa med pa'i rang bzhin sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sbyar ba sogs don 'gyur gyi khyad par gzigs shing / be+e ro tsa nas bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo'i gzhung dum bu bsgyur ba sogs kyi ngo mtshar la rtsa ba med ba'i mos gus 'khrungs nas/ be+e ro tsa na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /ska cog gnyis ni nyi zla zung 'brel yin/ /rin chen bzang po tho rangs skar chen 'dra/ /kho bo yang ni srin bu me khyer tsam/ /zhes gzu bo'i thugs kyi bsngags pa mdzad phyir/ gsung rab kyi dgongs pa tshul bzhin du mi khrol ba'i legs sbyar mkhan pos de bzhin gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa chud 13

gsan pa mngon du snang ba'i phyir rig pa'i gnas 'di gting ring ba zhig tu shes so/ /lar kho bo cag gi ni yi ge'i brda rjod pa nas brtsams te/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang / dgongs 'grel bstan bcos/ tha snyad kyi gzhung / yin lugs kyi man ngag sogs rdo rje'i gnas jisnyed pa mthong ba de dag gus pas nye bar blangs te nyin mo'i snang ba dang sgron ma'i 'od la mjal bar spro ba'i bag chags bzang pa tsam las dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang nyid gcig kyang 'grogs nas sbyangs stobs kyi blo gros 'phel ba'i gnas su ma gyur mod/dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phur rgyal ba klong chen pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang lan gsum du mjal zhing brda thabs rten 'brel du mas byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas kho bo'i las 'brel rdzogs pa chen po nas sad pa yin no/ /dran mi dran tsam na gnas brtan kun bzang 'od zer gyi thugs rje chen po pad+ma'i dbang phyug dang / rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul/ tshe dpag med sku gsum 'dus pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad cing / gzhan yang snga phyir rgyal ba klong chen pa'i sems nyid ngal gso rtsa 'grel bla ma dgongs 'dus/phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ byang gter thugs sgrub/ rdo rje gshog rgod la sogs dran pa dang mi dran pa'i dbang lung mang po nod pas rten 'brel gyi sgo bzang po 'grig/lo bcu gsum lon dus bla ma grub dbang rin po che thugs mchog rdo rje dang mjal/ nged gzhon nu'i tshe nas snang ba mi dag pa de ma yin pas bla mar mtshan btags pa'am/ sgom chen kun spangs pa/ mdor na chos pa zhi dul gyi rnam pa can tshun chad la dag snang dang dad pa 'phel ba zhig yin te/ sngon gyi smon lam dbang las rje 'di pa la mjal ba tsam gyi snang ba 'gyur ba'i dad 14

pa yo nga / rgyun gtan bla ma rgyal khams nges med la gshegs pas yang yang mi mjal/ res 'ga' thag nyer phebs pa na'ang de dus kyi rgan po byis pa'i blo can rnams dge slong skar bzang gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa mang bas gcig la gnyis brten gyis sdig pa'i grogs po'i gzhan dbang gis mjal mi mjal sna tshogs 'ong / phyis phrin las dga' mos rgyas pas log sred can yang bltar snang mjal du song dus dpal gyi ri bo'i mchod khang chen mor rten bzhengs dang bcas rgyang ring tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod rten gyi thig rtsa phyag 'khrid du stsal/ phyag rgya chen po ye shes mthong grol gyi rtsa dbang dang / bsam pa lhun grub ma sogs smin byed dang 'brel bar grol byed kyi gdams pa cig rdzogs su btab nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' drin stsal/ mchod khang chen mo'i gyang logs la bzhugs pa'i thub dbang gi sku khru tshad khri rgyab dang bcas pa 'di la li ta bkres song gis rogs mdzad de nged kho nas btab/ ha cang ljid ches bas las thabs dang lus shed gnyis char la brten dgos pa brtson pa shin tu che bas nyin gcig la brgya ma zin tsam thebs/ phyis sus kyang de tsam 'debs ma thub pas rtog dpyod can rnams ya mtshan du byed/ de nub lus shin tu dub pa byung ste sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags gsal po byung / bla ma dam pa 'di nged la dgongs pa gtad pa yod pas sku gshegs nas kyang ye shes sgyu ma'i sku dang mjal / rdo khri chen po zhig gi steng nas khrid gsung ba na/ ngos kyi byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin thig le dkar por 'dug zhus pas/'dzum dmul le ba las cang mi gsung bas lan btab/de'i byin rlabs kyis brjod med kyi nyams shar/ chung ngu'i dus drung dam chos 15

blo gsal dbang pos/ rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po dang / mkhas grub chen po rong zom chos kyi bzang po'i dkon mchog 'grel zhig byin nas 'di khyed rang rnying ma ba'i chos kyi drag shos shig yin gsungs/bltas pas go rgyu dang shes rgyu cang ma byung / cung zad nar son nas blo gros gsal du song ba dang / snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi rtsa ba ma nor ba de rgyud sde bka' ma yin par shes/ de dang 'grel par g.yung 'grel gsal byed me long zhig byung ba gnyis ka nged la rten 'brel bzang bar 'dug /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs kho nas༄kha ba yin snyam pa byung / zur mes dbon rnam gsum gyi rnam thar la shin tu dad nas de'i ring lugs la bslab gnyer zhig byed snyam ste 'di skor la 'bag 'bug mi gda'/ rang gi khu bo dge slong rab rgyas de gsang rnying 'grel gsar tshor blo gros rno ba yod 'dug ste/gzhon nu don grub 'tshang rgya tsa na drang srong nyon mongs med mi bzhugs par gda' bas gangs ri thod dkar du lo gsum gyi thog tu gshegs/phyis grub dbang shrī nā tha las nyid kyi dgongs pas ji tsam brtol ba'i dka' ba'i gnas la dri bcad byas pas glo ba khengs par byung / gter chos tshad ma 'di blo rmongs kyi sems can la nyams su len bde ba'i man ngag tu mthong nas gnas dus der chos rje gling pa dang / rin po che de nyid kyi ring lugs la blo 'jug par byung bas brgyud 'dzin la su bzang dris pas/gu ru rgya mtsho dang /theg chen gling pa gdam nga can yin zer/las 'brel phyi ma la yod pas sku drung du gtugs/chos gling gi tshe dag gnyis/rin po che nyid kyi rta phur/ nā ga raka sogs zhus/ de skabs bla ma rin po che 'gro don rgyas pa'i skabs ma yin pas grong pa'i pha jor brtsi yang rang snang 16

dag pa rtsis su btang nas zhag gsum la gnas 'gyu rig gsum gyi dri brtsad la brten pa'i zhi gnas kyi 'jog tshul zhus pas snang ba 'gyur zhing /sems la phan pa zhig byung / da dung rdzogs pa chen po'i yin lugs gting phyin pa'i pha mtha' la ni ma reg /rigs zhang sgom chen dam pa las spyod 'jug dang 'grel par byang sdom/ jo bo rin po che'i lam sgron/ rgyal sras thogs med pa'i bka' 'bum/bde mchog lu yi pa/'dus pa 'phags lugs/'jigs byed ra lugs sogs/ snga phyir gsar sring gi dbang rjes gnang / bka' lung mang po nod/lar gnas skabs 'di dag tu skyoshas dang nges 'byung dpag tu med pa yod/bsgrubs pa 'ba' zhig las gzhan bya ba gang gis kyang 'chi tsa na phan mi thogs snyam pa byis pa mno shes mi shes tsam nas yod/ yod bzhin du lo nyi shu rtsa lnga lon lon chos zhus lo dang thos lo'i ngang du btang snyoms tha mal du lus pa 'di bdud kyi mngon sum du bslus 'dug /nyi zla kha sbyor las/ tshe 'di mi rtag mgron tha 'dra/ /mgron po rtag tu bsdad pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/lus kyi tshong 'dus su sems kyi mgron po tshogs pa 'di sang nangs par tshun chad na'ang mi gyes pa'i nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha med yin/ ma tshor ba de ga'i ngang la mi tshe phal cher song gda'/ nga phyi thal ches snyam pa'i snying las srid pa mgo mjug slog pa'i thal song byas ba tsam rgyun du skyes/ jo bo byang chub chen po zhal gyi dkyil 'khor cir yang 'gyur ba'i rnam pa zhig mjal bas mchi ma rang dbang med par shor/ dpal torgyan chos kyi rgyal po de rang dran/ de'i rnarme thar dang sgrub gnas rnams mthong bas dran du song / lho nub srin po'i yul la kha bstan nas yang yang du shor/ ngus pas ci phan phyi ma 17

zangs mdog dpal rir zang thal du bgrod pa'i da ge sbyor zhin byed dgos snyam bsgrub pa btsan thabs su byed pa'i zhe dam bcas/ mes dbon rnam gsum kyi gtsug lag khang kun tu tshe 'di'am phyi ma'i gnas skabs kun tu phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas yid la byed pa'i phyin ci log ma yin pa'i smon lam byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rjes su 'brangs nas btab/sde dang bcas pa'i lam kha zhig na btsun chung lo brgyad tsam 'gro ba zhig dge gon gyi brdungs 'thag btang zer/ lus la bdeg btsog gi rjes dang bcas gcer bu rnal ma tsam yang med par phud pa kho rang mya ngan gyi khung bur tshud/phyugs skyong ba'i bu dang bu mo chung ngu 'dras de'i sems gso zhing snying rje ba'i gnas su byed pa mthong bas rang nyid kyang mchi ma shor/snying rje dpag tu med pa skyes/ pha ma yod dam byas pas/ gnyis ka shi nas med zer/ dwa phrug la 'di 'dra phod pa snyam 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal du ston pa'i slob dpon du byung / stod gos legs po zhig yod pa phud nas g.yogs/ byis pa rnams la brda sbyor tshul bslabs nas bzhag /theg pa chen po'i lam du 'jug pa la byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa 'di rgyal ba'i sras kyi bslab par bya ba'i gnas gtso che shos shig yin/ de'i sngon du tshad med bzhis blo 'chos pa'i rten 'brel ma lus pa der 'grigs gda'/ rang lo nyer brgyad pa me mo glang gi lo cho 'phrul chen mo'i dus chen 'char bar brtsams pa na shrī par+sha ta'i gling du lo gsum gyi dam bca' ri mo snying la bris te bag phab/dgongs pa khyab gdal du ma grol bar gegs kyi 'jug pas sgo gang sa nas kyang glags lta ba las bzlog phyir/lo bdun gyi bar sa khyim dang 'du 'dzi'i them pa mi gda' ba dang gcig/8

sdod sa sde khrod yin pas mtshams 'og la ma jal phrad mi mang zhing chags sdang gi tshogs 'a / mi gnon pa dang sanyis/phyi satam nang du mi lon nang gtam phyi ru mi sgrog pas bug sgor nye ring su la'ang ngag mi gtang ba dang gsum/ltogs lha mgron du brten nas yon tan zang du mi 'tshong ba dang bzhi/ nang du chos spyod bcur mi gtogs pa'i lag las rnam par mi g.yengs pa dang lnga/ 'tsho ba gyi nar brten pa las dkor zas byung rgyal mi spyod pa dang drug/grol ba 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba las phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i las thabs mi bsgrub pa dang bdun gyi dam bca' spyod 'jug las/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan/ /de dag thams cad spyan snga na/rtag par bdag ni gnas so zhes/ /de ltar bsams nas ngo tsha dang / /gus dang 'jigs ldan de bzhin mnos/ /zhes pa ltar bzung zhing / de ltar bzung nas kyang / bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pa'i don med gsungs/ /gang gi chos kyi gtso bo mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ /bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang / /de dag don med gyi nar 'khyam/ /de ltas bdag gi sems 'di ni/ /legs gzung legs par bsrung bar bya/ /zhes pa 'di la nges shes rnyed/ /nyin re bzhin se gol gtogs pa'i yun la'ang yengs ma lam du song ma song nang nub re bzhin lta rtog bcug nas bsgom/dgos med kyi zhen log /skyo shas dang nges 'byung / bcos min gyi dad pa/sems can la snying rje sogs lam rtags dang po'i yon tan kyang je cher 'phel/zhi gnas kyi nyams rnam pa sna tshogs pa stes dbang can du 'char gyi yod pa'i 19

tshe rigs zhang sgom chen dam pas rgod tshang pa sna tshogs rang grol gyi sgo ma don gsung bgros 'ga' zhig bskur bar mdzad pas 'di res kyi gegs mang po grol/ las dang po pa la shin tu phan pa ra gda'/ lar ma bcos pa gshis kyi thog tu ngo sprod pa dang / byung tshor gnas nyams la ngo sprod pa gnyis lam khyad la gnam sa lta bur 'dug /kho bos rdzogs pa chen po'i grub mtha'i ngos 'dzin thun mong ma yin pa dang /dka' ba'i gnas ma lus pa mdzod chen bdun las rnyed pa yin/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang bcas pa tsho mngon sum par byon kyang rgol ba mi 'jug pa'i grub pa'i mtha' chen po 'di'i dgongs pa len mi shes na gzhan lta ba su mtho zer yang kun 'byung gi g.yogs pa can du go/zla ba gsum tsam lon pa'i tshe rang lus zhugs la sbyangs pa dang / nam mkha' la skyikha mo krung bcas pa sogs kyi snang ba yang nas yang du byung /lus kyi srin bu rnams de nas dag /spyir dus bzang po la sogs pa'i tshe nyams 'ur nas sgrub khang du bro 'khrab snying 'dod pa dang / snang ba bden med sgyu ma lta bur 'gro ba yang yang du yod pas mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang / sgyu ma ngal gso'i man ngag nyams 'og tu chud/ spyir srid pa 'di la me tog phog pa'i chos skal yang yin/ chos kyi rang ngos nas kyang rig 'dzin pad+ma'i zhal gdams rtsa gsum dgongs pa rang grol 'di la rgyud sde chen po'i spyi chings/man ngag zab mo'i gnad bsdus sogs dpag par dka' ba'i yon tan du ma 'dug pa gnas skabs 'di tsam na shes/ dbang lung gi brgyud pa chad du phongs pa na rmi lam du/ chu klung chen po zhig na gar mkhan zhig skam la 'thon du nye/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas skyeb lnga pa'i rtags dang ldan pa zhig ngos kyi 20

khu tshur na bcangs pa las phun sum tshogs pa'i sgra mang po bsgrags te chu klung chen por dor nas rgya mtsho'i rum du song ba mis/rten 'brel de'i don la brda mang por shes/dge slong sa man+ta bha dra bgres po mtshams nang du spyan drangs/khong pa thugs bskyed bzang / drang po ma bcos pa'i ngang tshul can dag snang dzoragro bar yod/ chos gsung pa la 'jug pa mi bde yang rgyud pa khungs btsun sel med yin/ dbang rdzas nged rang gis skabs thog dpyad nas phyag tu 'bul bzhin zhus/lung mdzad pa la zhag dgu tsam 'thogs/zhar la chos rgyal 'bri gung pa'i gter chos kyang nyan/ des gsang sngags rang nyid len pa'i nyes pa bsal te/ slar bdag 'jug lan mang por nod nas lam bsdus pa'i bskyed rdzogs la nyams len gnad du bsnun pas byin rlabs nye brgyud rgyal dbang pad+mas stsal/ yid ches pa'i nges shes rnyed pa las lo gsum 'di'i ring tho rangs bya skad sgrogs pa phyi mthar byas pa'i nam sad pa nas nyi ma tsha rting kha steng dus sbyor bzhi'i 'pho ba ma rdzogs ring yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud la rtsal bton bum can gyi thun rtag pa kun tu bzung bas cu tir zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi rtags phal cher shar/ rtsa khams yi ge'i rnam par grol bas mgrin pa rdo rje glu'i dkor mdzod du song / chos thams cad bltas pa tsam gyi shes snyam pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab klong brdol nas bla ma dgongs 'dus la rnam nges 'od zer brgya pa byis pa'i blo gros kyis brtsams/ srog bur 'dres pa las lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ril ba zhabs tshags can du song / 'og rlung la dri nga bas bzhin par mi nus shing / khams la mi 'phrod pa'i zas kyi rnam pa ci lta bu khong du song yang nyams brtas par gyur nas ngo bo ma 'gyur ba thon/ dri 21

chu bsung pa dang / 'du ba'i kha dog gis ma gos par 'bab pa sogs thun mong gi rtags mang po dang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che do rje nor bur brtan pas bde stong gi yon tan dpag tu med pa skyes/ dge sbyor nar son pas lo bar pa la lus rus sbal 'khar gzhong du bcug pa lta bu sogs rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid mngon sum pa'i lam rtags sgra ji bzhin pa'i srol du chud pa byung / de na'i mur lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug gi rnam thar 'khyongs na 'ja' lus su dwangs pa la dka' tshegs med pa'i nges shes rnyed na'ang / spyir dus kyi cud pa dang / khyad par dngos la 'pho ba chen po'i grub mtha' stogs pa'i las 'brel gyis phongs pas grong yul dang bcas pa'i ri khrod du 'du byed phung po'i grong khyer zo mdog bde ba nyid du lus par gyur to/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i skyon yang bltar mi mngon par sbas//khu tshur tsam gyi yon tan lhun por 'gran pa bzhin/ /gzung 'dzin lag pa chen pos kun nas kun tu 'khyud/ /rnam rtog lag na gzhong thogs dal rten min gyis dogs/ /dbang shes ri rtse skan pa gling bzhi'i ltad mos g.yengs/ /yul lnga rta gdong rgod mas kho ra khor yug bcings/ /bdag lta yongs 'du'i ljon pa yal 'dab bskyod la brtson/ /sung po lnga yi byed po'i rnam par thar pa lags/ /zhi gnas bsil zer dbang po 'phel 'grib res 'jog can/ /lhag mthong 'od zer brgya pa ma rig zin gyis g.yogs//rnams g.yengs rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis mnyam rjes bar lag phral/ /tshogs brgyad dbang po'i gzhu yi zhags pas bcings pa lags/ /rig pa ma bcos spros za' dang po'i sangs rgyas la/ /shes sgrib pha tshan rags pas sgom go chod ma nus/ /mu bzhi blo yis phral ba'i rtog dpyod bsam gtan la/ /22

mtha' brgyad spros bral re ba'i ston chen lham rdol lags/ /blo bral rang byung rig pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngang / /lhan skyes mun pa snag pos rang zhal thad kur bsgribs/ /dran pas ched 'dzin byas pas ngar gdangs so ma la /sgom gyi dngos gzhir 'khrul pa'i sgom chen gtan rdol lags/ /rtog tshogs bya lam rjes med rol rtsal sprul sku dngos/ /kun brtags blo sho rgod pas 'dzin zhen bral ma nus/ /lhag mthong gshis la 'byams pa'i ri dwags rgya shor la/ /rnam rtog chos skur 'dod pa'i grub thob smyon pa lags/ /sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i klong na grol ma nus/ /res 'jog ya bral can la rtogs pa'i las 'brel nyung / /snang tshad lam khyer tshig gi lam du zad pa yi/ /rgyas 'debs go yul mkhan zhig dngos kyang yin gyi dogs/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkhar grags nas stong pa blo yis bsgrubs/ /rjes thob sgyu ma'i sgra yis dngos 'dzin mtshan mas zhig /mnyam rjes dbyer med zer nas tha mal rang dgar lus/ /bdog pa ci yang dgos pa'i grub mtha' zin pa lags/ nye 'khon med pa'i thugs rje 'dod pa'i phyogs su lhung //log par bsgrub pa'i phyogs la bzod pa bsran mi nus/ /rnyed dang bkur lta'i slad du dbang po sdom pa'i tshul/ /snying rje skam thag chod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lags/ /cung zad rnyed pa'i tshe na rgyags dang dregs pa'i nad bu 'phel/ /spangs rtogs yon tan mi smon grags skam dge ba'i chom rkun gnyer/ /chos ltar bcos pa kun dang mthun pa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul/ /ha cang sbas drags rgyal rnams thugs kyis khrel dogs 'dir brjod do/ /de las gzhan du thun mong ma yin pa/ /ci yang med mod gal te yod srid na/ /mos pa brtan pa'i rgyun las gnas skabs 'dir/ /cha tsam skyes 23

pa'i rang rgyus mig 'phrul ni/ /gang tshe sgo gsum mi 'dar bsdoms pa nas/ /stan thog 'dir ni lus gnad ma zhig cing / se gol gtogs pa tsam la'ang yengs ma yengs/ /nang nub re bzhin lta rtog bcug nas bsgom/ /de yi 'bras bu nam yang mi bslu bas/ /zla ba gsum na zhi gnas rtse gcig pa'i/ /gnas nyams nyin mtshan bar mtshams med du shar/ /gnyid kyang mar me sbur ba ji bzhin no/ /da ko sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam/ /nges par sngon la gang yod mi shes pa'i/ /shugs ring dbugs 'byin chen po'i 'bab stegs kyang //kha rag sgom chung rjes su 'gro ba snyam/ /tshe 'di'i 'tsho rtsis chags snang g.yo 'khrug gi/ /ri dbang 'joms la gnam lcags thog lta bu/ /'chi ba snying dran nyid las gzhan med par/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bden pa rgyud la smin/ /byin rgyud rtogs pa 'pho ba'i byed pa po/ /su yang ma yin rang gi mos gus la/ /rag pa de phyir dad pa'i gdungs shugs kyang / /mchi ma 'khrug pa'i byed pos rtag tu bos/ /theg chen lam gyi yon tan phal mo che/ /mgron por 'bod la snying rje chos pa bzhin/dgra mi sha bor mtshon rnon thogs pa la'ang //'khun pa med par srog 'di ster phod skyes/ /'khor ba shin tu mi bde sdug bsngal ba'i/ /rum na sems can kun gyi mtshang bcas de'i/ /gnas la bzod thabs med pa'i smre sngags dang / /shugs ring mchi mar bcas pa rtag tu 'gran//nges par 'byung dang skyo shas drag po dang / /snying rje tshad med mos gus rlabs po ches/ /lo zlalidamabaca' brtan po ma lus pa//skyo ngal med pa'i ngang du zad pa byung ///gang las byung pa'i yon tan ci snyed na/ /ma yengs lam du slong ba'i chos drug gi/ /dran pa'i ngo bo rang grol chen po'i klong / /rkun po'i rnam rtog yibs pa'i 24

'phro bcad do/ /de la'ang yid ches nyams kyi 'dzin stangs dang / /sgom 'dzin shes bya'i dri ma phal mo che/ /brjod med blo bral chen po'i gshis su dag /btang snyoms lung ma bstan las 'das pa'o/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom mtha' las rnam grol zhing / /lhag mthong gshes la 'byams pa'i gzhi rtsa chod//chod dang ma chod 'di yang blo btags tsam/ /brdal pa chen po chos sku'i bzhugs tshul lo/ /skye med nges bzung mnyam bzhag yon tan skye /'gag med lam khyer rjes thob rang ngor grol/ /snang ba'i steng du stong pa'i rang zhal mthong / /rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan nyid du grol/ /de nyid ma rig srid pa'i khung bu can/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis rgyun la rtag tu 'khor/ /bsgom 'dod blo ni chags dang spong 'dod sdang / /chags sdang bcos ma'i blo yis 'khor bar 'phen/ /de phyir ye grol chen po'i ngang bsgom dang / /kun brtags phra mo'i dpyad pa khyad che ba'i/ /rang bzhin shes nas de kur lus pa las/ /'khrul ba'i de nyid rig pa'i klong du yal/ /theg dman lam gyi skal bar mi grol ba'i/ /gzung 'dzin sems nyid gya gyu'i rang bzhin can/ /yud la grol ba rdo rje snying po'i drin/ /don gyi rtogs pa brjod pa de la rung / /lar lo gsum 'di'i ring la/ rdo rje'i rigs dang /rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs te yi dam rigs tha dad pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du go 'pho ba'i gnad dang / de'i rang bzhin mnyam gzhag chen por bsre ba la goms par bslabs pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zung 'brel nyid du rdzogs pa ni rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i 'bras bu yin pa smos ma dgos la/ gnas skabs su'ang rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi ldang tshad ji lta bar gdags su rung 26

ba'i bskyed rim gsal brtan gyi nges brjod rdzogs pa'ang 'ga' tsam snang bas phrin las rnam pa bzhi la rang byan chud pa'i rten 'brel 'grig cing /gdon bgegs kyis mnar ba'i 'gro ba gang zhig la rig pa gtad pa tsam gyis mngon gyur du phan pa'ang 'ga' tsam byung la/ gang zhig snying rje chen po'i blo shugs 'byung du skyes pa de'i tshe de'i dus na rang gzhan brje bar nus so snyam pa'i kun slong bzang po rgyal po byams pa'i stobs la smon par nus pa tsam du skyes pa las/'jig rten na skye ba nas skye bar rabs su brgyud pa dang /gdung 'dzin la sogs pa grags pa'i lcasas kyus mthon po'i gnas la dpyad du med pa'i ku su lu sran ma lta bur zlum pa'ang / las 'phro dag pas rang bzhin gyi bla mar bya ba dang / ri mor bya ba dang / bste stang du bya ba'i 'os su mthong zhing de dag chos kyi sgo nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkri bar nus pa'ang stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi gzhan dbang kho na las bdag nyid thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pas ma yin no/ /gang gi tshe mos gus chen po'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i mod la/ mi gnas mchi ma'i char rgyun drag tu 'bab pa dang chabs cig /gdung ba drag po'i blo srog la mi phongs pa tsam du skyes/ de'i rjes 'brel du snga na med pa'i rtogs pa brjod du med par skyes nas snga ma snga ma'i lta ba phyi shun lta bur 'gro zhing / de la so /sa pa'i yul rkyen tha dad pas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i grong khyer chem po na gnas pa'i rtsa khams kyi yi ge rten dang brten par bcas pa gsang ba ye shes chen po'i rlung gis rdo rje'i rol mor dkrol ba las/badz+ra gas kuḥste glu'i rim pa'ang ji snyed cig byung ste/de la ched du 'dzin pa ma zhugs pas zin bris la la gyar/ la la gzhan du 26

'khod pa sogs yod pas 'dir ma bris/ de lta na'ang chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/ bcom ldan 'das bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa la ni gal te sangs rgyas mi bzhugs da'ang / nam mkha'i dkyil dang / cig pa dang / shing ljon pa rnams las chos kyi sgra 'byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa dag pa la ni rang gi yid kyis spyod pa nyid las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thams cad 'byung ngo / /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa phun sum tshogs par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs der blo las su rung ba'i nye bar len pa dang / snang ba'i chos nyid sgyu ma ltabur rtogs pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bas mtshams sbyar te/ bka' 'dus rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi klong byang thugs kyi sgrom bu brda bsgyur gsang ba'i gal mdo babs shing de nyid 'byung ba'i sngon 'gror snang ba dpe char shar ba'i brda las blo ldan bh+ra ma ra'i gtam du grags pa ja zhal gsum 'thung ba'i yun la bris mi tshar ba tsam du babs pa blos bkod pa'i yi ge ma yin pas don bzang la tshig gtad pa med par snang ngo / /sgrub khang yang 'og min dag pa'i zhing / /'du khang dang tshogs 'du dran don med/ /de dran na chags sdang me ltar 'bar/ /byang chub la gson bsreg gtang nyen yod/ /cog pu ni rang bzhin sprul pa'i gnas/ /'du 'dzi dang rgyal khab ma gshegs shig /de gshegs na sgrub 'bras zong la 'tshong / /ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs yal gyi dogs/ /cod ḍa gyi lha 'dre'i yid rtsa 'khol/ /rnga chol dang rol mo ma dran cig /gtor rgyag gi 'gro don slebs nas yong / /lam rtags kyi yon tan 'grib nyen yod/ /27

mi rkang dang gling bu gdangs 'gyur snyan/ /dung sgra dang rgya gling ma dran cig/ri dwags kyi smig rgyu mthong ba ltar/ /stong gsob la mi tshe bskyal nyen yod/ /gnas yul gyi bkod pa lus la tshang / /rkang pa la 'phang lo ma skor cig /tshar lhang gnyis mal sar 'grig gin gda'/ /sprang snyogs kyi mthar thug cig byas nyan yod/ /mtshams 'og la mjal phrad ma mang zhig /dge ba'i grogs po gser las dkon/ sdig grogs kyis dge sbyor rlung la bskur/ /sems snang stong la bum pa'i dbang bskur zhus/ /thun mtshams su kha bsdur ma btang zhig /phyi gtam nang bskyel 'di rnam rtog rgod/ /kha btsum na rtog bral gyi yon tan 'char/ /sems gsal stong la gsang dbang gi nyams len mdzod/ /sgom 'dod tsho shes bya ma slobs shig /de shes na srung 'khor gyi mi thub pa'i/ /gegs chen de rang la tshang nas gda'/ /mi shes dang mi yong sku drin che/ /sems bde sdong la sher dbang gi lam khyer mdzod/ /bum 'um dang yig phrin bya ba mang / /chos brgyad kyi rtog tshogs gsar re sgug /bug sgo la rdo bajigs thong la zhog /rig sto nga la tshig dbang gi lam khyer tshang / /g.yo med du brtan pa lus kyi tshugs/ /sgyu lus kyang dran pa nye bar bzhag /rnam rtog la 'gro dang 'ong ba med/ /sems nyid kyang dran pa nye bar bzhag /tshogs drug gi yul la bya ma shor/ /tshor ba yang dran pa nye bar bzhag /gshis thog la bcas bcos ma dgos pa/ /chos nyid la dran pa nyer bzhag go /mnyam bzhag la sdig pa'i kun slong med/ /mi dge ba yang dag spong ba lags/ /chos nyid ni mu bzhi'i spros dang bral/ /gzung 'dzin kyang yang dag spong ba lags/ /snang ba la ma zhen chos skur dag /rnam rtog kyang yang dag spong ba lags/ /'khor 'das la rang bzhin ma grub pas/ /28

gnyis 'dzin kyang yang dag spong ba'o/ /nyin mtshan du mnyam par bzhag la brtson/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa yin/ /lhag mthong gis de yi chos la 'grogs/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang pa yin/ /zhi lhag kyang don la ro gcig gnas/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa yin/ /de yi ngo bo gsal dwangs phyed/ /shes rab kyi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa yin/ /blo 'das la yon tan ma lus 'char/ /dge chos ma bskyed pa bskyed par byed/ /mnyam rjes la ris med rtsal stong bas/ /skyes pa'ang gong du spel bar byed/ /rtog pa'i gzhi rtsa rang sar chod/ /phyi nas mi dge mi skyer byed/ /shar ba dang grol ba dus mnyam na/ /skyes pa'ang rang sar spong bar byed/ /yang dag gi don la nges shes skye /dad pa'i dbang po de las gang / /bsgoms dang ma bsgoms gang du'ang dran/ /dran pa'i dbang po de nyid do//chu bo bzhin du rgyun 'chad med/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o//de la bsal bzhag bya ba med/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i dbang po'o/ /gting mtha' med pa'i mtshang shes pa/ /shes rab kyi dbang po khyad par can/ /snang ba ni dag pa rab 'byams zhing / /khyab gdal chen po dad pa'i stobs/ /dus gsum kyang du ma ro gcig ngang / /skye 'gag gnas med dran pa'i stobs/ /yod med kyi mtha' la spros bral shar/ /dbu mar gnas pa'i ting 'dzin stobs/ /sgom ba'i ngo bo bri gang med/ /le lo dang bral ba brtson bgrus stobs/ /lhan skyes kyi ngo bo brjod pa bral/ /rang byung ye shes chen po'i stobs/ /tshogs dang sbyor ba'i lam chen por/ /yon tan gyi rnam pa cir bstan pa/ /ris med mnyam pa chen bor 'gyel/ /spros bral gyi ye shes rnam mi rtog /ting 'dzin gyi byang chub yan lag nyid/ /mtha' dang bral ba khyad par gyi chos/ /yang dag gi byang chub yan 29

lag nyid/ /lus sems dang bcas pa'i tshogs pa kun/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i byang chub nyid/ /spong len las grol ba gang zhig ni/ /brtson 'grus kyi byang chub yan lag go /sa lam gyi rnam par dpyad du bzod/ /rnam 'byed kyi byang chub yan lag yin/ /rgya cha da dang phyogs su lhung ma myong / /btang snyoms kyi byang chub yan lag nyid/ /'dar ba dang 'phrisas pa'i chos can min/ /dran pa 'di byang chub yan lag go/ /gar yang phyin pa med pa la/ /ci yang ma mthong mthong ba'i lam/ dbyings kyi ngang la rtsol rtog med/ /yang dag 'di lta ba'i rtse mor 'dug /rang ngo'i ye shes bsgrib pa med/ /yang dag 'di rtogs pa'i rtse mor song / /ca co dang ga zhas bslu ba min/ /yang dag 'di ngag gi rtse mo lags/ /spangs pa dang rtogs pa lhun rdzogs nyid//yang dag 'di rtsol ba'i rtse mor phyin//mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i dngos/ /yang dag 'di 'tsho ba'i rtse mo lags/ /mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob shugs la 'dres/ /yang dag 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi rtse//rang gsal la sgom pas phan ma btags/ yang dag 'di dran pa'i rtse mo'o/ /re dogs kyi gnyis snang rang sar zhig /yang dag 'di las mtha'i rtse mo nyid/ /'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /bsgom pa'i ngo bor rang grol nas /lam lnga sa bcu'i 'bas stegs la/ /mi slob lam gyi rtogs pa'i chos/ /mngon gyur dag pa gnyis ldan zhes/ /grags pa pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /mthar thus sngags kyi myur lam la/ /ma brten sa nas sar 'phags pa/ /nges par skas kyi gdong bu bzhin/ /'gro bar 'dod pa'i rnam rtog can/ /de la byang chub yong ma yin/ /cer grol rig pa skad cis ma'i/ /steng tu byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /sum cu rtsa bdun ma lus pa/ /spangs thob bral bar rdzogs pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor 30

bdas gi nyams len gastsogs/ /dam bca' rdzogs pa na bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong la sgrub chen bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgo nas phrin las bzhi dang mchos la brten pa'i ho ma'i las sbyor brtsams/ mchod zla skyes thob kyi rtse mor son la/ thos bsam la rig pa rno ba zhig yod/ bslab gnyer rgyud thog tu mi 'gel ba ni dge bshes mtshan nyid pa'i gzhung lam chen mor med dam snya ma/ dbu ma chen po'i lugs la zhi gnas khyad par ba 'thob pa des/ mdun na zan za ba po'i kham rdog la'ang grangs kyi non pa tsam du mi yengs pa yod zer ba thos/ khyed rdzobs pa chen po'i lta ba har sangs zer ba 'di hwa shang gi grub mtha' dang gcis pa yin par byed kyang / 'ja' lus grub pa dang / grol ba thob pa mngon gyur tu byung lugs 'di la dpags na lta ba'i ngo bo ni zab mo rang zhig yod par 'dug skad/ma yengs pa zer ba'i tshig de kha gcig pos 'tshang rgya na kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyugs rdzi rgan pos kyang chen 'dzin gyi ngang du dran pa bzhag pa'i tshe/ stong phrag khri phrag tu longs pa'i phyugs kyi ngo bo rtsi bar nus pa rig pas grub/ rdzogs pa'i sa ngas rgyas kyi lta ba la spros bral gyi ming gdags don med/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i dbu mar blos bzhag pa'ang dran pas bzung ba'i yod mtha' la rtsang gis dogs// sangs rgyas kyi lta ba zab mo ston pa la klu sgrub lung bstan/ rgya sar na dgongs 'grel tshad ma zla ba grasas pa yin/ rnam pa'i gzhung lugs la smra bsam brjod med gnyid 'thug po dang gcig pa'i phyogs phul bkod pa'ang 'dug /de ka yin na rdzogs pa che po hwa shang dang mthun pa lod du ma song / rgyal ba'i yum la'ang sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bsngags pa de las brjod ma shes pa'i phyir dang /yang skabs shig tu nges pa'i 31

shes pa dang / yul gyi 'dzin stangs zhig pa lta ba la dpyad pa rdzogs pa'i tshad du khas blangs pa de kha thugs rgyud la khel gyin yod na ni/ snga ma'i khas len dang dngos 'gal la song kyang go bcad/ rdzogs pa chen po'ang phyogs gang du 'phul/ gsar rnying gang gi thad du'ang 'dra min mang po yod pa ni kun na gsal/ bod na rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung stegs su bcas nas rdzogs pa chen po'i grub mtha' rang sar slong nus pa de rgyal ba klong chen pa yin/de'i dgongs pa la rtag chad kyi rgol ba 'jug pa 'dug na rnal 'byor pa nga yang thor tshugs 'dreg pa la spro ba yin/byas pas khong mgu song /sngar go ba nga che ba yin te/ sgom byung gi shes rab khyad par 'phags/ khyod bslab gnyer ni ma byas skad/ khong gi de dri ba lhag bsam nas nged la 'gro brtsi bar 'dug ste shes bya gshis thog tu grol ba la rgyu mtshan 'di yod/bde gshegs snying po nang nas gsal ba la/ /phyi nas dran pas 'dzin pa btsal ma dgos/ /yul la ched du dmigs pa'ang rnam dag pa/ /zab cing spros bral klong la phyag bgyi'o/ /bcings grol las 'das pa ka dag gi rig pa/ /rgyas 'debs kyis ma bslad lhun grub tu rang shar//byar med la rtsol byas kyi lhan thabs kyang mi 'debs so/ /rtag chad kyi ma bslus blo bral gyi rig pa/ /dbu ma la ma bcir sems 'dzin las 'das song //rang grol la bskyar grol gyi mthun 'jug kyang mi byed/ /dran pas kyang ma bzung rang bab kyi rig pa/ /'char sgos kyang ma g.yel thad ka ru rang yan/ /cer grol la gnyen po'i bsal bzhag kyang ma dgos so/ /stong gsal gyi rigs pa smra bsam dang brjod med/ /chings 'dzin kyang ma byas rgya yan du ma 'byams/ /blo bral la 'thad legs kyis gzabs mchor kyang ma 3 2

dgos so/ /yid dpyod las 'das mnyam nyid kyi ngang sgom/ /bcos slad kyi ma gos rang sa na thal thal/ /dbyings grol la go nyams dang pho tshod kyis mi reg go/ /gnas 'gyu dang mnyam rjes zhi lhag gi 'brel mtshams/ /tha dad du dbye ba'i rnam grangs kyang zhig pa//bzung dran gyi gdon chen sangs pa las byung ngo / //dran pa la dran lugs rnam drug tu yod pa/ /ma rtogs mthar 'dzin gyi g.yang sar lhung na/ /sgom chen dang gnas lugs mkhon pa zhig 'byung bas/ /lta ba la mtho dman brjod sa rang ma rnyed do/ /zhes so/ /lta ba'i yin lugs rjen par mthong ba dang / /sgrib pa spangs thob bral ba ngo mtshar che/ /skyid sdug gnyis la 'dam ka da rung 'dug /ro snyoms lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /nges 'byung drag po rgyud la skyes pa dang / /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod pa ngo mtshar che/ /snang yul rkyen khang 'chor nyen da rung 'dug /gnas la nges pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang grol chen po sems la shar ba dang / /shes sgrib bag la zha ba ngo mtshar che/ / yengs ma lam gyi chom rkun da rung 'dug /rtogs pa'i lo tog smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi bar 'jigs pa med tshe mthong tsa na/ /snying rje rtsol med skye ba ngo mtshar che/ /ngag 'khyal dbus na tshig rtsub brjod mi lang / //spra /sdi /kāswā tārdo byi zloshā byin gyis slobs/ /klog pa thos bsam dang 'brel 33
rdzu/nga rdob pa bas ba

——— sgyu namogurabe/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo//rtse khri'am pho shī0sku'ir/༄7/ci'i radharmadha tsatsakra/༄༅//snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo der//mamapho/ma'i〈khrimarmāsgo'i/ar+yasanāthalalitasunirte/gdod ma'i mgon pos gar brtses pas//maram sarmā'i 'amachu'ijilokā mu|lha/tsayatasma/snang ba mtha' grol klong yangs gdangs//90chusam0mthethe'amartso btaskamāshusanamuk+tarak+ta:ci gar ma bcos lhug par bskyangs//

༄༅/ /ci shar ma bcos lhug par bskyangs/ /de tshe mgrin pa'i khang mdzes nas/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can mas/ /shin tu snyan pa'i pi wang la nges pa don gyi glu zhig blangs/ /rang bzhin dga' dang skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur so skye'i rnam rtog phra rags kyi/ /snang tshul yi che'i brjod pas sgrub pa grub pa'i ngang tshul ma yin kyang //las 'brel can rnams chos la bskul ba'i lhag bsam khur dang 'grogs pa'i gtam/ /bya bral ral pa'i thor tshugs can des dad ldan sems kyi rten du bkod//de nas rang lo so gcig pa sna tshogs zhes pa sa mo yes lor dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i thugs rjes lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi dam bca'i mtshams gegs med du thems/ grol dbang dang dngos grub len chog sbrags ma'i dga' ston la 'dab ldan g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i dga' tshal nas sbyin bdag zhal ngo rnams 'dzom/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas tshe dbang dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ nye ltos bar ma'i 'gro ba kun kyi phyag mchod kyi yul du bzung yang blo dred kyi dogs pa dung nge byas/ da ni chags pa dang sdang ba la sogs te nyes pa mi bzad pa'i 'byung khungs pha yul dang grwa tshang gi zhen 'khris mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor/ gnas nges med la pha gzhis kyi mthil bcol/ gang byung des chog gi ngang nas rgyal khams kyi gces phrug gzhon nu zhig byed bsam pa kho na las med pa'i tshe nye ltos dag na re/ da 'di nas phyogs 'gro sogs byas na mi 'gab pa'i sha tsha yin yin gyi bslab byas bslu brid kyi btson rar 'jug pa 'dug /de'i tshe sna nga ba byung rgyal gyi glus rang gis rang la 'di skad ces bskul lo/ /e ma ho/ /bstan nga// 7

bdag po shākya seng ge/ /ljongs 'di'i lha skal phyag na pad+ma/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus yorgyan chen por/ /snying nas mos pas gsol ba 'debs so/ /dred po'i blo sna chos la bsgyur mdzod/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin gang la bsam kyang / /skyo shas nges 'byung cong rdo chen po/ /da res dal 'byor rin chen thob kyang / /mi tshe phal cher stong par zad 'dug/snying nas dam chos byed lo byas kyang / /chos brgyad rnam g.yeng zol dang 'dres 'dug /'dod yon lam 'khyer sngags la spyad kyang / /nyon mongs dug lnga rang rgyud shor 'dug /sde dgon khrod du bsam gtan bsgoms kyang / /shi gson dkor gyis 'pho ba 'gyangs 'dug /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sgom blo byas kyang / /mthu nus grags pa'i phyi la shor 'dug /ka dag rang ngo rjen par shes kyang / /rjes thob nyams kyi shun pa bsdad 'dug/mtha' grol klong yangs rtogs par shar yang / /mtshan mo'i rmi lam 'khrul bar gol 'dug /gzhan la dge bskul snying gtam bshad kyang / /ngag bkyal phyar ku'i rgyu ru song 'dug /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan/ /deng sang 'gro ba'i thog du babs 'dug/da ni cis kyang dgos med bsams nas//lha chos gsha' ma snying nas byed do/ /gong ma'i gdan sa byin rlabs che yang / /chos bzhin spyod sa dben gnas ri sul/ /'dris med bshes med lung stong 'grims shig /'bul ba med na bla dpon mi mnyes/ /mang 'gyed med na grwa tshogs su dga'/ /longs spyod med na mched grogs 'du 'bral/ /'khor 'bangs med na kun gyi brnyas shing / /bstan 'gro'i don yang grub pa ci zhig /lung dang rig pa rtogs pa'i yon tan/ /dbu ma'i sgrubs na zhal 'dzum dmul dmul/ /bsgrub tshugs bzung na 'jungs med tha sha' / da na bcos brtsam na 38

kha bshad tshig skam/ /'khor slob 'dus na gyi nar khrel brdas/ /nyams rtogs gleng na kha lta rbad khams/ /des na shel la ya mtshan sus bya/ /shel rang sbas lung skyog mor bzhogs mdzod/ /kye ho/ /gnyug ma'i gnas la ma chags/ /sgom thag 'khor gcig sked la dkris te/ /g.ya' rdza gangs stongs ri sul kun tu/ /snang ba gtad med chen por thong mdzod//de ru 'du 'dzi'i gzeb las grol te//me long rdo rje lta bu'i shul lam/ /snyogs nas gtan srid zin par mdzod cig /ces smras/ de'i tho rengs rgyal rnga brdung ba'i cha na bdag cag dpon slob gsum gyi sus kyang ma tshor bar/ phu'i ri khrod mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su skyo ba seng ba la phyin/ zhang rigs sgom chen dam pa na re/ mdang nya mgo gru yin zer ba zhig tu zhugs nas gtsang po'i dkyil du slebs tsa na/mi mang po na re/ltos dang rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje nam mkha' la phebs 'dug zer/bltas tsa na nyid he ru ka pa'i chas su byas nas snang / sngar tsha bo'i 'du shes dang mos gus chung ba'i skyon sel du go gsungs/ de nas bzung dag snang dpe med mdzad/ dam tshig shin tu gtsang bas sa skya pa'i gser chos su grags pa mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi byin brlabs zhus pas/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po dang / tshar pa chos rje/ mkha' spyod bzhugs stangs mtshar ba de bcas nyams snang la shin tu gsal bar mthong / lar shan+ta de was/ skad cig gcig gi 'dza' 'gyur la/ /yud tsam gyis ni dgrar yang 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i gnas la khro byed pas/ /so so skye bo mgu bar dka'/ /zhes sems can rang rang gi ngang tshul ston pa la rings pa'i chu skyar dang byi la'i sde tshogs mthong yang gnyen gshin par 'grogs/g.yon can gyi ngag gis gshung zhing brkyal ku'i sa 39

bon 'debs pa'ang brag ca lta bur shes pas chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang du brdal nas gzhan don byed dgos pa la da lta de'i dus ma yin/ /'on kyang mos pa can gyi ngor sman gyi bsgrub chen yid sbo ba zhig btsugs pa'i grol dbang la phyogs de'i skye bo phal cher 'dus/ pa la chos dang dam rdzas kyi 'brel ba btags shing smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab/ bdud rtsi nas chu 'go /lha tshugs/ sa gnad la sogs par bsgrub gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bum gter dang bcas sa bcud gso ba'i rten 'brel yang bgyis/ de'i tshe rig pa dwangs shing snang ba thams cad bde stong 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba byung bas cog pu'i 'og nas mgur ma don gyi bskyed rim la sbyar ba 'di byas so/ /rgyu rgyu rgyu/ rdu gsum sku gsum thugs kyi sa bon yin/ /hūṃ gsum dug gsum 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin/ /rgyu gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs srog yin/ /r+ghaṃ las lhag pa'i snying po ga la yod/ /hūṃ gnyis log 'dren 'dul ba'i mtshon cha yin/ /rgya 'dre 'byung po 'dul ba'i gshed ma yin/ /sde brgyad gnad la 'bebs pa'i drag sngags yin/ /drag po r+ghaṃ ji ngang skad kyu ru ru/ /hū/ snang grag phyag rgya'i 'khor lor rdzogs tsa na//khams gsum r+ghaṃ gi stong sgras shigs se shig/stong gsum hūṃ gi snang bas yems se yem/ /bstan dgra dam sri'i mgo la chems se chem/ /ju/ snang srid klong lnga mi shigs yum lnga'i dal/ /rang rig bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'khor lor rdzogs/ /rig rtsal dbang thob gyad kyi glu blangs pas/ /'khrul snang 'khor ba'i thun phugs rang sar jib/ /r+ghaṃ/ khams gsum zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng yang / /rig mdangs ye shes 'khor lor rtsal rdzogs pas/ /kun brtags bskyed rim gsal brtan rang dag klong / /rig 40

rtsal gar dgu'i rol par cha la la/ /r+ghaṃ/ rig pa gzhi dbyings klong du phyin pa'i tshe/ /yid dpyod theg pa'i blo sgom rang sar das /dran 'dzin sanyen po'i rtsol ba mthong sar yal/ /dbyings rig dbyer med klong du sos re dal/ nu t+ta : hūṃ hūṃ/ :ཿzhes srog gi snying po bgrangs pa las/ /stong gzugs rdu gi snang ba mkha' 'gror gyur/ /nam mkhas gar khyab mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dal/ /hūṃ bi snang glu brda skad tse re re/ /dug lnga'i rnam rtog sku lngar ya la la/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu rgyu rdu hūṃ/gzhom med r+ghaṃ bi snang glu lnga ldan gyi/ /re dogs spang blang dgas sgrub cham gdal grol/ /lnga ldan pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang der/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i gral du khyod cig byon/ /rdu rgyu hūṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ dus lnga'i gdon gyis gzir rnams snying re rje/ /bde stong chen po'i ngang du dgra gnyen zad/ /spangs thob bral ba'i 'bras bu ngo mtshar che/ /khyab sadal snying pa'i shes pa a la la/ /rgyu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rgyu zhes byas pas rang gzhan thams cad snang ba 'gyur sing sing byung ngo / /rgyal ba bu ram shing pa mchod/ /gang tshe yon bdag zhig gi nang / /klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la//dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid pas//thang zham zhes pa'i phyogs snga yi//chos skad 'di ni sgrog tu byung / /khyed kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa bzhes e myong /gsang sngags nyams su len pa la so so thar ba'i rtags dang cha lugs kyang nges par dgos/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bshad nas yod zer ba la/ngas de shin tu yin/ tshul khrims 'chal bas gsang sngags mi 'grub par gsungs pa'i rgyab skyor la'ang de skad gsung dgos/ nged cag gshis lugs rdzogs pa chen po ri sul dang dben pa kho na la dga' zhing / stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba la nyams len gyi mthil bca'/rtogs pa shar mi shar 4/

mos gus dang bsgrub tshugs kho na la re/ 'phral gyi spyod pa phyi tshig med pa tsam lhur len pa'i bhu su ku ba dag /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa de tsho'i dog 'tshangs byed dgos pa mi 'dug ste/ go yul gyi dbang du byas na/ gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i rten de la don gyi sdom pa gsum ldan du bsgrub dgos pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i skabs nas/ so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i cho gas thob tsam yin/ /de 'dzin mi 'dzin dam tshig dang sdom pa bsru nga mi bsrung la rag las/ de ltar sdom pa de rgyud la gnas phyin chad sngags spyod kyi rten de la so thar gyi rtags dang cha lugs kyang nges nges rtag rtag byed dgos pa'i gzhi cis grub/ khyed ltar na mda' mkhan mchog gis spyod pa'i grub chen sa ra ha pa dang / o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo rnyi la sogs rgya bod kyi paṇa grub sngags la spyod pa mtha' yas pa zhig la gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i skal ba chad cing 'og ma rnam gnyis kyi sdom pas btang ba ste/ don gyi sdom pa'i mtshang ma rig pa min las che byas pas/khong khams pa nga rgyal can rigs grar rtsod pa'i bag chags shin tu 'thas pas/ bzhin gyi mdangs pad+ma rā ga lta bur gnas 'gyur nas skad 'dar ba dang lag ngar sgreng ba chabs cig pas/ 'o na sdom pa'i ngo bo gang la ngos 'dzin zer zhing zhe sdang gi snang mig bltar byung bas/nga snying rje lhang lhang ba byung / khong la zhe sdang 'di langs pa rang res rtog ge'i tshig lan gdab pas lan/ da 'jam po'i ngag gis smra dgos snyam nas/ dge bshes rin po che thugs bden/ ngas bslab gnyer sogs byed ma myong pas ji 42

bzhin shes pa mi 'dug ste/ khyed rang yin ma yin gzhig 'brel gnang ba zhu/kun rdzob nyan thos kyi sdom pa la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas nyes spyod sdom pa gzhir bzhag nas/ gnang bkag gi dbye bas nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims/ /byang chub sems dpa' la de'i steng du dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed de tshul khrims rnam pa gsum/rig pa 'dzin pa la rigs lnga'i sdom pa la sogs te mtha' yas/ de gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ji ltar bsrung na/ mtshan nyid so sor 'dzin pas rang ldog ma 'dres/ gsum mas gcig po de'i rgyud kyi mi dge ba sdom pas dgag dgos yongs rdzogs/ sngags kyi dus na so thar dang byang sems zhes rdzas tha dad pa med pas ngo bo gnas 'gyur/yon tan yar ldan ni pad+ma cod pan las/ dbang gsum bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de ni dge slong chen por gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de dag la'ang gnad kyis mi 'gal ba dang /dus skabs kyi bya bas dbye ba kho bo'i bla ma dri med 'od zer bzhed/ don dam kyi sdom pa ni spyod yul las yid gtso/de'i rgyu mtshan so so thar ba las kyang /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul//'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs//sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo//zhes zer ba yod/sangs rgyas kyis khyim pa'i dkor za bar rjes su gnang ba de ldan pa dang grol ba rnam gnyis yin/ ldan pa ni tshul khrims can dang / grol ba ni stong nyid rtogs pa la yin/ khyed kyi ltar na 'di gnyis kha phral ba la yang dogs pa skye nyen gda'/ so so thar pa'i rtags dang cha lugs can ma gtogs gzhan du 43

gsang sngags kyi brtul zhugs la sogs pas grol ba can 'asa' yang mi srid par khas blangs pa'i phyir/ 'di tsho'i yon tan de sbyangs pa'i yo na tan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa/ gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i lag len la mkhas pa/ ldan grol gyi brtul zhugs la dbang 'byor pa'i 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug lta bu la mnga' ba yin gyi/ gzhan paṇa chen shākya shrīs bod na rje btsun mi la des rtasas dang cho sa byas na btsun pa mtshan nyid pa zhig 'ong thang zhes gsungs pa ltar rang cag byi la'i brtul zhugs kyi tshul khrims mchos 'dzin can la dka' las chen po 'dug pas phan tshun dag snang sbyangs res 'di ka spyan lam bkra ba 'dug byas nas/ snang ba yengs pa ltar tshig go min mi go min gyi dbyangs rta la bskyon nas mgur ma 'di 'dras 'then no/ /kye ho/ snang sems gnyis su med pa'i rang ngo la ltad mo zhig bltas pas//gdod nas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sangs rgyas dang mjal byung ngo / /a ho ye 'bras bu'i grol sa de dag pa gnyis ldan la zhu ba no/ /shāka thub zer ba'i gtsug tor rong rong de yin na dasa' ba la/ /sde snod gsung rab rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod la gzigs dang / /mu stegs zer ba'i rtag chad smra ba rnams ga le bzhugs bzhugs mdzod dang byas e go/ /yum chen shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa khong la 'khyud rgya zhig byas pas/ /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi nyams shig shar byung ngo / /a ho ye bshad pa'i chu 'go de zla ba grags pa la zhu ba no/ /'dzam bu gling gi rgyan drug mchog gnyis de yin na dga' ba la/ /dbu ma chen po'i dgongs pa snying la shar ba la ltos dang / /tshig skam kha la mur ba'i nyan thos nan po tsho ga le bzhugs bzhugs rang mdzod dang byas e go/ /phyag rgya chen po 44

do ha'i dkor mdzod la zhu ba'i lde mig /grub pa'i dbang phyug sa ra ha pa la khong ges gnang byung ngo / /a ho ye sgom pa'i nyams myong de sha wa ri pa la 'dri ba no/ /rgya gar yul gyi grub thob brgyad cu de yin na dga' ba la/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i chang gis bzi ba la ltos dang / /rkang bro glu bzhad la brtul zhugs su 'dzin pa tsho ga le bzhugs bzhugs mdzod dang byas e go/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po khong gtan grogs su bskos pas/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos dga' rab rdo rje yang snying dkyil du phebs byung ngo / /a ho ye rtogs pa'i bogs 'don de kun tu bzang mo la zhu ba no/ /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan bi ma mi tra de yin na dga' ba la/ /lta sgom gyi phu thag zad sar 'khyol ba la gzigs dang / /lha 'dres brlams pa'i grub rtags ngom mkhan tsho ga le bzhugs bzhugs rang mdzod dang byas e go/ /byas pas khong snang ba 'gyur/dbyangs rta snyan snyan sku tshe ring / nga yang rnying ma la mos po yod/ rta mgrin yang gsang 'di gter ston gsum gyis gter nas bton pas shin tu yid ches pa yin u 'di'i sbyin sreg gi dpe cha zhig dang phyag len de dgos pa yod zer/ bla ma la dmod sngags la 'phra/ zhes pa der 'dug go/ /de nas yon bdag pu shud kyi gzhi kur phyin/gur cog la brten nas klu sdings su bsdad/mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog rgyas pa zhig mdzad byung bas nub mo'i mi la na klong yangs bde chen gyi khang mdzes su bud med cig gis yar bzhengs pa zhu dang bzhugs gdan srabs nas mi 'dug zer gos gdan kha sang ma zhig btings byung ba phyis kyi rten 'brel la bltas/ bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog bla na med pa mdzad/ tshes bcu pa rnams la gsang 'dus skum po bzhi dbang dang / yon 45

bdag sku ngo rnams la grol tig lam rgyas pa'i dbang zhig byas/ de nas dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phur bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i dran pa mngon du bzhag nas phyin/ zur mkhar rdo'i mchod rten du tshogs bskangs bgyis pa'i tshe snang ba khral khrol du song / rig pa la dag snang mtha' yas pa shar ba na 'di skad do/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mtshan ma spros bcas kyi dge sbyor la/ /rang 'dod bral ba'i srog mkhar tshugs/ /bskyed rim snod bcud rnam dag la/ /zhen med rang shar gyi gnad cig go/ /mi tshe bsgrub la dril ba la/ /grub rtags mngon shes kyi zhe 'dod bral/ /nor sa gsum gyi phrang las thar//de bdag gi thos pa'i nyer len lags//rdzogs rim gdod nas spros bral la/ /cang med stong pa sgom don med/ /mnyam rjes rig stong zung 'jug la/ /btang bzhag ched 'dzin rang sar dag /tha mal rig pa rang gsal la//dran med har po'i lhad ma zhugs//nor sa gsum gyi phrang las thar/ /de bdag gi bsam pa'i gdeng tshad lags//lhag mthong gang shar rig stong la//brtag dpyad shes bya'i bya ma shor/ /rang bab gzhug ma'i dran pa la/ /yengs kyi dogs pa'i mkhan po med/ /sgom med dmigs gtad bral ba la/ /btang snyoms blos btang dris ma gos/ /nor sa gsum gyi phrang las thar/ /de bdag gi sgom pa'i gdeng tshad lags/ /tha mal gyi tshor ba'i sdug bsngal med/ /zag bcas kyi dge bar zhen pa bral/ /rig pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags bzhin/ /yul gyi gsal char re ltos med/ /rnam rtog dbyings su thim na yang / /dran med mun pa'i gzeb las grol/ /'dod khams dang gzugs khams gzugs med lha//6/gol sa gsum gyi zang las thar//thug phrad kyi shes pa gu yangs la//spros

bral 'dug pa mngon du gyur/ /'di bdag gi 'bras bu'i skyel so lags/ /zhes smras/de nas bsam yas marims phu'i dge'u 'og nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i sgrub phug tu grags pa der slebs/ brag phug gi steng thams cad ni jigs pa'i bla bre bres/nang thams cad rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil/zwa tshod la sogs te sngo ngad sna tshog pa'i myu gus khyab/ tshe 'di'i snang bar rang sar ldog nus pa'i sa der rang nyid gcig pur 'dug/char zhod shin tu che bas phug pa'i phyi nang la skam rlon mi 'dug pas 'gag stongs der grong pa'i skye bo zhig la spe'u dkar po zhig g.yar ba nyin mtshan med pa'i gos su byas/ sgos mdza' dang byams skyong mkhan ni nyin mo'i skar ma las med pas 'gol zhing nyams rtogs la shan phyed/grub thob gong ma'i shul lam snyogs snyam pa'i blo bde seng nge ba kho na byung / re zhig nas ja sdor la sogs te bcud ldan gyi zas rnams 'ja' lus 'grub tu nye/ sngar skyid po 'ba' zhig ma gtogs sdug po zhig ma myong ste/ tshargyan chen po'i sgrub gnas su snying po don gyi bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa 'di bsod nams gang las kyang che/ zas dka' thub bcud len la brten dgos byung kyang bsgrub pa'i dam bca' mi ldog snyam pa'i zhe bcad drag po skyes/sems can rnyed pa med la smod/ /rnyed pa can la mi snyan brjod/ /rang bzhin 'grogs dka' de dag gi//dga' ba ji ltar skye bar 'gyur//zhes pa ni bden po rang snang / chags zhen med pa'i gnas su 'dug tsa na brag phug gang na min pa 'di 'drar bsdad zer phyar ka sgrogs/zla bo dag nas kyang de bzhin mi 'thad dam zhes smra ba la 'di skad ces spro ba bskyed do/ /pha rdo rje'i slob dpon pad 'byung dang gcig /bu dag pa'i 'khor slob rje 'bangs dang gnyis/ /47

gnas bras dmar dpal gyi mchims phu dang gsum/ /tshul de gsum 'dzom pa'i rnam thar de gsan tam/ /gnas dben pa'i brag phug bsam gtan gyi rdzong chen/ /'khor 'du 'dzi'i kha rul zhen chags kyi rtsa ba/ /nga ri sul 'grim pa yul med ni ma lags/ /rje grub thob gong ma'i shul lam du 'dug bo/ gnas bdag 'dzin gyis nga bdag zhen pa dang gcis /rdo ngos 'jam gyis cig pa 'i sa mkhar dang gnyis/ /thugs dar cog gis brgyan pa'i gnas khang dang gsum/ /'di gsum bsgrub na sprang pos kyang 'grub tshod na sada' ste/ /tshe nges med 'di bsams nas brag phug bzung ba lags/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms shig ma ched grogs tsho/ /sa 'jam legs kyi zhal ba srubs med dang gcig /shing mdzes bzhogs kyi ka bdung sra mkhregs dang gnyis/ /tshon khra 'byed gyi ldebs bris shing rtsi dang gsum/ /'di gsum bsgrub na sprang pos kyang 'grub tshod na gda' ste/ /tshe nges med 'di bsams nas brag phul bzung ba lags/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms shig mched grogs tsho/ /rten mchod bshams kyi bkra mdzes gzi brjid dang gcis/thab phyis bdar gyi skyogs zangs rnam bkra dang gnyes/ /gzan sham thabs kyi cha lhab ngom khyer dang gsum/ /'di gsu ma bsgrub na sprang pos kyang 'grub tshod na gda' ste/ /tshe nges med 'di bsams nas brag phug bzung ba lags/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms shig mched grogs tsho/ /sde dpon chen gyi ngo 'dzin 'gro phyogs dang gcig /rnga 'ur choms kyis bsrung bzlog gsad gnan dang sanyis/ /lto yas thags kyi za 'tho 'tshol ba dang gsum/ /'di gsum bsgrub na sprang pos kyang 'grub tshod na gda' ste/ /tshe nges med 'di bsams nas brag phus bzung ba lags/ /mi rtag rache ba soms shis 48

mched grogs tsho/ /'gran sems chags sdang gi rigs lam bsla ba gnyer dang gcig /rang rgyud gnya' rengs kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang gnyis/ /rang don cha med kyi gzhan don 'ur langs dang gsum/ /'di gsum bsgrub na sprang pos kyang 'grub tshod na gda' ste/ /tshe nges med 'di bsams nas brag phug bzung ba lags/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms shig mched grogs tsho/ /lha med 'dre med kyi las 'bras khyad gsod dang gcig/stong lta yug 'byams kyi gdol spyod brtul zhugs dang gnyis/ /chang bzi smyo 'grogs kyi 'bas bro ldar ldir dang gsum/ /'di gsum bsgrub na sprang pos kyang 'grub tshod na sada' ste//tshe nges med 'di bsams nas brag phus bzung ba lags/ /mi rtag 'chi ba soms shig mched grogs tsho/ /a ho/ /pha pad 'byung dang dga' rab shrī seng / /rje mi la dang lo ras dwasas po sogs / /khong phyag rdzogs kyi paṇa grub thams cad kyis/ /gnas bras khung bzung nas dngos grub thob//bdag de dag la mig ltos zhu ba lags//rje klong chen dang zur pa mes dbon gsum/ /khong rdzogs chen mched bzhi'i rnam thar gyi/ /mi kho bo'i yid kha phrogs pa las/ /'ud che tshad la ba spu mi ldang tsam/ /sprang ltos med kyi spyod pa skyong ba lags/ /tshe mi rtag snying nas dran pa des/ /gnas nges med du bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /ngas 'khor bar zhen pa'i gnong 'gyod med/ /blo gtum kyang 'dod kha rdzogs pa lags/ /chos rdzogs pa chen po bsgom bsgom pas//don mngon sum rig pa gnad la phebs//da 'khor bar mi ldog blo thag chod/ /da dung zad par 'khyol ba zhig byed pa lags/ /sngon tshe rabs mang por tshogs bsags pas/ /chos rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam mjal/ /gzhi ka dag chen po'i dgongs pa lon/ /chos bor kyang yengs su 49

med pa lags/ /'chad rtsod dang rtsom pa'i klong brdol kyang / 'dis las rlung rgyu ba 'phel dgas nas/ /da tshig la rtog dpyid mi gtang bar/ /don yin lugs kyi steng du 'jog pa lags//gnas brag khung brten pa dam pa'i lugs//sde sa mkhar 'dzin pa khyim pa'i srol/ /nga'i skyon yon phal gyi mi rtogs pas/ /gnas nges med la skur pa mi 'debs 'tshal/ /tshul de skad drang gtam rjen pa'i glu/ /lar rang gcigs skyes pa ma lags te/ /gnas dben pa'i brag khung brten pa'i tshe/ /khyod sa mkhar bzhag nas brag khung brten/ /bcos ga log ces sgro skur byed pa'i dus/ /bdag thol byung rang grol rnal 'byor pas/ /yid skyo ba seng ba'i mgur du bzhengs/ /'di chos mdzad yongs kyi thugs la 'phrod//gnong can snying gi tsher mar byed//rkun nor bzhin du a tham rgya//zhes so/ /de nas 'dab ldan g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i tshal nas mgo dung las dkar ba'i mi rgan zhig 'tsho ba'i yo byad bskyel du byung bas thog drangs chad bskyel rgyun mar byung / der lhan skyes ḍāk+ki'i brda ston ltar me tog phug par 'dug gnas bzos shing /steng la sgo skyor 'jag skyobs la sogs pas re zhig 'dug tu rung bar byas/ de'i ring blon chen gur dkar phug gi ri rtser gnas 'brel byed du lhags pa'i tshe 'od gsal thod rgal gyi nyams la spro ba brtas pa'i glu/ pha bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'//skyabs rig 'dzin rje 'bangs rgya mtsho rnams/ /bu'i de ring snying gi dkyil nas dran/ /yang lcags pho 'brug lo gro bzhin nyar/ /sprang chos med in+d+ra ma ri ca/ /dpal mchims phu'i blon chen mgul du bskyod/ /der shes pa yul phyir 'brengs pa yi/ /sems tshogs drug gi ltad mo 'di ltar mngon/ /ri mthon po 50

gnam gyi ka ba 'dra'i/ /'dabs g.ya' dang rdza yi mgul pa mdzes/ /steng phyogs na thang dkar rgod smug 'phyo/ /logs gsham na lha bya gong mo rgyu/ khong bra byi'i tshogs kyang mi rtag sgom/ /gzugs can gyi skye po'i rgyu 'grul med/ /gung ba rnams bcud la lding zhing g.yo//gnas ngo mtshar can de'i rtse mo na//lhun grub rang byung gi gur dkar phub/ /brag dbyibs ni rus sbal sum pa 'dra/ /steng lho sprin smug po'i bla bre bres/ /bar sbrang char zim bu'i ཿda pan 'phur/ /bya rog dag chung stong sgra sgrogs/ /sku gsum ye bab kyi dgongs pa la/ /lhun grub thod rgal gyi 'ja' ris 'khyil/ /thig le dang lug rgyud zim bur g.yo/ /dus de tshe me lhas dbang ba'i sa/ /gnas yar klungs pad+ma shel phug gi/ /steng yang thog zla gam lta bu yi/ /'ja' tshon sna snga pa gur du 'khyil/ /der o rgyan mngon sum byon no snyam/ /mig chu bur dbang shes zug bzhin du/ /don spros pa med pa'i dbang bzhi blangs/ /gtad med kyi shes pa spros bral la/ /ye bab kyi gnas lugs lhun gyis grub/ /kun rdzob tu bde nyams dpag tu med/ /don dam du bde sdug mtha' las grol/ /dus de tshe rdo rje'i mched po yis/ /dpal rdo rje'i mgur las byon pa yi/ /lhun grub gyi gtam gsum dgos so skad/ /der dran rig cham grol so ma'i gdangs//snang ba dpe gras kyi mgur 'di blangs//ho ho/ /mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs na//khong thang dkar smug po gshog rtsal ngom//bu nga rang yang snang sems gzhi grol klong / /gtad med kyi nam mkhar yengs med 'phyo/ /dma' dog mo sa gzhi'i skyed tshal na/ /khong rtsi shing nags tshal lo 'dab g.yo/ /bu nga rang yang nyams myong gong 'phel phyir/ /rnam rtog la rig pa'i rtsal sbyong byed/ /bar 'dod khams mi yi yul gru na/ /sman mtshar sdug kun 51
