gos rgyan gzabs mchor ngom/ /bu nga rang yang mtha' grol klong yangs ngang / /phyi yul snang gi 'char sgo rgyan char 'dogs/ /mtsho sngon mo g.yu zhal 'khyil 'dra'i ngang / /khong gar mkhan tsho 'gyur lcam mnyen lhag 'khril/ /bu nga rang yang snang sems bsre ba'i phyir/ /rgya mtsho cos bzhag la gdar sha gcod/ /gnas sde dgom chen po'i chos ra na/ /khong dge bshes tsho dgag sgrub mtha' med mdzad/ /bu nga rang yarno mtha' brgyad spros bral ngang / /'khor 'das rgyab gyes kyi rigs lam gtong / /khri mthon po dar gos 'bol brtsegs steng / /khong bla chen tsho phrin las cir yang ston//bu nga rang yang rten 'brel lam slong phyir//sems rig shan 'byed kyi lta sgom skyong / /phyi bkod mdzes kyi khang gzhis skyid po'i nang / /khong mi dpon tsho 'bangs la nyal thag gcod/ /bu nga rang yang brag phug rang gsham nang / /kun rtog yul 'byams la drag 'jun byed/ /sdug khyim thab mang po'i go ra na/ /khong ma rgan rnams 'khor ba'i so nam rem/ /bu nga rang yang gnyug ma'i brtul zhugs dang / /sa lam gzhi grol gyi dgongs pa bskyangs/ /spang sngo ljang g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal steng / /khong rdzi bo rnams phyugs lug skyong bran byed/ /bu nga rang yang rnam rtog lu gu rgyud/ /lhag mthong rtog med kyi ra bar 'dzud/ yul lam phrang dang dben pa'i bas mtha' ru/ /khong jag rkun rnams mtha' med mas sprad rem/ /bu nga rang yang 'jig rten chos brgyad la/ /snang ba gdong 'ded kyi 'phrog bcom byed/ /gnas nges med kyi rgyal khams yangs po cher/ /khong rtogs ldan rnams sgo khyi'i 'gram rus gcog /bu nga rang yang dgongs klong yangs pa'i ngogs/ /gzung 'dzin khyi rgan gyi ltag rtsa spur/ /khyim phun tshogs kyi sgo phyi khang skor na/ /khong gces phrug tsho yul la rtsed mo rtse/ /52

bu nga rang yang ma bcos gzhug ma'i grong //yul can rig kha'i rtsed 'jor rol/ /'khor ba na 'di 'dra'i gzigs mo snang //myang 'das la legs nyes blang dor bral/ /sems kun gzhi gcig la rnam 'gyur brgya/ /rig ma rig gi me long ngos su shar/ /de snang ba dpe la gas pa yin/ /dpe de nyid don la sbyor ba yin//don de nyid tshig gis bkral ba na/ /khong snod bcud phal gyi thugs la gzan//blo nang du bkug na bden pa'i gtam/ /mi go ba can gyis dpyad na shes/ /nged brgyud pa bzang po'i bu brgyud 'di/ /re dogs kyi srad bu phra sar gcod/ /nyams 'ur tshe snang srid glu ru len//gnas mi med ri sul dben phug 'grims//sems khong grol bsgrub pa 'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs/ /ka dag chos zad kyi grub mtha' snyogs/ /'di gcig tu 'ud gog rngam po che/ /gnyis su drang gtam bden po che/ /gsum du dgongs pa rang shar tshig /ri gnam la co 'dri 'dra ba'i rtser/ /klong chen mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ /bre mo'i tshul du bgyis pa lags//phyir lam mtsho rgyal phug tu gnas 'brel zhag tu longs pa byas pa'i tshe gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlabs pas brtul zhugs rol pa'i glu/skyabs pad 'byung rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma ye shes mtsho rgyal snying nas dran/ /bdag khams gsum yid can thams cad dang / /dgos gsol 'debs bu la thugs rjes gzigs/ /tshe mi rtag g.yang kha'i byi'u 'dra/ /'di 'gyur bar nges kyang chos ma dran/ /las 'di bya'i tig po med pa'i ngang / /gzhon so dkar gyi mi tshe bud de thal/ /bu de ring bsam bzhin snying rlung langs/ /las mtha' med 'khor ba'i btson ra 'dir/ /sngon thog med dus nasad bar 'khyams/ /chos byed lo'i ngang la mi tshe zad/ /dgra 'chi bdag byung na ji ltar byed/ /tshe 'di yi 53

snang ba za zi kun/ /rtag mi thub nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /ding gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam kun/ /tshe phyi ma'i 'khrul snang dang khyad par med/ /'di bsam bzhin snying rlung dbang med langs/ /nga'i bla ma o rgyan chos rje dang / /nga'i mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal lcam/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /dus de ring mjal na skyid pa la/ /gnas ya mtshan dpal gyi mchims phu yi/ /lhun grub rang byung gi mtsho rgyal phug /yum rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i phyag rgya/ /brag shel gyi mchod rten brtsegs pa 'dra//'dabs g.yu lo 'khyil ba'i nags tshal khrod//khong bya tshogs bung ba gsung glu snyan/ /gnas 'di 'dra'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sems gya gyu'i 'khrul rtog rang sar 'gags/ /nyams sna kha ma non thod rgal bskyangs/ /las bya byed 'khor ba'i rnam rtog zhig /don de phyir bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /dus snyigs ma'i spyod tshul ya ma brla/ /gshes gang la brtags kyang snying po med/ /pha grub thob gong ma'i bshul lam snyogs/ /chos rdzogs pa chen por gdar sha chod/ /dkor sha zan nag po'i sde gog dang / /yid zhen chags sgyu ma'i nor rdzas spongs/ /blo dgos med zhen log snying bcang mdzod/ /dus da res 'khor bar phyi phyag tshol/ /phyi nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog dang / /nang rnam rtog gya gyu'i sgyu 'phrul gnyis/ /dus skad cig tsam yang rtag pa med/ /rtag mi rtag blo 'das gnyug ma'i ngang / /gshis kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal klong / /dus gsum gyi rnam rtog kha yan glod/ /tshogs drug gi yul snang rang sar 'gags/ /chos 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po la/ /snang sems dang skye 'chi'i 'du shes med/ /ye bab kyi rang gshis lhug pa'i ngang / /chos zad kyi rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur/ /ho ho/ /stag lpags dang rus rgyan khro 54

lo lo/ /dril chung dang g.yer kha si li li/ /lhun grub kyi thor tshugs ldems se ldem/ /cang te'u dang gling bu kyu ru ru//nges med kyi gnyan khrod 'grim pa'i tshe/ /re dogs kyi rnam rtog rdzun po ches//'khor 'das kyi bar lag thad kur 'byed//klong grol gyi rig pa hur spyod skyongs/ /dga' rab dang 'jam dpal shrī seng / /pad 'byung dang bi ma klong chen sogs/ /je nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi dgongs rgyud yin/ /bdag dpon slob tsho brgyud pa bzang po'i bu/ /blo bde gu yangs la rgyun chad med/ /gzung 'dzin la phaṭa kyi gtor ma rgyob/ /lta sgom la ming 'dogs bya rgyu med/ /byar med ngang du sa lam rdzogs/ /tha mal gyi shes rig lhod yangs so/ /a la la chags med zhen dral ngang / /'khor 'das kyi re dogs 'ja' ltar yal/ /sku gsum gyi 'bras bu gzhi la rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /der gcung sgrub g.yog kyang gnas su slog /re zhig rang gcig phur mtshams shin tu dam par bcad pa'i tshe chig ri la ngo mtshar skyes pa'i mgur dran pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba ni/ gnas ngo mtshar can dpal gyi mchims phu na/ /rang byung lhun grub kyi me tog phug /phral thigs tshags dang 'dzin spras ma dgos shing / /phugs bdag 'dzin gyi zhen pas mi 'ching ba'i/ /'bu shubs thon gyi gzhal med khang chen snang / /sgrub khang 'di rnal 'byor ba'i rgyan du che//pha rang byung pad+mas bdag la stsal//grogs snying rus can rnams 'di ru sgoms//phyi lus gnad lhun grub kyi bya skyibs nang / /rdo thab rdza khog gi 'khor 'bangs can/ /shing skam me 'bar gyi khol po rnams/ /phral bsdu yar dang khrigs bcad ma dgos shing / /phugs rnam dpyod kyi zhen chags mi skye ba'i/ /gar bzhag 'dol 'dol gyi zham ring ba/ /nye gnas 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du che/ /bya 55

ba blos btang gis nga la stsal/ /grogs 'du long can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ /nang bkod pa lus kyi pho brang na/ /lha rang sems su shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyi mtshan ma'i dal la ma ltos shing / /snang stong zung 'jug tu lhun grub pas//phral gsung chog dang ḍa dril ma dgos shing / /phugs 'du 'bral med pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /yi dam 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du che/ /'di rnam smin rig 'dzin gyis nga la stsal/ /grogs dbang rnon can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ /phyi dag snang can gyi yul grong nas/ /zas mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i yon gyi bdag /phral dgongs len dang rim gro ma dgos shing / /phugs bsngo smon btsan pos mtshams sbyor ba'i/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyi rnam thar can/ /yon bdag 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du che/ /pha rtsa gsum rgya mtshos nga la stsal/ /khyed dag snang can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ /spu ne tso lta bur snying sdug la/ bzhin pad dkar lta bur bkra ba'i bya/ /phral gtam lan gzhal yang ma dgos la/ /phugs mgu 'khang chags sdang mi skye ba'i/ /skyo rogs kyi bya wang bsam med po/ /mdza' grogs 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du che/ /byams snying rje'i sbyin lag yangs pos stsal/ grogs byang sems can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ dbyings rnam dag sgron ma'i pho brang na/ /mngon sum rig pa'i gar rtsed mkhan/ /lam srog rtsol gnad du chud pa'i mthus/ /phral las rlung gi g.yo bar mi nus shing / /phugs gnas lugs yid dpyod du mi gol ba'i/ /lta sgom 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du che/ /lam snyan brgyud zab mos nga la stsal/ /grogs las 'phro can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ /sde gyang rol gyi zhen chags snying nas thongs/ /khyu mang po dang 'grogs pas sna gtun 'phog /tshe stod kyi bya bzhag phal cher brjed/ /da lta'i rig pa tha 56

mal pa/ /phral kha 'dzin gyi rtsis gdab ma dgos la/ /phugs gang dgar yan pa'i blo bde mkhan/ /da dung khyu nas mi byol re/ /ltos med 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du rmu /'ur gtum thag chod kyis nga la༄la/ /grogs thar 'dod can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ /skyabs mtsho skyes rdo rjes dbyings nas gzigs/ /pha drin cen bla mas dgongs rgyud 'pho/ /ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bar chad sol/ /phral bya byed mang po mi dgos shing / /phugs sku gsum rang rtsal rdzogs pa yi/ /skyid nyal 'di rnal 'byor pa'i rgyan du che/ /mnyam rjes dbyer med kyis nga la stsal/ /grogs sgom nyams can rnams de 'dra mdzod/ /dpe brgyad don brgyad kyi mgur ma 'di/ /gnas 'og min dpal kyi brag phug tu/ /rkyen zhe sun drag pos mtshams sbyar nas/ /rang gcig pur 'dug la skyid snang tshor/ /nyams bde stong chen por 'bar ba'i tshe/ /pha tshergyan yul gyi mkhas pa che'i/ /bu chos med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ /tshig blo la shar nas yi ger bris/ /don nyams su len pa'i bskus mar bzhag/grogs dag snang can tsho mnyes par shog/dus 'di dag tu rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i ye shes kyi sku dang lan gsum mjal zhing byin gyis brlabs pas/ /kun tu bzang po'i chos 'khor du 'dus pa la spro nas/ /bla ma bzang po 6rgyan chos rje la zhus pas/ /byin rlabs zab mo dgongs rgyud spros bral de babs byung / /lta sgom ye bab sku gsum lhun grub 'di dga' yo/ /nyams len byar med blo 'das ye grol 'di skyid do/ /yi dam bzang po pad+ma snying tig la zhus pas/ /bskyed rim zab mo snang stong zung 'jug dang mjal byung / /rang sems mngon rdzogs lha skur song ba de dga' yo/ /rnam smin rig 'dzin tshe 'dir thob pa de skyid do/ /mkha' 57

'gro bzang po rdo rje rnal 'byor la zhus pas/ /phrin las zab mo dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod de brdol byung //tha snyad tshig la bslab gnyer ma dgos pa dga' yo/ /snang grag brda dang dpe char song ba de skyid do/ /rgyud pa bzang po byin rlabs don rgyud la zhus pas/ /dbang bzhi'i nyams rtogs bum pa gang byo ru stsal byung / /rig pa'i rtsal dbang rang la yod pa 'di dga' yo/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i tha snyad zad pa 'di skyid do/ /don dbang zab mo dri med 'od zer la zhus pas/ /thugs sras las can rtogs grol dus mnyam la langs song / /dka' spyad sdug bcir zhe 'dod ma dgos pa dga' yo/ /byar med lhug pa'i rgyal sa zin pa 'di skyid do/ /nyams len bzang po rdzogs pa chen po la zhus pas/ /gnas lugs zab mo chos nyid mngon sum dang mjal byung / /rig pa'i gsal mdangs phyi la gsal pa 'di dga' yo/ /lam rtags zab mo nang du mngon pa 'di skyid do/ /myur lam zab mo snyan brgyud pho nya la zhus pas/ /lta sgom zab mo lhod lhod 'bol 'bol dang mjal byung / /rlung sems dbu mar dbang du 'dus pa 'di dga' yo/ /snang sems dbyer med zang kha rgya yan 'di skyid do/ /sgrub khang bzang po brag phug rang gsham la zhus pas/ /'od gsal zab mo gzhon nu bum sku dang mjal byung / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rtsa gdar chod pa 'di dga' yo/ blo bde gu yangs chags med zhen bral 'di skyid do/ /gsang lam zab mo khregs chod a ti la zhus pas/ /da lta'i rig pa kun tu bzang po la longs so/ /bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod ḍa dril mi dgos pa dga' yo/ /shes pa gdong gtad sgom la song ba 'di skyid do/ /chos skyong zab mo dam can sde bdun la zhus pas//phrin las bzang po re dogs tshar gcod dang gnang byung //58

gsol mchod ma dgos stong grogs mdzad pa 'di dga' yo / /phrin bcol ma dgos chad mtho bsrung ba de skyid do/ /dga' skyid 'dzom pa phyogs kyi grangs ldan gyi thol byung / /gsung gi dben gnas mchims phu dge'u yi phug tu/ /'khos med sprang po mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis blangs pas/ /kun gyi rgyud la nyams rtogs 'bar ba zhig zhu'o/ /zhes so/ /'di'i tshe mi nyams 'dres pa zhig la/ mi gos ne kha gyon zhing sdum bag chags la gtsug skra lan bur mdud pa zhig sgrub phug 'gag der 'ongs/ nged du phyag gsum btsal/ them pa la mgo bo btsugs te 'di skad ces gleng ngo / /snga phan mjal thengs gsum song ba'i rjes ma dmar nag rak+ta'i phyogs su mjal ba de yin/ da nang nged gdan 'dren la 'ongs pa lags pas cis kyang phebs dgos zer/ khyed su yin nged lo gsum gyi dam bca' ma rdzogs par 'gro thabs med/ dus nam 'ong dgos byas pas/ sang gnangs las ma 'gyangs par pheb dgos zer gtsug sku'i lan bu la shog tshar zhig 'dug pa bstan byung ba bklags pas/ 'das dang ma 'das so mtshams (mkhas pa kha cig 'das ma 'das kyi so mtshams thams cad la dpyad pa byed mod kyang / kun mkhyen gyis/ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /ye shes grub kyang las kyi pho nyar ston/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyogs gnyis ka 'gal ba med par bsgrub shes so/ /)nas/ /mngags pa'i bang phyin 'di yin no/ /zer ba 'dug /nag po chen po yin par go ste spros bral du bzhag pas nyams mis de sad/ phyogs der gtan du mi chags pa'i brda ston tsam du 'dug /rgyud lung man ngag rnams nas lung bstan la dngos 'dzin gyi rab gnas byed par ma bshad na/ ri sul gyi rnal 59

'byor par shar grol dus mnyam gyi dngos grub la sgrib pa mngon sum tshad ma lags/de'i tshe mtha' med 'khor ba'i btson rar nges 'byung drag po ni skyes/tshe 'di'i legs nyes dang blang dor thams cad khron pa'i nang du rdo 'phangs pa ltar phyi tshig dang re dogs med pa'i blo rgod langs/ mi tshe la tshad btsugs nas snying po'i don la res 'jog med par yin lugs bzo med du skyong ba'i ne bcad drag po'ang skyes/ sdug bcir zhe lus dang khong bsran tsam la bsgrub pa'i pho tshugs re ma dgos/ ring mo zhig nas rig pa'i gnas lugs gu yangs rang grol chen por la zlos/ ji lta ba'i dgongs rgyud rgyal dbang pad+ma yab yum gyi thugs rjes snying gis rdzing bur byos pas ji snyed pa'i mkhyen pa'i klong dbyar gyi chu bo ltar brdol/ snang ba gdong 'ded rang bab byung rgyal las/su'i kha la nyan yang chos dang ni mthun pa dka'/ 'jig rten lugs dang ma mthun kyang dang du rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung dpang por bzhag nas zhib mor 'thag pa'i snying stobs ni bskyed/rgyal ba gong ma'i byin rlabs zhugs/dag snang can gyi mkhan slob dang / sgom chen la sogs pa yang dag pa'i don la mos pas dpyod pa dang / rnal ma'i lam mthong ba dang / the chom gyi sgrog tu chud pa ji snyed kyi sar rang bzhin sol ba dang / gegs skyon sel ba dang /mngags sar bstod pa dang / mngon pa'i nga rgyal rtsa gdar gcod pa sogs kyi spobs pa rnyed pas chos don gnyer ba'i 'khor slob dga' tsam 'du ba'i mgo tshugs/ 'on tang kho bo cag ni da lta'ang bzang po ma yin la/ gdod nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gdung dang sprul skur ming gi ma snyan pas lo gsum btang ba'i grwa pa la khrid zhus nas zer mi mthun par blta/las 60

'phro ngan pa'i khyim btsun ma yan chod kyi kha zer ba dang phyar ka gtong ba'i skabs kyang btsal/ /de'i tshe 'di snyam du/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul du sgom par bya/ /zhes pa de snying thag pa nas dran/ tshig lan smra ba lta ci bskyar zlos tsam yang ma byas so/ /de lta na'ang rang nyid la dag pa'i snang ba ches dka' ba dag ma rangs pa dang ngag tshig brlang pos pha rol gyi do zlar blta ba la/ kye grogs po dag 'di ltar shes par gyis shig /byis pa so so skye bo chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi drwa bar 'bums/gzung 'dzin gyi sgrog dam pos bcings/'khor ba'i btson dong chen po gcig nas gnyis su thar med lu gu rgyud du 'khor ba dag gi las dang / bsod nams ma yin pa'i snang ngo ru bdag cag la lta ci/ston mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'ang dge slong lhas byin dang /legs pa'i skar ma/ mu stegs kyi ston pa drug rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas log par bsgrubs pa'i tshul mdo sde dang 'dul ba'i dang du brtags pas shes/de bzhin du rgya gar gyi slob dpon thogs med la smad cing / phyogs kyi glang po lta bu la'ang / phyogs kyi glang po ni mun pa'i glang po'o/ /kun las btus ni mun pa'i kun las btus so zhes gang zag dang gzhung sun phyung ba dang /rgyal sras zhi ba lha lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' la'ang ku su ku 'du shes gsum pa zhes bsgrags/ bod du mkhan slob chos gsum gyi dus bon dang sdig blon gyi snang tshul/ sa phyogs 'dir gdod ma'i mgon po dang zhal mi gnyis pa kun mkhyen klong chen pa lta bu'i rnam dpyod la'ang gshe zhing /skur ba mi bzad pas thugs dbyung ba ni/ khams 'dus me tog 'phreng ldan las/ drang por gnas na 61

rab tu gyong bar mthong / /nor gyi dben na bsod nams med par 'dzin/ /chos dang ldan na 'khos med thabs jugs zer/ /de 'dra'i skye bo mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /mthun 'jug mkhan la dge bshes bzang por brtsi/ /g.yo can tshul 'chos mkhan la btsun par smra/ /tshig cub gleng zog mkhan la bzang por brtsi/ /de 'dra'i skye bo mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /zhes dang / deng sang dus na rnam gzhag phyin ci log /rang skyon dang 'gal yon tan skyon du brtsi/ /tsu ta'i skye bos rkang gnyis mi rnams la/ /rkang gcig lhag ces bzhad gad byed pa ltar/ /rtsom 'chad rtsod par smra ba'i bsam yas pas/ /chos bzhin spyod la brnyas pa'i dus 'dir mthong / /zhes gsung gis spyongs pa yin no/ /lar thang stong rgyal po la sprang pos 'phya ba'i dpe bzhin 'di dag snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i rang mtshang du 'dug pas dam pa su zhig gi ba spu'i khung bu tsam yang g.yo bar mi nus so/ /de'i phyir thos pa mang po ni bzod pa'i dka' thub brten pa'i gnyen po'ang yin no/ /lar gyi na'i gtam gyis brdzi bar mi nus shing yul rkyen ngan pa man ngag dang bde stong du 'char ba la drod thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /yang sprul rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /byang sems paṇa grub thams cad la/ /snying nas 'dud do dbyings nas gzigs/ /sems can blo mig ma dag pa/ /dag pa chen po'i gdul byar shog /gzhan snang ba dgra ru ldang ba'i tshe/ /nga nyams dga'i glu dbyangs len snying 'dod/ /don med kyang bre mo bgyis pa lags/ /chung lus rgya'i sbubs nas nyams rtsal rdzogs/ /che lung rtogs g.yu ral len bu g.yo/ /dben gnas ri sul gangs stongs 'grim/ /da skye 'chi gnyis la bas tsha med/ /62

nga seng ge dkar mo'i phru gu yin/ /wa mos gangs stod 'grim pa med/ /las myong bas 'dag go blo re bde/ /'di zhen pa ldog pa'i gegs sol yin/ /tshe sngon bsags las 'phro dbu ma'i sbrubs/ /chos ma bslabs shes bya'i rtsa mdud grol/ /lam stong nyid nam mkha'i klong na 'phyo/ /sgom mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i gshog rtsal sbyong / /nga bya rgyal khyung gi phrug gu yin/ /khyim byas nam 'phang gcad pa med/ /gtam bden par ma grub bser bu 'dra/ /gtum mo'i ngo sprod kyang 'di mar 'dug /dbyings klong chen dgongs pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /don thugs rgyud bka' bab glog dmar 'khyug /chos 'od gsal rdo rje'i rwa rtse rno/ /gzugs rtag chad gnyis su ston pa med/ /nga g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i bu chung yin/ /sbrang mas dgung sngon snyogs pa med/ /gtam rang bzhin med de 'khrul pas bzos/ /sgyu ma ngo sprod kyang 'di khar snang / /pha pad+ma'i lung bstan nags kyi khrod/ /rtags 'gyur med kyi ri mo lus la rdzogs/ /chos bka' gter bstan pa'i grwa zur 'grim/ /lam smongs pa'i ri dwags zil gyis gnon/ /nga stag mo ri bkra'i bu chung yin/ /zhum bus them pa brgal ba med/ /gtam dri za'i grong khyer gsar pa 'dra/ /bar do ngo sprod kyang gzhan du med/ /gzhi skye med stong pa'i nam mkha' la/ /lam 'gag med gsal cha'i 'od zer 'bar/ /kun gzhi'i mun pa rtsa gdar gcod/ /chos rdzogs chen bstan pa'i me ro slong / /nga bcu gnyis bdag po'i bu rgyun yin/ /srin bus mun pa bsal ba med/ /gtam rdzun po che ste chu shing 'dra/ /rmi lam ngo sprod kyang 'di nyid do/ /chos bshad rgyud nam mkha' lta bu'i ngogs/ /sgom don rgyud rig pa'i gzungs dang ldan/ /yar ngo'i nyams rtogs 'phel ba yi/ /mar ngor bag chags shugs la 'grib/ /nga spros 63

bral zla ba'i bu rgyud yin/ /mun pas mtshan nyid mthong ba med/ /gtam grag stong nyid de ngo bos stong / /'od gsal ngo spyod kyang 'di ka rang / /tshe mang po'i rabs su chos la sbyangs/ /da res thos grol chen por song / /mi shes ldan kun gyi thod du bcings/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam gyi khur chen 'khris/ /nga klong chen rab 'byams bu chung yin/ /lkugs pas blang dor shes pa med/ /gtam kun brtags yin te zag pa zad//'da' ka ma ngo sprod kyang 'di kha lags//ho ho//rig pa ye nas ka dag la/ /stong pa blo yis 'chos ma dgos/ /da dgag sgrub kyi grub mtha' 'dzin don med/ /shes bya gshis la shor ba tshos/ /rtag chad kyi bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal/ /ye nas sku gsum lhun grub la/ /'bras bu logs nas 'tshol ma dgos/ /da blo sgom gyi grub mtha' 'dzin don med/ /stong nyid lam du shor ba tshos/ /yid dpyod kyi bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal/ /nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ci shar yang / /spang gnyen rig stong rjen par dag/da tha dad kyi grub mtha' 'dzin don med/ /stong nyid gnyen por shor ba tshos ya bral kyi bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal/ /spros bcas dang spros med thams cad kun/ /gzhi klong chen yangs par 'ub kyi chud/ /da rjes gzhig gi grub mtha' 'dzin don med/ /stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba tshos/ /res 'jog gi bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal/ /dus deng sang sgom chen phal cher kun/ /shor gol nor sa'i phrang ring la/ /tha mal gyi rig pa bskungs nas 'dug /la la bshes gnyen tshad ldan gyis/ /zin te re zhig gnas lugs don/ /bslad med rgyud la skyes na yang / /rjes la chos dred nyams chag dang / /rnam g.yeng bdud kyi phrang la zhugs/ /go yul kha lta'i lud gog la/ /thams cad chos dbyings 64

thams cad stong / /thams cad chos sku thams cad sems/ /las 'bras mi bden nga rgod ces/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bya byed mang / /mi nag khyim pa'i 'tsho 'dzin dang / /mgo dpon grong chog dag la rim/ /la la srid pa'i phun tshogs dang / /yon bdag rngam zhing gdol bar spyod/ /mchog dman bye brag mi phyed dang / rang rtsis dregs pas brgyal ba dang / /lha bu'i bdud kyi bslus pa rnams/ /snying re rje ste chos skal chad/ /ho ho/ /bdag sngon dge'i las 'phro sad pa des/ /sdug bcir lo zla'i grangs 'dren gyis/ /zhe yus khong bsran ma dgos par/ /snang ba brda dang dpe char shar/ /rig pa gtad med chos skur grol/ /'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa'i gdangs/ /chos nyid mngon sum rjen par mthong / /rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa des/ /las rlung rnam rtog bag la zha/ /ro rkyang nyi zla'i rgyu ba de/ /dbu ma sgra gcan nang du zhugs/ /nang gi rtsa mdud lhod por grol/ /'ching grol med pa'i sgom mkhar tshugs/ /klong chen dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag /de tshe slob ma 'dus kyang 'dus/ /de tshe 'gro don byas kyang byas/ /rang sems chos skur yang dag shes/ /kun tu bzang dang brgyud pa 'phrod/ /ngo sprod thob tshad 'tshengs pa yin/ /bdag gdong pa lnga pa'i rnal 'byor gli/shes rab gsum gyi sgyu rtsal la//glen pa'i ri dwags snying 'dar yang //gangs ri lta bu'i mkhas grub tsho/ /mnyes nas bya dga' mthong tshor mdzad/ /khyed log lta'i shes pa ma nyams rnams/ /bzhugs sa 'khor ba'i gting du zab//skur pa sangs rgyas 'phags par thob/ /dgra ya chos dang bla mar gyis/ /bstan 'dzin byung na sgo phyogs bsrungs//bstan bshig 'dug na grogs por bsdebs //khyed la rigs bdag 'di 'dra ba/ /srid pa las kyi bskos pa mtshar/ /de dang 65

de la 'bras bu 'byung / /'di yang gnad la phebs mi phebs/ /phyogs lhung can gyi smyon pa dang / /ba lang rdzi bos dbye mi shes/ /da ltar bzhugs pa'i mkhas grub dang / /slad nas 'byon gyur kun gyis gzigs/ /lar kun rtog rten med shar grol la/ /tshig bzang ngan rkyen gyi mi brdzi ste/ /rlung bser bu'i reg byas nyam chung gi/ /srog chags la sdug bsngal skyed na yang / /nags me yis tshig pa'i grogs su 'gyur/ /rkyen lam du slong ba'i bogs 'don yin/ /sgra brag car shes pa'i gegs sel yin/ /gnas sde dgon spong ba'i lung bstan yin/ /grogs sdig can spong ba'i bskul byang yin//'di rnal 'byor gyi lta ba'i rgyan du che/ /nged ri sul 'grim pa'i sprang po dang / /khyed 'khor bar chags pa'i e brten rnams/ /tshe 'di yi byed las tha dad pas/ /tshe phyi ma'i 'gro sa so sor yod/ /gzhan chags snang gi zug rngu skyes tsa na/ /nga byang chub sems kyi rtsa mdud grol/ /de grol tshe 'di 'dra'i glu re 'byon/ /de byon pas lta ba'i gnad re bshad/ /de bshad pas sgom pa'i bogs re thon/ /de thon pas rtogs pa khong nas lud/ /de lud pas spyod pa shugs 'byung skyong / /de bskyangs pas chos nyid rang mal zad/ /de zad tshe tshe 'dir mngon sangs rgya/ /de rgyas tshe bdag la 'brel thogs kun/ /las bzang ngan med pa 'tshengs pa yin/ /de 'khor ba dong nas sprugs thabs lags/ /bdag brgyud pa'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i bu/ /sems rang mthong longs pa ma lags te/ /tshig rtsub kyi tsher ma mi bzod pa'i/ /slob ma rnams spro ba 'phel phyir ro/ /byas nas brag phug 'gag tu bro brdungs pas khong rnams kyi zhe snang rang sar zhi thub pa byung ngo / /'di'i tshe kong spyon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis chos kyi rnga chen brdung bar bskul zhing rten 'brel 66

legs spel gyi lde mig rang du snang / rig 'dzin thugs mchog nas brgyud pa'i gter kha gsar rnying gi man ngag phal cher dam pa 'di la nod/ /sems can gzu bor mi gnas pa re zhig gis gu ru'i sku brnyan la brdib choms byas pas zhe khrel gyi ngan smra mdzad pa mi mngon pa'i rum du rgyas btab/ thugs rje'i 'jug pa dus las mi yol ba'i rten 'brel gyi mgur ma 'di phul bas khong yang lhag par mnyes so/ /gnas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang na/ /mgon sangs rgyas stong gi phrin las pa/ /skyabs kun 'dus gu ru rin po che/ /spyir 'dzam gling yongs kyi rgyan du shar/ /sgos bod khams gling dgu'i gnyen gcig pu/ /bus gsol ba drag po snying nas 'debs/ /phas rnga yab gling nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /khyed shākya thub pa'i rgyal tshab yin/ /skyabs rigs gsum mgon gyi sprul ba'i gar/ /bod kha ba can gyi lha gcig pu/ /rje khri srong lde'u btsan khong pa'i snying / /'bangs thugs rjes skyong ba'i zhal bzhes dgongs/ /bus gsol ba drag po snying nas 'debs/ /phas rnga yab gling nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /yid gdon gyi brlams la ci cha yod/ /bod sems can thams cad khyod la dad/ /chung bsam brlag byis pa'i ngag nas kyang //skyabs yorgyan pad+ma 'bod shes na//thugs btang snyoms bzhugs pa mi rigs pas/ /bus gsol ba drag po snying nas 'debs/ /pas rnga yab gling nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /dus nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad/ /dgra gshin rje'i dmag dpung mdun du lhags/ /lus yid 'ong bem por lings kyi song //dbugs me stag tsam 'di yar ba'i tshe/ /skyabs re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas//bus gsol ba drag po snying nas 'debs//pas rnga yab gling nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir dpal sngags kyi 67

bdag mo'i ye shes kyi rol pa rnam par bkod pas bskul ba la brten nas skal ldan bdun la grol thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi don rgyud kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i thog ma byas/ chos 'di pha chos su 'dzin par 'os ba'i rang grar yang ming tsam las mi grag cing / gzhan gyi thos 'dzin gyi pad+mo dang nye ma myong ba tsam gyi dar rgyas nyag phra bar yod pa rang gi slob rgyud kyi mtshon te mos pa can mang dag gi nyams su len pa dang / 'grel ba'i sgron me sbar ba sogs 'phel rgyas kyi sgo dbye ba'i byed por rgyal sras pad+mas dbugs dbyung ba'i rten 'brel gyi bden pa 'gog tu med pa'ang grub/ 'on kyang / phal cher yongs su 'dris la sdang / /rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa 'tshol/ /zhes pa der snang / /rang nyid lam 'dis grol ba thob pa'i phyir ched du brjod pa'i glu/ gnas chen de zangs mdog dpal ri na/ /dus gsum kun mkhyen pad 'byung bzhugs/ /'khor rje 'bangs rig 'dzin tshom bu yod/ /bdag las can bu la thugs rjes gzigs/ /sku gsum gyi ston pa brgyud pa bzang / /rigs bsdus kyi gu ru bsgrub thag nye/ /lam snyan brgyud yi ge med pa yod/ /zhag bdun phrag gsum gyis lam rtags mjal/ /6rgyan gyi thugs rje bsam mi khyab/ /rdzogs chen gyi khyad chos bsam mi khyab/ /chos bsam mi khyab pa snying thig gi/ /bstan pa de nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ /klong chen la dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod nas/ bshad rgyud kyi grub mtha' gtan la phob/ /don thugs rgyud rig pa 'od gsal gzungs/ /bdag las can skyes bu'i snying la babs//ci shar kun dag pa rab 'byams la//dgag sgrub kyi blo sgom bya ma dgos//nga dbyings rig 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor pa//rkyen bzang ngan klong chen ngang du zad/ /snang grag kun dpe char song tsa na/ /68

gang shar kun chos nyid bden pa'i gtam/ /tshig tha snyad skam por zhen ma dgos/ /blo gtad med kyi ngang nas sa lam rdzogs//rang rig la skye'achi'i ming 'dogs zad/ /'khor 'das la bzang ngan blang dor med/ /gzhi gnad la phebs pa'i rdzogs chen 'di/ /sprin ye zad kyi nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /'dir 'dus kyi skal ldan pho mo rnams/ /'khor ba la ma zhen ri khrod 'grim/ /khong sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /rang rig pa'i ngang du kho bos mthong / /dus da res mjal ba skal ba bzang / /sang cis kyang mjal ba'i smon lam zhu/ blo gtad med kyi bden pa nus mthu che/ /don lag tu longs par gdon mi za/ /der zhabs drung yang steng pa dang / rgyal rtse mda' bzang nor dpal kyang gshegs bskyel gyi rdo rje'i glus de nyid du snang ba gting nas 'gyur zhing mchi ma blags/ ma ṇi bha dras rang khyim pha mes kyi las thabs sems can khri phrag mang po'i srog la 'tshe ba'i sdig ris 'jig rten 'byor rgyad kyi gnas su ltos pa'ang snying thag pa nas spang bar dam bcas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs bstan pa la blang dor byas pas rjes su yi rang ba rgya chen po bsgoms/slar zhabs drung gi bzhed pa bzhin lta ba la thal chen po'i mgur/pha grub thob gong ma yongs la 'dud/ /nyams gdar sha chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems mi 'char dgu 'char gyi rnam rtog dang / /stong gsal rig pa'i theg le gnyis/ /brjod du med pa'i ngo bor gcig /chos phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i tha snyad dang / blo 'das spros bral byar med gnyis/ /dran rig ngos gzung med par gcig /rang sems skye 'gag mtha'abal dang / /ye shes zang thal gyi dgongs pa gnyis/ /tha mal rig pa'i gshis su gcig /lar nga yir 'dzin gyi 69

grub pa'i mtha'/ /rtag chad kyi phrang las brgal ba med/ /bdag phyogs 'dzin zhig pa'i bya bral gli /gnas lugs la brjod byas gtan ma phebs/ /chos chen po gsum gyi nying khu 'di/ /khong rgya gar gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / /'phags bod kyi paṇa grub tshad ldan gyis/ /'grel pas bkral zhing nyams su bltar/ /'di dbu ma snang med spros bral dang / /phyag chen 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor/ /rdzogs chen blo 'das kha yan gyi/ /ye shes mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i//dran rig lhun grub chen por gcig/de 'on kyang lam gyi 'jug sgo dang / /rtog pa'i lam khyer bogs 'don sogs//mngon sum gnad kyi nyams myong la//bul mgyogs yod kyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /ji bzhin mngon du phyung nas 'dzin/ /blos byas zhi gnas ltengs po dang / /'jur dran rang sa'i 'ching ba can/ /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis/ /gnas lugs rang zhal 'gebs pa la/ /rnam dag lta bar rlom pa 'khrul/ /bdag rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rig pa gzhi grol gyi gnad go nas/ /stong 'byams phyogs 'dzin pha mthar bskrad/ /blo khrims med kha yan zang thal klong / /gang shar ye shes chen por dag /bzang rtog ngan rtog lung ma bstan/ /tha mal rig pa klong chen dang / /spang blang ye grol chen por song / /nyams rtogs bzang po'i shubs nas don/ /gcer bu snying pa bzo med ngang / /gdod ma'i rgyal sa 'dzin pa lags/ /de skad rang bab thol byung gtam/ /'og min rdo rje'i ke'u tshang du/ /klong chen mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ /nyams la shar nas glu ru blangs/ /rigs rus zhing sa gshin po'i ngogs/ /lung rtogs 'dab ma rngam byed pa/ /zhabasadrung sku gsum klong grol la/ /phul bas dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /ces so/ /la ra las dang po ba la 70

nges 'byung bskul zhing skyo ba seng ba la'ang mgur ma 'di byin rlabs che/ nang gi rtsa mdud grol ba'i skabs su'ang nyams kyi sna kha mnon pa rdo rje'i glur 'char/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha 'dre dag kyang snang ba 'gyurab yin pas/ tsan+d+ra shrīs ched du bskul ba'i ngor/rnga yab dpa' ri 'od phung gi glong na//skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan rje bzhugs yod//sprang po'i blo gtad zhu sa de ma nor/ /gsol 'debs rem shog rdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi dbus na/ /theg pa'i mthar thug rdzogs chen de bzhugs yod/ /sprang po'i nyams len 'jug sgo de ma nor/ /thod sgal sgom shog rdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /lta ba mtha' bral byar med kyi klong na/ /mngon sum rig pa'i thig le de bzhugs yod/ /sprang po'i sgom pa yid dpyod dang ma nor/ /dbyings rig gzir shog rdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /sgom pa blo 'das skyid nyal gyi klong na/ /sor bzhag ye bab rdzogs chen de bzhugs yod/ /sprang po'i nyams len bcos ma dang ma nor/ /lhod de sdod cig rdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /spyod pa cham grol gtad med kyi klong na/ /rang grol gnyug ma ye rdzogs de bzhugs yod/ /sprang po'i bya bzhag tshul 'chos dang ma nor/ /zhabs bro khyogs shog rdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /dam tshig sa ma 'bum sde yi klong na/ /ye bsrungs chen po bsrung mtshams las brgal song / /sprang po'i 'dun ma chos min dang ma nor/ /nyams dga' skyong shog rdo rje yi srun grogs tsho/ /'bras bu cog bzhag sku gsum gyi klong na/ /bcing med grol med re dogs las 'das song / /sprang po'i rnam rtog 'og gtums dang ma nor/ /gzhi rtsa chod shog sdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /'khor 'das gnyis med khyab gdal gyi klong na/ /khams gsum lus can pha ma ru 71

'dug pas/ /sprang po'i sems bskyed phyogs ris dang ma nor/ /smon lam thob shog rdo rje yi spun grogs tsho/ /bdag cag 'dir 'dus skal ldan gyi tshom bu/ /las smon dag pa'i mched lcam zhig lags pas/ /rnga yab dpal rir rig 'dzin gyi tshom bur/ /nyam nga med pa seng ge ltar mchongs 'gro/ /zhes so/ /yang nyams snang la bud med cig gis/sku gsum gyi zhing khams la go ba bskyed pa'i gsung mgur zhig dgos zer ba la/e ma ho/ /'khor 'das bdag med gzhi dbyings kyi klong na/ /gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang de bzhugs yod/ /zhal phyag 'dzin pa dag pa de a ho/ /gzhon nu bum sku'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /nges pa lnga ldan bde stong gi zhing na/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas longs sku de bzhugs yod/ /kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan de a ho/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /mngon dga' la sogs lnga tshom kyi zhing na/ /phyed sprul longs sku'i sangs rgyas de bzhugs yod/ /byar med sa lam sbyong ba de a ho/ /ye shes snying po'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /rigs 'dus zangs mdog dpal ri yi zhing na/ /rgyal kun 'dus zhal mtsho skyes rje bzhugs yod/ /skye 'chi'i ming 'dogs zad pa de a ho//'ja' lus rdo rje'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /tha mal rig pa spros bral gyi klong na/ /gnyug ma'i rang bzhin rdzogs chen de bzhugs yod/ /chos kyi 'du shes zad pa 'di a ho/ /byar med lhug pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /dwangs ma lnga ldan lhu ti yi klong na/ /rig pa dngos med khyab gdal de bzhugs yod/ /cir snang dag pa rab 'byams de a ho//ye grol chos sku'i bla ma de mkhyen no//sung khams glemached 'dus byas kyi grong khyer/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod rang byung gi ye shes//snang tshad dpe char shar ba de 72

a ho/ /rang byung rig pa'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /sgom pa rang gsal lhun grub kyi zhing na/ /'pho med bya bral sangs rgyas de bzhugs yod/ /lhod de sdod pa'i lta ba de a ho/ /nges pa don gyi bla ma de mkhyen no/ /mnyam bzhag lta stangs ga nga 'gro la thong zhog /sems 'dzin yid dpyod rang bab tu skyur thong / /btang bzhag ched 'dzin blos byas kyi ci byed/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas ka dag la 'dug go/ /cig chod gzhi rdzogs a ti yi theg par/ /sa lam bci ba'i 'o brgyal ni ma dgos/ /lus rgya'i zhubs nas chos zad dang mjal nas/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i gsang lam la chas 'gro/ /zhes smras pas/ 'o na sems can thams cad 'bad pa med par mi grol ba cis lan zer/ ye ma ho/ sems nyid 'di nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /ye shes dang ldan pas khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal 'di nyi ma zla ba 'dra/ /dngos po dang bral bas khyad par 'phags/ /rig pa 'di zang thal shel gong 'dra/ /sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas khyad par 'phags/ /rnam rtog 'di dngos med bser bu 'dra/ /lhag mthong dang ldan pas khyad par 'phags/ /lta sgom 'di bu chung gzhon nu 'dra/ /'du shes dang bral bas khyad par 'phags/ /bdag bya rgyal khyungagi phug gu 'di/ /sgo nga'i grubs nas gshog rtsal rdzogs/ /phyi lus kyi shun pa dor ma thag /dbyings nam mkha'i klong du mi 'phyo re/ /khong bya bran rnams da dung lang tsho skyong / /de 'dab ma'i nyams rtsal ma rdzogs lan/ /chos rdzogs pa chen po ye grol la/ /sa lam gyi bskyar nas grol ba med/ /dbyings nam mkha' lta bu'i mkha' klong na/ /sems rnam rtog gya gyu'i bslu brid mkhan/ /'dis 'khor 'das bar lag phye phye nas/ /sems gzhug ma'i rang sa zin dus med/ /bdag gang shar gdod mar shes pa 73

des/ /lta sgom la ming 'dogs bya rgyu zad/ /blo khrims med rang yan du bsdad na yang / /don bden pa'i gshis la 'pho 'gyur med/ /phyi 'byung lnga lus kyi mtshams khang nang / /snying a wa lhu ti'i mal sgom du/ /sems tshogs drug rang sa'i sku 'tshams byas/ /lus btsona'ajug gi mtshams la re dogs spangs/ /gzhi ka dag bsam ngo bral ba'i ngang / /lam yin lugs rang sar 'jog shes pas/ /sgom yid dpyod kyi sa lam brtsi don med/ /'di skyid nyal rgyab pa'i lag rjes lags/ /tshul de skad thol byung rig pa'i mgur/ /khyed dag snang can gyi rta ki nir/ /sprang chos med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ /nyams thol shar yi ge'i lam nas gdams/ /zhes so/ /'di'i tshe bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi nyin mtshan thun mtshams kun tu mgur glu rang 'then pas snang ba bden med du zhig /sgyu ma dang mi lam lta bu'i nyams mtha' yas pa shar nas sgo shing khron po zhig la mdud pa byas pa lo dus su'ang ma bskams par skyes/ snying rje chen po stobs su gyur pas mi dad pa dag kyang slar byams par gyur/ bya dang byi'u'i tshogs kyang dga' bar byed pas 'dab chags kyi gtam rig pa rang shar zhes bya ba'ang bris/ 'khor ba la nges 'byung blo deg tu skyes nas thams cad bsgrub pa la yid gtod cing thugs dam dge sbyor la brtson/ khyad par dbang khrid kyi skabs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rtags khyad par can mang zhing / sa la zhing skyong gi 7khri'am mi ma yin cha ma 'tshal ba'i rjes nying lag mi gsal ba tsam skad cig skad cig la mthun snang grub pa dang /kha btags rnyed pa sogs byung / de lta na'ang kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i rtags snang ra ri la ya mtshan du rlom pa dang bden rdzun gyi dag sangs ni byed don ma mchis te chos kyi byin rlabs 74

la nges pa 'dren pa'i slad tsam mo/ /ho ho/ /'khor 'das snang srid thams cad rang gi sems/ /sems 'dis brtags na yul gyi snang ba kun/ /bden bden yod yod 'dra ste yul can klong / /rnam par dpyad na chu shing snying po 'dra/ /yod med mtha' bral phyogs lhung zhig pa'i klong //dbu ma tsam du 'dzin pa'ang blo yis byas/ /de phyir chos med sprang po nyal nas sdod/ /shin tu rnam dag tha mal rig pa 'di/ /sus kyang ma byas gang nas byung ba med/ /spre'u lta bu'i sems 'di tsab tsub mang / /'khor 'das bar lag 'byed mkhan khyod kyi byas//sems rig gdar sha chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa//rig pa 'gyur med klong du nyal nas sdod/ /rdo rje snying po theg pa kun gyi rtse/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun gyi ma rtogs pa/ /tshig gis mi mtshon dpe las byung ba med/ /klong chen kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga nas/ /byin rlabs don rgyud tshul du snying la babs/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /rang sems bla ma'i ngang du nyal nas sdod/ /lta rgyu med pa lta ba'i bzhugs tshul la/ /mi 'dug snyam pas rgyas 'debs yul la shor/ /sgom rgyu med pa sgom pa'i la bzla la/ /yengs la shor bas sgom chen phar cher bslus/ /spyod pa'i gnad la dus tshod gces na yang / /mthar 'dzin gud du bcad pas phal cher nongs/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i ming 'dogs zad pa 'di/ /ro ltar nyal ba'i sprang po'i 'dun ma'i rtse/ /go ba'i lta bas snying po'i don ma mthong / /nyams kyi lta bas gnas lugs rang zhal bsgribs/ /tshig gi lta bas bya bral bya byed mang / /ye nas lhums su zhugs pa'i lta ba 'di/ /gzhan la bshad na khrel bgad ga shar byed/ /rang gis bsams na sa 'og gter mthong 'dra/ /ji srid 'du shes zhig par ma gyur par/ /de srid lta bar rlom yang rnam rtog 75

yin/ /kun rtog dbyings su nub pas rnal du 'byor/ /dbyings nas rig rtsal rdzogs bas a la la/ /langs kyang chos sku nyal kyang rdzogs pa che/ /gshis lugs spros bral ye yin chen po la/ /lta stangs sems 'dzin zhags pas bcings don med/ /bag med ro nyal byas pas sa lam rdzogs/ /ha ha ha zhes 'dar nyal sprad nas 'dug pa'i tshe/ skad cig ma der dum pa zhig rnal du shor ba'i rmi lam na/ bde stong ye shes chen po'i lang tsho rngam zhing / bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i zur mig can/ gsal stong blo bral chen po'i byad dbyibs mdzes pa'i bzhin bzang ma zhig kho po'i mdun du khrong gi 'ongs nas/nged kyi lag pa la shin tu chags shing 'phreng ba'i tshul gyi dam du bzung nas 'di skad ces zer ro/ /nged skor gcig mtsho snar 'gro ba yin/ zla ba bcu drug tsam las 'gor mi yong / 'di kha gnas kyi khyad skye bo pho mo grwa btsun la ma nges pa mang po yong 'dug pas de thams cad la zhal mjal tsam re dang 'brel ba thogs tsam re gnang ba zhu e go/zhes shin tu 'phreng ba'i tshul gyi zer bas/ rnam thar bzhi ldan gyi dran pa chos nyid blo 'das kyi ngang du dar gcig brgyal nas mi 'dug go/ /der rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi snang cha'i rten 'brel lugs ldog tu snang bas ngas kyang lag pa'i tshigs pa la brda byas nas zla ba bcu gnyis las 'gor mi yong byas pas/ des kyang lag pas brda' sna tshogs su ston pa'i brda thabs cir yang byas te song /rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i brda lan ston pa'i snang ba g.yel bas brda don 'phrod pa ni cang med/ der gnyid de sad tsa na sems la skyo shas shin tu che ba zhig langs/ shes pa 'di chad chod yad yud bar do'i snang ba 'dra ba zhig tu song nas gda'/der har gyi langs 76

nas lus gnad drang por bsrangs/ rlung ro drag tu phud/ mig bar snang la har re bltas te sems nyid ngal gso ba'i phyag rgya byas bsdad tsa na glu 'di 'dra zhig snying la dam kum shar byung ngo / /pha mirgyan je la snying nas 'dud/ /sems gzhi rtsa chod par byin gyis rlobs//bu sems kyis sems la blta ba 'di//gzhug ma'i dran pa ma lags pas/ /bu da lta'i shes pa bzo med ngang / /ma yengs tsam du cog ge zhog/bu dran pas ched du bzung ba 'di//sgom gyi gnad tshang ma yin pas/ bu rang bab dran rig so ma'i ngang / /ched 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog/bu gnas tshad sgom du 'dod pa ni//zhi lhag zung 'brel ma lags pas//bu gnas 'phror dgag sgrub med pa'i ngang //rig pa kha yan gtad med zhog /bu zhal gzigs lung bstan byung ba 'di/ /kun bzang dgongs pa ma lags pas/ /bu re dogs khong grol so ma'i ngang //gtad med bden med chen por zhog /bu mngon shes brtag pa gsal ba 'di/ /gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings ma lags pas/ /bu bzang rtog ngan rtog lung ma bstan/ /rang grol klong yangs chen por zhog /bu gzhan gyi bkur bzos byed pa 'di/ /grub rtags mthar thug ma lags pas/ /bu skye 'chir bag tsha med pa'i ngang / rang mthong med pa'i gshis la zhog /bu zang zing longs spyod 'du ba 'di/ /lam rtags yon tan ma lags pas/ /bu nor rdzas sgyu mar shes pa'i ngang / /bdag med rig pa'i klong du zhog/bu mnga' thang je cher 'phel ba 'di//chos zad 'bras bu ma lags pas/ /bu bya bral stabs bde gyi na'i ngang / /tshul 'chos zhig pa'i ngang du zhog /bu sgom blo'i bag chags 'khor yug 'di/ /nyin mtshan 'dres pa ma lags pas/ /bu nyin snang sgom gyis ma bslus par/ /gtad med spros bral ngang 77

la zhog /bu gnyid la sgom blos slebs pa 'di/ /dbu ma'i 'od gsal ma lags pas/ /bu rlung sems ro gcig khyab gdal ngang / /sgom med blo 'das chen por zhog /bu blos byas mtha' brgyad spros bral 'di/ /ka dag phyogs yan ma lags pas/ /bu rig gdangs lug rgyud 'bral med ngang / /snang rig zung 'jug chen por zhog /bu bskyed rim gsal brtan a 'thas 'di/ /ma hā yo ga ma lags pas/ /bu zhal phyag 'dzin zhen zhig pa'i klong / /rig stong mnyam rdzogs chen por zhog /bu dga' bzhi'i nyams la zhen pa 'di/ /a nu yo ga ma lags pas/ /bu rlung sems dbu mar 'dus pa'i ngang /bde stong blo 'das chen por zhog /bu srog thur gnad la goms pa tsam/ /thabs lam mthar thug ma lags pas/ /bu mkhas pa bzhi yi gnad shes pas/ /sor rtogs ye shes ngang la zhog /bu sku gsum lhun grub shes pa tsam/ /a ti'i mthar thug ma lags pas/ /bu lhag mthong rdo rje lug rgyud dang / /yid dpyod rdzun phugs brdib la zhog /bu rags lus dwangs mar 'gyur ba tsam/ /phung po lhag med ma lags pas/ /bu gzhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan klong / /nang dbyings btsan sa zin par gyis/ /bskyed rdzogs rgyud sde'i man ngag mthil//gab pa mngon phyung gsang ba'i gtam/ /mkhas btsun brgya yi zhal bsdur kyang / /'di las lhag pa su yis gsungs/ /rang byung pad+ma yab yum dang / /chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pa/ /yab sras brgyud pa'i bka' drin la/ /tshig 'di kho bo'i blo la shar/ /don de nyams len mthar thug yin/ /dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu yi/ /'og min rdo rje'i gsang phug tu/ /klong chen dgongs pa'i mdzod nas bris/ /rtsa gsum mkha' 'gros bzod par bzhes/ /dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /yang 'ga' 'ga'i chos skad 78

la blo nem nur skye pa'i tshe/ nga'i bla ma o rgyan chos rje dang / /nga'i rig 'dzin dri med 'od zer zhabs/ /nga'i pha rgan rgyal sras 'gro 'dul gling / /nga'i ma rgan ye shes mtsho rgyal rnams/ /dus de ring dran nas tshugs thabs med/ /phyi snang ba sems kyi rol rtsal du/ /thag chod kyang 'dzin pa'i 'phro 'du rgod/ /rkyen yul snang gi bde sdug g.yon can mas//gshis rig pa'i dpa' bo 'khrul du bcug/dkor nag po'i nus mthu ri las lci/ /dus snyigs ma'i spyod pa rlung las 'tshubs/ /las sgrib pa'i gong bu gser las lci/ /nga bsam bzhin snying rlung dbang med langs/ /dran rig la 'pho 'gyur med pa de/ /lta sgom gyi gnad du che skad kyang / /tshogs drug rang stong gi rtsal ma rdzogs/ /'du shes ma zad pa yi re mug /rjes thob kyang rtog pa'i dra bar nges/ /gnas mi med lung stong chen po'i nang / /phung po 'ja' lus su bsgrub rgyu la//rnam g.yeng can gyi ri khrod du//'gro don ming btags kyi ngag 'khukha sgrogs//rgyu dran rtog gzhi med rtsa bral la//rkyen rnam rtog ngan pas mi brdzi yang / /rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas gnyis po las//thim pa'i rang rtsal ma rdzogs des//nyin mtshan dbyer med du la ma zlos/ /kun gzhi las rlung du g.yos pa des/ /mi lam sna tshogs kyi cho 'phrul sems/ /des chos skur grol la the tshom skyes/ /phyi dus kyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug tsho/ /dran pa la sgom gyi rtsa bar byed/ /rtse gcig la lta bar rlom pa der/ /dpyad na nam mkha'i rnal 'byor du/ /nga khas len byas kyang mi gnong tsam/ /snga dus kyi grub pa'i rig 'dzin dang / /rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde yi/ /lta spyod dang lam rtags kyi yon tan la/ /bsams na dang po'i las can khyod/ /da dung dben pa'i ri khrod brten/ /'di drang don dang bstun pa'i skyo glu yin/ /nges don dang 79

bstun pa'i gsung cong yin/ /dgongs pa can gyi co 'dri yin/ /byang chub don gnyer dbang phyug rigs/ /gang na bzhugs pa cha ma 'tshal/ /rtog ge'i tshig sbyor shes pa yi/ /nga rgyal rang rtsis tsam min pa'i/ /nyams rtogs rgyud la 'byor ba'i gtam/ /gsar bas lan cig gdab par rigs/ /rang gi rang la de skad smras pa'i tshul/ /mi shes khengs pa che ba'i u tshugs can/ /ma rtogs blos byas lta sgom mchog tu 'dzin/ /phral snang srid pa'i phun tshogs rngam pa der/ /'di 'dra'i yi ge rtsed mo'i tshul du bskur/ /de'i tshe rdo rje phur pa la bsnyen pa dung phyur ngag bcad gcig gi thog nas song ba'i pad+mo dharmā 'du ba shin tu 'khrugs pa'i tshe/na tsha lam 'khyer gyi man ngag sku gsum rang grol zhes bya ba/drang srong rig pa'i ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtsa ba ma rig pa/ /de yi lugs 'byung bskyed pa bro nad kyi/ /gnyen po zho rgyan sman gyi bla ma la/ /'dud do dug gsum na tsha zhi bar mdzod/ /na tsha sdig sgrib 'ded pa'i phyags ma yin/ /na tsha bla mar sgom la gsol ba thobs/ /na ba brdeg btsog byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ /rnam smin sus kyang mi myong rang thog 'bab/ /babs pa'i las skal zin na blo bde ltar//bla ma dkon cog drin gyis lhangs pa yin//na tsha dngos grub yin pas lha gsol gyis/ /na tsha las ngan 'dzad pa'i snga ltas yin/ /na ba'i ngo bor ma blta na mkhan ltos/ /sems kyi thog tu na tsha ma 'jog par/ /na tsha'i steng du rig pa rjen par zhog /na tsha chos skur 'char ba'i gdams ngag yin/ /lus ni bem po sems ni stong pa nyid/ /bem por cis gnod stong par gang gis tshugs/ /na tsha'i gshis la byung gnas 'gro gsum 'tshol/ /na tsha glo bur byung ba'i rnam rtog yin/ /rnam rtog yal tshe na tsha rang 80

sar dwangs/ /rig pa blo 'das gsal stong chen por grol/ /na tsha longs skur 'char ba'i man ngag yin/ /bskal bar bsags pa'i sdig sgrib na tshas 'dag/nyams rtogs dngos grub 'gugs pa'i pho nya yin/ /lus kyi gces 'dzin bor la mal gcod kyi//dmigs pa gsal pos sha khyer khrag khyer thong //res 'ga' khrol tshags can gyi stong ra sgom/ /na sa tal mar phug la rlung gis thon/ /rjes shes dbyings rig zang thal ngang la zhog /na tsha sprul skur 'char ba'i man ngag yin/ /na ba 'di ko rtsa gsum thugs rje'i mthu/ /na ba 'di ko dkon cog rnam gsum drin//na ba 'di ko sdig slong bsgrub pa'i mthu//sgrib pa'i bud shing 'di las lhag pa med/ /yi mug log lta'i rim gro ma byed par/ /las ngan zad pa'i rtags yin dga' ba sgoms//dben pa gsum gyi sgo gsum nyer bsdams shing //mnyes pa gsum gyi gtso bo sgrub pa yi/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskang nus pa'i/ /sku gsum dbyings rig 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od kyis dben pa'i mal nas gdams/ /dge bas dug gsum nad las grol gyur cig /de'i tshe sgom chen shrī nā tha'i mtshan can phyogs der phebs pa dang 'grig/nye rigs kyi rmongs zhen thugs la bcangs nas phrad du phebs/ sngar rna thos tsam las mjal gleng med pas gang ci'i gsung gleng smar ba'i lhongs shig la/khyod rig pa che rabs 'dug/bla ma su la gtugs pa yin/dang po yin na smin grol gling du chos sgor zhugs/ rgyud gsang ba snying po la'ang bslab gnyer zhig byas na yong rgyur 'dug ste gsungs/ gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa'i gsung gang yang 'byon phyin 'dug go/ /der rang gis dag pa'i snang bas ba da de dpal gsang ba snying po dang rgyud bcu bdun la sogs pa'i chos 'brel yang 81

zhus pa na/ do ger can la chos mi 'chad/ ces pa las brtsams te thabs la mkhas pa'i co 'dri'ang mdzad/ drang gtam rang du snang ste dpyad phyir 'di skad ces zhus so/ /de shin tu bden/ spyir srid zhi mnyam nyid du 'dres pa'i lta ba myong thog tu ma khel bar ral pa thor tshugs su byed pas mtshon te ru ka pa'i chas byed pa 'di gsang sngags kyi bla 'tshong / rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i khrel sa/ sprang 'khyams zog po rnams kyi rnam thar du 'dug /nged kyi 'di rgya gar gyi slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang 'od gsal gyi ngang du mjal ba zhig byung ba nas bzung spyi bor glegs ral dang bcas 'ching snying 'dod pa zhig byung bas snang ba byung rgyal du btags nas bcings btang ba yin/ zog po dang grub thob gang du ngos bzung kyang chog pa yod/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi chos nyan pa la khog yangs pa'i dbang du btang na slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang /slob ma rnams 'khor gyi rnam rol du dag snang sbyang ba'i lugs kyang yod pas da res dgongs pa mi khrel ba zhu byas pas thugs snyems cung zad chag /de'i tshe rtsed mo'i tshul du yi ge 'di bzhin bris nas phul lo/ /e ma ho/ /rus ni chos rje 'brug pa'i bu/ /cho 'brang gnubs kyi rigs su gtogs/ /mnga' ris la dbang ba min na yang / /rabs la yas 'ded thongs tsam lags/ /bu tra nas shākya'i bstan la zhugs/ /u pa sa ga'i rnam thar bskyangs/ /tha ma ṇi ka ra'i sdom pa mnos/ /'jug sgo la go rim 'phyugs snyam med/ /thos bsam de phyogs med grub mthar byas/ /bshes gnyen kun la dag snang sbyangs/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi sgo ru zhugs/ /btsan thabs su rtogs ldan byas snyam med/ /rten 'brel de r+ghaṃ chen kā ras bsgrigs/ /82

smin grol du byang chub rdo rjes btsud/ /rtsod med kyi rig 'dzin rnams kyis bskyangs/ /bla ma la nor 'khrul byung snyam med/ /zhen log gi bsgrub tshugs rang gis bzung / /nyams len la zhun thar pad+mas mdzad/ /gtad med kyi rig pa chos skur shar/ /lta ba la gol 'phyugs gyur snyam med/ /khyed shes kyis gdung ba'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /don rgyud de yo rgyan chos rjes stsal/ /bogs 'don de mdzod chen bdun gyis bton/ /sgom pa la gol shor yod snyam med/ /zla dga' zas 'tshol du ma 'byams shing / /spros bcas dang spros med dge sbyor kun/ /'khor gsum yongs dag gi mtshams sbyor byas/ /spyod pa la tshul 'chos shor snyam med / /kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' drin la/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i me long mthong / /phyi nang gi grub mtha'i khyad par shes/ /blun sgom dang mun rdzas bslus snyam med/ /ral pa thor tshugs kyi lan bu can/ /gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / /snang ba zil gnon gyi rten 'brel yin/ /legs 'dod dang tshul 'chos byas snyam med/ /mkhyen gnyis kyi gter mdzod brdol ba 'di/ /lung bstan gyi bden pas rab bskul nas/ /sngon sbyangs kyi rang stobs bstan pa yin/ /mu cor gyi tshig skam yin snyam med/ /bstan thog tu bsgrub tshugs 'dzin pa 'di/ /'gro sas 'phongs pa ma lags te/ /khong grub thob gong ma'i bshul lam yin/ /gdul bya med pa yin snyam med/ /chu dang grub mtha' bla ma gsum/ /rang gi yul na bzang ba de/ /rang rang so so'i mthong snang yin/ /rgyud bshad blo la 'dzin pa la/ /ngo mtshar che snyam mi bgyi ste/ /rgyud don bde blag rtogs pa la/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug mi zer ram/ /de phyir tan+t+ra bco brgyad bcud/ /rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po la/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bho rnyi'am/ /lung bstan rdo rje man 83

chad nas/ /ngag dbang chos dpal yan chad la/ /rgya bod rgyud 'grel dgu tsam mthong / /gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po la/ /brag phug dang du 'grel pa byed/ /'di las zab pa'i 'grel pa ni/ /ngas ni nam yang ma mthong ngo / /zhes phul bas dag snang che ru song / de nas thugs nang gshin par gyur nas gang ci'i gsung bgros glengs pas khong pa bde gshegs 'dus pa dang gshin rje tshe bdag gi bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba'i rnal 'byor du go nas slar ched du gdan drangs te de dag gi dbang lung yongs su rdzogs pa nyan pa yin no/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/nang rgyud yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di'i brgyud pa khungs stor du nye ba la/ paṇa chen rin po che ye shes rol pa'i rdo rjes dā ri dra'i brtul zhugs kyi dbus gtsang la stod lho byang thams cad du bka' brgyad kho na'i ched/ la chu phrang gsum la dka' ba spyad/ yab rje nas bzung bde 'dus kho na yang tshar nyer lnga gsan rjes rje rigs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la spros pa chod pa'i tshe dpal gyi mgur las/ de phyir rig 'dzin phyi rabs 'byon pa rnams/ /rgyud lung man ngag thams cad stengs kyang sla/ /bka' brgyad rnam gsum nyams su ma 'jug cig /gsungs pas gdams phran la sdug bcir ma byas par rgyud sde chen pos gzhung bsrangs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag la don gnyer chen pos klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo bdag gir bzung ba lags/ kye hoḥrje dus gsum kun mkhyen pad 'byung dang / /chos theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa che/ /khong sngon byon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems/ /rgya bod kyi grub thob yongs la 'dud//yongs da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus/ /mi phal cher log pa'i lam la 'phyan//tshul mi dge bcu la spyad pa'i mthus/ /yid can kun ngan 84

'gro'i duḥkha myong / /bod rtags 'dzin gyi chos gzugs phal mo che thos bsam la nan tan mi byed par/ /mda' lnga snying zhugs kyi spyod pas g.yeng / /'di bsams bzhin snying rlung gcong gis zin/ /sngon tshe lo brgya pa'i gnas dus la/ /rje shākya thub pa 'dzam gling byon/ /chos drang don gyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ /nges don gyi mdo yang grangs med gsungs/ /lam bslab pa gsum gyi rgyud bsdams shing / /nyan thoga'adul ba'i bstan pa dar/ /bka' bden pa bzhi la nan tan mdzad/ /srid pa tha ma'i byang sems mang / /de deng sang yin na dga' ba la/ /de deng sang yin na skyid pa la/ /gnas 'og min gsang chen rol pa dang //ri ma la ya dang 6ḍi ya//tshul nges med kun tu sprul bsgyur gyi//sku'i bkod pas 'bras bu'i theg pa bstan/ /de rgyud sde bzhi dang yo ga gsum/ /thabs shes dang man ngag rang byung rgyud/ /don yang dag lam la bkri bar gcig /'jug sgo la zab khyad lhag par che/ /'phags yul du gsar rnying dbye ba med/ /mngon phyung dang gab pa'i gnad yod de/ /mkhan slob chos rgyal sku drin la/ /bod gangs chen 'dir cig car dar mod de/ /mi khrims med gdol ba'i kun rtog gis/ /bzang ngan dang phyogs cha'i sde ris phye/ /chos rdzogs pa chen por yo ga sgrogs/ /kye nyi zla nam mkhar rgyu ba 'di/ /chung byis pa'i lag gis dgag bya min/ /khong kun tu bzang po bka' btsan pas/ /rig 'dzin gyi sprul pa rim par byon/ /don dam pa rig pa so ma'i rgyud/ /klong chen po dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod brdol/ /yul snang kun brda dang dpe char shar/ /bka' rgyud bshad pa'i bstan pa dar/ /dgongs rgyud bsgrub pa'i srog shing tshugs/ /byin rgyud ye shes rang sar phebs/ /ri sul kun rnal 'byor zhig sdus

khengs/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i lam srol btod/ /de rtse btsun seng ge dbang phyug dang //me long rdo rje klong chen pa//so zur gnubs dang skor rong khams//drag rtsal rdo rje nyang ral sogs/ /bka' gter bstan skyong mang po'i drin/ /pha sgrub rgyud gong mas rdzogs chen gyi/ /bstan pa'i me ro kun nas slong / /don rig pa 'od gsal snying po'i gzungs/ /dus deng du'ang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ku su lu'i sprang po rnams la gdams/ /'khor 'byor ldan gyi khengs sems ltar snang tsam/ /bdud dam sri 'byung po'i lung bstan 'um/ /phugs blo yi re ba yid ma brtan/ /gzhi ka dag chen pos bslu ma myong / /'di grub rtags rgyal po cis ma yin/ /sems stong gsal zhi gnas 'dzin pa can/ /yid rtog dpyod kyi lhag mthong g.yo 'khrul po/ /dbyings lung ma bstan gyi byar med gsum/ /'di gsum po rdzogs chen khyu nas bud//sgom dran 'dzin gnyen po'i 'ching ba dang //blos ched 'dzin byas pa'i stong nyams can/ /blo go yul dred pa'i rgyas 'debs gsum/ /khyed gsum yang jogs chen khyu nas bud/ /sems 'du shes grung po'i lta sgom dang / /blo go rar 'thums pa'i nyams zhen dang / /yin myang bya'i dri mas sbags te gsum/ /khyed gsum yang rdzogs chen khyu nas bud/ /bdag 'ching ba can gyi bya bral ba/ /sngon skye ba 'ga' la sbyangs ba'i mthus/ /tshe da res thos grol chen por song / /khyed mched grogs rnams ko long mi mdzad mkhyen/ /'di kha tshig 'ud gog tu song dogs kyang / /klong chen po dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod brdol/ /sems las rlung dbu ma'i rgyal sar gton/ /rtsa a wa cu ti'i mdud grol dang / /mi rmongs pa'i blo gros lkog gyur gnyis/ /'gal ba ltag sprod du snang ba'i tshe/ /stong nyid snying rje'i gdangs kyi glur/ /shar ba shing shun 86

'jam po'i ngogs/ /'og min rdo rje'ibag tu bris/ /dge bas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /ces smras nas mtshamasadam par bcad/ 'od gsal spros pa med pa'i ngang mdangs snang grag thams cad ju lnga'i rgyang glur len pa'i skabs shig gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na rtsi shinganags tshal gyi sman ljongs mthong na dga' ba zhig tu bud med lngas khridabyungab la/ de'i khrod nas rgan pa rang gi ma yin snyam pa zhig gis nga la shin tu brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur pha mtha' mi dpogs par ston/ bu chung la gces kha byed pa ltar/ mgul par 'khyud pa dang / gdong gtug pa dang 'o byed pa la sogs ngo tsha dang tshul 'chos pa'i rnam 'gyur spangs nas/ bu chung dang ma'i 'du shes kyi ngang nas brag phug shin tu yangs pa slob dpon chen po'i dbu rjes yod pa zhig tu khrid/ der khong rnams kyis 'di mtsho rgyal gyis gur pa bsgrubs ('di slar 'brug pa dge slong dang gleng skabs/ spa gro stag tshang gi mtsho rgyal gsang phug yin par ngo legs par 'phrod )pa'i gzim phug yin/ 'di u rgyan gyi dbu rjes yin zhes nged la gnas bshad kyi tshul du bshad nas/ khong rang rnams skad gra shin tu snyan pas maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs yid 'phrog pa zhig byas song /de'i mod la skad cig ma der de'i khrod na/ /bud med cung gzugs mi sdug pa zhig 'dug pa des bskul nas thams cad kyis nged la gdong gtad ste/ bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs/ /sogs blo ka gcig rgya gling btang ba'i skad las kyang snyan cing dwangs sangs par zer bas snang ba zichan ba zhig byung / de'i mod la rang gi phu bo yin rgyu ba zhig kyang khrong gi byung nas des bskul mkhan byas/ chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni/ci/sogs sh+lau ka gcig shin tu snyan pa'i skad gra sdebs nas 87

zer ma thag /rang gi snang ba la/ da 'di tsho yar klungs rten gsum mjal du 'gro yong / smon lam 'debs lugs shig bslab dgos snyam tsa na co dir gyis gyes song / de'i khrod nas nga rang gi sring mo yin snyam pa zhig da rung bsdad nas/ bslab don 'dra zhu rgyu yod de 'gol 'gol shig rtsa ba nas ma byung zer nas rna ba la kha gtugs te/ nyid rang lus dben par bzhugs dang / ston dpyid la sogs pa'i 'tsho chas ni 'bad med du yong / ngag dben par bzhugs dang / zer ba'i mod la skad shugs chung du chung du btang go rgyu ye ma byung /shub bu shub bu de go rgyu mi 'dug de las gsal bar smras dang byas pas/da dung skad shugs chung ngu btang / yang thos pa zhig la mi chen tsho la'ang ngo 'dzin cher gnang gzhan 'dra zer/ 'phros rnams go rgyu ye ma byung / der mi lam yin par shes te 'di lung bstan 'dra zer rgyu yin pa srid snyam nas ltos pa med par dran pa spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas/mi lam 'khrul pa yin par los kyang bden//mkha' 'gro rang rtsal yin par los kyang bden//lung bstan ltar snang yin par los kyang bden/ /thams cad kun rdzob yin par los kyang bden/ /bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i dbang du ma gyur zhing / /mkha' 'gro bdag gi dbang du 'dus pa las/ /dran rig spros bral dbyings la bzhag tsa na/ /gnyid sad bu mo gar song cha med thal/ /der rjes thob kyi shes pa la skyo shas tshad med pa zhig langs/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rang rang gi las la spyod pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med par myong ba rnams yid la lam lam shar nas snying rje dpag tu med pa skyes/ nga'i bla ma u rgyan yab yum de snying la dran nas tshugs thabs dang bral/ da ci'i mkha' 'gro 88

rnams yid yul du lam lam gsal zhing u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling la gshegs song snyam pa'i mod la skyo glu rgyang 'bod 'di thal lo/ /da lta skyid mo gda' ba dkon mchog gi thugs rje/ /phyi ma 'gro sa legs pa sgom sgrub kyi 'bras bu/ /'jig rten mi dang snang ba bsnun dadagos pa mi 'dug /nga'i snying grogs dam pa'i lha chos la phebs shig /mi rtag 'ji ba dran pa nges 'byung gi rtsa ba/ /snying po'i bsgrub la gzhol ba don ldan gyi bgyi ba//'jig rten 'khor ba'i pha gzhis la chags dang dgos pa mi 'dug /nga'i snying grogs dben pa'i ri khrod la phebs gtong / /lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa don rgyud kyi byin rlabs/ /sgom pa ma bcos rang gsal tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu/ /sde dgon chos ra'i zhen pa byed da dgos pa mi 'dug /nga'i snying grogs dben gnas brag skyibs la phebs gtong / /'chi bdag nam yong med pa'iganas tshul la bsams pas tshe 'di'i legs nyes ston po'i 'ja' khrid ltar go byung / /skyid sdug mi lam sgyu mar zhen da dgos pa mi 'dug /nga'i snying grogs gong ma'i rnam thar la soms shig /gnas bzang brag ri'i ba gam brjid chags kyi phug tu/ /milos snying nas dam pa'i lha chos la bsams kyang / /las shugs bden pa'i rnga sgras yid kyi chom thun byas te/ /snang ba yul phyir shor ba'i skyo glu zhig thal lo/ /'od gsal nyi zla'i sgron ma nub ri la gzims pas/ /sna tshogs rtog pa'i rgyu skar lang long du g.yos byung / /bag chags kun gzhi'i gza' skar ngan song gi gting rdo/ /nga'i shar ri'i mgron po skyo sangs la phebs shig /skyo grogs rang sems dkar po bde stong gi ye shes//nyams gas lang tsho rngam pa'i 'jo sgeg dang sbrags nas/ /gtad med bden pa'i rgyang glus sems gso zhig thong la/ / 89

nga'i snang sems ka dag spros bral la sbyor dang / /mdza' grogs glo snying thug po rdzogs chen gyi sgeg mo/ /kun brtags yokha'i snang ba mtha' grol du thong la/ /sgron drug 'ja' zer thig le'i 'dzum mdangs kyi ngang nas/ /nga'i snang bzhi'i 'od gsal zad sa la skyol dang //mdza' mo thugs bskyed dkar po kun bzang gi ḍāk+ki/ /dbyings rig gzhon nu bum sku'i khang mdzes kyi nang du/ /dran rig 'pho 'gyur med pa g.yung drung gi khri la/ /nga'i rig pa cog gzhag 'khyil ba ru zhog dang / /tshisgo mtha' shes byas gzhal ba ngar 'dzin gyi cong rdo/ /don mtha' rtogs pas gcod pa grub thob kyi bshul lam/ /byar med rgyal po skyid nyal lhag pa yi mal du/ /nga'i skyo grogs 'od gsalaspubs 'jug la phebs dang / /so dkar bzhon pa'i mi tshe yad yud la langs song / /dbu dkar rgan po'i 'tsho rtsis sgug long ni mi gda'/ /da ni mi tshe'i nyi ma nub ri la langs song nga'i lam sna u rgyan chos rje yis mdzod dang / /gnas bzang mi med lung stong pha gzhis su bzung nas/ /rtse btsun chen po'i rnam thar ma 'aslongs ngo zin na/ /mkha' spyod dbu ma'i lam la btsan thabs su 'khrid pa'i/ /nga'i ye shes mtsho rgyal bsu ma la phebs dang / /ci shar dag pa rab 'byams nyams myong la shar na/ /gnas kyi gang zag rlob pa'i re dogs kyang ma dgos/ /dam tshig zla zhun dkar po'i bas mtha' zhis btsal nas//nga'i mi tshe'i lhag ma sgom sgrub la sgril gtong / sgrub gnas chu shing 'dzom pa dbang chen gyi pho zang / /lwa ba dkar po'i lding gur 'od gsal gyi khang mdzes/ /mkha' 'gro glu dbyangs sgrog pa'i nags tshal gyi gling nas/ /nga'i skyo grogs bung ba'i dbyangs rta la drangs so/ /zhes blangs pas gcig por bro 'khrab snying 'dod tshad tshad kyi nyams 'ur ba 90

byung ngo //bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /re zhig gi tshe nyi 'og gi rgyal po'i lung nas bod chung ngu'i ljongs kyi phyir song du dbang bskur ba'i las kyis khengs pa'i ri bo nam mkha'i dbyings la co 'dri ba zhig yod ces grag go/ /des de bzhin gshesas pa'i gsung rab kyi phung po bya ba las kyi 'khor los bskyed bsrings pa'i ngo mtshar gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang / bsngo ba smon lam gyi mtha' bsdus pa'i yi ge'i brtsam gzhi dgos zhes bdag la bsnyad par mdzad do/ /de yang 'di skad du/ rang phyogs kyi grub mthar ma lhung ba/ dngos cag pa dang dbang phyogs kyi mi'i bdag po la bstod ra gang che dgos zhes pa tsam snying por snang /der 'di snyam du/ kṛ kri'i mi ltas dang mtshungs par sde pa bco brgyad du gyes pa'ang shākya seng ge'i phrin las kyi dbang gis yin/ gdul bya'i dbang gi bstan pa'i rnam grangs tha dad du shar ba la rtsa ba'ang tha dad par dbye na 'chos pa rmongs pas g.yogs pa'o/ /de lta na'ang 'phen byed kyi kun rtog ji lta bu yin kyang rdzogs byed kyi las dge ba'i phung por rdzogs pa nyid du dpyad/rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa'i bab tshul gzhung tshugs par sngon du btang nas gnas skabs kyi rjod byed la snyan dngags pa'i rab btags dang /zol gyi bstod pa'i ngag garnyarba rab dga'i gling bu'i sgra gdangs su bsgyur nas shog bu brgya la nye ba zhig bris/ nor skyong gi tshil bus zug rngu'i rma la phan pa'ang 'jig rten na chos can/ /brtsam gzhi'i yi ge 'thu ba la phan pa'i dngos por gyur pas yi rangs/ /gcam bu'i ngag gi yi ge'i lam nas gya gyur bstod cing gnang byin 'dra yang thob bo/ /rgyu des re zhig gi tshe mtshams la huX

'don gyi brda 'grem dang bcas chos tshig sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi phyogs ga la ba der bya bral rnal 'byor spyod pa slar nyan thos kyi cha byad byas te 'degs dgos pa'i pho nya ba shugs ldan gyi bzhon par bcas pas mdun bdar byung ngo //de'i tshe sngon nas sman btsun mched lngas 'gyur med nges pa'i lung gis blang dor gyi gnas bstan pa de yid yul du lham mer shar/ rang byung lhan skyes ma'i ḍāk+kis kyang bshol ba'i brda stabs cir yang ston to/ /der 'di snyam du/ 'di phyi thams cad du nam yang bslu ba med pa de dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum las gzhan du ga la zhig /tshul des rang re bya bral rnal 'byor pa'i mgo btags ni dus ring mo zhig nas khong rnam pa la zhus zin/phral snang zang zing gi dngos po dang khe grags snying la 'dod pa zhig yin na bsgrub pa'i dam bca' rlung la bskur nas der bgrod pa yin mod/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ gzhan bzhugs pa rang drag /bstan pa dang sems can la phan rlabs po che thogs pa zhig yin na der bgrod pa zhig yin mod/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/gzhan bzhugs pa rang drag /dngos su sbas/ lkog tu brid/ ngo so gzhan gyi 'don pa'i bya byed su las kyang brel ba zhig sngar yang byas zin/ da yang de ka las 'os med byas pas rang gi rang la bden no bden no zhes smra zhing gnya' shing skam ltar rengs nas su'i kha la yang nyan pa mi 'dug go/ /dbyings brag stod la bzhugs pa'i thang dkar gyi rgod por/ /'khor gsum stag chas mdzes pa'i mda' sgro gcig 'dod de/ /rgod po gnam 'phang bcad pas gnang thebs rang zad song / /glang chen smyon pa lta bu grub thob kyi gshegs shul/ /stod gangs dkar 'grim pa'i seng ge dang dkar mor/ /thag 'dogs sgo khyi re 9 2

ba mang po dang 'dug ste/ /seng ge gangs la zin pas mthong sa na mi 'dug /khyung chen mkhar lding lta bu grub thob kyi gshegs shul/ /nags rlung nag 'tshub ma'i rgya stag gi khra chung / /tha shal bong bu'i pags pa'i mthongs 'jug la 'dod de/ /stag mo ri sul 'grim pa thub sa na mi 'dug /g.yu 'brug sngon mo lta bu grub thob kyi gshegs shul/ /rtogs pa gdeng du gyur pa'i ltos med kyi bya bral/ /gto chos grong 'khrul byed pa'i a ya cig re ste/ /ngo bsrung phyogs cha spangs pas phebs sa na mi 'dug /rang gdangs ltag tshugs can gyi rnal 'byor la ltos dang / /he ho byas pas 'ga' zhig na re/ ha cang rang thugs gtum ma drag gam zer/ kun mkhyen gyis/ bsdad pa'i tshe na 'gro ba'i blo sna 'don/ /phyin par gyur na bsdad pa legs zhes zer/ ci zer 'di zer rang bzhin cha med pa'i/ /zhes dang / chos gtsor bzhag nas bya lam bsgrubs na yang / /'jig rten ma shes bya byed nor zhes zer/ /cung zad bstun na mthun 'jug che zhes smra/ /dus ngan 'khor la bsams bzhin skyo ba 'phel/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan gyi rnam par rtog pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di la mtha' med/ rang gi dgongs pas zhib mor dpyad pa de la nor 'khrul mi 'dug go byas so/ /dus de'i tshe slar yang gnas dang gang zag gi rten 'brel zung du chud pa'i che ba dbyung zhing skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi gdung ba drag pos srid pa de'i 'ching zhen btsan thabs su gcod pa'i rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyi mgur glu 'di bsgrags so/ /lta ba blo 'das kyi pho brang na/ /sgom pa yengs med kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ /spyod pa mtha' grol gyi mnga' thang che/ /dpon mjal go chod pa zhig de na gda'//'jig rten pa'i mi dpon gang dgyes mdzod/ /ma bcos lhun 93

grub kyi 'dun khang na/ /snang rig zung 'jug gi btsun mo bzhugs/ /bde gsal stong nyid kyi bzhin ras mdzes//sman grogs go chod pa zhig de na gda'//g.yon can gyi sgeg mo gang dgyes mdzod//zhin med rang grol gyi mnga' ris na//lung rtogs yon nyan gyi blon po bzhugs/ /thos bsam sgom sgrub kyi blo gros che/ /mi 'dun stabs mkhas pa zhig de na gda'/ /dpyad 'khyog por btang rnams sang dgyes mdzod/ /rgyud lung man ngag gi mdzod phugs na/ /yang tig yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhugs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nus pa che/ /gser gyi yang zhun zhig de na gda'/ /zab dgu'i mching bu rnams gang dgyes mdzod/ dbyings rig zang thal gyi klong chen na/ /theg brgyad zil gnon gyi gser 'khor bzhugs/ /'khor 'das dbang bsgyur gyi 'od zer che/ /rgyal thabs spyi blugs shig de na gda'/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal rnams gang dgyes mdzod/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug gi nags khrod na/ /sku gsum rang chas kyi glang po bzhugs//shin tu rnal 'byor gyi theg pa che//'gran gyi do med cig de na gda'//sa bsrung dbang po rnams gang dgyes mdzod/ /thos bsam phyogs med kyi ne'u thang na/ /sgom pa rang gsal gyi cang shes bzhugs/ /sa lam cig chod kyi bang 'gros mgyogs/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan zhig de na gda'/ /a shwa mjug ring rnams gang dgyes mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ldan gyi g.yul ngo na/ /bsrung bzlog gsad gnan gyi dmag dpon bzhugs/ /'od zer spro bsdu'i dmag mi rags/ /rgyal 'gong tshar gcod cig de na gda'/ /kuṭa ka tshogs rnams gang dgyes mdzod/ /de mi dbang nga yi khyad nor yin/ /rgyal phrad kun la yod ma lags/ /nam 'chi cha med kyi ri sul na/ /tshe srog hub 'debs gyi 'chi bdag 9/

bzhugs/ /cis kyang mi ldog pa'i nus mthu che/ /dgra 'jigs go chod pa zhig de na gda'/ /glo bur gyi dgra bo gang dgyes mdzod/ /las 'bras bslu med kyi tshong 'dus na/ /bde sdug rnam 'byed kyi tshong dpon bzhugs/ /bzang ngan 'dor len gyi nor nyams che/ /dpyad shin tu bzod pa zhig de na gda'/ /g.yo 'khrul gyi rgya pa gang mnyes mdzod/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi chu 'gram na/ /zhen pa rang log gi mnyen dpon bzhugs/ /thag pa sna tshogs kyi sgrol 'don ma khas/ /mi dal 'byor don ldan zhig de na gda'/ /'dod gdungs kyi ded dpon sang dgyes mdzod/ /shes pa rang gsal gyi spang ljongs na/ /rnam rtog 'tsho skyong gi rdzi bo bzhugs/ /shal grol rjes med kyi ri lug mang / /mi sems bskyed can zhig de na gda'/ /gla 'dod kyi rdzi bo gang dgyes mdzod/ /nang rdo rje lus kyi satsang khang nang / /phung khams gnas dag gi lha tshogs bzhugs/ /ma bcos lhun grub kyi zhal phyag mdzes/ /lha byin rlabs can zhig de na gda'/ /phyi 'dus byas kyi lha khang gang dgyes mdzod/ /de 'khor ba dpe la gras pa yin/ /myang 'das don la sbyar ba yin/ /zung 'jug gnad 'gag shes pa yin/ /snying gtam gros su btab pa yin/ /yin lugs bzhi yi mgur dbyangs 'di/ /gsung gi dben gnas mchims phu yi/ /dbang chen nags kyi dur khrod che/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang me tog phugs/ /sdig can skye bo'i rgyu 'grul med/ /bya tshogs snyan pa'i gsung glu kyur/ /na bun dkar po'i mgul dar mdzes/ /g.ya' chu bsil ba lhung lhung 'bab/ /bung ba mang po 'phur lding g.yo/ /nyams rtogs rtsol med 'char ba'i gnas/ /rang byung brag gi khang mdzes nang / /rdo rje snying po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dbang chen mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ /blo la shar nas bris pa 95

lags/ /der nam dus ston ser dang thug /nub mo o dkar du grags pa'i ngan sems can 'dis sa la'i 'khri shing gi rtser 'dzegs nas bya wang gi phrug gu chung chung de grangs med gsod kyin 'dug pa'i 'jigs skrag gi skad shin tu mi bzad pa thos pa dang / snying rje drag nas sdug bsngal bzod blag med pa byung / u rgyan rin po che mkhyen/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho la bde ba khab rtse tsam med pa 'di nas mtshon/ sman dang myu gus 'tsho ba'i 'dab chags 'di lta bu la'ang tshe srog glo bur du gcod pa'i 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal dos drag /'di dag gis kyang rang gi pha dang ma byas zhing brtse bas bskyangs pa'i grangs mi chod/ da lta rang gi 'du shes 'khrul du bcug /bya wang de dngos yin pa'i 'dun pa btang na/ de ma thag gzugs phung sbra'i chon thag shor ba'am/ lpags rlon me la bsregs pa ltar 'dus shing skyi bung bung mi byed pa'i dbang mi 'dug 'khor ba zo chu'i 'khyud mo lta bu yin pas skye ba 'di ga'i phyi ma dud 'gro 'di lta bu zhig gi lus mi len pa'i nges pa ci yod/ dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ zhes pas byings gnas dang kha 'thor gyi dud 'gro phal cher la sdug bsngal 'di ka yod/ de yang sems can dmyal ba'i tshod du byas na chung ngu tsam yin/da 'di la gzhan thabs ni mi 'dug btang snyoms su bzhag na sems bskyed kyi khas blangs 'chor/ mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs sbyin pa byang sdom gyi bslab bya yang yin snyam nas mun pa'i smag dang grang zug gi reg bya ldang 'dug mang po'i ngal ba khyad du bsad nas 'ur rdos dkrogs pas zhag shas re khyad yong gi 'dug /spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ /bsal lo snyam du bsams na yang / /phan 'dogs bsam pa 96

dang ldan te/ /bsod nams dpag med ldan gyur na/ /sems can re re'i mi bde ba/ /dpas tu med pa bsal 'dod cing / /re re'ang yon tan dpas tu med/ /bsgrub par nus pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs/ da legs par bsams tsa na ngan song lta ci/ mtho ris na'ang bde ba khab rtse tsam mi 'dus /ma brtags pa'i snang ngor 'khor dang 'byor pas dregs pa'i sde dpon 'di tsho skyid pa ltar snang yang / dgra mi sdug pa dang phrad dogs/ rang bas che ba'i dgongs pa ma longs dogs/ mnyam pos do bsdos dogs/ dman pas skur pa btab kyi dogs pa la sogs sdug bsngal kho na las mi 'dug /'jig rten bar ma'i 'gro ba 'di dag sho zhe sdang / mgu 'khang bco brgyad/ sdug lus khong bsran/ 'dod bskyangs min/ snying mi sdug pa dang gdug gshibs thod pa dung 'grog sogs sems skyid pa zhogs las tsam med pa'i tshod du gda'/ dbul po lto gos kyi 'phongs pa 'di dag ni nyin bza' rgyu med/ mtshan gon rgyu med pa khral nag gi khar sdug skur btsugs pas mi chog /dpon po dpya khral sogs la nem nur byung na dmyal ba mngon sum lta bu'i mnar spyod dang khrims lugs lus thog tu myong bas skyid po zer ba gang na'ang mi 'dug /ci tshugs byed snyam nas sems sdug langs pa la tshad med pa zhig gi ngang du ma ṇi 'dren gyin bsdad tsa na/ de kha'i ngang la 'du shes 'di 'khrul/ kun gyi gzhi mdo chen mo bya ba'i thang yangs po zhig tu slebs/ de na ma bcos rang byung bya ba'i mchod rten chen po zhig kyang 'dug/mchod rten de la bskor ba byed mi mang po 'dug pa'i khrod nas rtogs ldan zhig dang grwa ba zhig chos gtam chu khol khol btang ba mthong /der grwa ba na re/ khyod rtogs ldan gyi rigs las zog che ba/97

mi thams cad mgo bo bskor don dam pa'i gnas lugs ni ma go/ grub mtha' gye mtsho'i mtha' dpyod ni mi shes/ chang dang bud med la bsnyen pa btang nas sdod/ byed lugs 'di tsho mgon po rdo rje 'chang gis gsan na ci gsung ha go zer ha las las byed kyin 'dug /rtogs ldan na re bzhugs bzhugs/ 'brug smyo na gyi mgur 'bum na da lta 'dul ba dang su mthun zer/ bcom ldan 'das dang rgyan drus mchog gnyis mthun las che/ gzhan 'dul ba yi ger bris pa'i snas tsha dang shog bu mthun yong zer ba de khyod kyis ma go 'dug /mi mtho bskor ba la chos brdzu byas nas bskor ba dang / rgya ba byas nas bskor ba la khyad yod pa e yin/ chang dang bud med ni rtogs ldan khas ngan pa byung na ma rtogs hu hu hu/ zer gyi 'dug pas grwa ba zhe sdang langs/ rtogs ldan la sang bza' brdeg grabs byas/ khong gnyis lag 'thab sprod du nye bar ngas sems kyi ma bzod/ khong gnyis kyi bar du 'tshangs/ de 'dra mi mdzad pa zhu zer kyi yo da tsa na/ bskor mi ba gzhan zhig na re/ khong gnyis nga che nga btsan gyi khengs pas btan du dag snang sbyang res med par 'di ka byed cing 'dug /da khyed rang cha lugs gra min grub min snang ba gdod 'ded lta bu la/ gting bsam pa bzang po 'dug pas rgyal ba'i bka' dpang por bzhag pa'i gzu cig thong dang zer der ngas rig pa gzengs bstod/ 'o na gsan pa zhu/ sems nyid ngal gso'i lung bstan las/ bod khams mi rnams dam sdom bral/ /de dus gangs dkar ti se nas/ /yar lha sham po'i bar dag tu/ /btsun pa'i gzugs can bye ba gcig /btsun par mos tsam 'bum phrag gcig /tshul bzhin sdom pa bsrung ba ni/ /lnga brgya lhag las mi 'byung ngo / /btsun gzugs mang na sdom 98

nyams mang / /de dus sde yi ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan mngon du gyur nas chos gzugs phal cher khyim pa las bsam sbyor lod cing / yon gnas su khas 'ches nas zhim dgu'i zas dang / bdog dgu'i dngos ngo la longs spyad pas kyang mi chog par/ bsod snyoms tsam byed kyang bye'u dang khra thug pa lta bu'i sgyu gshed kyis blangs nas khyim pa sun 'byin kho na lhur byed pa 'di pa'ang bcom ldan 'das thugs blo bde po yod skad mi 'dug /gsung rab sde snod las/ ngas sha'i zas su la'ang ma gnang mi gnang gnang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab tu byung ba rnams la sha'i zas ni mi rung bar ngas bshad do/ /zhes dang deng phyin chad du nga'i nyan thos rnams sha bzar mi rung ngo / /zhes bshad pa ma gtogs bshas ra'i nang du tshag lug gi mgo la rtags gsal bkod shog gsungs ba ma mthong / de bzhin du chang la/ gang zhig chang gi btung ba rtsa'i rtse mo yan chad 'byung bar byed pa de ni nga'i nyan thos ma yin la/nga ni de'i ston pa ma yin no/ /zhes chad la bor kyang sha chang gnyis ni dge slong du rlom pa rnams kyis kyang lto'i dwangs mar byed pas de ka gcig po sdom pa yu la med du sangs nas mi 'dug pas khyed btsun pa rnams nas kyang gnas dbyung gi 'jigs pas chung ma dngos su ma brten pa tsam la sdom pa gtsang ba'i rlom sems kyi kun la khyad du bsad pa 'di ma mdzad par dga' bo'i mdo sogs la'ang thugs bsam legs po bzhes pa zhu/ blo gros rab gsal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las kyang bslab pa dang tshul khrims ji ltar bsrung bar bgyi/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pas tshul khrims dang / tshul khrims 'chal ba dang / tshul khrims bsrungs ba la sogs 99

pa'i 'du shes sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa ni/ lha'i bde ba nyams su myong nas slar ngan song du 'khor bar 'gyur ro/ /sang la sdom pa dang sdom pa ma yin pa'i rlom sems med cing / rtog pa med pa de ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes bshad/ yang rtogs ldan rnams kyi chos lugs tsam dang /sgom zhwa bus 'khyud kyi srung ba tsam la brten nas nyon mongs pa lnga la 'byor nyog tu spyod cing da dung bdag cag ni gsang sngags pa'o zhes chang la sogs par bag 'dzem med par spyad nas spyon bar gyur pa'i tshe bag med ngo tsha dang bral ba'i spyod pa la brtul zhugs che ba'i ming snyan po 'dogs pa 'di yang theg pa chen po'i bstan pa la rma 'byin chen po zhig tu 'dug /bskyed rdzogs kyi nus pa mngon du gyur nas dug bdud rtsir bsgyur nus shing /chang gi bzi ba'i nus pa zil gyis gnon thub pa rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / grub chen birlu pa sogs kyi rnam par thar pa dang spyod yul yin pa ma gtogs gsang sngags mos pas spyod pa'i gang zag lam zhugs pa rnams kyi btung bar ma gsungs te/ rgyud las/ su zhig chang gi myos gyur pa/ /de la gegs ni mang po 'byung / /sngags pa chang gi myos gyur gang / /ngu 'bod gnas su 'tshod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ deng sang gi bla ma grub thob tu rlom pa rnams chang gi bzi thub pa 'dug gam mi 'dug mi 'dug na go bcad/ 'dug na rgyun du rtogs pa la mnyam rjes med pa'i gdeng yod kyang chang gi bzi ba dang smyon pa la khyad par med smyo ba dang dus mtshungs par thugs dam dang sgom gyi dran pa'i tshugs kha ma shor ba lta ci/ 'du shes ma 'khrul pa tsam yang med mod/de bzhin du mtshon byed dpe'i dbang nod cing rdo rje theg pa'i sgo ru /00

zhugs pa tsam nas bgrod bya bud med la tsham tshom med par 'jug pa 'di yang khyab gdal du dar ba zhig snang ste/ ma 'ongs 'gong pos bslad pa'i chad lta la/ /stong nyid zung 'jug ces su 'chad pa dang / /gsang ba sngags kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i dus/ /nyon mongs spyod la bde ba chen po zhes/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan mngon du gyur pa ma lags sam/kha cig rlung gi nus pas dwangs ma btsan thabs su 'ching nus pa dang / des mtshungs par thur lam gyi phyag rgya lam la ma zhugs pa'i skye bo'i khrod du mtshar ston mchor dgod du byas nas rtsa rlung shes pa'i zlokha sems su byed pa thos te/de dag ni gsang sngags zab mo'i dam tshig dang sdom pa chu la rdo 'phangs pa bzhin du 'dor ba'i bstan pa'i com rkun pa nyid du nges la/ dbang gsum pa'i srog rtsol gyi nyams len rang lus thabs ldan gyi lam mthar phyin nas/ gzhan lus bde ba chen por dbang bzhi lugs ldog gi rtsal rdzogs nas 'pho med kyi gdeng thob pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog par/ 'dod pa'i ngo bo ka dag chags grol chen por rtogs pas nyon mongs kyi 'dzin cha so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes su 'char ba zhig med na/ 'pho med kyi gnad shes pa tsam ni gnas skabs su rlig pa bcad pa'i dud 'gro dang 'dra zhes rtsa rlung rdo rje'i dra mig nas bshad cing / mthar thug de la grol ba thob pa'i rten 'brel med kyi steng du ldog bgram gyi man ngag gnad du ma song bas/ srog rlung dang / grang ba la sogs pa'i nad rkyen sna tshogs pa mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad dang bsdongs nas 'jug pa de khyed tshos ma rig pa 'dug byas pas/ khong gnyis ma'i mtshang la phog drags/ 'thab mo byed 'phro rang sar bzhag /mgo thums bsgyur nas zhum zhum langs song bas gzhan zhig na re/101
