byung byung de ka yin rjes su yi rang / sadams ngag rnam thar gyi sgo nas ston pa de tsho la zer sa'an byas byas byung byung rang bris pas ci ka yong / khyod la rang yul na sgom chen pa a tho ba tsam kyi mthong yang mi 'dug /ngo shes 'dris med kyi lung pa tshor ni snyan pa 'ur langs pa zhig 'dug pa de 'dra ci zhis gam snyam pa kho na byung bas/ da byas tsa na bzhugs sa la 'khos mi 'dug kyang nang na nyams myong yod nges shes pa de mi bo ba can tshos rig par 'dug /da khyed rang gi grub mtha' dang / lta ba'i zhe phulas gang la gtong tshig nyung la mtha' chod pa zhig gsung ba zhu dang zer byung bas/ sems can blo mang ba bzhin du grub mtha' rnam grangs mang bas 'dul ba 'di ston pa rdo rje 'chang bi khyad chos su 'dug pas thams cad la dag snang sbyang ba las/ mdo rgyud dang man ngag zab mo'i tshig de kha la nyung ma mur mur byed don zab mo de dgra ltar spangs nas/ nga'i chos lugs las zab pa dang kham che ba mi yong nga rang las 'gangs che ba dang / tshul khrims gtsang ba/ grub pa thob pa mi yong zhes sde dang ris su bcad pa'i grub mtha' zhig nga la ston rgyu med/ rang ngo so sore gzhung lugs dang man ngag 'di rang legs bsam pa kun la yod/ nged cas rdo rje snying po pa la'ang kun mkhyen chen po'i gzhung gi rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi rjes pher nges pa de ka lags/ de las rnam par dag rgyu ci yod rjes 'jug bi grul mi btub pa ni su'i khrod na'ang yod pa de yin mod/ dus tshod dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa la rgyu 'bras 'gal 'du med pa ni/ rgyu'i theg pa nas nyon mongs pa dang 'dod pa'i yon tan gnyen po brten nas spang byar gsungs pa thams cad/ 'bras bu'i theg pa nas blang byar gsungs pa yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam 10 2

thabs dang shes rab bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'phags shing / dbang po rnon po'i gdul bya la rjes su bstan pas spang rgyu'i ngo bo lam du longs pas mthar thug gnyis ka spang bya'i bdag nyid can du mtshungs pa yin pa go dbos/dper na rma byas dug zos pa dang bzhan gyis zos pa la khyad par ci 'dra 'dug /de'i ngo bo rang lta ba rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyi byed pa pos byas shing thabs kyis zin pas khur bor ba yin/ yang nga'i bla ma u rgyan chos kyi rgyal po des/ rgyal po chen po/ nga'i gsang sngags 'di lta ba gtso che lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor ba mdzod/ lta ba'i rjes su spyod pa shor na dge stong sdig stong du gol nas nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta bar 'gro/spyod pa'i rjes su lta ba ma shor ba mdzod spyod pa'i rjes su lta ba shor na dngos po mtshan ma can gyis bcings nas grol ba'i dus ma mchis/ zhes gsungs/ gsang sngags mos pas spyod pa lam thad drang du 'khrid pa'i gnad 'di las zab pa mi 'dug snyam pa yod/ gzhan du sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ /ces sdom pa gsum ker nyes pa bskyed pa bkag cing / yon tan bskyed pa bkag pa gang na'ang med pas gnang bkag rdzas mi 'gal ba'i ngo bo rang / mig 'phrul lta bur sems can gyi khams shin tu glo bur dri mas ma dag pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang das pa chen po'i dbyings la sbyor ba'i theg pa'i rtse rgyal rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po sgom med ye grol rang bab cog bzhag /gnas 'gyu bar 'gyel/ ye bzhag ngang sgom 'du shes gtad med/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog dga' ba dang / sdug pa dang / skyid pa dang / ngu bro ba la sogs te bzang ngan re dogs kyi rnam rtog 103

lcags kyi par bur bcug kyang mi 'chun pa de ko/da lta'i rig pa rjen hur hur/khas len thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du ma yengs/ ma 'khrul/ dmigs pa gang la gtad/ min byas na yin/ yin byas na min/ gad mo 'chor/ dgod rgyu med grub mtha' zhig/smra snying mi 'dod/kha phya ra ra/mig hur hur sems can thams cad kyi grol sa chen po kho la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khong gis kyang ming 'dogs ma shes/ kun tu bzang pos kyang lab rgyu zad nas/ /res 'ga' snang cha yin zhes ngo tsha dang bral ba'i gzugs sngo hrong hreng g.yo 'gul med pa ltar byed/ res 'ga' stong cha yin zhes gting gsal brjod du med pa'i ngang mdangs nam mkha' stong pa las kyang dang sangs/ gu yangs/ har che/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi lab lab mang po rdzun phugs rdib/ rgyud sde dang man ngag zab mo'i kha spo mtha' dag da lta'i dran rig he ho/ zer ma shes/ lab ma shes/smra ma shes/da de ga'i ngang du zhog thong /zer gyi yod tsa na nyams snang de sad/ snang ba la/ 'a'i rnam rtog rdzun po che 'di'i bde blag dang g.yo 'khrul la yi gang zag dga' mo zhig yin na mkha' 'gro'i gsang lung yin byas kyang los 'ong /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don bsams tsa na kun tu rtog pa oṃ lha'irgyu/lar thugs dam bskyangs pa'i lam rtags sam/'dod khams kyi bdag po'i cho 'phrul gang la'ang gsal sna ci rigs pa 'byung ba bshad ste/ don dam par 'od gsal 'dus ma byas kyi klong du dgag sgrub re dogs las 'das par brdal ma shes na 'jungs shor/ rang re tsho'i nang gi rtogs pa dang phyi'i spyod lam gnyis rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa'i rgyud lung man ngag dang bstun na gar yang phyin par mi 'dug pas/ ye shes kyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i dag pa rab /04

'byams dang mngon par mkhyen pa yin snyam pa ni med/ nang du dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa dang / phyi ru re dosas kyi gzeb las grol zhing tshad med thugs rje'i 'jug pa mngon pa chos nyid yin pas/ rang re la dag snang che zhing rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyi thugs la de ltar bzhag pa zhu/ zhes smras nas rang gis rang nyid la bslab bya snying gtam gyi mgur bca' yig chen mo zhes bya ba/skyabs rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs kyi ngo bo/ /dus snyigs ma'i skyabs gnas gangs chen gyi lha cig/dran pas snying gi mun sel o rgyan rje mkhyen no//bdag las ngan sems can la thugs rje yis gzigs shig /sems gzhi med rtsa bral myang 'das kyi rdzong chen/ /yid rtog pa'i drwa ba 'khor ba yi cong rdo/ /khong gnyis kyi so mtshams skyo shas su shar ba'i/ /gros snying gtam dran pa'i me btsa' la 'debs so/ /las nag por bsags pas lus ngan de blangs shing / /gshis spyod ngan ston la yid skyo zhig shor bas/ /skyabs dkon cog rin chen btang snyoms su ma bzhugs/ /snying rje ba'i 'dab chags 'jigs skrag las skyobs shig /las 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin du ston pa/ /rje rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi 'jug sgo//bdag las nyon can gyi bde ba ru mthong bas/ /sdug 'khor bar gtan 'khulas da lta phan thal lo/ /mgon bla ma'i byin rlabs snying dbus su babs pas/ /blo las rung bla ma phyi rol na ma bzhugs/ /sems chos skur grol bas bag chags kyi rten la/ /snying dmar por ston pa'i bslab bya 'di 'chad do//gnas ngan song sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ru mthong bas//'dis dal 'byor rnyed dka' mngon sum du bstan mod/ /khyod dal 'byor mi lus stong zad du ma gtong / /las byas pa don ldan lha chos la rem mdzod/ /105

chung byis pa'i mi tshe thal rtsed la zad 'dug /lus lang tsho'i mdzes pa 'chi bdag gis bcom 'gro/ /gtam lto bos khol po mi tshe la rim kyang / /lu sa dres mas bsdam tshe phan pa zhig mi 'dug/las dkar nag khra gsum ma rul ba'i sa bon/ /'bras bu rang thog smin pa mngon sum du e gzigs/ 'dis ngan song gsum gyi brgya char yang mi phod/ /'dzol dge sdig blang dor la ma shor ba dgos so/ /chos zhus blo thob blos 'khor ba las mi grol/ /gzugs rab byung tsam gyi nyan thos su mi 'gro/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis ma ldan du zin kyang / /tshong bun skyid khyim pa'i 'tsho 'dzin la ma rem/ /nyan rang zhi bder gzhol ba gnas skabs kyi bde ba/ /theg chen gzhan don bslab pa byang sems kyi don rdo/ /'jag tsho bla na med pa'i gsang chen la sbyangs nas/ /rten 'di la byang chub thob nges shig byed dgos/ /lus log pa'i 'tsho bas gzi byin dang ldan zhing / /nor gsog bskrun mkhas po'i thong sham da 'grig 'grig /yid mi dge'i zlos gar ngan song la chas pa'i//grogs gra sa'i zhen pa snying dbus nas chod mdzod/ /mgor skra yi lha wa mu stegs la'ang yod mod/ /gos ras gos gyon pas rtogs ldan du mi 'gro/ /pha grub thob gong ma'i shul lam la 'byon na/ /gnas dben par bskyed rdzogs nyams len la 'bungs mdzod/ /blo bla mar gtod pa skyabs 'gro yi mthar thug /don gzhan don lhur len sems bskyed kyi ngo bo/ /dran shes bzhin skyong ba mdo sngags kyi lam khyer/ las shes shes mang po'i pher yod de zhog mdzod/ gnyen nye ba'i gdung sems lha bdud kyi g.yab mo/ /dgra ngar ma'i ya bzung dmyal ba yi lam mkhan/ /mi gzhan zer kha mda'i re dogs la nyan na/ /chos mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa log lam la bsgyur yong / /106

gtam snya na pa'i grags pa nga rgyal gyi cong rdo/ /nor kha drag 'dzomag pa lha chos dang rgyab 'gal/ /mi'i khyu nas bud pa bya btang gi yang rtse/ /che'i lhas ma chags med blo bde la skyel mdzod/ /gnas dben par bsgoms pa 'i mthu nus dang yon tan/ /khong 'jig rten khyim pa'i rkyen sel la btsongs nas/ /'gro don phrin las che ba'i nga rgyal gyi stong sbo sa/ /bdud mngon sum 'grub pa'i g.yang sa la gzabs mdzod/ /skyabs bla ma dkon cog thugs rje la brten nas/zas mthun rkyen mi brel lhud lhun du babs kyang / /las rgyu 'bras phra zhib rtsis grangs su thob la/ /sdig sha chang zas la bag yo da kyi rol mdzod/ /nang bdag 'dzin khong bsran ma zhig pa de ko/ /phyi dur khrod nyul ba'i brtul zhugs la chas kyang / /phugs sprang snyogs khyer ba'i snga ltas su 'dus pas/ /gnas dben par bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rang tshugs mdzod/ /yul sa phyogs gang dang ci 'dra ru 'dug kyang / /'khor ral rol chags snang sa bon de spangs la/ /stabs bde po tha mal smyo spyod kyi ngang nas/ /blo bde po ka dag chos zad rang skyong mdzod/ /skabs 'ga' re dgos pa don ldan gyi rgyu bar/ /blo chos mthun mched grogs re gnyis las mang ba'i/ /sems lang shor sha chang bdud gcod kyi rtog btsun/ /rjes nyul ba'i bla chung de 'dra zhig ma mdzad/ /dus kun tu mi nyog rten sgor de mang na/ /zas dkor nas bas med byung rgyal du spyod dgos/ /rang gcig po'i zas gos shugs 'byung du sla bas/ /pha grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar la gzigs mdzod/ /gson dad pas byin pa'i zang zing gi dngos po/ /gshin 'gags la thug pa'i nyer dpyad kyi rnam grangs/ /'dis thar pa'i srog rtsa btsan thabs su gcod pas/ /khab skud pa bsgyus nas mchod sbyin la thong /07

mdzod/ /dgras log bsgrub byas kyang thugs dam gyi bogs 'don/ /gtam ma nyes kha yogs dge bskul gyis lcag 'debs/ /'di chags zhen 'jig pa'i bla ma ru 'dug pas/ /kho'i drin lan 'khor thabs med pa ru gzigs mdzod /snying nye po'i gdung sems gzung 'dzin gyi bstod phur/ /grogs mdza' ba'i mjal phrad dge sbyor gyi bdud gcod/ /kha mi dge'i bang mdzod nyes ltung bi 'byung khungs/ /zon mdzad na khong de gsum la sgrim mdzod/ /yongs drag zhan phyi nang bar ma yi thad nas//las bzang ngan rnam 'gyur ji 'dra ru ston kyang / /de ma shes ma rig rdzu bag dang 'grogs nas/ /stobs bzod pa'i go cha btsan po ru bgos shig /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rgyal bas kyang gdul dka'/ /phan btags pa'i brda lan log bsgrub kyis sbyor zhing / gnas dben pa 'dug kyang brnyas dmod kyis gtser ba/ /de kun kyang rmi lam sgyu ma ru sgom mdzod/ /lung rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyal bstan gyi snying po/ /chos 'chad spel rtsom pa bstan 'gro la sman kyang / /yul bsod nams dman pas gzhan don du mi 'gyur/ /sems 'khri ba chod nas bsgrub pa la 'bungs mdzod/ /dus bskal pa snyigs ma'i spyod tshul dang lung bstan/ /ma 'gro drug yongs kyi spyi gtsug na babs 'dug /chos tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin skar las dkon pas/ /ma ḍak+ki'i gces nor khyab gdal du ma sgrogs/ /las bsrung bzlog gsad pa'i brtul zhugs la goms kyang / /dgra 'chi bdag bdud por las sbyor ni mi 'gro/ /gzhan bstan pa'i so nam byed mkhan ni dkon pas//rnga brdung na bya btang smyo ba rang yin mod/ /khyu mang po'i tshogs dpon mgu 'khang gi rang bzhin/ /mi chen po'i ngo 'dzin re dogs kyi 'byung khungs/ /skyabs kun 'dus o rgyan chos /08

rje la zhus nas/ /lam zab mo rdzogs pa chen po la zhugs mdzod/ /phyi nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog gi sla lugs/ /nang rnam rtog gya gyu'i bya byed kyi skyen lugs/ /'di bsams bzhin thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ /da 'chi chos ma ran dgu ran la 'dug bo/ /skra dag pa rab 'byams zhi khro yi tshom bu/ /gzungs glegs bam mdzes pa rig 'dzin gyi bla rdo/ /skyabs sku gsum bla ma'i drin rten du mdzod dang / /gnas zangs mdog dpal ri thag ring na mi 'dug/lus dag pa rab 'byams bde gshegs kyi dkyil 'khor/ /rlung nyi khri cig stong skye med kyi bzlas pa/ /sems ma bcos spros bral rang bab la zhog dang / /blos btags pa'i bskyed rdzogs la yid smon ni ma dgos/ /'gal ma 'gal rtsod par gzhung lugs pa los mkhas/ /chos kha 'dzin bsgrub par dbang yod rnams btsan drag /gshis brjod med blo 'das rdzogs chen gyi khyad chos/ /rkyen chos skur 'char pa 'od gsal gyi pha phogs/ /phyi snang ba dkar dmar rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo/ /nang rig pa bzo med lhun grub kyi rdzong chen/ /nga nam mkha'i rnal 'byor yin snyam pa med de//blo gtad med de yongs grol klong chen gyi thugs rje/ /gros snying gtam de ko nga rang la yin mod/ /gzhan gsan mkhan byung na ngo mtshar gyi rang bzhin/ /don rgyal sras spyod pa'i ngang tshul du gda' bas/ /skyabs rig 'dzin rgya mtsho mthun 'gyur la bzhengs shig /'di khams gsum rigs drug sems can gyi tshogs dang / /sgos blo snying gtod pa'i yon sbyor dang 'khor slob/ /gzhan gcam bu'i ngo 'dzin sna tshogs kyi 'dud pa'i/ /las 'brel thogs kun la smon lam du zhu'o/ /zhes smras/ 'brug pa'i rtogs ldan zhig gnas 'brel la 'ongs pa log khar nged kyi bug sgo 'gag tu dag 109

snang gi phrad du byung / sanas tshul 'dra gleng bas bsgrub tshugs dang mos gus nor nyan rang zhig 'dug /nyams rtogs skor la dri mol byas pas bla ma nyams myong can gyis ma zin pa'i nyams/ sgom lcags kyu dang 'ja' tshon ma sogs zhi lhag ri chos skad gya mdo mang po smra ba snang / kho'i snying rus dang bsgrub tshugs la 'phongs nas bka' rgyud gong ma'i dgongs pa 'di 'dra yin pa 'dra zhes rje mi la dang / yang dgon pa/ dwags po lha rje rnams kyi bzhed srol dpang por bzhag nas 'jam po'i ngag gis smras pas lag pa 'dar sil sil byed pa dang sbrags thugs bden zer sgom chen pa rgad po'i rang mthong ltag tshugs de rang mi byed pa'i go ba len pa zhig 'dug pas sems la shin tu phan par byung song / chos 'brel 'ig dbos zer ba ltar byas/ kha sang nas nged 'dir bcar na yod rgyur 'dug ste sku gnyer bas khong spun gnyis rgan pas mtshams byas/ gzhon pas mtshams g.yog byas nas yod zer ba'i rgyus yod las ma byung / mdang 'di nas cod ḍa gyi skad thos pas sems shin tu spro ba zhig byung bas mar lam mjal du yong ba yin zer 'phreng 'phreng ltar byed kyi 'dug pas kho'i bsam pa rdzogs pa'i slad du mgur 'di 'then no/ /e ma ho/ /chos nyid mngon sum mjal ba spros bral gyi bla ma/ /gtad med dran pas lta ba mo sa gus kyi mthar thug /thig le phyi na mi bzhugs shel sbug gi zer gdangs/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen sgom na de ltar du mdzod cig /bkod pa byang chub sems mchog bde stong gi ḍāk+ki/ /g.yo ba'i rlung gi 'grems pa thabs lam gyi rtsa ba/ /gnas yul phyi na mi bzhugs rtsa 'khor dang dbyer med/ /bde chen a nu sgom na de ltar du mdzod cig /g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin lhun grub kyi yi 0

dam/ /dkyil 'khor gsum gyi sgom pa bskyed rim gyi snying po/ /zhi khro phyi na mi bzhugs lhan skyes kyi rang gdangs/ /rnal 'byor chen po sgom na de ltar du mdzod cig /ye nas bsrungs mtshams bral ba dam tshig gi khyad chos/ /nyams mkhan rtsa gdar chod pa chos nyid kyi gshis lugs/ /nyams bya gdod nas dag pa ka dag gi ngo bo/ /lta ba'i klong bshags sgom na de ltar du mdzod cig /zab mo'i snyan brgyud sgom pa nyams len gyi sand 'asag /dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol ba lam rtags kyi yon tan//sa lam phyi na mi bzhugs rang rig la rdzogs 'dug/sangs rgyas lag bcangs sgom na de ltar du mdzod cig /ces smras/ dus de'i tshe nye skor gyi grong pa rnams nas sems can rgyags pa dang lus bongs che ba la sogs zlakha sems kyis bsad/ de'i mchin pa la sogs sdig zas kyi phud de thugs dam pa dang sgom chen pa tsho la phul shog ces khyer yong gi 'dug go/ /ster ba dang dag snang los yin te/ gsod nus pa de snying khams shin tu che/khong tsho'i snang ba la gsod pa'i nyes pa chen po de mi brtsi bar/ phran tshegs byin pa la phan yon chen po 'ong du re bas khong rang tsho'i nyes pa 'dag pa dang / sems can de nged tshos lcags thag 'then 'then byas chog pa lta bu'i re ba chen po zhig bdog ste ga nas yong / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bur dril yang sa yi lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes sems can thams cad kyi rang gi ma byas/ khong 'jig rten pas de ltar ma rig ste gsod nus kyang / rang re chos pa tshos bza' nus pa'i kha na mi 'dug /de ci'i phyir na skye ba sngon ma'i pha dang / ma dang / spun dang / mdza' bshes la sogs pa yid la gces dgu de tsho deng sang dud 'gro zer ba'i sgur po/ /gti /11

mug can/ blang dor la rmongs pa/ mgo la rwa co can/ sug bzhis sa la 'gro ba'i lus stabs 'di 'dra zhig tu song bas pha ma dang gnyen bshes de dag yin snyam pa'i rnam rtog tsam yang med par gyang ra stong pa bcug /'jig rten ya rabs kyi spyod tshul las phyir ldog cing / snying rje chen po dang zhe 'gras pas mthong ba tsam gyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i sdig can shan pa zer ba de'i lag tu rang gi skye ba sngon ma'i pha dang / ma dang / srun zla gnyen bshes la sogs pa de dag mthar chags su rtsis sprod byas pa'i tshe/ma rgan de dag lus 'dar phri li li/mig mchi ma khram khram/dgugs sbrud pa nyed nyed pa'i ngang nas 'di snyam du/da ci drag kyi hud/ 'bros sa ni med/ 'phur ni mi thub/ da lta nyid du sa 'dir dim na dim na snyam pa'i sdug bsngal dos drag la lcid che/'jigs skrag gi snang ba dmyal me'i dong khar lhags pa lta bu'i ngang der/ lus gnam sa bsgyur/brang drod tsha lam lam byed cing mig sngo hur hur/ blta bzhin pa de'i lto ba gris kha phye/lag pa shad de btang nas 'gul ba tsam yang med par 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam por btang ba yin 'dug pas/ 'jig rten khyim pa'i mchod gnas la dga' rgyu mi 'dug go//o rgyan rin po che mkhyen zhes yang yang smras/mchi ma dbang med du shor/ 'phags pa ka t+ya ya nas/ khyim bdag cig gi sgor bsod snyoms la byon tsa na/ khyim bdag des bu chung zhig pang par bzung / nya sha zhig zhim zhim snar bza'/ khyi mo zhig rus pa bza' ba la rdo bdeg cing srung pa gzigs pa 'phags pa'i mngon shes kyi dpyad pas/ skye ba de kha'i pha nyar skyes pa'i sha bza'/ ma khyir skyes pa la rdo bdeg rang nyid gsod pa'i dgra bur skyes pa pang na 'tsho bar mkhyen pas thugs shin tu mug ste tshigs su 112

bcad pa/ pha sha bza' zhing ma la bdeg /las ngan dgra bo pang na bzung / /chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'/ /'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/skye ba snga phyi'i lus stabs 'gyur ba 'dis/ pha ma'i sha bza' ba la tsham tshom med pa'i snying khams 'di yi re mug snyam nas snying brtse shum shum yod tsa na/ snying rje chen po'i gshis stong pa nyid kyi brtul zhugs su shar nas ga re/ da bsad zin pa la yi mug sgom pa kho nas mi phan/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje'i 'jug pa tshad med pa'i phyir rdo rje theg pa la sdug bsngal bde bar bsgyur ba'i man ngag kyang yod pa'i phyir/bsnyen sgrub zab mo tshad du ni 'khyol/lta ba rnam par dag pa ni yid dpyod dang pho tshod la mi re bar phyogs lhung dang bral/ de la nyan thos theg pa lta bu'i gu dogs dang / skye bo pal pa lta bu'i bag med pa'i bza' btung gi rang nyid la sgrib pa'i phung po mi bzad par bskyed cing / gzhan la phan pa med pa'i thabs la rmongs pa de 'dra ni ma yin snyam nas gzungs sngags rnam par dag pa'i sngags kyis btab/ /stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ba'i bden pa mi 'gog phyir sdig bshags la dmigs nas lo star lug gnyis gsum ci 'grub dang / nye'u brgya dang drug cu kha yan re srog skyob pa'i dam bca' lhur blangs/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig khyad du mi gsad pa'i phyir chos nyid la chos nyid kyi rol pa'i gsal snang bza' ba'i rnal 'byor du shar bas sems can de'i lus kyi 'brel pas tshogs rdzogs par byas te bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor drag pos rnam pa kun tu rgyas 'debs pa yin te/bdag nyid la dga' ba rnams nas phyin chad srog la bab kyang srog gcod kyi las 'di spongs shig /ci'i phyir na dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can gcig 113

gi srog bcad kyang bar gyi bskal pa gcig tu nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar 'tshed par gsungs shing /de lta bu'i sbyin pa'i gnas la'ang /mdo las/ sha dang chang gi sbyin pa dang / /dug dang mtshon cha'i sbyin pa sogs/ /zhes mi dge ba'i las su dngos rgyud kun nas 'gyur bar bshad pas sbyin pa de lta bu yang gnas ma yin no/ /lam khyer mi shes pa rnams nas sha bza' ba yang spong ci thub gyis shig /de lta bu'i bden pa'i tshig kun tu 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod nas lta ba nyams kyi glu/ho ho/ /dang por bya ba sems kyis btang / /rnam g.yeng spangs nas chos spyod brtson/ /bya ba'i las la zhen log sgom/ /bar du bya ba blo yis thong bya byed mang po dgos med shes/ /byas pas zin pa med par go/ /da lta bya ba rtogs pas thong / /bya ba'i 'du shes thad kur zhig /byar med rgyal po'i btsan sa zin/ /dang po dka' spyad snying rus byas/ /yi dam bsgoms shing rig pa bgrangs/ /dmigs rten bcas nas dran pa rten/ /bar du bskyed rim rang la shar/ /rig sngags bzlas brjod lhun grub shes/ /mnyam rjes dran pa'i so ba tshugs/ /da lta bskyed rdzogs rig par grol/ /'byung 'jug sngags su rang shugs shar/ /bya btsal med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /dang po bza' btung sdig par shes/ /las 'bras bsams nas tshod kyi rol / /gyi na'i zas kyis pho ba bskyangs/ /bar du bza' btung tshogs su shes/ /bag yod ngang nas skye mched khams/ /snang stong lha sku'i zhal du phul/ /da lta bza' btung chos nyid la/ /chos nyid khyab gdal ngang nas rol / /zas kyi bu lon ci la zer/ /dang po nyon mongs dug tu shes/ /nyon mongs spangs nas gnyen po bsten/ /dam chos

'dul ba'i gzhung lam bsrangs/ /bar du nyon mongs rtsa gdar bcad/ /byung khungs brtags nas zil gyis mnan/ /ma grub stong nyid ngang la bzhag /da lta nyon mongs dbyings nosi shar/ /dbyings su grol bas spong gnyen med/ /'dod yon chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan/ /byad dang kha dog ma 'gyur kyang / /klong dang dgongs pa 'gyur ba des/ /'jigs pa med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /dogs pa med pa'i ngar zhig thon/ /thogs pa med pa'i chos shig shes/ /'gyur ba med pa'i lung zhig thob/ /gtad so med pa'i gdeng zhig shar/ /'dra 'dra kun gyis lha phyag 'tshal/ /mnyam mnyam kun gyis skyabs su re/ /skal ldan kun gyis bla mar mthong / /skal med kun gyis gshe zhing sdang / /sems nyid chos sku'i rtsal rdzogs shing / /snang ba sgyu mar shes pa des/ /chen pos bkur kyang rlom sems med/ /ngan pas smad kyang sdang sems med/ /las dang bsam pa smon lam kun//tha dad 'khor ba'i chos nyid du/ /go bas brtags na gad mo 'chor/ /ma dpyad rang shar rang grol ngang / /chags sdang zhes bya ci la zer/ /bdag la 'brel ba thogs tshad kun/ /bdag ris 'drongs par smon lam 'debs/ /skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal zhi bar shog /dus 'dir mchod rten dmar po nas rkyen sel 'dra la yong dgos tshul gyi bsu ba'i yi ge 'dug /lan 'di bris/ dben par rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /che btsan grong pa'i ngo bsrung tsam gyi slad/ /rnga brdung gtor rgyag mo rtsis mdos gyer sogs/ /bsgrub 'bras zong du 'tshong ba rigs ma yin//zhes pa la sogs sems la gang shar bcos bsgyur med pa bris pa'i mjug tu/ log par lta na khyod kyi las su zad/ /nga rang skye med rang grol de skad lo/ /zhes bskur yang khong 'di skabs ngos la dag snang shar ba dang 15

'grig pas kha sang nged kyi de skad zhus pa la thugs ma 'khrugs las che gsung zhing / de nas bzung lo skor lhag tsam gshor 'degs khal bcu re'i 'dzin tham byung / nged bya bral ba la lto phyid tsam byung tshe gshor 'degs kyi dgos pa mi 'dug /ma ldangs ma phyid pa byung na khyed zhu sa bzang po tshor zhus chog pa bgyid do zhes dwangs pa mi ston pa'i 'dzin tham par phul byas kyang /nged rang bsam pa rdzogs pa'i slad du ci nas kyang longs shig ces gsungs pa la/mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi sdom gsum rnam nges las/ dad gsum ldan pa'i sems can don mi byed//sems mi bsrung dang bslu ba bcu gnyis pa//zhes rtsa lhang bcu gnyis par gsungs pas blos blangs pa'i rdzas ster ba po'i bsod nams rdzogs pa'i slad du bdag gir byas te stong mchod kyi mchod 'bru/'chi nges kyi srog bslu sogs kyi ched du btang nas gnas min du god zag bre gang yang ma byas/ mgon po klu sgrub dang / rgyal ba klong chen pa'i rnam par thar pa la yid phyogs nas bsngo smon rnam dag gi rgyas 'debs pa las/ mchod yon go ldog pa'i bgyi ba lan gyis brngan pa dang / tshig gi gtang ngag bskyed pa sogs phal la mi bgyid pas brgya bshig stong 'gugs kyi thabs la rmongs par mthong ba'ang 'dug go/ /ka dag 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang du nyal bas/ kha bshad ne tso'i 'don pas gting brjed la langs song / /ga nas bltas kyang mtho ba a ti yi theg pa//nga rgyal rang mthong ma lags rdzogs chen gyi khyad chos/ /ca gas bsags pa'i zang zing ri rgyal tsam yod kyang / /cha med bar do'i 'phrang la 'khyer dbang ni mi 'dug /ja sigs rta nor gser dngul rmi lam sgyu ma yi rang bzhin/ /nya mo gangs la snyag snyag ri khrod la phebs dang / ta na ga 116

na'i gsang spyod nyams myong la sbyangs pas/ /tha mal rig stong rjen pa'i mdza' grogs dang mjal byung / /da lta snang zos pa de po'i rgyang glu zhig blangs nas/ /na chung mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling mchog la chas 'gro/ /pa ra spa ra'i rnam rtog gtad med du bsgyur nas//pha rgan rig 'dzin pad+ma'i ring lugs la sbyang pas//ba glang lta bu'i 'du shes chos sku ru grol song / /ma bcos lhug pa'i spyod pa byung rgyal du bskyangs btang / /tsa ri bskor ba'i snying rus sgom sgrub la mdzod dang / /tsha grang 'o brgyal mi dgos chos sku dang mjal yong / /dza lan rta ra'i thugs sras nag po yi zhabs kyang / /wa ltar gal du tshud pa'i snang tshul la gzigs shing / /zha mo pad+ma mthong grol spyi gtsug tu bzhag pas/ /za 'dre ltogs 'gong rnams kyi snang ba yang 'gyur song / /'a cag byin rlabs che ba'i mthu nus ni ma lags/ /ya gi zangs mdog dpal ri'i o rgyan gyi thugs rje/ /rwa bar gti mug sgom pa'i phag thom ni ma yin/ /la klungs gtad med nyul ba'i gcan gzan gyi bu rgyud//sha khrag zas la rings pa'i snang tshul dang bstun nas//sa lam dbu ma'i sbug tu mig chod la bcang btang / /ha cang dal dub ma dgos rdzogs chen gyi lta ba/ /a don skye med ka dag rang rig la rdzogs 'dug/ ha ri'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i nye rgyud la brten nas/ /a ha 'bar 'dzag zhu bde'i gsang lam la chas 'gro/ /'di'i tshe gnas kyi gang zag byin gyis brlabs pa'i dag snang mtha' yas pa shar/ rig pa'i rtsal snang phyogs med du rgyas nas 'khrid pa rnams la rgyal yum sher phyin gyi dgongs pa rang bzhin theg mchog rgyal po'i gshis lugs su bkral ba slob dpon nā ga rdzu na'i dgongs bcud tshig gsum don brgya ma zhes bya ba spros bral lag bcangs ma'i 117

mgur/ gson dang dad ldan bu slob rnams/ /rig stong blo las 'das pa yi/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa dang / /bu chung lha khang blta ba ltar/ /'du shes lung ma bstan pa gnyis/ /'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod/ /brjod med ye stong zang thal dang / /ltos grub shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis//'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod/ /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab dang / /rtog pas btags pa'i rig shes gnyis//'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod//pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral dang /nyan thos 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis//'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod//ma skyes gdod nas dag pa dang / /rgyang phan pa yi chad lta gnyis/ /'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod/ /mi 'gag rig pa'i gsal cha dang / /so so skye bo'i 'khrul snang gnyis/ /'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod/ /nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid klong dang //phur bu pa yi grub mtha' gnyis//'dra 'dri nang nas nor sa yod//so so rang rig ye shes dang / /gsal cha med pa'i mi rtog gnyis/ /'dra 'dra'i nang nas nor sa yod/ /rang chas lhun grub spyod yul dang / /tho co smyon pa'i brtul zhugs gnyis/ /'dra 'dra'i nang nas rnor sa yod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum chen la/ /dbyings chen ka dag ngo bo dang / /rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes lnga/ /'dus ma byas pa'i thugs rje gsum/ /phyogs ris med par tshang bar shes/ /de phyir gnyug ma'i dran pa yis/ /rgyun chad med par phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgongs pa klong nas grol tsa na/ /bslab gnyer zer ba brdzun du gda'/ /smig gi grub mtha' nga mi 'dzin/ /snang ba sgyu mar go tsa na/ /tshul 'chos zer ba thog re che/ /nga cag grub thob brgyud pa'i bu/ /dran rtog gzhi med rtsa bral la rang rtsis skye ba mi srid de/ /khyod cag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /dgongs pa rnal 1/8

mar sbyor ba'i phyir/ /gang shar rig pa'i mda' yis bskul / /dge bas gnas lugs rtogs par shog /yang chos zhu ba rnams phyi nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs pas yid skyo ba snyam byed cing nges 'byung gi pha phogs la spyod pa na skyo ba chos dbyings su zhi ba'i glu/ skyabs pad 'byung rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed sason dang dad ldan bu slob rnams/ /gnas nyams dga' dpal gyi mchims phu la/ /mi phal pas bltas na skyo bsun can/ /dbyar 'od chen gyi khang khyim skyel la khad/ /brag phug kun thigs pa'i bla bre bres/ /sa gzhi kun brlan gsher gyi 'dam rdzab mod/ /ri klungs kun smug pa'i gos kyis satums/ /bad gan dang rlung na 'du 'khrugs mang / /dgun dus su grang ngar lcags las tsha /brag seng nas lhags pa'i bang chen mang / /thal ba dang kha char bu yug 'tshubs/ /de spyi mthun grub pa'i gsal sna nga yin/ /nged rnal 'byor gyi dbongs pas bltas tsa na/ /'di rta mchog rol pa'i pho brang dngos/ /skyid 'dod dang 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng rkyen med/ sha chang dang sdig zas gser las dkon/ /nges 'byung dang skyo shas dbang med skye /khyed spun grogs rnams rang ril rtsa sadar chod/ /phyi yul snang la kha ba'i bu lug 'tshubs/ /de bu yug 'tshub pa ma lags te/ /sems snang ba'i yul la shor bas lan/ /blo nong du/bug dang sgo ma phrus tsho /rlung 'ur 'ur gyi sgra skad sems la gzan/ /grang zug gi res bya snying la rgyas /de rlung chen gyi zug rngu ma lags te//nang bde drod kyi nus rtsal chung bas lan/ /lam gtum mor sbyongs shig sgom phrug tsho//mi mangs kyi 'dug ba'i brag phug la /nyams grib gyi rig pa 'jibs so snyam//nang las nyon gyi grib las ma grol na//phyi yul snang gi grib la byol mi tshar/ /debag phug btsog pa ma lags te/ /rig 1 9

pa la kun gzhi'i grib kyis mnan//sems ris gdar sha chod cig sgom phrug tsho//gnas sku bzhi'i grong khyer du 'byon pa la/ /'bem lus srog la nus pa'i snying khams dgos/ /phyi snang ba'i yul gyi skyid sdug la/ /nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyi bya shor na/ /chos byas so snyam yang sdug lus yin/ /dka' ba dang du longs shig sgom phrug tsho/ /phyi 'jig rten skye bo'i la ga dang / /nang mnyam 'grogs zla bo'i byed spyod ngag /cung yin min tsam yang mi bzod na/ /kha chos skad mthon po ngag 'khya9 yin/ /sems bzod pa sgoms shig sgom phug tsho/ /zhes smras pas thams cad snang ba 'gyur/ rab rnams kyis 'du 'dzi dang yul 'khor spangs/ /chos la 'bros shing tshe dang bsgrub pa snyam par dam 'cha' ba/ 'bring gis lo gsum gyi bsgrub pa'i zhabs tog tha mas kyang sngon 'gro 'bum ther dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bum phrag gcig nas 'bum brgya tham pa'i bar gsog pa'i lam srol tshugs/ /rang nyid kyis kyang bsgrub tshugs bzung ba'i rten 'brel dang khyad par mig ltos 'di gang la'ang gces pa yin no//dus 'di tsam nas spros bcas kyi dge sbyor la zhen pa rang bzhin gyi dag /lus gnad kyang ci bder gnas pa zhig yod pas gzhan dag bag yangs kyi rtog pa bsal ba'i slad/ rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin rnam brgyad sogs/ /rdzogs chen gyi grub thob yongs la 'dud/ /lta ba nam mkha' mdung bskor dis/ /the tshom gyi dra ba rang sar bcad/ /rtsol med a ti'i dgongs pa yin/ /chad lta'i rigs dang ma nor ba mdzod/ /sgom pa shugs 'byung rang gsal 'dis/ /blos byas kyi lta sgom zil gyis gnon/ /lhun grub rdzogs chen gyi dgongs pa yin/ sdug bcir 'jur dran dang ma nor ba mdzod/ /spyod pa gtad med rang grol 'dis/ /rkyen ngan dang 120

bde sdug zil gyis gnon/ /srid gsum zil gnon gyi dgongs pa yin/ /dge stong sdig stong dang ma nor ba mdzod/ /'bras bu khyad chos drug ldan 'dis/ /mtshan ma'i chos sku zil gyis gnon/ /gzhon nu bum sku'i dgongs pa yin/ /tha chad rgyang 'phen dang ma nor ba mdzod/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi po 'di/ /grub mtha' kun gyi snying po yin/ /rtog pas btags na 'khyer so mang / /shes pa skad cig ma'i mtshang rig na/ /tha snyad kun ne tso'i 'don pa 'dra/ /'khor 'das zer ba'i 'gal 'du can/ /'khrul grol gnyis kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /dpyad na lag pa'i lto rgyab 'dra/ /khyed dag snang dam tshig ldan pa rnams/ /dran pa rang grol chen po'i klong / /spros bcas kyi dag sbyor yal du chug /nyal bas gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub/ /chos med 'di chos pa'i yang rtser gda'/ /'od gsal gnyid kyi klong na gsal/ /nyams rtogs mal gyi nang nas rnyed/ /rtsa mdud lus gyi rgya nas grol/ /sangs rgyas phyi nas 'tshol ba dang / /sa lam gyi sgug sdod yi re mug /dbyings rig zung 'jug chen po'i klong / /ye shes bla ma'i sa mchog non/ /de bden rdzun grub thob yongs la dris/ /'khor ba dong sprugs kyi ljags bsnyen mdzod/ /de nas dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu'i lo gsum gyi dam bca' rdzogs par nye ba'i tshe 'tsho ba ngan ngon la brten pa'i khar shing chu gdug pa can gyi rkyen byas/ tshe rabs su bsags pa'i las ngan gyi lhag ma dang / dkor lan chags kyi rnam smin rang gi lus thog tu smin/ /rgyab na glo gcong gi na tsha ni rdos brdungs pa tsam/mdun na khrag rlung gi gzer ba mda' gzer ba lta bus mnar/ rkang pa la 'bam gyi bsnyan gzhi ro lci/ lus zungs thams cad zad de lo brgya lon pa'i rgas 'khogs bzhin du nyam thag /lto chas 121

kyi dang kha yang 'gags/ kha stobs shor/ gzugs stobs 'khums/ jom gsum phyin na sgyid pa 'dar/ da lta phral du shi na rang ngo nas jo bo bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar la yid phyogs nas blo phugs chos dang chos phugs sprang la gtad nas gtad pa bzhi'i mgo non pa'i lugs tsam byas/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs la blo gdeng tshud pas the tshom dang 'tsher ngad ci la srid kyang / gtso cher pha ma rgas 'khogs snying re rje/ de bzhin rang la snying nas blo gtod pa'i yon bdag dang 'khor slob dad pa can 'ga' tsam gyi bsam don gyi re ba ma rdzogs/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang / sems can la phan rgya cher gdags pa'i yid smon mngon du ma gyur pa blo lhag 'u sa/ o rgyan rin po che mkhyen no zhes yang yang brjod/ de lta na'ang rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs rjer sems thog tu nad kyi khur bkal ba'i duḥkha myong ma dgos par/ nad thog tu rig stong klong gsal chen po'i me btsa' btab pas/ na tsha dang nar 'dzin gyi dran rtog thams cad mtha' grol klong yangs chen por 'ub kyi chud/ gdams ngag la nges shes skyes/ skyen ngan la bsnyengs ma thor/ de zhib mor dpyad na lus la na tsha/ sems la sdug bsngal ci byung yang nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i steng du ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'byung ba ni/ na ba la mtshon na gzugs la na tsha'i zug rngu/ tshor bas de nyid zug tu shes pa/ 'du shes ni skad cig 'brel chags/ 'du byed kyi yang na bar byed/ rnam par shes pas thus gi rang bzhin la spyod pa sogs sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis zil gyis gnon pa'i gnad go/de'i tshe dad pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bu slob 'dras tshogasabaskangs bgyis /22

pa na/ rang snang dag pa'i nam mkha' la grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po dbu skra thor tshugs kyi sked chings sba sgyug lhas ma can gyis bsdams pa zhig dang mjal / dag pa'i snang ba pha phogs su byin/ snang ba thams cad bde stong khyab gdal chen por 'dres/ grub thob rin po ches tshe'i bar chad sel ba'i mtshan mar go/ /mos gus lhag par 'bar bas mgur 'di bzhengs so/ /rje grub thob chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ba'i yang rtse rdzogs chen a ti rtogs/ sgom pa'i ming med lta ba'i ngang du grol/ /spyod pa'i rgyal po bsgrub pa 'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /da ni sprang po shi yang mi 'gyod tsam / /dad gshin dkor zas grib kyi gar bu yis/ /thar pa'i gnya' gnon rtogs pa'i zhal ras sgrib/ /rgyal sras kun gyi smad pa bo lags nas/ /gyi na'i srog 'tsho tsam las bag med du/ /spyad pa'i nongs pas ma gos blo re bde/ /de phyir ngan ngon se ba'i shun pa la/btung ba bgyis te rgya ja'i bam po dag /dkon mchos mchod pa'i rgyu ru bsngos byas kyang / /gzhan gyi dang bas byin pa'i btung ba zhig /rtog med ngang la rol pas rkyen byas nas/ /lan chags dkor gyi la yo gas phral du phog /nag po'i ja yis rnam bzhi'i 'du ba dkrugs/ /nam smad gnyid kyi mun pa sangs pa'i tshe/ /byang khog nang du khrag rlung stod 'tshangs zhugs/ /'byung 'jug dbugs kyi 'gyu ba'ang bcod la khad/ /langs na mi bde 'dug na mi bzod cing / /'gul bar dka' ba'i duḥkhas mnar nas 'dug /rkyen ngan las su shes pa'i sprang po ngas/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma de/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gtsug tu gsal btab nas/ /myur lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom/ /na tsha sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i phyags ma yin/ /de phyir bla ma'i thugs rjer shes byas shing / /na tsha /23

bla mar bsgoms te dbang bzhi blangs//bla ma'ang rang gi sems su shes byas te//sems nyid ye stong rtsa bral ngang du glod/ /de la na mkhan ma grub chos kyi sku/ /na ba rang bzhin rnam dag longs spyod rdzogs/ /na tsha rtogs pas zil gnon sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med ngang na 'ching grol zad/ /rdzogs pa chen po gzhi grol klong yangs dang / /rkyen ngan rdo rus thug pa'i thugs rje yis/ /bsnyen sgrub shin tu brel ba'i thun ma tshogs/ /don yod grub pas snum gyi kha dog ston/ /rus tshigs 'khums shing brang gzhung 'gas snyam byed/ /dbugs kyi phyi la gzer gyis 'breng gyur kyang / /stong nyid ngang du na tsha bag la zha/ /sman dang gnyen po'i dpyad la re dogs spangs//de tshe kun gzhi'i sems la 'di snyam du//chu bur lta bu'i tshe srog ya ma brla/ /mdang nub nyal dus bde bar btsa' mod kyi/ /nangs par ldang dus bzod ku'i zug rngus mnar/ /de bzhin do nub nyal dus mir 'dug kyang / /sang zhogs ro la mi 'gro yid brtan med/ /'chi ba yong la dka' tshegs mi 'dug pas/ /sos dal le lo'i dbang du ma song bar /de ring nyid nas 'chi grabs kho na mdzod/ /da lta na tshod yol la ma thug kyang / /mi tshe'i nyi ma nub ri'i phang par nyal/ /'chi bdag mdun na bzhugs pa ma mthong 'dug /cis kyang dgos med soms shig mkhyen brtse'i 'od/ /dug sbrul nag po pang du babs pa lta'i/ /sha chang sdig pa'i zas la bag yod bsten/ /bzang ja rin thang can 'di dkor rngam che/ /gyi na tha shal tsam gyis 'tsho bar mdzod/ /chos rnams kun gyi mtha' rten smon lam yin/ /sdug lus khong bsran tsam la gtad pa med/ /rang 'dod brtan pa bral ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /'khor ba dong sprugs smon cig mkhyen brtse'i 'od/ /ces dang yang /124

a ho/ /gdod nas stong gsal lha sku la/ /kun brtags bskyed rim gyi lhad ma 'debs/ /snang zhen phyag rgyar rdzogs pa'i ngang / /zhal phyag 'dzin zhen skyur la zhog /'byung 'jug sngags kyi rang bzhin la/ /lce mchu'i bzlas brjod thang re chad/ /grag stong sngags su rdzogs pa'i ngang / /sgra tshig 'du 'phro skyur la zhog/dran rtog chos sku'i rol rtsal la//sems 'dzin rdzogs rim mdud pa khrol/rig stong spros bral rjen pa'i ngang / /skye 'gas rtsis 'debs sgyur la zhog /'khor 'das rig par rdzogs pa la/ /'od zer spro bsdu rtog pa'i chos/ /ro gcig klong chen yangs pa'i ngang / /btang bzhag ched 'dzin skyur la zhog /lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul la/ /bzang ngan 'dor len gnyis su med/ /dbyings rig zung 'jus chen po'i ngang / /dmigs gtad rang sar skyur la zhog /na tsha sgrib pa'i bud shing la/ duḥkha'i rnam rtog sna ma bskyil/ /na mkhan dmigs med rtsa bral ngang / /bden 'dzin dbyings su gtor la zhog /de skad dus mtha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'og min rdo rje'i brag phug tu/ /bsnyen sgrub zab mor gzhol ba'i tshe/ /sgrub lhobs phyi nang gsang gsum gyis/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung tshogs pa las/ /'khrul 'byams rmi lam za zir thal/ /'khu 'phrigs lhan skyes 'dre yi ston/ /byang khog glo gcong dam pos bcings/ /rnag dri'i ngad pa zad mi shes/ /glo bur yam po'i rims kyis zin/ /glo lud sna chu tsa ra ra/ /skabs shig 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /blo la shar nas yi ger bris/ /blo bral rig pa'i ngo bo la/ /na tsha sdug bsngal ming yang med/ /de phyir dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas/ /bar gcod rkyen gyis mi brdzi zhing / /sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin nas kyang / /khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /bdag nyid gcig pos 'drongs par thog /ces 125

na tsha dbyings thog tu snyoms pas gnas lugs don gyi kun tu bzang po'i rang zhal mthong / de'i tshe zhal sadams ka kha sum cu ma 'di byung ngo / /spyir bod 'bangs yongs la bka' drin che/ /sgos sprang po bdag bi skyabs gnas mchog /rje sangs rgyas kun 'dus u rgyan rjer/ /snying rus pa'i gting nas sasol ba 'debs/ /bu ka dag spros bral phyogs yan la/ /kha dog bzo dbyibs mtshon pa med/ /ga pur dbyings su yal ba ltar/ /nga bdag rtsa gdar chod la 'os bu ca co'i tshig la ma zhen par/ /cha med pa sa mtha'i nags khrod der/ /ja chang 'dod yon ma bsams par/ /nya ltar rig pa gcer bur 'og /bu ta na gha na'i spyod pa 'di/ /tha mal gyi lam du mi lhangs pas/ /dwa phrug sa mthar 'khyar ba lta ra/ na dga' shi skyid ngang du 'og /bu pa sangs lta bu'i lhas bsam gyis / /pha rol kun la das sna nga sbyang / /ba mo nyi mas bzhu ba bzhin /ma ris yul nas thon la zhog/bu tsa ri tra solas gnas skor la//tsha grang dka' spyad mi dgos kyi /dza hu'i rgyun ltar ting nge 'dzin/ /wa ltar ri sul 'grim la sgoms/ bu zhwa bos 'od zer don gnyer dang / /za ma'i ched du ma rgyug par/ wā cas skye 'chi'i dgra bo la/ /ya nga med pa'i sgo ma sgru ba rem/ /bu ra gan lta bu'i blo rengs kyi/ /la klung khyi bzhin nyul ba de/ /sha za 'byung po'i gdon dang 'dra/ /sa sde gcis tu bsgrub tshugs bzung / /bu ha la lta bu'i rnam rtos 'dis/ /a don skye med don la sgrib/ /rma bya lta bu'i brtul zhugs kyi//dug lnga lam khyer btsan thabs sbyangs/ /de skad gegs sel nyams kyi glu/ /blo 'das kun tu bzang po yi/ /bu gcig mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer la/ /'og min rdo rje'i brag phug tu/ /mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i tho rengs kha/ /gsal rig rjen pa'i ngang nas rtsal/ /nyi shar yi ge'i lam 26

du bzhag /sems can kun la phan thogs shos /ces so/ /de nas sbyin pa'i bdag pos tshe ring ljongs byang chub smon pa'i tshal du gnas khang ka ba nyi shu'i sa bkod legs par bskrun pa'i sa 'dul gyi ched du dpal chen bla ma drag po'i ting 'dzin ye shes kyi rol pa rnam par bkod pa'i rtsal las rang shar ba'i rigs lnga ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki'i bros sbyangs shing / sgom chen rnyarmā'i mtshan can gyis bya khyung ka ru r+ṇa bsgrubs pas sa gzhi las su rung bar byas/ gzhi der sa bdag gdug pa can gnas pa'i cal sgrogs la brten nas po'i phyogs kyis yid la zug rngur gyur pa'i skye bo snang ba la shin tu bden par 'dzin pa/ gya gyu dang bcas shing / gti mug gi rang bzhin la kho ra khor yu ga tu spyod pa gang zhig gis yid la 'phrigs ma mi bzad pa bkur na'ang / yul bdag srid pa'i lha rabs ma sangs g.ya' spang skyes gcig mi dkar gyon pa nem song la wa'i zhwa thod can zhig tu byas nas cog tse gcig gi khar dor dril thod rnga dang bcas pa tshar gnyis bzhag pa ngos la btud de phul rjes dar dkar gyi g.yab mo dang bcas song /brda don la rnam par dpyad de nyes skyon med par stangs bcad/ gnas gzhi gegs med du grub ste yu na du gtan chags dgos par gso la ba 'debs pa la/ ga re bya btang la gnas kyi 'khyer so ma dgos mod kyi dgos pa khyad par ba dang ldan pa la dgongs nas sangs rgyas kyi gzhi 'dzin pa'i bslab pa'ang bcas/ gnas la sred pa dang rtag 'dzin spong phyir ljongs rgyu ba'ang gsungs/ da ni rig pa la gtan srid zin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gang byas kyang bde snyam pa'i tshe/ rmi lam gyi snang cha rdzun po cher 'bying dbar stag rtse'i pho brang yin rgyu'i seng g.yengs kha shar ba lta der/ spyod tshang ba sna / 27

tshogs rang grol bzhugs khri mthon po zhig khar bzhugs nas phyogs der spyan phur tshugs su gzigs shing phyag mnyam par bzhag pa zhig mthong bas dus da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan gnyis shes/ sgrub brgyud gyi bstan pa la cung zad phan nam snyam sbyin pa 'i bdag po la'ang de de bzhin du bsgrub par bya'o zhes spro ba bskyed/ lam glu ring mo 'di yang byas so/ /ka la piṅka'i lung bstan drin can bla mas gnang byung / /kha smras gleng gzhir 'jigs na rnal 'byor dbang po ma yin//ga nas bsams kyang da ni re dogs mtha' las grol song / /nga cag pad+ma'i bu brgyud las 'phro sad pa'i gang zag /ca co brag ca'i sgra la khu lan byis pas sbyin yong / /cha lugs bltar snang ngan yang 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pas//ja chang sgyu ma'i nor la chags sred zhen pa mi gda'//nya ltar chags med zhen med grub thob gong ma'i shul lam/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa deng sang bod na dar kyang / /tha dad zung du 'jug pa'i gsang sngags nye la mi shes/ /da lta shi yang mi 'gyod gdeng chen blo la khel 'dug /na 'chi rkyen ngan byung kyang rang rig skye med spros bral/ /pa sangs lta bur dkar ba'i dag snang khyed kyis sbyangs dang / /pha ma 'brel thogs kun la smon lam 'an bus btab chog /ba lang lta bu'i skye 'gro dbang po rnam rig gtsang yang / /ma rig rmongs pa'i mal du ngan song sgrub pa snying rje/ /tsa ra zan gong gsod pa'i grong sngags sdig can rnams kyang / /tsha grang dmyal ba myong dus 'o brgyal ci 'dra byed pa//dzaḥbh+yo rbad pa'i drag sngags grong khyer hral po'i rgyan cha//wa ltar phugs su yibs pa byang chub sems dpa'i shul lam/ /zhwa mos grub mtha' 'dzin pa snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus rtags/ /za lan tshogs gsog rim pa 128

lnga brgya tha ma'i dge rtsa/ /'a cag bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel tshogs gnyis mnyam rdzogs byas nas/ /ya mā n+ta ka byung dus pad+ma 'od du dengs 'gro/ /ra gan gser gyis g.yogs pa'i tshul 'chos bslu brid mi shes/ /lwa wa lta bur rgyu spun phyi nang med par byas nas/ /sha za srin pos bskor ba'i rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi/ /sa 'dzin das pa'i spo la pa da 'byung mjal bar dengs 'gro/ /ha la'i blo ngan 'chang ba'i skye 'gro gdul ba dka' yang / /a don skye med sgom sa tshe ring ljongs la zhus nas/ /sku gsum rtsal chen rdzobs pa bde ba chen po'i pho brang / /kun rtog dbu mar thim pa 'od gsal chen ngo 'i 'char gzhi/ /'khor lnga'i mdud pa grol ba lhan skyes pho nya'i gar mkhan/ /smon la ma rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchos nyid la dengs 'gro/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /der lo gsum gyi dam bca' ni mthar phyin/ gnas de nyid du 'dug ring rang ji zas phud thud nas bcad de zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bcu la brag dmar ke'u tshang du mchod pa lnga tshar mar me dang bcas pa/ tsān dang sa ga gnyis la brgya mchod tshar re bcas ma chag pa dang / bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi sman sgrub/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo khri tshor nye ba/ mkha' 'gro'i me mchod mang tsam dang / grol ba'i kha skong bcas sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi las bzhi'i sbyin sreg sogs spros bcas kyi tshogs gsog kyang ci nus bgyis/ shi gson gyi dngos po cung zad 'byor pa yang dkor la ji mi snyam pa'i brtul zhugs kyi gnas min du god zag phran bu'ang ma byas par mar thog tu brjes pas stong mchod kyi mar yongs rdzogs 'dengs/'dab ldan g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i tshal du dge bskul gyi spro ba bskyed de mchod rtsam mchod 'bru yongs su rdzogs pa'i rkyen sbyar sprel zla'i tshes brgyad la /29

'bu shubs nas thon pa bzhin du mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas su phyin/zhing pa rnams than pas nyam thag pa la phan du re ba'i sems bskyed kho nas has po ri'i rtse nas bsang brngan dang bka' nan rab brjid byed pa'i lugs byas pa lha 'dre rnams khrel dgod mi byed las che/ tshe bcu'i nyin sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs pa'i jo bo byang chub chen po'i sku mdun du stong mchod kyi sprin kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam rol du rgyas thebs par byas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu bstan pa dang sems can gyi sman yon bla na med par 'gyur zhing / rang la shi gson gyi 'brel bar thogs pa mtha' dag byang grol rnam mkhyen gyi bo 'phang la 'god pa'i smon lam rlabs po che btab/bar khang g.yu zhal du tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen por bskor ba'i tshe mkhan slob rje 'bangs rnams kyi thugs rje dang rnam thar dran pas dga' ba dang skyo ba'i nyams shin tu 'phel ba byung / dus de'i tshe rang gi lus la mnabs pa'i gyon pa dang / dpe cha tsam las gzhan pa'i zang zing ci yang mi 'dug pas/ bya bral kun spangs pa'i ming gdags su rung ba tsam yod/ gang zhig srid pa'i grong khyer 'di/ /chags pa tsam nas 'jig pa'i chos//de phyir ma dang bu gcig pu//bral ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs gyur na//snying yang tshal par 'gas pa lta'i//cho nge 'don pa de yi sems/ /dbugs 'byin slad du 'di gdams so/ /pha dran pas snying gi mun sel mchog /dpal ma ḍi ya na'i slob dpon rjes/ /dus snyigs ma'i sems can bskyab tu gsol/ /khyed tshur la gson dang dad dam can/ /phyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir/ /blos legs par brtags na snying rlung ldang / /stod ya gi srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ /smad na rag dmyal khams /30

bco brgyad yan/ /sdug bsngal rgyun chags kyi 'khrul 'khor can/ /de ma rig khams gsum sems can kun/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal gyi sa bon 'debs/ /sems skyo shas dang nges 'byung ma skyes pas//blodam pa'i chos la 'gyur ma nyan/ /sdug ltar snang tshe 'di'i 'dun ma la//gtam tha shal tsam gyi rjes 'brangs nas//zhen chags kyi 'khor lo bskor ches bas//sdug bsngal rnam gsum gyi rgya la chud//de dam chos ma nus pa kho nas la na/ /mi kho bo'i tha shal du bas na'ang / /gzhon nu'i lang tsho gsar pa nas/ /skyo shas dang nges 'byung kho na bsams/ /nam 'chi cha med kyi blo sna bstungs/ /cis kyang dgos med kyi snyems thag bcad/ /gtam khe grags gyi phyogs su sems ma btang / /na dga' shi skyid la skyabs gnas bcol/ /rang byung gi gnas lugs brjod med bskyangs/ /ri sul dang dben gnas gnyen po 'grim/ /sngar mi lo bcu gcig sgrub par 'bungs/ /dus da lta dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rkyen ngan dang sdug bsngal ci byung yang //rang shar rang grol du lam gyis lhangs/ /sgyu ma dang mi lam lta bur 'byongs/ /bde sdug kun 'od gsal stong pa nyid//khyod 'jig rten pa sdug bsngal rang rgyud la//bzod du med par spyod pa 'di/ /don rang sems lkog tu gyur pas lan/ /da sdug bsngal spangs pas 'phongs pa med//sdug bsngal shar ba'i mkhan po ltos//des sdug bsngal gyi rang mtshang nges par 'jig /sdug bsngal la rtog pas brtags pa na/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal te/ /sngon bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dus/ /nyes med du rgyal po'i chad pas mnar/ /dgongs phog gi 'pho 'gyur cir yang shar/ /de 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal chen por grags/ /dus gtan du tshe 'di'i khe grags la/ /chags nas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong 131

sogs/ /lus sems la bde ba'i skabs mi rnyed/ /phral ltar snang bde bar snang ba kun/ /khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdu ga bsngal bltar mi mngon/ /dus da res snying la brtse ba'i sras/ /sngon las dbang bi bden pa mthu che bas/ /dus glo bur sku tshe btang ba des/ /sems bzod blag med pa'i zug jus bcings/ /dus nyin mtshan bar med duḥkhas mnar//'di sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes su grags//tshul de phyir sdug bsngal gsum po 'di/ /khong sems can kun gyi gnya' na 'dus /'di gzhan min zhig rang la 'byung ba'ang min/ /sngar chos rgyal btsun mo 'brom bza' la/ /sras gcig las med pa'i pad+ma gsal/ /yab gces pa'i ngang tshul ma bzod bzhin/ /dbang med du 'jig rten pha rol song /pha u rgyan chos rje'i thugs rje yis/ /ro la rnam shes bkug pa'i tshe/ /mig blta zhing smra ba shes na'ang / /tshe zad pa bsring pa'i mthu med pas/ /zhag gcig kyang bsdad dbang ga la yod/ /dus de tshe rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ /dag ma dag bi skye ba mang rgyud mthar/ /sngon smon pa'i 'bras bu stobs gyur nas/ /rig 'dzin kyi zlos gar las 'brel rtsal/ /lo bcu bdun tsam nas snying thig bton//khong las can yongs la spel rgyu la/ /glo bur bdud kyi cho 'phrul mthus/ gnyal rgya 'gro la yi rtse mo ru/ /mtshon sna tshogs kyi char pa phab nas bkrongs/ /khong lho brag mar pa thugs brtse zhing / /lus sha nas chad pa'i snying gi bu/ /sras dar ma mdo sde skad pa de/ /rkyen drag shul can gyi rta grir bkums/ /dbu klad sa la bkram nas gshegs/ /rje rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho zhes/ /bod bde skyid 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /sku blta bas chog mi shes pa de/ /sa mthar dwa phrug bzhin du thal/ /tshul de phyir las dang de 'bras ni/ /byang sems dang /32

'phags pas kyang bdag gir mdzad/ /mgon shākya thub pa'i zhabs pad la/ seng ldeng gi tshal bus gnad tshul bzhin//las sus kyang bcos su mi btub pa //de bdag gir bzhes pa thugs khral bskyungs/ /bod sangs khrod kyi chos pa mi la dang / /dwags po zla 'od brgyud par bcas/ /klong chen dang zur pa mes dbon sogs/ /gsar rnying gi grub thob phal mo che/ /rkyen ngan la brten nas chos dang mjal/ /sdug bsngal la brten nas dngos grub thob/ /'khor gsum stag chas kyi drung 'khor dang / /gser g.yu'i lan tshar gyi sgeg chos can/ /sto bas 'byor mnga' thang gi dregs pa 'dis/ /dus gtan gyi 'dun ma bslu bslu 'dra/ /mi phal cher dud 'gro dngos dang mtshungs/ /'dir rmi lam tsam gyi 'dun ma la/ /rtag chas su bzung nas g.yo sgyus 'tsho/ /tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma nyes pa la/ /dogs pa tsam yang byed mkhan med//ngas rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho mthong //rtag par byang chub sems mchog bskyed//rang byung gi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i mthus//'khor 'das kyi gnad mtshang rig pa des//dud 'gro'i khrod nas cang shes tsam//skyid sdug mdang gi gli lam 'dra//mdang nub bden kyang de ring yal//de la dgongs nas thugs khral bsgyungs//dkon mchog gsum la blo rtse thod/ /dam pa'i lha chos snying la phur/ /da ni dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus/ /su la bltas kyang blo sna skyog /gang la gzhigs kyang snying po med/ /ri sul 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /sems can mos pa tha dad kyang / /smon lam phyogs ris bral bar 'debs/ /las kyi bsdus pa'i 'khor slob dang / /glo snying gtod pa'i yon bdag kun/ /dam pa'i chos la blo phyogs nas/ /gtan 'dun tshe 'dir 'grub par shog/bsgrub pa nan tan dang 'brel ba'i skor te skabs gnyis pa'o// ///33
da ni bya ba las kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i gtam bshad par bya ste//3
nga rdo /sa kyibs ba

re la zu lha'i memarmā༄ tho/sna du:retatismrasal+la/༄cu//de nas bzang ngan legs nyes dad //rje lha ma'i〈〈rgyu'istoskyunisdorabhasha/sarba /bstod smad chags snang kun la yang / /rgye rmākhri na((gima'i (opadhasmyum/dzetasu//ci mi snya/snyipa'i blo 1sa nas/ /lo7 670〈spu/)/smanagalbalalhapiṅgalasasnyik+ta:snal ma ser po'i btsun tshugs dang / /

༄gyi/ /skye bo 'drid pa'i sgom ldir sogs/ /rang nyid bslu ba'i rgyur mthong nas/ /thams cad mnyam pa chen por brdal/ /rgyu 'bras srog tu brtsi ba dang / /gzhan phan bsam pa bzang po dang / /bstan la sri zhu'i lhag bsam dang / /chos kyi snying por rang rig pa/ /brten pa thob par ma gyur na/ /bltar snang chos tshul bzang po yang / /'khor ba'i rang bzhin nyid yin pa/ /shes nas blang dor med pa yi/ /dang du ci bder gnas pa la/ /gzhan ngor dge dang mi dbe yi/ /rnam par rtog pa ci shar yang / /nga la thob dang shor ba med/ /re dang dogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'ang yod ma yin/ /ris med mnyam pa chen por aḥ/ de nas bod la bkra shis 'byung ba'i gnas has po ri dung seng gnam du 'phyang ba 'dra ba'i mdun nas bteg/chu klung chen po lo hi ta'i 'gram du skya rengs 'char bar brtsams pa'i tshe thug choms kyi sgra chen po zhig byung ba'i mod la rta mchog he ru ku'i pho brang gi g.yon ri'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' nas drang srong chen po zla ba la dus me thugs pa'i kha dog 'dra ba zhig rgyu ba mthong bas bsrung ma phyi bzhin du 'brang ba'i rten 'brel du go/ /rim gyis dal 'gro'i klung chen po shing rta'i bzhon pas brgal/ gzhis ka g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i tshal nas sdun bsus/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer pad+ma 'od gling du brtol/ sa der lcang skya'i 'gal dum yog 'gal tsam zhig 'dug pa gad 'khris su lag dal lta bur btsugs pa legs par skyes shing/ slan chad chu mig brus pa'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu song bas gzhi bdag gi rten 'brel shes/ dpal rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas zhi ba'i bsregs drugs kyi gnas gzhi bkra shis par byas/ /sa brko rdo slog gi dus bag la zhar srog 137

'gags pa'i grog sbur yan chad la sgrib sbyong bi 'dun pa bsgyur/ spyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs pa'i gnas la dogs pa de mi dgos pa'i lung yod mod de drang nges ldem dbongs kyi tshul shes pas rgyu 'bras rang sa'i 'bras bu la yid ches par byed pa 'di gal che bar sada'/gzim chung 'khor lo tshogs chen du phur sgrub dang 'brel pa 'i sman sgru ba nyung ngu zhig byas/bzo gnas 'di'i rig pa la sngon sbyangs kyi snang ba sad cing rgyud chos dang 'dres pa'i sdom brtson rnal 'byor spyod pa wa gan+d+ra dharmā girtis gyang ris 'dri ba'i bkod pa bgyis/ rab gnas la thug gi bar bya ba rjes btsan par byas nas chu pho rta'i lo gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i gang ba rdzogs pa'i mtshams su/dur khrod rol pa 'i gnas gangs la rje'ur gnas 'brel byed du phyin/ gnas de nyid rang bzhin gyi nyams dga' la bag phebs/ sgyu ma lta bu'i blo dang mi ldan pa rnams skyi g.ya' ba'i rnam par snang / de'i nub mo rmi lam na 'brong rtsal po che zhig gis nged la rgol du 'ongs pa yi dam gyi bskyed rim brtan par byas pas kho'i zhe snang zhi nas tshom mer bsdad pa zhig rmis/ sang nyin bsang dang gser skyems sogs byas shing / ri ltar byas pas zhol der rdza khyil brgya tsam 'dug pa mthong bas/ sngon gyi tshe byon pa'i sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed de tsho la mos pa chen po 'phel/ skyes bu dam pa re re tsam gyi thugs rje'i nus pas sems can mang po'i blo chos su bsgyur nas/ nges legs kyi lam la bkod pa'i rjes shul 'di kur 'dug dpal u rgyan chos kyi rgyal pos/ /da dus sems can 'bum phrag don byed las/ /snyigs dus sems can re re'i don byed dka'/ /ci'i phyir las ngan gding tshad ches pa'i phyir/ /zhes dang /138

bcu phrag yan chad kha lo bsgyur nus pa'i/ /gang zag de ni 'phags pa'i sprul par nges/ /brgya phrag yan chad kha lo bsgyur nus pa'i/ /de ni rgyal ba dngos yin gdon mi za/ /zhes gsungs pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa yab sras dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po ku ma ra dza/kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer /sngon dus su byon pa'i jo bo bka' gdams pa sogs kyi ri tshugs 'dzin pa'i rnam thar la dad pa mi skye ba'i dbang ga na yod/ da lta 'brel tshad don ldan du grags pa dag gis slob brgyud pa'i dregs pa tsam gyi nang na'ang sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i tshugs kha zin pa lta ci/ 'khor ba'i gnas la zhen pa gting nas log ste gtad pa bzhi'i cha shas 'khyongs pa yang dkon pa'i dngos po nyid du grub pa'i phyir/ thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi stobs che chung de tsam du go nas rang nyid kyang de lta bur 'gyur ba shog cig snyam pa'i smon lam shugs drag tu btab/ de'i nub mo'i rmi lam na mtshan nyid pa zhig gis nged la bgro gleng btsugs pa'i 'phro la/ khyod rgyal khams gang la dga' zer/ ngas pad+ma kha phye la dga' byas/ blo phugs gang la gtod zer/ nam mkha' klong yangs la gtod byas pas/ skyedas pa'i tshul gyis cang mi zer/ de kha'i mur mi dpon snum bag can gzugs bzang ba g.yog dang bcas pa zhig byung nas/ nged kyi khyim du tshe dbang la gdan 'dren pa yin zer gus pa ltar byas nas sde khyim chen po zhig tu khri gdan bkod sogs bzabs nas 'dug pa'i khar bsdad pa na gnyid yal/ gnas bdag yar lha sham pos byed par 'dug snyam pa shar te gang yin dpyad dka'/ nged gsum gyi zhag bdun gyi bar gnas 'brel byas pas kha ba shin tu che ba babs/ snang ba yul rkyen gyis bsgyur bas nges 'byung 139

dang skyo shas dpag tu med pa skyes/ mnga' ris bu mo'i tam bu ri'i rgyud la drangs nas glu 'di 'dras kyang 'then no/ /na mo gu ru/ yar la bltas pas ka dag 'od gsal gyi mkha' la/ /lhun grub nyi zla'i tshom bu me shel las dwangs pa//lta sgom spyod pa'i rgyan du med thabs ni mi 'dug /o lo'i sems pa dgung sngon mthon po la shor song //mar la bltas pas kham sa gsum 'khor ba yi grong na//ma rgan 'gro drug sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar 'dug /'di 'dra mthong bas snying rtsa dbang med du 'dar nas/ /o lo'i sems pa dam pa'i lha chos la shor song / /'di ru bltas pas rdza ri mthon po yi rtse mor/ /kha char na bun rlung gi reg byas dang g.yogs pa'i/ /g.yam pa 'i spyil chung chags med zhen bral gyi khang mdzes/ /o lo'i sems pa gangs la 'i rdza khrod la shor song / /dgra la sdang zhing gnyen la rang shugs kyi chags pa'i/ /sde dbon 'du 'dzi'i zhen pa yid yul na mi 'dug /bslab bya byis pa'i bslu brid ma mdzad dang e go/ /o lo'i sems pa snang zos gang bde la shor song/ /sdig zas sha la mnyes kyang gzhan srog ni mi gcod/ /rlung gshos rtse sgro ngar ma'i brtul zhugs dang 'grolas nas//lta sgom nam mkha'i phu thag btsan thabs su gcod pa'i/ /rma lo'i sems pa thang dkar rgod smug la shor song / /bsam med dud 'gror skyes kyang dge sems dang ldan pas/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i kha zas dang kha ru mi 'gro/ /rtswa dang myu gus 'tsho ba'i skad snyan gyi 'dab chags/ /o lo'i sems pa lha bya song mo la shor song / /ri dwags spang la brtse ba sngon gyi las smon yin pa/ /khrel med lings pa'i dgra la byol phyin pas los chog /gang byung zas kyi yang rtse rtsa chu ru 'dug pas/ /o lo'i sems pa sha ba smug chung la shor song / /kha sang phung po bya 0

la gtor shul de mthong bas/ /gzhon pa'i sgyu lus la kha'i na bun du rgo byung / /lus sems bral kyang tshor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol pa'i/ /rma lo'i sems pa 'od gsal chos sku la shor song / /do nub tsam yang mi 'chi'i gdeng tshad ni mi 'dug /bya byed mang po ngan song 'khor ba yi gting rdo/ /byar med ngang nas sa lam chig chod du 'gyur ba'i/ /o lo'i sems pa ma bcos lhug pa la shor so nga / /grangs med gsu ma gyi sgug yun btsogs sa na mi 'dug /sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo rang rig la rdzogs song / /da lta'i shes pa sangs rgyas rlon pa ru 'dug pas/ /o lo'i sems pa 'od gas la rdzogs chen la shor song / /dben pa 'i ri ngogs gangs la rje'u yi rdza khrod/ /sku mtshams dam po kha char na dun gyis bsdams tshe//dga' skyo 'dres pa'i nyams sna nga ban bun gyi ngang nas/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi smras so/ /sto na ser nas pad+ma 'od gling du mtshams la zhugs/ sbyin bdag gi 'tsho ba gcig pur chos shes pas gzhan ngo bsrung ba dang / grong chog la sogs pas phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i blo g.yeng bshol/ skyid la zos bde dge sbyor 'phel ba dben pa'i yon tan yin kyang dpal ri nas sprul sku rin po che gsan sbyangs la byon/ sngar rwa sprul de nyid kyang gong ma'i dam tshig kho na la bsams te nye bar bstan pa'ang dge sbyor la rnam par g.yeng ba byung / skabs 'di tshor rnam gling pas sde pa brgyud khong ba'i gzhon nu la yi ge sogs bslab rogs nan du byung ba'ang ci mi snyam par bzhag pa de yin na'ang / spyir ni sde 'dzin gyi sang zag go nas 'phongs/ sngar phyogs gzhan du gsan sbyangs kyi rten 'brel 'grigs pa'ang byung tshod mi gda' bsam mchims su 'dug skabs kyang dgag bya du ma sa thos bsam gyi gnas la 4/

ri dwags rgya la btsud pa lta bu'i brtan pa bral ba gong ma'i gdan sar mi btub par shes nas/ 'di res sprul pa'i sku rang cung zad sku nar son pa'i dgongs dpyad yin pas de'i kha'i grogs su 'gyur bar byas/ 'dir dbyar lo gcig ril por bzhugs/ phyag bris/ lan war/ snyan dngags gtso bor gyur pa la/ bzhugs lugs yan chod bcos/ dus 'khor gyi lag rtsis 'di ni ha cang rang rnam par g.yeng drag pas sngar sgrub pa la 'jug pa tsam nas sa gzhong la yang mi 'bri ba'i dam bca' byas nas gaṇ+ḍa'ang bla brang du bskyal ba de yin pas phral sel re'u mig gzigs pa'i skor tsam la cha bzhag bo/ /spyir rgyal sras rnams kyi mi slob pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams la sgo gang nas kyang 'jug pa yangs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas su mi sems pa lta ga la yin/ rang rang gi brtson pa dang mkhyen stobs la dpags nas yon tan sbyong ba 'di mtha' btsan por mchis shing /khyad par bla ma'i rigs la ni thugs bskyed dang spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa kho na gal che bar gda'/ ston ser lings pas ri dwags brngon pa la skyo ba shin tu skyes ba'i mod ri dwags kyi gtam nges 'byung gi pho nya zer ba de'ang nyams chos su shar/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud bcu bdun gyis lung nod pa'i phyir grub dbang shrī nā tha shes brag tu phebs pa'ang sadan drangs/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i phyogs la gsan rgya shin tu che ba yin te 'di lo'i dgun nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ snga lo sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa dang / gshin rje tshe bdag gi cha mtshon 'dod chos gtso che ba rnams zhu thub bas 'tshengs snyam pa byung / chos don du gnyer ba rnams gang na dge ba'i 14 2

bshes gnyen dang rten 'brel 'grig pa de tsam la brtson pa bskyed pa ni sal che ba yin no//skabs 'dir kong yul shing lo'i dga' tshal nas nyang ston bkra ti ba rig pa'i rdo rjes gsung bris kyi lam nas bskul bzhin/man ngag lung gi gter mdzod shog bu bzhi brgya nye ba'ang brtsams/ sbyor rtse sprul pa'i sku rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa khra 'brug tu phebs pa nas dbang chos 'ga' zhig gi slad du 'dir cis kyang slebs pa byed dbos zhes chibs gsar ma la sga bstad de 'bod mi byung bas der brtol/ 'jig rten gyis gdags pa'i sprul sku che ku'i go sar bzhugs pa la thugs snyems cad med pa'i rang bzhin bzang / gu ru drag po'i dbang zhig dgos phebs pa dang / gzhan chos 'brel gyi rnam pa 'ga' tsam phul/ bo dong 'jigs bral chen po'i gsung rab las brtsams te rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / tshogs drug gi khyad par la dri ba mdzad pa'i thugs kyi dogs pa bsal/ dag snang khyab gdal du 'byongs pas gsungs bgros la'ang sngag sbug sbyang skyong med cing / 'phros don la nged gzhon nu'i tshe mi'i dbang bo des/ khyed bla sprul gyi rigs tsho thugs gnyer dang /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba la brtson par ma mdzad na/ skye ba len pa skad kyi yang shi yang gsos zer ba de sprul sku rnam pa tsho la byung nyen yod gsungs byung ba/ gzu bos brtags tshe shin tu bden par snang / rdzogs pa chen po la don rgyud ma chad pa bzhugs pas rang gzhan gyi bstan pa la phan du re bas nyams khrid gnad smin zhig zhu ba'i slad du slan chad cis kyang nged phyogs su sleb pa byed dgos zhes gser/ dngul/ nam thang gis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan bzang po'i bdog pa skyes su bstar bar mdzad nas de nyid 'dus pa chen po'i grong 143

khyer du sashegs/ spyir dus kyi rgyad pa ni phyogs gang na'ang yod mod/ khyad par yul lha chen po ma sangs sala' spang skyes kyis bsrungs pa'i sanas skye bo rnams chos kyi bag chags shas chung zhing / bste gnas la spyod pa'i khyim pa'ang srog gcod pa sogs la ji mi snyam pas dbang bo bsgyings la/ 'brog dgon pa'i yon tan gyi snyigs ma tsam gyis kyang nyam chung rnams 'tsho bar shes shing /sos kyi tshe smig rgyu shin tu g.yo bas snod bcud kyi dge mtshan rang bzhin gyi dbal chung ba'i steng / skyin thang bi chom pos 'o tos la rtag pa rgyun du 'tsho ba sogs la/ thabs dang rten 'brel zab mo 'i cho gas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad du gsol zhes gzhis ka nyid nas bskul bar mdzad pa la/ 'o lnga drug tsam gyi bar phu mda' bar gsum du lo lo bzhin bum gter nyi shu tsam re bcug /'jam dpal nā ga ram nas gsungs pa'i 'byung ba dpal bskyed kyi 'khor lo'i bca' ga dang /yul lha mgo 'phangs gtod pa'i man ngag si bum sater/sgrub chen bde gshesas 'dus pa dang / bar chad 'dul ba'i gnyen po bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas lo lo bzhin zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshar mang po la snod bcud kyi rgud pa zhi ba'i dmigs gnad bsgyur/ lo tog smin par nye ba'i tshe rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang / g.yang chog /rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung sgrogs/rtag pa la chud pa'i nyi ldog dang bstun gzhis skar khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlos sogs kyis rgyun 'dzugs par bskul bas spyi sger su la'ang phan pa'i dngos po nyid du 'gyur grang snyam pa ni yod/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sems can mos pa tha dad pas/ /rgyal bas kyang ni mi mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas smos ci 'tshal/ /ces sasungs pa de yid la mno bas re dogs /44

ni gang yang med/ 'di skad du/ lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing / /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / /rgyal po chos bzhin spyod pa dang / /'jig rten khams kyang bde bar shog /ces pa'i smon pa phyogs gang du 'grub kyang dngos cag dga' ba bsgom pa yin pas so/ /sde dpon rigs kyi 'byor pa phal mo che'ang skye ba snga mar byang chub chen po'i lam du bsgyur ba la mi mkhas pa'i dge 'bras lan cig srid pa 'di la smin pa shas che/ de'i rang bzhin ni/ brgya byin mchod 'os nyid du gyur nas ni/ /las kyi dbang gi slar yang sa steng lhung / /'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang / /'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes 'jig rten gyi dpal 'byor ni ji ltar phun sum tshogs kyang 'khyags pa'i steng gi khang bzang ngam/ mdang sum gyi mi lam sad nas ci yang med pa ltar rtag pa min pa mthong ba'i chos nyid su gyur na/ da res kyi dpal 'byor la brten nas/phyi ma ngan song gi rgyu 'bad pas bsgrub pa ni shin tu'ang bag tsha ba yin la/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las sems can gcig gi srog bcad pa'ang nyi tshe'i dmyal bar yun ring du gnas par gsungs pas/ mi dge ba bcu'i phyi mo srog gcod pa'i las thabs 'di spang thub pa zhig byung na dge rgyun rlabs po cher 'gyur tshul yang nas yang du bskul ba na/ 'jig rten mkhyen par grags pa'i sdig grogs kyi gzhan dbang chen gyis go phye nas dmigs bsal shugs kyi 'dzem par mi nus pa lo gnyis gsum las gzhan lo bzhi lnga tsam gyi khong du'ang sems can brgya phrag las ring du brgal ba'i srog 'khyobs/ de ltar na'ang jo nang pa chen po'i rnam thar du/ deng sang ngam phyis kyi bla ma rgyud can/ bla brang sngags pa ba/ bla chen dang bla chung khyu gcig srog /45

gcod la ni mi 'dzem/ sku gsung thugs rten la ras chod byed/ ces snang ba ltar 'gro ba mang po'i 'dren par snyam pa'i sde rnams su'ang kla klo'i spyod pa dar zhing /btsun pas dmar khe byed pa sogs kyi gnas tshul la dpags na/sdom pas rgyud ni ma bsdoms/ rmongs pa'i gos kyi ni g.yogs/ dge sdig gi blang dor la rmongs pa'i skye bo tha mal pa dag la re ba'ang ma mchis pas/ srin po'i brtul zhugs la sred pa dang / rdzi bo yan chod kyis kyang rgan rgon gyi rjes mi zin par bsnyad pa'i bskul ma byed pa mang mod/slob dpon nā ga rdzu nas/khyod kyi dge slong bram ze lha dang ni/ /mgron dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang / /'khor gyi slad du'ang sdig pa mi bgyi ste/ /dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ /sdig pa'i las rnams spyod pa 'ga' yang ni/ /de yi mod la mtshon bzhin mi gcod kyang / /'chi ba'i dus la babs na sdig pa yi/ /las kyi 'bras bu gang lags mngon par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni yang dag bshad/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus byas kyi dge ba la sku bzhengs pa tshogs che/ de las kyang thugs bzhengs pa tshogs che/ de las kyang gsung bzhengs pa tshogs che/ de las kyang sems can gyi srog bskyab pa tshogs che gsungs/ rnam pa kun tu sems can gyi srog la 'tshe ba 'di kho na la sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'ong ba yin pas sa pho stag lo nas bzung sa glang phan la bongs chung ba dang / 'gab sgor ba sogs rin la rtseg pa'i bsam sbyor gyi ma yin par dus bzang po dang bstun btang snyoms chen po'i blo rgyud la bzhag nas gri 'og ma 'ba' zhig bslus pa la/ lug lnga bcu tham pa/ gtsang po nya chen sum cu so gsum/ nye'u stong phrag gcig /ri bong brgyad rnams song / de yang blo khengs 14 6

pa tsam gyis gnas su ga la yin te/ dngos cag tshong dang so nam la rnam par mi rtog /grong chog ni mi 'grim/ nang du 'bru khal bcu longs pa'ang mi 'dug pas de tsam la ltos pa'o/ /da dung ji srid srog gi dbang po 'gag pa la nye ba de srid du dam bca' 'di mi gtang ba yin/ me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas ni/ /'chi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes bya'i rnam pa rgya chen po gzhan las chos thos rgya che ba nyid bsod nams che ba yin pas shing pho spre'u'i lo so ka tsam nas shar phyogs kong po'i yul nas nyang ston rig pa 'dzin pa chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon/ 'khos su phebs pa'i zhabs tog bi bsnyen bkur te bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'am/ bka' 'dus bar par grags pa po ti bcu gsum gyi dbang lung yongs su rdzogs pa nyan/chos tshan tshang ma tshang la lnga pa chen po'i gsan yig zhal lce gcod pa lta bur yod pas rtog dpyod zhib tu byas/ khong pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam zhig las rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi bka' rgya'ang 'bad med du grol/lo snga ma rta lug gnyis la shi gson gyi dngos po nyung zad 'byor pa rnams gcig tu dril nas g.yo ru khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang la stong mchod gshom pa'i gra bsgrigs/ sngon la yar klungs shel gyi brag phug tu bteg /la khar snang ba gtad med kyis nyams thol byung du shar nas/ e ma ho / /snang ba 'di gangs ri dkar bo 'dra/ /gsal 'tsher dwangs pa sngon gyi las/ /ma bcos gzhug ma'i 'du khang na/ /blo bde dang gu yangs rgyun chad med/ /rig pa 'di shel gyi mchod rten 'dra/ /gsal 'grib dang bral ba sngon gyi las/ /sgyu ma lus kyi gzhal yas su//rang shar rang grol rgyun chad med//dran pa 'di chu klung chen po 'dra//147

'phel 'grib med pa sngon gyi las/ /rten 'brel sna tshogs kyi sa gzhi la/ /lhung lhung du 'bab pa rgyun chad med/ /lar dga' ba la bsams na dbod snying 'dod/ /skyo ba la bsams na snying rlung ldang / /'di 'jig rten 'khor ba'i spyod srol yin/ /mi nga la bde sdug gang yang med/ /yar cis bltas pas pad+ma shel phus gi brag ri/ /na bun dkar po'i mgul dar gyis bkra ba de mthong bas /nga'i dang bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje de dran byung / /skyo grogs la phebs dang ye shes kyi mtsho rgyal/ /mar cig bltas pas g.yo ru'i khra 'brug gi gser tog /ljon shing gsar ba'i ra bas bkra ba de mthong bas/ /nga'i dang rje'o rgyal sras lha rje de dran byung / /skyo grosas la phebs dang man+da yi ra ba/ /rtag brten ther zug yul la chags pa de spa ngas pas/ /rgyal khams mi yi byams skyong yasas ma rang mdzad byung / /dad pa can gyi gces phrug byed pa nga'i dga' ba/ /las kyi 'brel ba tsho dam pa'i lha chos la phebs shig /rdo rje theg pa 'i myur lam zab mo la sbyangs pas/ /las rlung dbang 'dus rten 'brel phyogs med du rgyas song / /thad ku'i shes pa lam khyer byung rgyal du shes pas/ /'du 'dzi'i khrod na'ang sa lam dal med du bgrod yod//dregs pas rgyags pa'i mi dpon sdig can la ci zhu/ /bcos mas byas pa'i sgrib bsig rmi lam dang sgyu ma/ /gang byung sna nga ba 'od gsal chos sku dang bsres nas/ /bde sdus rnam rtog ro snyoms chen po ru sbyangs btang / /ber gos 'od zer khri rkang mthon po yi rgyan cha/ /dbang bzhi'i don rgyud rig stong rjen pa la gnas 'dug /'brel tshad blo kha dam pa 'i chos phyogs la bsgyur nas/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i gu yangs smyon pa zhig los byed/ /snang srid snod bcud phyi nang bzang ngan gyi rten 'brel/ /ting 'dzin 'dun 8

pa'i kha lo bsgyur ba dang sprags nas/ /sems bskyed 'phen pa'i nus stobs chen po yi rtsal shugs/ /re ltos 'cha' ba'i skal ldan gdul bya la byin yod/ /gzhan la mthong snang rnam pa sna tshogs su los yong / /rang ngor re dang dogs pa'i rnam rtog dang bral bas//na dga' shi skyid blo bde gu yangs kyi ngang nas//ma bcos lhag pa'i skyo glu zang ma ru thal lo/ /zhes smras/ dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal pos nub phyogs sprul pa'i zhing dhu ma thā la'i gnas dang dod mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas su slebs/ rang dang gzhan gyi rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer yang dag par mchod nas mtsho rgyal gsang phug tu spyod/ der dad 'dus slob ma'i tshogs kyis da lam 'dir thugs la shar ba'i mgur ma zhig dgos zer ba la/ thol byung nyid la brjod pa yi ger bkod pa ni/ dpal gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /dbyings kyi yum chen gnam zhal ma/ /zung 'jug sprul pa'i zlos gar can/ /mu rgyan yab yum de snying nas dran/ /bde ba chen po'i brag ri la/ /stong pa chen po chos 'byung shar/ /bde chen dbang mo mtsho rgyal ma'i/ /ngo mtshar gyi sgrub phug tu slebs tsa na/ /skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis//rdo rje rgyang glu sgrogs shig zer//de tshe snang ba dpe ru blangs//stong nyid blo bral gyi nam mkha' la/ /lhag mthong 'od gsal gyi bya rgod lding / /phyogs gang du'ang lhung dogs med pa'i dpes//lta ba la rtag chad med pa zhig 'tshal/ /brag ri kun mtshon cha gzings pa 'dra/ /gcong rong dang ngam grog dam na yang / /mi shes ldan kun 'dar 'phrig med par bgrod/ /dpe de kyang sgom pa'i phrang la bcur/ /'jigs shing skyi g.ya'i dur khrod na/ /ma mo dang zakhri sgyugs glu len/ /gad rgyangs ha har sgrogs pa bzhin/ /spyod pa la the tsho ༷da

pa 'tshal/ /de ring skyid pa'i nyi ma la/ /las smon gyis bsdus pa'i mched lcam kun/ /rten 'brel gcig tu tshogs pa 'di/ /sngon gyi las 'brel yin mchi ste/ /'dus pa 'di mi rtag tshong 'dus 'dra/ /mgron po gyes pa'i rjes shul na/ /ci yang med pa de sems pa skyo/ /dpe 'di la bsams nas lha chos mdzod//ya ki shed dgung sngon dkyil 'khor la/ /'ja' sprin gyi rnam 'gyur gya ma gyu/ /za 'og gi khengs pa 'phrog pa yang/ /rlung bser bu'i rkyen gyi phral du zhig /dus da lta gar song dang 'dir yod med/ /dpe 'dis kyang mi rtag 'chi ba bsams/ /sngon mirgyan chos kyi rgyal po dang / /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bzas/ /smin grol gyi bdud rtsi kun la byin/ /sgrub sde'i srog mkhar btsugs pa yang / /deng sang brag skyibs stong pa'i nang / /bzhugs pa'i shul yang ma lus pa/ /'dus byas rtag pa min pa'i mtshang //dpe 'di la dgongs nas lha chos mdzod//rgya la lha chos nus pa na/ /rdo rje snying po'i theg pa la/ /bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i gsang lam dang / /rtsa rlung thig le'i myur lam yod/ /sangs rgyas da lta 'grub du yod/ /byang chub lag pa'i mthil na yod/ /de go bar mdzod cig skal ldan rnams/ /zhes smras/ nyang gter rdo rje phag mo khros ma'i dkyil 'khor du rigs lnga ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs nas sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgyas par phul/ skabs der nged dpon slob bcu gsum tsam pas gzim phug dang 'tsher rnams bsdoms nyin kha shas thel nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo lnga stong tsam bskor/ /nub mo lha btsun mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gis brag nyag gser gzhong 'khyil ba'i bla g.yer cog pu la brten nas dben par gnas pa'i tshe gnas tshul dang mthun 150

pa'i mgur//glang po che'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba 'di sba bar bya ba yin na'ang / /gang zhig 'di na myos par byed pa'i rdzas kyi dran pa'i dbang po ni myos/ rab tu myos/ kun tu myos pa dag gis spyod tshul gze ma ra mgo lta bu'ang mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du ni brdal/ sngon gyi tshe lha bla ma zhi ba 'od dang / byang chub 'od la sogs pa'i tshe pho brang btsun pa'i bka' shog tu grags pas sna drangs/sngags log sun 'byin du btags nas chos la sdang ba'i nyes pa mi bzad par bsgrub pa'ang / la la'i lus ngag gi spyod yul rlabs po che las byung bar nges na kha na ma tho ba chen po'i gnas la de dang de'i mtshang brtol ba sdig pa chung ba yin/ pha margyan chos kyi rgyal po dang / /ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo pad+ma lcam//dus rtag par yid la 'du 'bral med//de ring snying gi dkyil nas dran/ /phyi snang ba la sprul bsgyur ma nus kyang / /nang sems nyid la rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i mi/ /klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas yar klungs pad+ma shel phug gi//brag nyag dpa' bo'i lding khang du//zla zhun thags su btags pa lta'i/ /gur cog la brten nas 'dug tsa na//nyams rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa'i snang cha la/ /ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo ci yang mthong / /dbyings brag stod la gnas mal 'cha' ba yi/ /bya rgyal rgod po'i zhal na re/ /ma gi sha zad gyi dur khrod chen po na/ /ro mgo yod brgya la mgo med stong / /chung sgong rgya grol nas da bar du/ /zos pa grangs kyi mi lang ste/ /nga 'grang rgyu med pa'i ltogs bla can/ /mig hu re sdod pa mi mthong bar//da dung tshe 'di'i 'tsho rtsis la//zhen chags che ba'i skyebo rnams//phyed dang bzhi yi zhag thog la/ /tshogs 'khor bskor ba dgod bro bro/ /lha bya gong mo'i zhal na re/ /gnas la mos pas yongs bzhin du/ /smon lam rnam dag 151

mi 'debs par/ /glu chung dang sir glu'i rgyab chos mkhan/ /'bu srin gsod pa'i gzhon skyes rnams/ /ngan song 'bad pas bsgrub pa ko long long / /brag gseb byi chung zhal na re/ /gzhan la gnas kyi ngo mtshar sgro gas/ /tshogs 'khor yang chud mi za'o skad/ /rang nyid tshogs kyi spyang ki byed/ /lha la dgun nas dbyar chas sprod//phyogs mi dad pa ldog pa yi//tho btsun gyi rnam thar ci re re//nag chung pho rog zhal na re/ /bskyed rdzogs kyi drod de rang sar dgos/ /a ta'i rus la ci zhig snyems/ /ban 'gong gi spyod pa rlabs po che/ /snying po'i ring lugs su brdar btags nas//yin lusas kyi grub mtha' sun phyung yang / thar pa nag po'i sku mched can/ /'byon sa lcags khang sgo ro ro/ /zer gyin 'dug pa rnams la nga sems yengs nas yod tsa na//rigs pa'i lcags kyu yin zer pa'i mi zhig khrong gi thong nas/ /rnal 'byor pa 'di na ci byed 'dir don ci la 'ong zer/ da 'di ru margyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ stong nyid bsam du med pa la ltad mo blta zhing yod/yong ba ni rang gzhan 'brel thogs kun gyi dngos po chud mi gsan pa'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor du 'ong byas pas/khos nga la mig hur gyis bltas nas bro ma dbyangs kyi glu 'di 'dras btang byung ngo / /'o na gson dang rnal 'byor pa/ /tshul la dgongs dang bya bral ba/ /khyed kyi brgyud pa ci la thug /theg pa'i 'jug sgo gang la gtogs/ /nyams len gnad du ci la gtod/ /sgom pa'i nyams myong gang ltar mchis/ /spyod pa'i gshis lugs ji ltar yin/ /khyed cag yon gnas dam pa tsho/ /gnas la bgrod pa ngo mtshar te/ /'u lag 'ded pa sdig pa che/ /rang gi stong 'gros mi pher bar//gzhan la bong bu'i khal chen 'gel//snying rje med pa'i lta ba de//ji /52

ltar mtho yang rnam rtog yin/ /'on kyang chos dang gang zag sga/ /pha mtha' sus kyang mi dpogs pas/ /re zhig 'dir ni drang po'i ngag /'jam la snyan pas sngon bsus te/ /bdag la ji bzhin sgrog par 'tshal/ /ces zer bas bdag nyid kyang nyams 'ur ba 'dras byung nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /mi min rnam rtog sems kyi bu/ /'dre min kun rtog snang cha'i rtsal/ /nga'i brgyud pa kun tu bzang po yin/ /kun bzang rang gi rig par rtogs tsa na/ /rgyud pa 'dren pa brjed nas thal/ /theg pa'i 'jug sgo rim pa dgu/ /dang po nyan thos theg par zhugs/ /bar du byang chub sems la sbyangs/ /tha mar gnas lugs ngang la bzhag /dus da lta bskyed rdzogs gdeng du gyur/ /gshis lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang / /'jug sgo'i rnam grangs brjed de thal/ /nyams len ni thos bsam sgom gsum yin/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i snying po de/ /zas dang nor phyir ma yin de/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi/ /gnyen por btang ba rang gi lugs/ /lta ba brjod med blo 'das yin/ /nam mkha' lag pas 'dzin pa dang / /ri bong rwa yi rno rtul dang / /mo gsham bu yi byed bzhin la/ /shes byas rtag tu btub tsa na/ /lta ba'i zhe phugs dmigs su mchi/ /gdod nas 'khrul du med tsa na//mtha' brgyad spros bral rdzun du gda'//sgom pa gtad med ye bzhag yin//rang bab lhug pa'i chu rgyun la/ /mnyam rjes gnyis kyi dba' rlabs kun/ /rang shar rang grol chen por rdzogs/ /dmigs gtad bral ba'i shugs 'byung la/ /sgom rgyu'i rang ngo rdzun du gda'/ /spyod pa tshul 'chos bral ba yin/ /'on kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /mdo sngags theg pa so so ru/ /dgongs gzhi dgos pa mtha' yas pas/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa la/ /dpags 153
