nas tha dad bstan pa'i phyir/ /deng sang bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /byung rgyal spyod pa a mthas na/ /rtsa cing 'bad pas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gdul bya'i yul dang bsnan de spyad/ /de phyir klong chen bya bral ngas/ /ri khrod dben par 'dug tsa na/ /gang shar snang ba lam du khyer/ /gang byung des chog tsam du byas/ /dad pa can gyi yon bdag gis/ /mos pa zhal nas bteg tsa na/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i dbugs bral ba'i/ /sgom chen rgan po seng ge'i gsob/ /gyi na'i brtul zhugs la zhen pa'i/ /tshul 'chos nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor/ /bla chen rnams kyi lad mo byas/ /gyi ling seng ge 'dra ba zhon/ /grum phad bskungs nas rten sgam bton/ /dar kha bcad nas mdud pa bor/ /de tshe tha mal skye bos kyang / /bzang por mthong nas thal mo sbyor/ /rang gi bsams tshe gad mo bro/ /kun gzhi gcig la rnam 'gyur brgya//gang zag gcig la mthong lugs gnyis//rmongs pa'i sems can snying re rje/ /nga la re dogs gang yang med/ /g.ya' khrod rdza ri 'grim pa'i tshe/ /rang gshom cog bu'i pho brang na/ /gcan gzan pags pa'i khri steng du/ /gcer bur nyal ba'i bag yangs pa/ /ngo tsha bral ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ /mgrin pa rdo rje'i dkor mdzod nas/ /snang srid sems su thag chod pas//'khor 'das rdzun gyi rang mtshang du//nges par go ba'i rgyang glu len/spyod pa'i gshes lugs de tsam mo/ /sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /chos gos gsum gyi sku la brgyan/ /lhung bzed 'khar gsil bsnams nas su/ /grong khyer chen po ga la bar/ /bsod snyoms slad du gshegs pa las/ /mi dpon bsgul nas sa rim bskul/ /snying rje med par 'u lag bdas/ /sems can sdug la sbyar ba'i gtam/ /mdo rgyud kun la ma grags pas/ /khyod cag nges par 154

bden mod kyang/ /bdag la shi gson 'brel thogs kyis/ /cung zad byin pa'i zang zing kun/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs don gnyer gyi/ /slad du 'ga' yang chud ma bzos//rten gsum rnams kyi spyan lam du//bsod nams dang ni ye shes kyi/ /tshogs gnyis rlabs chen bsags pa'i mthar/ /bsngo smon btsan po'i mtshams sbyor ba/ /'di la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bka' dang 'brel ba'i 'grel pa yod/ /'brel thogs pha ma lus can kun/ /gnas skabs mngon mtho'i dpal reg cing/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen byang chub la/ /myur por reg pa'i dgos pa yod/ /de go'am rig gam dam tshig can/ /ces smras pa na/ /yang de'i 'di skad smra'o/ /kye'o gson dang rnal 'byor pa/ /khyod rang gi yul na 'dug tsa na/ sgom chen gyi na'i ngang tshul can/ /shes rab can gyis dpyad tsa na/ /brtag tu dka' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /phyogs 'dzin can gyi snang ngo ru/ /tshig la mkhas pa'i rtog pa can/ /las 'brel can gyi snang ngo ru/ /mthong na dga' ba'i sems bskyed can/ /nyams rtogs can dang mol tsa na/ /klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rang bzhin sus kyang mi rtogs shing/ /tha mal sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /brag ri g.yang sa che na yang / /rtse sgro rgyas pa'i rgod phrug la/ /lhung gi dogs pa'i 'jigs pa med/ /de lta ba brjod du med pa'i rtsal/ /chu bo zur du 'bab na yang / /gangs stod bsnyegs pa'i nya mo la/ /'i rdzogs kyis dogs pa'i nyam nga med/ /de sgom pa rgyun chad med pa'i rtsal/ /nags khrod 'jigs pa che na yang //rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i rgya stag la//ya nga bag tsha'i rnam rtog med//de spyod pa rablo bab lhug pa'i rtsal/ /rtsal gsum ldan pa'i rnam 'byor la//dgra skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa ma mchis kyang / /bskungs sa rnam pa gsum du 'dug /155

gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dam tshig yin/ /dam tshig med pa'i gang zag dang / /zol 'grogs kyi ngo lan mangs pa na/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel 'phyugs/ /dus min du tshe srog bskungs kyi dogs//theg chen gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed yin//byang sems dang bral ba'i gang zag la/ /zab don gyi bdud rtsi byin pa na/ /dngos grub sbrang char bskungs kyi dogs/ /'gro don gyi rtsa ba thugs rje yin/ /thugs rje yul la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /zhi bde dang gzhan dbang du shor ba na/ /rlabs chen gyi phrin las bskungs kyi dogs//bskungs sa gsum gyi phrang ring la//dran rig gi so chen btsugs gyur na// cha ྅ni8 du gzhan don spyod/ /de nas 47985spro'i 88 'gro/ /zhes nyams thod rgal du 'ur pa'i rtsal la lung bstan gyi rnam pa'ang 'dug pa don dam dang kun rdzob gang du'ang khas len grub pa med pas rnam rtog gi khung bu can la mdzes pa'i dgag sgrub kyi blo bzo med pa nyid du bzhag /mar res btsan thang g.yu'i lha khang du rten gsum rnams la sri zhu bgyis/ seng g.yengs la bzhugs pa'i slob dpon chen po'i snang brnyan byin rlabs can de nyid kyis snyan shal phyag tu mngon sum pa lta bur bzhes pas skye ba nas tshe rabs su rjes su 'dzin pa yin snyam pa'i mos gus bla lhag tu 'bar/ rtswa gnyer dag snang can nas gsang sngags pho brang du 'tsher brkos shing bud shing gi mthun rkyen legs par sbyar/sa ga zla ba'i dus chen dang bstun g.yu ru khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang chen po'i khyams su lnga tshan lnga'i mchod sprin brgya phrag bcu'i 'khor lor bshams/snyan shal gyi rim pa rgyas par bstar/ o rgyan lha khang du brgya mchod/ bka' 'dus gsar ma'i cho ga rgyas pa dang 'brel bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya phrag /56

bskor/ dbang bzhi rgyud thog tu smin pa blangs/ smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mtshams sbyor byasakrin kra me 'khor gyis bon can dag gis bla ma 'di pa chagaka bzang po yod pa e yin zer skad/ nged kyi kha rje dbang thang yod tshod med tshod dkon mchog la bsti stang dang / ri mor bgyid pa de nga gi ma go/ phugs na rang tshim pa'i bdog pa tshags su btsud nas/ cha shas dge ba'i tshul du longs spyod pa'i snang shas la goms ches pa de ker 'dug /lar khong cag gi ltar nged phyug po yin mod/ klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ nor rnams kun kyi nang na chog shes pa/ /rab mchog legs par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /kun tu chog shes mdzod cig chog mkhyen na/ /nor mi bdog kyang yang dag 'byor pa lags//zhes pa'i glo ba dga' bo de dang rtag tu mi 'bral bas so/ /sprel lo spre'u'i zla ba ni dngos cag la dmigs bsal gyi dus chen yin pas/ pad+ma 'od gsal theg pa mchog gi gling du sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por snang srid kyi rtog tshogs ra sa ya na'i 'khor lo nyid du sbyangs rtogs sbar ba bdud ji sman gyi sgrub chen rgya gar rig 'dzin gyi lugs su bgyis/ rjes 'brel du dbang chen bskur ba la/ gsang sngags kyi 'jug sgo ni rnam pa khog yangs la ngo bo gnya' dog pa'i tshul sdom pa gsum gyis rnam par nges pa'i dgag bya du mas/bya ba dang mi bya ba'i gnas legs par rtogs dgos pa zhig yin na'ang / phyi mthar gsang sngagasame sam la gyer ba khyab gdal du grags pas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi ring lugs sgra ji bzhin pa re zhig cig nas nyams dmas zin pa der zad la/ de lta na'ang rang nyid la rtsa nyung gyi nyes pa cha yang ba'i thabs dang rten 'brel/ gya tshoms su 'jug pa'i rgyud chud /57

gsan pa sogs kyi nyes dmigs las ldog pa'i kha lo cir yang bsgyur/ ra sprul bstan rgyam sogs gsang sngags mos pas spyod pa'i gnas su shes pa kha shas la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang chen rgyab brten pod dgu'i lung dang bcas pa song /rnam pa gang du'ang dkon mchog kho na'i thugs rjes 'tsho ba ha cang gyi na ba dang / brel ngo la brten mi dgos shing / snod kyi 'jig rten la log par rtog pa'i bag chags ngan goms las ldog pa'i byed pa rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bur/ gang na dben pa'i bste gnas kyang rang bzhin gyi nyams dga' ba tsam gyi dbang thang nyam chung la'ang bzod par mi nus pa'i dge slong lha chen pos klan ka 'tshol ba la rings pa'i rnam 'gyur cir yang ston to/ /slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ yid ni lus can ma yin pas/ sus kyang gang du'ang gzhom mi nus/ /lus la mngon par zhen pas na/ /lus ni sdug bsngal dag gi gnod/ /brnyas dang tshig rtsub smra ba dang / /mi snyan pa yi tshig de yis/ /lus la gnod par mi 'gyur na/ /sems khyod ci phyir rab tu khro/ /gzhan dag bdag la mi dga' ba/ /des ni tshe 'di'am tshe gzhan la/ /bdag la za bar mi byed na/ /bdag ni ci phyir de mi 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lo mang po'i snga rol nas chags snang gi rnam rtog ro snyoms chen por la zlo ba la sbyangs pas 'khu 'phrig gi blo gleba'i gnas phal cher la nyam nga bag tsha cher mi 'byung ba yin/ lar mi la'i rnam thar na mar pa'i gsung / yul mi rtsis chung ba'i rang yul na/ /phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod/ /ces bris 'dug pa ltar/ 'di tsho na drag zhan pal mo che dang btang snyoms chen po'i 'brel ba can yin pas zhwa 'dom dang / lham gog re tsam las lhag pa'i gdul bya phrin las gang yang med pas 158

nged la gnod sems 'chang ba dag kyang rang bzhin gyi bag g.yel ba'i mod drang srong chen pos nyag phran gyi rwa bar btsud pas snying rje la/ mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya phyogs mtha' yas pa nas 'dus te rang gzhan gyi don cung zad 'bad pa med par grub pas bdag nyid la rnal 'byor pa dkon mchog 'bangs zhes bya'o/ /yid skyo shas dang nges 'byung lhang nge dran/ /las rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len phra la zhib/ /don gang la'ang dgos med zhen log can/ /rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi lar smon//dus deng sang nged rang chos pa tsho//skabs dang po nges 'byung sad sud kyi/ /chos byed blos bla ma'i gdams ngag mnyan/ /de cung zad bsgoms pa kha la khyer/ /gtan snyan grags gzhan zer dbang du shor/ /rang dma' sa 'dzin pa lta zhog gi/ /gzhan chen pos kyang spyi bos mchod du re/ /khong 'jig rten par dka' las ci 'dra 'dug /lto bza' rgyu dang gon rgyu ci 'dra 'dug /khral 'ar 'ur dang 'ded drag ci 'dra 'dug /de byas kyang phyi ma ga 'dra yong / /srod rgyug glu len pa thos tsa na/ /rang mal du nyal ba la zhe khrel skyes/ /tho skar gral ma zhig pa de nas langs/ /las sdug skur btsugs pa'i bza' btung de//chu dwangs sangs dang sing 'dag tsam du 'dug/ /rang chos pa tshor phyag las ci 'dra 'dug /dal brel dang bde sdug ga 'dra 'dug /bza' rgyu dang gon rgyu ga 'dra 'dug /u hu hu skyid sdug gi ma snyoms pa zha/tshod res ha cang rang skyid drag pas//res 'jog cig phyi mar yong nyen che///de byung na ci drag ga tsug byed/ /bod gangs ris bskor ba'i rgyal khams na/ /grangs can pa'i grub mtha' mngon gyur med/ /shākya'i bstan pa la kun kyang 'jug /de la rang gzhan du gcod lugs 'dis/ /dga' sdug dang chags sdang 159

skye lugs 'dis/ /kha gsag dang dbyen gcugasa'i sogs pa/ /thapab sna tshogs kyis mang po'i ngag dkrogs nas/ /gzu bor mi gnas pa'i ngan g.yo rdzu 'phrul can/ /gnad ma go ba'i rang rgyal chos gtam dang / /don ma rtogs pa'i bdag med spros bral yang / /byang chub gsum gyi rgyur ma nges/ /rlung mi bsgom pa'i 'khrul 'khor gya ma gyus/ /rtsa mdud grol ba'i lam rtags ga na yod/ /dbyings ma mjal ba'i 'dri rgyu med pa 'dis/ /slar 'khor ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ /rang ma mgu na dam tshig mi lam tsam/ /chags sdang gi rang 'degs lhung byas na/ /de la phal cher mgu mod kyi/ /sems bskyed dang gzhan don ga tsug byed/ /lar dad med la sems ngo sprad pa de/ /rang byung gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /skad cig ma dang por cer mthong dang / /mdzub tshugs su rang ngo shes na yang / /bsod nams kyi ma 'chun rang sang yal/ /khong lung bstan gyi slob ma'ang nor gyi brid/ /gzhan sdig pa'i grogs kyi phyogs 'dzin byed/ /mdun drin can dang bla ma'i zhal ta snyan//rgyab mched grogs dang tha shal nyid du sgrogs/ /rgyu 'bras bur smin pa mthong tsa na/ /snying ma tshim 'phongs sems dang snying rje skyes/ /lar gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dam tshig yin/ /nga spros bral sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /'phral ltar snang gi gya gyus mi brdzi yang / /phugs dam tshig nyams pa'i chad pa 'di/ /grogs khyed la byung dogs smras pa yin/ /khong re re zhig sdig can gyi dkor la brngams/ /chos snying rus su byas kyang gyod cig mchi/ /las dkar po'i chos la rem na yang / /khar srog gi zhu gri zos pa des/ /me 'bar chen zhun mar gyi gsod pa bzhin/ /las sdig sgrib sbyong bzhin sdig chen bza'/ /'di yang shi yang sos kyi 'khrul 'khor la/ /don snying po ci 'dug 6 0

mno bsam thong / /rgya gar na rgyan drug mchog gnyis la'ang / /gdung dar sku skye'i grags snyan med/ /phugs rang rgyud kyi yon tan mi rtog par/ /yongs mi nag pas sangs rgyas dngos mthong la/ /de de bzhin no snyam pa'i rang rgyal 'dis/ /mthar 'od srung rdzogs byed dang phrad kyi dogs//nga skye ba mi len pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /sbyangs yon bcu gnyis dag na yod/ /gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i go rim la/ /rtag brtan dang ther zug ltar snang tsam/ /brnab sems dang 'dzin chags ma spangs pa'i/ /sbyin len gyi phyag len mkhas mkhas mos/ /thar pa dang dgra bcom ma thob dogs//khong sde dpon rnams sngags sdom ma go ba'i//lam myur po gsang sngags la 'jug blo 'di//tshe gcig la mgon po rdor 'chang gi//grub mtha' snyogs pa yin mchi ste//phugs ma tram̐ ru trar phyin gyi dogs//nga rig pa thod rgal du 'ur ba'i tshe/ /rang skyon la ji mi snyam pa'i blos/ /bshags btsan po sbag zhug med par thal/ /khe dang nyes dmigs ma bsams shing / /rnal 'byor gyi snang ba gdong 'ded la//bsam yod ko long mi 'tshal te//phog thug med pa'i klong du a/ /'di lo'ang ston ser dur khrod rol pa'i gnas gangs la rje'u'i rdza khrod du gnas 'brel byed par phyin/ yar stod mgo ne ba rnams nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par bstabs/ snga lo tsho 'dir slebs pas ser ba mi 'bab pa dang chu bzang ba sogs byung / gnas rengs pa dul ba'i phyir phyi lo rnams kyang sleb pa byed dgos zer/ gnas la rengs rgyu ci yod de 'jig rten pa'i kha gtam du snang / kho rang tsho dag snang chen po 'dug pas rin chen srungs par grags pa'i logs la rang byon gyi rnam pa gsal ba yang ngo sprad/ zla ba dgu pa'i dang der sbyor rtse rin po che lha rtser lo gsum la phebs 161

brtsams kyi thog nas nged 'bod mkhan gyi bang mi ched gtad byung / shul du 'jug par brtsams pa na/ mi lam du bud med cig gis cha rgyus med pa'i sa cha la/ 'di na 'dir bzhugs kyi bkod pa 'dra mo zhig dang / dgra jag chom rkun mi yong /dol du nged kyi jo bos kyang gdan 'dren zhu rtsis 'dug zer ba/g.yor po stod la go ba rting la byas tsa na bgrod par bya ba'i gnas lo ro dol/gnas de na tshe ring ma bzhugs pa'i khyad par du shes/tshor ba dang bcas pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po can la ngal dub kyi rnam pa spyi mthun du yod par bsams nas rkang pas 'gro gang bcogs rta las gzhol te phyin pas/ zla bo tsho rkang pa na ba'i gsung 'byon par snang bas slan chad cang shes su song / phu na gangs ldan gyi ri bo ni shel gyi mchod rten lta bur bkod legs/ bar na mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga'i pho brang gi brag ri dbu 'phang gtod pa lta bu/ skabs phyed pa'i gnas ci rigs par sa la'i nags tshal thor bu dang bcas pa'i sman ljongs la ri dwags rnams bag phebs par rgyu zhing / 'bab chu bsil ba'i sgra dang bcas 'du 'ji'i nyes dmigs las brgal zhing / nags kyi yon tan phal mo ches bstan pa sog pa lha rtse zhes rje btsun ras chung pas mkha' spyod kyi grub mtha' rdzogs pa'i gnas su slebs/ bla ma mchog nas bsnyen bkur dang sri zhu thugs la btags/ 'dul ba lung las/ nga la mkhan po med pas na/ /nga ni rang byung dge slong yin/ /zhes 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i bla ma shākya seng ge ni spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gzhan dbang can la mi ltos par/ mdo sngags rang sa'i lam dang de'i 'bras bu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i de ma thag par mngon du mdzad la/ gzhan 'jig rten gyis gdags pa'i sprul 162

pa'i sku rnam pa tsho yang / chos nyid kyi ngo bo shes bya ma yin pas/ brgal brtag gis gshis kyi bzhugs tshul chen po'i mtshang 'drus par ma gyur pa gang / rkang 'khyams kyi rgyal bu rgyal sar 'don pa'i dpes bstan par bya ba'i ngo bo nyid/dbang dang don dam brgyud pa'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chos nyid mngon sum par gtan la 'bebs pa/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i smin grol lung gsum gyi sgo nas rang byung gdod ma'i rgyal thabs la mnga' gsol/chos la phyogs ris mi gcod pa rgod tshang mgon po rdo rje'i rnam thar la smon nas bo dong pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ma chos 'brel du zhus/ zhar la 'brug pa rin po che pad+ma dkar po'i rnam thar gyi nges pa drangs pa'i rten gsum rnams zhib mjal byas/ sku 'dra la bal tshar 'dogs pa sogs rdo po dang grogs mched rang du snang ste chos pa la dag snang dga' mos 'dug /zla ba'i 'khor lor longs pa tsam gyi bar la bzhed don ma lus pa bskangs/ brgya kong legs po dang / sa'i snying po la sogs bdog pa༄sa pa mchod rdzas dang rten bzhengs la shin tu mkho bar byung /lam zhor la zhe bor zhag bdun 'dug ring bsam gtan chos sde nas bo dong pa'i gsung rab de nyid 'dus pa chen po la bltas mo byas/nged rdzogs chen pa kun gzhi dang chos sku'i bye brag 'byed pa la chos skad rang mtshan par 'dod par snang / mdo las kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhes gsungs pa ni/ byis pa rnams chos kyi dbyings dri med la yid ches par dka' bas de dag drang ba'i phyir yin gyis/ sgra ji lta ba bzhin ma yin la/gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i blo yin na/ byis pa rnams kyis gnyid 'thug po log pa'i gnas skabs su tha na'ang la las cung zad myong dgos pa la cung zad 163

kyang myang ba med pa'i phyir dang / yod na rmi lam gyi blo ltar 'gyur bas 'jig rten na sems med pa'i gnas skabs su/ shin tu grags pa mi brtan par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'di ni 'phags pa kho nas so sor rig pa'i dngos kyi spyod yul yin gyis/ gzhan gyis nyams su myong bar nus byed ma yin te 'khrul snang gis bsgribs pa'i phyir dang / shi ba'i tshe 'khrul snang mngon gyur zhi ba bag chags kyis non pas rjes su dran par yang mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems la kun gzhi'i rnam shes su bzhag pa gnas skabs kyi gdul bya drang ba'i don ma yin na/ dbus mtha' las sems med pa'i gnas skabs lngar bshad pa'i gnyid stug po'i tshe/ yul lnga'i shes pa yid dang bcas kun gzhir thim pa'i gnas skabs na/ chos nyid kyi ngo bo ma nor ba sus kyang nyams su myong ba med pas shes pa la/kun gzhi chos dbyings su sad pa'i cha nas dbye ba'i khyad par 'di dgongs 'grel mkhan po kun gyi shes pa ma yin no/ /rje bo dong pa'i gsol 'debs shig dang / chos skyong bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi gsol ka nyung 'dus shig dgos gsungs pa'ang 'di nas bris te lha rtser phul/ tshur lam sba mkhar phur grags pa nas nam bteg gla khol la 'dzeg dus/ dngos po rin thang yod pa zhig bor ba'i rnam rtog shar/ skad cig ma dang por 'phongs sems kyi snang ba shar/ de ma thag ston pa'i gsung rab na lus srog la ltos pa med pa'i lo rgyus yod/ de tsam la chags pa'i bya bral gyi rnal 'byor pa hu hu/dngos 'dzin dang bral ba da ga na yod/rang gis sardor / nus pa kho'i dbang thang gi thob pa yin/khong la dga' ba dpag tu med pa rte da dge ba'ang 'dun 164

pa'i khyad par yin pas 'phongs sems ma skyes na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'ang de las gang snyam nas bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs byas/ gangs rgyab nas rta bor ba la'ang bsam pa de ka skyes pas bya sa ko kha'i bang chen gyi gtam rgyud bzhin 'dun pa dge ba'i nus pa kho nas gnyis ka lag tu son/las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa lags/ lar 'khor 'das rnam rtog gis bzos pa'i g.yo 'khrul dang bde blag la aḥ/ blo 'di bzang ngan gang gi phyogs su'ang phral phral 'gyur 'gro ba la dka' tshegs mi 'dug pas rnam pa kun tu dran pa dang shes bzhin gces pa'i tshul/ shan+ta de was/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhis bya/ /ma grangs drol ba'i khrod gnas na//bsgrims te rma yi bag byed bzhin//skye bo ngan khrod gnas pas kyang //sems kyi rma 'di rtag tu bsrung / /zhes pa 'di gal che bar snang / dgun rang gnas su ldog /mtshams rgya'i mur gnas pa na/ mdza' shes la springs par/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun//'bar bas bsregs pa'i lus can 'di dag kyang / /thal ba yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ /shin tu nyam chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma myur bul rtag pa mngon sum du mthong ba la skyo ba bskul ba'i glu/pha dran chog rgyal po u rgyan rje/ /gnas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor gshegs/ /ma snying la byams pa'i mtsho rgyal mas/ /bu shul du bsgyur nas mkha' spyod 'grim//dus de nas da dung srid mtsho la/ /las nying mtshams sbyar ba'i rnal 'byor par/ /phyi log smon dam sri'i cho 'phrul dang / /nang rtsa rlung 'khrugs pa'i 'khu 'phrigs sems/ /rkyen rnam 'gyur sna tshogs la skyo nas/ /lam ro snyoms chen por la bzla tshe/ /grong stod 166

nas bu chung shi'o zer/ /grong smad nas rgas 'khogs na'o zer/ /grong dkyil nas rgyal bsen gnod do zer/ /brtag pa dang byin rlabs dgos so zer/ /rjes 'dzin dang bsngo smon mdzad dgos skad/ /khong rang rang so so'i 'dod pa'i don/ /gag thug gi gnas skabs yin snyam nas/ /sems bskyed dang smon pas dang yang blangs/ /las 'khor ba zer ba'i sdug po 'dir/ /sems skyo shas kyi rnam cha cir yang shar/ /dus re zhig mun pa'i smag rum na/ /gcung sgrub g.yog kho mdun du har gyi byung / /yar bzhengs pa zhu dang rin po che/ /lcam rin chen dpal 'dzom gshegs par gda'/ /gsal 'debs la da lta pheb dgos zer/ /der rtab rtab ngang nas phyin tsa na/ /chung me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin/ /yar thol gyi longs pa'i lcam chung de'i/ /lus mal gyi tha mal bzhag nas 'dug /snying rje ba la bzod thabs ga na yod/ /lam zab mo rdo rje'i theg pa yis/ /gnas spor dang bsngo smon yang dag bgyis/ /khong 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags thebs de/ /glog phreng las bde blag rtsal drag pa/ /dus rtag par yid la gcags yod kyang / /do nub za ma'i skad cig la/ /mngon sum du mthong bas mchi ma bku/ /'di do nub khong gi thog tu bab/ /spyir sems can kun gyi mdun na 'dug /sgos bdag cag la nam yong cha ci 'tshal/ /de bsam bzhin dam pa'i lha chos byed/ /'di dran bzhin dben pa'i ri khrod snyogs/ /de mthong bzhin 'di snang zhen 'khris gcod/ /de bsams bzhin blo sna drur bur 'bul/ /yid gdon gyis btab pa'i skye bo kun/ /mi gzhan la byung ba shes bzhin du/ /de rang la 'ong snyam mi 'dug ste/ /mi nga la snying nas ltos pa dang / /khyed bsgrub tshugs zin pa'i slob ma rnams/ /tshul 'di la bsams nas snying 166

rus bskyed/ /cis kyang dgos med kyi blo sna bstungs/ /zhes so/ /rgya gar na slob dpon chen po klu sgrub zhabs kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i dus tsa na sde snod 'dzin pa gzhon nu sde zhes bya ba bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la sel bskyed pa'i phyir 'tshe ba chos su smra ba kla klo'i grub mtha' brtsams pa yin/ bod na de'i ring lugs mngon gyur pa med kyang / bsam sbyor rjes su mthun pa mang po 'byung ba 'di ma' nas/ bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ /la sogs pa'i sho lo ka gcig po 'dis gal bsdams par shes/rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi dbang las bstan pa'i sgo yang 'gro ba'i mos pa de snyed dang 'tsham pas 'dul bar shes pa la 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal shin tu gzu bor snang / 'di na rang nyid gang gi rjes su zhugs pa de'i grub pa'i mtha' tshul bzhin du shes pa rang dka' mod de/phyogs mgo ches pa tsam gyi thog nas gzhan la snang zhen dang bcas pa'i blos zag zog mkhan du dril bsgrags na mdzes mod/ skyes bu rigs gzugs thos dang ldan rnams kyang / /shes dang tshul khrims bral ba bkur ma lags//de ltas gang la yon tan 'di gnyis ldan//de ni yon tan gzhan dang bral yang mchod/ /ces pa 'di rgya gar chu bo gang hā phan chad kyi gnas tshul du 'dug /jo bo rje'i grub mtha' 'dzin na so so thar pa'i sdom pa dag kyang bsam pa byang chub sems kyis 'phang bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'i sbyor ba 'di rgyud la ldan par byas nas rab tu byung ba'i spyod yul sum brgya pa las/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyis nor 'phrog dang / /mi tshangs spyod rdzun btsos pa'i chang la sogs/ /gar sogs phreng sogs mal chen mtho ba dang / /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul spong byed pa/ /nyon mongs dgra g.yu/ /la

byed tshul khrims te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gnas la dam chos 'dul ba'i rgya cher 'grel dang / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde sogs nas legs par bkral ba'i bslab bya la tshul bzhin du gnas pa byung na bod nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas so snyam nas dad pa shin tu 'phel ba yin/ gzhon nu nyid nas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang ma bsdams pa bdag cag ni/ sum brgya pa las/ gang zhig gnang med de bzhin bkag med pa/ /de ni gsungs pa'i rjes mthun brtags te bzung / /zhes pa ltar dus byin gyis brlabs nas/ yang nas yang du za dgos pa la byang sgra mi snyan pa'i gling du mos pa nas bzung / rin po che la reg pa dang bdag gir byed pa na dkon cog mchod pa dang / sems can gso ba la sogs pa'i don du gnang ba yin snyam du mtha' gnyis la gnas pa spangs nas phyogs mthun dang rung mthun du brtsi mkhan zhig yin du chug kyang /ltung ba mi 'phog pa la shin tu phan par gda' ste gzugs brnyan kho nar song ba'i tshul/ ched du brjod pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag mgo reg la byang chub ga la yod//rnal ma ser po la byang chub ga la yod//chus bkrus pa la byang chub ga la yod/ /dgongs lto bcag pa la byang chub ga la yod/ /ces gsungs pas dge slong rnams yid gnyis su gyur pa na/ yang bka' stsal pa/ ye shes kyi spu gris rnam rtog gi skra breg par bya/ stong nyid kyi gos kyis nyon mongs pa'i tshad pa las skyob par bya/ ye shes kyi chus ma rig pa'i dri ma bkru bar bya/ bsam gtan gyi zas kyis 'dod pa'i sred pa bsal bar bya zhes gsungs pa des so//de lta na'ang sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang las gyur pa'i bag chags du ma sad/lta ba 'di la dgag sgrub mang po zhig 'dug pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 168

'ga'i dgongs pa dang gtan tshigs bkod 'dug pa ltar na/ snying po'i ring lugs 'di rtag chad kyi mthar lhung yod pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po mthong yang /sgom pa'i nyams myong gi steng nas de ltar smra ba po'i mtshang yang phugs nas rig /nang gi nyams su myong ba brjod med blo 'das chen po la tshig gis btags pa'i khas len gang gis kyang phog pa med pa zhig tu song bas/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ tshul khrims las ni nyams sla yi/ /lta las de ltar ma yin no/ /zhes lta ba nor ba las rnam grol gyis 'bras bu med pa'i gnas la'ang nongs pa med pa'i nges shes thob/ de kus rgyu 'bras lung ma bstan byang gi sgra mi snyan pa srog mi gcod pa lta bu'i mtshungs dpes spyod pa la tshul 'chos dang blang dor ngo skog can byed dgos pa'i rdzun phugs kyang rang sar dib/'di byas na 'di yong snyam pa srid pa rgan po'i rtog dpyod can gyi re ba chen po'am/ mdo sngags gnyis na'i don mthar thug gang yin pa dang 'gal ba'i chos min gyi bya ba rlabs po che byas na dkon mchog rin po che thugs khrel yong snyam pa'i 'jigs rtseg rtseg las/ gzhan srid pa mgo mjug ldog kyang snying las su gyur pa'i dogs pa'i rnam rtog chen po phal mo che yang 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du sangs par gyur na'ang / gtam du bya ba'i gnas la/ rgyal bas snying la 'bab dang bden pa dang //log par smra ldan skyes bu rnams kyi ni/ /sbrang rtsi me tog mi gtsang lta bu'i tshig /rnam gsum bka' stsal de las tha ma spang / /zhes kyal ka dang rtsub mo 'dres pa 'di nam yang smra bya ma yin par nges mod/ de lta na'ang zhi ba lhas/ byis dang 'grogs na byis pa la/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /'khor bar dga' ba'i gtam la sogs/ /mi 16 pi

dge cis kyang nges par 'byung / /zhes pa ltar kha cig ni zhe sdang / la la ni 'dod chags/ phal cher gti mug gi dbang las dul bar mi gnas pa'i rnam thar gang yin pa 'dul ba lung las/ gang zhig rab tu byung yang yon tan snod ma gyur/ /skra dang kha spu bregs kyang dge sbyong tshul ma zhugs/ /rab byung de ni rab byung ma yin khyim pa'ang min/ chu med khron pa ri mo'i mar me ji bzhin no//zhes pa'ang snang ste/ snang ba dag pa rab 'byams kyi dam tshig dang 'gal bas de la rtog dpyod gtong mi nus/ 'di na gzhan gyis don ngan pa yid la bsams shing / tshig rtsub mo kha ton du bgyid pa gang yin pa la gnong bkur ba bzhin du 'chab par bya ba ni nam yang ma yin pas lnga brgya pa rnams kyis rna lam du myos par bya ba ni bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa tsam la'ang bkag par ma zad/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi bgegs byed pa'i tshul/ yan lag brgyad pa'i rgyud las kyang / ra ro dang po bag med gnas la gnas/ /rnam rtog ngan bcom bde ba yin snyam sems/ /ra ro gnyis pa glang chen smyon pa ltar/ /kha na ma tho tshul khrims 'chal pa'i gnas/ /ra ro tha ma sems med ro ltar nyal/ /gang yang mi shes mun pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di ga'i dge skyon dang po nyid nas rig pas dgyes spro dang phud bzhes la spro ba zhig ma yin mod kyang /smad ra byung phyin rgya che la gting zab pa de ka sgrib pa 'dag pa la phan pas myos par bya ba'i gnas la bag ma yin par spyod tshul gyi klan ka /su zhig gi dad par gyur cing gang la theg pa chen po'i chos kyi sgo nas phan gdags pa de dag ni bgrod bya dang / log par g.yem pa'i rten du phyar ka sgrog par byed/ kha zer bar byed/ de la 'di snyam du/ lar de bzhin gshegs pa la'ang mu stegs 170

byed kyi bram ze'i bu mo dang mdza' zhes brjod na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug la tshul ma yin pa'i cha la dbyar gyi chu klung bzhin du 'brub par gyur na'ang dam tshig gi kun tu spyod pa'i gnas/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pa/ /rten yang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /ci bde bar ni brten pas 'grub/ /ces dang / rtsa rgyud le'u bcu drug par/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis longs/ /bud med dag kyang bsten par bya/ /rdo rje'i lam ni 'di dag gis/ /sems can thams cad bskul bar bya/ /zhes pa 'di la dgongs pa lung ston ltar bshad pa'i skabs/srog gi rlung ste las rlung gi rgyu ba dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum gyis nges pas gsad pa dang / chos nyid dang tha snyad gnyis 'gal ba can yin pa'i dpes don gyi gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'i rdzun tshig smra ba dang / blang bya'i rdzas sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sus kyang ma byin bzhin du rang stobs kyis blangs pa'i ma byin len/stong pa nyid la bud med kyi sgrar btags te/ de nyid la rig pa ye shes kyi sbyor ba la 'don pa bsten pa'i tha snyad dbang rnon sngags la drod thob pa dang /ba gnas la spyod pa'i khyim pas mtshon gsang sngags mos pas spyod pa'i gnas rnam pa gnyis la gnang ba dang bkeg pa'i mtshams kyang shes/ spyod 'jug las/ la la bdag gi khrag mthong na/ /dpa' brtan lhag par skye 'gyur yod/ /la la gzhan gyi khrag mthong na/ /'bog cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba yod/ /ces blo'i nus parang 'jug pa tha dad pa'icad par yang rtogs/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i byis pa rnams kyi tsul sgrogs la 'jigs pa med pa'i gdeng 171

yang thob/ yul rkyen chos nyid dang bsre ba'i ro snyoms dngos grub chen po'i pham thab shin tu yang blo'i ngo la lkog tu gyur pa'i rigs can 'ga' zhig la rtsed 'jo dang bzhad gad kyis gnas su gyur pa 'di tsam brjod mi rung ba ma yin te/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnyarma rak+ṣi tas/ khyim nas byung zhing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /khyim pa bzhin du bya ba mtha' yas shing / /spang blang thams cad khyad du gsod pa ste/ /drang srong rnams kyi dmod pas gdab bya yin/ /zhes bshad pas rang skyon la ci yang mi sems pa sgo nga lta bu'i rnam rtog can la dga' ba chen po'i gtam 'jigs med dpa' bo'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba/ya gi grub dbang sa ra ha pa nas/ /da lta drin cen bla ma yan chad kyi/ /gsang sngags dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rnams/ /'dod pa'i yon tan sgyu ma lta bur spyod/ /chos mgo ma thon smra na khyod rang shes//dang po 'dul khrims bslab pa dang du blangs/ /bslab par bya ba'i gzhi bcu sun ma dbyung / bltar mi mngon pa'i lkog gyur ring du spangs/ /khyim gyi 'tsho 'dzin lho tshong byang bskyel sogs/ /ltar snang btsun pa'i gzugs brnyan byas re shi/ /de nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa khrel bag yod/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rtsa thig rlung la bsnun/ /rig pa gtad med chos skur yongs su grol/ grub pa'i mtha' dang spang blang rang sar zhig /bslab pa bsrung ba'i nang na 'di gces pa/ /sems bsrung brtul zhugs dran pa lta zhog gis//cing ba 'byung ba'i sgo gcig mi shes pa/ /yin zhes thogs med bzhed phyir de'i gnas la/ /so so thar pa'i mdo dang rgya cher 'grel/ /dge tshul gyi ni lnga bcu pa tsam dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu yi/ /nyes byas sbom po pham lhung 'byung tshul gyi/ /gzhung lugs /72

tsam yang mthong bar ma gyur pas/ ldan dang grol kha'i yon tan lta ci smos/ /dmar ser gos la tshul khrims chags so snyam//spang bya'i gnas la lkog tu gyur pa can/ chu nang rdo ba skam po mthong tsa na/ /byi la'i brtul zhugs ma bzung khar rje che/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma bdag med dbyings/ /rtsa ti'i rtsa mdud dgrol la chas pa bzhin/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas la mig bsgyur gar/ /gu h+ya pad+ma bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ/ gnas brtan rgan po 'dod pa'i dka' thub can/ /rdul gyi dwangs sa med pa'i me long ltar/ /mgo bregs brtul zhugs dag kyang 'gyur bcas phyir/ /chu yi yon tan bral ba'i chab rom bzhin/ bdag tu spros pa zhi ba'i srid gsum sgron/ /tshad ma'i gtan tshigs tsam la ltos min pa/ /rang las byung kyang 'di zhes mi mtshon pa/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i chang gi myos pa'i rjes/ ngan skyugs ma yin po ti glegs bam char/ /rgyal po lung bstan rdo rjer 'gran pa bzhin/ /gnas 'gyu brkos su 'debs la khengs pa'i blo/ /gang dang mched grogs spyod yul mnyam pa can/ rnam mang thos pa'i nor gyis phyug pa dang / /go sa chen por 'phangs pa'i dam pa 'gas//dad pa'i me tog 'thor la rings pa bzhin/ /rang min gzhan la mi mthong thos sgrogs rigs/ /rnal ma ser po'i me tog gang yin pa/ /rdo rje'i theg pa 'di la skrag pa'i mod/ /rang tshugs las kyang 'das pas shin tu nyams/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i chos tshul la/dngos dang dngos 'dra dngos min gsum du yod/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas bsgrub la myur bul tsam/ /las dang de yi 'bras kyang rang sar yod/ /so so'i 'dun ma bdag gir bzhes pa 'thad/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po stangs dpyal kyang / /dus gsum kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan dbyings/ /dus 173

med chen po'i klong na 'du 'bral med//rdo rje'i gnas 'di tho cos ma yin no//lar ār+ya de was/ phal mo cher na mi rnams ni/ /dam pa ma yin phyogs yongs 'dzin/ /zhes pa ltar phal pa 'di ni gnas skabs kho na la 'gro rtsis pa'i spong gnyen gyi 'gyur ldog gar mkhan gyi lag pa las kyang bde blag 'a tan /zer lo'i rjes su 'breng ba la ni dga'/ chos kyi don ni ngo mi shes/ las 'phro dang skal ba ni shin tu chung / de la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams mi dgyes pas rtsa khams bde ba chen po'i pho brang du kurma ḍāk+ki'i lha tshogs la nyams grib kyi rten 'brel stobs su gyur nas/'du ba cha mi snyoms pa la thams dang rim gros thob shor med pa zhig byung / de'i tshe dbang chen 'dus pa'i tshe rta zung 'brel gyi bcad mtshams shin tu dam par yod pa'i tshes bcu zhig gi nub/ nyams snang la bud med rgyan cha mchor mo bkrag zil can zhig gis bzhin mi sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i ngang la/ lung bstan yin zer ko dmar la bris pa zhig gtad byung ba'i rgyu mtshan des/ de ta'i mur khang pa skyid rab cig na grub brgya'i rnam thar rigs mi 'dra ba gsum klog pa'i snang ba la/ bal po'i slob dpon dpal sdes mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang rang bzhin mthun mi mthun gyi rtog dpyod zhugs pa'i ngang der/ gtsang smyon he ru ka pas bskur ba yin zer ba'i yi ge zhig lag tu 'byor bar/kha yig la kun dga' dbyangs can tshe dbang zhes bris 'dug /de la dpyod mi shes par dgod bro ba'i mod/ da ci'i bud med de dang / dri lan 'di 'dra byed pa'i snang ba shar/ ka dag gnyug ma'i gtan srid zin pa khyed/ /kha dog mdzes pa'i ni gu nga la dgongs/ /ga bur thengs pas tshad pa smin pa bzhin/ /nga bdag log 'dzin spangs pa'i chos shig 174

zhu/ zhes zer bar/ ca ga rnam rtog yin kyang sdom pa bsrung / /cha byad bu mo mtshar kyang ltar snang tsam/ /ja bzang shang dkar btung pa'i dge slong la/ /nya ma'i bslu brid 'os pa ma yin no//zhes smras pa na/shin tu lus pa'i tshul gyis/ta na ga na gsang chen 'phur 'gro'i lam/ /tha mal nyan thos spyod pa'i yul min kyang / /da lta sangs rgyas 'grub pa gsang sngags kyi/ /na ma'i bsgugs yun mi dgos khyad chos yin//zhes zer bar theg pa chen po'i rigs can yin par nges nas/ pa pā rdo rje'i lam gyi gnad shes na/ /pha rol phyin pa bdun pa thabs kyi lam/ /ba ling tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod bzhin du/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje byas pas chog /ces brjod pa na/ de shin tu spro ba'i rnam 'gyur ston cing / lag pa nam mkhar gdengs nas/ tsa ri nye pa'i zung spyod de nas 'ongs/ tsha grang rnam rtog spangs pa'i ḍāk+ki yin/ /dza lan rnya ra la sogs nyul du 'gro/ /wa ltar 'khyam pa'i bud med nga ma yin/ /zhes smras byung bas/rang gi shes pa'ang brtul zhugs rol pa'i ngar thogs nas/ ngo tsha dang tshul 'chos kyi rnam rtog rang sar zhig ste/zhwa mos ci byed ral pa'i zur phud yod/ /za ra zi ra'i btsun pa tsam bzhag nas/ /'a cag grub dbang sa ra ha pa ltar/ /ya nga med pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong / /zhes smras pas/ rwa co lta bu'i theg dman chod re chung / /la wa pa ni gnyid kyang 'od gsal ngang / /sha za 'bod sgrog rgyal po pad+ma bzhin/ /sa bcu pho nya'i lam gyis bsgrod lags sam/ zhes zer ba la/ 'di skad du/ ha las skyes pa'i badz+rarngakhri ni/ /a la la ste dbu ma'i 'khri shing can/ /haṃ yig byang chub sems la rtag rol nyid/ /gtor blugs rgyal po'i dam tshig dang du longs//zhes smras pas/ thal mo sbyar nas/bde stong bung 176

ba gzhon nu'i 'phur rtsal gyis/ /bcu drug sprang ci'i nying khu 'thungs pa las/ /bdud rtsi'i chu yur gyen du drangs pa'i mod//nga yang khyod dang ro gcig 'dres gyur cig /ces zer ba'i mod la sna nga shes 'dres pa'i nyams de nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin song ngo / /de nas nam gung gnyid kyi rnal 'byor la sleb pa na/spyan snga rin po che'i phyag tham yin zer ba'i tham chen mtshal gyis bkus pa gcig dang / shog ser hril mo tshas bzang pos gril ba zhig 'ja' sa yin pa'i khungs kyi gal rtsis ha las byas byin/ the'u dmar gyi rten 'brel dang /gtsang smyon nye ru ka pa'i gnas tshul ni bla ma sa skya pa chen po chos bdag tu lung bstan par 'dug /chu bo rir lcags zam dang / dri'u lhas pa rin thoches 'gyangs min la chab shog de stsal byung / sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa'i srog shing bzhugs shing / 'jig rten rmongs pas g.yogs pa'i dus tshod na sngon sbyangs stobs su gyur pa nyid du bzhugs pa'i dngos po nges par bstan pa'i gtan tshigs rtog dpyod can gyis shes par bya ba'i slad du/ dri'u lhas pa'i phyag bris dang po/ dri med bshes gnyen ldang ma lhun gyis rgyal/ /kun mkhyen chos rje yab sras brgyud bcas kyi/ /thugs rje'i rol gar mi mngon sbas pa'i tshul/ /rnam 'dren rig 'dzin bla ma gang zhabs su/ /rang tshul rtog la dmus long ltar dmun yang / /gzhan tshul yang dag ltar snang sa le sbram/ /ra gan so sor 'byed pa'i gdeng ldan pa/ /g.yung mgon rdo rjer rab dad mchid 'di gsol/ /gdod nas spangs rtogs yon tan yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /go 'phang dzin+ta ma ṇi'i mchog brnyes kyang / /drang don skye 'dir tshul bzhin sbyang rim gyi/ /deng sang gsal rdzogs yid bzhin dbang rgyal khyod/ /gsang gsum mi zad 176

rgyan gyi 'khor lo che//gdod ma'i yon tan khong nas rngom mod kyi//skal dman skye po'i snang ngor dben pa'i rir/ /lha dang ḍāk+ki'i rje bor dgyes bzhin du/ /'dir snang rnyed bkur grags pa'i ched 'dus pa'i/ /'a 'ur za zir cher rlom 'gro don gyi/ /mched zlar ma gyur skal ldan 'ba' zhig ngor/ /snying po'i bstan pa spel der cis mi gus//gsung gi gnas der gsung gi rig 'dzin rje//'od gsal klong du chos kun thugs chud pa'i//snyan pa'i sgra chen tshur mthong la gab kyang / /mkha' spyod mig yangs tshogs rnams ca cos brel/ /dag pa'i dgongs zab zla ba'i ma ma'i rum/ /dri med 'od zer thugs bcud nor bu'i gter/ /gdod nas mchis pa dus babs gan mdzod kyi//snying por phyung la dad pa'i spu long g.yos/ /'di na rgyal kun 'dus zhal mtsho skyes rje'i/ /thugs rje'i grib tu bsil bar ngal gso ba'i/ /'du shes gsum pa rang don ma grub bzhin/ /gzhan phan zol zog spyod pas 'da' bzhin lags/ /sgrib bral gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes spyan/ /glo bur ling tog nang gi rnal 'byor gyi/ /mig sman chen pos sbyangs pa'i spyan snga na//lkog dang mngon gyur tha snyad rdzun pa'i chos//'on kyang byams ldan ma la bus pas bzhin/ /rang tshul bsngags 'os dam pa'i rnam thar dang //bral yang ma sbas gsong por rdo rje'i snyan//gtsubs pa'i rkyen du gsol 'dir ma khrel dgongs/ /skyes rabs mang por tshe'i ya na'i rjes/ /bskyangs sam kun rtog dwangs pa'i me long du/ /mgon der dad shugs gzugs kyi snang ba ni/ /bus pa'i dus nas 'gog med cir yang bkra/ /ris bral dam pa kun la phyogs lhung dang / /bral ba'i dad gus dag snang cher rgyas shing / /mgon po de dag gis kyang rjes bzung bas/ /skal ba bzang po'i dge 177

mtshan cir yang thob/ /rgyal gsung dngos dang rjes 'brangs grub pa'i mtha'/ /ma lus gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs tshul du/ /nges shing mthar thug dgongs pa'i gnad gcig tu/ /shes pas phyogs 'dzin a 'thas ma dgos skyid/ /'on kyang thos dang bsam pa'i rjes zhugs pa'i/ /skal bzang tsam las rnam g.yeng gzhan dbang gi/ /rang yid brtan pa ma thob kun rtog gi/ /gya gyus brel 'di rnam kun ngal ba'i gnas//da ko glog gi mar me'i gnas tshad kyi/ /srog dbang lhag ma ji srid yod kyi bar/ /dal 'byor don ldan nges gsang theg pa'i rtse/ /nyams len thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed du gsol/ /sgos kyi snying po rnam 'dren rig 'dzin rje/ /gang nyid bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs brtan cing / /bdag kyang ring min dngos zhal mngon sum du/ /mjal zhing zab mo'i bdud ci spyod par smon/ /gnas skabs bdag gi 'gal rkyen sol ba dang / /'dod pa 'grub pa'i thabs tshul gsang ba'i lung/ /ye shes gzigs ngor gsal dang sngon rabs rgyud/ /kun kyang ma sbas drang bo'i bka' yis stsol/ /de skad deng sang skyebo'i spyod 'gros dang / /ye nas mi mthun blo sna yan gar ba/ /legs sam nyes kyang rung ste gdod ma nas//rtag tu shar ba'i rnal 'byor smyon pa des/ /tshul khrims blo gros shes rab 'od zer gyi/ /rgyud du brdzus te byon pa'i bla ma mchog /dgyes pa bskyed phyir rang gnas kun grol gling / mkha' 'gro'i gling nas sug bris nyid du phul/ /ces pa 'di yin/ gar rgyud pa 'di la chos rje rgod tshang ba nas bzung dag snang gi srog shing bzang po 'dug pa'i ste/ /rin po che 'di nyid gsan bsam gyi 'bras bu phyogs 'dzin du smin pa'i bshes gnyen rtog ge pa dang mi 'dra bar snang ba khyab gdal du dag pa 'di ka gcig 178

po'ang rnam thar bzang por snang / phyag bris dang po 'di phebs rgyu'i nub/ban+de skug 'dzi re zhig gis/ mdangs mtshar po g.yu yi ne tso yis/ /gos dro 'jam gyi ngos la ji dug bkus/ /des rang byung rdo rje sgril ba na/ /lus chu bur gyi kob por song gis dogs/ /sha dam tshig yin pas bza' dgos zer/ zo sa drags na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad sdang/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig ris shig zer ba'ang phul ba ni yin/ slar chab shog thengs gnyis tsam byung ba bzhin/klog pa thos bsam gyi grar brgal brtag rtsod pa'i 'khor los slob dpon chos kyi grags pa'i rnam thar skyong ba la dang ba brtas pa'i rab 'byams smra bar grags pas/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yis gus phyir min/ /zhes chos kyi tshig don la brtag dpyad legs par bya ba 'di glen pa rnams kyi rna mchog tu mi 'dzul yang / rgyal ba klong chen pa'i grub mtha' yin pa bzhin/ dngos cag ku su lu pa'i gzhung / lung gi gter mdzod skor zhig phul nas/ rigs pa dang rigs pa ma yin pa'i gnas la byi dor mdzad par bskul pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen dgongs pa'i gter mdzod pad+ma'i gdung tshab mchog gi zhabs pad du/ mtshams zhu'i mthar/ longs spyod ro 'dus 'khor lo'i mdud rgya kun/ /zab gsang rnal 'byor chen po'i sor mo yis/ /lhug par bkrol ba'i rang 'bras legs bshad dbyangs/ /tshig rer chos gung na rdzogs hā ma ka /kun bzang dgongs pa'i dbyings nas rgyal thabs bcud/ /spyi nas blugs pa'i zab gter thugs kyi mtshor/ /'khyil ba'i cha shas dri lan zol nyid kyis/ /skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs der rangs/ /rnyog 179

pa'i cha shas lan brgyar btsal byas kyang //rnyed par ma gyur dad gsum 'dab ma brgya/ /rnam par bzhad pa'i gsos gyur thal mo zung / /spyi bor zum ste chab mi 'tshal bar phul/ /slad ma na yang bdag sogs bstan dang 'gro'i/ /spyi dpal chen por zhabs zung rtag brtan cing / /rnam kun tshad med thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /'dor ba med par 'tshal lo rig 'dzin dbang / /ji srid dngos zhal mjal ba'i skal bzang la//spyod par ma gyur de srid yang nas yang / /rjes su brtse ba'i bka' yig mi 'chad pas/ /skyong bar mdzod cig kun mkhyen gnyis pa kye/ /zhes rdo rje'i lam gyi mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud zhig pa las snang ba dpe char shar ba'i lam rtags yod pa dang / rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang rang byung 'od gsal gyi dbyings nas sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba gsum gyi ye shes chen po dang ro gcig pa bskur thob med par bzhugs pa'i rigs yongs su sad pa na/mdo las kyang / gang zag sa mthon po la gnas pas chos kyi gter rnyed par bshad pa bzhin/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur la tshad mkha' 'gro'i lung / rtags zab mo'i brda ris kyi bzung ba'i chos tshul nges pa'i mtshang longs pa 'di ngo mtshar dang bcas pa'i rnam dpyod du nges la/ de skad du byang ba bdag pos/ dri med 'od zer kun mkhyen thugs gter mdzod/ /sgo 'phar 'byed la gzhan gyi 'gran zla bral/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lugs 'di la 'jug pa'i gang zag phal mo ches/ don rtsa ba chen po 'di ma go bar/mkha' 'gro yang tig la sogs gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi dgongs pa'i long nas phyung ba'i gter kha chen po la dgongs gter zhes nyams chos gyi nar 'khrul zhing / gong 'og phyin chad nas bshus bkab byas chog pa cher 180

med pa zhig la/ spyi brtol can gyis zhal bshus su khungs phyung ba po'i blo nus dang 'tsham pas tshig don gang gi thad du'ang nor ba chen po yod pa'i kun 'byung gi sgro btags can/ slo dpon pad+ma dang / bi ma la mi tra sogs par khag bzhag pas/ spongs can pa'i mkhas grub gzhan gyis sa 'og gi rdzun ma zhes pad+ma'i ring lugs rtsod pa med pa dag la'ang the tshom du byed pa 'di byung ba yin pas/ ma yin pa la yin dang / yin pa la ma yin zhes bsgrub pa gnyis ka la nyes pa mi bzad par yod pas/mngon par shes pa lnga dang bral ba rnams/dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang / /dga' dang shin tu sbyangs dang ting 'dzin dang / /btang snyoms 'di bdun byang chub yan lag ste/ /mya ngan 'das thob bgyid pa'i dge tshogs lags/ /zhes pa'i don la dgongs par 'tshal/ cho 'phrul chen po'i tshes brgyad la shrī parba ta'i 'dus tshogs su nyin 'khyongs gcig gi bsnyen bkur nas na raka dong sprugs kyi cho ga bstar/dge 'dun rer skya chen re dang / gsum ṭaṃ/lo snga rting gnyis la 'byor pa'i shi gson gyi gos lham sogs nye bar dpyad pa gang yod 'gyed la btang / gtsus lag khang gi zur bzhir lo gro nas skyongs pa'i rlung dril chen po bzhi yang btags/ bsam mchims nas dge slong mchog tu grub pas zhal gdams shig dgos zhes bskul bar/ kye ma kyi hud khams gsum gyi 'dren mchog /rtsa gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /dran chog rgyal po 'dzam gling gi bla rdo/ /rma rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa de dran no//sngon tshe bzang po rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa/ /mi rnams rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dpal ldan/ /sa rnams ma rmos lo tog bi 'byung khungs/ /las dang nyon mongs bab shugs kyi chung ngus/ /mtho ris bu 181

mo'i skyed tshal la chags kyang / /gnas skabs mngon mtho'i yon tan gyis phyus mod/ /da ni dus ngan snyigs ma yi yang mtha'/ /sa yi bcud nyams nad mtshon gyi bskal pa/ /nyon mongs dug lnga 'byor nyog yospyad pas/ /tshe thung nad mang sdug bsngal gyi skye 'gro/ /khyer shog khur shos 'u las gi 'ded drag /brdungs shig bkyigs shig mnar spyod kyi duḥkha/ /ma ldangs ma phyid ma mthun pa'i ngang la/ /mi tshe lham gyi rdog pa ltar 'dzad de/ /ngan song gnas la ling skyur gyi 'gro ba'i/ /spyi mthun las kyi nyer len 'di e gzigs/ /sngon bsags dkar po'i las thabs kyi lhag mas/ /da res dal 'byor mi lus tsam thob cing / /dam pa chos kyi sgo mo ru zhugs kyang / /chos dang zhe 'gras lto 'grangs dang gos phyid/ /don gnyer phag pa'i spun zla ru song ba/ rang dang rang 'dra'i grogs po rnams mthong bas / /glo bur 'chi bdag bdud po dang phrad na/ /ga tsug bya snyam glo snying 'di skyog grang / /khyed kyang dal 'byor don yod cig mdzad na/ /mang po tshogs pa'i chags sdang gi ram 'degs/ /mi byed bsams kyang shugs 'byung du thal ba'i/ /dug lnga'i rlung 'khor dal med du bskor bas/ /sems nyid a thang chad pa 'di skyur nas/ /da res tshogs pa'i pha ma dang spun zla/ /yul mi khyim mtshes grwa tshogs dang 'du long//rtag rtag 'dra yang skad cig la 'gyur ba//tshong 'dus mgron po shul med la gyes bzhin/ /rang rang 'chi tshe mar dkyil gyi spu ltar/ /su dang mi 'grogs las rjes su 'brangs nas/ /phrang ring bar dor gcig skyel la 'byon pa'i/ /'o brgyal sems dpa' skyo mo 'di dgongs nas/ /dal 'byor rin chen don ldan zhig mdzod dang / /nga nyid sa phyogs de nyid du sgom pa'i/ /brag phug char skyobs rlung skyor dang bcas pa/ /de nas de la mi 18 2

rtag pa'i ngang tshul/ /bltas mthong gzigs gsal mtshon dpe ru bzhag nas/khyed kyang gnyen 'khor yul gzhis dang bcas pa/ /rang bzhag ling skyur nam 'chi dang cha med/ /thugs la dbongs nas bsags sbyangs dang bskyed rdzogs/ /steng 'grus med pa'i bskul 'debs shig zhu'o/ /nga yang 'dug gnas skyid mo zhig gda' ste/ /bka' gdams dgon rnying gyang ral tsho mthong bas/ /de pa'i nang du 'don 'don dang chos spyod/ /gnyal dang lo ro'i gyang gog tsho mthong bas/ /de pa'i nang du chang 'thung dang glu bzhad/ /don mkhar lung pa'i dud stong tsho mthong tshe/ /rnam rig 'khyug la cang grung du 'dzoms pa'i/ /bya bzhag g.yar po byed mkhan gyi mi tsho/ /deng sang gar yod 'dir yod dang bral ba'i/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe don gyi chos 'dis/ /snang ba mi lam mig yor du go nas/ /then med rol pa'i brtul zhugs la spyod yod/ /khyod kyang nges 'byung zhen log gis lcags 'debs/ /dus bzhir snying la gsal 'debs kyi bskul nas/ /las dang rgyu 'bras phra zhib kyi 'dor len//'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med las thar thabs/ rang sems rin chen yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /rang ngo rig pa'i thabs rtsol la 'gungs nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub nges shig mdzod dang/ /pho brgya'i dkyil nas rgod shos shig 'ong nges/ /mgo brgya'i dkyil nas rang thon zhig 'ong nges/ dal 'byor mi lus don ldan zhig yong nges/ /de skad snying nas phan 'dod kyi bsam pas/ /khyed kyi bskul ba'i mchid lan du smra ba'i/ /byed po klong chen nam mkha'i dang rnal 'byor/ /bi shwa ḍakhri'i mgur dbyangs la smon nas/ /de 'dra ji bzhin skyo glu yi phreng ba/ /mgrin pa rdo rje'i dkor mtshod nas blangs so/ /gzhan snang dge la 'gyur ba zhig zhu'o/ /lo de'i sos nas tshe dpag /83

med kyi sku 'bum ther btab pa nang gzungs kyi btso bor bzhugs pa'i mchod rten byang chub mthong grol ston pa 'khrungs pa'i dus chen la 'go 'dzugs kyis bzhengs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchod rten brgyad kyi thig bi rnam par ba'ag pa byang chub ljon shing du grags pa'ang gsar du brtsams/ 'di lo'ang 'brog chen 'jigs su rung ba ga la bar gnas 'brel du lhags/ rdza khrod du bsam gtan la gnas pa las/ mun mtshams su cog pur log pa'i skabs na zhum nag che phyogs tsam la/ bde blas sre mong ltar 'khyug pa zhig rdza gseb gcig nas gcig tu 'khyud 'gro ba zhig mthong /zla bo rnams la zhum bu e yin byas pas 'dir mi chags zer ba dag nas yu la 'di na ce spyang yod zer ba bden pa 'dra/ ston gsum rtsi thog dang 'bras bu smin par phyogs pa'i tshe dpal chu bo ri nas rje grub thob chen po'i khri la mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan du mas legs par bsgyings pa lcags zam sprul pa'i sku rin po che dpon g.yo ga zhung bsdus shig phebs/zhag gsum gyi ring /dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gsung gleng smar/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rgyun dbang dang / klong chen snying tig bi chos bdag tu rten 'brel 'gris pa bzhin rtsa dbang rgyal thabs spyi blugs tsam/ gzhan dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'brel thar thor 'dra yang phul/slan chad sgrub chen bde gshegs 'dus pa ma tshang ba med pa gsan bzhed dang / shan 'byed/la bzla/ rang grol mngon sum du ston pa rdzogs pa chen po'i smin grol thun mong ma yin pa'i dga' ston la spyod phyir ci nas kyang dpal chen chu bo rir slebs pa byed dargongs gsungs/ sang du kun tu rgyu rab bzang 8

bi brtul zhugs 'dzin cing / de las kyang gdul bar dka' ba'i rgan po byis pa'i blo can la chos kyi las 'brel 'jos dgos na/ dag snang dang mkhyen dpyod phun sum tshogs pa 'i dam pa la bdud rtsi zab mo'i me tog 'thor ba bstan pa dang sems can gyi sman yon bla na med par 'gyur grang snyam nas /bzhed pa chos bzhin du bskang ba'i khas len byas/ dgun chos kyi bya ba bsgrub pa'i rtsub 'gyur zhi phyir khro rol slang dgu ma'i gtor bzlog sand smin zhig song / nam zla dros nas 'og min lha khang gi rten bzhengs tshugs/ rten gtso rma rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku tshab bdud 'dul gyi cha byad skyes bu'i lus tshad nyis 'gyur tsam bzo sgros gtsang ba dang / 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ rje btsun sgrol ma dang bcas pa mi tshad tsam/ kun la srog shing nas brtsams te nang gzungs kyi bya ba rnams lag bstar dang / rab gnas dga' ston mtha' rgyas la thug bi bar nged rang mchod yon gnyis gas rgyu 'don spun 'don byas/ gser gyi byug pa dang / bzo yon rnams rang nyid kyi 'grub nga bzhin dang du blangs/ ji srid bar mchod me sdong long re nyin mtshan bar med/ nyin re zhal zas dang / de ma'i mchod 'bru bcas gzhis ka rang nas sbyor 'jags mdzad/ting mchod cha dang bla bre sogs kyang dngos nas sgrigs/phyi nas rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang / dpal mabon klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ mi dge bcu po spangs pa'i steng / /chang mi 'thungs dang 'tsho ba bzang / /rnam mi 'tshe dang bos sbyin dang / /mchod 'os mchod dang byams pa ste/ /mdor na chos ni de bzhin no/ /zhes mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug du gsungs pa bzhin/ 'brel mtshungs kyi sri zhu sla ba'i gtsus lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di 185

dag la khyim pa'i 'tshang mi 'chos/ nyams pa gso ba dang / bste stang je cher bskyed/ rang dbang gi ri la ri rgya bsdam pa dang / srog gcod la 'dzem pa sogs kyi rgyun la 'bad na kho bo'ismon lam gyi dbang las gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu khyed cag la don che ba'i rten 'brel zab mo yo da ces kha chems su 'dri ba yin/ sgrub gnas rten sasum dang bcas pa'i dkar chas nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba'ang bris pa'i khongs su/ 'phra rgyan/ na bza' mchod rdzas sogs kyi nges brjod kyang gsal/ gnas gzhi dang por 'debs pa tsam nas ma gza' rdor gsum gyis skyong bran byed pa'i dag snang shar zhing /phyi'i gnas bdag brtan ma chen mo bkra shis tshe ring mas rang gir mdzad pa bzhin gnyer du gtad cing skyes bu chen po dang lcam dral du byas pa'i bla rdo srog 'khor khyad du 'phags pa 'i rten ma khar bcas pa yin/ mthun par 'gyur pa'i yul na gnas pa dang / /skyes bu dam pa la ni brten pa dang / /bdag nyid legs smon sngon yang bsod nams bgyis/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi ni khyod la mnga'/ dbe ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa tshangs par spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs pa thub pas gsungs de'i phyir/ /skyes bu dam pa bsten bgyi rgyal ba la/ /brten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba thob/ /ces slob dpon nā gardzu nas mdza' bo bde spyo da la gdams pa bzhin/ dus tshod 'di tsam na theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i sgo nas las 'brel can smin par byas shing snang ba blo rdeg tu bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel las/ dka' thub 'ba' zhis lhur blangs nas grol ba don du gnyer bzhin lo gsum gyi dam bca' rang la gnas pa'ang bcu phras tu ba la ba dus gcig la snang bas/ 'di tsho'i nyin gcig si dge sbyor la'ang don cung 186

zad 'dug snyam spro ba 'phel ba'ang byung / spyir nas chos bsha' ma byed mkhan nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon zhing gtan la phebs pas yid skyo ba'i gnas/rgong ma 'ga' zhig gis gsung bgros na/ mi chen gyi slob ma stong sras gcis las/ brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i sprang po gcig dga' zhes gsungs pa 'di chos thos nas dpyad pa'i gsung nges pa can du snang / rgyu mtshan de nas 'khrid dang gdams pa btab pa la ltos de rgyal po'i nang gzan drung 'khor tshos gnyis dang / bste gnas la spyod pa'i khyim pa/ tshong dang so nam gyis g.yeng ba'i btsun gzugs rnams la slob ma'i dwangs ma byas pas ci btub/ bya ba gting nas thongs pa'i rtogs btsun gangs kyi seng ge 'dra ba byung na dga' ste de'ang nyung / 'di lo mda' dpon g.yu thog pa dpa' bo'i dbang phyug de nyid chu tshan zhor nas dpon g.yog lnga bcur nye ba dpung bi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i cha shas la 'gran pa bzhin du 'dir chibs kha bsgyur/ spyir gang zag gi rgyud tshod ni sus kyang thengs par dka' mod de/ khyim pa'i ngang tshul can zhig la de dkon mchog gsum la bla mar bya ba'i dag snang 'byongs thal ba zhig yin par snang / bka' bsgo dang / byin rlabs dbos gsung ba bzhin byas/mgur dbyangs la dgyes che bas bskul bar mdzad pa bzhin/ las smon rten 'brel dpag bsam ljon thing gi steng du/ /rgya gar shar gyi rma bya gzhon nu yang phebs byung / /rma bya'i gdugs skor dam pa'i chos phyogs la bsgyur dang / /gzhon pa nga tshos thar pa'i lam sna zhig zin yong / /bsod nams dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i shing rta la phebs pa'i/ /lho mon shing lo'i tshal gyi khu byug bi gsung snyan/ /ya gi dri za'i bu mo'i gling bu las snyan pa/ dbyar gsum nam zla bsro /87

ba'i rten 'brel la yag byung //'dir 'dus las smon mthun pa'i rdo rje'i dang spun grosas/ /nga tsho'i bla ma bzhugs pa'i chos ra la phebs dang / /smin grol bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i dga' ston gyi ngang nas/ /nyam sa dga' glu ru len pa'i khyad chos shig yod do/ /bde chen 'pho 'gyur med pa'i bzhugs gral gyi dbus nas/ /lha dang bla ma'i zhal ras ma bsgoms kyang mthong byung / /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i snying tig 'od gsal gyi theg pas/ /'ja' lus chos skur bsgrub pa'i dngos grub cis zhu'o/ /zhes pa 'di ram 'degs dang bcas blangs pa yin thegs khar dbang bzhi len pa yin zhes ngos la dbu satugs nas spyan chab bsil bar 'dus /snang ba 'di slob ma tshor 'char gyi yod na nyams rtogs skye ba'i rogs su shin tu 'gyur bar gda'/ /gnang sbyin gyi gras su mar ltang che ba zhig 'dug ste/ lha sar mchod pa'i 'brel ba dang por phul/ dpal ri nas sprul pa'i sku yul rkyen gyi nyes dmigs du mas thugs dbyung nas 'khrid gsan pa la phebs/ go don chags su re nas sems nyid ngal gsos khog phub ste gsal 'debs dang sbrags sngon 'gro'i skor dpyis phyin pa nas/ dngos gzhi rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig nas rang byung gdod ma'i rgyal thabs la mnga' gsol/ rgyab chos su shing rta chen mo rtsa 'grel/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba'i snying po/ mkha' 'gro snying tig /bla ma yang til /mkha' 'gro yang tig sogs kyang song / grol thig la dbang chog sgrigs ma dgos gsung ba/gsang chen rdo rje'i lam gyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad ma lus pa dbang gi sgrom nas shes par gyur pa 'di rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi ring lugs sgra ji bzhin par 'dzin pa rnams kyi spyi nor yin/ gdams phran phar cher la man ngag gi 188

gzhung bsrang mi nus pa zhig snang na'ang / 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang don de nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni tshig nyung la donag dpag par dka' —ba rgyud sde chen po'i spyi chings kyis legs par 'khyud la rgya bod kyi grub chen rnams kyi gzhung dang mi 'gal ba/ khyad par gsang ba 'dusapa'i gzhung dang phyogs mthun pa nyid du rig pas/ bar seng rnamagasu dpal ldan medus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rgya gzhung dang / bod 'grel tshad mar gyur pa rnams la'ang rang stobs kyi dpyad pa bcug /rang lugs rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches gsar rnying gi rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang don phyogasagacig tu bkod pa gab pa mngon phyung gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba'i rang bzhin kyang nges par byas nas dbang gi cho ga mkhyen brtsechadagongs rgyan zhes bya ba de/go bde ba dang don 'du gtso bor bton nas bsgrigs/chu bo ri nas gnod sbyin yang le ber gyis bla rdo srog 'khor zhig bca' dgos gsung /gzhon nu'i dus nas tsakra bya ba la byang chub pa zhig pas paṇa chen rin po che'i gter gzhung la man ngag lag len gyi brgyan pa nyams su bstar/ de skabs gsang chen rnying ma la phyi skor 'dir bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag zhal gsal dbyings yod kyi yig gsal dkon pas de lta bu zhig cis kyang dgos zhes — thebs pa la/ 'og min bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bris nas phul ba la dgyes pa 'khrungs pa'i mchid lan/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bor bzhugs kyang sems can kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin rnam par 'phrul/ /shes bya kun gyi pha rol byon yang spros pa kun gyis rnyog pa med pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /bstan pa kun gyi sgron me lags kyang sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i 189

chos/ /mkhas pa kun gyi rtogs par dka' mod thar 'dod kun la rgya cher seng ge'i sgra sgrog ces/ /snyan grags gtam gyi 'og min zhing khyon yang / /yongs su gang de don dang ldan pa nyid/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs btegs nor bu'i drung / /zol sbyor tsam min malon khyod yon tan gyi/ /rin chen shing rta bla na mtho ba yis/ /nyer drangs ri dbang bzhin du mi g.yo ba'i/ /dad pa rgyas pas phyag gis btud de zhu/ /'og min zhing na rdo rje 'chang / /rnga yab dpal rir smyo rgyan rje/ /snyigs dus phyogs 'di'i mun sel du/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jigs med gling / /dngos gcig du ma'i zlos gar chu zla bzhin/ /bsgyur ba'i ngo mtshar dngos po mtshan dpe'i nyi/ /srid gsum legs tshogs pad+mo kha 'byed pa'i/ /snang ba mi 'gog nyin mo'i dpal gyi gshis/ /rmongs chen dug bis myos pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ /byang chub srog rtsa gcod la dpa' ba'i khur/ /'dzin la mkhyen rab bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun can/ /dri med bshes gnyen ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /snyigs dus shin tu rgud pa'i rlung nang du/ /thub bstan sgron me ming gi mthar lhung tshe/ /mkhyen brtse ye shes snang bas srid gsum khyon/ /yongs khyab mgon khyod rnam par mngon sum byon/ /gdod ma nyid nas ji lta ji snyed chos/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i rin chen be+eḍūr+ya/ /'bad rtsol sbya ngas stobs btso sbyangs ngal ba la/ /ltos min mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer lhag par 'bar/ /sna tshogs grub mtha'i blo yi zhe 'dod gzings/ /rgyal kun gsung rab chu gter cher bshams kyang / /mtha' bral dgongs pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /tshogs gnyis dpung bas thogs pa gzhan ma mchis/ /gang 'dir snyigs dus rang bzhin rtsub mos cher dkrugs /90

pa'i/ /gsang chen rdo rje'i theg mchog chos tshul bsdu ba la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yi cod pan khyod la bcings//rdo rje chos dang skal ba mtshungs shing ngo bo gcig /cod dus mtha' 'dir pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa mgon khyod yin/ /gzhan du chos kyi rigs las skyes pa phal/ /rmongs dang 'du 'dzi'i spyod pas ches cher nyams//de slad chos kyi dung sgra 'chad dang rtsom//gsal bar khyod dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i mgur/ /ro gcig nyid nas phyogs 'dir sgrog pa la/ /skyon dang 'gran zla'i go skabs srid na su/ /sku bzhi'i khang bzang rtse mor 'gro ba'i rin chen them mas ma smad pa/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa ngo mtshar tshig don bcu drug cha/ /rab rdzogs mkhyen rab ri dbang spo nas skal bzang spyod yul mkha' la shar/ /de tshe rgyal sras kun gyi bkra shis glu dang rol mos mchod/ /gang tshe legs bshad bdud ji dngar po'i skyes/ thugs rjes chags pa'i bka' drin ro bda' ba/ /gus dang spro ba'i spyi bo la son pas/ /ring du sna tshogs rtog pa 'gags par gyur/ /mkhas dang btsun dang grub pa'i yon tan bral/ /sgom pa'i myu gu le lo'i sad kyis bcom/ /mang du thos kyang 'bras bus stongs pa bdag /bsams bzhin rang gi tshul la khrel bar gyur/ /'on te rgyal kun 'dus zhal bla ma'i zhabs/ /gtsug gi nor bur thob pa legs byas kyis/ /phung po mngon mthor shes pa'i spro dga' yis/ /khyod shes gsol 'debs tsam la skyabs 'tshol bzhin/ /'chi med grub pa dpal gyi ri bo'i ngos/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang / /gsar du bsgrub pa'i 'du 'dzi brgya phrag gis/ yid ni zhi ba'i gnas las ring du byas/ /zhes pa la sogs gtsug lag khang gsar 'debs grub bstun rab gnas dang 191

bcas bzhed don 'byams klas pa bsgrub phyir lhags dgos pa snyan gsan dbab pa'i tshul du byung /de ltar chab shog gi rim pa bkod pa'ang slob dpon klus/ shes rab med la bsam gtan yod min te/ /bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med/ /gang la 'di gnyis yod pas srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes 'jig rten gyis rmongs pa'i blos dam par btags pa tsam la mi ltos par rang ngo'i yon tan gyi bye brag rgya mtsho dang ba lang gi mig rjes kyi chus mtshon pa'i gnas dam pa de dag gi rnam thar zur gyis bstan par bya ba'i slad du yin gyi/dngos kyi grags pa sgrog pa'i don du lta sa la zhig ste/ spel legs kyis tshig la rab btags kyi srad bu rgyu ba 'di rgya gar kha spu can gyis bstan bcos la sogs brjod gzhi mdzes par bya ba'i phyir na byas pa las/ don la mi gnas pa'i tshul slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ bud med yan lag dri nga rul pa shin tu mi sdug dang / /pad+ma zla ba ut+pal dag tu snyam byed pa/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyi rdzun de'i 'bras bu mi bzad pa/ /de dag de yis mngal nas 'jug pa de yin no/ /zhes sasungs pas shes so/ /ser sna g.yo sgyu chags dang snyom las dang //mngon pa'i nga rgyal 'dod chags zhe snang dang //rigs dang gzugs dang thos pa lang tsho dang / /dbang thang che bas rgyags pa dgra bzhin gzigs/ /zhes pa'i rnam grangs 'di 'jis rten pa lta ci chos pa bzang pos kyang bya dka' ba'i gnas su snang yang /chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mnga' ris la dbang ba dag yid la smon pa'i gnas ma rnar ba yin pa'i brjod pa yang yang yong ba la brten/ rang yul na grags pa don du gnyer ba'i rnam dkar las gnad du smin pa dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub /9 2

pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por/ sbyin pa'i bdag mo tsan+d+ra this rgyan gos kyi thog nas stong mchod bshams par mdzad pa'i zhar/ thel nas yang rdzong bar gyi sgrub gnas byin can ma tshang ba med par brgya mchod re dang / tshogs brgya re me mchod bcas ba'i tshogs gsos dang sbrags yon mchod tshang mas gnas 'brel byed du lhags/ nged rkang 'gros zhan pas bzhon pa la brten dbos pa'i phyir dka' ba dang du longs pa'i ngal dub kyi sgrib pa 'dag nus pa zhig yong tshod min te/ gnas rten khyad par can gyi byin rlabs kho nas lam bar tshor gnyid 'od gsal du 'char ba dga' mos byung / gzhan du na rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter ston chos gling pa'i mgur na/ sngon bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i skabs/ 'gro mgon gyi phag mo grub pa la'ang / ro gcig rtogs nges kyi slob bu gsum/ ('jig rten mgon po/ 'ban rta phug pa/ chos rje'i lhum me/)de las med pa rnam thar na gsal/ dus deng sang ro gcig dang sgom med du/ /zhal bzhes kyi sgom chen skar ltar bkra/ /nga gcig tu skal ba bzang bsams kyang / /khyod rtogs rtogs 'di yi mang lugs kyis/ /rtogs pa zhig rgyud la ma skyes dogs/ /khyed nyams rtogs ro gcig gi rnal 'byor tsho/ /zas zhim mngar dang thag gi 'jam rtsub dang / /des mtshon pa'i ngo bsrung dang mthun 'jug 'dis/ /gsung drang mdog kha yang rdzun du zad/ /don de phyir rnam rtog gi gdar sha chod/ /ro snyoms kyi gdams pa'i phrang la gshor/ /chos dang rang sems 4 zhu dag mdzod/ /ces pa 'di shin tu mad par snang / /lo 'dir phag gis sa bsko rdo slog brtson/ zhes pa ltar/ char chu sngar mi grag rgyas pas zhing ma nga po gram par brdal/zam pa phal cher shul med du song bas rdo ring mdun /93

gyi zam par slebs pa'i tshe/tsho bzhi'i rgan po bcas mi nyis brgya tsam zam shing la thag pa 'dogs pa sogs bya ba mang po brel 'dug pa kun gyis byin rlabs zhu ba dang sbrags/ bla ma grub thob phebs da cha dga' mo e yong / byin rlabs thugs rje che dgos zhes 'gag dog sa rma rgyan pad+ma la byas/ de la snying rje shugs drag gcig skyes byung ba'i mod/ chu la drag sngags so lnga pa bzlas pa'i de'u gtor/ ka ba rnams klu chen brgyad dang / gdung lcam lto 'gro'i dbang po dra bar 'brel bar bsgoms pa'i mod/ zam pa rang bzhin med par shes pa'i ngang la rten 'brel snying po dang / shis pa brjod/ nged kyi bstan pa dang /sems can la phan thogs pa zhig yin na zam pa 'di gnas par shog cig snyam du dkon mchog gsum la gdung ba drag po zhig skyes/ gzhan ngo la bden rdzun gyi dag sangs dgos pa med de rang ngo la rten 'brel bzang po zhig 'grig /mi ring bar lcags zam byang chub rgyun lam nas zham rim pa can rta khal lag do dang bcas 'bod mkhan du lhags/ rnam gling pa sogs thugs 'brel can 'ba' zhig ji sar zhag sa bgyid du stsal/ dpal 'gos lo tsā ba'i deb sngon gyi rgyus gra thang gi gtsug lag khang / lam brkyang byams pa gling gi sku 'bum yang mjal bar phyin/ nang gi rten gsum dang / mchod rten gyi bzo bkod/ gyang ris sogs khyad du 'phags pa zhib mjal dang / tā ra na tha'i rnam thar na gsal ba bzhin yar rgyab pas bzhengs pa'i grub brgya sogs la'ang rtog pa zhib tu byung / dgon khrod na dus 'khor mchod rten sogs mkhas pa'i dbang phyug byon pa'i phyag rjes mang du snang / lar paṇa chen byams pa gling pa dang / mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po gnyis ye shes 194

nang du phrad pas gsar rnying gi zab chos phan tshun du 'bul bar mdzad tshul rnam thar na thebs pas skyes bu dam pa de tsho rtsa cing drug pa la bdag gir mi mdzad pa zhig yin par snang / rim gyis thar rtser thab bsu dang bcas smon 'grub 'chi med thar pa gling gi nye 'dabs su slebs pa na/ mkhyen dpyod phun sum tshogs pa'i sprul pa'i sku rin po ches/ thar pa'i rgyal mtshan chos gos rnam gsum gyi byi byad mthong na mi mthun pa med pas sgo drung du bsu ba la byon/spyir sems can gyis mos pa tha dad cing / khyad par dngos cag la thang stong rgyal por bla ma bzang po'i phyag dang / smyon pa brtson 'grus kyi dran rgya'i dpe bzhin/ mchog dman du mas brnyas pa dang / bkur ste phyogs 'dzol bar 'ong ba'i tshul la snang ba goms par gyur pas/ tsam pa ku'i do shal gyon pa la dang ba brtas pa'i snang ba a 'thas shig ma yin mod kyi/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa'i don thugs su chud pas dmun po'i dregs pa dbyings su bzhag pa la ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa skyes/ dam pa mchog nas gsar du bskrun pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la rig 'dzin bka' brgyad kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga dngos sta nyin gnyis ma/ mchon par gnas bya'i 'khor lo thab tu spyan drangs nas sreg blugs kyi mchod pas mnyes par bya ba sogs yon bdag bsgo ba nas dga' ston la thug gi bar mtha' rgyas su byas/ dkyil 'khor de kha'i steng nas dngos sta thel ma'i dbang yang bzhed pa bzhin phul/ nyang gter phag mo khros ma'i me mchod kyi zhing skyong bi mkha' 'gro ma rnams mnyes par byas/ de nas thugs rgyud grol bar byed pa 'khrid kyi gnas la/ gsang sngags 195

snga 'gyur la mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi rang tshugs 'dzin pa'i grub pa'i mtha' khyad du 'phags pa yod pa'i steng / rgya gar gyi shing rta chen po rnams kyi ring lugs kyang zhar gyis tshang ba bstan pa la rim gyis bslab pa rgya chen spyod pa/sa lam ting nge 'dzin gyi drod tshad bstan pa zab cing rgya che ba/ chos nyid kyi tsho gnas lugs bstan pa zab mo lta ba ste/ brgyud pa gsum gyi man ngag kyang chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa rgyal ba klong chen pa'i gzhung yod bzhin du yan lag ji brgyad ldan gyi chu 'gram na ba tsha'i khron pa 'dru ba'i dpes gdams phran la sdug bcir byed mi dgos pa dge ba gsum gyi don khrid zab mos gzhung bsrangs te/ man ngag rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi 'khrid/ rgyab brten lung dang bcas pa zung du 'brel bas chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal thabs la mnga' gsol/ de ltar grub nas snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde dang sgrub sde chen po gnyis su bzhugs pa'i sgrub sde'i gtso bo bde gshegs 'dus pa pod dgu'i dbang lung ma tshang ba med par phul/ dbang la grwa tshang pa phyogs su ma 'thor ba phal cher bcas 'dus pa nyi shu rtsa lnga byung / de la 'di skad ces bya ste rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po paṇa chen rin po ches bka' brgyad rnam gsum lha'i tha ram las/ 'di 'chang 6rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /nyid mtshan dus drug 'bral med spyan gyis gzigs/ /yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtshos byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gros bu bzhin rtag tu skyong / /chos skyong dam can sprine phung bzhin du 'du/ /phyi nang bar chad sel zhing dngos grub ster/ /phyag rgya chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir rig 'dzin phyi rabs 'byon pa rnams/ /rgyud lung /96

man ngag thams cadastongs kyang spa /bka' brgyad rnam gsum nyams su ma 'jug cig /sgrub pa'i snying po thams cad stongs kyang sla/ /rdzong phrang gnad gsum sgrub grwa stongs rma 'jug /bshad sgrub bya ba thams cad stonges kyang sla/dbang khrid rgyud kyi bshad pa nyams ma 'jug /ces gsungs pa de yid me lhag par yang gcags nas gal chung chos la byed pa'i dus tshod 'dir chos kyi rnam grangs derag sngar dben pa'i ri khrod durwa ri dra'i brtul zhugs la gnas bzhin du'ang don gnyere bla rna med pas nyan cing/ de ltar nyan pa'ang 'chad spel nus pa'i gang zag la yongs su rdzogs par 'bul thub pas blo kha rdzogs pa'i tshul/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa de'i gsung gi 'phros las kyang / nang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu dgung la stor la khad la/ ble ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje dang / rang gi skye ba sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'phro mthud pa 'dis re ba'i dpal ni thob/ da ni zag bcas kyi phung po da lta rang zhig cing shi yang 'gyod med snyam pa'i blo gdeng rnyed/ dal 'byor gyis rten 'dis bstan pa rin po che la bya ba byas so snyam du blo gdeng mthong ba yang gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje 'dis dbus gtsang la stod lho byang thams cad du chos tshul 'di kho na'i don du shing lo rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du la chu phrang gsum la dka' ba spyad/ yab rje nas rim par bde 'dus kho na yang tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga gsanapa'i mthar/ lho rgyud dgon dkar zhes pa'i ri khrod du mnga' bdag kun dga' 'od zer gyi dngos slob/ rje rigs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dang mjal zhing / lan gnyis su gtugs nas spros pa yongs su chod pa yin pas so/ /rgyu mtshan de lta bus bstan rme la gces spras dang / bka' drin bsam 197

gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul snyan du sgron shing / dngos cag gis sngar dbang lung nyan klag gang gi thad du'ang / sde che sar yod pa dag nas ni dpe mkhyud dang bsdam ra/dbus rgyud spyi 'gro la ni dpe rgyun yang dkon pa kho na'i gsung gling gi nye bar len pa'i rkyen dang / dam pa'ang bstan pa nyams gso la thugs bskyed chen por gyur pa'i rgyus/ bde 'dus yongs rdzogs gsar bzhengs mdzad pa zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin/ mi ring ba nyid du phyag thog tu khel ba mig gi lam du dong zhing / dus skabs der ri mo ba chos kyi grags pa'ang zla bor yod pa nas bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbang tsag kyang gsar du bskrun pa yin no/ /tshur gter kha 'og ma'i gsang rdzogs pod bzhi rgyab chos dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che'i rig 'dzin yongs 'dus kyang nyan/bod khams yongs la bkra shis dge legs 'byung ba'i ri/ sa'i mdud lta bur yang song bas/ spyi sger kun la snod bcud kyi legs tshogs spel ba'i phrin las kyi le lag g.yang gta' bsdam pa dang / klu gta' bzhugs pa la sogs 'byung ba'i dpal bskyed kyi bca' g.yang bzhed pa bzhin bsgrubs/ rtse mo ba rnams la nyang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul gyi dbang bgyid du stsal ba'i khongs su thar rtse ba sogs phyogs gzhan gyi grwa btsun thor bu dang khyim pa 'ga' zhig bcas par thar pa'i sa bon 'debs pa'i slad/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnad du smin pa nas thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs ma ṇi'i lung dang bcas pa'i chos 'brel bzhag /snga 'gyur gyi chos tshul la log rtog dang skrag pa skye ba'i grub mtha' ltos grub tu smra ba dag gis kyang gshung bar mi nus pa rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang /98

po'i grub pa'i mtha'/ de bzhin gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i gsung gi gsang ba ltar/ thog mtha' bar gsum du dge zhing / don bzang po/ tshig 'bru phun sum tshogs pa/ ma 'dres pa/ rnam par grol ba'i yon tan rgya mtshos yongs su phyug pa gang / gangs ri'i khrod kyis mkhas pa kun gyi 'dun sar mdzes pa nyid de/snga 'gyur ba kun gyi btang snyoms chen po'i spyi nor las rkang 'dzin gyi grub mtha' don gnyer chung skabs/ dngos cag la gdod ma'i mgon po'i zhal skyin mngon sum pa de bstan nas bstan pa 'di la sri zhu nus par byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge mtshan las/ slan chad gsung rab rnams ma tshang ba med par gsan pa'i rten 'brel du rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i le'ur 'phro can du bzhag/shing rta gsum dang mdzod rtsa 'grel gsang snying 'grel pa la sogs pa rnams bdog pa gtong ba la 'phongs pa med pas gsar du bsgrub pa'i thugs 'dun rtse gcig par yang shar song ba ring po ma yin pa phyag thog tu khel/ rgya can tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel rgyas par mdzad cing /'bul nod dang bsnyen bkur gyi rim gro chen po bskyed par mdzad pa'i tshul yang 'di lta ste/ sa gzhi dang / bzhon pa dang / gos dang rin po che la sogs pa'i rnyed pa/phyag dang /ldang ba dang /stan stob pa dang /brjed pa dang /skun sled pa dang /khrus dang /bku mnye dang /dril phyis dang /spos bdug pa dang /snyun gyi gsos sman la sogs pa'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul gang yin pa dang / lo gsum gyi bsgrub pa'i dam bca' sogs mnyes pa gsum gyi pha mthar son pa nyid du mdzad/chos rje brag phug pa yang chos 'di dag yongs rdzogs kyi 199

'du bar yod pa nas mkha' 'gro snying tig gi btags grol par 'di khong gis ster bar mdzad pa rten 'brel legs shing 'gro don che bar byung / sku 'bum chen mo'i mchod mjal gyi zhar lcags zam la rab gnas byed dgos phebs pa snang sems khyab gdal du 'dres pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i thang la/ stong nyid kyis gad rgyangs sgrogs pa de ltas byin gyis brlabs pa la gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i 'bru 'thor ma dgos mod kyis/spyod 'jug las/gru dang gru chen zhugs pa rnams/ /yid la bsam pa 'grub gyur te/ /chu yi ngogs su bder phyin nas/ /gnyen dang stan cig dga' bar shog /ces pa 'di smon lam du btab nas me tog gtor/ nged ldog khar rgyal ba klong chen pa'i sku mi tshad du longs pa zhig gsar du bzhengs pa'i dbu tshugs pa dgon gnas gsar par 'khyol na rten 'brel legs sam snyam yang /gdams phran la sdug btsir byed pa'i nyi ma spyi dang mthun par shar/ 'chi med kyi grub gnas ri bo'i ngogs/ /mi lam sad pa'i gnas skabs bzhin/ /shul du zhugs pas bltar mi mngon/ /skyes thob kyi lang tsho sgeg pa'i ngogs/ /rig gnas kyi do shal 'dzin pa la/ /snyel ba mi mnga' dam pa'i gcung / /sgo 'phar mdzod ldan gyi dbang po yang / /bskyel thung la re zhig chas pa bzhin/ /yab la rnam shes mtha' yas na/ sems gnas tsam la yid ston pa'i/ /rang bzhin lta stangs kyi shes pa gang / /dri smed (med)kyi gdung ba ngo mtshar yang / /lta sgom gyi gleng mo med pas skyo/ /'chi med kyi chu rgyun 'bab pa las/ /tshang tshing dang bcas pa'i gcod rong na/ /shugs ldan gyi bzhon pa cang shes rnams/ /bsod nams ma yin pa'i skung bar bkod/ /brag ri la rang byung gi them skas can/ /200

de la rdog pa bzhag dka' bzhin/ /shugs ring dang dbugs chen 'byin pa'i ngang / /nub pad+ma dbang gi phug pa'i sgor/ /'jur mig la srad bu rgyu bzhin bgrod/ /yab rig 'dzin pad+ma'i sgrub gnas la/ /yid gdung ba'i mos gus bzod blag med/ /bu gcig po stor ba'i mya ngam gyi thang / /sems ri dwags rmas ma ltar 'khyam pa'i/ /rgan rgon gyi mthun pa'i yo byad bshams/ /dong sprugs dang tshogs 'khor yang dag bgyis/ /chu lo hi ta 'gram rgyu tsa na/ /so bya dang chu skyar rgan po'i sde/ /nya pa dang bcas pa'i sdig spyod kyi/ /rnam 'gyur mi bzad pa'i rgyu 'bras la/ /skyo shas dang nges 'byung 'gran pa bzhin/ /yul gangs ri dkar po'i grong rdal na/ /pad+mo'i ge sar las sprul pa'i sku/ /nyer grol gyi gnas su dgung 'ag bdun/ /bzhed don gyi shing rta 'dren pa'i zhar/ /tha snya da dang gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang / /bu rin chen grub kyi rjes 'brang ba /zhwa lu pa'i bshes gnyen bde bshegs snying / /cho sar ldan pa mchis pa la/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i maṇ+ḍal/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dag sbyor dang //rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya bzhi/ /gar gyi gzhi bca' nas brtsams pa'i/ /dri ba dang ltad mor g.yeng ba bzhin/ /yon tan dang khengs pa lhan cig min/ /snang ba'ang dgra ru mi ldang ba'i/ /nyan thos sngags la mos spyod can/ /tshul 'di 'dra dge ba'i yan lag go/ /skyid gshongs su grags pa'i skam po'i grong / /dar gud la mig 'phrul lhags pa bzhin/ /nyag phran gyis 'phan por phyin de'i khrim/ /zhag gnyis su re ba'i don yang bsgrubs/ /nangs par na srang gi dus sbyor tshe/ /rkang bran gyi ba'on pa'i steng 'dzegs nas//bshes gnyen grwa ston 'bar gyi gnas//skyung ka gad rgyangs sgrog par brtol/ /gnas 'gyur gyi grub mtha'i mkhan po 201

gang / /dpal rdo rje gdan pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /chos kyi gleng mo 'byams su klas/ /sang nangs par rnam sras gling du slebs/ /khrus chog dang tshe dbang bzhed bzhin bsgrubs/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos/ /ri dwags smig rgyu la 'thas pa'i ngang / /rang gnas su bde bar phyin pa'o/ /lo 'pho mtshams su dpal ri nas sprul pa'i sku rin po che phebs pa la/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs dang rig 'dzin yongs 'dus gnyis kyi dbang tshang bar song / dgun snang ba skyo shas cher brtas pa'i rgyun la dus chen zhig gi tho rangs rwa sprul de yin snyam pa'i gzhon nu sdum bag can zhig gis/ zhug chol kha dog skya chal le ba zhig sgra sgrogs pa dang snyam du/'dis lo gsar ser phreng tshar gsum song ste/sbug chol bcu tham pa'i khrod na 'di las legs pa ma byung zer/yang cung zhig bsams nas khyed 'di 'dra min tsam zhig 'ong rgyu yin pa la dkyus ma tsam las ma byung / bdud 'dul ba'i yum dang mjal/ chos mdzod zab mo la dbang mi bsgyur ba zer/ rang gi bag chags la bka' 'dus snying tig gi rgyu mtshan khong gis ma rig/yum dang phrad zer ba rtogs brjod chu zla'i de la zer rgyu yin pa 'dra snyam de khyed la sus bstan byas pas/yongs rdzogs ma mthong /de kha'i thad shog bu gcig sgrub rgyud zho rgyan lags nas bshus 'dug pa las mthong zer ba'i med/ nged kyi brtags pa la 'di 'dra shar zer/ raklu'i phreng ba spus legs la la na rgyan/ la la na srad bus mtshams bcad pa/ la la na skud pa'i dkris dkris sbrul gyi rnam par byas pa/ bcu shad la yi ge mang po khra lam lam gsal ba zhig ston pa dang sbrags/ sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i thabs la phan zer/ de kha'i mod la shugs ring zhig 'don pa dang pags/ phreng ba dum 202

bur bcad pa'i mtshams bzung nas bstan pa bgrangs pas u u zer ba'i sgras bstan/ der snang ba skyo chad de ba zhig la cang zer ngo ma dod tsa na gnyid sad/ nam mkha' la zla ba skya yal shar 'dug pa rtsa rlung gi 'du tshul zhig las srid pa bar dor slebs pa lta bu'i skyo shas shig shar/ sprus pa'i gnas chen dben pa zhig tu tshe'i 'du byed 'di gtong ba yin na blo kha rdzogs pa la snyam nas skyo glu 'di 'dra sbag spug med par thal lo/ /ngo mtshar dang a ho/ /bya rgyal rgod po brag stod mthon po la phebs dang / /rtse sgro rgyas pa'i nyams yangs gang bde ru bskyangs chog/rgod phrug skyas chen zangs mdog dpal ri la bteg dus/ //o rgyan yab yum drin can pha ma las lhag pa/ /tshe sngon 'gro don 'dzam gling rdo rjo la bskyangs te/ /da res skye sa'i rten 'brel cung zad cig 'phyugs pas/ /tsam pa ka dang thing lo rlung khyer gyi rang bzhin//bsod nams ma mthun gzhan phan 'grub pa yang dka' 'o/ /drin can pha ma glo bar ma bcags pa min te/ /khams gsum sems can pha ma spun zla ru gcis pas/ /gnas grogs 'ongs spyod dri za'i grong khyer ltar med nas/ /gcig por 'gro ba tsa na gang yong rang mi 'tshal/ /sgom po ma yin byis pa'i brtul zhugs la brtse ba/ /snang ba gtad med rang byung lhun grub kyis sashis lugs/ /lang shor mkhan zhes rgyal khams skye bo tshos ma bkyon/ /'dun ma'i gdeng tshad ma nor tsam pa zhig e yod/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dun ma dang / /rtog pas btags pa'i pher yong gnyis/ /bzang por brdzu dang gdod nas yin/ /gang yin rtsa ba chod dam kye/ /dbyar stod shin tu than pa'i gnam/ /dbyar smad chu klung chen por 'gyur/ /skom rlon khod du chi snyoms pa/ /snod kyi 'jig rten 'gyur ldo ga lags/ /gang zhig tshur la 203
