mos byas shing / /phar yang phan cher btags pa gang / /res 'ga' rnam 'gyur cir yang 'char/ /'dris la khengs shing gsar dzispro/ /bcud kyi sems can 'gyur ldog lags/ /kha sang lang tsho brtas pa'i mi/ /de ring thod pa 'breg la thug /shul mi ca co 'don panyang / /da ni mya ngan dbyings nas sangs/ /'di yang sgyu ma'i dpe cig lags/ /na ning chos dang mthun pa yi/ /bsgrub la brtson pa'i zhal ta kun//ci gsung bla ma'i bka' bzhin zer/ /da lo sdig pa'i grogs dang bsdongs//la la rang bzhin ngan las byung //la la rkyen gyis cho 'phrul can///phal cher bdud kyis dbyen bcos nas/ /rang snang 'gyur ba ma tshor bzhin/ /mi ltas tsam gyi rtsub 'gyur la/ /gegs dang rgyal 'gong 'byung ngo zhes/ /rgyu phaṭa phaṭa sgra 'byin na'ang / /rang blo gegs kyis glags bltas nas/ /rnam rtog 'gyur ba'i tshul gang yin/ /mi shes rmongs chen glang po rnams/ /grib ma sha zar 'khrul ba bzhin//lar ni bya dang mi bya'i gnas//su yis nor dang su yi yin//'phags pas min pa mi mkhyen pas/ /nged rang 'dus pa'i tshom bu yang / /so sor 'gyes chos can yin pas/ /de yi rang bzhin dbongs pa mdzod/ /sde pa spangs che ba 'chi bdag gi zhags pasasangon gyur tu btab pa la phan du re bas byin rlabs la bos pa'i zhar stag spyan la tshogs brgya dang / mchod 'bul du lhags/ ku ma rā dza'i gzim phug mjol du bskyod dus der grub chen pa spro ba chen po brtas te nged la ma dā na'i yol go bteg nas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi chos bro phul byung ba'i mod la snang ba shin tu 'gyur/ gtad med kyi ye shes gsar du 'khrungs pa'i snang cha'i nyams la 'gro ba'i mgon po ku ma rā dza zhal khyim che chung 'tsham pa la kha dog smug 'dzi re/ ol ko la zhol chung chung 204

yod pa zhig mjal/ skye ba sngon ma'i bla ma yin snyam gdung ba drag po dang bde stong gi nyams zad mi shes par skyes pa'i ngang / bu'i tshe phreng bsal ba yin gsungs nas phyag rgya ma ṇi dha rar bsgyur/rdo rje snying po'i lam la gnas skabs su dge mi dge'i rten 'brel nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i 'jug ldog kho na la 'byung ba 'di ngo mtshar gyi gnas/longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas//dbe slo nga bram ze bkron dang bshes rnams la//sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi pha rol tu/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /zhes pa 'di yid la gcasas/ tshe yang nges med yin snyam nas zang zing ma lus pa gcig tu 'doms te shrī parba ta'i gling du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung sgrogs byas/ badz+ra a dra lo gsum grol ba nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel la nai pa la'i dong tse brgya phrag dang / mar pon che tsam stob par mdzad pa 'gyed dang zhal 'debs la 'khyil ka che ba byung / dge 'dun brgya ma zin tsam gyis zhag bdun la bka' 'gyur rin po che khrol/ nyin gcig gzhin po'i 'brel pa can la dmigs nas na rag dong sprugs zhus/ thog mtha' bar gsum la 'gyed dge 'dun rer skya chen re/nyis 'thus la bsod btags/ṭa kha re phyag gtod/bsngo rten gyi gos lham nyer spyad sbams 'bul la zho re dang ṭa kha thob pa nges pa byung snang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i srog chags lta bur snang bas dgon par yang mang ja'i 'brel pa zhig nus/ skabs shig nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i ngang tshul zhi ba dang dul ba'i rnam pa can zhig bis bshes spring gi tshig don la 'grel pa mdzad pa yid la shin tu bcags pa zhig byung ba dpal mgon chen po klu sgrub zhabs kyi byin rlabs su shes/ deng sang 'di na 205

bstan pa la rim bzhin 'jug par 'dod pa dag la / blo chung zhig gis phan btags na/zhes pa ltar phal gyi skya lus ma bsgyur ba'i ngos nas chos byas pas chog ces yid gnyis la 'dogs pa mang bas/ shes ldan kha cig 'di ji ltar rung zer ba/ bstan pa'i sgor ma zhugs pa rang gis 'byor pa bcu tshang ba'i gegs byed/ sdom pas ma bsdams pa'i dge ba thar pa'i rgyur mi 'gro/ rang bi blo dang las 'phros btub phyin/ bsang sngags nyams su len pa la'ang rgya gar mkhas pa'i bstan bcos na/ sdom gsum cho ga mi ldan par/ /sngasas pa'i bdag nyid mi 'byung ste/ /zhes so sor thar pa nas bzung rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa'i bar rim can nam/ dbang dus cig car du nod pa'i rten la sngags kyi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa de lam ma nor ba yin/rgyu mtshan des deng sa nga lnga brgya'i tha ma la bstan pa'i sgo ra 'jug pa dag kyang la la ni 'jigs skyobs/phal mo che legs smon kho na'i 'dun pas 'jug pa las med pa'i dus 'dir/sde dang /bza' btung la don du gnyer ba med pa nges 'byung dang bcas pa'i blos rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul la slob pa ni shin tu phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin/ khams gsum bdag po sngar yang len brgyar byas/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan sgrong ba da res tsam/ /zhes mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dag gis bshad/phyin chad rang rgyud la bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe gnang bkag jis mtshams/ rgyal ba klong chen pa/ kun mkhyen rong zom/ zur mes dbon sogs kyis bzhed pa bzhin mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches/ de lta'i sdom gsum gang zag rgyud gcig la/ /rang ldog ma 'dres dgag dbos yongs su rdzogs/ /ngo bo gnas 'gyur yon tan yar ldan pa'i/ /gnad kyis mi 'gal dus skabs 206

gang gtsor dpyad/ /ces pa'i rgyu mtshan bo dbos byas/ sde pa pha lha sku gzhon rang dang las 'brel zab pas 'dir gtsug phud dbyung bar mdzad/ skra rten du dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang / ting lnga tshar sung bco brgyad kyis bzo rgyu las byas pa sogs mdor na snga phyir nged rnam par dkar ba'i bya ba bsgrub pa la mkho che ba'i bdog pa rgya cher brnya ra/ rjes su 'brangs pa'i gra rigs lo gsum gyi sgrub skra yod pa rnams skra 'dab ji ltar byed kyi dogs gcod byung ba/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la rtags tsam 'dzin pa'ang bstan pa mi nub pa'i rten 'brel la ltos pa yin na/ nyes spyod sdom pa ni smos ci dgos te/ dge 'dun gyi sgrigs dang de'i khrod na 'du 'tshog byed dgos pa rnams so so thar pa'i rtags dang ma bral ba ltar snang la mdzes shing / don la smar pa'i nges pa brjod pa de lags/ rje rgod tshang pa sna tshogs rang grol gyi dbon sprul/ rin po che thang 'brog pa pad+ma ris 'dzin dbang pos/ snga so ra chu pho spre'u'i lo nang nas dag snang bla na med pas gsung bris kyi snying por/ deng rnying bstan ri mo'i mar me lta bur gyur pa'i gnas ska bas 'dir/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i lung rtogs gdong lnga'i khri la rang stobs kyis 'dzegs nas snga 'gyur rdo rje'i theg pa la bshad sgrub kyi bya ba mdzad nus pa khyod cig byon pa bka' drin du che/ da dung yang chos rgyun dkon pa rnams gsan pa dang / dbul po chos don gnyer ba rnams 'bul ba la ma ltos par rjes su bzung / rgan po'ang na tshod drug cur thal ba gdams pa'i snying pos rjes su bzung ba'i phyir ngos mjal gyi smin pa thugs la gcags pa 'ig kha zhe ma yin par gsol ba 'debs pa yin sogs kyis mtshon phyag bris yang nas yang du stsal bas don tshan gnyis po yid la shin tu 207

'thad pa'ang byung / me khams 'khor lo'i sna can gyi zla ba'i phung po la dngos cag dpal chen chu bo rir dong ba'i tshe/ lha sar phebs zhar nas 'dir ched kyis gtad 'dug kyang rten 'brel 'phro can du lus pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rjes bskul ba'i tshul/ rgyal po dza zhes bya ba das /chos la las 'phro yod gzigs nas/ /zhes pa'i sta bon du snang / phyi lo 'ol dgar bka' 'gyur lja gas lung gi chos 'khor la phebs lam nas bkyogs te ched du phebs par mjal/ bla ma dam pa ni ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes nyid du 'dug /gsung gis bskul ba bzhin rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tis gi bka' gtad byin brlabs kyi tshul du phul/ yar lam cis kyang phebs pa'i dbongs gtad 'dug pa la/ kho bo cag gi bsod nams dang smon pa'i dbang nas/ re zhis chos mtshams 'jog dbos pa'i stes dbang la sa/ ji skad du mdo dgongs 'dus kyi le'u bzhi par drag shul can zhes bya ba'i ri/ dgon pa chen po'i sanas de ni/ /ye shes snying po can rnams kyi/ /theg chen sasang ba 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thog ma tha ma'i dus med par/ /dam pa rnams kyi bsngags pa yin//zhes phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i rdo rje'i gnas chen po/ skal ba'i chos can gyis 'jig par mi nus pa'i rang bzhin ni bde mchog rdo rje'i mdo 'grel las/ rtse na rtsal gyi rgyal po gnas/ /ngos la brag dkar khyi tshulas pa / /seng se gnam du 'phyong 'dras brgyan/ /rtsi sman rtsa brgyad tshang bar 'khrungs/ /'du ba'i nad kyis yongs mi tshugs/ /spyi bor ka lan ta ka ni/ /mi gnyis gcig pur gnas pa'i sgra/ /mdzod ldan de yis tshang bcas shing / /skal ldan rnams kyis bgrod par sla/ /skal med 208

rnams kyis yo ngas mi thar/ /zhes ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse mor gsang ba'i bdag pos yo ga gsum gyi chos char phab pa gang / skal ba chen po'i lcags kyus 'gugs par nus pa'i sgra las rgyal po dza zhes sam/ in+d+ra bho rnyi las brgyud pa'i chos 'khor chen bo/mdo sngags kyi lam ma lus shing lus pa med pa rdo rje'i 'gros kyi gzhung lam gcig tu tshang bar ston pa 'og min tshogs chen 'dus pa'i po ti glegs bam gyi char sngon byung gi lo rgyus dang rjes su mthun par 'chi med kyi ri bo'i spo las sa 'dir babs pa'i rten 'brel rang byung du 'grig cing / gsang sngags ston pa'i slob dpon ni dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang gnyis su ma yin pa'i rang bzhin du nges pas/ gsang ba'i bdag po dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par bzhengs pa bdag nyid kyi 'dun sar 'al mngon sum par bsta na par gyur to/ /de ltar gyur nas cho 'phrul zla ba'i chos 'khor chen po'i dus chen kyang dus kyi rgyal mos lhags su bcug pa lta bu'i thad gar 'dus pa mdo'i dkyil 'khor sgo sgrag bcu gcig gam dgu'i nges 'byed can du dbang mo che'i bdud rtsi legs par nod pa ni/ rgyal po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i spyi gcod las/ de tshe in+d+ra bho rnyi ngas/ /thugs kyi sgrub pa mngon rtogs te/ /de nyid sgo nas de nyid bsgrubs/ /smon pa'i lha dang de ru mjal/ /'dod pa'i bsam pa de ru 'grub/ /don dam bcud kyang de nas rgyas/ /zhes pa'i rjes su song ba yin/ /rjes 'brel du/ dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i kha 'gengs rje rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i skye rabs brgya pa dang /'dra 'bag chen mo/ paṇa chen rin po che'i sdom gsum rnam nges/ byang pa'i kerma gu ru/ lnga pa'i rgya can dang /gsung 'bum nang ma/rgod tshang sna tshogs pa'i gsung 'bum/209

dkar chag nang bzhin rgyud 'bum rin po che'i bka' gtad sogs chos rtsa ba chen po mang du thos pas bka' drin chen por gyur pa yin/ glang stag gi lo 'di tshor bzo gnas sprul pa'i rdo rje dharma kirtis dad pa dang kun tu don yod pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te/ dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po'i skyes rabs rnam thar shel brag ma'i zhing bkod thang chen rnams lag bstar ma byasate bris pas dngos shin tu gtsang bar grub/ rus tshugs dang rnam 'gyur gyi kho lag ma lus pa sman thang pa dang / chos dbyangs pa'i rjes su yid phyogs par gyur/ gong sham hor gos rgyan bzhi dang / gtso bo'i mthongs ding phon/ byings rnams hor gos 'khyil snam rin thang bral ba bcas sku thang 'dir dngul srang nyis brgya'i rtsa ba ma smad par yod pa'i byings che'i zhabs 'degs rje drung rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa yin/ sngon gyi tshe lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bla na med pa'i thugs bskyed grung pos mtshams sbyar/ sprul pa'i lo paṇa chen po spyi dang / bye brag 'jig rten mig gcig bi ma dang be+e ro'i zhabs/ rma gnyags la sogs pas legs par bsgyur ba'i snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu rnams/nag po'i rtsa lag gis nus pa dang / sems can gyi bsod nams dang skal ba'i dbang gis mkhas su rlom pa'i rtog dpyod can dag kyang / mdo las/ 'jam dpal gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i bka' la la ni bzang bar 'du shes/ la la ni ngan par 'du shes pa ni chos spong ba'o/ /zhes pa la ci yang mi sems par/la la ni chos kyi rnam grangs rlabs po che'i gnas la legs par mthong ba'i blo mig zhan pas skrag /la la ni 'gyur gyi khyad par cung zad kyi tha snyad la rtog cing don gyi dbyings la cang mi sems pas sngangs/ la la ni nyon 210

mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa chos su sgrogs pas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las logs su gyur pa'o zhes/ dran pa nye bar ma bzhag pa'i kun slong gis rgyud 'bum rin po che bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dbus na bzhugs su ma 'tshal/bzhugs par mi 'gyur ba'i grags pa ngan pas dbyen bcos nas rgyal ba'i phrin las chud gsan pa de blo la gdung ba'i khur du ni lci/ 'di skor la dpe rgyun yang dkon par gyur pa snying thag pa nas ma bzod par rang nyid kyi lus srog dbang thang dang bcas pa'ang thed la por te rgyud 'bum rin po che gsar du bzhings pa'i snya gon mno ba na/ dkon mchog gsum mchog yin pa'i bden pas/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po dang / slob mar gyur pa'i tshogs kyang zhabs 'desas bsgrub pa la spro ba bteg par gyur te/ skyes bu chen ngo legs so legs so/ /de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ zhes rang rang gi 'byor stobs dang bstun pa'i me tog 'thor ba la dang ba ston to/ /de'i tshe rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'jigs med gling pa ni/ rgyud las/ 'jigs pa thams cad spangs nas su/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyi ni/ /sngags pas seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /'di la mi bya ci yang med//de bzhin mi za'ang yod ma yin//smra bar mi bya cung zad med/ /rtag tu mi bsam ci yang med/ /mnyam par ma bzhag sbyor ba yi/ /rtag pa nyid du mnyam par 'jog /ces gsungs pa ltar/bdud dang bdud kyi rigs kyi bar chad dam/ klan rka'i tshogag the tshom gyi gnas gang yin pa la 'khu 'phrig gi blo skad cig ma dang por shar kyang /gnyis par yal bas bcos su med/ sems can pha mar shes kyang snying rje chen po'i blos sha khrag la tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod/ sems can bslu ba spangs nas 2/1

ni/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spyad/ /ces pa ltar/ snang ba 'di bu chung lta bur song bas byis pa'i grogs kyi dbus su mda' rtsed kyang thal/ sdig pa rlabs po che spyod pa mthong na yon gnas dang /sbyin bdag yin kyang zhe khrel 'debs/gya gyu dang bcas pa'i slob ma skal ba ngan pa'i mtshang 'dru ba'i tshe smra bar mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhi gang la'ang chos nyid kyi rtsi dang ma bral tsam la gdeng 'cha' bas/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs na mi 'grub tshad tshad kyi bya ba brtsam pa la'ang the tshom med pas lcags mo yos kyi lo'i so ka nas phyi lo'i dbyar gyi bar rgyud 'bum rin po che bzhengs pa'i bya ba mang pos brel bar gyur to/ /de la 'jig rten gyi skye bo phal mo che ni rgyud 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa las rnam thar shel brag ma jo mtshar che la/ rgyu 'gro che ba tsam du byed mod/ bsod nams bsog pa la khyad par med kyang / bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa ni dam pa'i chos kho na yin no/ /bya dka' ba'i cha nas mnga' ris la dbang ba rnams ni khral dang 'u lag bzhag pa'ang dkar po'i las la nyes pa'i phung pos 'tshe la/ dngos cag rnams ni shog las kyang rang nyams su bstar/ skyo sun gyi rnam pa dang du blangs tshe snying gar thang stong rgyal po'i sras kyi phyag rtags bzhag go zer ba'i phyag rjes zung lham mer gsal ba zhig mis/ rgyu 'gro'i cha nas bri ba'i gla thob nyid la'ang dngul srang brgya dang sum cu ma mthar bsten pas gzhan rnams shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i khongs su dad pa dang bsod nams la 'dun pas zhal 'debs kyi rnam pa ji ltar phul ba'ang 'god pa nyid do/ /sngon rgya gar na bstan pa dar ba'i skabs/ dam chos dang 'dul ba'i 21 2

gleng 'bum na/ gos phyag dar khrod pa zhes yongs su grags/ bod gangs can gyi dase bshes rin thang can/ /sham thabs la dngul srang bco brgyad tsam/ /de ma 'grig tshong dang khe spogs byung //bdagades kyang ang raka la sems pa shor/ /tshogs gral du 'jug na stod 'gag 'gran/ /stod 'gag bzang shos la rta mig ri/ /hor gos la rin thang med pas len/ /bdang/ des kyang sgom thag la sems pa shor/ /ther phrug gi rtsol bsgrub lta ci smos/ /mtha' mug ma yan chad kyi gnod pa sdang / /bdag des kyang rang gos la blo sems shor/ /grwa sa dang skya tsha zung du sprel/ /phan tshun skyong bran gyi 'dzin thag can/ /bsam sbyor yang du ma ro gcig la/ /mgon shākya'i rgyal po khrel dogs nas/ /ngas drin can gyi pha ma'ang ci bder bzhag /khar rje dang dbang thang ci 'tshal ba/ /rgyud 'bum gyi phyogs su spong dag smon/ /dus da lo sang phod tsam sgyu ma'i lus/ /mi 'jig pa'i nges pa mi rnyed snyam/ /bya bral gyi gshis tshul gyi na'i ngang / /gcod yul brtul zhugs kyi spyod par phyin/ /gnas yar klungs shel gyi brag phug gi/ /phyag 'tshal la khar 'byor tsam nas/ /snang ba 'di rang dbang med par 'gyur/ /dpal chargyan chos kyi rgyal po la/ /mos gus kyi gdung ba bla lhag 'bar/ /gsol 'debs dang smon pa drag po byas/ /dbang bzhi yang mnyam pa nyid du thob/ /lar snang ba 'gyur ba'i dad pa la/ /byin rlabs kyi pha phogs re nges par yod/ /snang ba 'gyur ba'i snying rje la'ang / /bsod nams tshad du su yis bgrang / /de rdo rje'i lam gyi gnad cig yin/ /zhing skyong gi ma mo gnas bcas shing / /bsil tshal dang mnyam pa'i dur khrod du/ /sngon 'dris shing bshes pa'i ne gu'i lus/ /rus pa'i dum bu skya khrol le/ /khrag dang chu ser rlon tshi re/ /213

dbang med du pha rol song ma thag /de mthong bas skyo shas kyi dug ro langs /rang gzhan gyi rtag 'dzin la zhe khrel skyes//spyir sems can kun la snying rje'i blo/ /sgos na gzhon du thal ba la lhag par yang / /bzod med kyi snying rje'i chu klung 'khrugs/ /gzungs sngags kyi btab nas smon pas sbyangs/ /sang nangs par sa la spyod pa'i zhing / /ri zangs mdog dpal ri gnyis pa der/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa bskor/ /don gnyis lhun grub kyi smon mtshams sbyar/ /me mchod kyis mkha' 'gro mnyes byas pa/ /dus mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i mi lam na/ /lha rdzong btsan rdo rje dgra 'joms de/ /nang dge bsnyen du sprul pa'i cha byad can/ /slar btsad po'i rnam par bsgyur byas nas/ /bza' btung dang 'bul ba'i rnam pa byas/ /de 'grog tu mdzes ma zhig na re/ /khyed dang kho mo tsan dra dpal/ /smon lam gcig pa mkhyen lags sam/ /lus ni za zhing 'phrug pa'i nad/ /grib las byung ba yin no skad/ /'jig rten log lta be chom che/ /rten 'brel phyi nang gsang ba'i chos/ /'grig la nyes 'gal mang mod kyang / /nyam nga med par tshe bsring ba'i/ /thabs la 'bad pa zhu zhes zer/ /de tsam la kun rdzob kyi gsal snang zhus/ /stong tshogs dang brgya mchod smin par byas/ /dpal bsil ba'i tshal dang mnyam pa yi/ /dur khrod du brtul zhugs rol pa'i bros/ /snang ba'i rdzun phugs cham la phab/ /mtshan mo'i thun gyi cha gsum la/ /lus sbyin yang sha khyer khrag khyer btang / /tshar lhangs kyi rten 'brel ma lus pa/ /dbu mar rlung zhugs kyi 'od gsal ngang / /'grig ma 'grig gi rtsis gdab bya ma dgos/ /rig 'dzin gyi gter ston rat+na pa'i/ /gdan sa chos lung gong 'og la/ /gcong rong gi phrang la bshar nas phyin/ /khang hrul ni sgyu ma'i lus kyi dpe/ /rten gsum ni 214

bsags pa'i nor dang 'dra/ /rmi lam gyi nang nas rmi bdo 'phror/ /skad cig la sad pa'i gnas skabs bzhin/ /rang gzhan gyi rten dang brten pa yang / /'khrul snang du ston pa'i slob dpon lags/ /da ni dge sbyor la 'bad pa zhu/ /chu mig dgon gsar bas bsnyen cing bskur/ /rat+na pa'i phyag bzor grags pa yi/ /dpal mgon ma ning la khrus gsol tshe/ /mar me la zegs ma 'thor ba'i sgrar/ /'bar ra ra zhes pa'i sgra zhig snang / /za nyal gyis khur po ci mchis pa/ /khyim bdas gis dad pas dbugs 'byin byas/ /ri yu mo brag gi dben gnas su/ /bsnyen bkur gyi dang ba tshogs su bstabs/ /rags rtsibs su grub brgya'i bris sku bltas/ /phyi nang la 'bru yi me tog gtor/ /dkon mchog ni thugs rje tshad med pas/ /dad can gyi skya ser las byung ba'i rdzas/ /ci mchis de mchod pa'i dngos por sgrigs/ /g.yo ru'i khra 'brug la sri zhu byas/ /'dod bral gyi smon pa rgya chen btab/ /dgon thang gi sku 'bum mdun du nyal/ /grwa rgan yang bza' bcas tshim par bgyis/ /chom rkun gyi mchod rdzas khyer ba'i tshab/ /gra sgrig gi sdug skad 'don pa der/ /mchod kong gi 'bul bas dbugs 'byin byas/ /phyug po'i mjal zhu ngang ma bsrings/ /nam seng la chas nas 'ongs pa'i lam/ /las 'brel la myong grol gyis 'brel ba byin//rang gnas su bde bar phyin pa'o//kong smad sde pa rgya la ba rgyal khab kyi rum nas chos bros la byon pa rjes su bzung nas zla bor yod/ /blo gros kyi sgo yangs pas rgyud 'bum gyi shog las dang do dam sogs la khur gzhes che ba byung / dgun sprul pa'i sku mchog gi dbus grwa tshang pa bco lnga skor dang / grub pa'i khyu mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor/ pha lha rje drung rdo rje snying po/ gzhug mar gnas pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bde 2/ 5

gshegs 'dus pa'i chos 'khor chen po dang / grol thig rig 'dzin gyi rtsa dbang chen mo bskur/dbang don de nyid gsal ba'i bdag 'jug dpon slob tshang mas lan lnga tsam blangs te/cho ga phyag len gyer dbyangs dang bcas pa la dag ther 'dris goms mig ltos la phan pa tshang mas dang du len par mdzad/rang lo zhe gsum pa'i tshe phreng la dmigs chu bo ri bla brang nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung dang / gsung rtsom tshigs bcad bcas gnang ba sprul sku rin po che gra bcas kyi gsungs/ ring min gangs ri'i khrod 'dir khu byug bgrod pa dang por brtsam du nye ba na bzo gnas rig 'byung gi yul gru nas rgyud 'bum bzhengs pa'i bris pa rnams slebs/bshul rings kyi mgron po zo mdog bzang ngam/bskyod pa yang ngam zhes dbugs 'byin dam pa'i 'bab stegs la bzhag ma thag so ku'i 'brug gi sgra dang por grag pas ring min nyid du rgyud 'bum 'di las du ma 'phel zhing 'chad nyan gyi phrin las dar ba'i rten 'brel du byung / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bsnyen bkur dang yon gyi mtshams sbyar te las rgyun zla ba phyed dang bzhi'i khongs su legs par 'dril/ bdag cag chog rogs pa dang bcas bcu skor gyis rgyud sde rin po che nas legs par gsungs pa'i rab gnas mtha' rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dga' ston dang bcas pa cho gar ldan pa bgyis/ gdugs 'jam zhing sta gon gyi nyin dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa 'ja'i gur rim pa gnyis pas rab tu dkrigs/ byin rlabs kyi dge mtshan la kun kyang snang ba 'gyur/gzu bo'i blo gros phra ma'i 'dam rdzab kyi gtums pa dag la thal 'gyur rnam dag rkang btegs su 'cha' bar nus pas de nyid kyi blo gros dri bral du byed pa'i dgos dbang can/ snga 'gyur gyi rgyud la rtsod pa 216

spang ba'i tshig rigs 'ga' zhig gnas skabs 'di'i brjod bya'i dam tshig tu nges pas/ ston pa mchog dang de'i bstan pa la bya ba lhag par byas pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ gangs khrod bstan pa'i rtsa lag mes dbon rnam gsum lo paṇa dang bcas pa'i sngon byung rags rim gyi sna drangs/ rdo rje'i theg pa snga 'gyur zhes grags pa de'i zab dang rgya che'i grub mtha' ma nor ba bzung bar nges pa'i dam pa'i tshogs kyi chos 'byung spel legs kyi khong du chos la sdang ba'i nyes spyod kyang byi dor byas pa'i dkar chag 'dzam gling tha gru khyab pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'ang brtsams/ rgyu 'gro'i rim pa spyir dngul sung bzhi brgyar thal ba'ang dam pa gsum dang 'brel ba'i bsngo bas rgyas btab/ lo gsar ba dang glegs bam rnams dpal ri theg pa chen po'i gling du bsu ba ser phreng gi bkod pa gya rnam pa dang bcas spyan drangs/ sngon gyi tshe 'u shang rdo'i rten du gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das gzugs kyi rgyal po chos li rnying ma shin tu mtshar zhing nges par gsung byon du grags pa'i byin rlabs can sri zhus nyam chung bar bzhugs pa la gser zangs kyi dbu rgyan phras phyug pa zhal gsor/ khyad gos kyi na bza' la sogs pas gzengs bstod/ rgyud 'bum rin po che'i kun ra dang 'brel ba'i bzhugs khang lho mon gyi yul du bskrun pa 'bad pas drangs te gtsug lag khang gi gral dbur bzhugs su gsol/ grwa tshang tshogs yongs nas nyid gnyis gsung sgrogs la bsnyen bkur rgyas pa/ bkra shes kha btags re/ ṭa kha re'i 'gyed bcas bsgrubs/ rtag tu mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa ni sangs rgyas kho na'i khyad chos su 'dug pas nyin mtshan la bzlas pa rnams a la la/gzhan rjes la thob pa'i shes rab kyang 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i 217

yo langs la sbyar tshe rtog pa'i 'du 'god du 'dug pas 'ching grol med pa'i ngang sgom la ngal gso'i dbugs 'byin thob/ khu mi'i tshes bcu pa rnams la zlum po bzhi dbang dang 'don cha'i lung byin/ 'bru'i 'bul ba byung ba rnams sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i zla thebs su sprad/ sde pa lha rgya ri pa'i gdan 'dren gyi chab shog dang po byung / lho 'brug gi yul nas bla ma rnam rgyal can dang bcas 'dus pa bco lnga skor la rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid btab/ bla ma rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa'i yongs bsngo dang sbrags lcags zam rin po che'i ljags bkod kyis gdung rten rab gnas la bskyod dgos shar/dbu rtse rigs gsum la mchod pa ci nus bstabs te thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i smon lam byas/lar kho bo skal ba mchog tu gyur pas kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la rmongs pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa dag gis mi mthun par bltas nas lhas sbyin gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'ang byung ste/ yid bzhin mdzod las/dman pa'i nor dag nyo tshong byed na yang / rang gi mi shes gzhan la 'dri bar byed/ /deng sang gang byung chos kyi lam der 'jug /rnam dpyod mig med thos bsam snang ba ldongs/ mig ldan gzhan la dri ba'i rtog pa med/ /thar 'dod skye bo mang po bdud kyis bslus/ /zhes pas snying rje ba'o/ /sgrags su chos rje brag phug pas bsnyen bkur/ me tshogs so so nas stong phrag thal ba dang mchod pas thugs dam bskangs pas/ mtsho rgyal bla mtshor mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i brda bsgyur kyang babs/ bla ma rnam rgyal dpon slob can 'dir 'brengs par/rta mgrin dang / gur drag gi dbang lung / nyung bsdus la dam can sde bdun gyi srog gtad kyang bgyis / dad ldan 'brug rnam rgyal lha sa nas nged phrad du byung 218

ba la dge tshogs rin po che'i gtam gyi spro ba bskyed de rnam thar shel brag ma bzhengs bar gdams/ de'i tshe khong ltos grwa pa zhig gi snang bar 'di 'dra bzhengs ba las mdzad brgya gcig bzhengs na don che snyam pa'i tshe mi lam du slob dpon rin po che'i dbu la gcag tor skyes nas rim bzhin sangs rgyas su gnas 'gyur ba zhig byung zer/ dmyal bar 'khrid pa'i ded dpon zhig theg pa chen po'i gang zag la log par lta ba 'di yin no/ /chos rje brag phug pas gar dril dngul gyi dang mchod ka li cha/ rten bzhengs kyi rgyur gser btul phon cher la sogs pa'i bdog pa stobs/ sa der mi lam du ston rtsa sbug tu grags pa'i btsan des stag lhags kyi 'bul ba dang sngon gnas 'ga' zhig bshad/ chu bo ri nas rta khal gyi bsu ba 'byor bas nged dpon slob tshang ma lcags zam byang chub rgyun lam du kun tu bzang po'i chos 'khor la 'grim/ rdo rje sadan pa'i rnam thar gyi rgyus dgon gnas rten gsum la zhar bltas byas/mkhyen brtse chen mo'i bzo gnas kyi mig la ngo mtshar gyi bdud rtsi drangs/ yab lar sleb gra dge rgan em chi rig gnas dbang po chibs bsu la byon/bla brang yang steng nas rol mo'i bye brag dang bcas pa'i bste stang kyang mdzad/ grwa tshang par mang 'gyed 'char can ma byas/ 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' ba dpal bsam yas pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i gsung rab las ngal gso skor gsum/ mdzod bdun rtsa 'grel/ gsang ba snying po/ 'grel pa phyogs bcu mun sel rnams 'gog lam gyi bden pa la bshad pa'i ba dan g.yo bzhin pa'i lung bklags/ spyir theg mchog mdzod sogs rin po che thang 'brog pa las brgyud pa dang / shing rta chen mo sogs gnas brtan kun bzang 'od zer las 219

brgyud pa'i rim pa yod de/ kho bo las brgyud pa 'di ye shes kyi sku lan gsum bstan/ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba'i de ma thag so sor rtog pa'i shes rab dang rtogs pa mchog gi snod du gyur/ rig 'dzin pad+ma dang ḍāk+ki ma'i brda ris las dam pa chos kyi mdzod klong rnyed/ brgyud pa'i chu mgo gangs la thug pa lags so/ /slar bla grwa yongs rdzogs la gshin rje tshe bdag gi dbang gong sa lnga pa'i yig cha btsan par byas/ sku 'khor nyung bsdus la lung yang ba gas/lar nged kyi grub dbang dam pa la nyan dus mchod rten bcas chog skor la'ang dri ba zhib tu bgyis pas man ngag gi gnas 'di la gangs ri'i khrod tsam na khong pa lag len nyams 'og tu chud pa'i tshe bdag dpa' bo rang du snang ste/ de'i rgyus blo la chub par byung yang kho bo'i kun rtog drag po mngon spyod kyi las la lar mi spro bas g.yel/ shrī nā tha'i zhal snga nas/ 'di'i lag len rgyun gya tsom pa byung na/'dra cog la dpyad pa 'jug go zhes kyang gsung /de skabs rmi lam na/skyes bu gos dkar lcang lo g.yo ba zhig gis nged la dung zhig byin nas/ 'di las chung tsam zhig sprul pa'i sku la'ang phul ba yin te khong mnyes pa'i bar skabs mi 'jug zer/ rgya can las bzhi lha mo dang / lha chen/ tshe ring ma sogs kyang phul/phyi lo'i so ka rgyud 'bum rin po che yongs rdzogs nyan thub pas skal ba mchog tu gyur/gser dngul srab ther la sogs pa'i chos yon kyang bstabs/'phags yul ba rnams/ jo bo shākya mu de'i bzhugs khri la gtad nas/ khri 'di la bzhugs pa'i ma hā mu ne de bod kyis thob/ de'i zhal mthong tshad ngan song mi myong zer skad/ bod blo dred drags pas zhal lta ba'ang mi brtson/ mnyam bzhag gi rang ngo na sangs rgyas mthong ba las kyang rang sems ngo shes pa 220

dga' ste chos sku'i go 'phang shes rab kyi phyogs pha rol tu phyin pa gcig gi rjes su 'brangs des so/ /rjes thob la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po ni spyod pa'i phyogs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las 'byung ste/ dbang po yul la sad pa'i tshe thabs 'di khyad par 'phags pas lha sar jo shāka rnam gnyis kyi zhal blta ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhu ba la ched du gtan nas phyin/gser chab/ kur me/snyan shal/ gser sil ma'i me tog gtor bas sna drangs/yan lag bdun pa dang / ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i brjod pa gsum gyis smon pa dang / 'jug pa dang / gnyis ka ches brtan pa nyid thob/ de'ang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri med 'od zer gyi bka' drin las cho ga tha dad pa ltar sbyar ba'i ldog pa tha dad pa gsum/ brjod pa gsum gyi tha mar smon 'jug ngo bo gcig tu skye ba'i blo rdzas gcig /dus gcig /byed pa gcig pa'i go don yang nyams su myong / de ltar kun rdzob cho ga la brten pas don dam mtshan nyid sgom stabs kyi 'thob pa'i tshul/ rang bzhin zer ba'i cod pan gdags pa'i gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po mnyam yangs phyogs bral chen po'i klong na spong gnyen med par gdeng du gyur/kho bo'i rgyud la byang sdom yar ldan du gyur pa'i gnas skabs nas rgyal ba'i myu gu mkhyen brtse'i lha zhes ming byin gyis brlabs so/ /rjes chog tu smon lam gyi rgyal po bzang po spyod pa dang / 'jug pa la rjes dran du slob pa par phyin drug gi ngo bo rgyal ba ma pham pa'i rjes su 'brangs/gu ru lha khang du tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa bskor/zhag gsum gyi bar la don du gnyer bya rnams grub/ 'brug rnam par rgyal bas zhal gdams shig zhu ba la/ gnas chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa ru/ /skyabs 221

mtshungs pa med pa'i jo shāka mjal/ /gser sil ma'i me tog sku la gtor/ /zhal gser gyi byugs pas snum par byas/ /don dor ba med pa'i smon lam btab/ /ma mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i tshogs 'khor bskor/ /blo 'khun pa med pa'i mgur glu 'then/ /deng 'dir tshogs dam tshig dag pa'i 'khor/ /las zin pa med pa'i 'khor ba la/ /blo a 'thas zhen chags ma che bar tshong 'dus kyi 'gron po gyes pa bzhin/ /lus longs spyod 'dus byas kyi mtha' ma soms/ /phral 'du 'khod dang phyi tshig 'jig rten gyi/ /yong rnam thar spyi mthun lags mod kyi/ /de kho na mdun ma'i rtser ma 'dzin/ /tshe snga phyi dang las 'bras kyi 'dor len la/ /donayang dag gi gzhig pa ma bcug na/ /dpe gru rdzing zhig pa'i ded dpon bzhin/ /dus lan cig thob pa'i mi lus 'di/ /stong zad du e 'gro mdo bsam thong / /lar 'chi mkhan ni gnam sa'i rdul phran tsam/ /'gyod med du 'chi ba gcig las nyung / /don de phyir blo sems nang du khug /phral chos gzugs dang zab zab ma byung yang / /las mi dge bcu la dgra bzhin gzigs/ /dkon mchog la blo snying brang gsum thod/ /sems bsam pa bzang po'i spyi tshig 'di/ /mi skye bo rang dga'i byang chub sems/ /rjes 'brel du gzhan la 'tshe ba spongs/ /skyabs 'gro dang yig brgya yan lag bdun/ /phyag 'tshal dang bskor ba mchod 'bul sogs//tshogs gsog gi dge ba rgya cher 'gungs//sngags lam la bskyed rdzogs mthu che yang //khyim gnas kyi lam du longs pa ni//dpal ldan 'byor pa'i dbang po tsam/ /(in+d+ra ri rnyi)/ /'on kyang mos pa lam 'khyer la/ /nu/tha' bkag pa'i gnas skabs ci zhig pas/ /lha sngags dang chos sku'i lam 'khyer la/ /rnam kun dran pa brten kyang 'tshal/ /khyad par mos gus 222

bla ma'i lam/ /byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang / /'brel bar gsol 'debs snying po 'don/ /zhing khams spyod la brtson yang 'tshal sems can gyi las mtha' tshad med pas/ /snang tshul dang spyod pa risas mi mthun/ /de kun la phan bde'i bsam sbyor dang / /mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs sbyin btang yang 'tshal/ /dge ba rgya mtsho'i srog shing ni/ /sems bskyed dang bsngo smon btsan po ste/ /sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' khyad 'phags 'dir/ /rnam kun bdag gir mdzad kyang 'tshal/ /blo tshod dang mthun pa'i snying gtam 'di/ /gnas dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sa ru/ /'brug rnam par rgyal ba dad pa can/ /rgyud rang bzhin 'jam pa des bskul ngor/ /gtad med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /grong tshig dum bur bcad nas bkod/ /gzhan snang dge la 'gyur bar shog /lam zhor la kun mkhyen chen po'i sgrub gnas brag dmar zang yag nam mkha'i rdzong du mchod 'bul dang /tshogs brgya/me mchod/rdo rje'i glu la sogs pa byas/chu 'gram 'di lta bur sdig spyod kyi bur mi skye ba'i smon lam btab/lcags zam gyi sku 'bum chen mo cong bar rab gnas bskyar dgos gsung ba cho gar ldan pa byas/ sgom don skor la dri ba le tshan du bcad pa gnang ba bsam byung gi shes rab dang mthun pas lan btab/ gangs dkar du rkun po'i rkang pa bregs nas ring po ma lon pa mthong nas snying rje dpag tu med pa skyes shing myong grol dang lto rin byin/ 'di dag rang spyod kyi lan zhes smra mod/ de lta na dmyal ba pa rnams kyi dang po las de'i rgyu bsgrub pa'i spyod pa mthong na zhe khrel ba las snying rje'i yul du cis 'grub/ yar mdar drung yig gis bskul nas bya sa lha khang gi gnas yig brtsam par khas blangs kyang gnas 'dzin pas bdag 223

po e byed mi shes snyam nas btang snyoms su lus/pad+ma 'od gling du slebs phral 'brug pa bla ma'i myong grol bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa btsugs/ khong la sman dzasgrub kyi lag len legs par bslabs/ bla mas ba so dang li 'khar sogs las grub pa'i a tsa ra'i nyer spyad sna tshogs kyang phul/ gtsang rgyang ru dpal sdings rje btsun mar dge ba gsum gyi don khrid dang 'brel ba'i 'khrid bstan pas sngar khong rang gi yab la mtshan nyid pa'i bla ma zhig gis khyed rnying lugs mdzad nas mkhas pa klong chen pa'i lugs mdzod/ de slob dpon pad+ma dang mnyam byas kyang chog /lhag byas kyang btub gsungs song ba de 'di yin par skad/shing rta lo gsar phral sde pa lha rgya ri ba'i rta bsu ba drung 'khor can byon/ chad dkar rdzong dpon chu skor bas rdzong du bste stang mdzad/ dga' ldan lha rtse'i gzim chung chen mor zhabs drung lha phun tshogs dbang phyug dpal 'bar dang mjal 'dzom mdzad/ de nyin 'grub sbyor gyi rten 'brel khyad nas tshe dbang zhig dgos gsung ba phul/ khu bo zhabs drung dga' ldan 'jigs med dpal bzang gshegs nas zhag lnga pa'i skabs/bdun tshigs dang po dang bstun pur gyi mdun du sbyong ba dang gnas spor lam bstan yang bgyis/ bsngo rten 'bul spam dngul srang lnga bcur thal ba'i dngos po'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/zhabs drung khri pa dang nyin re bzhin zhal rgyas/ khrus chog /byang 'grol/ tshe dbang / rjes gnang / dbang ma'i rigs bzhed pa bzhin phul/ zhabs drung mkhyen rab kyi sgo yangs pas bar dang bar mtshams thams cad chos kyi gleng mos 'byams klas/ phyag mdzod chen mor sa brgyad dbang phyug ngal gsos po rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa'i rten phywa rten nor bu'i lugs rin po ches 224

phyur bur bltams pa'i gter bum dang bcas pa'i bca' ga shin tu rgyas pa/yul dang yul phran rnams su sba rgyu'i bum gter brgya dang lnga bcu skor rnams bsgrubs/ sde dpon gyi gtor bzlog phal cher khyi zan rol bskyel du 'dug pa khyed dpon slob nas khro rol zhig thugs rje che na gsung ba/ nged dben pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ba nas gtor rgyag gi rigasal mi spro bas bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgo nas zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg khri char thal ba la zhal bsgyur/ gzhan yang chos skyong gi rten 'dzugs sogs dang / rtsom pa sna tshogs kyis gsung ba rnam g.yeng za nas dang du ma blangs pas thugs rangs pa'i mthar son pa med/ nyin cig rdzong rnying gzim chung gsar par rab gnas dang 'brel bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston la/ sa'i snying po gseg ma dang / bzhu btul can/ mar ltang / srab ther/ snam phrug la sogs pa'ang gnang / rten gsum/ mchod cha/ rol mo/ mi rabs su gson par grags pa'i klu'i gzugs brnyan rnams kyang mig gi spyod yul du mngon par mdzad/ grol tig gi rtsa dbang rgyas pa rang lugs dang /klong chen snying thig dbang lung tshang ma gsan/ de dag dang bstan bcos gsar bu phal mo che'i dpe rgyun yang bsgrun gsung phyi mo ni bzhes/dkor mdzod la ma byin len byas pa'i skyebo zhig rgyal khrims kyis gzir ba la/snying du rje ba'i zhu 'phreng sprang rtsi'i ro ltar dngar bas nongs pa chags te bde ba'i gnas su dbugs 'byin byas/ sku sger so so'i gzim chung du'ang bsnyen bkur 'bul nod la longs spyad/ gshegs rdzongs gnang skyes gya rnam pa dang / rnam rab yong steng nas lo ltar 'bru khal sum cu tham pa'i 'dzin tham gdang ba/ mi ser bskyel 'dren ring bdag la 225

brten nas gzhan dag mnar ba'i nyes dmigs dran pas ldog par zhus kyang /'di res phebs nan gyi khyer dgos shar/de lo nyid du 'dzin tham de ni bor/bshes springs las/ 'dod pa rnams ni phung bkrol bskyed pa ste/ /thub pa'i dbang pos skam pa'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/ /de dag spong bgyi de yi lcags sgrog gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar 'jig rten 'di dag bcings/ /zhes pa la blang dor nus na bya ba'i dus la rang bzhin gyi bab/ sde pa gleng gzhi'i dkor la rgyun chags su spyod pa'ang spyir rnam smin lci la khyad par 'gro ba'i khams dang kun rtog 'gyur bcas yin pa'i phyir bsnyen bkur la brten nas khro chags dang 'khon du 'dzin pa 'phel ba'i rten cing 'brel 'byung rang bzhin med par dag pa de kha'i ngang du bzhag /rgyal po'i khab 'dir mtshan nyid pa'i dge bshes shig na re/ rdzogs pa chen po lta ba kun gyi yang rtser byed cing / lta ba mtho bar byed pa'i ngo bo la zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang khyad par ci lta bu yod zer/ lar skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i lta ba brjod byas gtan la mi phebs/ brjod don dngos la'ang mu bzhi'am/ mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i lta ba ni dbu ma'i kyang bzhed don mthar thug tu byed dgos/lta ba'i chos nyid shes byas gtan la dbab pa'i tshe spros bral gyi khyad gzhi 'di la phu ma gtugs na khyad chos bsgrub dka'/ sa paṇa gyis/ pha rol byin pa'i spros bral las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod gyur na/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes gal 'dzugs pa'ang der mad/ 'on kyang spros bral de'i dgongs pa len phyogs la 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis/ skyes bu'i blo stobs so sor dgag sgrub tu shar nas sgra ji bzhin pa dang ldem dgongs kyi bsgrub gas ni khyad par shin tu 226

che/ spyir mtshan nyid pa tsho ni/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ la sogs pa'i tshig la go bas dpyad pas don thog tu phra yas/ rnam shes kyi rtog pas ye shes dang rgyab 'gal/ phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong pas rgyu mtshan gshis kyi thog tu ma khel/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sems can gyi khams la shes byar mi srid snyam du rtog cing grangs med gsum gyi mtha' la ltos 'cha'/ nged rdzogs chen pa ni nye ba'i snying po'i rgyud las/ bsam gtan byang chub don la gang 'jug pa/ sgom mo snyam pa'i nad kyis zin ta re/ /bde gshegs yul ni tshig gi mtshon du med/ /sangs rgyas yul du bstan pa 'khrul pa'i lam/ /zhes pa 'di dang / chags bral gyi rnam pas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /ces pa 'di don la sbyor skabs/ ngo bo la mtshan nyid med pas zab/ rang bzhin la bsam du med pas zhi/ rtag chad kyi mu la ma thug pas spros bral/ chos nyid la bral thob spangs pas 'od gsal/ rtog dpyod kyi shes bya las 'das pas 'dus ma byas pa ste/ lam dus su bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu dang / bla ma ye shes kyi spyod yul can kho na'i rten cing 'brel 'byung gi byin rlabs las yin tshul rig thob/ tu ngo sprod pa yin/ de gnyis kha phyir dang nang lta'i khyad par ma mthun pas bsam tshod dang bshad tshod mi mthun pa 'ad byung ba yin byas pas/phyag rdzogs hwa shang dang mthun zer ba'i phyogs snga de khong gi blo yul du ram me 'dug pa shes te 'di skad smras/ chos kyi dbyings dge sdig spang blang las 'das pa'i chos nyid thad drang du ston pa'i skabs/ yum las kyang / stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed med/ rnam par 227

shes pa med/ ces pa 'di la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab blang byar ngos gzung ba dang / spang bya la dor ba gang yang med/ hwa shang gi 'dod pa yin zer nas tshig gi lam du sgro btags mang po 'dren pa de dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i 'dod pas dgag gzhir byas pa yin na ni/ klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa dri paṃ kā ras 'di ltar bkral te so sor rtog pa'i shes rab de nyid kyang ma grub ste/ dper na shing gnyis phan tshun drud pa las me byung ba'i rkyen gyis shing gnyis po tshig cing med pa'i rjes la gang gi bsreg par byed pa'i me de nyid kyang rang zhi ba de bzhin du rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi ngo bo thams cad med par grub tsam na/shes rab nyid snang ba med cing 'od gsal ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pas/bying ba dang rgod pa la sogs pa'i skyon du gyur pa thams cad bsal te/ bar skabs de shes pa cir yang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin/ dran pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad spangs te zhes pas sgom rim gsum ni rab tu gzhar/ rtsod bzlog las/nga la khas len med pas na//nga ni skyon med kho na yin/zhes pa la sogs pa'i don chos nyid la lung du ma bstan pa'i gnod byed gang gis gegs byas pas hwa shang gi rgyal ba'i bka' rdog dril byas pa de khas rtags ma grub zer/ 'di yang dpyad par bya ste/ de nyid rgyal ba'i bku' la tshad mar mi byed pa mu stegs can gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i gtan tshig e yod/ yod na sangs rgyas phal po che la sogs pa'i gsung rab hwa shang gi blo la bzhugs shing /don la rtog pa ni chos dbyings ma bsgyur ba'i gang du sba sang shis lo tsā byas te hwa shing gi blo las phal chen bsgyur ba'i dpang po yod pas so/ /yang khyed rang rnam pa yid la mi byed pa'i chos skad la log par lta bzhin du 'brug pa 228

kun legs grub thob tu 'dzin gyin 'dug pas de nyid kyis/ bsam yas su hwa shing chen po'i gzhung thams cad yum gyi glegs bam la khungs bcol bar 'dug pas/ phyogs snga mdzad mkhan tshos phyogs snga ma longs sam/ yum sher phyin 'khrul na ni ma shes/ gzhan slob dpon ka ma shī la ni dbu ma rang rgyud par 'dug pas/de'i grub mtha' rnam dag yin min jo bo dge ldan pa la 'dri ba zhu lags/ zhes bris 'dug pas so/ /de yang bdag lta mchog 'dzin yin zer na/ jo bo'i cig char 'jug pa na/bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes kyi ci yang mi gzigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ye shes kyi yul mi mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes klu sgrub kyi gzhung drangs pa la ltos/lar sba bzhed nas de ltar bshad pas zer na/ chos 'byung dang rnam par thar pa tsho mnyam pa nyid kyi blo can la dag snang dang nges shes skye phyir ni rung la/ gzhan du na gzu bo gzi bor byas pa'i dpyad pa dgos pa'ang med mtha' mi khegs/ gal te de ltar yin du chug kyang chos ni tshig la mi rton don la ston pa blo mchog rnams kyi khyad par yin pas kun rdzob la mi rton don dam la rton pa'i phyir/ dgongs pa can dang nges pa can gang yin dpyad dka'/ grub pa'i skye bu mchog gi ltar snang thams cad sgra ji bzhin par 'dzin na/mi las/mtho mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shed nas/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal rdzun mkhan/ /chos drang don gyi bslu brid gsungs gsungs nas/ /nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med/ /ces pa 'dis chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la skur ba btab par ye 'gyur/ de bzhin du mkhas grub chen po dag gis dgos pa'i slad du khri brgyad stong pa 'phongs stegs su bcug pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod pas so/ /don dam par lta ba'i gnad 229

gang tshad ma dang / gang cig shos rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho nas mkhyen gyi gzhan gyis ma yin pas rang nyid gang la yid ches pa de skal ba dang bsod nams kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /lar brjod bya 'di'i snying po'i brjod don la rtog dpyod phra mo'i shes rab zhugs ma zhugs kyi khyad par las mi 'dug pas de'i rang bzhin kho bo cag gi bzhed gzhung / glang chen rab 'bog las/ sems lnga skyes pa'i skyes bu'i thugs/ /lam gyi ngo bo rgyud yin pas/ /thams cad ma lus rdzogs par byed/ /dpyad du med par go ba ni/ /dbang po non po'i spyod yul te/ /snang srid chos rnams ma lus pa/ /byang chub snying por gtan la 'bebs/ /dpyad du yod par go ba ni/ /dbang po rtul po'i spyod yul te//dpe don rtags dang gtan tshigs kyi//yid ches nges shes skyes par ston//dpyod pa zhugs pa rtog pa'i gzhi/ /rtog pa zhugs pa dmigs pa'i rten/ /dmigs pa zhugs na 'dzin pas bzung / /'dzin pas bzung phyir grol mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos rnams thams cad sems can sems su 'dus/ /sems nyid nam mkha' la gnas te/ /nam mkha' cir yang mi gnas pas/ /de phyir dpyod pa'i bya byed bral/ /byar med bsam bral brjod 'das rtogs/ /dpyad du yod par dngos zhen pa/ /mu stegs rtag par lta dang mtshungs/ /dpyad du med la zhen 'thas pa/ /mu stegs chad par lta dang mtshungs/ /mtha' gnyis gol sa bcad pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pas phyogs gcig zhen mi bya/ /zhes pa 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa sgra ji bzhin pa yin/ /des spyod phyogs khyad du bsad snyam na/ sems kyi sde las/ ma bcos rnal du bzhag pa der//theg dman rtsol bsgrub kun 'dus te//'og ma'i byang chub de la rdzogs//230

zhes pa 'di gnad zab mo yin/ dge bshes mtshan nyid pa'i chos skad khyad du 'phags par snang yang 'di'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog rang mi ma khyen pas lan pa 'dra smras/ yang bka' brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dag la/ lha klu'i ka gdung / gza' skur gyi gral phyam la sogs pa'i rdzig na mi jig na byas pa lta bu la dgos don gang yod zer/ gsar ma rnams la'ang / drag po dang / dbang phyug la sogs pa 'jig rten na mthu che zhing dbang btsan pa rnams zhabs kyis brdzis/ dus kyi 'khor lo sgra gcan gyi stan la rnam par bgyings nas/ nyi zla gza' skar la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi dbus na brngams na ma brngams na byas/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi chos skad zab mos 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi dkyil 'khor nyag gcig tu rdzogs par mdzad pa la dgos don gang yod/ de dag la sbyang gzhi spyod byed sbyangs 'bras rnam par dag pa yod zer na/ 'di dag la'ang dgos pa dang / 'brel ba dang / don khyad par can la dag pa sbyor ba'i khyad gzhir bkod pa yin te/rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ gzugs khams ma lus dbang du bsdu ba dang / /drag po'i lha brgyad nga rgyal gzhom pa'i phyir//lha brgyad rol pa'i gzhal yas rmang du bting / /gti mug mun tshogs ye shes bskyed pa dang / /byol song klu rnams dge la gzud pa'i phyir/ /klu brgyad bzung nas khang pa'i gdung du bris/ /'dod khams ma lus dbang du sdud pa dang //phyogs mtshams srin po dregs pa gzhom pa'i phyir//rgyal chen phyogs skyong rnams kyi cig pa byas//sku bzhi dpal brgyad tshang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi bzung nas ka gdan byas/ /theg pa'i khyad par gzhan las dpag pa'i don/ /glang chen ka la pi sa ka gdan byas/ /gling 23/

bzha'i mi rnams dgos 'dod bskang ba'i phyir/ /gza' skar mig tshags byas pas 'gyur ldog med/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ /seng ge ka la sha yis ka gzhu byas/ /'khor ba'i gcong rnying gnas nas sbyang ba'i phyir/ /seng ge'i kha nas bdud rtsi'i 'o ma 'dzag /thod rus bar khyams gnam lcags gzer gyis brgyan//zhing chen bla bre rnga yang 'phan gdugs dang //thugs rje'i byang sems kun tu khyab pa'i phyir/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i rgyan bcas gsal bar ldan/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /khong ngos cag gi grol tig la dag snang che tshul gyi lam 'bring po'i lung zhig nyan song / de yang blo gros gsal ba'i rtags ka yin/rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal gdams shig dgos zer ba/dngos dang rdzu 'phrul gyi ngag gang yin yang rung bar byas pa 'di bris/ yod med mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhag gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ /gting mtha' bral ba'i ye shes la/ /rtag dpyad med par phyag bgyi'o/ /gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dgongs pa ste/ /tshig gi lam la khyer so mang / /zung 'jug gnad 'gag mkhyen lags sam/ /snang dang stong dang mi rtog gsum/ /tha dad gcig la gcig 'brel gyi/ /zung 'jug 'chos pa'i tshig gi mdas/ /don gyi 'bem la snad pa dka'/ /chos nyid gzhi med rtsa bral gyi/ /snang ba'i yul la gos ma myangs/ /tshul 'chos gegs las rang grol ba'i/ /dbu ma'i gnad 'gag mkhyen par mdzod/ /'khor 'das blo yi byas pa'i chos/ /smra bsam brjod med ngo bor grol/ /rab tu mi gnas dbu ma'i gnad//spros bral ye shes nyid la'o//mdor na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs//rtag chad gdon dang 'grogs pa med/ /yin lugs tshig lami re ba//rdzogs pa 232

chen po'i grub pa'i mtha'//zhes smras/'di dag shes ldan wa gijos//tshig las ye ge'i lam drongs zhes/ /nan gyis bskul ba'i 'phros don lags/ /'di lo'i rnyed pa rnams nas srong btsan bam sor bod khams bde thabs dang / stod hor gyi kha gnon la dmigs dpal o rgyan chen po'i snang brnyan skyes bu'i lus tshad nyis 'gyur tsam yum dang bcas pa bzhings/ /bzo gnas rig pa'i dpyad nyams 'og tu chud pas zhal skyin gyi 'bur kyong thams cad la phri bsnan gyi bkod pas 'doms/ tshig bdun ma'i byin 'bebs rtag tu bgyis pas bzo sgros gtsang bar byon/ zhal gser lan bdun gsol/ 'phra rgyan rang la'ang dngul srang lnga bcu'i rtsa ba ma smad par yod/ gong sa lnga pa'i thugs bskyed las po ta la'i gzungs par gsar rnying ris med du tshogs che bas shog bu bcu ldeb brgya la nye ba btab/gu ru'i snying po 'bum ther lhag bcas/yig drug khri phrag mang po la sogs pa chos sku'i ring bsrel/ma skyes dgra'i rten skal las 'phel ba'i yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel rnyed par dka' ba mang po bcas rnam pa bzhis phyur bur gtams/sku gsung thugs rten rgyu dang byin rlabs kyi 'phags pa'ang bzhugs gnod sbyin bang mdzod kyi bca' ga dang bcas pa rang gis lag bdar/ chog rogs pa bco lnga skor dang bcas dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i rab gnas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa legs par bsgrubs/ rab ston len mi spyi mangs la ṭa kha re dang bsod btags re bkyes/ bzo bo'ang shin tu mgu bar byas/ bzang gos las grub pa'i na bza' dang mchod rdzas/ dkar yol stegs bcas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal phul ma/ rgya dril rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang bcas pa'i sku'i 233

nyer spyad kyang phul/mdo mangs pod chen nyi shu tham pa btang ba chen pos rang gir byas pa'ang kun dga' ra ba dang bcas sku'i nye logs su bzhugs/gtsug lag khang 'dir mchod pa'i rgyun med pas / gzhis ka nas 'bru gtsang khal sum cu tham pa dang / rang nyid kyi dngul srang lnga bcas mchod me sdong gcig gi thebs sbyar/ rgan po'i ngag bgros la byi dor byas pa'i gnas yig cig kyang sngon nas brtsams/ sbyin pa'i yan lag tu lug lnga'i srog bskyabs/rgyal chos mdzad kyi klong chen snying thig gser ma bzhengs pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ dgun sprul pa'i sku rin po cher tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang / bde 'dus lung cha tshang / bla ma gsang 'dus rnams song / lug lo 'dir dbus gtsang / lho 'brug /khams kong sogs sna tshogs 'dus pa bco lnga la 'khrid btab pas/ bo dong gling rab 'byams pa 'di dag gi dbus na gzhung lugs la thos bsam che shos rang du snang ste/ sems man ngag gi lugs su mtshang btsal nas rig pa bcar phog tu ngo sprod pa'i tshe mi slob pa'i zung 'jug la sogs pa'i chos skad tshon pos khong mgo 'khor shos su byung / de la kho bos/chos rje bo dong pas zhi byed la sogs pa'i chos skad la dgag sgrub mdzad par a narnyas/ phung 'di stong zhes rtos na'ang byang chub sems dpa' de/ mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang ni 'gal/ zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyi blo'i rtog pa bsal/smra bsam brjod med kyi don la rjes dpag gtan tshigs kyi gzhig 'brel mun khung sbar chod kha phyir bltas kyi dpyad sgom dpyod byed kyi mkhan po'i thog tu gzhi rtsa bcad pas phan pa rgya chen thogs/ lar ku su lu pa'i sems 'tshol 'dis 'khor 'das kyi gyes 234

mtshams ba lang rdzi bo'i rig thog tu'ang bcar phog tu ngo 'phrod pas sa ra has/ mkhas pa thams cad bstan bcos 'chad pa na/ /lus la ye shes yod pa ma rtogs so/ /zhes gsungs de mad/ de lta na'ang lta ba lung rigs dang 'brel ba/ sgom pa nyams myong dang 'brel ba/ spyod pa dus tshod dang 'brel ba/ 'bras bu gzhan don dang 'brel ba zhes bya ba yin pas rmongs pa lam nyes nas 'khrid pa la/lam ston gyi bla ma de spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa dgos te/de ma byung na sems gnas stug po'i sgom tsam kha ba'i 'og gi 'bar 'bur dang 'dra ste gang yin shes pa dka' 'o/ /dus 'di tsam na dpal tshe ring ljongs kyi sgom grwa 'dir/ lo gsum 'dag sbyar ba rang brgyad dgu tsam/ gzhan lhags skyobs dang / cog pu sogs la brten pa'i bya bral gyi dge 'dun rnal 'byor pa rnams sgom sgrub shin tu 'phel/ mtshan mo'i cha la'ang thun gsum du bcad pa'i cha bar ba la gnyid log /cha gnyis po dge sbyor gyi skyong ba'i steng 'grus la slob phyir/ thun tshod pa dmigs bsal bskos/ thun brda'i rkang gling la rtog dpyod dang res 'ga' skor g.yeng gi nyams sad/ chos rje rgod tshang pas dge sbyor phyed ngo tshas byed dgos gsungs pa'i gtam yang don mthun du song / 'dir gnas pa pal mo che so so la 'jig rten phyogs ngo nas khungs dang brten sa yod pa'i mi 'jigs skyob dang / legs smon gyi slad du gra sar ma zhugs/ gu yangs dang tho co'i slad du ras gos gyon pa ma yin par/ blo bla ma la gtad/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la bskur/ chos 'ba' zhig la bsams te 'ongs pa lags pas rang nyid kyis kyang bza' 'phro btung 'phro yan chad bgo bsha' byas te sbyin pas phan gdags/chos kyi phyogs su 'jug mi la spro ba 235

bskyed de snyan par smras/ log bsgrub dang skyo ngal bzod par byas te thabs gang nas kyang gzhan don spyod pa la brtson/ khe grags bsgrub pa'i brtun pa bcom nas chos tshugs la gnas pas don mthun pa ste/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la dngos su gnas par dka' yang rjes mthun pas slob ma bskyangs pa yin/mal ka ba can pa na re/ stan phar la stob/ phyag phar la 'bul/ chos phar bshad nas bsnyen bkur tshur la re ba yin/ nga la ni btsun pa'i 'khor gyi dgos pa med ces pa dang / chos theg pa chen po la gang zag theg pa chung ngu spyad pa'i las snang ni bsam gyis mi khyab/de'i phyir gdul bya dus la bab nas sems can la phan thogs pa'i tshe theg pa chen po'i brtul zhugs la lhag par slob dgos/ ngas skyes rabs brgya pa la bltas pas blo bskyed chen po byung nas de'i don rnams smon lam du byas pa'i bstan bcos skyes pa rabs kyi rgyud snyan dngags dam pa'i 'khri shing du bsngags pa'i pra ṇirta mi'i ci kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar bya ba'ang brtsams/ gsog pa dang / bsrung ba dang / spel ba gsum gyi nyes dmigs 'di la ma bsam na phyug po zhig de ma thag la 'ong ba 'dug ste/ 'khos chung ba 'dis rtsam pa yang zla thung nge ba yod/ de la gang dkon pa'i phyogs nas 'jungs pa'i brtul zhugs dang 'dral bar byed pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi lag len du 'dug /rnam pa gang du'ang gtor tshogs dang mchod pa'i bya ba la brtson/ rgyun gtor kyang chu ma rag ci 'grub bgyid/dkon mchog bslu ba'i nyes dmigs la 'jigs nas rtsam pa bzang shos la mchod rtsam sbyor/ de kha'i mig ltos kyi 'dir sgom chen pa chu thal la brten pa dag gis kyang chu ma rag gis rgyun gtor 'dzugs/ rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i 236

bden pas longs spyod kyang chung du mi 'gro/ brgya mchod kyi mtshon pa'i mchod ro pon cher 'ong ba phal cher dkon pa dang / long sprang gi phyogs su dengs 'jug pa yin/ khyad par lo 'dir 'byung po dang yi dwags rnams kyi dbul phongs bsal phyir gtor ma'i mchod sbyin 'bum ther gya rnam pa btang nas bdag nyid dang mchod yon du 'brel ba'i yul sprang rnams kyang tshim par byas/gtor ma'i gzhung kha 'bar ma dang / rnam nges rnams kyi mtshan nyid legs par tshang ba kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal khrid phyogs gang du'ang ma dar ba/ blun dad tsam ma yin pa'i grub pa'i mtha' dang chos spyod yan chad ma nor ma 'khrul ba de dar na dga' bas kun nas kun tu dar ba bgyis pa yin/ dus 'di tsam na bod kyi mi drag rnams nas bsngo rten brda mtshon re yang bskyal/bla dpon rnams la sa tu gtor na thugs la 'dogs pa'i rten 'brel shar te rigs kyi bdag po dkon mchog gsum gyi chog shes par byas/ dben par nam 'chi cha med las bsam rgyu med pa'i blo sna bsnangs nas gzhan gyi mdun sar blta stang la ma sleb pas khengs pa can du gzigs kyi yod pa'ang shes te thos pas rang rgyud grol ba'i snyems chung lags/ yul dang sa phyogs gang du phyin yang skye bo rnams kyis byams par byung bas 'byor pas kyang ma rdug ste dkor gyis gzi byin ma bsgrubs/ bka' gdams pa'i dgon rnying mthong bas gnas gzhi'i rten 'brel kyang gshis la gang grub tu bzhag /bzhi bcu zhe lnga tshe tshad yin te tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi mthu las da lta'i bar du bde bar 'tsho/rten 'brel ma 'chol na jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis drug cu tham pa'i pha phogs byin/ 'brel 'dris kyi cha nas spyod pa'i 'jug ldog ji ltar g.yo yang sems 237

can rang gi chos nyid yin pas 'khon du 'dzin pa la rab gnas ma byas/'khrid dang gdams pa ji ltar 'debs kyang skyes rabs dang blo sbyong gi gtam dang 'brel bas 'khor ba la zhen pa ldog pa'i thabs byas/ so thar mtshan nyid pa'i thob mtshams kyang 'khor ba la nges 'byung nam skyes su 'dod phyir las dang po pa la phan pa'ang 'di che ba yin/ me pho spre'u'i lo shar ma thag dpal gyi bsam yas gtsug lag khang la stong mchod 'bul du lhags/ mar zhu phon gang che bzhu nas rgyun kong rnams la'ang khyab ci che byas/ cho 'phrul chen mo'i nya la jo bo'i sku mdun du gser sil ma'i maṇ+ḍal dang / gser chab/ snyan shal la sogs pas sngon bsus/ byang sdom len pa nas skyes rabs brgya pa'i smon lam la kha ton du bgyid pa'i bar byas/ bar khang g.yu zhal du tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ rtsis dpon kong po rgyal bskor ba phyag dbang du byon/ sngon rabs chos 'byung las brtsams pa'i gsung lan btab/rang yul gyi yon tan brjod nas der sleb pa byed dgos gsung / sde dpon tsho'i dad pa'ang ston ser gyi me tog lta bu la mi rtag pa sgom/ 'di skabs 'phags pa 'i yul nas rang nyid la glang po che gzhon nu zhig 'bul mkhan 'ongs pa la lam dang lam du skye bo thams cad lta rub byed tsang de'i rtswa gzan ma 'byor dogs pa'i snying las byed pa lan gnyis su mis pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi gdung 'tshob cig par 'dug /brag dmar ke'u tshang du mchod pa rgyas pa dang 'brel bar/ tshe dpag med sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag 'jug/tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/gser chab/ sil ma zho gang gi maṇ+ḍal/ snyan shal lha rdzas dri med bstar/ bla ma rin po cher bza'i 'bul ba dang / gling stod smad la mang 'gyed btang /238

tshogs kyi 'khor lo stong tshar lnga dang / me mchod la sogs pa'i tshogs bsags bgyis/ de nas bla brang du 'og min tshogs chen 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dang 'brel bar 'dus pa mdo sgo sbrag dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor du smin gling lo tsā ba'i yig cha'i steng nas sprul pa'i sku dang chos rje brag phug pa rjes 'brangs 'brug pa'i bu slob bcas 'dus pa nyi shu skor la mdo dbang smin rgyas zhag bco lnga'i khong du grub/ ma hā dang a nu'i sgom rim gyi dpyad pa la rig pa gsar pa gzhan yang 'thob ste sngon du dar ba rnams la rjes su yi rang ba sgom/rin po che'i che zhe rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma la gsal snang du/ dbang gi dus chos longs sprul gsum u rgyan yab yum dang bcas pa rdo rje slob dpon la thim pa dang / bskang gso'i tshe ḍak+ki'i dbang mo tshe ring ma gtso 'khor lngas bskor ba g.yon du byed pa sogs g.yon pa'i kun spyod/ lhag ma la gdangs gyer ba'i tshe tshogs len pa bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i 'du ba sogs gang zag de'i blo gros kyis sbar la mi theb pa'i gsal snang mthong snang 'od dra 'dra tshad pa mang po shar/ rjes 'brel du gshin rje tshe bdag dang / klong chen snying rig sogs kyang bgyis/ bsgrub sde ba spyi tshogs la dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang dang 'don chos spyi'i lung byas/ de nas kun mkhyen chen po'i rnam thar la mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pas sgrub gnas ri mo can du gnas 'brel la phyin/bdun phrag gnyis kyi bar brag phug dang cog gra la brten pas nges 'byung rang bzhin gyis 'phel/ nags tshal gyi gtam u dum wa ra'i chun po dang / ri bong shin tu brtan pa'i rtogs brjod brag ri'i mgul rgyan yang nyams su shar/me tshogs stong phrag thal ba byas/ /byis dang sdig grogs blun po phra med dbus/ /239

tshogs kyi ded dbon 'khyams pa ma bzod nas/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dus zhes bskul na yang / /ga zha'i gtam dang brag ca'i snying por song / zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi me tog kyang / /gtor bar byed po rang gi sems bskyed las/ /zhing pa rnam rtog bral ba yin pa'i phyir//'khor gyi spyod pa kho na'i phyi phyir son/ /sprel lo spre'u zla ba'i sman bsgrub kyi sta gon tshugs pa na/ mon pa rdza dkar bla ma dang / srib mo bla ma gnyis kyang byon/ sgrub chen gyi gzhung bsrangs ba'i dkyil 'khor bdun dang sbyor ba brgyad kyi 'khor lor rtog tshogs thams cad ra sa ya na'i rang bzhin du sbyangs rtogs spang /mon bla gnyis la klong chen snying tig/rat+na'i phur pa/ yang ti nag po rnams kyi dbang lung byas/ khong gnyis nas mon phyogs su sems can gyi 'gro don la pheb dgos zer ba'ang gzhi bdag gi rten 'brel du 'dug /tshong dpon 'brug rnam rgyal can nas 'di kha'i ma phyi sor bzhag gis rnam thar shel brag ma rgyu tshogs phun sum tshogs pa'i thang sku la rab gnas zhu ba sogs kyi slad du 'byor pa la rgyab yig rab gnas gser gyi sor rjes sogs btab/ tshong 'di g.yo rgyus ma byin len dang khal ma mnar ba'i nyes spyod chen po glengs/ yar stod mgo ne ba rnams la ser bas lo mang por bstud nas ston nyes btang bas/ dar gling spyi so dang lding spyi'i gdan 'dren nan chags che bar/ sa der bka' brgyad dang / phur pa'i sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg/bum gter/yul bkru/gzhi bdag la dam bzhag sogs bgyis pas de lo nas ser ba ma babs/ 'di dag byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel kho na la byung bar 'dug ste sngags nus che ba dang man ngag zab par mthong gi 'dug /ngas ni rdzas sna gcig dang man ngag gcig la'ang brten par ma byas 240

so/ /mer mo dang / stag ru sogs yon bdag snying 'dris rnams kyi gdan 'dren zhar/ zhol khang dang chos drung bskal bzang sogs kyi dkar kro dang /tshogs 'khor la rol/ lam zhor grwa tshang du nyin gnyis kyi bar rgyud 'bum rin po che gsungs sgrogs la/kha btags re dang /zho do ma'i 'gyed bstabs/sde pa pha lha sku mched kyang rim par byon/ lho rgyud du sems can gyi 'gro don dang /sgos su rnying bstan gyi zhabs tog tu mtsho snar rgyud 'bum bzhengs rtsis la/bkod zhus rab gnas sogs la ci nas bskyod dgos zhes nan chags che ba/snga sor shing rta chen mo'i lung gi 'phros don la rnying bstan gyi rtsa ba rgyud 'bum rin po che dang mdzod bdun shing rta rnam gsum la chags pa'i nges brjod dang bcas bzhings par bskul ba rje drung rdo rje snying po'i thos 'dzin du dong nas/ zhabs tog bsgrub tshul lag thog tu longs/ sngar bsam mazims su bu mo gnyis kyi brda don le tshan gnyis po'ang g.yu sgron ma dang tsaṇ+ḍi ma'i lung bstan rgyud bskul du 'dug pas bskyod/ rdo khog la khar chibs bsu dang bcas rdzong du sleb/re zhig 'dug ring sde ba mched dang /rta dbang spyi gnyer/thang grong gnas po sogs la rkyen sel rjes gnang dang / rdzong de gdol pa'i grong khyer dang nye bas sems can gyi srog la 'tshe ba la sdug bsngal dang snying rje dpag tu med pa skyes/'bri gnyis go rar btsud pa mthong pas pha ma gsod du cha ba'i sdug bsngal byung / de gnyis srog bslu'i brda sbyar bas dngul srang brgyad kyi gang btab/sde pa'ang snang ba 'gyur nas 'bri gcig bslu ba mdzad/sems can thams cad kyi srog skyob pa'i nus pa yod na snyam pa snying thag pa nas skyes/slob dpon chen po'i sgrub gnas khyung ri shin tu gogs pa kho bo cag 241

dgun zhugs kyi rkyen las zhig gso yang dag pa shar/ les po tsho gsum gyi 'u lag pa rnams la ster byin yang bgyis/ ring min spyang tshang dang srin mo phrang sogs la gnas 'brel zhag bcu skor byas/me tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs/srin mo phreng du gnas yig kyang brda bsgyur du babs/ mon pa 'di blun dad shin tu che bas rkang pa la mgo gtugs te/ bla ma sems can don kun phebs pa yin dad/ dka' 'u ma ral/ lem rked po ra sa zer/ de lo ga jag pa sa 'grib pa lta bu sleb pas lo tog la 'tshe bar dkon mchog la gsol ba btab/sbyin sreg la 'dun pa bsgyur bas de ma thag kho dengs pa dang 'grig /bla ma lem pa yin le 'gu ra zer/ 'di tsho 'byor pa nyung zhing 'khos dman yang bsam pa'i khyad par las grong tsho so sor dbang mo che 'dzugs/ rang cag bste ba'i gnas la nyin mtshan kun tu bskor ba byed/ bho ṭa'i yul gyi phyug po la bsams na dad langs ldang ba dang gtong phod kyang gya rnam/ dgon rtse pa brag sna bla mas khong pa'i bste gnas su sri zhu dang bste stang yang dag pa mdzad/khong yul dbus kyi rigs gra chen por thal 'gyur gyi rig pa la goms/ smad rgyud pa'i bshad srol 'dzin par 'dug pas/ kho bos kyang rje btsun sharnya pu ri pa'i grub pa'i mtha'/ mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma yab yum la/ /lam dbang zab mos legs par smin byas nas/ /rnam dag dbang lnga'i chu bos sgrib gnyis kyi//dri ma kun bkrus sku bzhi'i sa bon bzhag/dam tshig sdom pa rtag tu bsrung ba las/ /zab mozhi lam bzang skye ba'i snod gyur pa'i/ /ma dag skye shi bar do'i snang zhen rnams/ /yid ngor sbyangs nas sku gsum lam 'khyer ba/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed tshang pa'i bskyed rim gyis//rim padang po'i lam la mngon gyur shog/242

ces pa nas brtsams te dpal ldan 'dus pa rim lnga'i chos skad rnams/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba'i snying po la sogs yo ga gsum gyi lam rim dang yang sbyar/de'ang rim pa dang po bskyed rim la/'chi ba chos sku/bar do longs sku/ skyeb sprul sku'i rnal 'byor lam byed/ de bzhin dben gsum gyi rim pa dang / thim lugs bzhi/ bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i dpe'i ye shes goms pa las rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnyis su snang ba'i bag chags bcom ste rim pa bzhi pa'i 'od gsal skye tshul dbang lnga'i chu bo dang ltos grub can du 'dod pa'i tshul kyang brjod pa'i skabs rnyed pas rgyud sde rang sa'i sa lam bgrod tshul la mtha' gcig tu zhen pa dag kyang tshim pa thob/gzhan du na mdo sde bskal bzang las/slob dpon la ni mchod mi byed//bla ma dag la ri mo med/cung zad tsam gyi khro byed cing / /khyim sun 'byin dang ldan pa yin/ /pha rol bsod nams ma dad cing / /rang gi yon tan mi sems par//gzhan gyi mchod pa shes nas ni//phrag dog mi bzad bskyed par byed//ces pa la brtul zhugs brten pa dag la gzu bor bgyid pa'i chos kyi gtam yang dag pas skabs btsal sa yang rnyed pa ma yin no/ /khong la dus kyi 'khor lo zhig nyan par 'dod de stes dbang 'grig pa zhig ma byung ngo / /mdo mkhar nas mdzod pa bi dza ya bro nad kyi lo 'khor du mnar bas nan chags kyi gdan 'dren byung /khong 'jig rten cig shos su nye ba la/ dbang bka' rjes gnang gi mtshon rkyen sel dang / sngon 'dris dad can yin pas sman pa dang sman sbyor kyang rmi lam du gsal ba bzhin lung bstan pas phan pa chen po thogs/ gnyer tshang gzhung dang mdzod gnyer pa so sos kyang bsti stang 'bul nod mdzad/ mkhar ltag lha 243

khang du grags par spyi dbang zhig bskur bar mdzad pa la stod smad kyi skye bo phal mo che tshogs/ lam zhor rat+na pa yab sras kyi dgon pa kun grub pho brang dang bum thang sogs la'ang bltas/ grwa btsun gyi rnam pa gang yod la mang 'gyed re byas/ rngang pa rnams kyi dad pas spyan drangs pa bzhin chos kyi las 'brel bzhag /bla ma rdza dkar ba'i dgon par gsang rdzogs sgrub chen dang 'brel bar khong rang yab sras/ rong pa dbon zur sogs la dbang 'bum la nus dbang lnga'i lhan thabs sbyar ba dang / klong snying / yul pa spyi tshogs la tshe dpag med sku gsum 'dus pa rnams bskur/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rten/rol cha/ zong mar/ mdzo la sogs pa'i 'bul nod kyang mdzad/ khyung rir slebs nas bla ma phan tshun nya shang gi chu rgyud stod smad chos rje ser chags pa nyi shu rtsa lnga skor la rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig gi 'khrid shin tu smin pa btab/ phyir kho bo cag ni las dang po par/ sngon 'gro'i chos la nan tan byed cing / lhag par sems bskyed la rtsal du 'don pas/ sems bskyed mchod pa dang 'brel bar byang sdom 'bog chog kun mkhyen chen po'i ring lugs sgra ji bzhin pa lag len la 'debs/ des shing rta chen mo gnyis kyi dgongs pa'ang nyams su myong / 'jug pa'i bslab rgya pha rol tu phyin pa drug la skyes rabs brgya ba'i gtam rgyud 'brel mtshungs su sbyar nas bshad pas gzhan rgyud la phan pa'ang che/ de'i tshe 'brug pa kun grol gyi rmi lam na/ kho pa shig gi zos pa phyir mngon chung du dor bas/ gral mdzes pa bud med cig na re/ khyod ngo re tsha/ de ring gi byang sdom len thengs gsum ma song ngam/ de 'dra'i sems bskyed zer bas ngo tsha ba'i snang ba dpag tu med pa skyes zer/ smon 'jug gi 2

sdom pa la bo ba ra ri chags pa la'ang phan yon de lta bu 'dug /lta ba phyin ci ma log pa rtogs bya'i mthun pa'i rkyen du gyur pa de mos gus rnam par dag pa dang / byang chub gyi sems gnyis po rang yin par yid ches skyes lags so/ /srib mo bla ma rgan dmangs dang bcas pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin yul gyi mchod khang der bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen sman sgrub dang 'brel ba btsugs/ khong tsho 'chams dang rtsed sna mang po byed/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa bskor ba la bskul bzhin du nyin mtshan ltag sprod/ bar do ngo sprod zer ba'ang skye bo blun po chos kyi bag chags dang bral ba las 'bras ston pa'i slob dpon du 'dug /bla ma la la'i rnam thar na/ rnying ma bas 'bag 'chams byed pas chos kyi byin rlabs yal zer ba sogs bris 'dug ste/ snga 'gyur gyi grub pa'i mtha' chen po 'dzin pa dag ni 'bag dang 'chams la gtso bor 'dzin pa'i gtan tshigs kyang med/ rang nyid ni lus kyi bzo gnas gar 'chams kyi gnas la lhag par byang chub pa zhig yin te snyems pas gzhan la sun mi 'byin/ byed pa la spro ba'ang med/ snang ba dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba la phya chad de/blo gros 'di dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba nas bzung sgra snyan bzung ba'i sprang bo'i glu ngag la'ang 'khor 'das gang rung re dang 'brel chags pa'i ro myong rgyu 'dus pas thams cad la dag snang sbyangs te gnang byin re yang byin/de dag sngags rgyud kyi cho ga la mi gnas pa'i thal 'gyur 'phog zer na/khrom gyi dbus na bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka dang bral ba'i khrab khrab mang po ni kun na dar bas dag snang sbyang ba la thugs gtad pa zhu/ grol dbang la mtsho sna nas bzang lung pa yan chod kyi mi sna stong phrag tu nye ba 'dus/ de'i dbus 2 /bya

na dal ba brgyad dang ldan pa ma nga ste phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom pa brgyad kyis rnam par gzir zhing / 'byor ba bcu ka tshang ba'i mi lus shin tu dkon pas snying rje dang skyo shas dpag tu med pa skyes/ lar sa mtha' 'di dag tu dad pas 'dus pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyi rna lam du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang /gzungs sngags khyad par can bsgrags/ skyabs 'gro gcig pu'i phan yo na kyang bas ma gyis mi khyab pas de'i lung phos/dam rdzas kyi 'brel pa khyad ci che byas/'dzam bu'i gling pa khams drug ldan gyi rten yin pas bum dbang tsam gyi las 'brel bzhag /sems can rnams kyi rnam shes dang rang bi rtogs pa'i chos nyid ngo bo gcig tu ro mnyam pa'i rjes thob la/ gang gis bdag ni mthong dang thos pa dang / rjes su dran nam res sam gtam du brjod/ /bdag la legs bshad thos pa de das kyang / /ring por mi thogs rgyal ba'i dbang por shog /ces pa 'di sems bskyed zab mo'i 'phen pas smon lam du bsgyur/ yul sna nga chos nyid dang 'dres pa'i nyams thod rgal du 'ur bas rdo rje'i glu yang bsgrags/'bru mar/ srog chags/ lho zong la sogs pa'i 'bul pa'i dase rtsa byang chub tu bsngos/ dngos la byung ba'i srog chags rnams mnar gyi dogs pas ba'an la mi 'tshong / bsad kyi dogs pas yon rdzongs la mi 'debs pas mi khom pa 'i gnas na bde bar 'tsho/ nang dbang du gsang rdzogs cha las rdzogs pa gcis dang / sde pa sku mched kyi bskul nas khyung rir bde gshegs 'dus pa tshar gcig rnams song / nag mo khros ma'i rgyud cig brgyud du grags pas dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa dang / chos dbang rin po che'i yang dag kyang rang bzhin gyi 'grib nas rnyed par dka' ba lho rgyud 'di nas dpe lung gnyis ma'i rgyun 246

'bad pas blangs/ stag tshang sgom chen bdud rtsi 'od ldan gyi bcud len stobs su gyur pas na tshod bdun cur thal ba'ang gzhon nu ltar yang zhing zo mdog bzang la rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid dang gegs sel bogs 'don gyis phan btags/ khong gis kyang chos yon du lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi bsgrubs pa'i maṇ+ḍal dam bcar ldan pa phul bas rjes su yi rang ba lhag par skyes/lar 'chi ba la bcar bzhin du dbe sbyor la 'bad du song ba 'di chos pa sad kyi ma khyer ba'i mngon rtasas su 'dug/'jis rten na dbang po che dang nor po che 'chi ba mthong na khyi shi ba las kyang bag 'khums par 'dug pas srid pa'i phun tshogs 'di la snying po 'dug re shi'o/ /skabs 'dir shul rings kyi 'gron po rgya tshad kyi mnar ba zhig nged la skyabs su byung / 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / nad pa dang ni chos smra dang / /skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /yon ni gzhal du med par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan rim gro pa das la'ang gdams nas snying rje'i yu la du bdas sir bzung / khyung ri 'dir rten gyi rnam pa par bkab zhig mi 'dug pas byes yul gnyis ma'i bab kyi rgyu rkyen tshogs par dka' se byung na'ang / ji skad du/ bdag ni yongs su ma btang na/ /sdug bsngal spong bar mi nus te/ /ji ltar me ni ma gtang na/ /bsreg pa spong bar yang mi bde/ 'es pa ltar blos bdag dang bdag gir bzung ba'i dgon gnas dang khyim la rten gsum 'cha' ba las khyad par du gyur pa yin pas satong ba dang brtson pa'i dam bca' brtan pos lhun grub rig 'dzin sangs rgyas pad+ma'i snang brnyan sku tshad che ba ring bsrel rnam pa bzhis phyur bur satams pa zhig bzhengs/ rab gnas kyi don po rang gis rtogs pa'i ye shes skye 7

dang chos nyid mnyam par bsres shing /rgyud sde rin po che nas gsungs pa'i cho gar ldan pa'ang byas/ grog mkhar lta bur snying po med pa yi/ /'byor ba so ma'i smig rgyu ltar mthong nas/ /sred pa'i rnyog pa dwangs pa'i man shel la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snang brnyan 'gog pa med//dgon rtse sprul pa'i sku nas chab shog cig mdzad byung ba'i snying por/ dam pa gong ma'i gsung rgyun skyor zlos kyi/ /de tso'i 'don pa lta bu'i bstan bcos la/ /mtshar du med kyang khyod kyi legs bshad las/ /cha shas tsam zhig sug par son pa la/ /ches cher rangs pa'i dad pa'i rnam 'gyur shar/ /long bas long bar ya mtshan skyed byed pa/ /deng dus mang yang yang das lta ba la/ /phyogs mthong tsam skyes skyes bu'ang thin tu dkon/ /de lta bas na 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du/ /chos dbyings 'gos pa med pa'i klong chen por/ /gcig tu brdal ba'i rnal 'byor grub thob tu/ /grags pa don ldan khyod kyi yon tan dri/ /rgyang ring gnas nas tshor bas mjal 'dod kyi/ /bsam pa dung bas zab rgyas gdams pa stsal/ /zhes pa la sogs gnas dus kyi mchid phreng rgyas par snang mod kyi lha sa nas phyag ma 'khor bas mjal 'dzom ni ma shar/ zhwa'i cod pan gyi tshos mdog tsam la nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba mi bskyed pa 'di yang mang du thos pa'i yon tan du 'dug snyam pa'i rjes su yi rang ba thob/ nam zla dros pa dang mtsho snar rgyud 'bum bri zhus tshugs/ nyin bris la rdzong du zla bo gnyis kyi chad zhu dang / rang cag gi brag sna'i ri khrod du tshig don gnyis ma'i cha la dpyad nas zhu rtsis byas de ring nas phyi mo rgyun 'byams dang / yig mkhan gyi rigs brda dag la rmongs ches bas bri bcos mang bo zla ba gcig gnyis la grub rigs su mi 'dug pas stod cha la ci nus bgyis/248

'dir rong pa seng rdzong dang / dpal ri dpon jo rnam gnyis chos rje chu dkar ba sogs dad 'dus nyi shu skor la klong thig smin khrid du btab/ 'dul ba gzhi la sa/ dge slong dga' ba can la tshangs spyod kyi pham pa byung bas de ston pa dran nas 'gyod pa'i tshor ba drag pos gzir zhing /bdag ni sngon chad dga' ba can te da ni mi dga' ba can no zhes dge slong gi dbe 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus na mi 'chab par bshad pa bzhin/ las 'bras rnam gzhag dus ma jo rgan mo zhig gi 'gyod tshangs kyi 'o dod mi 'chab par 'don pa byung bas gnyen po stobs bzhi'i cho ga de la rdzogs pa yin/ thang grong gnas po 'chi med tshe dbang 'jig rten 'di snang la phan phyug tshang ba'i khyim du sgrub chen bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub rgyas pa tshugs/ grol dbang la che drag rags rim la rnal 'byor rgyun dbang / phyi rol ne seng i thang yangs par gnyal dang lor stod/ mon 'brug /mdo mkhar sogs kyi mi sna'ang tshogs pa stong phrag gnyis su ldang ba la skyabs 'gro 'bogs pa dang / sems bskyed kyi bag chags 'jog pa dang / byin 'bebs byed pa tsam don por gyur pa'i byin rlabs mo sa pa'i khrom dbang dang / dam rdzas kyi 'brel ba/ rigs gsum mgon po dang / gu ru'i snying po/ sgrol ma rnams kyi lung byas/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang sazungs sngags sgrogs pa/ 'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin pas chos nyid dang bsres pa'i smon lam rgya chen po btab/ gnas po la tshe tshad lu nga ston dbos zhes yang yang bsnyad pa/ slob ma dad can gyi bla ma zos por btang ba'i nyes dmigs la 'jigs nas mngon shes can du ni ma brdzus/ tshe ring thung yang las 'bras kyi byed pa rgyu mthun yin pa'i mtshang bshad nas/ khong bi 2 9

zang zing kyang don yo da pa ra bya ba'i phyir sems can brgya'i sros bslu dang /rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rta mgrin gyi sku rnams bzhengs pa ra bskul bas brgyad stong gser ma bzhengs par dam bcas pa'i smon tshis kyang bris/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la sku gsu nga thugs rten bzhengs pa'i srol ma nub pa de ka skye bo rnams dkon mchog la dad pa 'phel ba dang / bsta na pa mi nub pa'i rten 'brel la ltos pa la bas/ kong yul ba shrī ཿ tir dalar po zang du gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan che ba bzhengs par bskul ba'i gzungs 'bul rab gnas la lha gas/ zhal khyim gyi bzo bgros bcos bskyar byas / rang gi ma rgan mo'i phyi rten la rdo rje sems dpa 'a dang / 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso'i sku khru do pa re yang bzhengs/ gnas yig sasar brtsams byas/ sku 'ang song pa sogs mon bod kyi skye bo sna tshogs la tshe dbang zhis bskur/ tshogs stong phrag gcig thal ba btang / 'brus pa bla ma me ras smad pa la klong snying gi 'khrid lebs par btab/ spang chen pa rnams stas tshang du ang nyan byed pas sgrub char nags rongs kyi bshul la 'grim ste brgya mchod/ tshogs brgya sasum bzhi/ yul pa spyi tshogs la tshe dbang dang ma ṇi'i lung byas /sros chags 'bum phrag mang po dbusas 'byin thob pa'i sbrang tshang sasum spo sa shel gyi bslus nas thar du bcug/khong tsho la ri rud chen po byung bas lha 'dre bka' thos dgos zer bar/'jig rten mi bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad sdig pa byas pa la sa byung ba yin zhes la sa 'bras legs par bslabs chad tho'i ye be+e 'di byin pa yin/srid gsum 'di na sangs rgyas kyi zhal ma mthong zhing / ma tsho skyes rdo rje'i dam 'og tu ma chud/ tha mal gyi snang ba rang rgyud par a 'thas pa'i yi dwags 250

'byung po'i tshogs la smras pa/ sems can thams cad rang ngo rang sga ma rig pas rgyu byas/ gzung 'dzin la rtas chags su zhen/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs pa'i kha brgyud/ sdus bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras la rang dbang bral bar spyod pa zhig na/ da dung blang dor gyi sanas la rmongs/ gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pas ngan 'gror gtan 'khyams kyi rgyu bsgrub pa 'di bzang po ma yin pas/'dul ba lung la sa/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dbe ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /zhes pa'i don la legs par bsams la yul spang chen gyi sa'i cha spyi dang bye brag la gnod 'gal gyi bsam pa spongs de bzhin du rang ga'an gyi las 'bras mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir yul pa rnam/sa nas kyang sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma'i gdung 'dzin kho bo rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa nod nas bdag bi chos dang mthun par bcas pa'i khrims tshong dang so nam sogs skye bo rang dbang gi longs spyo da la chos mi shes par nyes med kyi ri dwags 'ded pa/ sprang tshang brdib nas dmyal ba'i rgyu bsgrub pa/ khyad par du lta ba dang grub mtha' ngan pa la blo gtad/ la sa 'bras la ci yang mi sems pa'i mo bon phra med gyi rig sngags mkhan gyi rjes su zhusas nas nad pa'i glud du dmar mchod byed pa spyi dang bye bras la ze mkhar sma na pa sogs la'ang phyin chad lam ngan de las ldo ga pa'i chad byas pa yin pas khyed lha 'dre rnams nas kyang ko long dang phrag dog spongs/ nad dang mu ge /sad dang ser ba/ ri dud shwa log /'byung pa sgang gshongs/ kha mchu 'khrug rtsod/ mi la thi chad/ phyugs la bod kha/ nor la gang stongs/ 'bu sbrang gcan gzan gyi gnod pa sogs snod bcud kyi rgyu rkyen rten 2 )/

'brel 'o sa pa la mtshungs zlar byed pa'i mi mthun phyogs spongs la/ zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyis shig /de las ldog na dkon mchog bden pa'i bka' chad dang / chos nyid zab mo'i bden pa mthu/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi stobs rtsal drag pos khyed rnams kyi mabo bo 'gas par 'gyur/snying la za bar 'gyur/ yan las rengs par 'gyur/ nang khrol 'tshig par 'gyur/ mthar gyi sems can dmyal ba'i grong khyer chen por sdus bsngal mi bzad pa myong bar 'gyur bas dam tshig la gnas par gyis shig /sa ma ya i dan rak+ṣan+taḥ/ ces mtho thog tu bzhag /de nas mtsho snar rgyud 'bum rin po cher dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i rab gnas mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa bsgrubs/dkar chag la mu mthud gnas skabs kyi gtam la skyes rabs brgya pa'i smon la ma sbyar ba'i zin bris kyang btab/ spyir sde bdag gi rigs kyi dge ba'i 'du 'bod 'di rigs 'gre gzhan la ltos na snying stobs dang gtong phod ma smad pa yin te/ rgyun par las 'bras la rtsis su byed pa dang / 'bangs kyi khur du mi 'gro ba nyid dge ba'i rtsa ba mthu che bar sems pas de kha'i 'bel gtam kyang byas/ gtso bor rang nyid kyi lag 'don dang / 'khrid pa rnams la sems bskyed mchod pa'i le lag sogs 'ga' la zhal 'debs kyang bskul te lug bcu tham pa'i srog bskyabs/ spre'u/ rus sbal/ ne tso sogs ster mi byung ba spyir de dag gzab tu chud pa la snying rje dang / khyad par spyod phyogs lam du slong phyir spre'u bzod pa'i rten/ ne tso byams pa'i rten/ rus sbal snying rje'i rten du blo sbyong byas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' blo chen rnams kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs skad cig skad cig la 'phel ba'i gnad kyang shes/ lar nged 252

la gzhan gyi rma bya zhig bskur ba lam du shi ba'i ro bsha' bgyis pas snying chu bsags par 'dug/srog chags ched du gnyer gdams kyi btson du 'dzin pa 'di la las 'bras mkhyen pa rnams kyi gzab dgos pa 'dug /ldog pa'i lam por 'brog pa'i grong du phyugs lug la phyag nas dgos zer ba shi chad dkon pa'i bsam par 'dug /khyu chen po 'di yang myur du mtshon gyi chad pas dengs par 'gyur snyam ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal la snying rje tshad med skyes/yi ge brgya pa dang sbyong rgyud la sogs pa'i gzungs sngags bsgrags/ smon lam btab/ gri gu dmyal ba'i zangs khar phyug po dag gi khyim du chos dad dam rdzas kyi 'brel btags/ jo bo la mchod 'bul smon lam byas/ brgyad gra pa'i ja zhus la rang bzhin shes pa'i gdab lan byas/ lho rgyud du thob pa'i rnyed pa rnams kyi dpal gyi ri bor zhag bdun gyi ring bka' 'gyur btsugs/'bru dkar bre 'degs/se le re/ shog bu bcu ldeb gnyis re dang / grol nyin zong ras spam 'byed ṭa kha re thob pa rnams btang / rnam snang sku rgyab la rgya dar/ lho zong spus dag gi gnam rgyan/ sa 'phan/ rgyal mtshan sogs kyang btsugs/ ri bo bde chen du mang ja gnyis dang / la yug bzhi brgya'i 'gyed skal phul/ nged lho rgyud du dengs khar 'jig rten na grags tshod kyi gdon zhig dngos dang gdon gzugs rten dang brten pa'i rnam par byas nas/ khyed skyes bu dam par shes nas gnod sems bcang ba med/ phyogs la phebs na bar gcod brtsam par sla zhes pa'i tshig ma ning mgo zhig zer ba'i mngon rtags kyang gsal/ phyir dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa rnams la bar chad 'byung ba'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/ rkyen bdag tu 'dzin pa/ de yang bsod nams kyi bsags pa chung ba/ sdom pa dang 253
