dam tshis la nyes ltung can/ mo sa gus chung zhing the chom che ba mtshams ral dang nyes dmigs mi bsam pa snying stobs dang shes rab chung ba rnams 'byung po dang mi chen gyi gzhan dbang du 'chor ba yin/ rgya la chos mdzad nas khong pa sa thob che bas sbas/ gnas pad+ma dkar po'i sa mtshams su dbon pa 'debs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gdan 'dren gyi dus bsgo'i ye be 'byor yang /spyir dus snyigs ma'i dbon sanas 'dzin skyong gi sems can gyi don 'grub pa'ang dka'/ gnas skabs su 'gro don la ming btasas kyang 'dod pa ma zad kyi bar yid la byed pa gang yin shes dka'/ sngar ma tsho snar dengs skabs la ma bar du rta drel gyi sna'i shu shu dang ngal dub kyi rnam pa mthong bas lam thag ring por rta khal la brten pa'i nyes pa gcig po 'di'ang 'dag par mi nus so snyam pa'i blo g.yeng chen po shar/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi ston pa nyan thos kyi 'khor dang bcas pa'ang bzhon khal la mi brten pa'i dgongs pa yid la dran nas skor cig kyang 'gro ba'i blo g.yeng sad/'di lo sgrol ma 'bum ther/tshe gzungs 'bum ther gnyis/ brtsogs rgyud brgya rtsa/ sman bla'i mdo chog brgya tshar btang / thos pa 'dzin pa dang / dkon mchos la dad pa'i bsod nam/sa 'phel phyir bka' 'gyur tshar gcig mdun du bdar nas klog tu bcug /rang lo lnga bcu pa'i dgun thog 'dir dwags sprul dang / mon ljongs mkhar bla ma can 'dus pa bzhi bcu skor la 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo smin rgyas dang /mkha' 'gro snying thig /bla ma yang tig /chos dbang rin po che'i yang das /rta 'jam dbyangs gsum la sogs pa'i rjes sanang mang po yang bgyis/ 'ar chosasu jo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi 'grel bshad dang / rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i25

rab dbye/ bshes springs rgya 'grel slob dpon blo gros chen po'i lugs skabs gang 'gris nas bshad/ slob spring gi 'grel pa rgya gzhung gnyis la legs nyes kyi rtog dpyod kyang shar/ mon pa bla mas dris nas dran pa'i gtam/ yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'ang yi ser bkod/ skabs 'di dag tu kho bos sems stobs chen po bskyed nas rnying bstan gyi rtsa ba mdo sgyu sems gsum la rag las yin/rjes su zhugs pa rnams rmongs ches pas snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sde dang /de'i gzhung don ma nor ba mkhas grub chen pos srol btod cing thin tu grags pa brtan pa'i grub mtha' bzang po rnams la de das byin brlabs yal lo/ /zhes dga' rab dbang phyug bi ro 'dzin skyong bas bstan pa'i gzhung nub par nye/gdams phran rnams kyis ni rgyud sde chen po'i spyi don mi lhongs pas bstan pa 'ba' zhig la bsams shrī pad+ma tar 'dus pa mdo'i bsgrub mchod kyi rgyun zhig tshulas par re nas/ chog phrin gyi par mang po bsgrubs/ yan lag gi dkyil 'khor rnams lhan thabs su byas pa'i chog khrigs byas/ ras bris bzhings/ bri this dang phyag rgya rnams rgyud ldan las khong du chud par byas/ dngul srang brgyas gtsos pa'i cha rkyen sbyor rtsis kyi dbu mdzad gsar rnying ched du bos/ cho ga'i las khrid la sbyar yang / 'jug pa'i sgo dbang phrin las kyi gzhung chos 'dzin/ rten cing 'brel 'byung phyag rgya la sogs dam tshig sga kun tu spyod pa'i gnas la khyi'i mdun du rtswa bzhas pa lta bur gyur/ skyes rabs las/ rgya mtsho'i pha rol tshur rol 'gram yang ring //shar nub gnyis kyi ri dbar de bas ring / /nam mkha' dang ni sa gzhi bar yang ring / /phal dang dam pa'i chos ni de bas ring / /zhes pa der 'dug /da ni lnga brgya'i tha mal babs pas bstan pa la 255

zhabs tog 'grub pa'ang dka' ba'i gnas la yid skyo nas mnyam bzhag la mos pa che ru song / la ra gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor ni thar pa chen po'i grong khyer yin pas bla ma mtshan ldan gyis slob ma snod ldan bcug pa gcis po'i skal ba'ang 'jig rten na rnyed par dka'/ cho ga dang ting nge 'dzin dag pa'i 'bras bu bslu ba med de/ rmongs pa rnams ni ngas 'chad spel ni mi nus zer nas chos thos pa'i yon tan la rgyu 'bras khyad par blta/ 'gro don mdzad mkhan tsho'ang chos gang dang gang gi rang rgyud kyang smin grol du 'gyur/ gzhan la'ang phan pa rgya chen bstan pa'i lam srol mi nub pa'i khur blang ngo snyam pa'i skyes bu chen po'i blo ni btang / dbang lung bi rgyun 'dra thob na des rang bi grags pa bsrung ba dang rnyed pa 'tshol ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig sems pas bla ma la bla mar mi 'dzin/ chos la chos su mi sems pas so skye'i ngang tshul las g.yos pa med bzhin du bzhugs khri mtho ba kho na skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan du snyems pa'ang gangs can na ngo mtshar gyi gnas gcig go/ /kun mkhyen chen ngo sa/ dbang rnams ma rdzogs rgyud don mi shes la/ /bzlas brjod ma tshang bsnyen sgrub ma thems bzhin/ /dbang bskur rab gnas grong chog rnyed 'tshol dang / /blun po'i rmongs zil zas gos che khyad can/ /log rtos grub mthas rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed/ /'dren pa'i gzugs brnyan mthong bas sems 'di skyo/ /zhes gsungs/ bdag cag rang rgyud la rtog cing bar do bgrod pa'i yon tan ma thob pas dkor dang log 'tsho'i nyes dmigs la ya nga nas 'dug pa la byas pa drin du mi gzo ba'i bla brdol snying re rje/ rnam pa'i rten 'brel 'phyugs pa de 'phongs pa ma gtogs rgya gar paṇa chen la bho ṭa'i gzhan dring 256

mi 'tshal/ dngos kyi spangs rtogs dang chos tshul rgya mtsho sngon gyi smon lam gyi rang gzugs las byung na rigs kyi bdas por dri med 'od zer rang ma.o no//sgam po pa'i rus zur zhabs drung bstan dar la snying thig gsar ma'i 'khrid tshul smin pa byas/ khong shes rab che zhing dri ba mang po byas pa'i 'phror zab mo yang tig zer ba snying tig bzhi la e the skad/ rgyud bcu bdun dang btags grol rgyud gsum/ man ngag brgya bcu dgu zab pa pod bzhi/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gsang ba'i de bas dang bcas pa gnad du bsdus pa yin /dkar chag nyi zla gza' skar gyis bstan pa'i snyan brgyud thig le gsang skor ni deng sang shin tu dkon/ 'di'i bla brgyud la tsa rir 'od phung du yal ba'i ma jo gnyis kyi bla ma dam pa gyer yang bzhugs pa sogs bla brgyud kyang spyi dang mi 'dra ba yin zhes bshad/ khong gis kyang lo gsum gyi bsgrub pa khas blangs nas byon ni song / ri khrod par bskyed rdzogs zab mo las lhag pa'i brgya bzhig stong 'gugs kyi dge ba bdud las yin/ spyir bdag cag 'dod pa zad pa'i rigs can du mi 'dug kyang / dad rdzas gshin skor 'dis srog la hur thum byed/ nyams dang rtogs pa 'grib/ chag che nyam nga 'du/ sa lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan la sgrib par nges shes 'drongs pas rab tu yang nas 'jig rten dang mthun 'jug ma byas/ thabs dang rten 'brel ma bsams rang bzhin du chang chung 'byor pa dag gnas min du god zag la shin tu 'jom par byas kyang / skye bo gzhan dag ni dkor dang rnam smin la ji mi snyam pa sha stag yin pas bsam pa sna tshogs 'char/ rgyu des rang la 'byupa 'gyur mi shes pa'i rdzun gtam gyi brtag pa dang /bsngo rten la sogs pa'i rgyun lam bcad na 257

snyam pa yang nas yang du shar yang thas ring la sogs pa'i sa nas 'ga' dang 'gas kha chems ba'ag pa sogs la mi len pa'i dbang ma byung tshe nye skor gyi chang chung rigs ma blangs na kha na ma tho ba de bas che zhing / byang chub se mas dang 'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung la'ang 'jigs pa sa yid 'phribs se ba'i ngang nas bdag gir bgyis pa'i rdzas phran bu pa rnams las rten bzhings shig yid la bsams pa'i tshe/ dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong si thugs rjes g.yo ra stod phyogs nas chos don gnyer ba'i skyes bu bzo gnas la byang ba zhig slebs/ bzo phud du rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong 'bar zhis bzhengs/de nas bkra shis srong btsan bam sor nye ba'i sras brgyad skyes bu gzhon nu'i lus tshad pa dang / bod du brnya na pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel pho brang yu ma bu bla sga nga du dam pa'i chos bab pa'i thog ma spang skong phyag brgya pa la sogs nas mtshan bzhi bshad cing / 'dus pa mdo yi byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor nas mngon rtogs bstan pa 'i phyosas bcu'i sangs rgyas 'gro don la gshesas pa'i tshul bcu tham pa/ pad+ma 'od gling bi satsang khang du rgyal ba klong chen pa'i sku brnyan dang / bzo bo cig thos gnyis kyis thub pa grong khyer ma dang / spyan ras 0zigs kha sar pa ṇi'i ldem sku khang pa la dpags pa gnyis bzhings thing bza gnas kyi bkod pas 'doms / bcad ldan smal sham / san jus ma dzod nang / rdo rje gsang lam ma sogs bzang rgos 'ba' zhis bi na bza' dang / dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa'i rgyu rkyen las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul ma tsha gser can 'khyar gzhing gi stegs che ba dang bcas bkra zhis srong btsan bam sor phul/ gnas de nyid du chos rogs pa dbe 'dun bco lnga skor dang bcas 258

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa dang rang sanas su 'og min tshogs chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po gnyis la brten rab gnas kyi rgyud mdor bsdus satso bor bzung / rgya gzhung dang cho ga mthun par gsar bsgribs bkra shis rgya mtsho la brten nas dngos sta nyin gsum ma'i rab gnas spros pa can rgyas pa 'i phyin sreg sogs mtha' rgyas can dang / rab ston 'gyed bcas sngar bzhin bsgrubs / rten bzhengs kyi don po ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi la rag lus pas rus shing la rtsa thag dang shing 'dab sogs ma bsdams par btso bor gzungs sngags dang dar ras 'ba' zhig dkris nas tshogs rdzogs par byas/ dpal ri ba'i tshes bcu ba rnams la'ang slo ba dpon chen po'i sku dang bcas 'di 'o 'i dbyar ngo phal cher rten bzhengs kyi bya bas 'das/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dpal ri'i gtsang khang du bzhugs su gsol/rten gyi zhal gsor mang bskol nyi shu tham pa btang de dam pa'i chos 'dul ba zhal 'byed dang / mnga' ris grwa tshang par mang ja dang 'jam btang nas spyod 'jug bi smon la ma gsu nga bar bskul/ grwa tshang 'di pa'i dge bshes bka' ram sa pa bcu tham pa smon lam rnam gsum 'don du spyon par byas pa'i 'ar/kho bo shing rta chen mo'i ring lugs la'ang gus pas rgyan 'jug gnyis zhal 'don dang thun dbar la rgyu 'bras man ngas bdun ldan smon 'jug gi sems bskyed la dam bca' 'jog par bskul/ ye ge gzhan gyi dogs pa skyes nas rdzogs chen pa kun bzhi dang chos sku ji ltar 'dod dri ba la kun mkhyen chen ngo 'i bzhed nga sa lan btab pas rangs/ rdzogs chen gyi lta ba la lhag par 'dri bar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po bya ba de don dam pa'i bden par 259

mthun/ de sems can gyi khams la dngos bstan du yod med skabs jo nang pa dang gser mdog can pa la rub brgyab pa de ngas kyang go zhing rtogs/ khong rnam gnyis kyang bzhugs mchi na lcags la thar btang mkhan zhig yin par snang bas/rjes kyi gtan tshigs rnams 'thab mo ya med du song snyam pa dang /rang lta la mchog tu mi 'dzin/ lar shes byas gtan la phab pa'i lta ba mtha' dag go ba yin/des skye med kyi rtsa ba mi chod/'o na dbu ma'i rtsod bzlog las/tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi srid/ /gsungs so snyam na/ de lta ba lung rigs dang 'brel dgos pa'i slad du dgongs/ sgom pas nyams su myong tshe'ang shes bya'i sgrib pa dang 'brel che bas 'gag med kyi yon tan rnal du mi gnas/gdon nas grub pa'i lta ba spros bral rang gnas kyi ye shes la bzo 'chos mi dgos par rtogs tsa na rdzogs pa chen po zer ba'i khas len thams cad dang bral ba de yang / 'di mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa chen po rnams kyi snyan du mi 'dzul yang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med//bzhag par bya ba cung zad med//yang dag nyid la yang dag blta//yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes pa dang ni par thebs kyi yod/ 'on kyang bod skad rigs gcig pa'i ston pa la bzang ba phya ba chos kyi seng ge yang don dam bden pa sgra rtog gi yul du bzhed pa dang mthun par thos bsam gyis shes rab las byung ba'i lta ba sgra tshig gi rjes su 'gro ba'i chos skad khyed rang rnam pa'i des btub/ pha dam pas/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ thabs gzhan bsten pa rmongs par shes par bya/ /zhes pa 260

ltar/ ku su lu pas dben par bsag sbyang dang / bskyed rim dang sems bskyed dang mos gus la sogs pa'i thabs la brten nas rtogs pa'i lta ba ni spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob 'khrul par bshad/ /ces pas sgra tshig gi gtan la mi phebs kyang / 'phags pa'i ye shes mngon du rtogs pa des bka' dang dgongs 'grel rnam dag gi don la dpyad tsa na 'gal ba ltag sprod ma yin pa'i zhus dag pher nas song / de mun mun tshod tshod yin par dogs na/ mtshan nyid pa rnams kyi phu gtugs sa rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab yin/ de ni don dam pa'i bden pa sgra dang rtog ge'i yul yin pa blta zhog /zhen pa'i yul tsam yang ma yin zhes bzhed pa yin/ 'o na gang gis rtogs na gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud las/ yang na blun po dad pa brtan//de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye//rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge ba//de la dngos grub ring du bskal/ /zhes bshad pas khyed rnam pa la dag snang yod de mos gus med pas rtogs pa'i don cig car du rgyud thog la gdan mi 'drongs te mdo las/ shā ri'i bu don dam pa ni dad pas rtogs par bya ba yin no zhes bshad pas so/ /zhes smras pas btags pa ming gi rdzogs chen pa min par 'dug zer/ kho bo cag kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa la ngo mtshar nas yid bzhin mdzod do gal chen pos g.yar byung ba mdzod 'des mngon mdzod dang phar tshad kyi chos skad dang bsgrub gshag gtan la phab pas klog pa thos bsam pa rnams kyi snyan du lhag par 'dzul zhing / zhar la rje btsun sharnya pu ri pa'i thos pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi zhes pa'ang bskur bas phyi mtha'i rnying ma pa rnams gto chog dang gdams phran la rang lugs kyi grub 261

ma thar rlom pa mthong bas skuzhan dang sazhan dag snga 'gyur gyi ring lusas la chos spong bi la sa gsog pa'i gnyen por so nga / chos la sdang ba'i nyes pa bas la ba la phan yon dpag tu med pa yod pa yin no/ /chos rje bras phug pa spyir thos pa dang shes rab 'dzom/ mo sa pa brtan/ khong dang por b.la' brgyud pa'i rigs kyi sngon sbya ngas dang mis ltos kyang lebs pas rang nyid la'ang bla ma 'i ming dang phrin las yo da pa glo ba khengs te/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos spyi dang /khyad pa ra rang rig yid bzhin gyi nor bu gang la sa rnyed pa'i ded dngo na gyi bla ma la bzo gnas bslab pa'i slob dpon lta bur bltas nas gcam bu'i ngo 'dzin gyis dngos grub kyi sno da brdol ba de ma yin par kho bos dang po chu bo rir smin grol gyi rjes su bzung ba nas bzung bla ma gsang 'ing brnyas pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig la skyon byung ba cher med kyang / dbang zhus khrid thob sgo ma par khas blangs pa rnam sa re zhig rkyen dbang sna tshogs pas thog tu ma khel/chos pa spyi mthun gyi chags sdang sna tshogs pa'i stes dbang du gyur pa la 'gyod pa drag po rgyun chags su skyes pas mi 'chab pa dang mi sbed pa'i 'phrin yig yang yang bsrings/ 'di 'o ched kyi byon nas sgom grar bska nga ba las 'gyed bcas dang / ngos cag la nai pa la'i dong tse brgya phrag /lha rdzas bzang bos la so gas pa bstabs te brkyang phyag btsal nas/ bla ma dang thag nye na blo gzhan dbang du mi 'gro/ sanas 'di da lta mis ltos lebs/sdig pa 'i grosas dang bral/dge ba'i grogs po yod pa sa spro zhing mo sa pa'o/ /zhes lo gsum bdag 'byar gyi dam bca' la zhugs/ khong la bsgrub pa'i lhongs 'di phyi gnyis kyi mtshams do nub las med pa'i chu nang zla bar nye ba byung yang mos gus ma shor bas 26 2

'phasas pa 'jam dpal gyis bdud gcod mngon su ma du bskrad pa'i mi ltas mthong nas thar/ lar gang zag dbang po rnon po rgyu'i stobs can gyi rigs dad pa la 'gyur ldog med na gzhan ngo la ji ltar yang gsang sngags kyi lam nas dngos grub thob pa 'i blta rgyu chen po zhig de na 'dug bo/ /gzhan slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i springs yig las/ srin bu gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams mi/ /dam tshig nyams thing mna' la mi 'dzem la/ /shes pa rags shing khong brnag chung ba yis/ /sngar byas khyad du gsod par los zhes mchi/ /zhes pa ltar/ dbus gtsang gzhung pa 'i mi 'di rnam rig gsal / 'dris mi brtan/ gya gyu che/ the tshom dang zol 'grogs/ ngo lkog che bas rdo rje theg pa'i myur la ma zab mo nas lam mi 'chag tu 'gro ba shin tu nyung / gal te bsod nam sa kyi bsags pa can sazu bor gnas pa byung srid na mi khyad kyang phan chod pa yin/ lar dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngu to bas/ slob mi'i mi sa'i 'chos mi shes/ /yon tan 'chos shes sasungs pa ltar/ /deng song bsgrub pa'i dus kyi gsu ma pa yin pas skye bo rnams la skyo shas ra ri 'phel ba sla yang la la blo sod la thal / rgyu mi gzhi blun pa rkyen thos pa chung ba ngo bo bsod nams kyi rgyab ma 'khyor ba'i rigs can phal cher zhig /dang po skyo shas dang / nges 'byung / dad pa gsum gyi sna drangs nas rtse bcig gi nyams ra ri zhig shar/ de lam du ma song ba dag la sto nga lta shusas drag po zhig skyes/ de la ni las 'bras kyang chad par 'char na snying rje dang mos gus la rten gzhi ga la yod/ snying rje 'galas pas bso da nams kyi tshogs rgyun chad theg pa dman par ltung / mo sa gus yal bas spros bral dang 'brel ba chad ye shes kyi tshogs kyis spangs/ skye 'gag 263

stong par bsgom pa'i chad lta la rtogs pa yin no snyam nas/ bla mas bsun/dgon pas skyo/ de tsa na rang rgyud dang lhan cig skyes pa'i gegs kyi rnam par rtog pa la bla ma'i lung gis mi skyob/'di bas kyang dge ba'i khebs che ba byed/'di bas kyang dben pa'i gnas la 'gro zer ba'i tshig gi zol sbyor gyi bla ma bslus/ mched grogs spangs/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi 'tsho ba'i sgo dbral/gnya' yangs/ sgo nga ma drod las yar bas lang tshor smin pa'i 'phro chad/ slob spring las/ yul dang dug mtshungs dang po myong ba tsam na bde/ /yul dang dug mtshungs shugs bzlog dka' zhing g.yo ba yin//dug ni skye ba gcig la dus tu 'gyur bar zad/ /yul ni tshe rabs gzhan la'ang dug tu 'gyur bar byed/ /ces yul gyi rkyen ni rnam pa grangs mang / ngo bo rdzu 'phrul che bas thog ma'i bde gshegs snying po yang bslu ba la mkhas na/so so skye bo'i rang bzhin dam bca' ji ltar brtan yang 'thor rlung dang phrad pa'i bya sgro lta bu de bla ma mtshan ldan dang bral/ sgom gra tshad ldan gyi khyu las yar tshe dge slo nga thang pa zhes bya ba rlung sems las su rung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'gro shes pa rnam rtos ngan pa gcig lam du ma longs pas pha yul du babs nas dmag dpon byas pa'i gtam rgyud lta bu yod/ lar rje btsun mi las ras chung ba la ji ltar gsungs shing mngon du gyur pa ltar/ sgom gra 'dir chags pa'i dbang po rtul ngo thams cad kyang ltar snang mdzes pos skye bo bslu ma shes kyang / blo ma lad/ sdom pa dang dam tshig gi gnas la nyes ltung gi cher ma gos/ nang gi rnal 'byor la lam sna zin tsam sha stag byung / 'dir 'dug yun ring zhing blo brtan pa lho mon gyi phyogs su bsgrub tshugs zin pa dang / skye ba dang shes rab dman yang 264

snying po dung byur song ba dang / la las khyim mdzes med pa'i ri khrod du gcig bur lo dgu stan thog gcig tu bsdad nas g.yas g.yon du chom rkun gyi mi bsad pa dang / rdo 'phangs pa sogs byung kyang bla ma rang la gsol ba btab nas ma spos par 'dug pa sogs 'ga' dang 'ga' yod mod/ bla ma'i drung nas byer pa'i shes bya dang pher rgya can pal cher bar chad rang si dbang du song zhes thos / sde dge ru dam pa'i gra pa bzhi don gnyer che la 'bul nod nyung zhes khong tshos ched du gtad pa'i re che sa thams cad nas rim gyis bshugs pa lta bu'i mthar nged can du slebs/ shul rings kyi 'gron po snying rje'i yul du bzung nas khong tsho'i 'dod chos zab rgya 'khrul 'khor/ yang ti nag po de das gi sgo nas rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi ka dag dang / lam lhun grub kyi 'khrid tshul shin tu smin pa dbos zhes zer/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad shes par 'dod na ni rtsa rlung thig le'i byed bcings dang / dbang po rkyen gyi bsla da pa'i stong gzugs lam gyi bogs 'don gyi chos yin pas sems klong man ngag sde'i snying po kun mkhyen chen pos ji ltar gtan la phab pa'i don sems thos tu gdar sha gcod dgos pa yin zhes go ba legs par bkon/ la las gnas 'gyu'i 'gro phyogs dod tsam 'dug kyang kun gzhi the tshom can ldab dang 'tshang 'dru ba la goms pa zhig 'dra bas kho'i lam des 'begs par dogs /khong 'dod gdungs ches bas bka' brgyad kyi dbang chen kyang snga nur/chos rje brag phug pa dang / dwags sprul sogs 'dus pa bzhi bcu skor la zhi khro'i rim pa dbang gi las rnam pa gnyis dang / mdo byang chen po lto legs par sbya ra/ lar deng sang gi chos nyan pa snod dang dri ma'i skyon can la gsang 265

sgrog gi nyes pa dang dngos grub gnyis ka chung ste/ 'jig rten pa'i sde gnyis 'tshub che ba dang / dbang song ma gnyis sbas don yin phyir song du sdom bzung gi skabs nas thob thang dbye nas dbang mi la rgyas bsdus kyang byas/ da ni dus snyigs pas sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rigs can nyung yang mi re'i mdun du rtsis kyi shog khra re kha phye nasachos la thob brtsi ba'i nan tan ches pas klong chen snying tis gi dbar chog snying po don gsal la brten zhi khro'i lha dbang chen mo dang / dpal chen la sogs pa'i sgos dbang rnam grangs bzhi/nyung bsdus la tshe ring ma'i srog dbang pa nga shor/ snying this gsar ma 'di ya bzhi dang / rgyal ba klong chen pa'i grub mtha'i don po yin yang nyams su mi len pa mang pos chos nyams shes shes 'dra bas bka' rgya dbang med du bgrol/lha bas glegs bam brlag tu bcug pa sogs rten 'brel la cung zad gnod pa byung /la ra dam pas/ bod kyi chos pa 'di tsho kha cang la cang khyer mi mkhas/dad pa skye mgyogs la yal ba sla/ dam tshig mi bsrung bar dbang zhu/ nyams su mi len par gdams ngag zhu/ bod rtog pa che bas thabs la ma gyi snod lhung /'phan yul du gcig la btab pas de yang rul gsung ba de bden par 'dug go/ /nged lo gsum dang po'i dus sde dge phyogs nas bskur ba yin zer ba'i yig sgril chen po zhig nas/ sham thabs legs po zhig gi lteb la dar lhog dmar po chen po rang gnyis dang / dngul zho gang pa gsum bcas 'dug /de'i rten 'brel da res kyi khams pa tshos go bcad/ yul bab kyi spyod pa mi bzo bas nyin nub dus skabs gang la'ang skabs btsal du med par phyin chad bla ma dang mi mjal zhes sgo la gtan pa med pa lta bus dris shing zhe sun par 266

byung yang / rang ngo nas skyo ngal dang log sgrub bzod dgos pa rigs lnga'i dam tshig gi khyad par dang du blangs / gzhin pa gcig gi 'dug ring bzed zhal gyi 'dor po dri nga ba la longs spyod/ bdud rtsi che chung dam tshig bi rdzas su gces pa ra 'dzin/ ldos pa'i tshe smre sngags dras po 'don/ brgyal zhing sngangs pa lta bu'i ngang nas thams cad kyi rkang pa spyi bor blangs nas song bas dngos grub kyi snod du rung rung 'dra ste/ so so skye bo'i dad pa zhing kha'i bye'u lta bu de rkyen thog na 'dus pas da ni su la'ang re ba med/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i sgom pa'i 'du shes thams cad kyi nang nas mi rtag pa sgom pa'i 'du shes kho na mchog yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa de kho na yid la sems pa yin/ gang la'ang snying po med pas chos 'ba' zhig la blo gtod cig /ces 'al bdams tho lo ka re re'ang 'dod pa dang bstun nas bris shing lag rtags bkod pa khyer nas dengs/ snya na dngags don ldan du bya phyir slob dpon chen po ma ti tsi tra'i rgya gzhung gi mngon rtogs ston pa'i sa ngas rgyas sum cu so lnga nye sras brgyad/mchod rten brgyad/mtshan brgyad/ rnam bcu dang /'jam dbyangs phyas mtshan/ bla ma yi dam la so gas pa'i bsto da tshogs dang /nye sras la don 'grel kyang bkod/ sa mo phag gi lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba nas bzung rang nyid ji srid 'tsho'i bar bdun phrag re'i ring rang gnas su 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo stong phrag re bskor ba'i rgyun btsugs/ slan chad de la zhol chos dngo na sayo ga rnam gnyis nas 'bru ru'i khal lnga bcu tham pa dang / snum bya'o gang 'bul bar mdzad pa nged kyi 'bun dang bcas pa'i khrigs bcad kyi g.yo 'khor ni mi yong / mthar thug 267

dngos po chud mi za bar bgyid do zhes bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ /'byor pa med na ye shes tshogs/ /mnyam par bzhag pa bya ba nyung / /zang ring sleb na dkor nag phyir/ /bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par shog /tshogs gnyis 'di ltar bsags shes nas/ /su la'ang dgongs len mi dgos shog /'di ltar bsod nams yin phyin chad/ /zang zing kho nar bsten mi dgos/ /sems 'di las su rung ba na/ /byang chub sems dang bskyed rim sgom/ /yan lag bdun sogs grangs med pas/ /blo rgod nang du khug par shog /rten 'di khyad par 'phags pa'i lus/ /phyi nas rnyed dka' dran par shog /so ka gtor 'bum tshar gcig btang / dgon grwa lnga phrag gcig gis nyin gsum sman bla'i mdo chog dang sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga la ltung bshags tshar lnga brgya dang bzang spyod kha shas 'don du bcug nas khang pa'i zhig gsor sa phran bu bskos pa'i 'bu srin rnams la smon lam btab/ ye shes las grub pa'i chos skyong khyad par can rnams theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun dkon mchog yin par nges pa gting nas tshud kyang / kho bo phrin las la re ba chung bas ched du 'dzin pa'i do gal ma byung / 'di lo ma mgon lcam dral gyi brda bsgyur bab pa'i dus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yul lho phyogs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i skyes bu go zhub can gyis khengs pa'i 'khrul snang sogs chos skyong 'du ba'i rtags shar nas chu ma rag gi rgyun gtor bzang po 'du byas pa'i nyin/ sgo rtsar bya rog nyi shu skor babs/ yul phran 'dir zla ba dgu tsam bsdad/ mgon khang kyang rang bzhin du grub pa ltar gyur pa la ma mgon gnyis 'bur sku/ gzhan rnams bris sku dang zhal brnyan sogs nga'i sku rten/ gsung rten nag mo khros ma'i rgyud cha tshang /268

sater mabon phyag bzhi pa/ dpal mabon ma/ ning ji rgyud dang bcas pa'i pu sta ka /thugs rten bla rdo srog 'khor phyag mtshan mdos dang bcas pa 'du byas/dur khrod lha mo rje mo rta zhon ma smyon ma'i gzugs su byas nas 'khor ba'i mtshan ma mthong / lha mo 'di dkor cha bsrung bar ched du gyur pa yin pas/dkor khang du rang gi nor rdzas chud pa'ang tshig gi 'grol dbos par bshad na/bdag nyid phung du dogs pa rnams gzab 'tshal/ ston ser gnyer pa kong po pas yon sbyar nas 'dus pa nyi shu skor gyis bde sashegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i bdud rtsi sman bsgrub spros pa can btsugs/ rjes 'brel du 'dus pa snga ma rnams la bla ma yang tig gi dbang yongs rdzogs dang / zab mo yang tig si spros bcas bum pa'i dbang rnams bgyis/ dwags sprul dpon slob bdun la rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khrid btab/ la stod pa shar rgyang bla ma dgon gnas spangs/ lho mon gyi rdza rin chen spungs pa dang nye ba'i 'brog dgon chen por dka' thub bcud len rje btsun mi la'i dpe zlar 'os pa de nged dang mjal 'dod lhag par che ba'i phyag bris yang yang mdzad byung ba'i ngang mya ngan las 'das pa'i zhal chems bskyel bar slob ma tre nag tshang ba can dang / kho long stod pa'i mon pa pho mo 'byor ba la smin grol gyi gdams pa btab/ 'di tsho mos pa che yang chos dang 'dris bshes chung / skad rigs mi gcig pas lo tsā 'jug dgos pa'i dka' las la bsams na yul dbus su skyes pa rnams blo dred drags pas chu ma btang na dga' ba bsgoms nas 'bad dgos pa 'dug/dgun mtshams rgya dam par 'dug pa'i dbar la yon tan rin po che'i mdzod mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhung 269

lugs 'di brtsams/ kho bo'i blo gros la dpyad pa rdzogs pa'i man ngag tu bzung chog pa yod/ nam 'chi cha med kyi skyo shas 'di nam yang 'gas pa med pas rang nyid kyi phyi rten la bsams/ gser dngul / rgyan cha/ 'bo snam la sogs dngul srang bdun cu rtsa lnga'i rgyus thub dbang grong khyer ma'i sku li ma zhig bsgrubs/ cho phrul zla bar dpal gyi bsam yas la stong mchod bshams par dad pa'i nye bar len nga kho nas bskyod de/ snyan shal brgya phrag thal ba dang / stong tshogs sogs bgyis te rang gzhan bstan 'gror sman pa'i smon la ma rgya chen po btab/ gung thang la kha'i zhabs rjes dang / sku tshab rin po che'i zhabs drung du mos gus kyi brnangs shing mchi ma shor ba byung / sa ga zla ba la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgo sbrag dgu ma bris nas 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod chen mo chog rogs pa bco lnga skor bcas btsugs/ tshogs stong phrag thal ba btang / las dang po ba'i gang zag dge sbyo ra la khul du mngon pa rnam sa bza' btung gis brid nas rang mdun nyid du phyag 'bum dang skyabs 'gro yig brgya sogs bsag tu bcug nas sngon 'gro bsog pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ 'di skabs snang cha'i rten 'brel 'bring du gyur pa la/ dpal sdings rje btsun gyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel mdzad pa pra rtags 'gyur zhing / khong la yum ska'i byin rlabs byas pa'i rkyen gyis ma kha' 'gro'i lus dkyil gyi brda yang grol ba'i rten 'brel legs pa byung / lcags byi lo 'dir zang zing ji dngos po rnams spungs te gzhung nas bka' 'gyur rin po che bslu ma zhus pa tshogs gsog sga zhing du spyan drangs/ yon dngul srang phyed sum brgya dngul rkyang bi 'phros/ 'bo snam/ stag gzig lpags rigs/ ras cha spus dag rnam sa la song 270

chod rin thang ltar 'byung dka' yang / 'jig rten na sdig pa'i phyogs su lus srog kyang gtong ba mang na/ rnam dkar 'di lta bu'i phyogs su gtong sems la soms pa sbyin pa 'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad yin pas lus srog song kyang go bcad snyam pa byung / de kha'i bzhugs gnas la dmigs pad+ma 'od gling bskyar bzo'i dri gtsang khang ka ba bcu gnyis pa 'phar thog dang bcas pa bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde pa rdo rje phun tshogs kyis dang bas bskrun pa khong gi tshe de'i bya ba la rjes che ba yin de'i tshe rang nyid dang bsam satan pa la la'i rmis ltas su sa yul 'di mon mo 'ba' zhig sis khengs nas khang las rgya chen po byed pa'i mod la shing khang bkod legs grub pa'i rtser bal po gnyis kyis gardzi ra legs pa zhis btsugs nas dengs pa ma mgon lcam dral gyi phrin las su snang / seng g.yeng la mdzad pa bcu gnyis po gser byibs byugs kyis rtsis maso bsdus pa'i nang tshan mdzad brgya ltar bkral ba dang / thog 'phar rnams la grub brgya'i steng chos grags phyogs glang gnyis bsnan nas rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyang tshang bar bris/ dngos sta nyin gsum rab gnas rgyas pas rten snang mdzad dang / brten pa rnams bzhan so so'i rang bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i mthar rnam pa zhal bsgyur ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sres rab ston mtha' rgyas kyi bar byas/ dge ba'i gung bskyed pa dang sa bdag la phos thug sa ku ci'i srog 'gag pa rnams la dmigs nas chu gtor 'bum gter dang / lug lnga'i srog bskyabs/ der mdzod pa khrims mun du chud pa'i gnas tshul thos pas snying rje dpag tu med pa skyes/ khong la dmigs nas zas bsngo dang / bsngo smon yang yang btab pas/ btsun chung gcis na re/ des khyed la zhabs tog chen po 27/

byas sam zer/ de 'dra lta ci smo sa/ sanas skabs su btsan po'i khengs pas dregs pa dag gis dngos cag lta bu 'bu srin tsam du'ang sa la mngon/ rgya la chos mdzad chos bros kyis 'dir lo gsum btang rjes dgongs khrol gyi tshig zhor du'ang rnying ma'i bla ma zhes pa sun 'byin dang bcas snang ste/ so so skye bos gnas skabs kyi mngon mtho thob pa'i rlom pa 'di 'dra lha tshangs pa la'ang 'byung dka'/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can gyi rang bzhin shes nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzobs pa ra byed pa'i phyir ro/ /snga lo rang lo so bdun pa'i tshe/ gtsang spyon te ru ka pa'i sgras chos bdag lung bstan pa bzhin/ de nas lo grangs bco brgyad thal ba lcags glang 'o ra sa skya bong ma rin po che ngag dbang kun dasa' blo gros yab sras dbus phebs zhir bsam yas mchims phur zhabs bskyod tshe/kho bo'i gnas tshul bka' 'dri dang /da res nged dang mjal e yo nga zhes 'char bkod gnang 'dug kyang ma tshams sbyor byed mi med pa sa der zad/ phyi lo de ga'i gnas tshul thos pa la brten chos rjes skyes rabs brgya pa'i smon lam chos kyi mchod sprin du spros pas dgyes ches pa'i bka' lan dang / nged dbus su yong ska bas dngos su ma jal res lta ci/ phyas bris tsam yang mdzad ma byung zhes thugs yus pa lta bu dang /ngos cag la snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir khyod kyis bstan pa la bya ba byas pa la rjes su yi rang ngo zhes lha rdzas bzang po dang /bdud rtsi ril bu brgya rdo bzang gos lami ma yug bcas gnang phyin chad kyang gsung rtsom sang yod nges par bsring dbos zhes phebs/ zhu la na dang lhan cig yon tan rin po che'i mdzod/klong chen snying this gnyis phul bas bka' lan tshigs bcad dang / 27 2

zur gsal la/ gus zhu/ grub dbang dam pa nyid ni rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid dang mchog du mi 'gyur bde chen ro mnyam las lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las su shar ba bdag cag gi ston pa'i drung na moṅgal gyi bu/tsan+dan ba sing gi nags khrod du grub dbang shrī serta / ljongs 'dir mgar bstong btsan yul bsrung sogs dang / lhag par sa skya'i rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/bye brag tu bsam yas pa snyan ngag mkhan zla bral du 'khrungs tshe/ma gza' rdor gsum gyi snag shog phul nas rnying ma mdzod bdun legs bshad 'phags bod 'gran bral gsung rtsom/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ sde snod rgyud sde'i bang mdzod sgra snyan sogs la mtsho byung mas ro 'dzin bdud rtsir bsgyur ba sogs sku phreng rim can mkhas grub sha stag tu byon pa'i mur deng zhag pad+ma'i mtshan can gyi rnam par rol par bstan nas klong chen snying thig sogs dgongs gter dang / lhag par gsung rab thams cad bdag cag gi ston pa'i rjes phebs sogs don gyi skyes bu dam pa bsam bzhin skye med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa zhig la yang bag tsha the tshome ma mchis/zhes sogs dang /bstan pa la thugs bskyed shin tu che bas gser srang gang /dngul lnga bcu ma/nang mdzod sna lnga bcas yon tan rin po che'i 'grel ba brtsoms shig par bkas bskul ba bzhin mdo lam la bden gnyis shing rta dang / sngags lam rnam mkhyen thing rtar smos pa spyir shog grangs stong phrag tu ldang ba rtsom pa'i 'go btsugs/ lung rnams phal cher bka' bstan dngos las bcus pas bstan bcos rnying pa la ma grags pa re mang yod/de yang dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phur kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal mthong ba'i tshe/ shing rta chen mo na gab 2 73

pa'i tshul du yod pa mtha' dag 'dis gsal bar yod do/ /zhes glegs bam zhig sanang nas lung bstan thob pa bzhin shing rta rnam gsum dang / mdzod bdun tshor dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod/sngags spyi'i lugs kyi smin byed kyi gzhung rnams cung zad tshig bsdu'i lugs kyis rang sa 'i bstan pa nyams dmas shing grub mtha' slong ma nus pa rnams rtsal du bton nas bshad par snang bas 'dir rang phyogs rnams kyi bstan pa shes pa'i don la dbe ba'i bsam pas kun nas blangs/ bshes gnyen brten pa'i gnas skabs 'grel pa'i tshe/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang mjal nas 'jam dpal dkar po'i rjes sanang stsal te/ oṃ wa kye dā nā maḥ/ zhes pa'i rjes zlos kyi tshe gsung gi gdangs la'ang dpyad pa chen po byung / chos rje pas zin bris las dpe thog tu 'bebs pa'i ngal ba dang du blangs pa sa khong bi mi lam na/ da lam khyod kyis 'di bris pas mchod rten chen po zhig bzhengs pa'i phan yon thob/ de la sngon 'gro'i chos rnams ni them skas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba ni seng khri/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ni bang rim/ rdo rje theb pa'i smin dbang ni bum pa/ grol byed ni chos 'khor/ rdzogs pa chen po bla na med pa ni tog ste/ 'di ni ston pa dang bstan pa gnyis ka yin te mthong thos dran rig thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'grub po zer skad/ tshogs sasog dang nyams chag dag pa la dmigs nas sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sbyin srel 'bum ther bsgrubs pas byad ltas shin tu gsal ba mngon/ dngos cag ni rang gi bsod nams zad pa'i rgyu gzhan 'byor phun tshogs la mi bzod pa'i sanas gcig kyang med de 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi blo dang bral ba 'di 274

yang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgyur yod pa 'dra/ chos bsgrub pa'i segs zhi phyir khro rol slang dgu ma rgyas pa zhig byas/dgun mnga' ris grwa tshang ba nyi shu skor nas nyin gsum gyi ring mdo mangs gsung sgrogs dang / nub mo dbu ma thal rang gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i pod chen lnga ka la dam bca' 'jog par bskul/ dbu ma 'i lta ba myong thog tu 'gel na stong sang nge ba 'ig tu bsgrubs pas rtog ses de tsam la sa brtas par ga la nus snyam pa byung /nam zla dros nas btsug la ga khang gi rten satsor byams ma gon bzhengs ka ma skyes bu dar babs kyi khru gang ba'i zhal tshad can/ g.yas g.yon du snang ba mtha' yas dang / 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso gnyis de bas sku tshad chung tsam re bzhengs/ mdo'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar dngos sta nyin gnyis pa'i rab sanas dasa' sto na la thug bi bar snga ma rnams las je rgyas su byas/ sa skya song ma rin ngo che gzhan don gshegs pa'i thubs dam yongs bsngo rten dang /gdung rin po che sku mched kyi bka' thog kyang phebs/ kho long stod pa'i btsor chan sogs rngo/na pa'i mi rgan rnams la las 'bras la nges pa rnyed pa dang /dkon ma chog gi yon tan brjod pa gtsor bton gyi khrid cig bshad/ khong tsho'i yul du skor bcig yong dgos nan tan byed kyang sa chu mi 'phrod pa 'i rgyu mtshan labs/ 'bri gung yang ri sgar pa'i grwa pa hor a dras pa can lnga la smin khrid sand smin byas/ lha bab dus chen dang bci na bsam yas su stong mchod 'bul du lhags/ bar khang du tshogs 'khor dang / mnga' ris nas spya na drangs pa 'i gu ru'i sku tshab byin can der snyan shal nang mdzod tshon ris ma/ rgya rag si ma/ṇ+ḍal phul ma 'khar gzhong gi stegs bcas phul/ mchod ma jal thos brtan 275

bzhugs spyon lam dang snyan shal brgya phrag gnyis spros/ gser gsol sogs byas/ rab byung pa bsam gling slob dpon can lnga skor la smin khrid rgyas par btab/ jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du sems bskyed mchod pa dang 'brel bar byang sdom phog pa'i tshe/ hor a drag pa rten dge slong du 'dug pas rtsa ba bzhi dang 'gal ba'i kha na ma tho ba med kyang / ltung byed dang nyes byas mang la rags pa dang /khyad par theg pa chen po'i nyes ltung phra zhing bsrung dka' ba'i tshul bshad pa la nges pa rnyed nas rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa zhes/ mchi ma blags pa'i 'o dod bos nas 'chab pa med pa'i dag tshangs chen po byas/ skye dgu phal mo che la thos pa'i nyer len ni med/ phung po lnga dang rnam shes brgyad kyi bran dang yang khol du gyur pas/ khong la smyo ba tsam du lta bar byed do/ /tshur 'khor nas chu gtor 'bum ther zhig btang / 'di lo phan la phyugs lug brgya phrag thal nges kyi tshe thar song / 'bras srungs nas spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par grags pa'i gtsang pa dge bshes rin po che'am/ go bo bla ma'i spyan sngar chos rje pas mdzod rtsa ba dang skyes rabs byi dor mdzad par bskul bas khong thugs gzo bas spyir phyogs lhung chung / sgos dag snang chen po zhig 'dug pas rang stong gzhan stong dbu ma'i tha snyad la'ang yul dang yul can gyi cha nas dgongs pa 'grel phyogs las mtha' gcig tu 'gal bar stangs mi dpyod ces grags/ 'di res kyis gsung lan la/ bstan bcos le tshan gnyis la de phral zhib tu bltas pas don rnams khong du chud cing 'di gnyis la don gyi 'grel pa'ang 'di dang 'di lta bu yong nges snyam du rtsa ba bltas pas 'grel pa khong du chud/ da cha 'grel pa blta mi dgos/ nyid kyi bla ma de bzhin rgyal 276

ba'i bka' dang rgya bod kyi pa'o grub rnams kyi dbongs pa ji ba'in du rtogs thing / khyad nga ra snu na ngas sde gsum snyepa mkhyen nga/'i spya na lda na sngo na gyi dus na byon nga 'i ma/khas grub zla bral klong chen rab 'byam/sa pa ngag i dbang ngo dang rjes su rmi thun pa'i bsta na 'dzin gzhan 'gran bral ba zhig lags par 'khum sa / snyi sas ma 'i dus su bstan 'dzin 'di 'dra yang yod pa ngo mtshar trin tu che snya ma du dad pa dang spro ba rjes su yi rang ba gsum phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du ches cher 'phel/ da ni dad lda na rnams la bskul ma mdzad de rtsa 'grel 'di gnyis nga ra du babod nas rgya cher spel ba'i thabs mdzad na dus mtha' 'dir sas nga sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i 'bas 'degs dang / nyid kyi chos 'khor bsko ra ba gsol ba btab cing / bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi 'bas tog byas nga rnams kyang sang dang gang du skye ba der yang nam mkha' dang chu klung / ljo na thing dang / rlung nas bskul ba'i sgra la sa chos kyi sgra lhang lhang byung ste bla na med nga 'i byang chub thob pa ra mdo las sasu ngas pa bzhin rmongs pa ma 'u sa pa bsal nas chos kyi mig rdul bral thob par nges so/ /zhes sna nga / deng sang 'di na rmongs pa kha cig rgyal ba klong chen pa'i byin rlabs dang / gzhung lugs la brten nas kho bos sangs rgyas kyi bsta na pa shes so zhes brjod pa 'di la dge slong ko ka li'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yod srid de/ chos kyi rnam pa tshig bzhi pa gcig thos pa yan chod la dam tshig bsrung ba'i 'dun pa ma nyams par yod pas su'i ya nga mtshang la ma rgol/ bka' drin thob tshul gyi ngos nas dal 'byor bco brgyad po'i ming grangs yan chod kun mkhyen chen po la brten nas rtogs pa'i phyir na bdas cag gi ston pas/ gang las chos ni 277

rnams shes pa/ /de la gus pas phyag bya ste/ /bram ze gtsang mas me la bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir gsong por smra ba la mi mthun par blta ba yod srid na shākya'i sras po ring 'phur dang / lhag spyod kyi bstan 'dzin las phyir phyogs pas lnga sde rnams kyis dache sbyong go'u ta ma lhod pa/ mang du za ba spong ba las nyams pa zhes skur ba dang 'dra ste shin tu'ang snying rje'i gnas so/ /lcags zam nas sprul pa'i sku rin po che gnas gzigs dang bstun pad+ma 'od gling du phebs pa la yum ku'i byin rlabs/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ lung gsan 'phro rnams dang mdzod rtsa ba thog mtha' bar gsum rnams phul/ mdzod 'grel shing rta rnam gnyis las/ le'u dgu pa yan chod kyi zab mo lta ba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung legs par gtan la phab pa'i brgyud pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas kun mkhyen chen po'i bar dge ba gsum gyi don khrid ltar bgrang la/ 'phros le'u bzhi por rdo rje theg pa spyi dang bye brag rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi bshad gzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgra don gyis bsnyad pa'i dgongs 'grel snga 'gyur ba rnams kyi rig par bya la/ mdo sngags gnyis ma'i brgyud pa nye brgyud du 'dren na mgon po klu sgrub dang / 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la phu gtugs pa'i rgyu mtshan rtogs brjod phyi nang la brten nas shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar tshar phyin nas rwa brag kun grags bzhis gtsos pa'i rang slob nye bar 'khod pa rnams la bshad lung sbrags ma zhig byas/ mdo smad sde dge'i mnga' ris nas rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che sngar bod la byon dus gzhan dbang la brten nas mjal ma thub par thugs 'gyod shin tu che tshul dang slad nas 'dir bskyod thub pa'i dgongs pa 278

gtad dgos zhes/ dngul srang nyer lnga dang bcas pa'i gsung bris snga phyir 'byor/ nged kyi lo gsum dang por sde dge'i phyogs kyi yig sgril gyi sham thabs bzang po'i brda bzhin mjal thub na bstan pa la phan pa'i rten 'brel chen po yod kyang gnad byang las/ phyi dus 'gro don dus bab tshe: 'gal rkyen rnam pa sna tshogs dang : khyad par bdud blon dam sri'i rigs: rjes 'brengs rnam 'gyur cir yang brdzu:bka' drin dam tshig khyad du gsod:ces pa ltar/ gzu bor mi gnas pa re gnyis nas/ bla ma thugs shin tu gtum/ dgon pa'ang ri rtser yod zer ba'i rten 'brel bden bral gyi phyogs su bsgrigs pas bstan pa'i la rgya rang la gegs su che/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod dang bcas pa'i zhu lan phul/ dgon gams kyi sku skye rin po che'ang sdig grogs blun po'i gzhan dbang du gyur ches pas bsam sgom dang bstan pa'i bya ba gang la'ang seng shor kho na'i mur rims nad kyi phyogs su rnyed 'tshol la phebs pas glo bur nyid du sku tshe'i 'du byed thal pas 'phongs pa la tshad ma byung /gsol 'debs/gdung chog sbyin sres gi bar rje btsun shan+ta pu ri pa'i gdan sa la bsams te dang du blangs/ shing sbrul lo sar ma thag sa skya nas mgron gnyer ched gtad gnang ste gdan sar yong dgos kyi bka' nan tan dang / bka' tham rin po che'i dgongs don snying por/ ched gsol/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa la sogs pa'i thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas sangs rgyas su zin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i cha las mi 279

mjed 'jis rten gyi mabon po da ltar gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang bstun dang por byang chub mchos tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bska la pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan cing / nges pa'i don du de las rgya che ba dang zab pa'i tshul du ma sa khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la brten nas bskal pa dpas tu med pa'i snga rol du zag med kyi bdud rtsi brnyes su zin kyang / bdul bya'i khams la gzigs pa mi lhod pas rgyal pos 'dul ba la rgyal po/ dge sbyong gis 'dul ba la dge sbyong / bram zes 'dul ba la bram ze'i gzugs su bstan to/ /zhes gsungs pa so gas ma mtha' gzings dang zam pa la sogs pa'i bar gyi bzo gnas skye ba mchog bi sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pas sems can re ri'i phyir du yang dka' ba ches cher spyad par mdzad cing / khyad par rtsod ldan snyigs ma las ches snyigs pa'i mi bsrun pa rgyal ba gzhan kyis yal bor rnams lhag par thugs brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad pa dang / de'i sras kyis thu bo 'phags mchos phyag na pad+mas kyang mtha' 'khob kha ba'i rwa bas 'khyud mor bskor ba gdong dmar can gyi yul/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi yal bor 'di nyid gdul bya'i zhing du mdzad pa dang / 'di nyid du chos kyi ming mi grags pa'i dus sprul pa'i chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dgung lo brgya phrag mang por son pa'i mkhan po dang / slob dpon lo paṇa gyi tshogs dka' ba chen pos spyan 'dren par mdzad pas de rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba la yu la dman pa khyad par du 'phags par gzigs te thugs bskyed dus las yol 280

med nas dam pa chos kyi sgron me sbar/ zhing 'di'i ya gyal ru lag bi sa'i cha 'di nyid du'ang rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra'i dngos slob 'khon ston klu dbang bsrung ba solas nas bzung da lta'i bar du'ang 'khon gyi gdung rabs mu tis bi dog pa bstar bzhugs pa'i yab mes gong ma ji snyed pa dang / lhag par chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dgung grangs drug cu bsol kyang sems can gyi don mdzad pa la 'o brgyal gyi rnam pa dang bral te thugs spro bas/ song ma ji 'gir bo dan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin phyags phebs pa dang / gzhan yang rang gzhan gyi mkhas grub bgrang yas kyang tshul de ltar mang du lags na/ rgyu mtshan de rnams kyis da lam grub dbang rin po che nyid kyang spyir btang tsam du/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston/ /ces dang / shing rta'i srol 'byed ma pham pas/ ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /'chi dang na dang rga ba ston/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sku na mtho ba'i tshul gzhes kyis gtsang stod mtho sa grang ngar can gyi yul du phyags phebs dgos pa'i 'o brgyal gyi rang bzhin du gyur rung / sar gnas kyi byang sems chen po rnams/ zhing sbyong ba yul dman pa khyad du 'phags shing /dka' spyad dras pos sems can gyi don mdzad pa sogs gong gi rgyu mtshan rnams kyis na pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa bzhin du thugs spro ba chen pos 'di lo hor zla gsum pa sngon rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gnyis med dus 'khor gsungs pa'i dus chen gyi zla ba'i nang gdan sa 'dir phebs thub pa zhig ci nas kyang mdzad dgos pa ni/ji skad du/chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te//281

'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ /gang si smon lam ci btab pa/ /de yis 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin snyan sgron 'bul mi 'di khar 'byor phral phebs bsu ba shed rtsol gyi gtong rgyur 'dod don la zhu nan che ba zhig mchis kyang da lam phebs bskyod ma gnang ka med lags pas bstan 'gro'i don la thugs bskyed gzhan dring mi 'jog pas re ba'i shing rta yongs su gang ba ci nas kyang zhu/ rten nu bo'i sngags mdud dam rdzas phon che ba dang ngos zung dang lcam bcas nas rab dkar lha gos srid na ring ba re re/rgyan bzhi dmar po yug chen spus legs/ rin chen gnyis pa sung bco lnga bcas phul/ /ces par snang / bka' tham 'di pheb rgyu'i nub/ bsam yas sku rten pa zhal ngo phrin las de nyid dngos yin pa la/ bzhin ras mthing nag bkrag tu brtas pa/ zil gzhan las che ba zhig gis nang mdzod cig /bu har gyi sag lham 'ja' chen gsar pa/ gtsang gi zhwa thul dri med gcig bcas phyag rten du phul nas bstud rjes kho rang 'gying sgeg gis spub chol zhig dkrol/yang de chung 'dug zer/ de bas che ba zhig nged dkrol tu bcug /'di dpal mgon zhal gyi spyan 'dren par snang /'di res kyi bka' shog phebs nan che ba dang / yab rje dam pa de nyid thugs bskyed che zhing / gdung rin po che sku mched rnams dang bcas thugs smon gyi 'brel ba mi bslu ba'i tshul sngar gyi 'ja' sa tham ku'i rmi ltas dang / lhag par gnad byang lung bstan las:de dus las can dag pa'i 'khor: da lta'i 'dus par bcas pa rnams: rgya bod dbus gtsang ma nges par: la la che tshul bla dpon dang: 'ga' zhig dmangs dang tha shal tshul: ma 'gags spyod pa cir yang ston: kun kyang lte sme snying 28 2

mtshan spras: las kyi dbang gis 'dud pa 'byung : zhes pa'i don thog tu babs pas skor cig bka' nan mi gcog par zhus/ tshogs chen 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod snga nur dang / dpal rir nyin bdun gyi bar bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung sgrogs byas/phyag gtod ṭa kha dang zho gsum re'i zong 'gyed bstabs/zla ba gsum pa'i nang sa skya nas rtse drung rin chen sdings pa dpon g.yog lag do rta khal bco lnga bskor bcas 'byor/ de'i nub mi lam du/ sog po gzhon nu nyi shu tham pa yong nas bla ma gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhu ba yin zer/ nged rang khri mthon po zhig sga steng na 'dug pa'i cog tse'i steng nyer spyad 'dra mo'i za ma tog snying gzugs ma zhig phyag rten du phul ba tsa turmu kha'i srog snying du snang /da dbang bskur ba la bod sog phan tshun skad mi go bas ji ltar rung snyam tsa na/de'i dbus na bod skad shes pa gnyis 'dug pa na re/nged kyi gnas na gser gyi rgya thabs dang / rgyal mtshan ni shin tu mang / da gser zangs kyi dar cog zhig 'dzugs snyam pa yin zer ba la/gser zangs la dar cog gi srol mi yong /gardzi ra 'dzugs pa legs byas pas/ de'i bzo dbyibs ji ltar yin zer/ de kha'i mod la gtsug lag khang chen po zhig gi gardzi ra zang thal du mthong byung bas rnam pa 'di 'dra yin zhes bstan pas 'o na de bzhin rang byed dgos 'dug zer nas song / de'i brda ni go /thang grong sanas chen 'khor bcas dang / sa skya'i rtse drung dpon g.yog tshe dbang byas/ zla ba de'i nyi shu bdun la rang gnas nas btegs byi rdzing tshogs su bsdad nub kha che paṇa chen gyi rdza sku snang ba mjal zhing snyan dar phul/ 'du khang du dge 'dun rnams la byin brlabs dang mang ja'i 'brel ba byas/ sang nub gdung phud chos 'khor du 283

ban+dad spyi sger gyi nu/jal zhu'i ska bas sa skyar mtshan nyid slob sanyer la phyin ma ras pa 'i grwa nga bdun 'a so so thar pa la sa brtsam sa pa 'i dri ba 'asa' 'is si mthar lus ngas sga sdo ma pa gzugs can la bye brag mi ba'i lu gas dpyad bzod par spos khang pa'i rab dbye'i 'grel par drangs pa'i don bshad pas khong rnams kyang mgu/ phyi nyin song dkar chos sder bzhi len grub phral gnas mjal zhib par byas / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phye ba dang 'gris pas rten 'brel legs shing gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jug pa'ang byas / lcags zam du lam zhor 'gro rtsis thab bdu dang lam 'dzol bas bkra shis gling du tsha phogs sar sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i phyag tham thebs kyang ya gir dus tshes la ma 'byor dogs pas de nub gan pa la 'og tu snyegs/ sang nyin yar 'bros gci mcho re 'gram du nya pa rnams las gson po gang yod srog bslus shing dpal dir bsdad/ rim pas kha ro la brgyud 'as gnyis pa'i thog rgyang rtser ma sleb tsam la pha lha'i phebs bsu lam rgyus dang bcas rgyang mkhar du 'byor/ yon bdag snying 'dris kyi sger gzhis su bcas mal byas par lus stobs nyams shed chung ba la ngal gsos pa'i tshad du byung /sang nyin dpal 'khor chos sde dang / sku 'bum chen mo zhib par mjal ba'i bum steng sku gnyer rnams kyis ja zhu'i skabs rgyang rtse chos rgyal gyi rnam thar bltas/ mchod rten 'di'i chos 'khor 'di bas ldab 'gyur yod na mchu zhing gab pa'ang rgyur 'dug snyam pa byung / dge tsha'i sgrub mchod dang thug pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mang dag snang ba la rig pa'i me tog dor zhing / rdor dbyings dang dus 'khor la zhib bltas byas/ gur pas mgron por bos/28

dkar spro dang / zur gsos bsta ra bar bla ma bgres song gis zhal ta shā/jad/mang ja'i 'brel ba byas/ de nas rtsis gnas gsar du bsdad/ lha khang byin can gogs pa de mjal/ dkar me snyan shal phul/ btsun chung lnga drug bi spa phud blangs/ grwa tshang de'i zur mjal la mang ja'i slos byas/ pa snam mdo'i nan po phyus po des yar mar gnyis skar zhabs tog legs po byas/ smon khyung ram pa rje btsun ma'i dgon par tsha phogs thos rdzong lo dgu zer bar thang chad pa'i tshad la slebs/ rim par shab dang gyer rgyud/ zla ba bzhi pa 'i tshes bcu ba'i'i nyin dpal ldan sa skya'i lha khang chen mor slebs/ rig 'dzin pho brang du sdod sanas gnang 'dug pa bzhin sleb phral mgron gnyer dang / ma chen gnang nas ja zhus dang / lha rdzas bzang po stsal nas bde bar spyon nam/bskyod pa ya nga ngam zo ma dog bde bar gyur grang zhes ngal bso 'i dbugs byin chen po la sbyar ba'i bsti ba thob/ sang nyin tshes bco lnga'i dus khyad par can gyi nyi shar dang po la gzim chung du 'bod mi gnang ba bzhin gong ma rin po che sku ma ched dang mjal / sngar nas 'dris shing bshes pa lta bu'i 'al ta nang mar sanang / byings dmangs la brtse chen lha khang du 'byor phyag thos mjal rten gyi rnam pa rnams phul/ de nyin dus chen khyad chos dung dkar po rgyang grags bus/ lha khang chen mo'i mchod mjal gyi sne shan dge slo nga bgres po bsod nams bzang po sanang / khong rab 'byams pa don mthun lo rgyus la'ang 'dris pas gnas bshad dang 'brel bar gna' gtam kyang zhib par byung / mchod me snyan shal rgyas par bstar/ sgrol ma lha khang der snang ba 'gyur zhing gsal snang 'dra'ang shar/ phyi nas bzhi thog dbu rtse mjal dus rgya sgo 'i 285

steng logs la sa paṇa gyi gsung rtsom/ sgra pa nga yin rtog se pa nga smra ba ngan 'joms nga 'dra med/ /sdeb sbyor nga mkhas snyan ngag nga nyid mngon brjod 'chad la 'gran med nga / /dus sbyor ngas shes phyi nang kun rig rnam dpyod blo gros mtshungs med nga / /de 'dra gang yin sa skya pa ste mkhas pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/ /zhes snang / de lta mod kyi phyi nas ni gzugs brnyan las 'das pa'ang 'di ltar ro zhes pa'i phyir/ sgra rjes don 'jug rtog ger mi rton grub mtha' ngan 'joms ngag gi dbang / /ldeb sbyor don 'brel snyan dngags rgyan 'drongs mngon brjod rig byed rjes su min/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis bden don la reg rten cing 'brel 'byung kun rdzob tsam/ /dbu ma'i gtan tshigs chen po rnam bzhis rtag chad rgol ba 'thas pa'i phyir/ /bde gshegs ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan dri med 'od zer stong du 'bar/ /zhes pa 'di bris nas phun tshogs gling bi rgya sgo'i ya them la sbyar/ smra ba'i dbang phyug anan+ta na re/de yang de ltar yin med kyi mu stegs pa tshar gcod nus pa ni dkon pa'i dngos po can no zer/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod la dbang phyug nag po'i grub mtha' bkod nas/ gzung 'dzin rnam shes dang 'brel ba dang / yongs grub ye shes la spyod pa'i rigs pa khyad par can gyis rtag chad mthar 'dzin gyi rgol ba tshar gcad pa'i gtan tshigs mngon sum par grub pa yin no/ /zhes smras pas gdul bar rung ba ni skyes bu'i mtshan nyid yin pas rjes su yi rang ba mngon par phyogs so/ /gtsang khang gi 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba mjal zhing nye logs la 'phrog byed dga' bo'i ral pa mthong bas rje btsun sa paṇa gyis slob dpon chos kyi grags pa'i rnam par thar pas bstan pa la bya 286

ba byas so snyam mos pa thob/ de ltar na'ang sdom gsum rab dbye ni drang nges ldem dgongs bzhi dang ldan pa yin na 'grel pa 'ba' zhis ha cang yang thal ba'i gnas su mthong ngo / /de nas thong ma rin po che nyi shu rtsa sasum pa'i sku tshe'i phreng bsal ba dang / gzhi thog pho brang zhig gso rgya che'i rkyen sel du rdo rje phur pa dang sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sbyin sreg 'bum ther/ nyang gter khros nag ma'i me mchod de mtshungs/ pho brang gsar pa la bgeg skyod dang sbyin sreg tshar gsum/ de nas dam pa chos kyi bdud rtsi 'bul ba'i dang por/ tshe rta zung 'brel gyi dbang sgo phye nas rmi lam lung gsal bzhin byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i thugs sgrub gter kha 'og ma'i lugs kyi rtsa dbang rgyas pa nas bzung /rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i dbang chen la/ dbang gi rnam dbye dang 'jug tshul gyi khyad par yo ga 'og ma dang mi 'dra ba bla na med pa'i snying thig ya bzhi/ bka' brgyad bder 'dus/ gsang ba yongs rdzogs/ gshin rje tshe bdag /klong chen snying jig /phur pa rgyud lugs rnams dang / gsar ma la 'dus pa 'phags lugs/ bde mchog lu yi pa/'jigs byed rwa lugs te dbang bka' chen po bcu gsum lhag bcas dang /'jam dkar ma ti lugs sogs rjes gnang kha shas/ chos skyong skor la rga lo'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ shangs mgon phyag drug pa/ lha chen po/ khyab 'jug rog ti tshe ring la sogs phul zhing /la la'i bla rdo srog 'khor kyang bcas/ lar yab rje dam pa'i spyan ltos kyi bstan pa la phyag bzhes che bas gsar rnying gi dbang bka' yod tshad zhu gsung yang / nged ni sgom pa gtso bor 'don pa las thob rgya gtso por mi gnyer bar ma zad mdo dbang la sogs pa'i bka' gter kyi 287

chos rtsa ba che ba 'ga' zhig dpe cha yang ma sleb pas phyi nas smon pa'i yul du byas nas/ da res kyi char thugs rgyud grol bar byed pa khrid kyi gnas la gtso bor bton pa'i tshul/ dang po smin byed kyi dbang ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa 'i bdag nyid can dang / khams drug ldan gyi rdo rje'i lus la rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams dbang sga cho gas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du smin pa'i bya ba ni bla med kyi rgyud sde chen po gcig gis dbang bzhi tshang la ma nor bas 'grub la / 'dir yon tan rin po che'i mdzod kyi bshad 'grel dang mtshungs ldan gyi khrid la mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pas sngon 'gro'i skor skyes bu gsum gyi lam dang 'brel pa la sa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la rtsal 'don dang /de'i byang sdom gzhes pa la bab pa na/ sems bskyed mchod pa'i don du gtsug lag khang spyir stong mchod/ chos dung gsung bskul/ srog bslu rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi dus chen nyin phur khang chen mor rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas rgyas pa dang stabs gcig tu bsgrub par brtsams pa na bdag chen rin po che'i mnal ltas su/ da res phur khang du bla ma rdzogs chen pa la yang dag gi dbang zhus shig zer ba byung gsungs nas yang dag gi dbang dpe sku mdun du bsher 'dug /de la spyir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi gtso bo rdo rje phur par snang zhing / dngos grub brnyes pa'ang rgyun mi 'chad du byung ba'i rten 'brel dang bstun/ rgyud 'bum rin po che nas lo paṇa tha dad pa'i 'gyur mi gcig pa'i chos kyi rnams grangs brgyar nye ba nas legs par btus pa'i phur pa rgyud lugs kyi dkyil 288

'khor dang por zhal phye ba'i smin dbang gi snod du yi dam gyi lung bstan par snang / yang dag gi sgra ni chos de rang bzo'i sgro skur dang bral ba'i brdar snang ba de kha'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas 'o na ci nas kyang zhu zhes phebs pa ltar nyin snga mar rab gnas kyi sta gon grub ma thag slob ma sta bon byas/ phyi nyin 'dzam bu'i gling la nyi ma dros chen tshe spyan dbye grub par byas pa'i 'gros kyi snga dro'i char dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed phog ste dam pa'i skyes bu la gdod nas grub pa'i rigs lhag par sad nas byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang la mnga' gsol/ de'i rjes 'brel du sku mched gsum ka la phur pa brgyud lugs kyi dbang ma tshang ba med pa dang /mtha' rgyas su bshad pas sna drangs pa'i gser zangs kyi rdzas brgyad las chos dung ngo ma dang bcas phyag tu phul nas dga' ston gyi bar rgyas par byas/dngos cag la'ang gos dar gyi tshad grangs dang /bzang ja/ sa'i snying po dang bcas pa'i rab ston gya rnam par stsal to/ /de nas dngos gzhi la gsang sngags spyi'i gzhung lam dang mthun pa'i smin byed dang bskyed rdzogs phan tshun rten dang brten pa lta bur gnas pa'i bshad dang mthar gyi rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum la brten nas chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa blo tshod kyis bsgrub pa'i stong nyid med dgag dang / ma yin dgag gi 'gal 'brel la brten nas dbu ma chen mo la sogs pa'i chos skad tshon po'i rgo yul dang /gsum pa'i tshor ba las skyes pa'i dpe'i ye shes zag bcas pa la bde stong rgya che chung du 'dod pa'ang rgyu 'bras ltar byung ba'i dngos po skye ba'i bdag nyid can gyi stong nyid yin pas re zhig gi rnam par rtog pa tsam sdom yang sangs rgyas kyi zag pa med pa'i chos stobs 289

sa la mthong / 'dir rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i shes rab kyi sgom pa de ni rang gi ngo bo nyid kyi rig cing zad pa'i bdas nyid can yin pas dngos por 'dzin pa rdul tsam yang ma dmigs shing / mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa'i chos thams cad zad par 'gyur ba de la skye ba ga la yod/ de'i phyir skye ba'i bdag nyid can gyi sems zad pa dang / zad pa'i bdag nyid can mi skye ba shes pa'i shes rab rig thog tu nyams su myong ba'i steng nas gnas lugs ngo sprod shes na sang zag rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ste/ rje btsun sa skya pa dang po'i khungs kyang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i dngos slob yin la/ bar skabs su gong ma lnga la sogs pa ni phyi 'gyur spel ba'i bdag po'i rkyen du rten 'brel dang smon lam gyi stobs las grub cing phyi nas gsar rnying ris su chad pa'i dgag sgrub la chos su 'dzin pa ma yin pas bstan pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag yin pa'i phyir dpal mgon zhal gyi lung bstan gser gyi gardzi ra'i brda theg pa thams cad kyi rtse mo rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyal thabs la mnga' gsol ba'i don du song ngo / /rje btsun che zhe dam pas kyang bsnyen bkur yang yang dang / yum ku'i skor nyams gzhes kyi phyag dpe sdog par mdzad/ lha khang chen mo'i dge bshes ming don mthun pa'i drung rams pa a nan+ta shrī bha dra dang mdo sngags gnyis ku'i chos kyi 'bel gtam rgyud mar byung /khong gis mdzod 'grel gnyis kyang zhib mor gzigs nas dogs pa'i gnas la gnyis ka 'dzom thog tu dag ther byas/ lar rtog ge'i rig pa rno ba tsam la rgyu mtshan med de/ chos don gyi dbyings 'jal shes pa la mkhas pa zer/ khong dngos la mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa dang ldan pas bla ma dang mjal ba rje btsun sa 290

skya pa'i thugs rje yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal nas slob mar gyur pa byed pa la dbang bskur tshad ldan zhig thob dgos pas ci nas rjes su 'dzin dgos zhes bstud nas zhu bar phur pa rgyud lugs kyi ras bris su smin par byas/ dbu ma'i grub mtha' la shin tu chub kyang / chos nyid kyi bden pa mang du thos shing dben pa bsten pa'i bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas thob dgos pas bsam sgom gyi shes rab rig thog tu thug par byas/sngar gyi mi ltas su bod skad go ba gnyis shig 'dug pa der snang / khong gi theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi zin bris shig mdzad 'dug pa las 'phros te bslab bya'i gnang bkag la dpyad pa'i tshigs bcad de bris/ chos 'khor lhun po'i byams mgon dang / slob dpon chen po'i sku so sor snyan shal dang dkar me/ grwa tshang la mang ja sogs bskur/ de pa'i grwa pa bco lnga skor la rnam rgyal ma'i rjes gnang dang / mgron gnyer sbos skyab dang bcas nyi shu skor la byang gter thugs sgrub kyi dbang yang bskur/ bla ma bshes gnyen pa dang mjal zhing chos 'brel zhig dbos gsung ba ltar byas/ sa skya pa'i mdun na 'don chen po lan bzhi lnga tsam phebs shing bsnyen bkur dang gser 'phru gsar brdung sogs la thugs 'gan cher bzhes gnang / 'bri gung pa'i bla mtshan gyis nged cag tshar bcad la dmigs 'dra ba'i kun mkhyen chen po'i gzhung la'ang dogs pa'i dri ba mang rab cig bris pa 'dir 'byor ba la/ lan kai ta ku'i rna rgyan zhes bya ba bris nas gtam tshogs su bsdus/ yum ga'i mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog gi rten 'brel dang por/ sa skya pa sku mched la phul bas mnal ltas ngo mtshar can byung gsung / lha khang chen mor mang ja sbyor thel btang / re zhig 'dug na dgongs 29

pa 'dus kyang spyir na tshod thal/sgos sa chu mi 'phrod pa'i snyan 'bul yang zhus rnam pa kun tu bla mar bya ba'i ldang ba dang / bste stang dang / gdan bzos la sogs pa'i rim gros bzungs shing / gser dngul / ja gos dar sogs sashegs rdzongs gya rnam pa bstsal te rang gnas su phyogs/ rtse drung dge 'dun bkra shis can la sa do rta khal nyi shu skor bcas dal 'gros kyis bskyod/ rgyang rtser pha lha'i sger gzhis su zhag bcu skor bcags mal byas/ rang slo ba dad ldan chos gsal spun dang / phan bde bcas nas 'khos su phebs pa'i bsnyen bkur dang / brtan bzhugs/ 'bul nod sogs yang dag bsgrubs /rin sdings pa'i bla rgan dge slong rin chen bstan dar dad mos che bas smin khrid kyis rjes su bzung / dpal sdings pas dgon par bskyod dgos nan che yang rta drel rnams sa rong rtsub mor 'tsher bas bskyod ma thub/ ma jal mi dang chos 'brel shi gson gyi bsngo zhus sogs mang dag bi re ba skong / rgyang ru cis kyi lha khang la mchod pa dang nang mdzod bskur/ rgyal po'i khi mun du chud pa 'i rkun po'i rgyu 'bras la snying rje chen po skyes shing bza' btung gis phan btasas/lug lnga'i sros bskyabs/ yar lam phra skyong nas kyi gzhis mar zhag gsum thog /dpal sdings dpon sayos dang bcas pa la tshe dbang byin rlabs sogs byas/rim pas yar 'brog rgyud rang gnas su bde bar 'byor/ zla ba dgu pa shar phral phur pa rgyud lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris nas dpon slob bco lnga skor gyi sgrub chen 'ag bcu pa zhis btsubs/ gzhis ka nas sbyin bdas pang len mdzad/ de mtshams sde dbe nas rdzogs chen sprul pa 'i sku rin po che'i chab shog zhib rgyas dang bla ma bsod nams chos ldan can dpon sayog lnga 29 2

gdan 'dren la 'ong tshul rgyas par bsnya da rdzobs chen sprul pa'i sku snga ra 'dir phebs skabs mjal ma thub pa'i gsu nga cong dang bcas pa'i rgyu mtshan bskyar nas nyin mang po bsnud de nan chasas mdzad/ lam rtags su byang chub sems dpa' zhig mjal bar rmis/ khong mi gzhi bzang zhing la sa can gyi slob mar 'dus pa 'i phyir sngar yon tan rin po che'i mdzod ma thong ba nas bzung ste bla ma 'di dang ma mjal bar du rgya gar rdo rje bdan la 'gro dgos byung yang zhi ma shi med snyam pa'i sdod mi zus par byung zer/ nged dang por mjal dus thang sto nga rgyal po'i sku phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang / g.yo na tshe bum 'dzin pa zhig gi nu ma g.yon pa nas tshe chu tshe ril tshe bsgrub kyi chos skor dang bcas thon pa dang / yang shes rabagater ston zer ba zhis gis rgya gar gyi ri bo mchog rab kyi rtse nas slob dpon chen po'i sku brgya rtsa brgyad blang rgyu'i kha byang bstan pa zhig dang / tsan dan dmar po'i sku mang po thu bar babs pa sogs byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags dad pa can la 'byung ba chos nyid kyang yin/khong cag shul ring gi 'gron po yi chad pa med par rjes su bzung ste de ma thas 'khrid kyi mgo btsugs/ ring min sde dge rgyal po'i mdun na 'don gshen rabs stag rgyal dpon sayog gzhung bi sne shan dang bcas 'byor/ rgyal po'i chab cog dngul sung nyer lnga'i rten bcas sprad nas/ zhu yis nang gsal ltar nged kyi las don bla ma gdan 'dren la ched du mngags pa yin na spyan 'dren ma thub par 'gro thabs med tshul la na grangs mang por bstud nas bsnyad/ spyir sa skyong sde dge 'di yab mes gong ma nas dkon mchog gsum la bla mar byed/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gus pas bka' bstan gyi gtsos bstan 293

pa'i rtsa lag chen por gyur pa'i gsung par stobs po che bskrun pa sogs rnam dkar phyag gzhes rgya che/ris med pa'i bstan pa la gus shing rgyal srid chos kyi lugs su skyong ba'i chos rgyal du nges na dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po'i lung gis skabs dbye ba ltar kho bo cag mchod yul kyi dam par bzung nas rang gi mnga' ris su spyan 'dren pa'i ngag 'di ni ldog tu mi rung ba'i gnas su mthong mod/ gzhan phan 'grub pa'i gnas skabs na zhi bde la gzhol ba byang chung sems dpa'i rtsa ltung nyid du nges par ma zad 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i gtam las kyang / mkhas pa rang gi yul bas kyang / /yul khams gzhan du mchod pa thob/ /nor bu gzhan du brin pa tsam/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du ga la byin/ /zhes pas kyang gsal lo/ /khyad par lo gsum dang po'i rmi ltas su mdo khams sde dge'i phyogs nas lhags pa'i yig sgril la dar cog chen po'i don ni rgyal bu 'di dang las 'brel can du go yang slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ bgrod par bgyi 'os khrod lags na/ /bkug kyang ma mchis gang lags te/ /ma gus ma lags brnyas ma lags/ /rga dang nad kyis bar chad bgyis/ zhes pa ltar de ni na tshod kyang thal/ gzugs cong bas 'gro 'dug gi zer re mi bzod cing / sa chu brjes pa las glo bur du nad sna mang po 'du byed pas lam bar du'ang sngar bsam mchims su 'dug skabs kyi mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar/ mi'i ngo 'dzin dang chos lugs brgyad la brten nas rnyed pa dang snyan grags ma btsal/grong chog las byol/ dkor rngam po che la ci mi snyam par ma spyad cing / thabs lam zab mo'i rten 'brel dang bcas je 'phel du gyur pa yin na/ phyogs su ring ba'i bshul lam dang / sa chu'i 'du 'phrod tsub mos sgyu ma'i phung po la 294

nyam nyes par gyur na ni/ khyed cag la'ang phan par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir na/slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ 'gro dang 'ong ba'i rten tsam du/ /lus la gru yi blo bzhag ste/ /sems can rnams don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin gyis ni lu sa su bsgyur/ /zhes pa'i don la sems bskyed pa'i gegs su 'gyur bar shes ldan su zhig byed/gal te bdag nyid la thugs je yod na rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis bsrungs pa'i yul khams la gnod sbyin srun lngas 'tshe bar ma nus pa bzhin de ring gi nyin par nas sa skyong sde dge dang mchod yon du 'brel bas 'di phyir dge ba'i srung skyob dang smon pa'i tha gus sgril lo zhes pa'i don zhib par labs/ rgyal po'i mdun na 'don blo gros dkyel che zhing / lugs gnyis ka la gzhig pa che bas kho bos 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / las 'bras mi bslu ba'i rgyu mtshan la brten rgyal po'i las don dang / rang srog bsrung ba'i phyir ma gtogs gzhan du srog mi gcod pa'i dam bca' byas pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ gzhan du na khong rtsed sna'i phyir du'ang mang po'i srog 'phrog pa la ci mi snyam pa can yin pas yar lam gna' ba rang yang nyi shur nye ba song zer/ khong cag la tshe dbang dang bka' bsgo byin rlabs sogayobyas shing / rgyal por sa la spyod pa'i rna rgyan zhes bya ba'i springs yig kyang byas/ bla ma bsod nams chos ldan can la sems bskyed kyi mchod pa dang 'brel bar byang sdom phog pa'i nub khong gi mi lam na mchod rten dkar po bang rim lnga pa zhig gi dang po khro chus bsdams pa nas gter thon cig ces nged kyi gzong zhig gtad pa ltar g.yengs pas ring bsrel dkar yol do dang / yol go gcig na skye bdun sku sha yin zer ba snang ba las/ring bsrel sangs rgyas 'od 295

srung gi yin zer/ de nas dasar yo la gang po bla ma la phul/ cig shos nas mang po byin pas zad rgyu med par byung zer/ nged rgyal po kṛ kṛ'i sras su gyur pa'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs la sems bskyed thob tshul gyi nying 'khrul bden na khong si chos kyi gdung 'dzin cing sems can la phan thogs par rig /rgyu mtshan des bla ma dgongs 'dus sogs bka' gter gyi chos rnams bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs dang / snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rin po che'ang lus nyams kyi ji ltar dposas pa bklags shing / de nas gzugs can gyi dbang po rgyun yod kho nar mnyan po la 'tshal ba dang / gzugs can ma yin pa'i dbang shes kyis gtad rgya yang dag byas/ 'di lo 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod snga nur dang / sa ga'i nya la bsam yas su stong mchod rgyas par bshams te snyan shal/ tsholas bskang smon lam sogs sngar bzhin byas/ mnga' ris grwa tshang pa nyi shu skor gyis nyin sasum mdo mangs gsung sgrogs dang / sdom gsum yar ldan la dasag sgrub byed par bskul bas gnas 'gyur mi 'dod pa'i dpe la/ dge slong bis dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs na dge slong de dbe tshul du 'gyur ba thal/ zhes brjod song bas thabs dang shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa'i 'thad pa btang snyoms su byas nas 'bras bu rgyur ldog par bsgrub pa de rtog ge'i rig pa rang du 'dug snyam pa byung / dpal rir zhabs tog nyin 'khyongs 'gyed bcas dang / rgyal mtshan bkra shis dgu brtsegs che ba zhig bskrun nas mchod rdzas su sbyar/ rang re'i gtsug lag khang gi rtser dngul sung brgya phrag thal nges kyis bskrun pa'i saser 'phru zhig btsugs/ de ltar rang lo nga brgyad pa yan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa 'di ni mdo khams pa 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer 296

dang sa skyong sde dge'i mdun na 'don gyis bskul ba'i ngor dpal ldan pad+ma 'od gling du bris pa'o//yang dad pa can mang po'i ngor 'phro nas bshad na/ rta lo 'di'i dbyar ril por dbu mdzad rogs bcas kyi phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sku tshad brkyang grur ldang pa'i thang chen bcu gsum gser 'gro gang che byas pa bzhengs/ song sham rgyan bzhi tshal kha dang / mthongs sma la sham sngon po/ tog tsan dan/ zhal khebs sman rnying can grub nas so sor bstod pa'i rgyab yis dang / dngos sta stel ma'i rab gnas nyin gnyis song / rang slob mon ljongs mkhar bla ma dpon slob nyi shu skor byon par klong snying bi 'khrid smin rgyas su byas khong smin gling du 'byon rgyur snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa snying la bcangs nas bka' ma'i dbang lung gi rgyun gang yod zhu bar bskul/ tshur lam de rnams nged rang nyan pa yin byas tshe nged kyi bla ma la 'bul mi nus zhes bag tsha bar mdzad kyang / ston pa mya ngan las 'da' khar/ kun dga' bo'i lag pa nas bzung nas/ nga'i dam pa'i chos dkon mchog gi mdzod dad pa dang / 'dun pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bag yod pa gsum gyi gzung zhig ces gsungs pa yin na/ da ni bstan pa nub pa la phyogs pas 'di lta bu'ang gnas yin no zhes skabs dbye nas/ sgyu 'phrul zhi ba dang khro bo/ sa ngas rgyas mnyam sbyor yang dag zla sam dgu pa/ sems sde bco brgyad/ na raka dong sprugs/ bka' ma'i mgon po legs ldan sogs nyan/ dkyil thang bzhengs/ dbang chog /sgrub phrin phyag rgya/ thig rtsa sogs kyang blangs nas rdzogs chen pa'i bla mchan bsod nams chos ldan la'ang 'phel bar byas pa mdo khams su phan la re/ sto/ 9/ra

rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas phur pa rgyud lugs kyi sgrub chen gyi thog mtsho sna nas dgon rtse sprul sku rin po che'i gsung bris snyan tshig can zhib la bcar ba 'byor/ rten 'brel khyad par can gyis mtshams sbya ra nas lhun grub pho brang gi nang rten rat+na pa'i sgrub phur de 'dir lo ltar gyi bsgrub pa dang /'phar ma bcas la shin tu mkho che bas bslu ma tsam gyi rgyu mtshan zhus par sprul sku rin po che thugs bskyed dang dbongs pa che bas 'dir ring lugs 'dzin pa ni med/der bstan don la sman na rtsa ba nas 'bul zhes bskyel mi gnang /khro bcu gyar shing byings rnams tsan dan dkar dmar sha stag la/ phra phyag rnams nyams dod pa 'dug /phur pa byin rlabs can de yang rdul khrod nas 'gro don che sar phebs pas chos bdag dgyes pa'i mtshan ma'ang mthong / de yang mdo las/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yis gus phyir min/ /zhes pa ltar gang zag dam pa rnams ni chos kyi mtshan nyid rang stobs kyis dpyod cing blun dad dang phyogs 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang ba ma yin pas kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i thugs mos kyi drangs te mdzod bdun dang / shing rta skor gsum cha tshang zhig gnyer gdams la/yon dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga byung ba mdo khams kyi 'grim 'grul lo phyed dang gnyis thog tu phyag tu 'byor pa byas/ yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel kyang gsar bskrun bcas gang zhig bstan pa la phyag bzhes che ba rnams bstan 'dzin du 'bod kyis/ bcom chen po dang rang gzhan gyi phyogs ris che ba ni byis pa so so skye bo thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'o/ /ra ston sku skye rin po che 298

dang / khams bla can sogs nyi shu skor la bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang chen po ti lung dbang dang bcas pa byas/ de'i tshe khams bla la badz+ra a tsar+ya nyang ral pa can dang / rang nyid bu dī par gsal snang mngon sum shar zer/khams rdzogs chen pa'i gra ris sgom chen rig 'dzin can gnyis lto thebs dngul rta mis ma zhig yod pa ra mo che'i 'gag tu grwa pa zhig bis sil ma dang brje rogs bya'o zer dngul nang logs su khyer nas sgo ra ma don pas khong gnyis yi chad nas byung /dngul bor bas mtshon gzu bor mi gnas pa rkyang pa dang phrad zer ba la/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyed mdo khams nas byon pa'i ban gzhon gnyis/ /dang po grwa sar zhugs pa de/ /btsun gzugs yin te legs smon tsam/ /de nas grogs po cig shos la/ /khyim par 'bab dgos zer ba de/ /dpon gyi ngag bkod la brdzus pa'i/ /bdud kyi bslu brid dang po yin/ /de nas 'bros pa'i bsam pa ni/ /dkon mchog bi skyabs 'og tu tshud pas byung / /da ni dkon mchog gi drin bsams las/ /mi lus lan cig thob pa 'di/ /stong log byas na glen pa yin/ /srog la bab pa'i gegs byung kyang / /dam chos blo yi ma gtong ang / /de nas chos 'khor lha sa ru/ /rta mig thur srang lnga bcu po/ /ma byin blangs pa'i lag tu shor/ /khyed gnyis la sprang po'i go 'phang dang / /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal mngon sum bstan/ /byed po dge slong yin zer na/ /khong gi so so thar pa de/ /dge slong lhas byin dang ro gcig gyur/ /sdom rtsa gcad pa snying re rje//de gcig tu rang gi tshe rabs sngon//ma sbyin blangs pa'i rnam smin yin//gnyis su lan chags 'khor ba'i phyir/ /khong la phan pa'i sems bskyed 2/9/ /

sbyin pa'i bsod nams nges par thob/ /de phyir la sa 'bras la gus par mdzod /bla ma'i gnas tshul dris tsa na/ /gter gsar phyogs mi 'dzin zhes bskur/ chos kyi spyan ldan bai ro la'ang / /ngan snga gas phra men can zer na /dngos cas tsam la smos ci dgos/ /gcis tu de ltar yin pa srid/ /rang nyid gzu bor gnas bsams kyang / /khong gis de ltar mthong ba'i phyir/ gnyis su khyed gnyis chos kyi phyir/ /dngos la gtad nas yong ba'i phyir/ /bla ma dmod pa'i gang zag dang / /phrad nas 'gro lam dgag pa de/ /bdud kyi grogs dang mngon sum phrad/ /dase ba'i grolas kyi rten 'brel las/ ngo mtshar med kyang dngos cas dang / /phrad nas dam chos thob pa 'di/ /byang chub sems kyi nus mthu yin/:/dbang khrid gdams pa mngon du bstan/ /rang sems chos skur ngo sprad pas / /da res bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal/ /da rung byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdud kyi phrang la zad pa med/ /de bas skyes pa'i pha yul spongs/ /chags sdang grwa sa'i 'brel 'dris zhig /grong chog rnyed 'tshol la ma zhen/ /byis dang sdig grogs 'du 'dzi gsum/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i gnad gcod yin/ /de phyir dben pa 'ba' zhig bsten/ /khams pa'i blo gshed as sprang dang / /bod pa'i g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi/ /rnam thar ma 'dzin dma' sa zungs/ /blo gtad dkon mchog gsum la gyis/ /rang ngo rig pas mi chog gis/ /dran pa nyams pas 'khar bar 'khyams/ /de phyir rig pa rkyang ded thongs/ci/skyid sdug legs nyes rnam rtos gi//gzhi rtsa chod la rang ngo ltos/ /lam la gol 'phyugs spang ba'i phyir/ /yon tan rin chen mdzod 'di zungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /kun rdzob don dam gnyis la 'du/ /de phyir phyin drug lam mchog la/ /brten nas tshogs 300

sanyis rdzos/sa pa ra mdzod/ /ro snyom sa la ma du slong shes na/ rkyen ngan tham sa cad dge ba'i sngosas /yin gyis 'o sa lta'i rim sngo spo ngas / /nga yis bsgo sa pa bzhin bsgrub na/ /nam zhis thugs yid 'dres gyur nas / /blo 'das chen po'i rtogs pa 'char/ /chos sku'i klong na gnyis su med/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /ces pa 'dis sems la phan thogs chen po byung zer/ khams pa'i bla ma mi la ras pa zhes byang gnam mtshor bya bral gyis 'tsho ba zhig gis 'di khar phyag bris mdzad nas/ nged 'dir 'byor nas lo sasum song / dbon gnas chung ngu zhis bcas pa dang slob ma'i tshogs khyed la 'bul bas cis kyang 'di phyogs su phebs dgos zhes 'dus /khong das snang chen po zhig yod 'dug pas 'di phyogs su sprin la tshad ba'ag pa phyag mdzad zer/ byang sha zan gyi yul du 'gro ga la nus/ 'byor lan dam rdzas kyi 'brel ba dang bcas phul /'di ska bas lo snga phyi tshor 'brum pa 'i nad yams tho re long kun tu khyab pas gnas nas dbyung ba rnams la snying rje drag po skyes/ de la dmigs nas phur nga 'i bsgrub pa dang / sbyin sreg /zas sasur bsngo ba la sogs pa byas/ byis pa gter ston gyi 'brum bsru nga zab mo de dar cog la bris/ shis brjod dang smon tshig kyang sbyar/ shrī par+sha ta dang 'di gnyis kur btsugs pas nad de ye ma byung /bsrung ba de yid ches kyi sanas su 'dug kyang /'di tshor pho lha 'i byin brlabs yin zer/ yin shas kyang che/ rang ngo la snying rje dang phan sems dras po rgyun mi 'chad bar thar bas bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel/ nye skor gyi ri sul du dbyung pa tshor phan du re nas sman pa drag pa 'dra la yon chen po bstabs nas mi na sbyin gtong rogs bskul kyang thog tu khel min ma shes/ ltogs grir thi nye 301

rnams la sde par yang bskul nas yon mchod gnyis gas rtsam pa khal rgyab gsum bskyel du btang bas phan thogs byung nges/ de'i tshe rmi lam na mchims phu'i ge'u 'og de yin rgyu'i mdun na chu chen po dba' rlabs can 'gro/ de'i brag la chu 'thab kyi lam la ma thar nas phyir log tsa na/ chu'i pha ri na btsun gon ma mgo dkar 'gro shes tshad cig pang na me lhab lhab 'bar ba dang /phrag pa na snod chus bkang khyer nas khyor khyor 'gro ba mthong / ri de'i rgyab tu sleb pa dang rgan mo de chus khyer med las che snyam pa'i ngang la grwa pa zhig byung /de la rgan mo de chus khyer na snying rje/ khyod kyis zung shog byas pas dbugs ma chad tsam byas pa mchan 'og tu khyer byung bas nad bdag yin pa 'dra/de gso ba'i thabs byed kyin yod tsa na/ ban+de de na re/ de ring bskang gso'i 'du ba la 'ongs/ tshogs 'khor ma byung / da slob dpon pad+ma'i dge bsnyen jo bo nag khyung yin zer/ lar bskang gso smar changs byas pas tshogs sogs rjes chog kyang ga la yong / de skabs bsams par nyin ltar gtor gsos thog dpal chen gyi las gzhung bsrangs/de yang bselas gtor dang tshogs med na gnyis ka la phan yon re yod pa de ma bsams par snang / des gdon bgegs kyi gnyen por yang 'gro/tshong dang so nam sogs la snying thag pa nas mi dga' ste/rting sor phyogs 'gron mang / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / sgrub mchod stong mchod sogs sgo sang sa nas nyos pa gcig pus 'u mi 'dus zer/khral mi 'di tsho'ang rgya rdugs skabs snga phyi ring thung tsam yang bkag na de'ang sdig par 'dus /de la sprod rgyu ni zhing chung re gnyis las ci yod rgyu des mchod khang 'dir yang nyin ltar zhal zas gsum re ma chag na lo gcig la 302

stong mchod 'gro/ de bzhin du dkon gnyer des snga zhogs kyi char bka' 'gyur rgyun klog gi sgra ma chag tsam byung na dge sdig 'dun pa'i khyad par du 'dug pas 'brel thogs thams cad la phan nam snyam ste dbe sbyong ko ka li'i log 'tsho'i rtsod pa la yid 'byung ngo / /rang lo drug cu pa me sprel gsaras thag chos rje brag phug pa dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang bi dge slong ri khrod pa 'jam dbyangs can la rgya can gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang / klong snying gi rtsa dbang kyang bzhed sbya ra byas/ de skabs chos rje'i mi lam na ngos khri chen po'i khar 'dug pa'i rtsa na dge slong rnam rgyal ba yod pa la nang bcar 'dris bshes che mdog byed pa'i mur khang gis slebs tsa na/ nga lnga pa chen po'i dus kho gsol dpon chung ba yin pas 'di ltar red zer/ de khong la bsnyad pas de'i rgyu mtshan bla ma'i phyag rtags kyi mnan pa dgos zer skad/dge slong lnga pa chen po la mos pa chen por snang bas de'i rten 'brel 'dra/ 'di skabs rmi lam na stag lpags chen po zhig 'bul mkhan byung ba chos skyong gi phrin la sa su snang /'di lo gong sa rin po che'i sku tshe tshe bsgrub dang bstan don lar rgya'i sku rim byed dbos kyi rgya ma rim par byung / lar skyes bu'i tshe mi rtag cing zang zing la snying po med pa de rtag par dran pa'i steng / bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi rtsa ba bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas gso ba'i lung bstan bzhin bar khang g.yu bcal du byang chen mchod rten thog tshad bzhengs pa'i nyer bsdogs yid la bkod kyang bzo bo mkhas pa zhis ma 'byor/ dkon mchog gsum mchog yin pa'i bden pas 'dod dpal mkhan po sde pa spyang grong chos mdzad rang re la thugs mos thob nas bstan bcos gsar brtsams rigs g.yar po 303
