dgos tshul gnang de lan dang sbrags mchod sdong si rgyu mtshan phul bar sdom 'byung las/ shar gyi lus 'phags ba lang spyod/ /de bzhin byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /gling gsum po yi mi rnams ni/ /longs spyod chen pos yang dag 'tsho/ /rnam rtog med cing rtog dpyod med/ /blun rmongs bye brag mi phyed pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling du legs skyes pa/ /las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ /legs byas nyes par byas pa'i la sa/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yid/ /skyes ba sngon ma'i rnam smin 'dir/ /skye bo kun la mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bzo lanas sprul pa'i rig pa stobs su gyur kyang / de'i grub 'bras kyis chos 'khor gsum la sogs pa spangs nas sa mtha' 'grim pa la'ang dpyad pa zhugs 'dra bas 'di ni don chen kho nar 'dug pas bya ba'i khur bdag gis blang bar bya'o zhes rtser snyan zhus la'ang bla ma'i 'di bstan 'gro'i bde thabs su 'dus pas grogs dan bzang po gyis phebs/ de ma thag rang lugs kyi thig rtsa'i 'char dang /bzo rgyu rta mig mas gtsos pa'i rgya dngul ngo thog gi 'phros rnams 'di lo 'dzar khyad srang bdun cu don gnyis don gsum sha stag bis brjes nas spyir rgya dngul srang lnga brgya/ gser srang bcu gnyis/ phul zangs khal bcu gnyis/ in+d+ra rī la rin thang can gyis gtsos pa'i rin che'i 'phra rgyan lag tu gang yod dang / gzhis ka g.yung drung nas spos shel che legs/ che zhe tshe ring mas a sgor phul ba bcas phral rdzong byas/rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang / zhes pa ltar 'di bstan 'gro'i don chen yin pas gser dngul bkal ba'i dre'u 'dam la rgyag grabs dang / gtsang chu la 'gro grabs sogs 'tshub cha re che byung zer/ /nag phyogs pa'i mthu dkar phyogs kyi bden pas 304

'joms pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin pas rnam dkar gyi bungs bskyed pa dang / sprel lo snga phyi gsum gyi khongs su mchod pa sna lnga khri tshar rdzogs pa'i slad cho 'phrul dang bstun/ bsam yas su stong mchod 'bul bar bskyod/bar khang du tshogs mchod/ jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du byang sdom/ rab byung pa ra mang ja sogs sngar rgyun bzhin byas/ lar mig ltos dang dge sdig gi grogs po'i khyad par 'di mthu che bas rang gi nye gnas dang / che zhe tshe ring nas kyang stong mchod re phul/ 'dis mtshon ngos nas dge bskul byas pa la rten gzhis ka nas kyang shi gson so so'i thad du stong mchod lan lnga tsam/mtsho sna thang gnas sogs dngos la dad ltos tha dad pa nas/ bsam yas 'dir stong mchod bco lnga skor bskul thub/ rab grwa lnga bcu skor dang tshes bcu pas mtshon/ bar khang du shong thang zhis la gsang 'dus le'u brgyad ma'i dbang lung dang / thun drug gsol 'debs kyi lung byas/ rab grwa bcu skor la sngon 'gro'i khrid btab/ chos rje brag phug pas yon sbyar nas rta mgrin gling du sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sman bsgrub bdun gcig btsugs/grol dbang la mi stong phrag tsam tshogs pa la dam rdzas bkye/ gzhung sa nas nged dpon slob gnyis char log chog rogs dang bcas has po ri rtser lha srin dam 'dogs dang /phur pa'i sgrub pa mtha' sdud dang bcas 'dzugs dgos la/ gnas der rdul tshon la phur cha bkram pa'i rgyud lugs kyi bsgrub pa gnad smin btsugs/ nged gtor rgyag la mi spro yang bstan don la rtsa lhung yod pas chas zhugs kyi zor las spros pa can byas/ rlung rtags shin tu 'tshubs shing zor pra yang legs rgyu ma byung / chos rje'i rmi lam du spre'u chen po gnyis 'ongs pa phyi rol pa'i lha srung 305

tshogs bdag tu nges/ g.ya' ma lung du bskyod nas tshe dpag med sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag 'jug dang 'brel bar tshogs brgya/ brgya mchod me mchod sogs byas/ 'di lo tsa ri rong skor gyi stabs khams pa shin tu mang ba dang /nged kyi sar dang po rang 'ongs pa'i gras khams rdzogs pa'i gra ris tshogs gnyis rang grol skyes rabs brgya pa'i smon lam gsar brtsams de par la brkos pa'i par shing dang / de dus nged kyi skra dad rten du ga 'ur bcangs pa la de zhig nas ring bsrel rdos mi gzhig pa gsum 'phel ba/ rdzogs sprul gyi phyag na yod tshul 'byor/ des khams pa rnams blun dad kyi rgyur song nas phyag dbang dang chos 'brel zhu mi shin tu mang /de 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel yin na ni dkon pa'i gnas yin la/ gzhan so so skye bo'i ring bsrel thams cad ni brtag par bya ba'i gnas so/ /rang gnas su sleb phral dgon rtse sprul sku rin po che tsa ri rong bskor la phebs 'grul lam nas bya bral kho na'i tshul gyis phebs/ sngar 'bras spungs su gzhung lugs la thos bsam dang gtsang pa dge bshes rin po cher lam rim che chung / phyag chen yang gsal dang snying po don gsum la sogs dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor la sogs pa yang yang gsan pas/ lam gyis cha la go ba legs par chags kyang / nges par 'tshang rgya ba'i mdo 'gag lta ba rnam par dag pa yin/ de la dgag sgrub mang bas rang lta mchog 'dzin spangs te ri khrod du rgyud thog la khel ba'i phyogs la bsnyen pa'i phyir/ 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro rnams dge ba gsum gyi don 'khrid rtsa bar byas pa la gzhan lugs kyang nyams 'og tu 'dzul ba'i skabs sbyar dang / dngos gzhi stong pa nyid kyi skabs don la/ mdo lugs su zhi gnas 306

dang lhag mthong gi mtshan nyid bshad nas 'khrid pa dang / sngags su rgyud la bshad pa byed mkhan yin na rgyud ni rgyun chags kyi ming don la thos bsam gnyis nas dpyad nas gzhi rgyud bde gshegs snying po rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang bye nas ngo sprod pa dang /de'i bogs dbang gsum pas 'don pa la sogs mdo rgyud zab mo'i dgongs par snang yang / da ni bstan pa snyigs pas de 'dra'i skal ba can dang blo mthu yod pa'i dpon slob gnyis char nyung / byung gnas 'gro gsum la brten nas sems 'tshol byed pa sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa phal cher la grags shing / des ni thos pa sngon du ma song ba'am/ song kyang rung ste sems ngo rgyud thog tu snang la ma nges pa'i go nyams dang pho tshod kyi stong pa ltar snang las 'das pa'i nges shes skyes nas gnas 'gyu rig gsum gyi rtsa ba chod kyang don la skye 'gag grangs su 'debs pas byis pa nyer spyod kyi sngon 'gro tsam yin/ de ltar skye 'gag grangs su 'debs pa la goms pa cher brtas kyang rang gi ngo bo nyid blo las 'das par ma grol ba'i sgom chen du rlom pa dang / dbu ma chen po'i lta ba ni nged kyi ltar yin gyis gzhan thams cad ni rdzun pa'o/ /zhes rtog dpyod la chos nyid du 'dod pa gnyis ming 'dogs rnam dpyod che chung las sems rnam sayel la spyod lugs 'dra zhing snga ma gshis shor dang / phyi ma lam shor yin/de la snying bsran chen por gyur du zin kyang /byis pa nyer spyod kyi dngos gzhi las mi 'da' ba'i tshul ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs dam pa'i le'u las/ ting nge 'dzin kyang rab brtan la/ /de la mngon par zhen byed na/ /byis pa nyer spyod sa zhes bya/ /mya ngan 'das pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /kha cig rnam par dpyod pa de ni shes bya yin te/ bden pa 307

gzigs pa'i yu la du rung ba'i phyir ro /zhes kha phyir bltas 'dor du mi 'dod kyang rdo rje satsong pa la sa / chos nyid shes bya ma yin te de rmi rnam pa rathes ri nus/ /zhes pa la so bas pa'i rgyu ma tshan yang yang bsnya da nas rdzogs pa chen ngo 'i ka dag sga lta ba gshis thog tu rdo rus thug pa'i ngo sprod dang / de das bi dogs sel la nan tan chen pos bskul ma gnang ba ma ldog pas rnam grangs pa'i don dam la dpyad pa de bris/ 'phros don la gzhan 'ga' zhig na re/gzhan stong dang dbu ma sems tsam pa gcig /rdzogs chen yang de dang 'dra'o zer ba'i bla brdol 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ gzhan sto nga pa rnams byams chos bar pa gsum rang lusas kyi dbu mar 'dod pa de se mas tsam pa dang / ngo bo gcis tu byas nas sgro btags pa'i tshul kun snying sos/ dache bshes 'di rnams kyis mi go rgyu yang 'dir 'dug ste/ gzhan sto nga pa rnams ni byams chos bar pa gsum gyi dbongs pa rang lugs kyi dbu mar 'dod zer ba'i gtam tsam zhis rna bar lhung ba des/ rang rang bi grwa sa na rnam 'grel gyi sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i skabs dang / byams chos bar pa gsum gyidon yin rgyu ba sems tsam du 'dod pa'i grub mtha'i khul zhig 'dus pa de/ gzhan stong du ming bsgyur ba ma gtogs de kha rang yin yo da snyam nas gzhan sto nga dang sems tsam gyi khyad par zhin tu che ba ye mi go bar/ khyad chos de dag kho rang tsho'i 'dod tshul rnying pa'i sems tsam pa'i lugs de ka la yod dam/ sngar gyi de dang ni 'dra la 'dra min zhig byung snyam pa'i mgo bo spos pa de ker 'dug go/ /zhes grub mtha'i rtsa ba ma zin pa'i dgag bzhag kha phyir bltas pa de chos nyid kyi ngo bo don dam dang rdzas 'gal zhing / rtog ge'i 'dod zhen gyi rjes su son pa'i ming 'dogs 308

de dang der 'gyur ba 'dod kha'i lta grub tsam mo/ /lar yang kun gzhi'i rnam shes ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa kun tu 'gro ba lnga'i rjes su 'gro ba de nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis ma bcom bar du shes bya'i sgrib pa bag la nyal mi ldog pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la brtson dgos/ de ltar bcom pa la sngags lam thabs zab pas lam bskyed rdzogs kyis bgrod kyang tshogs la ma pa ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims la gtso bor bgyid pa gol sa chung bar ma zad/ da ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yang bsgrub pa'i dus kyi mtha' la yod cing ring min rtags tsam 'dzin pas ma rungs par bgyid na/dngos cag la mthong lam skyes pa'i slob ma ni med 'dra bas so thar rigs bdun gyi gnang bkag lta sgom spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang mi la 'gal bar spyod pa yon tan gyi gzhi rten du gzung na legs smon gyi gzugs brnyan la re ci dgos/ theg pa chen po'i dbe 'dun yang rtags dang cho ga la ltos dgos na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa//te lo na ro la sogs pa/ /dge slong brtul zhugs bor ba yi/ /grub thob rnams kyang sdig can 'gyur/ /tsan+dan spos kyi ngad ldang pa'i/ /dge slong ji snyed thams cad kyang / /rgyan dang bcas shing gos dkar ba/ /de dag kyang ni sdig can 'gyur/ /gshis kyi mi da spyod phyir ro/ /zhes theg chen tshul khrims ngo bo blang dor gyi sems la bshad do/ /phur pa rgyud lugs dang / klong chen snying thig sga mtshon pa'i dbang lung / shing rta dang mdzod bdun la sogs pa'i lung rags rim gtad rgya sogs byas/ de dag la'ang chos yon rgya chen po dang / zla ba gnyis bzhugs ring nyin ltar nai pa la'i dong tse dang /kha btags kyi phyag mjal/gdan bzos dang /bsti stang 309

ji lta bu byas kyang dang du mi gzhes pa sogs srid 'byor dang / dgon gnas kyis snyems pa'i khengs pa skyungs nas bla ma bsten tshul mdo rgyud las bshad pa ltar mdzad pa la ni ngo mtshar chen po skyes/ de skabs zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i tho rengs/ gnyid rang ma yin pa zhig la/ gzhung sa'i rgya ma kha byang dar sngon dmar tham can zhig byung ba kha phye bas/ kur dril dngos gzhi las 'thug pa gcig /thod ḍa chung ngu zur bzhi pa gcig /thor tshugs la sogs pa'i dbang chas cha gcig /sgrol ma'i dngul sku gcig /g.yer kha khong dkyus ma sgor mo gnyis/ ting 'dzin lha bsangs la mkho nas phul zer zam dmar dar cog gcig rnams dang /rgya ma de gzhan zhig gis klog pa la gor+ṣa'i gnas tshul dang / kho'i a ma'i phor pa dang phreng ba yin zer ba zhig phyar nas khong tsho'i mo phywa byed dus dmod bor sa 'di yin/ mo rgyag thengs dgu car la babs na/zer 'phro nas sngogs/ bsam pa la babs na bod la dmag byed rgyur 'dug bsam pa'i ngang khong tsho'i shi gson gyi bya ba thams cad rdo rje gling du byas pa red zer ba sogs thams cad rang ma nges/'di ma 'ongs lung bstan du snang /snga thog zur pa'i slob brgyud mdo khams su rnying dgon chags pa la snga ba maḥthog rdo rje gdan nas dge rtse sprul sku dang / phyag tsha sprul sku rnam gnyis/ lcags mdud dang sa ngan pa'i grwa rigs bdun cu skor dang / sde dbe'i gnyer pa mgon po chos bzang bcas 'byor/ klong snying gi dbang lung dang / tshe dbang spyi chos snying thig ya bzhi/ mdzod bdun skor bcas/ yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel rnams la smon lam gtad rgya/ sprul sku rnam gnyis dang / bla mchan so sos rtogs 'bul la ngo sprod zhun thar byas/ gaḥthog khri thog pa zhing skyong mgon po 310

zhi bar gshegs pa'i yongs bsngo rten/ yang srid myur 'byon gyi brtag pa dang gsol 'debs sogs kyang zhus/ gzhung gi sne shan dos rta dang bcas yor che bas zhag gcig las bzhugs ma thub pas 'khrin bzhin bar byon/ res shis khams pa grub thob yin zer bya ba thongs pa'i tshad cig byung / 'dir zhag kha shas ring dbang chos ci thob zhu/ rtogs pa'i bogs 'don ni 'dri rgyu med zer/rong skor la'ang dengs 'dug pas lam bden gyi re dogs ni ma sangs pa 'dra snyam nas/ rigs pas brtags pa'i stong nyid la/ /blo dang mig gi rnam 'gyur ldang / /'dzin stangs dbyings su ma grol bar/ /rtogs pa'i ro myang ma mdzad ang / /chos mig rdul bral ma thob par/ /rtogs so snyam pa mthong lam min/ /the tshom gcod rgyu med snyam pa'i/ /nges shes sgrog dang phrol cig ang / /chos dang gang zag thar pa dang / /gnas la gdung ba ma zhig par/ /blang dor spyod pa mi 'bral bas/ /ro snyoms mal sar mdzod cig ang / /tshig la bgrangs na rkang bcu gnyis/ /don la dpyad rgyu ches mang ngo / /gtsang nas yang stengs pa'i sras can dang / /rab gra gsum la smin 'khrid btab/ /sras nas klong 'grel gsar bskrun la zhus dag dang sprags lung byas/ gzhung sa nas sprel zlar khra 'brug tu chog rogs dgu dang bcas bka' brgyad/ rta mgrin thugs rje chen po gsum gyi bsgrub pa dang /srong btsan du'ang dpal ri ba brgyad gra'i slob dpon du phyin pa'i gu ru'i bsgrub pa byed dgos pa la/ dos rta sogs gnang kyang mi ser la tho ma 'phog pa byas/ sprel lo byung res sman bsgrub ltos che ba re byed rgyun yod pa gdung bsam rgyu drung gi ar do/ dza li gnyis phon che/zhol khang dang / tshong dpon 'brug gi ar do bcas sman 'bor che bas dkyil 311

'khor gyi khang par bya ba mi rdzogs kyang gzhung gi dgongs pa rten 'brel gyis mtshon par byas nas khra 'brug tu bga' brgyad kyi bsgrub khongs su las la sbyar/de dus rat+na'i prog zhu gyon pa'i dbangarten la thar pa brten par mis pas sman gyi lha mo 'dus sam snyam/ sprel zla'i mi tshogs la sun snang chen po shar bas grol dbang byed rtsis ma byas kyang dngos grub blang chog la khe gsum zhal ngo rnams byon pas sgra 'khrogs te mi stong phrag tu nye ba 'dus pa la dam rdzas bkye zhing bsgrub rdzas mgo thog tu bzhag /mchod khang chen mor stong mchod/dbu gdugs gogs pa gsar rje/yorgyan lha khang du brgya mchod/tshogs brgya/bstan srid bde ba'i smon lam sogs byas/ brgyad grwa lnga grwa pa dang / bkras chos pa nyi shu skor bcas la mang ja'i 'brel ba byas/ srog bslu lnga btang nas tshe thar sar byin/ zla ba drug par srong btsan du rje btsun sharnya pu ri pa'i bstan par phan res grol tig lom rgyas pas gzhung bsrangs te gu ru'i bsgrub pa btsugs/ grwa pa tshor cho ga phyag len gyi bgros dang / bdag 'jug yang yang len pa sogs byas/ nyin ltar mang ja btang / srong btsan du stong mchod kyi srol yong la res sde par bskul nas stong mchod phul ba'i mchod ro bzhi brgya re sprang por ster bar byas/ nged kyi srog bslu bstar chags byed pa shes pas 'brog pa dang gnas po gnyis 'dzom gyi lug khrid nas 'dir 'dug ring srog bslu nyi shu skor btang / rmongs pa de tsho yang gsod pa la 'tsher ngad chen po byed pa de 'dra la rjes su yi rang bar shar/ 'di yan chad la phyugs lug nyis brgya skor song / rang slob mon ljongs dkar bla ma gshegs pa'i dge tshogs bskrun pa la bla ma'i dpon po smin gling dge slong dpal 'byor can/ bco lnga 3/ 2

skor/ le po bla ma rdza dkar pad+ma tshe ring / srib mo bla ma dkon mchog nor bu bcas kyang 'dzom pa la tshogs dpar la khrid btab/ bsam mchims nas grwa tshang phebs pa dang 'grig pas srong btsan du nyin 'khyongs mdo mang de sgrogs/tsha yon dod sgril ras cha legs pa bstabs/dgon par sku skal mang ja btang /bzod pa dka' thub kyi mi mthun phyogs las grol ba'i smon lam btab/ rang gnas su 'bras spungs blo gsal gling pa'i dge bshes ming don mthun pa zhig thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas smin grol dang / rta mgrin gsang bsgrub sogs zhu bar byon/khong lnga pa rin po cher dad pa'i rgyus snga 'gyur la dag snang che yang /lho brag bdud 'joms gling gi bla mar byon ma rag pa nas sa der ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa ngo bo gcig tu byas pa'i chos gsar yin zer ba mthong nas khong tsho la'ang lung skyogs blun po'i rang rtags ma 'dzin ces tshogs gtam byas pa yin/ 'di 'dra bas rang gzhan thams cad la the tshom skye ba'i rgyur snang zer/ de'i lan rgyud 'bum dkar chag tu bris yod pas gzigs/lar ni chos kyi gter ni gang zag sa mthon po la gnas pa'i spyod yul du mdo las bshad na de dag ni rgyud lung dang 'gal ba'ang mi srid la/ dngos grub bsgrub par yang mi bslu ba'i khyad chos can rnams la sa chos rdo chos zhes bskur pa bdud kyi las yin/ gzhan du na bskyed rim la skye gnas bzhi'i sbyang gzhi spyod byed lta ci smos/ ngo bo dang rnam pa mi phyed pas bsgrub bya ngos mi zin pa'i tshig rkyang dang / dngos grub 'gugs par byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo sngags don log par zhugs pa dang / rdzogs rim la sbyang gzhi rtsa rlung thig le sbyang byed kyi thabs shes dang bral bas zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi drod tshad med 313

cing bde drod tsam la dmigs pa dang / de gnyis ku'i phyi mo'am sku bzhi'i sa bon du gyur pa dbang gi chu bo dang bral zhing dag rdzogs smin gsum gyi yon tan skye rgyu med na/ gsang sngags kyi gzugs brnyan ni yin/ de bzhin du rgyu kun 'byung dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal spong ba'i byed las med cing / byang chub mtho ris blangs skye dang / /chos dang zang zing phyir bcos rung / /zhes sdom pa'i dgos pa drug dang bral ba'i so thar dang / dbu sems bsres pa'i byang sdom dang / rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi stong nyid ston pa sogs gsung rab kyi gnad bcos pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan ni gsar rnying gang gi thad du'ang mchi bas na/ mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang / /phal cher mthun par ston byed cing / /gnad rnams log par ston pa'i chos/ /legs legs 'dra bar ston na yang / /bdud kyi byin rlabs yin no zhes/ /mdo rgyud kun nas gsal bar gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don de yin la de ltar na'ang gzhan gyis ched du dris pa dang / lta sgom gyi dogs pa sel phyir bskul ba'i lan mi ldon kha med las gzhan du na rgyan las/ mi rigs pa yi gzugs la'ang mi rigs na/ /the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes btang snyoms chen po'i chos nyid la kun nas dkris pa'i sems med pas snang ba dag pa rab 'byams dang mi 'gal lo zhes brjod/ khong 'dir lo gsum zhig gtong 'dod 'dug kyang /bzhugs yu la 'thad pa med pas chags snang med pa'i ri khrod cig la bzhugs na rtogs pa la bogs thon pa yin zhes lung bstan/ de yang rten dge slong du 'dug pas de la rjes su yi rangs/ stong nyid kyi lta ba klungs su phebs nas 'og ma'i lam la rang shugs kyi zhen pa ma ldog par las 'bras rnam rtog gi 314

rjes su son pas bden bzhi'i lam yang khyad du mi gsad cing so so thar pa rnam par(bya brag smra ba'i lugs) rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs spong ba bdun 'khor bcas la tshul khrims su bshad pa yin pas lta ba nga'i lugs su skyongs/spyod pa khyed rang gi lugs su gyis la ri khrod dben par 'dul ba las dge slong gcig pa'i gso sbyong dang / dbyar gnas bshad pa/ de lag len la thebs par mdzod cig ces gdams/ khams bla 'jigs med 'phrin las kyang nag chu nas rgya dpon gu ru'i skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu dang bcas thon phyag la 'byor/ khong las can gyi slob ma yin pas lam ring gi bgrod pa la mi 'tsher bar da dung mjal thengs shig e yong dang / mthar mdzad pa brtul bar gyur kyang yang srid nged kyi sar phebs nas rang dbang can du 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed dgos zhes rkang pa la mgo gtugs nas song / ru dam nas rdzogs chen sprul pa'i sku'i gnyer pa yang 'byor/ rten 'brel la dgongs pa'i dril bu gser 'go ma dang / bskal bzang gser bris ma'i rten ldan gyi gsung bris/ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad bcas 'phrod cing / bskal bzang dngul 'bum gyi gzungs la rten 'brel shin tu bzang / ma gir gtsug lag khang rgya che gsar bskrun gyi nang rten rnams la 'di nas rab gnas byed dgos dang / ched du bskul ma mdzad pa'i dam pa la zing ba'i gtam de bsngags/ se ra nas khal kha'i sog btsun gnyis pra 'bebs kyi man ngag zhu zhes nan tur chen po byed pa sa thag ring nas gzhung lugs la thos bsam byed par 'ongs nas don gnyer 'di 'dra la byed pa chos skal chad pa 'dra zhes smras/ zla ba drug pa'i nang gnya' dang du bal pos 'jabs nas dus zings langs/ gzhung sa nas 3/5

bla ma mang por dmag bzlog bsgrub rgyu gnang ba'i 'gag dog sa slob dpon pad+ma la bcol/spyir rnga brdung ba dang sgos mngon spyod la 'dun pa lhod kyang /bod 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod pa'i zhing / yul gru gzhan la ltos na skye bo pal pa rnams kyis kyang dge sdig gi sgra shes pas mi khom pa'i gnas gzhan dang khyad par che/ de la phyi rol pa'i brtul zhugs can gyis glags blta ba 'dis sems can gyi bde skyid dang rgyal ba'i phrin las gnyis ka chud gzoni pa'i gegs chag chen por snang yang de go mkhan cher mi snang bas yid skyo/rnam pa kun tu rgyal po'i mnga' ris dang dkor la brten nas shed spyod byed pa dag kyang khyad med zer na/ sa cha sbar thil tsam dang / dkor la ris bcad kyi shor god til 'bru tsam yang med par ma zad/lo snga phyi'i khong du'ang 'tsho rtsis dang rtag 'dzin gyi sems med pas chos kyi dbyings ni bde ba chen po yin/gnas skabs kyi gnas 'pho dgos na'ang mtha' skor thams cad gdul bya'i rang bzhin du yod pas re dogs til 'bru tsam yang med kyang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid ji ltar byed snyam pa'i blo g.yeng chen po langs/ de la thabs la mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes thob kyi tshogs ni a snyi tsar+ya'i phrin las la brten nas kyang rdzogs pa'i tshul rgyud las/ 'jig rten pha rol dag tu ni/ /bsgral ba rnams kyang mtho ris thob /bdag kyang byang chub gnyis su med/ /bsam pa 'byor pa'i shes rab la/ /sdis can bsad na las ngan 'chad/ ces pa ltar bstan 'gro kho na'i don du dmigs nas khro bo rol pa dang / khyad par phur pa rgyud lugs kyi smad las spu gri rlung 'khor gyi bca' ga sgrigs/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin phung po lnga dang 316

tshogs brgyad kyi gnad gcod pa'i gdab kha ki lā ya tshad kyi mi rig pa slob dpon lag lhag la dris nas/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa las drug man ngag gis gtor ba sgra ji bzhin pa nyams su bstar/ lar nged la zhe snang rang rgyud pa mi 'char bas rdo rje khrod pa'i rten 'brel kyang dbal chung bas rtags myur po 'ong dka'/ de lta na'ang / lto 'gros dbang ba'i sangs rgyas can ma'i dbyings/ /rnam thar gsum ldan la nyal bla gzugs ni/ /ldang ba'i cho ga nyams kyang mnar med kyi/ /rgyu rkyen cha shas ma tshogs rnyi la 'thogs/ /rang slob rdo rje klong gsal gyis skyid grong du yon tan rin po che'i mdzod par du brkos pa'i par shing dang / rgya gdugs dza ti nyis brgya bcas 'byor/ lho gdung bsam kha'i dpon rigs pun+da ri ka snga sor nas dad mos dang ldan pa la dpe don 'brel ba'i gtam gyis rjes su gdams bzhin lo grangs don gsum pa'i steng chos don gnyer ba'i bsam pas sleb pa rjes su bzung / snga lo rgya mtshams su yon tan mdzod dang rnam thar do ha'i rgyan sogs par du brkos pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ nged la a tsa ra'i dpyad pa ngo mtshar ba dag byin/ khong gis lho 'brug dang bha ṭa ga'i chings la ka li ka tar lo gsum bsdad/ bhaṅga la sogs par 'khyams nas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i rlabs log pa mthong mthong phyin 'dug pas/ yul gyi lo rgyus bshad pa la da dung gtam rgyud gzhan gyis dpyad pa dang bcas rgya gar sto phyogs kyi gtam de rtsed mo'i tshul du bris/de'i dgos pa'ang spyir sems can bsod nams dman cing glo bur ba'i bsam sbyor brlang pas da ni dus kyi rgyad pa'ang rim pas dman pa las 'os mi 'dug kyang / mngon gyur mi shes bzhin du lkog gyur 'ol tshod du smra bas sgra 'grogs 3/7

nas gangs can pa rnams yul spong ba la zhugs pa la phan phyir yin/ spyir ni bcom ldan 'das kyis ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed ces bya ba'i ma rig pa gang zhe na/sngon gyi mtha' mi shes pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' mi shes pa dang /sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mi shes pa dang /nang mi shes pa dang /phyi mi shes pa dang /nang dang phyi mi shes pa/las mi shes pa dang (rnam par smin pa mi shes pa dang /las dang rnam par smin pa mi shes pa dang / zhes pa nas ma mthong ba dang /mngon par ma rtogs pa dang / rmongs pa dang / kun tu rmongs pa dang / ma rig pa dang / mun pa'i rnam pa zhes bya ba 'di ni ma rig pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pas so/ /zla ba dgu pa'i nang mchod sdong rin po che legs par tshar phyin pas bsam yas su gzungs 'bul rab gnas la bskyod/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i rten 'brel du bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas gso bar lung bstan thob cing /de yang lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung gi sgo dang po gnyan po gsang ba brgya phrag gcig /za ma tog bkod pa/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan 'bum/ gang zhig rab tu gnas bya'i ngo bo ni sangs rgyas chos kyi sku dang / de'i rnam par thar pa ni byung chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun gyi dpe byad du rdzogs pas na 'phags pa rten cing 'brel 'byung gi mdor/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di ni de 'azhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku yin te/ sus rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mthong ba des ni de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo / /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can gang la la zhig gis mi gnas 318

pa'i phyogs su mchod rten ni skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam/ srog shing ni khab tsam/gdugs ni ba ku la'i me tog tsam zhig byas la/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings tshigs su bcad pa nang du bcug na de tshangs pa'i bsod nams bskyed par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos shing 'chi ba'i dus byas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas shi 'phos te 'chi ba'i dus byas nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rten snying 'bum ther lhag bcas kyis gtsos pa'i ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi/ shin tu rnam 'byor dang / rjes su rnal 'byor dang /rnal 'byor chen po thams cad kyi rig pa spyi blugs kun tu bzang po tsakra dang / rgyu kun 'byung las 'bras bu sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i 'jigs pa chen po brgyad tshan gnyis 'gog pa dam tshig sgrol ma'i tsakra so so nas brgya rtsa re sogs la mtha' dmag gis mtshon dus kyi rgyad pa zhi ba'i 'dod gsol sbyan/gser sbyangs kyis bris pa'i srog shing dri med rnam gnyis kyi cho gas brtan par byas pa dang / gnod sbyin bang mdzod dkor cha dang ldan pa sogs nyer bsdogs grub pa'i de ma thag 'dod dpal nas bal bo dang / zangs brdungs dbu mdzad re 'byor pas dngul dkar byibs gtums kyi steng / 'phul ma tsha gser can zur bkag pa tra bcu gnyis/ bzo sgros gtsang khyad gar blugs tsha gser can gyis seng ge mtho tshad pa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ sgo khrim pa tra phra phul shin tu mtshar ba'i nang sku tshab chos li rgyug mtho gang pa/ bum pa la dra ba dra phyed/ gser bzang kyi chos 'khor phul ma la can/ char khebs za ra tshags nyi zla nor bu'i tog /gser dang stong skor ri ba'i in+d+ra nī la mtheb 3 9

tshigs phra phyogs dang / be+eḍūr+ya'i rigs su bgrang ba'i byi la mig sran sbos tsam dang / ga dza mu tig de tsam/ mu tig che ba chi ba kha tsam dang / chung ba g.yu drug dmar sogs rang gya pher ba dang / g.yu pad che chung / spos shel che legs kyi gtsos pas sna tshogs/ byu ru'i phreng bas gtsos rin po che'i rigs rang byung dang bcos bu'i phra khung phul ma shin tu mang ba rnams sbyar zhing rang cag gis gzungs gzhug slob dpon klu sgrub dang / dze ta ri'i rgya gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs pa phul/ dbu thog tu gos rnying bla bre mthong bzang gos bkral btags par 'ja' smal sham dmar po dang / mtha' rgyan bzhi snyag kha chu brag can/ ka ba bzhi'i lcam gling byibs khebs/ mdun cog shing bskos ci mi 'dra'i gdong chen 'bur 'dod pa tra khong seng khor yug can gyi steng dngul srang bcu gsum las grub pa'i mchod kong dngul sung sum cu las grub pa'i ting bdun tshar/ rgya rag gi ting 'gag gzugs ma che legs bdun tshar sogs de bas brjod du zhib gsal ltar dang / mdor na rten bzhengs 'di'i ched du rgyu 'gro spyir stong dngul du ldang ba song zhing / 'di la brten nas rin po che brtag pa'i gtam de yang bris/ ji ltar rmi lam nang gi rnyed pa la/ /mi lam lta bu'i bsod nams dam pa'i tshogs/ /thar pa cha mthun nyid du mi bslu yang / /chos dbyings ngang na de la re dogs bral/ /rten sgrigs grub pa'i de ma thag gi gral tshes nyi shu gcig la sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshon dkyil la brten dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / gzungs khrus kyi bum bsgrub dang / bdag nyid 'jug pa sngon du btang nas sta gon gyi chos ma tshang ba med pa dang /sang nangs par lha bab kyi dus chen thog dbu rtse rigs gsum dang /320

gling bzhi gling phran brgyad sku stong mchod re bcas pa'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rnam par bkod de mtshan mo'i thun mtshams lnga pa nas ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi nyi ma 'char ka dang khrus kyi bya ba 'grig pa'i rab gnas dngos gzhi'i cho ga ma nyams shing ma tshang ba med pa/gser sil ma'i maṇ+ḍal snyan shal/gser chab byang sdom blang ba/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma/ tshogs brgya/ bskang gso dang bcas pa'i rjes song gi nyin mo'i sta son gyi cho ga ma 'khrugs shing ma 'dzings pa nyams su bstar/ de lta bu'i dngos sta thel ma'i rab gnas nyin zhag brgyad pa'i nyin mnga' dbul dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi zhal gso dga' ston nas bsngo ba'i bar byas/ dgu pa'i nyin gling bzhi gling phran jo mo gling gsum la dmigs pa'i sta gon dang /sang nyin gnam stong gi dus chen la nang par snga ba'i cha nas mchod rten dkar po nas gzungs sbyang ba sngon du 'gro ba'i khrus gsol dang / rten bskyed dgug bstim/ dbang bskur bsdus pa/brtan bzhugs bzhi po rab gnas kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i mthar shis brjod dang dmag 'khrug sogs dus kyi rgyad pa zhi ba'i gdung shugs drag pos nyin thog thag 'da' bar byas so//de ltar rab gnas kyi sbyin bdag gzhung sa nas gnang ba'i dgos cha dngul sung bco lnga dang / ja sgam/ shing rgyugs sogs stsal zhing / de thams cad kyi bdag po'i rkyen du smon lam gyi mthu grub pa 'dod dpal mkhan po spyang grong nas kyang mchod tshogs kyi zhal 'debs dngul srang lnga/ko legs 'bru dang /mar do che ba/gser btul dang snyan shal phon che ba rnams dang / mdor na bzo rgyu'i cha rkyen ma tshogs pa la gser srang gsum gyi mtshon chad pa 'thud pa'i 'gan bzhes rang nyid las khur che ba 32

mdzad/ rang slob bsam gling slob dpon lags btso bor gyur pa'i rab byung gra tshang gi 'khrid zhu ba rnams dang / sku gnyer dpon yon tan rgya mtsho bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde pa phan tshun gnyis rnams so so nas rab gnas kyi 'bas tog nyin 'khyongs 'bul nod 'gyed bcas kyi bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad/sku gnyer dpon gyis bskul nas bar khang bi gnas bshad rags bsdus dang /zhabs rjes dang / gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rten bshad/ bsam yas la rab gnas gsol ba'i gtam nyung ngu dang bcas bris/ bzo bo dbu mdzad gnyis la gyon pa lus gang /dngul srang lnga re/sder rgyab kha btags snga phyi bcas dang /byings la mtshar dga' dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ phor shubs legs pa gnyis/zong ras/ mkhan por dngul srang bcu skor/ sprel zla dang bcas par gzan phrug re dang phyi mdzod re/rtser sku gsung thugs rten dang ba so'i bsil yab/sku gzan/ nang mdzod dang bcas pa'i thugs rje che byung brda mtshon tsam phul bar/ bzang ja 'khor drug dang bcas rab gnas byas pa dgongs 'byor gyi rgya ma stsal/ bsam yas marims phur bskyod de mchod 'bul gser chab tshogs bskangs/ mkha' 'gro'i me mchod khri tshar/ brag dmar ke'u tshang gzim phug tu bzang gos 'khor brgyad ma ser po'i mtha' 'ja' sngo nag me tog ris kyi gnam rgyan/ mchod khang gsar mar grags pa rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gzim spyil lcam rtsa rul bas rdib la nye ba snga lo nas/ ko rtse sbag dang / dgu tshan bzang po bla brang du sprad nas thog bkab rgyu bskul ba bzhin sor chud pa la bla bre zhig phul/ gser gsol dang mchod 'bul byas/ gling stod smad la mang ja gnyis dang ja 'gyed btang / bka' blon bla ma/ bla brang / chos rje pa sogs kyi tshogs 32 2

brgya dang bsnyen bkur bcas ke tshang du 'dug ring snga zhogs thams cad tshe dpag med sku gsum 'dus pa'i bdag 'jus blangs shing grol dbang nyin mi brgya skor la tshe dbang bskur/ 'di lo sde dge rgyal po dbus phebs kyi 'char yod pas/ rang gnas su phebs na mi ser la dka' sbyangs byung dogs/ khams bla thon gdong / khyed dang gang mjal sar zham ring ba 'dris yod la zla ba dgu par nged bsam yas su mchod sdong rab gnas la nges bcar yong nges kyi der mjal 'dzom legs tshul brda 'phrod par mdzod ces bskul ba bzhin rgyal po'i mi sna 'byor pa la/mjal sa bsam yas las legs pa mi dgos tshule phul/ de nas 'gyang med la phebs phral bsam rdzong du mjal 'dzom dang /dbang bka' rjes gnang mang po byed dgos par khong gi gzim chung ba so lha khang du byas/ mchims phur phebs pa la rta 'ul bzhi bcu zhe lnga dgos pas mi ser rnams ci drag la gya bar/rgyal po'i dge ba'i sa bon mngon du sad pa ni/mi dbang khyod ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs/ /sems can rnams ni las kyi gzhan dbang can/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /snga lo lo nyes nad yams sna tshogs dang //'di lo dmag dang khral gyis shin tu gdungs//khyad par gnas 'di dag pa'i zhing nyid kyang / /yul gru chung zhing mi rnams 'byor pas phongs/ /nyin re bzhin du yul 'khyar grong stongs pa'i/ /skal ngan mthong bas snying rje skyo shas 'phel/ /gnas ri mig gis mthong yang bstung pa'i tshe/ /shul ring rdo skas 'jogs bzhin slar la bsring //rta rer dngul zho gsum gyi gla 'babs pas/ /dbugs 'byin chen po'i gnas la sbyar du gsol/ /zhes springs pas rta 'ul bcu tham pas chog pa byung / sang nyin bka' brgyad kyi 323

dbang bskur dus/ rta 'ul nyung ngur bsdus pa la rjes su yi rang phu'/ nas da dung yar lungs phyogs su'ang mes dbon gyi gnas rnyeng las gzhan thams cad du phebs na dpon sayo ga stobs che bas las dasar la rnam smin gnag pa 'byung tshul zhus par gsan dbongs mdzad/ btsun mo mkhyen rab che zhing bag chags bzang bas 'khrid spungs nyi ma gsum la go brda 'phrod nges byung /bla ma dang yang mjal dka' bas bsam yas su lhod tsam byed gsungs pas/sne shan pa sogs mdzad dka' gtad kyang dbang chos rnam grangs mang po myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs la 'bad pas zhag drug las ma 'thogs/ jo bo'i sku mdun du smon lam lhan cig mdzad dgos gsungs bar stong mchod gcig phral du gshom par bskul nas de bzhin byas/ lar nges 'byung gi rgyud brlan pa das kyang rgyal khab la sogs pa'i bste stang la ji mi snyam na/ chos nyid kyi bden pa ni re dogs kyi gzhan dbang can ma yin kyang / kla klo dang sdig spyod kyis bkab pa'i rgyal phran gzhan dang mi mtshungs shing / bstan pa dang de 'dzin la gus pa'i mngon rtogs 'di ltar ro zhes bsnyad na/ bla mar bya ba'i gnas la lta ba bzang pos/spos sna dang /ldang phyag/khri mnyam sogs bste stang dang /ston mos sngon bsus pa'i blon chen gyi mas gtam sngon du btang nas/'bul tho 'di lta ste/ gsang chen theg pa mchog gi khang bzang dbus/ /mi shigs zag med don dam bde ba cher/ /rnam rol mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer 'gro ba'i mgon/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bor skyabs su bsten/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i smin/ /rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtshor rab spro zhing / /tshe rabs nas bsags sdig lhung nyes pa'i dri/ /ma lus stobs 324

bzhi'i cho gas bshags par bgyi/ /dus gsum dri mas dben pa'i 'khor 'das kyi/ /ji snyed dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang / /mgon khyod srid pa mtha' can ma gyur par/ /brtan par bzhugs la bdag sogs 'gro kun gyi/ /sgrib gnyis gnyen por rtags tu che ba yi/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i chu klung kun/ /bla med byang chub rgya mtshor ro gcig tu/ /yongs su bsngo ba'ang 'khor gsum yongs dag nas/ /sgyu ma'i rtsed 'jor rol pa'i tshul gyis so/ /zhes bsngags brjod yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang nas/ rgyal ba nyid kyis rdo rje'i lung gis bstan pa ltar/ gangs ldan rwa ba dkar po'i ljongs 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyi thugs rjer brten/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa'i nang nas/ khyad par du 'jam dbyangs mi'i srid pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma sa wa spyan drangs/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid bzhengs/ rje 'bangs thams cad thar pa'i lam la bkod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa bzang po'i dpal la 'gran par mdzad pa bzhin deng rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra'i zhal skyin dam pa bsam yas su byon zhing /bdag cag gis sbyin bdag gi khur blangs te tshogs kyi mchod pa phul nas 'jig rten gyi khams su bde skyid 'byung ba dang / bdag cag rnams phral yun dge zhing shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar stong phrag phye ba'i smon lam dang / smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi gdams pa zab mo stsal ba sogs thugs rje chen pos bskyangs pa'i maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed du/ lha gos srid du ring ba/ rdor dril theg 325

chen gser rtsi ma/ ting shags dngul gyi nyag thag can/ ma tertse yug chen/ ling tshos kha sna tshogs lug lnga/ gos chen gser byus yug /pags byus yug /mdzod gos sngo nag yug /zam yug tshos kha sna tshogs drug /gser rdil tshad/ dngul rta mig ma gnyis dang /khol tshe srang bcu gsum/gser zho lnga pa gcig/ja bzang 'bring 'khor drug lnga/rta chibs/rol gnyis/dre'u/ka shi ma'i ras bcas phul/de srid skye bar dal 'byor lus thob cing / /dam pas rjes bzung tshul khrims rnam par dag /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bus rgyud phyug nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces snang / rnyed bkur dang ni bste stang la//rlom pa skyes nas bris pa min//rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin la//gus de chos rgyal rnam thar yin//sang nyin bkra shis dpal rar thon phyag la byon thog thor snam dang / 'go snam gyi gtsos pa'i phebs rdzongs brda mtshon dang / rgyal po stangs dpyal gyis gtsos pa'i nang ma rnams la tshe dbang /phyi rol du byings dmangs nyis brgya skor la byin rlabs dang mdud dam sprad/mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gras klong thang sgrol ma de/ sde dge'i mnga' ris na yod 'dug pa nyams gsos dgos pa'i tshul dang / phebs lam gyis mtshon gzhis byes thams cad du 'bangs la byams pas skyong dgos tshul zhus te thegs/ sku srung ba zhu chen dbon po la yon tan mdzod chos 'brel du byas shing / gzhan sku 'khor drag gzhan so so'i re ba bskangs/ rgyal po bsam yas su bzhugs ring phyir 'breng gi gnas skor ltos che ba kun tu rgyu'i gras zhig 'phyongs rgyas zhol pas rdo choms byas nas rkyen lam du song ba/khra 'brug tu phebs bstun sha lan len mi'i dpung 'ong tshul gyis skrag nas/nged la zhu ngo sgron rogs kyi bang mi gnyis 326

'byor/ 'di pa tsho lho brag mar pa'i yul mi lta bu yin kyang snying rje chen pos rgyal po la thal song de rigs gnang na nyes pa shin tu che bas ngo chen dgos tshul nan gyi zhu yig phul/ gzhan khams pa'i srol la sha lan len pa khrims su bca' bas lung skyog gi thub chod mthil rdol ba thug /bsam yas rdzong dpon spel gzhi 'byor rgyas pa la tshe dbang dang /rta mgrin bsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang byas/ rang gnas su ldog lam spo rar zhag gsum bsdad de tshe dbang dang sbyin sreg sogs byas/ slebs phral khams pa bco lnga bskor la khrid btab/ gangs ri'i khrod tsam na sbyangs yon bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge slong kong po rgod tshang pa sna tshogs rang grol gyi skye ba gsum pa rgya lar byung ba rgya la chos mdzad nas 'dir gsan bsam la phebs thub re byas kyang gzhan dbang du gyur pa 'di skabs sku nar son pa'i dgongs dpyad kyi mjal ma thub tshul dang / rnam pa kun tu rjes su 'dzin dbos zhes lha rdzas bzang po dang / sgam dril legs pa bcas 'byor/ de ska'i len dang bdud rtsi'i phur ma phon/ yon tan mdzod bcas phul/ bar skabs na lho rgyud gnyal phyogs la mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi mtshon snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa tsasto ba sangs rgyas brtson 'grus dang /sha gzugs pa maṅga la sogs kyi chos rgyud 'dzin pa sa la bla ma dang / mdo smad ru dam pa 'jigs med blo gsal can mdo'i sgrub mchod thog 'dzom pa la nye bzang zhing skyes thob dang ldan pa smin grol gyi go brda 'phrod pa la/ mdzod gsar rnying gi bshad lung dang rags rim bka' gtad sogs kyang byas/ shrī par+sha tar tshogs 'khor dang bcas 'du khang gi ka ring thog lcam gling 'dom drug gi sa byibs khebs la rgya gar kha thi'i gnam rgyan dang / dril bu theg chen 3 27

che ba spyi rdzas su sbyar/mdo khams pa 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi dpal chen gyi las mtha' rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog sogs btang snyoms su mi bzhugs par ci nas gtan 'bebs mdzad dgos zhes nan tan che yang /phyir brda sgyur rten 'brel gyis che/ khyad par mngon spyod la smo ba zhen pas ci mi snyam par lus thog /ru dam pa 'jigs med blo gsal can gyis gsol ba nan tan dang btsun mo'i pho nya 'dzom/ dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki'i zhal lung ltar rgyud lugs sgra ji bzhin pa'i he ru ka rigs bzhi'i sgos sgrub bka' gter zung 'jug tu 'brel ba'i gter rgya grol/ de yang rang gzhung las/ gal po la sogs he ru ku'i:tan+t+ra kun gyi bcud kyang 'dril:zhes pa ltar he ru ka gal po/gshin rje zla gsang sdig pa stobs chen/rta mchog rol pa/ phur pa rtsa rgyud rdo rje khros pa gtso gyur rgyud las man ngag tu 'dril zhing sgrub mchod kyi rgyun btsugs pas khri srong lde'u btsan gyis lo paṇa spyan drangs shing 'bad pas bsgyur ba'i rgyud rnams rdul khrod las dbugs 'byin thob/ rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog gi brda ris grol ba'i rten 'brel sogs kyi bdag po'i rkyen ni btsun mo dam pa ngang tshul byang chub rgyal mos mgul rgyan bskur ba las byung bas lung zin gyi skyes bur snang / snga sor lho 'brug phyogs nas slob ma'i dam pa kun grol bum thang tha ba'i brag la lo gsum gyi dus gli ltas la/ dgongs pas brgyud pa'i chos bka' 'dir/ /shog dril kha dog rnam lnga las/ /bzhi ni klong chen snying thig ste/ /gnyis ni da dung gtan ma phebs/ /don dam ngo bo oṃ lha / /yi ge gsum gyi rnam par gnas/ /de la bsam brjod spros pa bral/ /zhes bla ma dang mjal nas gsung byung bas gnyis po'ang btang snyoms su mi 328

'jog par gsol ba snying nas 'debs zhes byung ba'ang don la gnas/ khong cag gis bskul nas bar do dang bde ba can gyi smon lam/ btsun mo la spring ba'i gtam rkang pa bco lnga pa yang bris/ dbyar ngo 'dir srid pa phyi ma'i rten 'brel du dmigs nas rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams las rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa lnga sogs thang sku rgyu tshogs dag pa grwa tshar brgyad bzhengs/ dmigs yul 'brel thogs la chu gtor 'bum ther dang / yul mi dbul po la sbyin gtong gang slogs byas/chos rje brag phug par spro ba bskul ba bzhin khong gis dang du blangs nas bsam mchims su slob dpon chen po sku tshad che ba bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la bskyod/ dngos sta sprel ma dang / bod khams bde ba'i smon lam byas/ brag dmar ke'u tshang du brgya mchod/ tshe chog dang 'brel bar tshogs brgya/ me mchod khri tshar/ gzim phug tu rgya rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul ma che legs zhig phul/ dgon pas spug tu dad ldan slob dpon lags kyis bsnyen bkur 'bul nod dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel mdzad/bsam yas su stong mchod dang snyan shal brgya phrag phul/ khrus gsol brtan bzhugs/ bod khams bde ba'i smon lam btab/ bar khang du dge byams bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis zhabs tog dang bcas tshe chog tshogs brgya btang sar rab byung dbu mdzad pas hor dril zhig phul/ bkras dpal du nor rgyun ma'i g.yang rten rgyas par btsugs/ gtsug lag khang gi nye logs yin pas sa bcud gso ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ dkon gnyer dpon gyis sdum par blta stang rgyas par mdzad/ ka chu rdo ring pa'i mas rna rgyan phul ba'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ gzhung sa nas do dam gdong khra 'brug gtsug lag khang la rab 329

gnas byed dgos phebs pa chog rogs pa bco lnga bcas dngos sta nyin gsum ma'i rab gnas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg rnams gtong sgo'i khral 'jal la cha ma bzhag par bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho mes dbon gyi gtsug lag khang la gnas par nges pas gtor tshogs dang mchod pa'i sprin rang stobs kyis dang du blangs/ phan tshun gyi rab gnas thams cad la than sgang la char chu glo bur du brdol ba sogs dkon mchog gi thugs rje la nges shes skyes/ 'jig rten pa rnams ni pho lha che ge mo'i thugs rje yin zer ba yi dwags la yid ches pa tsam dkon mchog la byung na ā snyam pa shar/ 'byung po rang rgyud pa la char pa'i dbang yod min mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag la ltos/ 'bras spungs bde yangs bla mas snga sor yon tan mdzod gzigs pas 'di phyogs su phyag mdzad pa dang lhan cig nged tsho la 'di 'dra yod na gdugs bcu gsum bskor zhes zhal bkyal mdzad zer ba bzhin rtse tshogs mkhan por phebs ma thag pa dang 'grig pas gsang sngags pho brang du mjal du phebs/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol ba khyed la phyag 'tshal lo zhes gting nas grus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bla ma dang mjal ba skal ba che/ kha phyir bltas kyi thos bsam gyis lta ba'i de nyid mi rtogs pas da res rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo sprod mthil phyin pa zhig zhu/ mkhas pa klong chen pa'i gsung rab mthong ba la brten nas phyogs 'di la nges shes rnyed pa yin gsung / dri ba dri lan gyi sgo nas chos nyid gshis thog tu ngo sprad/ skye ba phyi ma bla ma gang phebs sar nga yang khrid cig gsung / de'i gong tsam du par+sha ta'i skyong byed du grags pas spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gang yod ces bsgyur sbyangs byas byung ba dang / 'jig rten la grags 330

tshod kyi gos dang / sde snod mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen chen po 'di tsam gyis gzigs stangs 'dzol lugs kyis kyang sems can gyi las snang la skyo ba chen po skyes/ yon tan mdzod dang skyes rabs chos 'brel du byas/ slan chad rab byung la spring ba'i gtam de bsngags/ gong sa rin po che'i bka' shog rin chen gnyis pa srang bco lnga bcas bde gzar chings sgrig skor la pha rol snang ba dbang bsgyur gyi phrin las byed dgos la/ sems can bde thabs la sems stobs chen po'i khur lhan skyes su yod pas snga 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i bsnyen sgrub dbang gi sbyin sreg bcas rtags mthong gi bar dang du blangs/'di tsam na ting nge 'dzin las su rung bas dus cig car du phrin las bzhi'i dmigs pa la rang dbang thob/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes par mi bgyid pa'i gnas su gzigs pa dus las yol ba'i jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal pad+ma 'od gling gi bka' 'gyur rten gtsor byon/ bzo bgros dang sku rgyu gcig pos kyang ngoms par snang bas spyan drangs pa'i yon srang 'khor sum cu bstabs/ dpal 'khor chos sde nas rin ldings bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las kyi bhan rnya dum bu gcig pa dang / gong sa lnga pa'i phyag dril yig rtags 'byar ba'i khyad dril ngo ma 'bul bar rgyang mkhar dge slong 'byor pa rten 'brel gyi sgo chen por snang / rgyang ru nas dpal sdings rje btsun drung dang yab kyi sku skye 'jigs med bstan pa'i phrin las/ yang zhabs gcung po/ rgyu lcam bcas nyi shu skor la khrid dang / dbang lung/ phur pa rgyud lugs/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ rang mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs bka' gtad byas/ 'di dag dad ldan gyi slob brgyud yin pas 'di lo re gcig pa'i keg dogs la dmigs pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 331

'brel mdzad/lo mjug lcags zam nas grub dbang chen ngo 'i gdan sa brtan 'phel gyi phyir rten gsum la rab gnas bskyar bas mtshon pa'i don gnyer chen po'i slad du gdan 'dren nan tan che ba'i zhal ngo ma ldog par skor cig bskyod dgos la /chu mig kha nas yin zer ba'i chos skyong pho rgyud gnyis dang /mo rgyud gtso 'khor lnga pas gdan 'dren gyi rnam pa byas/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i rigs rnams dam tshig la gus par snang / klong chen snying tig nas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i skor sogs gsar byung gi dbang lung rnams phul/chos sgo gsar pa rnams la ljags bsnyen gyi dam bca' yang mdzad pas de'i gong der rmi lam du sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la 'brel ba mdzad par mthong bas yang dag 'di lhag par bka' babs kyi chos bdag yin par rig/gza' tshes legs pa dang bstun bka' 'dus phur pa bdud dpung zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor thog mar zhal phye nas dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i rab gnas kyi khongs su zhi rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg /sku 'bum lcags zam gtsang khang chen mos mtshon pa'i gnas rten thams cad la me tog gtor/ ldog par nye ba na sku gsung thugs rten gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul nod gya rnam pa dang bcas bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs mdzad pa'i shis brjod kyi dus sprul pa'i sku rin po che mkhyen rab che bas rnyed par dka' ba'i rdo rje slob dpon du nges pa'i bsngags brjod 'grel chags pa dang bcas lo brgya phrag nas brgyad cu'i bar du 'tsho zhing gzhes dgos zhes gdung ba chen po mdzad pa yang drug cu re gcig pa'i keg dogs nas gsos thebs pa'i rten 'brel chen por gyur/gru so'i rnam g.yeng dang khyim pa tsho'i gnas dus kyi dpya khral la 33 2

nges 'byung dang snying rjes lhan skyes su shar/ nye'u kha shas bton/ rang gnas su slebs nas pad gling rus brgyud bum thang chu smad zhal ngo dge slong chos grags can brgyad la klong chen snying tig nas khrid smin par bshad/ mon yul wang thang la nas brgyud 'dzin gyi slob bu kun grol can gyis bskul byang la rten ma mgon gyi brda bsgyur grol ba'i rtags su sog po lha bzang khong btsun mo dang bcas pas dngos cag la gtsug phud dbyung zhing dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod pa'i rmi ltas gsal ba bzhin chos skyong srog tu btsa' ba re gnyis la spel/ bka' ma khyad par can 'di dag mi nub par re nas yang dag lha dgu dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dbang 'dus pa bco lnga skor la bskur/ bum thang pa bla ma chos grags bla ma'i phyogs su gtong phod che bas sku gsung thugs rten/ ri dwags kroṇ+ḍasa'i stan 'ja' ldan/ gser sung lnga/ dngul lnga bcu ma bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa rgyas par byung /nags shod nas nyi grags sprul sku 'jigs med bstan pa'i sde dpon g.yog nyi shu skor byon par klong snying yongs rdzogs/ bla ma gsang 'dus/phag mo zab rgya/rgya can dbang khag sum cu skor cha tshang / rang bstan la sman res grol tig cha tshang / sman bla dang / lha mo 'od zer can ma sogs rje gnang kha shas dang /'khrid shin tu smin pa byas/ brtan bzhugs dang 'brel bar chos yon du dngul rta mig ma gnyis/ rta mdzo 'dres pa bco lnga skor/ mar khal nyi shu bcas 'bul nod rgya che/ lam bden la re dogs kyi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshe zang zing gi rnyed pa la dga' rlom mi 'char ba chos nyid du 'dug kyang / gzhan dkor 'di ches pa tsam nas dbang bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin 333

na ma gtogs bla ma dang dge bshes su grags pa rnams kyi tshe la gzhar ba'i spu grir nges/ lar sprul pa'i sku dngos bstan cig yin kyang lus 'di sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin du 'dug na yon sbyongs la 'bad dgos par 'dug /lo 'dir rang gzhan gyi tshogs gsog la dmigs khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum ther/ gtso bor lag 'don la sems bskyed mchod pa'i zhal 'debs dang bcas snying rje shas mi bzod pa'i blos lug sum cu tham pa gri 'og nas bslus/ tshe gzungs 'bum ther/ sgom gyur tshogs stong rtsa dang 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen/ dpal rir nyin bdun gyi bar bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs la ṭa kha re dang / mar 'gyed/ thong ras zho gsum re btang / spyi rdzas dngul dkar gyi phud skyogs che legs dang 'phyar dar zin skya cha gnyis sbyar/ phyogs mgron gyis sun pas mtshalas rgya'i mu yin kyang grwa tshang gi nan bstud dang bstun tshogs dbur brtan bzhugs la phyin/ dpal rnying pa rnams la mang ja sbyor thel dang thug pa/ de pa'i mi ltogs rnams la zho re'i sbyin gtong byas/ri bder mang ja gsum/mnga' grar lo star gyi mang ja/'di pa'i yul mi dbul po rnams la sbyin pa ci nus sogs byas/ 'di skor skye bo mang po la grib gnon lta bur 'tshe zhing sgom grwar rgyu cung zad kyang med par ngan sems 'chang ba'i sdig to can la las snga lo sgyur sbyongs byas pa nas bzung rang nyid kyi bsod nams zad pa'i rgyur song nas dam can rnams kyi a sgyi tsar+ya'i phrin las la sbyar ba'i mngon rtags phral du gsal ba la snying rje chen po skyes shing /smonalam yang byas/ sdig grogs blun po'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i dam tshig skyon can dag gis bshags pa byung bar/ sangs rgyas la lhas byin 334

dang ma skyes dgras phyogs 'phangs/ glang chen smyon pa rbud rba la'ang 'khon du blta ba med na drin lan log 'jal byed pa 'jig rten na mang bas byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rgyud la 'dris pa'i gzhan dbang du btad yang gsang sngags kyi srog dam tshig la gnas pa'i rten 'brel gyis nyams grib la brten pa'i 'du ba 'khrugs pa dang / tshe phreng glo bur du lhags pa'i ltas kyang byung bas chos skyong rnams la bshags pa nan gyis byas/ byang chub sems dpa' la ngan sems skyes pa rnams la 'bras bu mthong chos su smin par gda'/ jo shāka drung du bzang spyod 'bum ther gdon pa'i 'brug pa dge slong can kha shas la 'khrid smin rgyas dang bzang spyod kyi 'grel pa rgya gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs nas bshad/ lar sangs rgyas phal po che nas byung bas phan yon la mtha' mi 'tshal te/ las dang po pas theg pa chen po'i spyod phyogs kyi go ba 'chags pa la byams smon kha gsal/ zla ba bzhi pa'i dus chen dang bstun 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar gtsang rgyang ru dpal sdings pa can/yang zhabs/gtsang theg mchog gling pa'i gra rigs rma rgyan chos 'phel can lnga/ gnyal sa la chos rje/ sha gzugs sku skye/ rab byung slob dpon can sogs 'dus pa bdun cu skor la mdo dbang chen mo zhag bcu gsum dang / phur pa rgyud lugs/ klong snying bka' 'dus/ bka' brgyad rnal 'byor rgyun dbang / bla ma yang tig sogs dang 'brel bar smin khrid smar pa btab/ bla ma tshor bri thig /cho ga dang phyag rgya sogs bstan rgyun la phan res legs par bslabs/ gzhung sa nas dpal ri'i sku skye ma byung bar grwa tshang gi bla ma'i khur byed dgos kyi rgya ma phebs kyang / 'jig rten gyi mthun 'jug ni ngos cag gi mi yong / deng sang gi 335

grwa tshogs la chosakyi sgo nas ni phan thogs pa dka' snyam byung ba rang mal du bzhag /'di skabs shig nying 'khrul du rtsa drarba'i chun po sngo ljang 'ba' zhig gis bkang ba'i shing rta'i thag pa khu byug mi skad sgrogs pa zhig gis drangs nas rang mdun du bzhag pa rim gro'i rten 'brel dang / bstan 'gror phan sems kyis bya ba'i 'khor lo'i mthus tshe 'phreng bsal bar mngon/ rang lo drug cu re gnyis pa 'dir mtsho sna dgon rtse nas sprul pa'i sku rin po ches spyan 'dren nan bsnud la/ snga sor sa phyogs der bskyod dus 'bul ba'i phyi ma rang der byams mgon bzhengs ka ma'i sku zhig ster mkhan byung tshe rtogs pa la da ni sa phyogs 'dir bskyod pa'i rgyu med de rten 'brel de ni de 'drar snang ngo snyam pa ltar/ na tshod cung zad thal kyang da ni rang gi bsam sbyor gnyis ma'i sgo nas rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med par sems can la phan pa'i dus su 'dug snyam sprul pa'i sku'i dgongs pa bskangs/ rta khal bco lnga skor gyi bsu ba 'byor nas rjes 'breng chos zhu ba dang bcas rang 'khor nyi shu skor bskyod/ mgyogs 'phyang zhon rta re mos byas rang gzhan thams cad mi spyod pa'i dal 'gros thog rdo khog la khar phyag mdzod pa'i chibs bsu dang / bcags por thab bsu bcas sprul pa'i sku rin po che rgya sgo'i phyir bsu ba la byon/ khong rang srab stan 'ba' zhig la bzhugs shing sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu'i bsnyen bkur dang bste stang mdzad/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma brten tshar nas sgom dus spyi bor sgom rgyu yin na brten tshul kyang 'di 'dra yin pa sde snod mkhyen pa'i rtags su 'dug /chos kyang rgyud tshod la dpags dgongs pas dpyad nas zhu gsung ba las thob rtsis mi mdzad pas rang khams dang bstun 336

chog pas gzugs kyang bde bar byung / mdo mkhar nas shing mangs sku skye/cog po sku gle gnyal sa la chos rje/ les po'i bla ma gnyis/ rjes 'brangs bla ma chos grags can sogs dang / dgon rtse'i dbu mdzad dge rgan sogs dbu che rnams dang phyogs 'dus bsdoms 'dus pa lnga bcu skor la snying thig ya bzhi'i bum dbang rjes 'brang thun mong bas smin par byas nas/ thugs 'dod bzhin klong chen snying tig gi spyi dbang snying po don gsal dang / bshes gnyen mang dag tshogs pas sde snod kyi bshad pa rgya chen po dang 'brel ba'i gdams ngag 'khrid kyi lugs su smin par byas/ gzim chung yangs pa can du sems bskyed mchod pa la stong mchod sngon du 'gro bas grwa tshang yongs rdzogs dang bcas skyes bu nyis brgya nye ba la dbu sems lugs gnyis kyi bshad pas sna drangs nas dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom phog /rjes 'brel du bzang spyod kyi 'grel bshad blo thog nas bshad cing / che phyugs gsum dang / lug brgyad kyi srog bskyabs/ 'khrid pa byings la dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal dang / gnas bcu sogs dbang bka' rje gnang gzhan gyi mtha' brten dang rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i 'grel pa/ sprul pa'i sku rin po cher khrag 'thung rigs bzhi'i sgos dbang dang / chos skyong 'ga' zhig gi srog gtad sogs byas/ dgongs bzhed bzhin sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sman bsgrub bdun gnyis bgyis pa'i grol dbang 'du khang gi bzhugs khri'i steng nas bgyis shing / khrom dbang la rta dbang chos rdzong sogs mi drag gi dbus/ la 'og yul gsum/ mer rag /sag stengs/ dag pa shag ti/ du rang tshun chod kyi lho mon dang / gnyal lor/ tshong dus kyi mi sna stong phrag bdun du nye ba 'dus par skyabs 'gro dang 'brel bar 337

las 'bras kyi chos bshad/ byin rlabs dam rdzas kyi 'brel ba/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gzungs sgrogs pa sogs smon 'jug rgya gang che byas/ mi tshogs de tsam sngar ma dran zer ba la sems bskyed smon lam gyi 'brel ba bzhags pas blo kha rdzogs par byung / chos sman 'bor kyang khal bcu skor tsam snang bas mtsho chen rnams la'ang btab cing khyab che/ sa bcud gso phyir yum ga'i las tshogs la brten nas zangs bum gyi bca' gas bum gter brgya skor dang 'brel bar g.yang bsgrubs gnad smin bgyis shing g.yang gta' bsdams/ spyir sems can gyi las sus 'gog thub kyang 'di lo'i char byang thang 'dir lo thog sad kyi ma bcom pa sogs dkon mchog gi thugs rje bskul ba dang / byang chub sems kyi nus pa la mthong chos su yid ches/ dgongs bzhed bzhin dngos sta thel ma'i rab gnas 'brel bar gtsug lag khang yongs rdzogs la me tog 'thor/ grwa tshang la mang ja lnga dang spyi 'bul ka 'phan gnyis/'gyed sna gnyis/ji srid bar lo lo bzhin mang ja lnga re'i sbyor 'jags byas/dkar po bzang du brgya mchod tshogs brgya bzang gos kyi rgyal mtshan cha bcas 'bul mi mngags/stag tshang dom tshang la'ang rgyal mtshan chung ngu re phul/ thon khar brtan bzhugs kyi sngon 'gror sprul sku rin po che sde snod kyi mkhyen pa rlabs che bas gangs ri'i ljongs kyi rgyal bstan nye 'khon med par sbyor ba'i dgag bsgrub gnad thog tu 'gro bas maṇ+ḍal gyi bshad pa de tsam snga na ma byung bas thog drangs/sku gsung thugs rten/dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal phul ma/hor sbug shubs bcas/g.yang tri'i yol go/'phreng ba rin thang can/'go snam gyi stan dmar/'gan sbyar/ sku 'gag /gser zho bco lnga/ dngul rdil tshad lnga/ glang mche/ rgya 338

kong /stag sgam cha/nad mdzod sna lnga/mar do bcu gnyis/'bras ltang sum cu/des mtshungs rgya tshos stang / btsod do/ stag gzig dom lpags/ do po re re bzhin ras cha'i dgu tshan spel ba sogs dngos grangs brgya 'bul lhag bcas kyi bste stang snga na med pa mdzad/ nged ldog par thugs shin tu 'phreng bas dgun mon mtshams su bsdad na dgongs pa 'dug cing tsho gsum nas sangs rgyas gling pa dang kho long stod pa sogs kyi gdan 'dren nan che yang 'du 'dzi la 'jigs shing dben pa'i yon tan dran par ma zad nam zla ldog gdong gi bshol thebs ma byung kyang sdod ring dbang rnon chos rjes 'breng ba'i 'bel gtam nar ma dang / theg pa chen po'i bstan bcos shog grangs nyis brgyar nye ba zhig mdzad 'dug par yang khengs skyungs 'ba' zhig gi don la mi gnas na byin za la 'bul/ zhus dag gi 'thus na dpyad gsum dag pas byi dor bgyid par bskul ma mdzad pas thugs bskyed 'phel ba'i phyir tshig don gnyis ska'i cha la dpyad zhus byas shing deng sang bstan bcos 'di tsam brtsams nus pa'ang dkon par mthong bas rjes su yi rang ba sgoms/ thang grong gnas chen sogs 'dris can gyi sar skor tsam re las bskyod long ma byung / gser dngul lho zong / bse ru/ glang mche/ rta mdzos mtshon dang 'bul rgya che bas dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ 'bru dkar la sogs pa'i do po lcid can rnams khal ma la spyod gcod dang / khe gsang 'tshol ba'i nyes dmigs la 'jigs nas gnas de rang du yang thong du bsgyur/ tshur lam mdo mkhar du spyan 'dren nan che bas de bar dgon rtse nas 'gyogs 'phyang gsar bzo 'gyogs mi grwa pa zho sha'i stobs ldan brgyad dang / dre'u gnyis sogs gnang 339

bas ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' la'ang brten ma dgos shing rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar sgoms nas bdud rtsi 'phebs sbyong gi dmigs pa yang byas/ tsha lung thang kur du mdo mkhar phyag mdzod pa'i phebs bsu dang bcas rdzong du 'dug ring de pa'i dpon g.yog sum cu skor/ grwa tshang khag chos lugs ma nges pa'i sman bla ba/ bskang gso ba dang bcas par skyes bu chung 'bring gtso bor gyur pa'i bshar khrid dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang / tshom chen du yul pa stong phrag tu nye ba la dbang dang dam rdzas kyi 'brel ba sogs sngon bzhin bgyis/ byams khang sogs sku gsung thugs rten gsar rnying rnams la shis brjod me tog 'thor/ tshe dpag med kyi sku dngul lnga bcu ma dang /mar ltang bdun/ ras cha'i dgu tshan sogs mdor na lho rgyud 'dir che chung dras zhan thams cad nas 'bu'/ nod bsnyen bkur rgya che yang dkor gyi nyes dmigs la 'jigs bsam pa ma gtogs brod snyam pa ma skyes/ yar lam sa skya'i dgon lag shing mang bla gras spyan 'dren nan bstud sar 'gag chos sde'i mkhan po bgres po dang grwa pa phal cher gyi byon pas mtshon yul pa spyi dmangs la tshe dpag med sku gsum 'dus pa khrom dbang du bskur/ shing mang dgon par ja sbyor gnyis/ṭa 'gyed/'gag chos sder kyang mang ja dang 'gyed btang /lar nged ni bstan pa thams cad la gus shing grub mtha' tha dad pa'i ring lugs la phyogs lhung med pas de dag so so'i bzhed pa'ang nyams 'og tu 'dzul ba'i rten 'brel gyi gzu bor gnas pa dang yon tan yod pa thams cad byams par byung / shing mang bla mas rta 'bul dang / chu dkar chos rjes mdzo mo sogs dad 'bul thams cad kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ lam 340

bar dang rang gnas sdom phyugs lus sum cu skor gyi srog bslu byas/ shing mang pas ra mo'i bar thab bskyel mdzad/ de nub sgo rgyar ra ba zhis tu gnas mal btang / ngos cag gi mtsho sna'i rnyed pa g.yas khal brgya skor mthong bas de pa'i gnas brtan des bla ma rgyun par nor bsgrub dang dbang sdud rang mdzad kyi yod pa e yin byas skad/ nged byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang chos kyi longs spyod rgya chen po la dbang na/ zang zing tsam la snying ngo ra ci zhig bsgrub/ lar dal ba dang 'byor ba bdun pa'i chos gzugs rnams ni dbang bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma thong yang phrag pa dog par snang ba ni/ bshes springs las/ ser sna 'phags min lags par mkhyen par mdzod/ ces rang nyid so skye yin pa'i mngon rtags su bstan rna/ /gnas dus der lam bar tshor kha ba dang bu yu ga 'tshubs pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu che bas skye bo du ma'i srog 'asags kyang dkon mchog sgri thugs rjes dang chos srung sga phrin las la yid ches chen po skyes/ rang gnas su sleb phral srong btsan bam sor gzhung sa'i phur sgrub bdun phrag dang 'brel bar brgya kong gsar 'bul gyi zhal bsror stong mchod dang / phye phur che ba gnyis phul/ rang min bsam yas mchims phur bla brag pas mkha' 'gro gnyis bzhengs pa'i rab sanas la bteg /dngos sta nyin gnyis ma mtha' rgyas sbyin sreg dang bcas grub nas/ brag dmar ke'u tshang du sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi sma na sgrub dang / bstan srid la ra rim gyi rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog bdun phrag kyang byas/ gling stod smad la mang ja lnga dang gsum ṭa re bkyes/ rang nyid kyi mar me stong phrag dang tshogs bskang me mchod 'bum ther byas/ 'di dus gzim phug tu nyal skabs bla ma bgres po zhig sga tshe 3 //

tshad yin zer ba'i shog dril zhig la bro dus dang dus me zer ba'i grangs nges shig mthong ba gu ru rin po che'i lung bstan du mngon/ bla mas brtan bzhugs la dngul sung bco lnga dang gos lug sogs bstabs/ bsam yas su sku gnyer dpon yon tan rgya mtsho khu dpon nas yon sbyar te bar khang du rab gonas dngos sta sbrel ma nyin brgyad dang phyi nyin 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan rol cha la sogs pas sna drangs te gtsug lag khang byings la me tog gtor zhing mtha' rgyas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ rab gnas kyi thog mtsho sna'i rnyed pa rnams las stong mchod tshar gsum dang gser sil ma'i maṇ+ḍal/ nang mdzod kyi gtsos pa'i snyan shal nyis brgya skor dang / lha sa dang khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang gnyis so sor mar me stong phrag re re phul/ nyi ldog gi dus yin kyang rab gnas tshugs nas ma grol bar nam mkha' 'jam zhing rlung bser bu'i rgyu ba'ang 'gags pas rten 'brel bzang / rab grar mang ja gnyis dang gsum ṭa bkyes/ khams bla 'jigs med phrin las bla ma dran pa'i gdung bas bskul te mdo khams su sleb phral yar sdog pa'i sa yon sbyar te rta mgrin gling du sman bsgrub gnad smin dang / dkor gnyer dpon dad ldan khu dbon gyis bskul nas dkar bcal thil du khrom dbang la mi stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dus pa la chos dang myong grol gyi las 'brel bzhag /rab byung mkhan pos dbus grwa tshang spyi tshogari su dang / khams bla gsar 'byor dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang / dge rtse bla ma/ rdzogs chen chos khrims pa bkra shis 'bum can mang dag la dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom dang bla ma gsang 'dus/ rig 'dzin nang bsgrub/yum ka bcas pa'i dbang lung byas/ rab gra che bgres rnams kyi bzhed pa 34 2

bzhin skyes bu gsum dang 'brel ba'i klong snying gi sngon 'gro'i 'khrid srungs shig byas/ bar khang dngul 'bum la dkar me rgyun 'dzugs sbyar/ zhal 'debs 'bul mi mang zhing de bstabs nas thob thang phyugs bcu gnyis la 'phar ma gsum dang bcas 'bri bco lnga sbyar/ khams bla 'jigs med phrin las nas jo bo'i sku mdun du tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i thog gser/ dngul/ rta dre'u lnga/ mdzo pho mo lnga/ ja sgam/ gzi dung / pe tong gi nyer spyad sogs 'bul nod rgya che/ de mtshungs khams bla dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang dge rtse bla ma dpon slob so sos kyang rta 'bul sogs mdzad pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ sa skyong sde dge /rdzogs chen sprul sku rin po che/ rgya rong sku skye rnam gnyis dpon slob so so'i gser dngul/ rgya sgrub gnyis sogs kyi rten dang bcas pa'i mtshams zhu'i lan bzhed pa bzhin phul/ las ldan kerma bsam grub kyis klong snying chos skor la lo gsum mdzad rgyu'i dam bca' rtogs 'bul gser gyi skyes bcas 'byor/ lar zang zing 'byor ba'i lo rgyus 'bri ba tha chad kyi gtam du snang kyang / sems can mos pa tha dad pa'i snang ngor mi 'bri ka med cig kyang snang /zur mkhar mthong kha ru'i khyim la me tog 'thor ba dang tshe dbang sogs skor cig bskyod/ 'thon pa'i lam zhor rdo ba'is grong smad pa'i khyim du/ tshe dbang sbyin sreg dang / dga' rnam pa'i grwa pa bcu skor la chos 'brel sna tshogs byas/ rang gnas su 'byor 'phral/ kong po nas spyod tshang sprul sku 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan byon nas sku gsung thugs rten dang dngul bum legs pas gtsos dung dkar ja sigs mar ltang sogs 'bul nod rgya che ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs mdzad/ sprul pa'i sku zla ba drug tsam bzhugs ring khams 3 3

bla gsum dang bcas pa ra dbang 'khrid kyi gtsos blo bskyed 'phel ba'i chos kyi 'bel gtam dang / dus 'di tsam nas mis skyon che bas byin tshab pa bskos pa'i rgyud 'bum rin po che dang / mdzod bdun sogs kyi lung yang song /gtsang po mgo dgur 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod 'dzugs rgyu mdzad pa'i zhal 'debs su dngul sung lnga sbyar/ rang lo drus cu re gsum pa lcags phag zla ba dang por shri par+sha tar bskyod de/ bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs dang 'brel bar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten tshogs chen 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun btsulas/khyu mchog gi rjes su ba lang phal pa dogs med du rgyu ba ba'in 'jig rten ni rmongs pa'i gzhan dbang can kho na'i steng / lha min gyi 'jug pa can dag dengs thing / rang nyid gdan tshab tu sdod skabs bcas phyogs bslad pa'i rigs med cing bya ba de/ spyir snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa dang sgos kun gzigs shan+ta pu ri pa'i bsta na pa la bya ba chen po bgyid pa'i blos cho ga phyag len phyag rgya sogs ngas thog nas 'doms par byas / sngar bas ma pa thos tu khel na chog sgrig sasar pa zhig dang / dbang chen sogs lam du 'gro ba yod de/da ni dpang po 'gribs pa sa de rigs ma grub kyang / dpe rgyun rnying pa la brten cing lung lusas kyi smon lam sogs rgyud kyi dbongs par ha cang mi 'brel zhing cho ga nyos pas btang snyoms su byas/ ji srid bstan pa nam gnas bar gyi sgrub mchod bebs dngul srang brgya tham pa dang bzang ja 'khor gsum gcig sbyar/ 'di lo ṭa 'gyed kyi dbus 'o lnga re thob pa'i rtsis btang / grol ston la tshes bcu'i 'chams dbyangs thog mtshan brgyad la bzang bos las grub pa'i gar phod bzhi dang lha phrug gi gos sogs sbyor 'jags byas/3 ‘

'chams dbyangs rgyun je nyams su song bar lu sa ngas si so nas bsla ba sbyongs gang drag byas kyang rngas dang lham gyi dper snang /grol dbang la mi tshogs zhin tu che zhing / grwa tshang tshos brtan bzhugs kyang mdzad/ dpal rnying pa rnams la mang ja sbyor sbrel dang / dbul po rnams la sbyin btang / ri sder mang ja sbyor sgrol dang la yug drug brgya'i 'gyed skal yang byas / 'di 'o sa skya gong ma rin po ches dbyar dgun gyi mtsham sa rten 'char can ma yin pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung paṇa zha dngul rdor nyi zlas ma tshan pa dang saser 'o bdun bcas snang ba rten 'brel gyi sgo chen por gyur/ 'di yan chad nyi grags gsu ma pas nags shod nas bzang bos kyi rten dang bcas bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin bris pa'o/ /mos gus kyi bla ma dbang du 'du ba'i dpe ltar dngos cas dkon mchog la dad pa'i rten 'brel gyis lo snga phyi 'di gnyis rang la sku rten gser zangs li ma sum cu skor las tu 'byor/ sde dge dpon mo ngang tshul byang chub rgyal mo'i bdas rkyen las mdo 'grel bden gnyis shing rta dang / sngags 'grel rnam mkhyen thing rta gnyis par du 'khod pa'i gnas tshul 'byor/ lcags phag zla ba gnyis pa'i nang nying 'khrul la bud med ma mi da gnyis kyis/ gzhon pa na re zla ba lnga par dmas langs pa 'dus kyang nged kyi ma rgan 'di zhen chags che bas snang ba rang mi 'dus zer/ sems can la bde skyid ma byung dolas pa'i blo ngal dang snying rje chen po skyes/ gzhung sa nas dmag 'khrug dang nad yams zhi bar dmigs pa'i lha chen gyi me mchod dang /phur pa'i bsgrub pa 'dzugs rgyu gnang ba lhag bsam rnam dag gis byas/ bka' blon bla mas yon sbyar mdzad nas dpal chen rol pa chen po'i gtor bzlog dmigs bsal 'dzugs 3 5

dbros kyang bstan 'gror dmigs nas nan tan bgyis pa'i nub/ khams pa'i bla mchan gnyis kyis rtsed mo byas pa yin snyam pa'i snam phad gru bzhi pa 'i nang tshangs thams cad grog ma 'ba' zhig ris bskyangs 'dus pas de dag spubs 'thums nas shi dogs sems las chen po byed pa 'is mis pa dmag gi blar 'dug /dbyar ngo sor khu a su ra pa'i dmag bis gtsang stod ru las bi sa'i char gyi sems can gyi bde skyid la gnod pa chen po byas/ myong ba dang byed pa rgyu mthun gyis las 'bras mngon sum par shar/ sems can thams cad la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsnga la bar mi chod pa'i mabo tshugs/ gzhan phyogs pa nyid kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la spyod pa'i mtshan nyid shes phyir skyo shas dang nges 'byung tshad med pa skyes/ de'i tshe rmi lam la thang stong zhig tu ru dar khyer nga 'i mi zhig 'gro ba'i lag na lung bstan yin zer ba'i shog dril zhig 'dug pa la tshigs bcad sho lo ka gcig snang bas sa da dus brjed thal / don da res gar dmigs pa'i sar phyin nas phyir ldos ces par snang / lar sngon chad rgya bar 'phags pa'i yul zhes bsngags 'os bstod 'os kyi gnas kyang da ni sdig spyod kla klos khebs pas mtha' 'khob chen por gyur pa de dag na/ sangs rgyas mi thes/ chos mi shes/ log par lta ba 'dzin pa can sha stag yin pas dmyal ba mnar med kyi rgyu tshogs bsgrub pa la skyo shas dang snying rje chen po 'phel/ bod gangs can 'dir sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag /bstan pa ni 'dzin byed kyi skyes bu la rag las pa nyid kyang da ni lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur pas bstan pa'i ngo bo lung dang rtogs pa gnyis ni chu lha'i phang par phyogs/ lnga brgya phrag bcu'i phyi mas 3 6

satugs pa'i rtags sdom pa'i gzugs brnyan kyang 'jigs skyob dang / legs smon la re/ rgyu des nges 'byung yod pa'i gang zag shin tu dkon zhing thub tshod dang brlang por spyod pa mang bas/ sngon chad chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis dbang dge 'dun la bskur ba de yang dus da lta sems can rnams kyi khur du song / chos pa chos ba'in mi byed/ dbon gnas mthu che ba rnams nas khral khrims khur ba'i khyim pa rnams la 'phros choms dang / khrims rkun 'dod rgyal du spyod pas rang sa'i sdom pa 'jig pa'i tshul mdzod las/ 'chal pa'i tshul khrims mi dge'i gzugs/ /zhes pas gzhan gnod gzhi bcas lhur len pa ni rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid yin/ des khyim pa sun 'byin cher por gyur nas bstan pa la mos pa ldog cing bsnyen bkur yang khral 'jal gyi gnas su lta/ chos byed kyi sang zag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can 'ga' tsam srid na yang / tsher ma dang dar zab lhan cis tu bsres pas bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka ma rungs par byas pas mgon dang dpung gnyen med pa'i dus su 'dug snyam skyo ba shin tu 'phel/ de lta na'ang yu la gyi nyes dmigs la skyo ba'i zhi bde'i sems ni byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa cing rgyu yin pas na/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba kun gyi dga' ba'i rgyu/ /sems can sdug bsngal cir gyur pa/ /rin chen sems kyi bsod nams gang /de la ji ltar gzhal gyis lang / /phan par bsams pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas mchod las khyad 'phags na/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /bde don brtson pa smos ci dbos/ /zhes pa ltar/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen pos dus kyi chad pa sna tshogs zhi ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gi thugs 3 7

rje rgyun mi chad pa bsku la /lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du dngul sung brgya phrag lhag bcas kyis bsgrubs pa'i stong mchod dang gser chab snyan shal 'bul du 'brug pa bla ma chos grags mngags/ 'gro la phan ma chog rgyal ba'i thugs la 'ang sman/ /gang la gnod mchos kyang ni de bzhin phyir/ /nga dang sems can bde sdus mtshungs gsungs na/ /'phags pa'i spangs rtogs bden pas 'gro 'di skyobs /rgyal bstan lnga phrag tha mas mi brdzi zhing / /'gro ba'i bde skyid bdun gyi bdun pa'i zhal/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa ngan pa dang / /log smon bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal bar shos /ces smon tshig tu spel nas jo bo'i sku ma dun du 'bum ther 'don par bsku la/ /thi gson gyi rdzas rnams don lda na bya ba'i phyir bzang gos sne tshang dang kha 'khyar sdoms yul bcu skor la mchod rdzas 'ba' zhis btsems/ bsam yas su stong mchod dang bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi rten 'brel la dmigs pa'i bar khang zhal 'debs sayas g.yon du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod bcas thang chen thog tshad ma bcu bzhi rgyun 'gram dang bzang bos 'ja' sgrigs kyi thong ldan la tshos sna lnga spel gyi phur ma dang nang mdzod sna lnga'i phur ma brtsegs pa'i gdung khebs byibs khebs/ bzang gos nam zhu'ang ldan smyug kha'i rgyal mtshan gong ba smal gsham mtshal kha/ stong mchod/ dpal rir nang mdzod brgyad la bskang rdzas bris pa bzang gos kyi 'ja' can/ mdo khams rdzogs chen pa'i dgon du de dang zhe mtshungs lha mo bcu drus gi snang brnyan bcas sbya ra/ dpal chen bka' brgyad rol pa chen po'i thang chen gser bcad ma dgu dang / sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i thang ka bdun tshar bzang bos 'ba' 3 8

zhig bi gong 'ja' can bzhengs/mnga' ris grwa tshang pa la mang ja bco lnga dang /bzan stong legs pa'i spong dag /bsam yas rab byung par sman bla nyin 'khyongs dang / dngul srang bco lnga'i zong ras 'gyed btang / 'gro ba'i bde skyid dang rgyal bstan mi nub pa'i rten 'brel la dmigs nas bzhung sar bzo rgyu dngul sung brgya tham pa'i mnyen zangs dang / bkus gser byang zho brgya phrag lhag bcas phul te bsam yas rta mgrin gling du bzhugs rgyu'i slob dpon chen po'i snang brnyan bzhengs pa'i bzo grwa 'dod dpal du tshugs/ hor gos za bab rgya kha dngul srang sum cu skor ri ba'i na bza' sku ber kyang 'chems/skyes nas 'chi ba las ma 'das pa'i 'byung 'gyur mchod sdong gi char rtog bcas dang / zur bkag /sgo khyim pa tra/ seng khri'i rgyan sogs phul zangs khal bcu gnyis dang / gser srang bcu gsum gyis bsgrubs/ lar dngos cag gi 'jig rten mthun 'jug ma byas/ 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng spangs bzhin shugs 'byung gi dkor rdzas phran bu 'byor pa dag dge tshogs su 'gyur ba'i yid dang chos su rtogs pa tsam yang bsam gtan gyi tsher mar byung / bho ṭa'i bla ma phyug po tsho'i rnam g.yeng dang thugs sun la rang nyid sha thang chad/ ye shes sku mchog mar gnyan dpal dbyangs kyi 'grel pa yod skad sngon chad ma mthong yang / gzhung 'di khyab che bas dpe lung sogs la ma brten par/ blo thog nas 'grel pa byas/ rgyud 'bum dur khrod mngon par rol pa mtshon cha 'khor lo dang / me lce 'phreng ba'i rgyud gnyis nas mngon rtogs dang bskang ba bsdus te mgon po legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po'i rten gtor dang bskang ba'i rgyun 'dzugs byas/ spyir so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa po la 3 zhu

lhag par yar ldan dbos na de dag gi blangs 'das sgra ji bzhin par shes pa'ang dkon pa'i gnas/ ltar snang tsam du rtags dang cho ga mi byed pas 'dul ba'i las chog byed srol med mod/ mdo sma da gser kha dgon so gas khams pa'i grwa rigs blun dad can rnams kyi nan ngo ma ldog pas byang chub sems dpa'i so thar 'bogs chog brgya skor la song / lung sde bzhi dang mtsho ṭika nyams 'og tu chud pas dge slong bi springs yig kyang byas/ gtsang theg mchog gling pa'i dbu mdzad can lnga la solas mon bod khams gsum gyi mi sna 'dus pa la 'khrid tshar gsum tsam btab/ theg mchog gling pa rnams gra rnying lugs kyi bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga yang se btang du bcug/ge re lha pa'i yum la bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi chos 'brel byas/ kuḥthog zhing skyong gi yang srid skor la bla ma mgon chung gdan tshab rnam gnyis kyi mtshams zhu khyer nas ched du byon pa la chos 'brel dang bka' gtad byas/ de mtshungs sde dge/rdzogs chen/ nyi grags/ ze chen/ rgyal rong / nyin byed sku skye so so'i mchas zhus dang dngos mjal byed 'dod gsung yang / rang re ni rga ba'i chad pas gtugs pas blo sna thung ngo las ma mchis so/ /dbul po la sbyin gtong srog bslu lug bcu skor/ chab gtor 'bum ther sogs bgyis/ sa skyong sde dge'i sku rim bsgrub rten gser srang do 'byor pa bzhin/ dpon slob bcu skor nas phur pa rgyud lugs kyi sgrub chen bdun phrag dang / de'i sgo nas sbyin sreg 'bum ther sogs byas/ khri pa no mo khang / rgyal yum/ zangs ri gung /mda' dpon lcang can sogs kyi bsngo rten byung bas rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo'i/ mi rtag pa lhag par dran/ mtshan nyid bla ma dga' ldan byang rtse bas 350

khyod dang 'phrad 'dod shin tu che yang stes dbang ma 'grig ces/ skyabs 'jug zhu rten bskur ba mdzad/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /ces pa der snang / e shag byang pa'i gdan 'dren nan bstud che bar mgyogs 'phyang la brten khyug tsam phyin/ 'bul nod bsnyen bkur rgya chen po mdzad/ gtsang 'gram du nya kha shas bslus/ rtses thang klu gzims gnyis sogs nas zhag shas bzhugs dgos u tshugs byed kyang /grong rdal gyi dbus su sun snang chen po skyes te zhag sa la sa ma bsdad/ de yi chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ zhes pa'i yang srid mang po yod pa mi 'dra ste/ dargon gnas sku skyes 'dzin pa bod kyi lusas su snang bas/ lu sas gnyis gang rung nas dgon par phan du re ba dag la/ bras dmar ke'u tshang du brtags sgril byas pa'i don rtser snyan sgron byas nas/ shrī par+sha ta'i sku skye ngos 'dzin gyi 'bo 'dren byas/gnyal sha gzugs pa/rdo bla 'jigs med/ sde pa rnam rgyal/ rnyarma kirti/ dpal sdings rje btsun ma rnams kyi ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel rgyas par mdzad/ rang lo re bzhi par sleb ma thas ste/ sde dge'i mchod dpon sangs rgyas bzang po ched du byon par dbang khrid kyi gdams pas rjes su bzung /mi gzhi bzang zhing rgyud dul bas chos kyi gdul bar rung ba'i mtshan nyid can du snang / sgrol ma rgya gar ma byin can/rat+na'i ldi gu de nyid kyi grangs ldan bcas brtan bzhugs mdzad pas rten 'brel legs tshogs chen por gyur/ rgya dngul srang lnga bcu'i 'bul ba dang bcas gsol ba btab pa bzhin rnam thar kha bskangs 'di yang bris pa'o//se ra smad nas mkhan po'i sku skye khrid gsan pa la byon/ khong smon lam 35/

tshosas chen la dam bca' bzhag pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa chen por 'dug /rnying ma bas mdos zor 'phen pa tsam las sde snod mi shes snyam pa yod kyang yon tan mdzod mthong bas blo 'phrog pa yin zhes gsungs/ gus pa chen po mdzad/khong la khrid btab pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya'i 'phros don la deng sang / dge slong gi bsnyen gnas blangs na bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'jig zer ba gcig dang / de 'dra'i rtog dpyod med par dus khrims yan lag brgyad pa len pa'i srol zhig 'dug pa gnyis la dasag dbos ji ltar yod dris pas/ nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims la pham ltung dang nyes byas kyi gtan nas ma bos pa'i dge slong yod na 'jig pa bden te/ dus deng sang rang bstan pa rtags tsam la nye bas gtan khrims yod lo las dus khrims la gus pa bskyed pa gso sbyong gi yan la ga tu legs zhes pa'i lan rnam dpyod che ba byung / de bzhin du tshangs gnas bzhi'i skor la dris pas kyang dge slong ma dpal mo'i po bstod la bcos 'chos pa rnams las lhag pa'i go ba ming don mthun pa'i dge bshes su byung / sems ngo'i tshe zhi gnas lhag mthong la thos bsam gyi dpyad sgo ma ha cang grims ches pa'i blo rtogs sel dka' tsam snang yang nges 'byung gi blo dang dben pa'i phyogs la snang ba 'gyur che ba byung bar zhal sadams dgos gsung ba'ang de bzhin du smras/ dbon po 'od zer la gsang snying 'grel ba phyogs bcu mun sel gyi lugs ltar bshad/ lar 'grel pa 'di don la rton pa gtso bor bshad pas phyi don du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog can gyi bo dka' bar snang / sa skyong sde dge'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub mi mdun smor mgon po lhun 'grub can 'byor/ theg chen rtse lnga pa dang / 'gan sbyar/ rgya 352

dngul sogs spam che ba dang / dpon mo yum sras kyi 'tshams zhu dngul dkar gyi bzed zhal spus legs sogs nyer spyad dang su war+ṇa sogs 'byor/ khong tsho ma 'byor gong nas/ mi ser la tho 'phog dogs/ 'di gar rten chas bskyel mi mdzad na rnam pa'i zur zos byon min la ma ltos pa yong zhes lan grangs bstud nas lab kyang / rang bsam mi bsam ga la gcig /'di gar 'byor nas rta dre'u drug cu skor gyi rta gsos sogs 'dug kyang mi ser la phan pa'i phyir zhu gsol byas nas gzan rin phran bus 'thus par byas/ bod khams bde thabs la dmigs pa'i slob dpon chen po'i snang brnyan gegs med du grub pas gzungs 'bul rab gnas phyir bsam yas la bskyod/ gzungs 'bul zhag gsum/ rab gnas dngos sta phel ma zhag brgyad byas/ sku gnyer dpon gyi bskul ma mdzad nas mchod khang byings la'ang me tog 'thor/ za babs rin thang can gyi sku ber/ dpyad ldan dmar lja nga spel ba'i sku par/gan gos khon mchu li'i mthong can gyi bla bre/ rgyan bzhi dmar po dang rgya yig ser po can gyi spel ba'i rgyab yol/ nyer spyad dril bu sde dge theg chen rtse lnga gser rtsi ma spus dag /dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal spyi khab kyi tshom bu can/ 'degs byed rgya bzo'i grul bum gzugs cha/ snod a thong sga tha li/ ri dwags shwa ra lhas btegs pa'i me dam rgya bzo ma cha/ dkar yol stegs bcas/ glang mche cha/ phye phur cha/ jus dkar gyi rgyal mtshan/ par khang du rdo rje gsang lam ma'i ka thums bcas phul/ sa zla'i dus chen nyin stong mchod dang / rab byung par mang ja gsum/ drug ṭaṃ/ khyim pa rnams dmag khrul gyi nyam thag par snying rje chen po'i blos/ bsam yas spo 'jug spyir dngul sra nga bzhi bcu skor gyi sbyin pa 353
