btang / khral dngul ma 'byor pa'i skye bo gnyis btson rar bcings pa thar bar byas/zha long gi mtshon pa'i sprang po rnams la zas rgos kyi phan btags/bstan srid lar rim la dmigs nas rta mchog rol pa'i bsgrub pa zhag bdun dang / zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg sogs byas/ de dag gi ring la rang slob dad can slob dpon a nan+ta dang /lha gnyer dpon yon tan rgya mtsho sogs rab byung che bgres thams cad nas zhabs tog dang 'bul 'gyed sogs bste stang gya nom pa mdzad/ rab grwa dbu mdzad bsam gtan pa sogs grwa tshang bco lnga skor la klong snying gi dbang khrid smin par btab/ 'di dag gi khrod na chos snang dang mos pa can mang bas blo bskyed yong ba'i rigs can du 'dug /sems bskyed mchod pa'i zhal 'debs la gzhir bcol ba'i lug bco lnga skor srog bslu byas/rdo gzhis pas bsnyen bkur byas te zhag sa bcags mal dang bcas rang gnas su sleb 'phral/ rab grwa kun tshul dang rgyang rtse rtse chen pa can grwa slob brgyad la khri kha btab/ lus 'di blangs pa tsam nas sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang gzugs can yin phyir/ snga lo nas phung po'i skye mched las de wi ko kha'i yul la nye bar longs spyod pa'i rten 'brel 'gags pa/sngon chad lnga pa rin po che 'gribs tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi a tsa ra dpyad mkhan gyis dbye ba'i rgyun/ bla'i sman pa gnyis la/ gnyer du gtad pa'i thugs bskyed bar ma chad pa'i slob rgyud yar lha'i mdun nas bye grong pa las ming can la gnas pas/lo snga phyi gnyis la thur dpyad res mos kyi byas pas gsor chud/lar bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon gyi rnam par smin pa ni gang la'ang ma gtogs so zhes gsungs/ las bdag gir bya dgos pa'i rigs la de lta ma 354

yin kyang / ngos cag gi 'di pha ma'i 'grib rgyun las byung zhing nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rang bzhin med par shes pa'i go myong bis na zug la sogs pa'i tshor ba rang rgyud pa'ang nyams su ma myong bas/ 'phags pas rga dang na ba dang //skye ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs//zhes pa'i don kyang 'dir rig go/ //zla ba lnga pa'i nang rgya dpung bal yul du bcug pa'i dmag bzlog bsgrub rgyu 'byor/ sems can la nye ring med kyang sa sprel 'o nas da lta'i bar 'jis rten mi bde ba'i byed po gang yin la dmigs nas phur pa rgyud lugs kyi sgo nas gang ba kha drug gi las sbyor btsugs/ bsad rtags kyi dbang du byas na gtso po'i gral na phag lo zhig yod par nges/ bsgrub pa'i sgang la yul gyi phur bya rgod nam mkha' nas mngon sum lhung ste shi ba dang / sgrub pa po zhig gi mi lam du/ 'brog mo rgan mo dung phreng can khro nyams shig gi gtso byas pa'i skye bo mang pos mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis nor lug mang po gsod pa la mo na re/ nga nas nas sdod long ni mi 'dug /rgyang mig rang blta dgos pas mig kyang tsha/sems can smyo tshad gsod dgos byung na rang gzhan gyi nor thams cad gsod dbos pa 'dus skad/ zhing bcu tshang ba rang sde la'ang yod zer ba 'dug /lar phur pa'i dam can 'di shin tu mthu rtsal che zhing rgyud lugs kyi sku rim 'di yang bka' gnyan par 'dug go/ /mngon spyod kyi dus dang de'i sngon rang nas pha rol la bcos min gyi snying rje chen po skyes pas phyin chad na'ang bsngo smon nan tan byas/ me lug lo'i mi ltas de la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lung bstan snang ngo / /lar byang chub kyi sems dang / rgyud sde'i man ngag la nges pa 'drongs dang bcas pa'i rgyu mtshan du bkod kyi/ ngas byas nga rgod kyi gral du 355

dog 'tshangs ni ma yin no//mi ring bar 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod btsugs/lho 'brug gi zla zur bgres po sangs rgyas bzang po'i yon tan mdzod mthong bas yid 'phrog pa'i mos pa thob tshul gyi mtshams zhu rten bcas dang / khong gi slob ma kha ling pa dang / gzhong dkar ba gnyis/ mon shar ro lam pa lnga/ kho long pa nang tshang du'ang ska da rigs mi gcig pa lnga skor la lo tsā btsugs nas 'khrid bshad/ 'di tsho chos la mos pa che yang skad rigs mi gcig pas go dka' ba la dpag na phung po gsum pa las mi khom pa dgur phye ba de bden par snang zhing / yul dbus kyi mi la ni/ chos snang dang mos pa cung zad kyang med pa 'di shin tu'ang skyo ba'i gnas/ ro lam wa sgom ri rgyu'i bras ri la gnas pa'i sbrang tshang dang / bya ri dwags kyi srog skyob pa'i don du dngul srang bcu tham pas brag ri nyos te/ bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar du ri rgya byas/ rang lo re lnga par rgyal seng gtam nas rgod tshang rin po ches 'od dpag med kyi sku 'jon dmar byin can/ mdzod gos 'khor brgyad ma lug /gser dngul mar ltang sogs bdog pa gya rnam pa dang bcas pa'i ring 'tsho 'bul mi lhags/ de mtshungs dbon rtse rin po ches 'dren byed legs 'bul gru gci spus dag /gser dngul/ zong ras bcas dang / sgom phyogs la bsam byung gi shes rab dpyad bzod pa'i dri ba rgya chen po mdzad pa la de len dang / gru g.yu rten bzhengs kyi mdzod spur dpyangs/ chos spyod bcu'i gtam de blo la thol byung du shar/ sa skyong sde dbe'i mtshams zhu bstud ma dang / rin chen ril bu bcu gsum/ gser dngul spam mtho ba 'byor/ lar kho bo cag 'dod pa zad pa'i blo skyes pa nas bzung ste zang zing char ltar babs kyang / dkor gyi nyes 356

dmigs la 'jigs thing / de bsod nams su bsgyur ba'i rnam g.yeng la sun snang chen po'ang skyes/ kha rag sgom chung bas/ snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor yin/ /rnyed bkur 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin/ /bsod nams dge sbyor gyi bar chad yin/ /dug la sman du ma blta ang / /gsungs pa la nges shes skyes pas lha'i bu'i bdud dang rtag par g.yul sprad/ shākya thub pa las lhag pa'i 'dren pa ma mchis te khong la'ang nyer spyad rdo'i lhung bzed las med pas/ gser dngul gyi rta sga dang / ja tir gyi gzi byin bsgrubs pa spangs shing / bdag pos gzung ba'i rten mchod dang / rang sa'i gtsug lag khang la khyim gyi 'du shes shar ba'i rten bzhengs 'di yang / rta la rgyan du byas pa de/ /bdag po nyid la mdzes pa yin//zhes pa der snang ngas bsod nams kyi rgyur gtan nas mi 'gro bar rig nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su dmag 'khrug nad dal mu ge sogs je cher dar ba zhi ba la dmigs nas bsam yas chos 'khor chen por chos longs sprul gsum gyi rten bzheng dgos pa las/ 'di lo 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku rgyur dngul srang bzhi brgya tham pa/ khri rgyab sogs gser zangs kyi rgyur zangs khal brgyad/ gser srang brgyad las 'phags pa'i ldem sku sle'u chung dang bzo sgros tha mi dad byon gtsang yid du 'ong bar phra rgyan gru g.yu spus dag gi phra spungs/ shel phreng byu ru che legs bcu'i rgyan bcas dang / jo bo byang chub chen po'i sku mdun du bod 'bangs bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel du gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga la brdungs pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams kyi bzo rgyu dang / gla thob srang lnga bcu bcas 'dod dpal du bskyal/ grub mtshams gong sa rin po che nas bka' sho/ spyan

bzang gos yug dang / rgya dngul rta mig ma bcas bsam yas chos 'khor chen por spyir chog rogs nyi shu skor dang bcas rab gnas bdun phrag gcis gi bar byed dgos pa phebs pa bzhin/ bsam yas su 'dus pa mdo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i bsgrub pa dang 'brel bar zhag bcu skor gyi bar du dngos sta thel ma rgya gzhung gi cho gar ldan pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi mtha' rten pa byas/ gtsug lag khang yongs rdzogs la rab gnas kyi don po bzhi dang ldan pa'i lhag gnas kyi me tog gtor/ sems bskyed gling du chos nyid kyi ngang gcig la ma chags pad+ma can gyi sgra tshig las 'das pa'i gsung sga snang bar/ dbang bcu'i dang po dpe byad grangs/ /de steng ye shes lnga ldan dpal/ /zhes pa'i don du snang / zhal gser stong mchod dang / rab byung grwa tshang la nyin gsum gyi bar bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs btsugs/tshar dod dang yon thob la dngul dang zang ras smar ba btang / 'phags pa'i dbu thog dang nye ba'i bar khang bi ka gling bzhi pa gcig la byibs khebs mthongs rgya ser gyi bos chen dang smal sham rgyan bzhi/ 'ja' khon chu li rin thang can sogs spel ba'i gnam rgyan dang dngul sung brgyad cu'i rgyu 'gro can dang / lcam gling gcis la mthongs mdzod gos lañca mas byas pa'i gnam rgyan bcas dang /zhabs rjes rin po cher bzang gos tshon spel gyi phur ma/ bsam mchims kun mkhyen chen po'i dbu thog rdo rje gsang lam ma ser po'i bla bre/brag dmar ke'u tshang du gdung khebs phur ma bcas phul/ jo bo'i sku mdun gser zho dang / ṭa kha so bdun gyi tshom bu maṇ+ḍal dang mchod 'bul gyi mthar/ bod 'bangs bde ba dang / 'brel thogs la smon lam rgya mtsho chen po btab/ rab grwa gtso bor 358

gyur pa'i mon bod kyi ser skya brgya skor la dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom phog /rab grwa nyi shu skor dang /mon shar ro lam pa/ra ma gyang ra ba/gzhong mkhar pa/gdung bsam pa bcas skad rigs mi gcig pa sum cu skor la khrid tshar gnyis bshad/ lo gsum dang / lo mtshams gu ru'i snying po dang / ma ṇi dung phyur gyi dam bca' 'bul ba'ang kha shas byung / snga lo ltar mon shar nub tshor ri dwags sbrang tshang sogs bslu rgyu'i dngul sung nyi shu skor bskur zhing ri rgya btab/ sems bskyed mchod pa'i zhal 'debs dang bcas lug nyi shu skor tshe thar byas/ dbul po rnams la sbyin pa rgya gang che byas/ ras phug sku skyes bskul ma mdzad nas skya ser mang zhig la gsol 'debs man ngag bcu gsum ma'i gtor dbang byas/ rta mgrin gling dang dgon pas sbrus sogs su gong sa rin po che dang / srid skyong rta tshag gi tshe sgrub sbyin sreg sogs bsgrubs/ slob dpon tshul khrims bsod nams sogs nas yod dgu bla mar bsngo ba'i bsnyen bkur dang brtan bzhugs/ de mtshungs chos rje brag phug pa khe smad rigs ldan sgrol 'bum sogs nas kyang bsnyen bkur 'bul nod rgya che ba dang / brtan bzhugs yang yang mdzad/ sgrol 'bum ma'i mu tig sran spos tsam drug cu skor dang /g.yu dmar gyi sked phra cha bcas rta mgrin gling slob dpon chen po'i dbu zhwa gsar phul la dpyangs/ chos rje brag phug pas sbyin bdag mdzad de bstan srid bde thabs su ma mgon g.yul mdos rgyas pa bdun phrag lhag bcas btsugs/ bsad mdos su zhal bsgyur ni nyer dgu'i mdos zor 'phen khar tshar gcig las ma byas pas/ nyer brgyad kyi nub mo dpal sdings rje btsun ma'i mnal lam du bud med khros pa'i gzugs can mang pos nged cag la 359

dmag brda ni byung / lag cha ma sprad zer ba dang / skor lam du 'dre'i 'du tshogs mngon sum du mthong ba sogs 'tshub lhongs chen po byung bas g.yul mdos 'di bstan srid kyi rim gror bsnyen sgrub thengs pa las gang dran du gyer na rang srog la gnod par 'dug/sa sbug tu 'bri gung pa'i 'dag sbyar ba dka' spyad sdug sgur gyi 'jur dran can la gegs sel bogs 'don byas shing dngul srang gsum gyi mthun rkyen byin/ gling stod smad lnga bcu skor gyi mang 'gyed/ stod pa rnams la dgongs pa yang zab kyi tshogs brgya mdzad bcug /rje btsun rat+na'i sku la snyan shal phul/ bka' brgyud pa 'di dag snang che bas 'bri gung ljongs pa sku skye gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang / chung tshang zur ba rang bi yab gshegs pa'i bsngo rgyun khongs su mtshams zhu gnang ba la de la na dang yon tan mdzod phul bas slar bang mi ched gnang gi zhu 'phrin dri bzang phon che ba bcas 'byor ba la dgongs bzhed bzhin mdzod 'grel kyang phul/ bka' blon pha lhas rten bzhengs kyi legasu sor za babs yug dang bcas lha ldan du gdan 'dren gyi chab shog dang mi sna nan bstud byung yang dad gshin gyi dkor la brkam chags dang / che gnyan la bsten nas re dogs byed rgyu gang yang med pas rang gnas su log /rdo pa'i rta bsu dang bcas sbyin bdag gdon gnod kyi ches cher gzir nas nyen pa la bka' bsgo/ sbyin sreg /tshe dbang sogs byas pas 'phral du phan/ 'ag gsum gyi bar bka' brgyad dang phur pa'i sbyin sreg /dmangs mi la tshe dbang sogs byas/ gru nang du chu klung 'di'i rgyud la gnas pa'i srog chags dang / chu ngogs su 'gro ba rnams spyod 'jug gi smon lam sogs btab/ gru kha nas khe smad kyi rta bsu dang bcas khra 360

'brug tu yum sgrol 'bum mas mchod pa dang tshogs brgya bshams 'dug pa bzhin/ mchod khang rnams la snyan shal dang / gu ru'i lha khang du tshogs brgya btang / sne rdzong gi khang gnyer chos la dad pa can zhig sgugs 'dug pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel byas/ khyim na gnas pa la skyo ba bden kyang sems can la tho ma 'phog pa dang / phan sems yang dag byas na ltar snang gi btsun gzugs la smon mi dbos zhes smras/ khe smad du bdun phrag lhag bcas ring nyin ltar tshe chos /tshogs bskang / phur pa'i sbyin sreg sogs byas/ lar dad can dang / khyim pa phal cher snang ba dag pas yon gnas bla ma'i rigs phebs pas chog par blta yang dkor sbyong mi byed par hor 'dra ltar ngo g.yog mang pos bza' ba 'dir dkon mchog khrel ba yin pas bsam yas ma 'khor bar thang chad se byung / yum sgrol 'bum ma 'di yon gnas thams cad la dad gtong che/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rgyun chags su mdzad pa'i steng rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid btab pas bskyed rim rang rgyud du 'dzin pa'i gegs las grol/gyon pa cha tshang dang /gser dngul/mdzo mo sogs kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ rang gnas su 'byor 'phral lho rgyud du rang bstan la sman pa slob dpon 'jigs med kun grol 'byor pa'i kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum thor bu'i pod/ rang nyid kyi dgongs gter bstan bcos cha tshang gra mtshungs pod bcu skor/ gser dngul/ bye ru'i brgya phreng / 'go snam chos spel gyi 'bog khebs/ rgya dar zong ras spus dag 'bor che/ tho ska/ tha li/li'i ga ḍa che chung / ba so'i sgam chung sogs a tsa ra'i nyer spyad rgya che ba dang bcas pa'i brtan bzhugs mdzad/ khong gi rang yul du lo gsum tshar gnyis kyi mtshon 361

bsgrub pa'i zhabs tog dang / rgyud 'bum/mdzod bdun/ snying tig sogs rang bstan la 'chad spel gyi phrin las dang gsung rab de dag gsar bzhengs khrid yig par bsko/ rgya bod kyi mtshams gdung bsam gyi ri rtser bsgrub grwa bstan rgyas ri bo btsugs nas grwa btsun bzhi bcu skor mtshams sgrub la 'jug pa'i sgrigs srol legs pas bstan pa 'phel rgyas la zhabs tog gcis tu che/ dad dam shes rab gsum gyi snang ba yangs pas gzhan don nus pa'i khar blo gtsang zhing kun spyod zhib pas bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa zhis blangs na 'thad min zhu bar/ deng sang sngags lam gyi drod thob pa lta ci/ go don tsam la'ang rmongs pas kun tu bzang po'i khrel bag gi spyod pa la 'gong ba'i dus 'dir bstan pa'i mig rkyen la'ang phan pa shin tu che zhing / bla ma'i dbongs pa'ang des rdzogs so zhes spro ba bskyed/ dus dbang gi brten mkhas kyi yon tan tshang ba'i mkhan po dkon yang / nges 'byung la gus shing gzhan gnod gzhi bcas la ldos pa'i sar dengs shig ces bskul/ sngar ma thob pa'i dbang bka' rjes sanang thams cad kyi bka' gtad byas/ mtsho rgyal bla mtsho'i lung bstan yang 'di la blta ba 'dra/ rang gnas su khong gi slob ma rnams dang / kho long ba bcu grangs la khrid btab/ sde dge lha lcam ngang tshul mas yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel pod gnyis la shog grangs stong la nye ba'i par phud glegs bam cha bdun/mtshams zhu dang bcas pa/ rig pa'i gnas rnams la rnam dpyod yangs pa rang khab kyi drung yig pa pad+ma rnam dag gi zhus dag mdzad pa'i mtshams zhu dang /dogs sel bcas 'byor/par shing yar dgos na'ang 'bul gsung ste/bod chos nyams chung / phyogs ris che/ phal cher chos kyi sun/ dar la ma smin 362

pa'i skabs 'dir dgos pa chung zhing / sa jog ring po nas khal ma'i dka' sbyongs gcig por yang 'jigs pas rang sar ba'ag /dpon 'bangs gnyis khar legs so'i zhu lan dang /dngos po mi dbos skra sen sogs dbos tshul la bla ma dpal sdings pa'i ga'ur rang nyid kyi 'gram sor skyes pa'i ring bsrel 'bur gnyis dod pa 'phel phye dang bcas pa dang / 'jon dmar gyi snang mtha'/ 'bo snam sogs rten bcas 'os ris/ drung yig dang par dpon la'ang de mtshungs bcas song / dge stong speg la rbad dang / mtshon gyi dbad pa rbad du nor ba sogs las par 'dzugs mang po par chud zos kyi rgyur snang /dpal grwa sum cu skor gyis gtsos 'dus pa bzhi bcu skor la/ grol thig rig 'dzin/ thugs rje chen po zhi drag /'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa/ gshin rje gsum dril rnams kyi dbang dang / 'don chos phal cher gyi lung bcas bgyis shing / mdo sngalas smon lam la go don bshad pa yis thog tu 'khod pa byas/srid skyong rta tshag rin po ches rgyud 'bum dkar chag gi mtshon pa'i rtsom rigs g.yar po dgos tshul dang / rgyud 'bum gsung sgrog byed du gnang ba'i nyin gsum gyi ring grwa pa rnams kyis bsgrubs/ grol thig gi bdag 'jus blangs shing /cho ga phyag len la 'ang sa/ dar byas/ gshin rje'i skor dang / thugs rje chen po'i skor la yig gsar byung ba zhabs tog yin kyang / sater gzhung dang sprul pa'i gter ston gyi ljags bsgrigs la bcos na mi legs pas nor ba yod sar mchan bus btab/ la ra tshe bdag zla gsang nag po dang / 'char ka chu thig sngon po'i rgyud nas bsdu lugs legs pa gnubs chen gyi rnam dpyod du che ba bzhin sprul pa'i gter ston chen po 'dis gshed skor la de 363

bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs phyag rgya zil gnon rdo rje'i rigs 'joms byed nag po/ rin po che'i rigs kha thun/ pad+ma'i rigs 'jigs byed ru mtshon dmar po/ las kyi rigs gshor song nyi ma khros pa sogs rigs lnga dang / tshe bdag bka' gter/ lcags 'dra lcags sdig /khro chu/ ki nang / yang bzlog /gsar ma'i gshed skor rgya mtsho lta bu gsan cing lhongs su gyur pa yin na/gang chen mtsho'i zhing khams la 'dzam bu'i gling bi gling bshad byed pa'i snga rabs pa kha cig gis 'jigs byed yod pa gzhan phyogs dang 'dres pa'o snyam du rtog cing dpyod pa ni mu cor smra ba yin no/ /lo snga phyir phur pa rgyud lugs kyi sbyin sreg 'bum ther re/ chab gtor de mtshungs/ tshe gzungs 'bum ther/bshags rgyud brgya rtsa/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ tshe mdo brgya rtsa dang / dpal rir 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod la zhabs tog nyin 'khyodas/'gyed ṭaṃ kha re/rgyud 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / mdzod bdun shing rta skor gsum rtsa 'grel dang bcas khyon pod sum cu so bdun la na bza'/ gdong dar/ glegs chab dngul dkar gzong ris mtshal gser can zho lnga re'i ljid ldan/ tong skud ljang gu'i si ta tu zhe mtshungs dang / rten gtso rnam snang la rin po che'i srog zhu g.yu pad gsum pa/ g.yu byur spel ba'i spa sdom bcas dngul srang brgya'i rin thang can phul/lha bab dus chen nyin srong btsan du stong mchod dang / ka 'phen che ba cha/bzang gos kyi gdong khebs 'phur ma can/ khra 'brug o rgyan lha khang gi phyi khyams ka gling bzhi'i sar bzang gos bcad ldan me tog ser po dang / rgyan bzhi sngon pos mthongs byas pa'i mdzod gos tshos spel yug bcu drug gi gnam rgyan dang / zhal gso'i stong mchod bcas phul/ lho brag thugs sras sku skye rin 364

po che gzhis gar 'khor zhag la phebs/ dbang zhig dgos gsungs pa la thugs rgyud smin du re bas mkha' 'gro yang tig byas/ thegs khar gcod kyi lung dgos gsung ba bla ma sku na phra/ las dang po pa yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /zhes pa la sems bskyed nas rten 'brel mi ldog par byas shing / mdzod bdun shing rta skor gsum dang / rang mdzod rtsa 'grel solas kyi bka' gtad smon lam byas/ lar pal mo che la/ mdza' min de ni shes rab mgon/ /sdig dang byis grogs kyis bkab pa'i/ /glang po bste gnas tsam gyis dregs/ /rgya chen chos kyi snod las bskal/ /kurma pa zhwa nas rin po che'i gsung 'phrin la yon tan mdzod kyi skyes lan phul/lho mon kho long stod rtsa mnga' zhes pa'i sa yul du rang slob phrin la sa rgyal mtshan gyi dgon gnas mchod khang gsar bzhengs la/rten skal sgrol ma chos li/ thub dbang bka' li/tsan+dan dmar po'i slob dpon chen po gtso 'khor/ tsan dan gyi mchod rten byin can/ rdor dril/ maṇ+ḍal / mchod kong sogs mchod cha dang / rten gsar bzhings kyi gzungs la sangs rgyas gser thub kyi ring bsrel/ 'bor che/ byin rten sna 'dus/ nye bar spyad pa'i gyon pa sogs bskur zhing dgon pa'i ming 'gro phan 'od zer du btasas/ slob dpon 'jigs med pa dengs khar/gdung bsam yongs lha bstan rgyas ri bo dpal 'bar gling gi rten skal du chos li la sa grub pa'i o rgyan chen po'i snang brnyan che legs byin can/ rdor dril gser 'go ma legs pa/hor zhus mdzod 'grel pod gnyis bcas bskur/srid skyong rta tshag rin po che'i phur sgrub bdun phrag gcig btsugs/ jo bo shākya mu der cho 'phrul zla ba ril por mchod me sdong rkang nyin mtshan 'khyongs pa 365

dang / snya na shal a yu she bsrings/ ma kha' 'gro'i me mchod 'bum ther/ tshe gzungs 'bum ther/mda' grwar mang ja/dbul por sbyin btong sogs byas/rnam smin gyi lus rten 'di'i chos nyid kyi rten can sgo rnyi tsista rat+na dhar dri bzhon gyi dpyang thag la drang ba dang / khyab par gdal ba sogs la lang tsho'i dus nas 'bad mi dbos pa'i rang dbang can nyid na'ang / rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi thugs rje'am/ /las kyi gzhan dbang gang yin kyang / /ri mo'i song nas rgya gar rgyal pos glang chen thal kur gzhon nu'i skyes bskur ba'i rmi lta sa ltar kun+da'i myu gu zhig kyang 'phel/ snga lo sgom pa zhig g.ya' 'u nga du bsgrub pa'i mi ltas su/pad+ma 'od gling nas yon bdas bi khyim thog rgyal mtshan la 'od zer 'phro ba dang / skyed tshal der ha lo'i sdong po ya mtshan can skyes pa la mi mang pos skor ba byed pa/ lo 'dir skya rengs dang nyi ma nub phyogs nas la na gsum shar ba dang / bla ma dpal sdings pa lo gsum la yod thog lhums dus dang mtshungs par khang thog der khri lcog mthon po dkar yol dang bcas pa ras dkar gyi khebs byas pa sogs byung zer kyang re dogs dang 'dus byas ni/bslu ba'i chos can nyid yin phyir mnyam pa chen por gdal/'on kyang la nye ni bzang ste/de ma thag pa'i zhag bdun pa la mdo khams nas rang slob dad dam shes rab can 'jigs med blo gsal sa skyong sde dge'i brtan bzhugs 'bul rgyu dang / rdo bla 'jigs med kyi dbus rdzogs chen phyogs kyi bla ma bla mchan sde dge'i mi drag rnams dang bcas pa'i mtshams zhu rten sum cu skor 'byor/ rdo bla 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer dpon slob sde dge'i pho brang du/ phur pa rgyud lugs dang / dpal chen gyi bsgrub pa mdzad pas/ mngon rtags legs 366

tshul dang / sde dge'i mnga' ris dase rtse zhes pa'i yu la du sa skyong dbang mos bdag rkyen mdzad nas mi ser la tho mi phog pa'i gnang sbyin dngul sung brgya skor bcas rang lugs kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dbon pa 'du khang ka ba bcu drug bi sa gsar 'debs mdzad/ snga sor par khang i bka' bstan par shog ngan pa bzang du btang ba'i dge bskul dang len gnang tshul bcas 'byor/ sand byang la sa/ ngang tshul pho gyong rgyal mo btsun:dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro e la dzas :chos srid rten 'brel legs tshogs spel :zhes pa dang /rdo blas klong snying gi khrid bshad pa'i 'dus pa snga phyi bar gsum la/ nyis stong dang /sum sto nga dang / lnga stong la sosas pa byung zhing / khyim pa rnams kyi rngon pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' 'bul bas srog chags bgrang ba las 'das pa tshe thar zhing mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa thob pas/ nged kyi dben pa ra zug nas smon 'jus sis sems bskyed pa la grub 'bras cung zad byung snyam pa'i spro ba skyes/nam snying nyang ban mchos dbyangs dang : lha sras sprul pas chos sgo 'byed:ces pa'i lung bstan rnams mngon du gyur/dgon(dbe)rtse sprul pa'i sku phebs nas zla sacig lhas bcas bzhugs ring dbang chos dang chos don gyi dri ba mdzad pa rnams la rton pa bzhi ldan gyi lan yang dag byas/ chos mthun dad ldan gyi slob ma 'jigs med blo gsal can dang 'jigs med chos ldan/ gling spyi bo ri khrod kyi slob dpon rig 'jin/ chab mdo bza rab rgyas/ dar mdo pad+ma skal bzang / rgyal rong pa bsod nams bkra shis/ yid lhung pa pad+ma dkon mchos /kurma phun tshogs gnyis sogs 'dus pa nyi shu skor la klong snying gi khrid sogs smin grol gyi sgo phye/ dpal 'dzin gyi 'byams yig lan rgyal ba 367

gnyis pas mdzad pa/ dkar chag rin po che'i mdzod khang du yang ma thebs shing / dpe rgyun da phan mthong thos ma byung ba 'di lo gtsang nas rnyed pa la lhan thabs gas ra bsnan dang / kun slo nga ngan pa'i ngag tshig brlang pos ka das la zur za byas pa'i lan dbos tshul la/ bod 'dir sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi dgag sgrub kyang phyogs lhung bi kun nas blangs pa'i chos spong dang bstan sel sde 'khrul sogs kyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu song snang na/ deng sang phyogs re'i mis can la dgag lan dbos pa'i rgyu mi snang ste/gzu bor gnas pa dang /dad pa'i rjes 'brangs rnams yid gnyis las grol ba'i phyir/ rdo rje gzesas ma'i mtshon cha de blo thog nas yud tsam la bris/ lar ka dag gi sgra don dang 'brel ba'i rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba 'di/ khrid rim thams cad la yin lugs rjen par ngo sprad kyang / shes sgrib kyi 'og nas ldang mi nus par 'dus pas/slad kyi bsgrub pa la yun ring du zhugs shing mos gus kyi mtshams sbya ra nas rtogs pa ni re mang byung la/ gzhan du dbu ma sems tsam gyi lta ba la/ dran pa mngon du bzhag pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba dang phyag rdzogs kyi ming can sha stag snang / khams stag mo dbon nas nyi grags rin po che'i mtsharmas zhu 'bas brtan dang dbu mdzad brtson 'grus kyi dri ba la lan btab/ sa skyong sde dbe'i rgyal bu 'jigs bral tshe dbang rdo rje rig 'dzin la springs yig char sprin gyi rol mo dang ston pas rgyal po la bcas pa'i 'jus pa'i bsla ba bya gsum las/mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs sbyin dang / bzod pa'i rten 'brel las sku tshe 'phel phyir/ da lta ba'i nas can btson dong du chud pa rnams bde bar dbusas 'byin gyi dge bskul byas/ dase rtse'i dgon gsar 'og min rig 'dzin 'phel 368

rgyas gling gi rten skal du chos li phyi ma'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum mtho tshad pa/phur pa rgyud lugs kyi zin bris lag bris ma/ bka' gdams pad spungs/ gtso phur gser skud kyi bcad ldan spus dag byin can/ glang mche/ rgod tshang sna tshogs pa'i dbu zhwa/ rang nyid kyi dbang zhwa sogs dang / rgyal rong dgon par phur pa rgyud lugs sgrub mchod gtan chags tshugs rgyu la tsan+dan dmar po'i gtso phur spus dag che legs bsrings/ tshogs pa lnga bcu skor gyi tshe chog /tshe bzungs sun bzlog dang 'brel bar sa skyong sde dge'i zhabs brtan nyin 'khyodas ṭa 'gyed bcas dang / 'jigs med blo gsal 'od zer la bka' gtad rjes gnang byin nas bla mchan du dbang bskur ba bzhin maṇ+ḍal bshad pa 'ang 'grel chags pa byung zhing / sde dge rang nas bi warta dang bcas pa'i mngon brjod 'di ltar te ro mtshar dwang byung pad sdong rtser 'khrungs mi 'gyur rdo rte'i gsang ba gsum/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang bzhin lha dang bla ma dbyer med dngos/ /'ardigs bad brtul zhugs grub pa'i grags snyan 'dzam glid tha grur yongs khyab pa'i/ /rnga yab dpal ri'i rig 'dzin gtso de gangs ljongs skyabs su deng byon nyid/ /'dren pa mchos gi spangs rtogs yon tan cha/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la mngon rdzogs ye shes rtsal/ /ston dang bsta na 'dzin dam pa bsam 'das las/ /deng 'dir tshur mthong rdo rje'i slob dpon tshul/ /dran dang mkhyen bzhin da dus brtan 'gro'i gnyen/ /srid pa gzung bar lam zhugs bsag sbyang la/ /ltos pa min kyang don mthun bsdu dngos kyi/ /369

mdo sngags bstan la rim 'jug brtul zhugs gzhes/ /gzigs pa dri med chos spyan dag pa'i ngor/ /phra zhib rang gzhan grub mtha' rnam 'byed kyis/ mkhyen dpyod 'di 'dra 'phags chen ngang tshul las/ /tshur mthong sbyangs stobs tsam gyi spyod yul ci/ /tshul des rnam mkhyen 'jug pa skad cig rer/ /'khor 'das chos kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid/ /sgrib thogs bral des shes byar mtha' med pa'i/ /grags skam dbang gzhu stong chen dbyings su yal/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bgrang yas bskal pa'i srid/ /byang chen snying por gang bi gshegs pa'i lam/ /'doms la khyed dang rgyal sras zhi ba lha/ /dbus mtha'i yul gyi bskal pas so sor rtogs//nges don dkyil 'khor bdag por yongs grub pas/ rgyud sde'i lam srol 'byed la bsnyengs bral 'dis/ /gnas gsum ḍāk+ki'i pha nor bu skal du/ /gsang ma dzod sde mis khyod la gtad min nam/ /khyad par rab mchog rtse mo'i skal ldan can/ /thun mong yul min nges gsang rdzogs pa che'i/ /shing rta'i srol chen 'byed la mtsho skyes rje/ /mngal skyes 'phrul gyis slar yang deng byon bzhin/ /phyag rdzogs dbu ma chen po rnam gsum zhes/ /myur bul mgo snyoms gad rgyangs cher sgrogs kyang / /zag bcas phung po 'od skur mngon dengs pa/ /mchog lasang a ti'i khyad chos ci yis bsto na/ /tshul de'i rgyal rig gang zag zab gter gyi/ /byin rlabs klung chen dar drag byung mod de/ /dgun chu'i nyag ltar phra 'dir 'dren pa khyod/ /rgyal kun bka' bgros 'byon par bskul min nam/ /kun bzang dbongs pa'i klong chen 'gro rgyud la/ /smin mdzad snying tig rdo rje'i tshis long rer/ /zab don bdud ci'i chu klung 'bum 'jo gang / /gdengs can bdag po khyod kyi drin las thob/ /yon tan dpag 370

yas rin chen mdzod kyis mtshon/ /don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel 'chos skyob tshogs/ /bskal bzang dga' ston stsal ba'i sku yi drin/ /dngos por gyur na mkha' 'di snod du chung / /lnga bdo'i brlang spyod 'bigs byed sa 'dzin spo/ /phrin las stobs kyi nor ldan bzhir nyal nas/ /rgyal bstan nyin byed 'dzam gling gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sngon byung 'chi med sde dpon 'phrul la zhugs/ /khyod zhal mthong dang gsung gi zegs ma tsam/ /skal bar thob pa'i mod la su zhig kyang / /gang zag dam pa'i grangs su bgyis nus 'dis/ /'brel tshad don ldan gtam de mngon du gyur/ /yul dang ska da rigs mi gcig lam ring gis/ /bskal kyang smon lam dus smin las ldan tshogs/ /khyod drung chos don gnyer la ngang pa'i khyu/ /pad+ma'i rdzing bur 'du ba'i rjes su bsnyegs/ /mtha' khob kla klo'i 'gro mang dam chos kyi/ /snod du mdzad 'dis sngon rabs mi la rjes/ /dresas gtum khyi dang rngon pa gdams khrid kyis/ /smin par mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar mngon du stsal/ /mchod pa'i zhing du 'brel mtshon yo byad dngos/ /gang zhig bstabs kun bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i gzhir/ /bskrun 'dis srid pa'i phun tshogs ya ma brlar/ /grags pa de yang snying thus lci bar mdzad/ /mdor na mgon khyod gsang gsum las brtsams te/ /bsngags pa'i gling bu bskal par bsgyur na yang / /rang bzhin brjod pa'i cha tsam rdzogs min na/ /phul byung sgro btags lam du ci zhig 'dren/ /de lta'i yon tan gter gyur mgon khyod la/ /gzhan gyis gsol gdab ci 'tshal mkha' khyab 'gro/ /srid las sgrol ba nyid kyi g.yar dam phyir/ /de srid gzugs sku 'tsho zhing cis mi gzhes/ /don dam nges pa lnga ldan rang bzhin gang / /'pho 'gyur bral yang lhag bsam ldan dag gis/ /371

ro 'dzin dbang po smra ba ngag gi sgo/ /don yod bgyid phyir zhabs pad brtan mdzod ces/ /nyer len rdul snyed grangs kyi thal mo sbyar/ /rnam smin dkar por 'bab pa'i zhu mchid 'dir/ /don 'bras snye mar smin par mi mdzad na/ /'gro la bu ltar phan bzhed brtse chen gyi/ /thugs dam nges kyang bslu bar mi 'gyur ram/ /de phyir gzugs sku gcig gis srid mtha'i bar/ /'gro sgrol mdzad pa gu ru pad+ma dang / /rnam dbyer med par mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khrir/ /nam yang brling bar zhal 'ches gsol 'debs rten/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i snang brnyan che legs tsha gser can/ mtshan 'bum gser bris ma/ bden rnam shing rta pod gnyis/ rdor dril gser rtsi ma stan bcas/ byang chub sems phreng byu ru'i rgyan gyis phyug pa/ gser gyi bcu bshad can/ tsi na'i sman phreng tong skud kyi pho ris rin thang can shubs bcas/ nang mdzod/ dngul dkar gyi maṇ+ḍal phul ma che legs/ zhal dkar/ stegs khebs thags drub seng che ris/ dkar rgyu tshon khra can las grub pa'i seng ge cha/ gser 'o lnga bcu tham pa/ rgya dngul bre chen gcig /ha shig gi yol go /gu gu shel gyi ga'u rin chen ril bu gsum ldan/shel dam/ bsil g.yab/ tsi na'i phyogs brtag 'khor lo/ mdzod bos ṭa kha ma yug/ling sngo ljang dmar gsum so so nas yug re/ ka ras sgrubs/ tsi na'i bzo bkod rin po che'i tog dang / steng gi khor yug mu khyud tsha saser phul can de mtshungs bya 'dabs zel mtshams tsha gser gyi 'phur 'gro'i kha nas nor bu cha bdun tong skud kyi 'phyang 'phrul can re res mtshan cing / shel mtshon gyi dra phyed la tong skud kyi phur ma bzhi brtsegs kyi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bcas/ bdog pa'i yo byad phra mo 'di dag dang / /bdag gzhan 37 2

dus gsum bsags pa'i dge 'bras sdoms/ /kun kyang mchod pa'i sprin du yongs spel nas/ /mgon khyod zhabs pad brtan phyir nyer stob na /bsam sbyor gcig tu dkar ba'i sa bon 'bras/ /bslu med dam pa'i zhing sar gang btab pa/ /'dod don g.yur du smin pa chos nyid ltar/ /ji ltar gsol 'di snying pos lci gyur cig /des mthus gus ldan bdag cag ltos par bcas /srid 'bangs mnga' ris yangs pa'i bde skyid dpal/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun la dbang 'byor pas/ /rdzogs ldan dang po'i rtse dgar rol gyur cig /ji srid nam mkha' gzugs gzhan ma gyur par/ /mgon khyod yon tan rjes dran mchid 'di 'dra/ /dpyid kyi pos pa'i sbrang ci'i mgrin snyan ltar/ /dus dang dus su rtag tu gsol bar smon/ /de ltar bod chen yul gru lha mi'i sde/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyis skyong ba'i rgyal khab nas/ /'bras ldan dkar po'i zla ba'i tshes dag bar/ /gus pa'i sor bcu snying gar zum ste phul/ /ces so/ /mon spa gro stag tshang dang nye ba'i gnas phu dgon pa'i sku skye lnga pa kun dga' rnam rgyal lam/'jigs med bde chen go cha dang /hor brag 'a go ba pad+ma lhun grub/lho brag thi phyi khyung tshang dbu mdzad can la klong snying gi khrid/ /rang dgon gyi sku skye rin po che la sogs pa 'dus pa nyi shu skor la snying thig ya bzhi/ klong snying phur pa rgyud lugs la sogs pa'i dbang ka byas/ /lar bi ma la'i snying tig ma bu spyi dang /khyad par de'i dbang gong ma gnyis ni/ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang yin pas/ rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi bla mas slob ma grangs bcad la bskur ba las gang byung gi byas na slob dpon rang nyid nyams shing 373

ma/ba' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung la/ slob mas kyang dbang mi thob par shes dbos/ gal te spros bcas spros med gnyis tsam byed kyang gzhung de'i tshogs mchod kyi rim pa dang 'brel bar dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing bzlas pa byas nga/ legs pa yin/spa gro'i bla ma gnyis snga 'gyur gyi ring lusas 'dzin rtsa 'i sde can dang / khyad par bi ma la dang / rgyal ba klong chen pa'i gzhung la dad pas/mdzod bdun/ shing rta sko ragasum/ rang gi bka'a'abum yongs rdzo nas bka' gtad byas/ khong be rnying rgyud tshar gcig bzheng bar dam bca' ba la bsngo smon dang / kun mkhyen gyi ba ka' 'bum cha tshang bsgrub pa'i rtsis la rogs 'gyu ra byas shrī par+sha ta'i sku skye rin ngo cher grol thig skor/ gshin rje gsum dril sogs pha chos kyi ngabang yongs rdzob/sa dang / 'do ma/ chos kyi lung / de'i steng du grwa gzhon phal cher dang bcas pa'i 'dus pa lnga bcu skor la bka' brgyad tshal 'byor rgyum/ dbang / dgongs pa ya nga zab/ (ji nga bzlog so gas kyi dbang bskur/ yon sbyar te bshags rgyud klog /dang/la rir tshogs/ chen 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod 'char cam zhabs tog nyin 'gyed dang tshogs 'bor btang /mnga' ris grwa tshang par chos spyod sma ra zhing / thing rta chen po'i ring lusas la bsha ) grwa rgyaraphe pa bas mang ja bzhi dang /lo ltar mang ja lnga'i thebs/ dngul sung nyi shu rtsa lnga sbyar/ phyogs thams cad mu gis nyam thag la snying rje chem/ po skyes nas sbyin gtong ci nus byas/ deb sngon las/ gangs can pa rnams la gtsug gi no ra bu gcig dang rna ba'i rgyan gnyis yod/gtsug gi nor bu ni slob dpon pad+ma sa wa'i/ /zhes pa ltar/ gangs can du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar nus pa khyed kyi bka' drin yin kyang mkhas su re ba'i snying khams can gyis log 374

bsgrub dang dbyen bcos pa la thugs rje dus las mi yol ba'i phyir brag dmar ke'u tshang du rgya dngul srang lnga bcu las brdungs pa'i maṇ+ḍal paraphul ma tsha gser can dang khon chu li'i gnam rgyan spus dag phul/ rang gnas su 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod 'char can btsugs/ chab gtor 'bum ther gcig btang /gtsang nas yang stengs pa'i lo gsum grol mjal dang bsdongs pa'i rtse chen chos sde pa gsum dang / sgo bsdus lha sdings slob dpon bcas pa dge bu gsum la sogs pa'i btsan btsun kha shas la khrid cigabatab/ lar gnas skabs kyi grags skam la snyegs nas chos nyan par lhags pa mtha' dag gi gdams pa'i srol kha mi zin kyang / nges 'byung dang las 'bras byang chub sems kyi rnam thar gang drag bshad pas kha shas blo 'gyur bas nyes spyod mi 'chab par bathags sdom byed pa'ang kha shas byung / khong rnams dang pha lha'i chos drung gnyis nas brtan bzhugs 'bul nod che bar mdzad/ zhabs drung gis slob dpon chen po'i gsung dngos bstan man ngag lta phreng dang / yang dag gi gsang dzo grel pod longs/ mnga' bdag nyang gi chos 'byung pod/ rong pas mdzad pa'i lta phreng si 'grel pa dang / theg pa chen po'i tshul la 'jug/ pa gnyis dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa bstan 'gyur snar thang par ma'i mtshan thor lta phreng gis 'grel pa tsam thebs kyang don la ma chud pa skapas 'dir khyer byung bas/ bod gangs can gyi rgyud tsam na mkhas pa'i sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi bstan bcos 'de mthong nas spyir snga 'a gyur dang / dgos rdzogs chen pa la bskur ba'i mkhas zlos dag gi lce gshin rje'i khram ris lta bur song nas/ slar la lce gnyis pa skyong dgos pa de byung ngo / /chu bo rir lcags zam rin po che glo 375

bur du gshegs pa'i nan tur ngo ma chogs par bskyod/ bka' brgyad bder 'dus kyi sgo nas phur sbyangs dang / bdun phrag gi bar zhi khro khrom dkrugs/ me mchod 'bum ther sogs byas/ rang gzhan thams cad la 'di lta bu 'ong snyam pa'i nges 'byung rgyud mar skyes/ rgya gar slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang phyogs kyi glang po lta bu'ang skye 'phags gang yin gyi dpyad pa byed mod/bod 'dir ni rmā nas gang zhing tshogs lam gyi sna ma zin pa dag la slob pa min pa'i bste stang byed kyang / gang zhig gi rgyud kyi sgrib cha stong ba la 'gal rkyen byed pas dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo mchod sbyin la 'bad dgos pa'i bslab bya dang /bde gshegs snying po'i mthong spangs kyi dag bya sbyong ba'i thabs stobs smon lam gsum la 'bad/ chu bo ri'i ser chags tshogs pa la dngul srang bco lnga'i 'gyed btang / gdung rten gyi thig rtsa bslabs shing thon khar brtan bzhugs zhig kyang mdzad/ 'dir ne le gshog pa bregs pa zhig mthong bas snying rje chen po skyes/ byang chub grub pa'i smug nag khro 'dzum zhal/ /sems can kun la bu gcig ltar brtse na/ /mkha' lding 'dab ma spu gris bzhar ba yi/ /chu tshod gcig pa'i gdung ba'ang bzod par dka'/ /lus nyams brtas pa'i sbyin pa stobs bskyed la/ /chu shel 'khor lo khrums kyi nya ba'i tshe/ /lho mon nags ma'i ljongs su dengs 'jug pa'i/ /sems bskyed ldan pa yod mchi dgongs shig kye/ /zhes bris/ mon kla klo 'gro 'ong byed pa'i sa lhu thi zhes pa'i grong khyer nas sbrang tshang sum cu skor gyi rin la sku gsung thugs rten dang / lha 'dre gdug pa can la bka' shog dgos zer ba ltar de bzhin du byas/ sa skyong sde dge'i 'tshams zhu gser dngul gos dar spam che ba dang bcas pa'i mi sna 'byor/ btsun mo dam 376

pa'i chos kyi dri ba dang / snga lo nang rten la rang gi 'gram so phul bar mgul du bcangs pa la 'di lo ring bsrel gnyis tsam 'phel tshul kyang 'byor/ chos nyams che che mos gdams pa la thob rtsi zhing gsar ngas che yang don la mi rton pa'i rigs la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i re ba med/ rang rgyud grol ba dang chos rgyun la phan pa gnyis ka mi gda' bas/ chos 'di mos gus can rang gi bgo skal du snang / sde dge'i mnga' ris rdza cu kha nas phyag tsha dgon pa'i sku skye ched kyi byon pa la klong snying gi khrid dbang dang bka' gtad lung rags rim byas/snga lo nas gtsang theg mchog gling pa'i 'dus spyi'i gdan 'dren nan chags che bar chos kyi/ 'gro phan 'ba' zhig la bsams te/ ngal ba'i khur 'gyogs 'phyang gis bzod par byas te bskyod/ mang du thos pa'i dbang phyug se ra smad sku skye rin po che yang gan pa spang phug tu rjes snyegs kyis phebs/ khong la grwa pa grwa tshang gi tshogs dpon 'di mar 'then pa'i dpyang thag tu 'dug pa'i tshul/kun mkhyen bla ma'i/ sna tshogs thabs kyi 'khor mang bsdus nas ni/ /mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dgon gzhis 'dzin pa yang/ /'phral la 'dzoms te bdag sems g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /gcig pur sdod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dben par bzhugs pa'i bskul byang dang / da cha thos bsam kha phyir bltas kyi dpyad pa bsgom pas rgyud thog tu 'gel ba'i dus la bab pas/ /bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i do ha mdzod kyi nang dbyings su sdud pa'i ngo sprod legs par byas/ mtsho 'gram ma thon bar nya dang nya pa'i las 'bras la snying rje chen pos skyo ba 'phel zhing nya pa dang phrad tshad la srog bslu smon lam rgya chen po btab/ kha ro la rtser bsang 377

mchod dang / gser skyesas sogs byas pas de ma thag gnod sbyin gang bzang mnyes pa'i gangs rud dang /zhag sar norabu bzang po khong rang si srin mos sor gdupa sbyin nas bsrung bar gzung smras pa mis/ dkar phyogs kyi dge bsnyen 'di tsho dam tshig la gnas par 'dug /mkhar mo zhes par tsha phogs 'grig pas gu ru chos dbang si sku 'drar dkar me dang snyan shal 'bul du btang / grwa btsun rnams la mang ja zhig byas/ gtsang pa 'di dad mos dang chos snang che bas 9sum mjal dang / shigason gyi bsngo rten 'bul mi thin tu mang bas bla ma tsho dkor gyi 'dam rdzab la thebs par 'dus bka' blon pha lha'i rta bsu bcas rgyal rtser slebs/ rtse chen chos sde bas dung bsu dang bcas bos pa bzhin lam zhor zur rtsar bsnyen bkur dad 'bul dang / sgrol ma lha khang mjal zhing me tog 'thor/sa dge bu gsum gyi grwa tshang thadad 'dus pa'i tshogs chen nyis brgya skor la mang ja dang/bsngo rten gyi zang zing rnams 'gyed la btang / dga' ldan pa dang zu be grwa tshang pa'i 'du khang du gdan zhu la mang ja dang 'gyed kyang byas/ bkra shes bde legs kyi khyim du bsnyen bkur ma dzad ceng /mu tig dang /g.yu pad kyi rna rgya na rin thang chen po'i 'bul nod kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ grwa ma rab brtan gling du theg mchog gling mkhan rin po che gnyer phyag las 'dzin rnams thab bsu la byon/ sang nyin rgyang ring nas dung bsu dang dgon pa'i 'dabs su gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rnga rol bcas dge 'dun bying sa nas bste stang chen po mdzad/ mang ja sbyor sprul brgyad kyi thog bsod btab/sa dang / ṭaṃ kha lnga re'i 'gyed spyi rabul bzang rgos kyi rgyal mtsham/ 'ja' sham gsum ldan phul/ mkhan po o rgyan dpal mabon 378

pa'i thugs bskyed shin tu bzang zhing dpyad bzod pas dge 'dun rnams la khur du 'gro ba gtan med par mdzad nas dbang lung khrid gsum gyi rang sa'an smin grol la 'god pa'i zhu 'bul byung ba bzhin/ grwa tshang yongs rdzogs phyogs dang phyogs 'dus bcas la thob/ mar tshe da pag med sku ba/sum 'dus pa dang / dwangs rma bcud 'dren gyi dbang sgo phye ste/ bka' brgyad bde gsang gnyis/ bla ma minasang 'dung 5/ phur pa rgyud lugs/ nya ri gter khros nag /bla ma yang zhig rgya can phal che ba/ drang slong log tri/ gshin rje tshe bdag /byang gter thugs sgrub 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/gnyan sgrol dang /phyag rdor rabyung 'dul sogs bka' ma'i rjes ba/nang kha shas/ khyad pa ra klong chen snying tis/ gi smin grol phal cher rdzogs pa'i khrid shen tu smin pa ra btab/ byang sdom gyi pan lag tu mchod pa rgya chen po dang /lug sum cu sgo ra srog bslur btang /gtsus la / khang rten brten pa ra bcas pa la bka' brgyad bde gsheb/sa 'dus mi 'i sgo nas rab gnas da ngos sta nyica/ gnyis ma shin tu rgyas pa dang /dgon gnas kyi dkar chag kyang bring / grwa tshang 'dir dmag zor ma shin tu 'go ba'i nyams kyis / de'i rjes gnang gi tshe shar phyogs bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa ri tshe zla ba'i 'dod 'a jo zhes bya bar gras/sa/ 'khor ma mo mkha' 'gro 'i bum phrag mang pos skor/ lho phyogs kyi ming smos pa'i mur gnyid dwa ngas/ snga 9ragyur bka' ma dang /khyab 'jug tshe ring ma sogs kyi rjes gnang byas/bla brang du ma ma gon gyi rten ma dos tong skud las byas pa dngos dag dang bcang pa'i mgon khang gsar 'dzugs la rab gnas byas/ gral dburalan gsum phyin/ bde yangs su tshes bcu'i 'chams phul ba'i zhar khrom dbang kyang byas/dngul dkar las 379

grub pa'i dkar stegs/ bzed zhal/ nas ze/ nang mchod kā li rnams 'phul ma tsha gser can/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' sga 'khor spus dag /gser dngul 'bru sogs kyi dngos 'bul dang / zhabs brtan rgya chen mdzad/ so so'i gdan 'dren nan bskud che bas/ sde dpon 'brong rtse ba/ 'dus byung lho dgon skyid sbug/dbang ldan bar tsho/'bras khud/bon grong dar gzhis/ spel gong /mkha ra kha nang 'khor/ dben rtsa grwa tshang / rgya tshe/ sne stod/ dga' bzhi dpon g.yog /mda' dpon lcang can/ 'phrang rings/ grong sgo che pa/ bka' blon pha lha sogs su sbyin sreg /tshe dbang gtsor gyur gyis so so'i 'dod chos dang / khrom dbang sogs byas/ 'khor grwa tshang bar byang bsdom dang smon lam rnam gsum gyi chos 'brel/ mang 'gyed/ gur rin sdings pa'i grwa pa thor bu la chos 'brel sogs byas/ ru gnon gyi gtsug lag rtsis gnas gsar du mchod sbyin dang mang 'gyed/ rgya ma'i don bzhin bstan srid rim gror phur pa'i sbyin sreg byas/shi gson gyi dad 'bul stong dngul thal ba 'byor kyang dkor gyi nyes dmigs la 'jigs pa chen po skyes nas bka' 'gyur bslu ba dang / lug brgya skor la srog sbyin/ dbul po la sbyin gtong / bsam yas kyi mchod pa gso ba sogs kyi dam bca' yid la bkod/ grwa mangs byings gzhung sgo 'gag dang mkhan po dpon g.yog grwa ma rab brtan gling du chibs bskyel la phebs/ lo gsum gyi dam bca' yang mdzad song ba khong sku tshe brtan na theg mchog gling gi la rgyar phan nges su 'dug /mar lam lcags zam du gdung rten la gzungs 'bul rab gnas byas/ rang gnas su sleb 'phral lho brag thugs sras par dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom dang / dpal chen 'dus pa'i dbang bskur/ bskyed rim gyi 380

bshad pa byas/rang da gon du bka' 'gyur nyin bcu phrag lhag bcas btsugs/mang 'gyed gzabs rgyas btang /khams nas ze chen sku skye rin po che pheb 5/snying thig ya bzhi dang klong snying gi dbang khrid sogs btab/ dngul rta mig ma sogs 'bul nod rgyas par mdzad/ 'brum nad dar drags pas shel brag tu gzhung sa'i sman sgrub la phyin/rang sman khal bdun skor kyang ma nyam du bsgrubs/rims nad la dmigs pa 'i sems bskyed dang / 'od zer spro bsdu la gnad du bsdun pas mngon rtags legs shing / nad kyang myur du chad/ shel brag pa rnams la ṭa 'gyed dang / mang thug /rtogs 'khor gyis tshim par byas/ 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod snga nur byas/ zla ba bzhi pa la bsam yas su khrid mchod dang / rgya dngul sung phyed nyis brgya la brdungs pa'i ting chen bdun tshar gnyis phul/ khral mi rnams la dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa'i 'gyed dang /dbul phongs lnga brgya skor la ja thug rtsam 'gyed sogs btang / sa skya nas tshogs 'bum ther gtang rgyu gnang ba brag dmar ke'u tshang sogs su rim pas btang / chos rje brag phug pa'i phyi rten lha khang la rab gnas byas shing bdag gir bzung nas 'bad pa don ldan du bya phyir rab grwa dge don pa lo gsum la bzhag/bsam yas su srid skyong rta tshag pas rtsad gcod dang gzigs bskyangs/chab shog gser dngul gyi rten bcas gnang kyang / bdag nyid la re dogs gang yang med pas ngos mjal mi dgos par zhus/ skyes bu chen po'i rang rtags can du 'dug pas dka' mchid la yang la na tshigs su bcad pa phul/sa skya nas rigs kyi bu rgyal sras nyin byed 'od zer la zhal gso'i legs skyes dang /rdo rje'i ming gi cod pan gdags par mdzad pa ni/a yu puṣ+ṭi ku ru oṃ/381

mchog tu gsang ba yum gyi dkyil 'khor du//dus gsum 'du bral med pa rtag tu rol/ /byang chub rdo rje'i 'od zer spro bsdu las/ /mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan bskrun mdzad pa'i/ /bdag gi rigs kyi bdag por phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la tshogs gsog sgrob sbyong mi dgos kyang //gdul bya'i don du snga 'o gtsang phyogs su/ /phebs pa'i dad rdzas dad 'bul dngos po rnams/ /srungs te bsam yas khri mchod 'bul mdzad pa'i/ rnam 'dren bla ma de la bdag cag dad/ /snyigs ma ra bstan 'gro'i ched du sang gi sras/ /glang chen thal dkar lhum sa zhugs kyis mtshon pa'i/ /bsams bzhin sprul mdzad rmi ngal skyes nga/da 'byung ni/ rig 'dzin mju stobs 'od zes 'gro ba'i mgon/ /log smon bdud kyi tshosas rnams 'joms mdzad rgyal/ /bdag kyang rig 'dzin chen po khyod nyid kyi/ /zhal sbyon mjal snying 'dod pa'i gdung ba ni/ /skom pa chu 'dod ltabu yod la gas kyang / da ni dus kyi dben pas sems pa skyo/ /sku bsrung le tshan bdud rtsi khri rdo dang / /yab yu ma sras bcas legs skyes mgu pa dar dang / /thugs sras dam pa sku gsung thugs rten bcas//gang bi bka' slob rig pa 'jon pa yis/ /dad gus spro ba'i ngang nas phul ba dge/ /zhes mthing shog la rin po che thun ma'i rdo rje'i ming gi cod pam zur bzhir dar tshon sna lnga re'i ba dan g.yo ba bcas stsal/ /sde dger snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rim po che'i par brko mdzad pa'i ma phyi 'di nas dgos gsu nga yang / spyir mnga' bdag btsan po'i dus na nang rgyud 'di dag bka' gnyan cing gzhung si gsang ba yin pas yongs grags su ma bsgyur zhing / gsung rab kyi brda skad la ma byang bas lo paṇa ska da 38 2

brda ma 'phrod pa'i rigs la'ang skad gsar bcad kyi dag ther ma phog /phyi 'gyur rnams lta ra sazhung gcis la sang zas mang pos bcos shing bcos pa'ang ma yin pa 'i dang 'gyur so ra bzhas si rgyun 'byams 'dra ma nyam du sna nga bas phyi cho k+ṣiṃ tshang ba'i risas rnam sa bsdur/ nu tshams zhu gse ra dngul ltos che ba dang /sung lnga bcu ma 'i maṇ+ḍal 'phul ma rgyal srid sna bdun tsha bser can/rigs kyi bu la saser dngul/ bos dar/ rgyan phreng spus das dang bcas pa'i legs skyes dang / 'di nyid ma hā sa pa'i yang srid du dogs slong byung bas phyogs 'di'i bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa yod tshe gdan sar 'khod pa zhig zhu gsung yang / bla dpon sde bdag chen po'i 'du 'dzi dang / dkor rdzas kyi lo ngas spyod la snying thag pa na sa 'jigs shing skyo bas rang bzhin lhums zhugs kyi 'gro phan sa phyogs gang byung kyang chog /sto na pa zhal bzhugs dus dgra bcom pa mang ngo sa bsnyen bkur la skyo nas bslab pa phul ba la legs so zhes gsungs cha/ tshogs lam gyi sne tsam ya nga ma zin par lo sa 'cho1ro rdzas kyi gzi byin bsgrub pa khyim/ chung spa ngas pa 'i khyim chen tham/sa cad kyi rnam thar te/mdo sde la sa btsug lag khang la khyim gyi 'du shes skye bar gsungs pa'i 'u nga bstan thobad tu bab pa 'i phyir ro/ maḥthog gdan tshab da be rtse rin po che'i pi warta tshig don zhin tu bzang ba 'byor/rnam dpyod che bas bstan pa la phan snyam spro/ lar yang khams phyogs pa rnams brnya na pa la phyag bzhes che zhing / lha ma yinagyi blo dang ldan pas bdag cag la 'ang dwangs pa mdzad pa tsam nas snga 'gyur bka' ma nub nga bstan pa bzusas brnyan du 'gro tshul ya nga ya nga glengs pas dgon chen tshor de dag gi sgrub mchod rgyun tshugs/ nyi grags gsu ma pa sa 383

nags shod rang dgon dang / rgyal rong dgon pa sogs su rgya dngul/ ja gos dar/ rta mdzo mang po'i gtong phod nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye nas klong chen snying thig gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod dang / glegs bam par brko sogs bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po mdzad/ brgyud pa khungs la thug pa'i chos yin par ma zad/ bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i sgos sgrub rnams dang / phur pa rgyud lugs sogs snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum nas bshad pa'i lha sngags dngos bstan la rton pa'i chos yin pas rdo rje theg pa'i chos bsrung rnams kyi phrin las kyi sgo dbye ba las/ dngos cag gis chos bdag 'tshol ba dang / rten 'brel bsgrig pa sna gcig kyang ma byas/nags shod du gdan 'dren nan kur che yang rga ba'i chad pas bsgrub ma nus/ theg mchog gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i chog sgrigs 'don bde ba bsgrigs nas sgrub mchod thebs la slar yang dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa sbyar/ mon shar phyogs ro lam du yod pa'i slob ma ku su lu pa dag gis kyang kla klo'i brtul zhugs can dag dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bsnyen gnas/ las 'bras la dwangs pa ston pa/ lhag par sbrang tshang sum cu skor dang / nya dang ri dwags bgrang gis mi ldang ba la brngan sbyin gyis bskal pa'i bar du ri rgya chu rgya 'debs thub pa sogs byung ba bla ma'i thugs rje yin pas/ bka' shog dang byin rten sogs dgos tshul ltar sku rten dang dngul srang bdun bcas bskur/ gdul dka' ba/ sbyong dka' ba/ rnam par shes pa las su mi rung ba'i gang zag la chos 'chad pa las/ sems bskyed kyi 'jug pas sems can grangs med la phan thogs pa 'di don gyi 'gro don yin snyam spro ba 'phel/ gdung bsams nas slob dpon 'jigs med pas 384

bka' 'bum cha tshang spus dag gsar bzhengs dang / chos spyod rang lugs su bsgrigs pa'i par phud bcas 'byor/ dgon rtse rin po che dang / sde dpon 'brong rtse ba sogs la tshe dbang byas/ phyogs phyogs kyi 'du ba dang / dkor rdzas kyi nyes dmigs la rang nyid sun snang dang /'ga' zhig khro ba 'phel kyang mi med lung stong du ma bcags pas lha'i bu'i bdud kyi 'phrang las ma thar de lta na'ang bdud la bdud du shes pa'i phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa'i bdud la gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching ba gcod pa'i dran shes dang ma bral bas 'chi bdag gi bdud des re zhig btang ngam snyam/ sa skyong sde dge'i sku rim du ma mgon legs ldan dang bcas pa'i bskang ba rgyun 'dzugs dang / sgrol ma khri tshar mang po bton du bcug /khams mon bco lnga skor 'a/ khrid btab/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i ring lugs la bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi gsungs pa 'di ngo mtshar shin tu che bas dngos cag gi chos rgyal mes dbon gyi gtsug lag khang la bste stang bgyis shing / dbus gtsang lho mon gyi 'dris can thams cad la'ang de bzhin du bskul bas don mthun gyi spyod pas stong mchong 'bul mi bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / slob dpon 'jigs med dpon slob rgya mtshams na gnas pas kyang snga phyir stong mchod phul ba'i 'di lo'i sdebs mthun du khra 'brug la stong mchod dang / mirgyan lha khang du rgya dngul srang lnga bcu las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'phul ma tsha gser can phul te/ 'jig rten du mu ge zhi ba'i smon lam btab/ srong btsan bam sor gdung khebs dang gnam rgyan phul/ lar dkor rdzas kyi rigs zhing sa dag par 'bul sbyor gyi rgyu rkyen ma tshogs pas lag tu re zhig yod ring la'ang / yid kyi bdag gir ma bzung bar sbyin pa'i 385

pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i smon la ma btab/ bdas cas gi bsta na pa dang sem sa can gyi don bsgru ba pa la sdus bsnga la ba dag srid na snying rje chen po'i yu la te/ dngos ni dben par chos nyid zab mo'i don la brten soms mang du byas pa 'i byang chub sems dpa 'a yin pa sa su la 'ang phras dos dang gnod sems ma mchis pa lags 'brus bkra shis sgang bi ka chi can brgyad la rig 'dzin gyi dbang dang / la sa 'bras kyi khrid bshad nas gzhan gnod spong bar sadams/ gzhong dpo ra bla ma sangs rgyas bzang pos dben dbon gsar 'debs la snga lo rab gnas kyi 'dun pa gtad pas mngon rtags legs tshul dang / 'di lo rten bzhengs la dus chos sgrigs pa'i me tog gtor dbos tshul ltar rab sanas kyi don ngo ba'i tshang bas ye shes 'bebs pa'i 'dun pa gtad/srong btsan du gos yu ga bdun gyi mchod rdzas phul/ rgya gar rtswa mchog grong la sto nga mchod dang / nye'u 'don rgya chen po lug nyi shu skor tshe thar byas/ chab sator 'bum ther btang / 'bri gung nas gser dang dri bzang phonalen sanang nas sman sgrub kyi las len la zin bris dbos gsung / gla gli'i thod pa brdar 98khrul pa dang dbab bskyil gyi sngags don ma phyed pa'i rang nyams la bdud rtsi bam brgyad dang /bde 'dus lto sbyar ba'i yig 4 zhig byung na legs kyang mig skyon gyis ma thub pas zin bris tsam phul/ 'bras spung sa bange yangs bla mas skyabs 'jug zhu rten dang bcas rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo sprod cig bsos gsung ba la dag pa gnyis ldan gyi mdzod khang bris/ rdzogs pa chen po'i do ha zhig kyang brtsams/ ring 'tsho'i rten du lha rdzas dang phyag phreng / dpe kyu na dkon pa bcas bskur gnang mdzad nas mi d+ma 'od du mjal ba'i smon lam zhu 386

gsung pa la mngon rtags legs pas lhag bsam gyi khyad par 'di ga'an dang mi 'dra bar snang /lha ldan du rdo tshad gsum gyis bsgrubs pa'i stong mchod dang /bsam yas su yang stong mchod phul/ mnga' ris grwa tshang par ja spag gsum dang dngul sung nyer gnyis kyi mang bkol btang /hor brag 'go dang tre po pa dge rnying 'dres pa kha shas la byang chub sems dpa'i so thar dang / 'khrid spungs las 'bras la nan tan che ba bshad/ lar mon pa dang khams pa solas la sngon 'gro'i chos la nan tan byas pas shes rgyud la cung zad phan nas /sdis spong dge bsgrub kyi dam bca' phul ba mang du byung / bod pa rnam sa ni chos la rgyus yod che bas ston pa dngos su byon kyang thul ba'i rigs su mi 'dug pa 'di lnga phrag tha ma'i chom pos slebs pas skyo ba'i gnas su snang nasas shod nas nyi grags gsum pa'i klong snying par phud dang rta gser sga dkrol ma rin thang can dang / gser/phreng ba rin thang can dngul rta mig ma gnyis/chung ja 'khor drug bzhi/ mar do bzhi sogs snga phyir 'bul nod thin tu che ba dang bcas pa gdan radren nanadur che yang sprul sku rang yar 'byon par byas/'bri gung nas pho nya bstud mar gnang nas khams nang chen yasal stong dgon gyi bla ma cha sa/sa med/ yi dam chos skyong 'ga' zhemi/ gi dbang lung rgyun spel ba ched mngags ma dzad pa bzhin don tshang byas/ rje rat+na la zab gter gyi bka' babs pa nas 'bri gung phyogs snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs can du song zhing /rnying ma b.la' gter gyi chos rtsa ba che ba mtha' dag mnga' ris paṇa chen rin ngo/ che sogs las brgyud de dar yang da lta nyag phra bar snang bas snga rgyus snyan bskul byas pa bzhin sprul sku rin po che 'di das/ snang dang phyag bzhes che bas gser 387

dngul dang gos cig sogs spam che ba gnang nas/ dbang chos kyi tho zur gsal mdzad pa yongs rdzogs ma thub kyang / snying tig ya bzhi/ phur pa rgyu da lugs/ klong snying / mdzod bdun gyi bka' gtad sogs byas/ dri ba sna tshogs byed par/lar rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum tshogs pa las dbang thob pa yin kyang /dus da lta phal gyis dpe rgyud kyi cho ga gsal po yang cha mi phyed na/ dbang brda 'phrod pa dang ye shes mthong ba lta ci smros/ de bas na byis pa nyer spyod kyi sems ngo dang / 'jig rten gyi 'byor stobs la dregs na/ rang 'byor gyi yan lag kyang nyams par byed pas shākya thub pa'i snyems chung la gzigs nas chos la zhun thar chod cig smras/ khams pa rdza yul ba gsum la khrid bsdus pa zhig bshad/ nges 'byung dang las 'bras shes pa'i don gtso bor bton/ sde pa bka' blon rgyar mkhar lha khang nas ched kyi byon nas zhag gnyis bzhugs ring tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang /dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig gi dri ba dang gsung gleng smar/byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la dwangs pa che bas sems can la phan pa 'ba' zhig gi ngang nas rgyal srid kyi bya ba rmi lam lta bur gzigs te dran pa'i rgyun bskyangs na gzugs can snying po'i rnam thar la reg par 'gyur ro zhes gdams/ dbyings sa chen por bzhugs kyang bla ma la bla mar 'dzin pa'i bste stang 'ba' zhig las snyems dregs dang che 'gying sogs med pas ka blo bde/'di la dpags na mal ka ba can pa'i gsung sgros bzhin thos bsam bsrung /sgom pa gtong / bste gnas dang zang zing 'ba' zhig gis snyems pa'i rings can rnams la chos kyi phan pa 'grub dka'o/ /lar dbang dang stobs 'byor yod pa tsam gyis sdig rgyun kyang rang shugs la 'du ba chos nyid yin gshis sde 388

bdas chen po'i dkor rdzas la gtong len gyis brel ba 'di yang blo mi bde zhing bsam gtan gyi tsher mar snang ngo / /la ra ngas mi chos dang yong ba'i thabs ni ma byas/ byung ba la dasa' tshor yang med/ mnyam par ba nas pa'i don ni smra bsam brjod med yin/ rjes thob thams cad du rdzas rnams yan lag bdun pas dkon mchog la bsngo zhing / rgyal ba'i zhing khams rdul phra rab bsko ra ba phyed pa'i 'dun pas 'chag pa dang chabs cig smon lam rnam gsum tshar res nyung mtha' dang bcas shi gson 'brel thogs la dmigs pa ni nyin ltar ro/ /bka' 'gyur gsar bslus dbu shog dang gnyis rnams gser zhun sha stag gis brjes/zhal khebs gsum brtsegs/ gdong dar gsum brtsegs/phar phyin can bzang gos rin thang can dang / glegs shing / glegs thag ras lhas sngon po chab bcas/ ka ci la sman par btab pa'i sgril tshas/ kun dga' ra ba/ dbu thog rgyan bzhi'i bla re bcas spyir dngul srang drug brgya lhag bcas song / hor dre po tshong dpon dang / sgam tsha dpon mo/ hor brag 'go nas gling tshang ri 'go ba bcas la chos 'brel byas/ khe smad dang / spo ra'i yum/ gzhis ka g.yung drung / dpal ri bla brang / sgom chen dharmā sogs kyi brtan bzhugs mdzad/ tshe gzungs 'bum ther/ mnga' grar bka' 'gyur/ srog bslu sbyin gtong sogs kyang bgyis/ sa tshwa 'bum ther gdab dus gtso mo 'brog mo'i rnam pa can mang pos maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bur gtsug g.yu dang / lhung bzed spub chol gyi 'bul ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs byas par rmis pas 'di res kyi tshe phreng bsal bas rjes thob la kun rdzob bden pa 'di mi bslu nges par snang /kho long stod du phrin las rgyal mtshan gyi snga lo lha khang bzhengs par 'di lo 389

byams sku thos tshad ma/ ston pa dang / slob dpon chen po'i sku/ dngos kyi 'dra 'bas sogs bzhengs par rab gnas la gdan 'dren nan chags che bar 'gro ma thub kyang ye shes sems dpa' la nye 'gyang med pas rab sanas kyi 'dun pa nan tan byas/ bla bre che ba dang / ka 'phan/ dung dkar/ rol mo sogs bskur/ ltar snang la khral mi rang ga ba zhig tu snang sto/ da dung bka' 'gyur e 'grub re ba sogs sems can gyi bsam pa'i khyad par 'di bsam gyis mi khyab cing nged kyi dngos po rgya che tsam bskur ba la yul mi rnams kyang dwangs pa che bas yul ljongs gsum gyi sbrang tshang gang yod mi rabs gcig gi bar tshe thar la btang / de mtshungs chos mthun gyi slob mkha rag sgom chung pas mo na shar phyogs ro lam me long mkhar du sgom sgrub dang ma bral bar bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la brten nas ri rgya chu rgya btab pas srog chags dung phyur mang po la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa byas par dngul dang byu ru spos/ shel mang po'i mthun rkyen byas/ mtha' 'khob kla klo'i lung pa dkon ma chog dang las 'bras la dad du bcus cing / chos nyan pa dang / ma ṇi dung phyur/ sdig spong dge bsgrub kyi dam bca' 'bul ba'ang mang du byu ru bas/ dbus chos dred kyi lung par grong chog dang mi chos kyi rnam/ sayeng sad chos pa byung / dpal sprul dngo na slo ba/ pa rnams yem chi/ mo na shar nub/ gdung bsam chos rje sogs 'dus pa re mang la khrid legs par btab/ 'dus pa mdo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i sgrub mchod zhag bcu skor btsugs / rdo rje brag pas mtshams zhu rten bcas che ba dang / zhal gdams rnam thar/ gtam cho gas g.yar po dbos gsung ba thugs rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i rten 'brel 390

bsgrigs/ theg mchog gling du sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i cho ga legs par tshulas pa'i gnas tshul dang / rigs kyi bu'i legs skyes bcas la dad ldan chos 'phel lags can 'byor bar/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs khrid dang / phyag rgya sogs la dag ther byas/ lo ltar gshor 'degs khal sum cu skor 'bul rgyun khal ma'i stong spyod blos mi bzod pas yang yang ldog kyang / bla grwa tshang ma dad mos che ba'i ngo ma ldog pas 'di lo nas bzung 'bru rnams kyi lug srog bslu btang ba'i lug rnams sngon yod tshe thar sum cu skor la bsnan te rgyab bal sgrub mchod kyi cha rkyen la sbyar/ sngo na chad kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung ma dar bas gtor rgyas dang 'chams dbyangs tsam gyi snga 'gyur gyi grub mtha'i sating mi phyin par rngo la bas/ mkhan po shrī nā tha 'di gdul du rung ba skyes bu'i mtshan nyid du snang bas do na gnyer chen po mdzad pa la/ bdag cag gi'ang bstan pa raba' zhig la bsams nas mdzod bdu na/ shing rta skor gsum/ gsang snying rtsa 'grel/ yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel bcas sde das nas bslu yon srang su / cu smor gyi bsgrubs te grwa tshang spyi sor sbyar/ mang ja sbyor sbrel lnga dang / rjes su yi rang ba'i gtam sogs bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhes gzhan don byas pa yin/mos ldan 'brong rtse yum sras nas rigs kyi bu la legs skyes spam mtho ba dang /sgyu 'phrul gyi sgrub rma chod 'dzugs rten zhabs tog nyin 'khyongs mdzad 'dug pa'i dge ba rdzob/sa byang du bsngos/ sto na pa rma chos des/ rab byung gis gser dngul la reg pa'ang bkag na/gser da ngul 14 snying nor du byed pa ni khyim pa brkam chags can dag dang bsam sbyor gcig par 'dug pas/bdag cag la dad 'bul byung ba rnams la mnyam bzhag gi don ba ser dang bong pa mnyam 391

zhing / rjes thob la gzhan dag gis sdig pa'i khur bdag la'ang bkal to snyam nas ya nga ba'i phyir/ rgya dngul thur srang lnga brgya skor gyi bzo rgyu las rgyal ba ma pham mgon po'i sku srid skyong rta tshag rin po ches bzhengs grogs mdzad par bkus gser/ khri zangs/ phra rgyan/ byi ru'i shal pa/ bzo bo bco lnga skor lag g.yog dang bcas pa'i gla lto/ sol rin/ dpon blon so sor legs 'dul sogs spyir dril dngul srang cig stong sum brgya skor song ba/ gla mi la brten bsam yas su spyan drangs te ngos kyi rab gnas la spyod/ bsam yas mchims phur me mchod 'bum ther/tshogs stong rtsa/brag dmar ke'u tshang du brgya mchod/tshogs bskang / bzang gos 'ja' sgrigs la tong skud tshon spel gyi sham dza ra btab pa'i gdong khebs phul/ gling stod smad la mang 'gyed btang / dgon pa sa sbug tu a nan+ta tshul khrims pas gdan drangs te/ thang sku gra tshar dang / na bza' bzhugs stan 'bru khal brgya'i 'bul ba stong mchod kyi rgyur bsngos/lar gang zag cang shes pa rnams ni re zhig phral byung gi mi khom pas gzir yang chos kyi gdul zhing stong sla ba nyid do/ /de nas rta mgrin gling du zhag bcu phrag gi bar du byams mgon gyi dngul sku la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgo nas chog rogs pa bco lnga skor bcas nyin ltar dngos sta sgrol ba'i rab gnas dang /lha bab dus chen gyi nyin rab byung grwa tshang ba'i bsu ba ser phreng dang bcas shing rta 'khor lo'i steng nas bar skor du byams pa chos 'khor la spyan drangs te bar khang du bzhugs su gsol/bcad ldan dkar po'i rgyal mtshan 'ja' sham gsum brtsegs che legs cha dang / gtsug lag lte ba'i seng g.yengs kyi lcam gling phyi mar byibs khebs rgyan bzhi ngur smrig la 'ja' spel can spyir gos 392

yug bcu gsum yod pa'i gnam rgyan phul/ phyi nang gnyis char la stong mchod re dang bcas rab gnas rgyas pa dang / sreg blugs sogs mtha' rgyas/ gling thams cad la brtan bzhugs me tog 'thor/ grwa tshang par rab ston mang 'gyed dang / khrul mi yongs rdzogs la ja thug /rtsam phyin/ ṭa kha re'i 'gyed btang / rab grwa kha shas la nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byas/ bka' blon pha lha yab sras zla mchod kyi mar bzhu dang bcas ched kyis byon par gnas rten thams cad la mchod 'bul dang smon lam lhan cig byas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las brtsams te smon 'jug gi bslab bya sems can la phan pa 'ba' zhig mdzad dgos par gdams/ gser dngul ja gos dar 'bru'i brgya 'bul sogs kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du rig pa'i ngang nas mchod sbyin 'ba' zhig gi rgyur bsngos/ zung phu lha sdings su rab gnas la gdan drangs bzhin dngos sta nyin gsum ma dang / bskang bshags sogs bgyis/ bla ma rin po che'i sku 'bum la snyan shal dang / grwa btsun rnams la mang ja/ṭa 'gyed btang /rdo brag sprul sku rin po che'i gdan 'dren 'byor/brag chen phur pa'i ya logs su mgron gnyer can gyi thabs bsu dang /rgya sgo'i phyi logs su grwa tshang yongs rdzogs kyi rol cha dang ba dan sgrong ba'i ser phreng /sprul pa'i sku rin po che gzim chung phyi logs su phebs/ bste stang bla na med pa mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug pa nyid kyang bla ma bsten tshul ji bzhin mkhyen/ grwa tshang la mang ja sbyor thel dang / skal 'gro sum brgya skor la ṭa kha re btang /'dra 'bag gsar bskrun dang gtsug lag khang spyir rab gnas rgyas pa mtha' rten can byas/ sku 'khrugs cung zad 'dug pa la tshe dbang dang / me mchod/393

tshosas brgya sogs bsgrubs pas 'phral du dwangs dzong chen snyingaji si khrid dang 'brel par byang sdom legs par phos /phyag lem ngabye — de bye byad kyis sman sgrub zhis 'dzu /sa dbos bsu nga bar bsgrub pa ri ngon ngo bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas rgyun me da na/ 'bag 'cham sa dang rnga rol gyi dngos grub mi thob pas dkyil 'khor bdun dang sbyor ba brgyad kyi dmigs khrid nan tan dang / nyin mtshan gsung mi chag gi bzlas rogs pa grwa pa drug re mos byas/grol dbang la dol pa dang nye skor ba bdun brgya skor 'dus/ dkyil 'khor de kha'i steng nas sku brkyang la bka' brgyad rnal 'byor rgyun dbang / mkha' 'gro snying thig dang / klong snying gi dbang / snying thig ya bzhi ka dang / snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi bka' gtad sogs kyang byas/de kha'i ring dbang dang /bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ bshad pa sogs chos kyi gtam 'ba' zhig la sbya ra rngo da de/ dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyang sdig to dang / byis grogs blun po'i gozhan dbang las lda nga mi nus pa mang bas mu ma thud pa ji lta zhig 'ong / bris thang mang po la sor rjes dang rgyab yig btab/byang bdag bi dus ya ba sus su 'brel ba'i rten 'brel las yin nam/ rang stobs las byung ba'i thugs mos che bar 'dug pas snya na bsku la zol sbyor med pa dang / grwa tshang ge tshob/sa dpon yin pas ris 'dzin pad phrin gyi rnam thar bskyang dgos zhus/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' cha tshang / gser dngul rdo tshad ja gos dar la sogs pa 'i 'bul ba spam che ba dang bca mi brtan bzhugs legs par mdzad/ gsol cha ra 'bol ba'i phyir ru ba sbra gur dang bcas pa 'is 'bul sasung yang / nged bya bral ju sdod nga rkun pas de risas mi zhu byas/ byang lus gonyis srog bslu 39

btang / gtsug lag khang steng shod/ rgyab ri dang bcas par me tog gtor/bskul ma gnang ba bzhin/ 'du 'dzi la skyo ba'i gtam dang / kun bzang smon lam gyi 'grel pa nyung ngu zhig byas/ sgrags mda' bar mgron gnyer can gyi phebs bskyel bcas mdzad/ rang gnas su 'byor phral theg mchog gling pa'i gnyer rnying can la 'khrid btab cing / 'jon dmar gyi sgrol ma dang / dngul srang lnga bcu sosas kyis brtan bzhugs rgyas par phul/ sde dge'i mi sna dang bcas pa'i 'tshams zhu/ rigs kyi bu dang bcas so sor rgya gdusas/ tong skud tshon spel la dwangs shel gyi dra phyed can dang /mdzod gsar rnying gi gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugs rten/ rgyud 'bum gyi par phud pod gnyis dang / dril bu gser 'go ma dang dngul 'go ma/ thod ṭaṃ gser shan ma/ ting shags dngul gyi nyag thab can/ gser rdo tshad gnyis/ wa rtsag /bzang ja 'khor drug gsum bcas 'byor/rgya rong dbon po sku 3 rin po ches gtsos rdzogs chen gyi dgon pa ma la ga phal cher kyi bla ma bla mchan/ grwa tshogs sum brgya skor rim pas 'byor ba la dbang khrid za ram tshags su byas/ shar khrid chig rdzogs kyi shes rgyud grol ba ra dka' yod de lug bzhi brgya skor gyi srog bslu ba dang / tshe mtshams/ ma ṇi dung phyur sob/sa kyi dam bca' 'bul mi byung ba'i dge ba bsngos/ bsta na rtsa/'i gzhi ma 'dul ba yin par ma zad sngags lam la zhugs kyang gang zag tshogs kye lam pa ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims la gtso bor 'don dgos shing da ni bstan pa rtags tsam la nye bas blang 'das sor mi chud par snang yang / rtsa bzhi chang dang bcas pa spong sems brtan pa re tsam byung yang phan thogs pa srid snyam/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas bshad pa'i 395

theg pa chen po'i gso stong phog /mdzod 9pas 'chal pa'i tshul khrims mi dge'i gzugs/ zhes bshad pas gzhan gnod gzhi bcas pa yang ma spangs na theg pa gong 'og gnyis ka dang 'gal ba yin no zhes bshad cing /sngags kyi brtul zhugs bas yangs su spyad chog pa'i lung su la yang bstan pa med do/ / rgya rong tshang la snying tig ya bzhi/ rnal 'byor rgyun dbang / klong snying dgos sgrub dang bcas pa/ bka' ma'i yang dag /dong sprugs/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ phur pa sogs mang dag bgyis/ gser srang lnga/ dngul srang brgya dang / bzang ja 'khor drug lnga sogs pa'i 'bul nod dang bcas/ ring 'tsho mdzad pas dkor rdzas kyi 'dam rdzab tu chud/ de kun kyang lha'i bu'i bdud du rig nas/ ya nga ba'i gnas su mthong ba las dga' brod dang rlom sems med kyang /de ma thab dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i rgyu rkyen ma tshogs pas/ bsam gtan gyi tsher ma byung dogs pas dkon mchog 'ba' zhig gi phyogs su maṇ+ḍal du phul/ rigs kyi bu 'di yang rdzogs chen pa'i yang srid yin tshul nan tan che yang / de 'dra'i brtag ba ni ma gsal/ sprul sku myur 'byon dang lung bstan sogs sngar byas pa de ltar yin nges/ sku skye phal cher ka kha mi shes pa nas khri mthon por bzhag /thos bsam sgom sgrub la g.yeng bas sku tshe yang mthar mi phyin pa mang bas de rigs kyi 'dod pa gtan nas med kyang / 'di la ni snga lo nas 'bri gung pas ngos 'dzin brtag dpyad byung dus gong ma'i phyag phreng dang dbu zhwa 'dra cog dang gnyis bstan dus/ ngo ma la reg /dbu zhwa gyon nas spyan mchi mas gang ste snang / zhal bye ma thag nas nga 'bri gung bla ma yin/ grwa pa mang po yod/ 'bri gung la 'gro zhes nyin ltar rgyun mi 'chad du gsung ba phyi nang rgyus 396

can thams cad la gsal ba ltar yin pas srid pa las kyis bskos pa la bsgyur bkod ma thongs/ rgya gar nas glang po che'i 'bul ba mis pa bzhin/yangs pa can gyi li tsa byi dri med grags pa dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyi sprul pa rtsod pa med pa 'bri gung 'jig rten dgon po'i skye ba rim brgyud/rje rin chen phun tshogs kun mkhyen shan+ta pu ri pa'i rigs bdag tu thob pas bdag cag dang chos rgyud gcig pa'i rten 'brel dang /lha sras mu khri btsan po/sprul sku zla ba/ chos kyi grags pa/ da res dang bcas skye ba bzhi'i bar yab sras su 'brel ba nyid do/ mdo khams rgya sde zhe'u dpon yang gser rdo tshad dang bcas mjal khar byung / klong chen snying tig rig 'dzin gyi dbang sogs dgos gsung ba bzhin byas khong gi sde dge nas bden rnam shing rta'i pod gnyis kyang bsgrubs 'dug/mtsho sngon po nas sog po'i rgyal po ching wang yang rdo bla dang mchod yon gyi rten 'brel las gser dang gos yug gi rten bcas 'tshams zhu dang / khyod dang thugs yid 'dres par gsol ba 'debs pa la rjes su gzung zhes snang ba bla mchan 'jigs med las brgyud de phebs pas skyes lan dam mdud dang /bla sku sogs bsrings/ sgom chung can bsnyen par rdzogs pa la 'dul ba'i bslab bya bstan de mtha' 'khob tu bstan pa'i mig ltos la gces spras bgyid par gdams/dngul srang nyi shu skor ri ba'i bsngo rten gyi rgyan cha bskur te sbrang tshang dang nya srog bslu bar gdams/ sde dger jo bor 'bul rgyu'i gser srang drug cu re lnga dang zho gang las grub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo brdung rgyu dang / ki lung dgon gsar du mchod rdzas bzo rgyu'i gos yug drug bskur/ /rang gnas kyi bka' 'gyur dbu shog dang gnyis kyang gser yig gi brjes/ zhal khebs 397

ri 3 myo brtses gu rī dwags stodagling pa sku skyer khrid dbang d+ku par byas/rigs kyi burgyar sra sa nyinabyed 'od zer kyang dbur stod 'bri gung du spyan 'dren gyi rta bal nyis brgya skor dngabacas sga ra gyi mkha na slo ba drung 'khor rnam sa 'byor pa bu lhan rgyas la ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel gyi 'bul rten sku gsung thugs rten/ maṇ+ḍal/ gser rdo tshad/ rta gleg ma gnyis dang / ṭaṃ srang brgya tham pa/ gos yug sna lnga bcas spam mtho bar snang / dal 'gros kyi thog bsam yas su bcags mal/ sto nga mchod/ gnas mjal rags rim mdzad/rim gyis skam pa la brgyud rgya ma khri khang du gdan 'dren zhab/ bzhugs la da zhar spro/ gsol ston rgyas pa dang 'bul nod bzang / 'dza gung rang gi dgon pa che phras mtshon lha sde khag dang / mal gro rdzong dpon bde mkhar bas mtsho'i mi sde khag gi dkar spro dang chibs bsu zhwa rigs mi mthun pa lnga brgya tsam dang bcas klungs shod pho brang brtse bar phebs / dngul srang brgya la skor ba'i mjal rten phul/ mjal dar rtse sprod gnang / nyen zhag ma nga po'i par khri'abul gyi yo langs dang / bro shon bya rma khan sogs rtse sna mang pos rmongs chen rna /sa mgo 'khor yang / shub/sa mithub kyi srog gcod sob/ṭa sde stobs chen po'i rnam thar la skyo ba shin tu 'phel/ mtshur phu gdan tshab pas ngos tshor bod kyi chos lugs tha dad pa'i lta sgom spyod pa gang yin gyi dri ba byas byung bar/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya'i /bams dang / dbang po dang / blo mthu dang 'tshams par ston pa'i phyir du/ grub mtha' smra ba bzhi dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i nges 'byed gsungs pa la mtha' drug dang tshu pa bzhi'i rnam par ris/ byed kyi bshad pa'i dgongs 'grel ni rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pas 398

ma dzad zin la /bod du bstan bcos smra ba phal mo che ni 'gog bden lhongs su ma gyur bzhin du/ lam bden la so so'i rgyud tshod kyi dpags pa 'i grub ma tha' dang chos lu gas re bcos pa min na rung ste/ngas mi/ rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pas shes rgyud 'di smra bsam brjod med du song / de la ni lta sgom mtho dman gyi blo dang / grub mtha'i dasag bzhag gi chos zad pa yin pas su/ la 'ang chags snang dang rtsod pa mi byed pa yin no//zhes pa'i don tshilas su bcad de bshad/rmi (tham du rang nyid 'dug pa'i gzim chung du /rang pa 'chag pa'i snang ba la rnam thos kyi bu yin zer ba'i skyes bu lus stobs byings las che ba gser gyi kha dog can zhig stan la 'dug pa'i mdun na mar me'i kong bu sbar chos ma brgya tshar sgrigs 'dug pa rigs kyi bu la rten 'brel bzang ngam snyam zhing / khong gzi byin che bas rnam thos kyi bu rang yin na phyag gcig byed dbos sam snya ma pa'i skad cis ma gnyis pa la/slob dpon pad+ma byon na ma gtogs phyag rang mi dgos snyam/ che tshang pas phur pa rgyud lugs kyi dbang zhis gsan song de nas rdzong gsar brgyud thel gyi khri 'don la byon/ thel pa rnams la mang ja gsum dang / srang drug cu lhag bcas kyi 'gyed/ btsun chung dbul po rnams la sbyin gtong gang drag byas/ thel la rab gnas nyin gnyis ma dang / sbyin sreg byas/ ri pa rnams la sgom kyi zhal gdam sa bris/ 0ter sgro ma/ gyi thil 'brong ngur du bzhugs ring tshogs stong tshar/me mchod de mtshungs bcas bya ga/rin chen phunatshogs kyi rdo'i gzim sgrom du cung zad bsdad/ gnas der sa g.yo ba dang chabs cig mi gnyis kyi maso bcad de gcig rbab la skyur ba'i snang ba byung / cig thos ma skyur ba ni mthong spangs spo nga bzhin pa dang sgom 399

spangs ma dag pa'i ltas su go/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtso mos dbang gsum pa'i lhan skyes kyang stsal bas/dbang don dang sbyar ba'i rdo rje'i glu gar kyang blangs/ri pa drug cu skor la mang ja dang 'gyed kyang byas/ gter sgrom gyi gzim phug tu slob dpon chen po'i sku bzheng rgyu'i dbu'i bzo bkod dang / srog shing sogs sta gon byas/ nam zla dros nas bzheng rgyur dngul srang gsum ja sbag /'bru khal drug /bzo bo la sham thabs dang gzan rnams bzhag /chu tshan de byin rlabs shin tu cher snang / sa 'bri'i chags snang la brten nas thel gyi dgon pa stongs shul mthong bas bstan bcos mkhan po rnams kyi 'dod zhen gyi dgag sgrub 'di bstan pa'i rma 'byin chen por 'dug snyam skyo ba 'phel/yang ri skar du mang ja sbyor sgril gsum dang / dngul srang drug cu re lnga'i 'gyed btang / khri 'bul gyi zi sbir dang dkor rdzas la longs spyad/ rin po che rnam gnyis dang thel spyi mkhan slob drung 'khor bcas la 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo bshad/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos 'khor chen po yin pas rdo rje brag dang / lho brag thugs sras pa gnyis kyang 'byon thub na bsams brda sbyar te/ chos nyams dang don gnyer med pa'i gnyis 'thung gi khrod nas ldang ma nus/ sa khol bur g.yo ba'ang lan gsum byung ste/ dbur stod phyogs su dkyil 'khor chen po 'di zhal phye ba'i rten 'brel du mngon/dkyil thang dang tsakhri yongs rdzogs gsar bzhengs dang / dbang gi snyel byang sogs la'ang do gal che zhing gser dngul ja gos dar sogs 'bul nod kyang rlabs che/ sde dger rin chen dbang ril sbyar ba'i sman phud dang 'tshams zhu rten bcas dang / mtsho sngon por rgyal khag che ba zhig gis rigs rgyud chad pa 400

rang slob rdo bla 'jigs med phrin las nas mngon gyur gyi phan thogs byung ba la brten/ rmongs pa'i kun slong gi phyogs bslad pa'i chos la phyogs ris kyi log rtog zhi ba'i steng / rgyal po ching wang dang / dge bshes gzu bor gnas pa dag gis yon tan mdzod rtsa 'grel mthong nas snga 'gyur la log rtog gi sdig rgyun chad cing / khong gi phrin las kyang dgag mi nus par song bas gser dngul spam mtho ba dang / mu tig /dug sbrul gyi mgo'i nor bu/ gos chen gyi 'bul ba ltos che ba 'byor/ dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang 'di mnga' bdag gzhon nu'i dus kyi sku brdzi nyang ting 'dzin bzang pos rdo rje legs pa bran du bkol nas bzhengs par grags kyang / don la rdo rings kyi yi ge la/ ban+de ting 'dzin snying nye/ zho sha che zhes sogs nyang ban la mdun 'jog gi bdag rkyen chen pos bzhengs pas ru gnon gyi gtsug lag spyi dang khyad par med cing dus mnyaskya/ la/srung ma mngon gsum par zhugs pas byin rlabs che bar grags pa bsti stang gi nyam chung bar gyur pa la/ snga rabs su rgyal ba klong chen pas zhig gso mdzad cing / da res rang nyid nas gtsang khang lte ba'i rnam snang / nye sras brgyad/khro bo gnyis dang /g.yas g.yon gyi lha khang thams cad la zhal gser/spyan 'gyed/ bzang gos yug bcu skor gyi stod le/ smad g.yogs/ chos gos/sku ber/ gnam rgyan byibs khebs/ 'phen dang / rgyal mtshan/ru mtshon/snyan shal sogs phul/ gtor sgrom gsar bzos kyi nang chu ma rag gi rtag gtor thun rdzas kyis phyug pa che legs bzhengs/ gnas yig brtsams/ grwa pa rnams la mang 'gyed/ srung ma'i gtor dbang / kun mkhyen chen po'i dus mchod thebs dngul sung lnga bcas sbyar/rab gnas dngos sta nyin gnyis ma dang /sbyin sreg/401

tshogs bskang / mchod 'bul smon lam rgya che na po yang yang byas/ ka tshal grwa tshang pas gdan 'dren nan bstud la gtso bor ru gnon gyi lha khang rnying mar rab gnas dngos sta nyin gnyis ma/mchod 'bul bla bre rten khebs bsgrigs/saser zangs kyi maṇ+ḍal 'phul ma che legs/ mchod lko/nga bcas phu' / 'du khang gi rten bka' brgyad dang phur pa'i sbyi na sreg tshar bdun/ grwa tshang la ṭaṃ 'gyed dang / mang ja gsum/ tshob/sa dgur lan gsum phyin/ ka ring la bzang gos/thon thi ma'i 'phan chen cha dang / sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i thebs dngul srang sum cu tham pa sbyar/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dbang bskur byas/ gung mkhar rdzong dpon gyi dbus mal gro smad kyi skye bo phal cher 'dus pa la 'du khang du khrom dbang byas/ sa 'dir rje btsun mi la nged rang gi mdun na bzhugs nas mgur mdzad pa'i sgra la lo bdun cu don gsum sdod pa yin gsung ba zhig mis/ sprang po shin tu mang zhing tshim rgyu med pa ltar snang ya ri skyes rabs kye byams pa'i gtam la blo bzhag ste khong ma 'khuspyogs par byas/ rgya la nas rgod tshang sprul sku ched kyis byon nas sku gsung thugs rten dngul rdo tshad/ bzang ja 'khor drug lnga/ mar ltang bdun/ kong snam mang ba bcas brtan bzhugs mdzad/ rgyud sde bka' ma'i zhi khro khrom dkrugs kyi dbang dang / bskyed rdzos mi kyi skor mang du bshad/jo nga sas ramadun gyi chu klung la zam pa zhig tshugs sam mi tshugs kyi 'char lding la skyes bu'i rtsol ba dang /snying stobs kyis bsgru bas na nges par grub pa'i blo stobs bskyed de dngul srang lnga bcu tham pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma dang / sems can mang po'i nyer 'tshor 'gyu ra ba'i smon lam btab/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa che chung gi sde snodathams /02

cad nas sha'i zas bska ga pa yin/ bod 'dir chen po dang btsun por rlom pa dag kyang dkor rdzas kyi rta nor dang gzi byin 'gran/ sde snod shes pa khas blangs nas las 'bras 1 cang mi sems/ stong pa nyid rtogs par khas blangs nas rang gzhan gyi phyogs ris che/ phyosas ris de rnam rtog las skyes pa yin las che/ dmigs pa med pa'e snying rje'i lha spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam sa las thams cad la dka' bar snang / chos la dmesas pa da nga / sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rjes tshangs pa'i gnas pa tsa ma gyi go ba'ang ma chags pas rang la khab zu / pa'ang mi bzod par/ phyusas lu ga gi snying gar gri 'dzugs pa 'di kla klo'i chos lugs gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la skabs ba tsal ba yin tshul rgyas par glengs te srog gcod kyi rgyun spong bar zhus pas rin po che nas kyang de kha'i mthun 'akyu ra gnang bas rjes su yi rang ba chen po skyes/lar rgyal khrims zhig na sem/sa can gyi bde skyid kyang rnal du mi gnas pas bden du chus kyang / chos dpon gyi gos 'dzin pa dag ni sman pas nad 95 gtar bsregs bzhin du snying rje'i gzhan dbang dang 'grogs pa ma byung na mgon po klus/ khyod kyi dge slong bram ze lha dang ni/ / mgron dang yab yum da ga dang btsun mo dang / /'khor gyi slad du sdig pa mi bgyi ste/ /dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don sred skyong da ga la'ang mol/ rin po che rnam gnyis la snying tig ya bzhi/rig 'dzin yongs 9radus/ man ngag bcu mi sum/ klong chen snying thig sgos dbang bcas pa dang / rnying ma rgyud 'bum kun mkhyen mdzod bdun/ shing rta skor gsu ma/ rang nyid kyi bden rnam rtsa 'grel so/gas dbu thog tu bzhag ste/403
