chos thams cad rgyal ba'i dgongs rgyud gcig tu 'dus shing rdzogs pa'i don la nem nur med pa'i chos nyid kyi bden pas smon lam dang bka' gtad byas/dpyid sos la thug pa dang / sa chu ma 'phrod pa'i rkyen las 'du ba shin tu 'khrugs te skye ba snga phyir nying mtshams sbyor du nye yang / slob dpon chen po'i thugs rje kho nas gaḥthog chos nyid pa g.ya' ma lung gi sman dkar po chig thub khyer te 'byor bas 'de res kyi gegs las grol/ stod smad kun tu 'khrug rtsod dar bar snang bas rnal du ma phebs nas gzhung sa'i dmag bzlog byed dgos snga phyir 'byor/ rang cag na nas dbang po ldongs/ ri sul du 'chi chos byed pa la re dogs ni gang yang med de/ sems can la bde skyid ma byung na snying re rje snyam nas/ seng gdong ma dang / ma mgon g.yul mdos kyi sgo nas rim gro gnad smin byas/gzhan gyi rim gro pa 'di yang rang la gnod pa che ste/'bri gung pa dang / srid skyong rta tshag gi sbyin sreg 'bum ther lan gnyis tsam byas pas mal gro gzi can sogs nag phyogs pa rnams ma dga' ba'i ltas shar te oṃ hā rgyu/ nags shod nas nyi ma grags pas 'tshams zhu thengs gsum dang / ring 'tsho'i rten/ sku gsung thugs rten/ rgya dngul lnga bcu ma/ rta mdzo bcas 'byor/ rigs kyi bu 'di lhums zhugs glang chen gyi ltas dang bcas li tsā byi dri ma med par gdod nas grub pa yin mod de/ sku na shin tu phra bas spangs rtogs kyi las sad pa'i rten 'brel dus la ma bab pas yid 'phreng ba tsam byung kyang / 'dus pa bral ba'i chos nyid yin pas re zhig ldog dgos pa shar/ thon khar ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel la sku gsung thugs rten/ gser rdil tshad dang bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ bzang gos kyi sku ber/ dgazhwa pad+ma kha 'bus 404

sogs na bza' cha tshang / dngul srang brgya tham pa/ bzang gos bam gsum/'go tshan ja 'khor gyis gtsos pa'i tshan grangs tshan bdun/ rta mdzo pho mo/'bri g.yag /dngul bum/ shis brjod snod dngul dkar gyi nas ze phul ma che legs pa bcas brtan bzhugs mdzad/ phar yang sku gsung thugs rten/ dril bu theg chen/ snam phrug srab ther legs pa dang bcas brtan bzhugs smon lam byas/ rin po che yang gzim chung 'gag tshun dang sku bcar nang ma dang drung 'khor bcas chibs bskyel ba bco lnga skor bcas thon/ rim gyis rgya ma khri khang du bka' blon lha sdings pas gdan zhu nan tan yod pa bzhin bskyod/gsung nan che yang zhag lnga'i ring sbyin sreg tshogs brgya sogs kyi re ba bskangs te/ cog la brag bi kun mkhyen gzim phug rdzi bo'i char skyobs su yod pa la bdag rkyen dang 'dra sku mi tshad mchod rgyun sogs bskul bas de bzhin mdzad pa la ye shes 'bebs pa'i dgongs pa yang yang gtad/ la tshur nang tshun zhabs tog dang phebs bskyel mdzad/ g.ya' ma lung du zhag sa byas/tshogs brgya dang / brgya mchod/ bzang gos kyi bla bre dang / gdong khebs lce le ma rang 'grig phul/ dkor rdzas 'di mi 'dod bzhin du 'du bas rdil tshad bdun gyis mar nyos te bsam yas su zla mchod dang / stong mchod gnyis/bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs bcas mar khal bdun brgya skor dang /tshogs skong /rab gnas/ khra 'brug tu stong mchod/ tshogs brgyas mtshon/ yar klungs rten gsum yongs rdzogs/ gdan sa thel sogs la mchod 'bul/ grwa tshang phal cher la mang ja/ shel brag tu tshogs 'gyed/ srong btsan du stong mchod/ slob dpon chen mor bcad ldan dmar po'i sku ber spus dag /yum bu bla sgang du bla bre 405

legs pa bcas phul/ ri bdes mtshon pa'i 'phyong rgyas kyi dgon khag drug dang / dar gling pa bcas la mar bkol btang / gtsang theg mchog gling par ja sbag dang dngul srang gsum bskur/ khams mi bde ba la dpal sdings rje btsun dang / sgom chen chos grags nas brtan bzhugs yang dag mdzad/ skye 'chi rang bzhin med par das kyang / lus 'di sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas/ bde sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa dang / tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi phyir/ srong btsan du stong mchod/ gdong khebs gsar bzo/ dpal rir bdun phrag sacig gi ring bshags rgyud gsung sgrogs/ slob dpon rin po cher sku ber/ phyugs lug bdun cu srog bslu/ khra 'brug khyams ra chen mor bzang gos spus gtsang sha stag las grub pa'i gdong khebs 'ja' ldan phur tshon spel 'dom nyi shu skor byibs khebs/ btsan thang du thon thi ser po'i bla bre sham ldan/ gdong khebs phur ma can/ khams klong thang sgrol mar bzang gos kyi bla bre sham ldan dngul gyi mchod kong che ba snyan shal bcas bskur/ chab gtor 'bum ther/ tshe lha'i sku khri tshar gnyis/ mnga' ris grwa tshang du 'aka' 'gyur/yang mi gcig rkyang gis bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs/ mon shar ro lam me long mkhar du slob ma sgom chung can la zang tshang dang ri rgya 'debs phyir dngul srang nyi shu skor gyi dngos po dang / slob dpon 'jigs med kyi grwa tshogs la badz+ra gu ru bsag rgyur dngul srang brgya skor bskur/ sa skyong sde dge'i mi sna slob bu 'jigs med blo gsal 'od zer gdong sprul pa'i sku 'bri gung du phebs pa'i khri 'bul dang / snga lo don gnyer byas pa'i bsam yas su 'bul rgyu'i gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che gser srang brgya las grub pa shin tu bzo bkod ‘ 06

legs pa/ gser zangs kyi rgyal srid sna bdun/ dngul bum legs pa cha/mdzod bdun/ shing rta skor gsum/ rang mdzod rtsa 'grel tshar bdun/ bla ma mchod chog tshar nyer gcig /dar gos/ rgyan phreng spus legs dang / rgyal bu dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i phyag bris yig phud gsung rtsom tshigs bcad 'di ltar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje gcig bsdus shing / /o rgyan rang byung rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /bod khams bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag 'jigs med gling / /'dzam gling rgyan du bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /ces tshe dpag med kyi sku dang dar nang mdzod bcas byung ba dam pa'i rang rtags su snang / gzhan yang snga ma mdzod 'grel nas ma dag pa 'bru bcos dgos rigs kyi tho dang gsar du rgyud lugs phur pa/ klong chen snying thig /rang nyid kyi rnam thar rnams kyang par du brko bzhed kyis ma dpe med rigs bskur dgos sogs kyang 'dug /lar sa spyod rgyal po sras yum lcam sogs kyis rnam pa kun tu dad gus kyis gtong phod rgya che ba dang / de tshe yang nyid kyi sku bal dang na bza' sogs byin rte na gyi rigs las dngos pos skyes len gang yang mi dgos zhes yang yang phebs 'dug pa dang / 'jig rten srid pa'i 'byor longs la chog shes med cing dkon mchog ris su bcad pa'i sde bdag phal gyi rnam thar las ldog ste/rgyal khab der yang gsar rnying ris med kyi bstan pa bskyangs shing rten gsum kyi rigs la bkur ste che bar ma zad/ lo bzhi sku tshad kyi mchod rten dang skabs su gang babs kyi rigs sku brnyan che phra mang po rgyun chags su bzhengs 'dug pa dang /'di skabs su yang zangs gser las grub pa'i rma rgyan chen po thog tshad/ yum gnyis de mtshungs bcas bzhengs pa'i thugs bzhed 'dug 407

pas de rnams kyi nang rten sogs na'ang 'gro don che bar rig ste snga phyi ci rigs par sku rten gyi skor la/ rma rgyan gyi sku tshab chos rgyal li ma/ rang gi thugs dam rten gyi tsan dan dkar po'i slob dpon dang 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku li ma/ li nag gi rdo rje phag mo rgya gar ma byin can/ khyung skyugs kyi 'phags ma rig byed ma/ bod li gsar pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma/ rang gis lag 'debs sman 'dam gyi slob dpon chung du gser byugs ma grangs mang ba rnams dang / bris sku la/ phag mo'i rgyab tu gnas yul nyer bzhi dang nang ngos su zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing khams rten dang brten pa 'brel pa'i bkod pa/ yang zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod/ sgrol ljang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig can/ rang nyid kyi 'dra sku skye phreng gis bskor ba/ yang brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ yang mos lha 'ga' zhig gis bskor ba/ 'dra sku chig rkyang dar dang gos ser la bris pa/ drag po dpal chen/yang dag/gshin rje/rta mgrin/phur pa/ma mo//rig 'dzin/dregs 'dul/drag sngags rnams la so so'i 'khor rags rim gyis bskor ba'i thang nag gser bcad dgu/ yum ka bde chen rgyal mo la yi dam chos skyong gis bskor ba/gsang sgrub seng gdong ma gtso 'khor/ rang gi shangs mtshal gyis bris pa'i ma mgon lcam dral gyi sku thang sogs la so sor rgyab byang / bstod smon/ phyag zhabs kyi rjes/ bzang gos sna tshogs kyi gong gsham/ling gnyis brtsegs kyis zhal khebs dngul rag tsan dan ba so ci rigs pa'i dril tog can/ gsung rten skor/ sangs rgyas bye ba'i mtshan mdo gser bris/ mdzod 'grel shing rta rnam gnyis/ klong chen snying thig tshang ma/ skyes rabs brgya pa'i smon lam/ bde ba can gyi bstod smon/ sgom 408

phyogs dri lan dang / gtam tshogs kyi skor/ yab yum sras gsum so sor springs yig /lha 'drer bka' shog phyag zhabs kyi rjes dang phyag rtags gter tham gyis mnan pa gcig /yang ka mad can gos ser la bris pa phyag rjes btab pa gsum rnams/ thugs rten skor/ bka' gdams pad spungs mchod rten gnyis/ sngon byon gyi gter ston re zung dang rang gi'ang mgul phur rgyun bzhes byas pa'i gter phur khro zhal gsum pa gnam lcags ma/ slob dpon chen pos klu mal gro btul te slar has po rir rdo sgrom du sbas pa srung ma rdor legs kyis bsten nas ngos kyis rnyed pa'i drag po rta khyung gi gter rdzas ngo bo sde brgyad kyi thog lcags dzhai k+ṣi bcos bu dang khyad par med pa'i li dmar rtsod bral gyi phur pa gnam lcags thog rgod du grags pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas sa skyong sde dge rang gi rten skal du babs pa/ gzhan yang byin rten gyi rigs/ sa skya'i bdud rtsi ril bu khri rdo/bsam yas dang /mchims phu/shel brag sogs su bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi chos sman khal re tsam gyi bungs yod pa/ rang nyid kyi mthe bong las btab pa'i dam rdzas h+ya rgya can grangs mang ba/dbu spa dang phyag zhabs kyi sen mo/ rang gi nyer spyad rnying gras kyi dbu zhwa/ gos ser gyi 'gan sbyar/ phrug dang lan na'i gzan pa gnyis/ 'bu ras dang phrug gi nang gyon gnyis/ yang yun ring rgyan pa'i gog rtsa dregs pa can/ 'phel gdung dang shog ser sogs kyis gtams pa'i dngul gyi mgul gab/ gser gyi sor gdub pad rag dang margad kyi phra can/ spa cog bsdams thag gi dar dregs pa can/ rdzab kyi mchod spyad gnyis/ rdzab dang rak+ta'i bsnyen phreng gnyis/ rgyal sras 'bri gung pa'i mnabs 'gag dang dbu skra/ sa bcud gso ba'i bum gter bco lnga/ sras 409

dang yum lcam so sor seng gdong ma'i srung ba ras thang re/ rig 'dzin yab yum gyi srog 'khor dpal gyi gdu bu rnam gnyis/ tshe spel ba dang / bsod nams spel ba/ nyes pa sel ba/ byad kha zlog pa/ 'brum rims dang / 'bros nad srung ba sogs kyi 'khor lo snga phyi mang ba dang / skal ldan byis pa gter ston gyi 'brum srung gi dar cog /ljags bsnyen btab pa'i chab dang gu gul/bdud rtsi don 'grub ril bu sogs dang /gzhan yang 'gro ba mang po nad kyis 'jigs pa las skyab phyir rgyal po'i pho brang du/ rin chen ril bu sngon yod la rgyun mthud dang /dbang ril shel dkar mchod rten gsar sbyor skabs gzhan phan zhal 'debs su dmigs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / mi'i mgrin pa dang / ba min dang / rma bya dang / gla ba rnams las byung ba'i dbang ril/ mi las byung ba'i snyi hang dang / dzā ti pha la gcig /a ru ra gnyis 'brel dang gsum 'brel gnyis/ rin po che in+d+ra nī la dang / mnad dang / g.yang tri'u/g.yu drug dkar rnams rdog po re re/bar g.yu che chung bdun/zhum mig gsum/pad rag bzhi/ kha che spos shel gnyis/ spos shel dkyus ma srang bco lnga/ byu ru dkrugs ma che legs gnyis kyis gtsos byur sung gsum/ gzi phreng ring ba bcas rnams phul zhing / gzhan yang bod dang lho mon sogs nas byung ba'i spyad pa phran bu re phul ba ni 'dir ma bris/ de dag rnams kyang gong smos ltar rtsos ldan rgyal po 'di'i thugs bzhed bskangs na bstan 'gro spyi la phan pa'i gnad mthong ba las/ bla dpon gzhan srol la 'gran pa'i 'bul len gnang sbyin gyi spros pa dang slad du bsnyen bkur gyi 'phel ka la bsam pa ni ma yin no//gdung bsam yongs lha bstan rgyas ri bo dpal 'bar gling nas slob dpon 410

'jigs med kun grol gyis sku gsung thugs rten/ byu ru'i brgya phreng /bse ru/ras cha spus dag 'bor che ba dang bcas zhabs brtan 'bul mi 'byor/ 'bri gung nas sku gsung thugs rten dang dngul sung lnga bcus gtsos pa'i 'bul rten bcas zhabs brtan 'bul mi ched gtad 'byor/ gter sgrom 'brong ngur gyi rib rnams la dngul sung bcu skor gyis mthun rkyen bskur/ de bzhin du bka' blon pha lha'i zhabs brtan 'bul mi'ang 'byor/ ring min bsam yas su mchod pa'i sprin rgya chen po dang bcas gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che phul/ re zhig gson na'ang bstan pa dang / /sems can 'ba' zhig la sman las/ /gnod pa'i las 'bras cung zad med/ /pha rol nyid du song na yang / /rang sems rnam thar sgo gsum dang / /'du bral med pa'i chos nyid la/ /re dogs cung zad yod ma yin/ /chos dbyings bde chen klong du aḥ/ ces pa 'di yan chad ni/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po nyid ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir/ spyir gdul bya mchog dman bar ba'i don du gsungs pa'i bstan pa ris su ma chad pa dang / lhas par snyigs dus kyi gang zag rnams tshe lus gcig la 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i skur mngon sum nyid du 'tshang rgya ba'i gsang lam 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa ri mo'i mar me bzhin du gyur pa de nyi ma bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir rags pa'i sprul sku tha mal pa'i lus ltar snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol pa bstan pa la skad cig tsam yang 'gro ba'i don du mi 'gyur ba'i gyi na tha mal gyi mdzad pa'i skabs ma mchis par gzhon nu'i tshul bstan pa'i dus nas bzung / sku'i snang ba nye bar bsdu ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i bar gyi 411

klog pa thos bsam/ spong ba bsam gtan bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa phrin las kyi tshul rnams gdul bya rnam sa kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mos ngo bzhin du don bzang po/ /tshig 'bru bzang po/ /ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa sgro 'dogs skur 'debs zol sbyo ra gyi sayon tshig gis ma bslad par chos phung rgya mtsho'i ming tshig brjod pa mtha' dag yangs por 'khyil ba'i mgur gyi bum bzang nas rim par bka' stsal pa rnams tshig gi gdangs gcig dang yi ge 'bru gcig gi'ang dbri bsnan spangs te ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa las/ dgongs pa'i mtha' dang kun rdzob kyi mdzad pa'i spros pa nye bar bsdu ba la mngon du phyogs pas gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings chen po ka dag gzhon nu bum sku'i dbyings su shel 'od nang du thim pa bzhin chos sku thig le nyag gcis bi don dam pa'i mdzad par bya bral skye med don gyi a yig chos dbyings chen por nye bar bzhugs pa'i mthar thug gi mdzad pa bstan pa ni tshigs su bcad pa rkang pa brgyad pa'i bdag nyid can gyi rdo rje'i gsung yis rtogs par bya ba dang bcas re zhig rdzogs pa'o////4/ 2

pad+ma dbang chen rol pa rtsal gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar mjug mthud kyi skor bzhugs so/ /༄༅//zab zhi spros bral rdo rje'i dbyings su ngo bo rgyal ba kun dang mnyam/ /rang bzhin gzhi dang snying por lhun grub stug po bkod pa'i nges pa rdzogs/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs brte'i zhags pas dam 'khyud pas/ /sprul pa'i zhod zur sgyu drar yongs bstan theg mchog bla ma snying nas dran/ /gang gi dus su chaḍi ya na dang / /'og min zhing du bstan pa'i snying po la/ /spyod pa'i grags pa bstan pa mngon sum du/ /gangs can yul du 'phos pa'i skal bzang mthong / /da ni ma rig 'khrul pas bskyed pa'i gzugs/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang 'gog pa med pa'i yul//rtag pa min par 'gyur ba'i chos can 'dis//yongs grub rdo rje'i chos kyang bag la bsgribs/ /'on kyang rab rib can la skra shad bzhin/ /zag pas sbags pa'i 'khrul snang 'di ltar yang / /rdo rje'i chos su grub pa'i ye shes kyi/ /sku la skye 'gag zhen pa byis pa'i blo/ /de phyir mig 'phrul lta bu'i snang ba yi/ /bkod pa'i mtha' dang rjes su zhugs pa'i gtam/ /zol /sdo zloching bu'i rgyan dang ma 'brel bar/ /rang bzhin nor bu'i phra tshom spras de la 'dir mgon po rdo rje 'chang bka' drin mnyam pa med pa 'di nyid ni gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po dang gnyis su med par thog ma med 413

pa'i dus nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing chos kyi sku dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i go 'phang brnyes na'ang / sems can ma dag pa rnams 'khor ba'i mtsho chen po las rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshul bzung ba'i 'khrungs rabs kyi phreng ba tshar du dngar bas ma tha' yas pa'i zhing rnams su bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod par lta ci smos te sku tshe 'di nyid kho na'i mdzad pa dag kyang mtha' yongs su rdzogs par brjod pa ni so skye'i blo'i ra ba las 'das pa yin kyang / bskal pa blo gros mchog dang ldan pa 'ga' dang 'gas rje nyid la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa glegs bam yi ge'i lam du mjal chog pa zhig dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa las gnas dus kyi gdul bya'i blo dang rjes su 'tshams pa'i mdzad pa thun mong pa rnams chu babs su brjod gzhir bkod pa ltar snang ba la thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs spyod ches mchog tu gsang ba rnams kyang blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis go bar 'gyur la/ 'phros don gyi tshul du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs mang po dang / man ngag gi gnad dag kyang cig char du ston cing gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi 'jug sgo du mar shar ba rnams las grub mtha' rang rang gi 'jog tshul tha dad pa ltar snang ba rnams/ chos kyi ngo bo la bzang ngan dang nor 'khrul med kyang / gang zag so so'i blo'i 'khyer sos chos kyi dbyings la 'jal tshul dang / nyams len gyi skabs bzang ngan nor 'khrul 'byung ba ni so skye'i chos nyid pas/ de dag gi gol sa thad kur gcod pa dang gdul bya mchog la gnas lugs sbar bcangs 4 4

su ngo sprod pa dang /— dman 'bring che gsum rang rang gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar nas so byang sngags gsum gyi dam tshig dang / sdom pa'i kun spyod sogs gnang bkag gi so mtsham sa phyed par nyams su len tshul dang / mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams kyi dgongs pa 'jal zhing grub pa'i mtha' la dgag bzhag gis phyogs 'then sogs la don gyi yin lugs nas gzhal ba'i bshags 'byed dpyad brdar sogs mdor na chos kyi rnam grangs rgya chen po 'bel gtam gyi tshul du 'byung ba'i rnam par thar pa chen mo skabs gsum gyi bdag nyid can gong du 'khod pa 'di nyid rim gyis zin thor phebs pas tha ma'i mdzad pa'ang dgongs pa lung ston gyi tshul du tshang ba yin no/ /de lta na'ang de'i don 'grel gyi tshul du cung zad rgyas par brjod pa dang zhar byung du bka' drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i mgon po de nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs shing slar yang zhing khams 'dis mtshon dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing bye ba phrag brgyar rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa la bdud dang bar du gcod pas brdzi bar mi nus pa dang / 'brel thogs mchog dman kun gyi sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur bar rdzogs pa'i thabs dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i tshul rnams rang nyid grags 'dod rnyed 'tshol gcam bu sogs ma yin par rang sems zol med dpang por bcas te zin thor bgyis pa rje bla ma'i rnam thar mjug mthud kyi tshul du 'god pa la/ de yang rje 'di nyid kyis rang cag rtag 'dzin can gyi gdul bya rnams la ched du dgongs pas sngon tsam nas spyan 'grib kyi tshul sogs sku na mthon por phebs pa ltar ston cing / mdzad pa rlabs che ba 415

dag gi dus na'ang /slan chad de tsam grub pa dka' zhes ring min zhing khams 'pho ba'i gsung thor bur 'byon pa dang / sngar dbang chos bka' rgya dog por mdzad pa rnams kyang phyis sus zhus la sanang zhing / lhag par 'bri gung sprul pa'i sku yab sras la 'dus pa mdo dbang sogs dang rje nyid kyi dgongs gter bka' 'bum sogs dgongs gtad kyis bka' lung rdzogs pa'i tshul du 'bul bar mdzad pa ni phyis zhal mi mjal bar dgongs par snang zhing /sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma can gyi lung bstan sku tshe'i tshad de las ring bar bstan mod kyang bsod nams dman pa'i gdul bya'i snang ba la sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la sku tshe ji tsam bzhugs dri ba mdzad tshe/ kun dga' bo'i rna ba bdud kyis bkab pa'i lo rgyus dang mtshungs par lung bsta na thog tu 'khel ba'i sku tshe'i rten 'brel gyi rim pa 'ga' zhig phyag tu ma lon pa dang / der ma zad gab pa'i lung bstan 'ga' zhig lo zla zhag dus kyi sgra ji bzhin ma yin par bstan pas mtha' gcig tu kha tshon gcod dka' zhes rje nyid kyi gsung las thos pas don du so skye'i blo snang du shar ba'i lung bstan gyi don 'grel ltar dngos su mi bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa thugs thag chod par snang ste/ sngar bsam yas mchims phur dpal slo rgyan chen po'i lung bstan ro dus dus me zhes pa ro dus lo dang dus me zla ba'i grangs su byas na drug cu re dgu 'byung bas de nyid thog tu khel ba las cung zad sku tshe 'di'i gdul bya ma rjogs pas phyir bsnur ba ltar bstan pa ni/ snga lo 'bri gung du chibs bskyod pa'i dgun dgung lo bdun cu'i steng du phebs ma thag pa na phyogs de'i chab ma 'phrod pa'i tshul sems can las nyon can rnams dang / rnam smin tshul 4/6

mthun ltar ston pa'i sku'i 'du ba shin tu 'khrugs pas bdun gcig tsam gyi bar zhing khams 'pho nyer byung ba na dge rtse chos nyid pa 'dir yod pa slar khams su 'byon pa'i thon phyag 'bul ba dang dus mtshungs pas khong gis phul ba'i gsol sman chig thub des re zhig sku dwangs pa ltar gyur pa/sngon ston pas dge tshul tsun+da'i ngor sku tshe zla ba gsum phyir bsrings pa dang tshul mthun pas gsol sman de nyid khong gi g.ya' ma lung nas rtsol ba med bzhin rnyed pa yang rje nyid kyi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul du go ba'i phyir bka' las da res dga' mo yong ba o rgyan chen po'i thugs rje yin zhes phebs/ de nas rings stabs kyis gdan sa 'di nyid du bde bar zhal gzigs thub pas phyogs 'di'i 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi lhag ma nyung zad cig gis bgo skal du thob cing / re zhig bar bskun gzhi med pa skyes bu gzhon nu lta bur bzhings bzhugs dang sku zol yang ba sngar bzhin snang mod/de ltar na'ang gsol zas la ji lta bar spyod par mi mdzad pas som nyir gyur te bsnyan ro btsa' ba thon pa'i gsol sman 'phrod gzhes dang / sku'i rim gro gnang ba sogs gzhis byes kyi dad mos can kun gyis mgrin gcig par gsol ba nan cher btab pa na/ lar skye mtha' 'chi ba chos nyid yin/ nged ni bya ba thams cad 'grub pa zhig yin pas shi yang blo bde/ de bas 'chi khar lag stong du 'gro ba tsho snying re rje/ 'on kyang khyod rnams blo mi bde na sman bcos byas chog /sku rim 'di dang 'di sogs gyis zhes bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis non pa'i snang ba brid pa'i zhal bzhes tsam mdzad pa bzhin/ mchims phu sogs gnas chen dag tu tshogs bskangs mkha' 'gro'i me mchod/ sku che'i bsgrub pa/ bsam yas sogs chos 'khor 417

rnams su mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su mang 'gyed/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dang sgro la ma tshe bzungs 'ur 'don/ bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog /ma mabon gyi bska nga mdos/ ma mo 'khrugs bskangs/ sats+tsha dang sku par grangs bsags/lug drug cu skor dang nya stong phrag kha yar tshe thar/ khyad par tshogs brgya dang bsu bzlog 'brel ba nyin mang po'i rjes sku glud dkor cha dang bcas pa bsdangs te de'i rjes 'brel brten bzhugs 'bul bas mtshon rgyab rten sku rim tshul gyis rnam dkar rgya chen po rje nyid kyi bka' lung du gang phebs rnams rnam thar zhal gsung mar yang gsal ba dang / gzhan yang rang blos dpyad pa la sogs gung cher bsgrubs skabs 'di dag tu rje nyid bzhugs pa'i nye skor du me tog gi char zim bu 'bab pa dang sa khol bur g.yo ba'ang snga phyi du mar byung ba myur bar zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i ltas kho nar snang /grub dbang wa gi:sa dbus bdag cag gzhis byes kyi bu slob tu gtogs pa rnams dang / dpal ri bla grwa spyi yongs sbyin bdag spu shud pa sogs dad can so so nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas zhabs brtan brtan bzhugs rgyas par 'bul ba dang / mtsho sna dgon rtse/ mdo mkhar gnyer tshang / gtsang thes mchog gling pa sogs phyogs su ring ba rnams nas kyang sku gsung thugs rten sogs 'bul nod dang bcas zhu 'phrin gyi lam nas zhabs pad brtan dgos kyi gsol 'debs dang / bsnyun tshul gsan 'phral sa skyong sde dge nas kyang rang gi mnga' ris kyi dgon chen rnams su dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu yon 'gros gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i bsnyen pa dung phyur bzhi dang sats+tsha 'bum ther sogs kyis brtan bzhugs rgyas par snang / 'tsho byed chu skyes pa 418

zhabs 'bring bcar sdod bcas gsol sman rigs phul te sman pa mkhas pa ga'an yang 'di zhes bya ba bos na zhes zhus pa na/ sman pa 'bod pa'i na tsha ni gang yang mi 'dug /'on kyang khyod rang tsho blo ma bde na rang re dang khad nye ba'i sman pa la bstan chog /thag ring nas 'bod pa khag sbyongs las mi yong zhes phebs khad nye'i sman pa mkhas su re ba nas phyag rtsa dang chab la brtag gzhig ngos gsol sman bsgyur ba dang bcas ji snyed cig phul ba bzhin du bzhes pa ni bdag cag rnams ma 'ongs pa'i sdug bsngal sngon bsus kyi yid rtab rtab por gyur pa'i gnas skabs der thugs kyi brtse bas dbugs dbyung ba'i bka' drin mi zad par blta'o/ /skabs shig gi bka' 'phros kyi gling stongs tshul du/ bla ma zhi bar gshegs dus sku gdung ril por gzhag na tshwa bsdam byed lugs 'di ltar byed dang /yang ding sang gi bla ma rnams kyis gzi byin 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pas dad rdzas chud gsan pa la zhe khrel bas pa ri'i dkor rdzas rnams ni sngar phan dkon mchog rang la dmigs pa zhig yin te/phyin chad khyod tsho'i thog tu bab tsa na spyi mtshungs tsam re mi byed ka med yong snang bas gong sa yas phyin gyis mtshon rang re dang 'dris yod kyi bla ma rnams la mchod bsngo brda mtshon re 'bul na 'di la 'di zhes sogs dper brjod kyi tshul du gnang ba bcas zhing khams 'pho bar dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung gi rigs rim par phebs shing / 'ga' zhig phebs 'phror bdag cag rnams mya ngan gyi duḥkha cher lhongs par mkhyen pas gsung 'phros gzhan la bsgyur bar mdzad de 'phro rnams rje nyid kyi nye gnas bcar mar zhu mi zhig yod pa la gnang ba phyis bshad rgyu snang / res 'ga' zhabs pad brtan dgos zhes pa'i 4 9

gsol 'debs snyan gtser pa'i smre ngag gi gdung shugs cher 'bar ba na/ re zhig skyon mi yong zhes ldem por dbongs pa'i zhal bzhes kyis rmongs pa'i blo la sgra ji bzhin par 'dzim pa'i spro ba bsring bar mdzad/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i gtso bo chos mdzad sā ra'i mtshan can la'ang gsung gi lhongs snga ma lta bu dang bcas pa 'ga' zhig phebs pa na/ mkhyen pa'i dbang pos phyag dang bcas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar ci nas kyang bzhugs dgos shing / gal te bdag cag gi bsod nams su 'chur thebs bral ba'i zhing khams gzhan gyis thugs yid 'phrogs te nges par thabs med pa zhig yin na mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes cis kyang gnang dgos shing mchod sdong rin po che yang sri zhus mi ngal ba'i khur blang zhu bas 'di khar bzhugs dgos tshul sogs kyi rgyu mtshan zhib par zhu bar mdzad pas/nged la skye ba len snyam pa'i 'dun pa byed rgyu med de chos nyid kyi mthus sprul pa zhig ni yong shas kha/ 'on kyang brtsad gcod rigs bya mi dgos zhes dang / 'phral yun du thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i zhal gdams dbugs dbyung tshad med pa gnang zhing / de 'phral mchod rten 'dir bzhugs pa legs dang bsam yas su bzhugs zer ba ma mgon la brtag bsgril gyis phebs/ blun rmongs dud 'gro'i rang bzhin las lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod cha shas tsam med pas/ rang nyid nas dgos don che ba'i slob don tshig 'bru tsam yang zhu ma shes kyang rje nyid kyi thugs rje la ni tshad ma mchis pas dpon gyi ming tsam 'bod pa bdag la'ang thugs re dang bcas rje sgam po gshegs rjes kyi lo rgyus 'phral yun gyi zhal gdams slob bya'i rigs dang dbang chas dang dpe cha rnams 'khyar med du gzhog /dgon pa'ang slad 420

nas 'bri gung sprul skus 'dzin bskyang yong ba gyis/ lar khyod tsho'i rnam rtog gi bye brag 'gog ma thub pa yin/ nged kyi snang ba ni rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ngang dang 'du 'bral mi 'jug ces phebs/ nyin mtshan med par skyil grung dang /res 'ga' drang srong tsog pus bzhugs/ spyan lta stangs kyi ngang las g.yo ba mi mnga'/grub thob sbri na sa nyas khyur med btang bas nya'i khog par lo mang por skyon med du bzhugs pa rlung gi nus pa yin pa bzhin/ rje 'di nyid drang don du yang rtsa rlung gi yon tan stobs su gyur cing srog thur gcig tu 'dres pa'i mngon rtags kun gyi mthong chos su yod pas srog rtsol la dbang 'byor pa'i nus pa kho nas 'di bar zhal bzhugs par 'dug cing / bka' las kyang /'bri gung gi na lugs dang na tshod kyi babs la ltos na da bar 'tsho ba yang dga' mo yin/ nad 'di gzhan gyis theg dka' ba zhig snang yang sngar rlung 'byongs po byas pas bde kyi na zug sogs gang yang mi 'dug ces phebs/nam dus stabs nyin re mon pa bcu skor re 'ong ba sogs thag ring nas lhags pa thams cad la zhal mjal phyag dbang sogs bar mi chad sngar las lhag par stsal/ sa rta zla ba bdun pa'i nang sde dge'i mi sna 'jigs med blo gsal 'dir zhag shas 'dug ring khong rang 'byor ba yan gyi rnam thar 'phro dgos zhes zhu bar saṃ bho ṭar ljags pod mthar tshigs bcad skye med kyi yi ge'i mtha' can de gnang / bka' chos yongs rdzogs kyi bka' gtad smon lam gyi byin rlabs dang bcas blo gsal can zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bdun la phyir bsdangs/ de'i nyi shu'i nyin rdo yul nas bla ma 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi yab mtshan dpon rigs 'dul ba rta dang bcas pa zhig 'byor par 421

mjal kha lhod pa chos 'brel zhal gdams sogs dang / tshe dbang zhig kyang zhus song ba re ba bzhin du mdzad/khong rnams sku dngos kyis gdul bya'i phyi ma yin/ nyer dgu nyin mon pa'i bu slob sdod yun ring ba gnyis la phyag dbang byin rlabs zhal gdams sogs gnang zhing phyir 'gro bar sems 'phreng ba'i rnam 'gyur mchi ma 'khrugs pa na myur bar 'phrad 'ong zhes dbugs dbyung mdzad de dgongs pa can zhig go//gnam gang nyin yang mtshams pa ba zhig la phyag dbang byin rlabs zhal gdams sogs stsal/de gong tsam nas yang dben rnam grol rtser gzim chung gnang rtsis kyis bla brang dang khyon gcig gis sa rtsi dang 'dzin spras kyis zhes phebs nas zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gnyis nyin yang dben du phebs 'phral 'o da nged skyid pa'i sa 'dir slebs pa yin no zhes nan che bar bka' phebs/ sbyin bdag gi sku ngos rnams la phyag dbang byin rlabs dang / sku mdun du ja gral la gsung chos kyi rigs rgya cher stsal/ sang nyin gyi snga dro'i char chos mdzad sā rar sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid dmigs rim stsal zhing de'i nyin khyab par bdug spos bzang po lta bu'i dri zhim pos phyogs kun khyab cing chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad pa'i rtags rlung ser bu tsam yang ldang ba med par nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i ngogs las me tog gi char chal chil du 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa mtha' yas pa dang bcas sa pho rta lo dbyu gu'i zla ba'i tshes gsum gyi mtshan mo'i thun dang po la bab pa na drang srong tsog pu'i 'dug stangs la bzhugs bzhin du mchod pa shoms shig ces bka' stsal nas re zhig gdod ma'i dbyings su spros pa nye bar bsdu bar mdzad do/ /kye ma kyi hud 'jig rten mig gcig zum/ /blang dor ston pa'i 422

bshes gnyen mig bus dor/ /grangs med srid par goms pa'i thugs bskyed kyang / /zhi ba'i dbyings su gzhol ba cang srid dam/ /gdod nas skye 'chi spa ngas pa'i rdo rje'i skur/ /mngon par byang chub zin mod kun khyab kyi/ /thugs rje 'gag pa med pa'i rang rtsal de /nye bar bsdu ba thugs kyis bzod lags sam//e ma ji srid 'gro rgyud 'khor ba'i rgyun/ /stongs min de srid gzugs sku'i rol pa yang / /rtag par 'jug pa'i kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi/ /nges par brdzun par mi srid rang snang skyon/ /thog med dus nas bsags pa'i las sgrib kyi/ /skal ba ngan pa'i bag chags stug po 'dis/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku yang 'pho 'jig tu/ /mthong ba'i brdzun snang bslu ba'i chos la ltos/ /mgon po gang gi zhal gyi pad+mo las/ /gdams ngag sbrang rtsi'i ro mchog myongs gyur kyang / /nan tan 'jug pa bral rnams rtag 'dzin gyi/ /gdon chen snying la zhugs par da gdod go/ /'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku can yang / /'jig pa'i zol gyis 'og min chen por gshegs/ /'jig rten las kyi rten gyur lus can rnams/ /nges par pha rol 'gro ba mkhyen par mdzod/ /de phyir sgo gsum ngal ba'i blo spang nas/ /gang la mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / /bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i bya ba nyin mtshan du/ /'brel la shugs drag brtson par dam bca'o/ /de yang gser 'od dam pa'i le'u gnyis pa las/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bshad pa de thos nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ji ltar na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pas de ltar sku che'i tshad thung bar bstan par gyur ces gsol pa dang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de 423

dag gis byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog la 'di skad ces bka' stsal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa de ni snyigs ma rnam pa lnga'i 'jig rten du skye dgu'i tshe'i tshad lo brgya thub pa'i dus su bltams nas sems can mos pa dman pa/dge ba'i rtsa ba dang dad pa chung ba'i sems can de dag bdag tu blta ba dang / sems can du blta ba dang / srog tu blta ba dang / gso bar blta ba dang / gang zag tu blta ba dang / log par blta ba dang / bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa dag dang / rtag pa dang chad par blta ba la sogs pa'i byis pa so so skye bo rnams la phan gdags pa dang / gzhan yang mu stegs sems can rnams la yang dag pa'i lta ba bskyed pas myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des sku tshe'i tshad thung ba bstan to//gzhan yang rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa de myang ngan las 'da' ba bstan pas/ sems can rnams de dkon pa dang phrad par dka' ba'i 'du shes dang / mya ngan dang sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes la sogs pa bskyed pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i mdo 'di dag myur du 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa la skur ba 'debs pa med par 'gyur bas/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pas sku tshe thung bar bstan to//de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu bzhugs shing mya ngan las mi 'da' na/ sems can rnams gus pa med pa dang / phrad par dka' ba'i 'du shes kyang mi bskyed pas de bzhin bshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo zab mo dag 'dzin cing klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang 424

rgya cher yang dag par ston par mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na de ni bcom ldan 'das rtag tu 'jig rten na bzhugs par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu dper na gang la la zhig pha ma la nor bu rin po che rgyas pa mang du yod pa mthong nas nor de la dkon pa dang / ngo mtshar gyi 'du shes mi bskyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ pha ma'i nor rdzas de la rtag tu yod pa'i 'du shes skye ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das rtag tu mya ngan las mi 'da' na de la dkon pa dang / phrad par dka' ba'i 'du shes mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang dper na la la zhig pha ma dbul zhing nor dang mi ldan pa zhig ste/ de rgyal po'am blon po chen po zhig gi gnas su phyin te de dag gi bang mdzod dang / nor dang rin po che la sogs pa mang po rgyas pa mthong na de dkon pa dang / rnyed par dka' ba'i 'du shes skyes te/ dbul po de nor btsal ba'i thabs bsgrub pa la brtson par byed do//de ni dbul ba dang phongs pa spang ste dzade ba dang 'byor pa bsgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'da' ba mthong na/de dkon pa dang / phrad par dka' ba dang / mya ngan dang sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes kyang bskyed cing bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byung ba'ang bskal pa grangs med pa na lan 'ga' zhig byung ste/ ji ltar u dum wā ra'i me tog rgya lam na yang 'ga' zhig 'byung ba bzhin pas sems can rnams de la dkon pa dang phrad par dka' ba'i 'du shes bskyed cing bcom ldan de la gus pa skye bar 'gyur/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i mdo rnams la'ang bden pa'i 'du shes dang / yongs su bzung ba'i 'du shes bskyed cing skur pa 'debs 425

par mi byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu de dang rkyen de'i phyir 'jig rten na yun ring du mi bzhugs shing myur du mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzad pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni thabs mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pa de lta bus sems can rnams yongs su smin par mdzad do//zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i tshad mtha' med pa la gdul bya rnams kyi don du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul sto na pa ni de bzhin gshegs pas thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pa phun sum tshogs par gsungs pa bzhin bdag cag gi 'dren pa mchog 'di nyid kyang nges pa'i don du gdod ma nas chos kyi sku'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i sprul pa yas sprul kho na nyid du gdon mi za bar ma zad/drang don gdul bya tha mal pa rnams kyi snang ngor bstan pa'i sku tshe 'di nyid yang gzhon nu'i dus nas theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i zab don snying tig gi man ngag khregs chod dang / thod rgal gyi lam sgron ma bzhi'i rnal 'byor la goms pas/ lhun grub snang bzhi'i sa la bsgrod pa yongs su rdzogaso pa'i chos zad blo 'das chen po'i dgongs pas zag bcas phung po'i rdul phran lhag ma ma lus par dengs nas 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku mngon du gyur te 'chi med gnyug ma'i bstan srid la mnga' brnyes pas skye 'chi'i 'jug pa chad zin pa la nem nur ma mchis mod de bdag cag lta bu rtag par 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyi le lo zlog par dka' bas dge ba'i rtsa ba dang dad pa chung bar gyur pa rnams chos la bskul bar bya ba'i don dang / mu stegs can dang 'dra bar rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi lta bas 'gran sems dang /phrag dog gi dug chus myos pa rnams kyang dge ba'i sa bon gyi bag chags dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba la 426

'dun pa'i shes rab kyis dran pa yongs su sad par bya ba sogs dgos dbang du ma la sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pa 'di lta bu yongs su bstan pa'i dus la mngon par bab pas bdas cag rnams ni mya ngan gyi tshor ba drag pos re zhig ci bya brtol med par gyur/ rje 'di lta bu la phal pa'i rigs 'gre'i gsal 'debs sogs ni ci la 'grub 'on kyang 'jig rten rmongs pa'i snang tshod dang yang mi 'gal bar dpyad de grub pa'i dbang po wa gen+d+ras sangs rgyas sras gcig gi rgyud klog khrol thugs smon mdzad/ de nas dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs ji ltar nus pa'i rim pas rjes su zhugs pa la theg mchog rgya la po'i lam nas gang zag mchog rnams mya ngan las 'da' ba ni khyung phug sgo nga'i nang du gshog rtsal rdzogs pa'i dpe bzhin du phung po'i 'brel thag chad pa dang yar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba las stong pa gsum 'od gsal dang bcas pa'i 'jug gnas ldang ba'i thim rim lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi nges pa'ang kun rdzob kyi spros pa tsam du zad pa'i phyir thugs dam du bzhugs re'i phung po bsgul bskyod mi byed pa sogs don dang ngo mtshar mi che zhes rje nyid kyi gsung du phebs pa dang bcas nang par sku gdung rin po cher dri bzang gi khu bas khrus gsol te bzang drug dang bdud rtsi sman sgrub phye mas legs par byugs/ rigs lnga thor tshugs rdor dril sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la nye bar thos pa'i cha byad rnams phul nas rtag brtan lhun grub chen po'i skur bzhugs su gsol ba'i khor yug kun mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho'i 'byor tshogs dang bcas/ grub dbang dam pas rdor slob mdzad pa'i grwa slob gtso bsdus bcu phrag nas snga thun la bla ma mchod pa'i 4 27

dkyil 'khor chen po mchod cing bsgrubs pa dang / bdag nyid 'jus pa'i dbang gi rim pa dang bcas pa/ gung gi thun dang phyi dro'i thun gnyis la zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang na raka bskangs kyi cho ga smin rgyas kyi thun mtshams rnams su mchog gi sprul pa'i sku myur gsal 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam sogs bar med dang / 'di kha'i gzhus mar gnas pa'i grwa rigs dang phyogs 'dus bcas nyi shu sum cu sogs nges med du tshogs pa nas le'u bdun ma/ rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs dang rnam thar gsol 'debs/ yig brgya dang ye shes sku mchog /bsam lhun myur 'grub bcas grangs gsog nyin bcu'i bar bsgrubs pa'i gdung chog pa rnams la dngul/ ja sug /gzan stod sogs kyi sa chog yon smar nges/ byings la'ang dngul/ dar 'gyed/ ras cha rtsam pa sogs kyi 'gyed sna mang ba bsgrubs/ de nas dgung zhag zhe dgu'i ma rdzogs ring mchod pa'i 'byor tshogs rgya chen po bshams ngos/ cho ga pa grwa grangs nges med du 'dzoms pas nyin ltar bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang / tshogs brgya smon lam dang bcas chag med ngos/bdun tshigs dag tu zhi khro rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor chen por na raka bskangs bshags dang skabs mtshams rnams su sku gdung rin po cher khrus gsol ba'i dri bzang gi chu khu bar btab pa'i 'jim pa la o rgyan chen po gtsor gyur gyi par sku mang po dang / sats+tsha grangs med btab/ g.yu ru khra 'brug tu stong mchod kyi dgos cha snyan shal bcas rgyas pa dang / mnga' ris grwa tshang du bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog nyin gsum tshugs rgyu'i dgos cha yon dngul rkyang grwa rer zho do re dang ras snam gos zas sogs kyi spoms 'gyed zho re dma' 28

mthar thebs pa/ sngon nas song ba rnams las kyang khra 'brug gi mchod 'bul zhi bar gshegs nyin rang 'grig pas ma sgrigs lhun grub tu dgongs su smin/bdun tshigs dang po'i nyin nas bzung rim par dgos cha gra sgrig gis/ gong sa yas phyin so sor rgya li spus gtsang gi thub dbang sku mtho tshad re dang / sde dril gser margo ma rdor bcas/ kha btags nang mdzod/ brgyad tshan bzang ba re dang / lha ldan jo shāka la gser chab dang stong mchod cig 'bul rgyu'i dod sgril dngul sung nyis brgya skor dang / snyan shal mang ba/ 'bri gung du rgyal sras rin po cher nang mdzod gu ru'i sku tshab gser dmar las grub pa mkhyid gang lhag pa/ gan dril rdor bcas/ thor snam gyi rta ber kha gsar/ bka' chems dgongs don thang yig gi thang chen gra tshar dgu/rgya bar phe reng pa'i shel mig rin thang can/ tsi na'i shel sgo/brgyad tshan bzang ba bcas/rin po che che tshad la thub dbang rdor gdan ma spus legs mtho gang / theg chen gan dril spus gtsang rdor bcas/ nang mdzod dang brgyad tshan bzang ba/ dgon khag thel sgro lung / ka tshal/brtse ba grwa tshang so sor mang ja gsum re dang 'gyed ṭaṃ ga re/de khul gter sgrom bcas kyi gnas rten rnams su snyan shal mchod 'bul rgya che ba/zhwa lha khang du'ang mchod 'bul bcas grwa tshang la mang ja gnyis/ 'gyed skar phyed brgyad re rnams zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco lngar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang phyi nang la mchod pa rnam lnga stong tshar gnyis dang gser chab snyan shal 'bor che ba dang / dkar khang du zla gcig gi mar bzhu mar khal bzhi brgya lnga bcu skor bcas bsgrubs/ bar khang du tshogs brgya dang mchod 'bul rab tu smin pa dang / jo bo byang chub chen po'i spyan sngar 429

lug brgyad kyi tshe thar/mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du mchod pa sna lnga rgyas par bshams thog gu ru gtso 'khor gyi sku tshab yid bzhin nor bur gser chab snyan shal dang / rgya dngul thur srang bco lnga yod pa'i kong bu 'phul ma legs pa rnams phul/ gnas 'dzin pa grwa pa ci yod kyi mgon du sprul pa'i sku bzhugs pas nyin gang tshogs brgya dang le'u bdun gsol 'debs sogs mdzad par ṭa 'gyed bcas cho ga yon smar bar phul/ gling smad pa rnams su mang ja gsum ṭaṃ 'gyed/ sgrags yang rdzong / g.ya' ma lung gnyis su'ang tshogs brgya dang mchod 'bul snyan shal/ de dag gi sanas 'dzin pa rnams la yang mang ja dang ja 'gyed/ zung phu pa gter ston rin po che'i gdung 'bum la mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar snyan shal dang bcas grwa btsun rnams su mang ja gsum ṭa 'gyed/ srong btsan bam sor grwa grangs brgyad res nyin gcig stong mchod bshams 'bul dang nyin gcig na raka bskangs bshags tshogs brgya dang 'brel ba snga phyi bsdams pa tshar gsum rten rnams la gser chab snyan shal mang bar phul zhing mchod pa'i ro ma rnams kyis yul mi dang 'phyong rgyas zhol tshun gyi mu to ba'i dbul ba bsal/ khra 'brug tu slar yang stong mchod gcig dang / 'am bu/ stag can/ shel brag /gdan sa thel rnams so sor mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar la mtha' rten snyan shal bcas dang tshogs bskangs gnas 'dzin pa dbul po'i tshogs la mang 'gyed/ ri bo bde chen par sman bla nyin 'khyongs kyi mchod bshams dang bsnyen bkur gzabs rgyas thog /skal 'gro brgyad brgya thal tsam snang bar rtsam phogs bre 'gyed ṭa kha/ dpal rir 'dus pa mdo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed kyis sgrub mchod bdun 430

phrag gcig gi ring dngos gzhi'i zhabs tog bzang ba'i thog 'dzugs sgang grol nyin bcas su tsha grwa tshogs 'khor bcas gzabs pa/ chog yon grwa rer dngul ṭa kha re/ grwa grangs bcu rer ja ko sbag/yang ṭaṃ re thebs rtsis kyi dngos po'i rigs sna tshogs 'dus mdo'i sgrub mchod kyi cha rkyen du dngul bum che ba gcig /dngul srang bco lnga yod pa'i ting bdun tshar gcig /dngul gyi sman rag ka li cha/dngul kong gcig/dngul thur srang nyi shu skor yod kyi rgya gling cha/spyi rdzas su/ rgyan bzhi rgyan mdog rgyu rnying gi phod kha cha gcig dang / hor rgyan bzhi sngon po spus dag gi phod kha legs pa zor pad tshem drub kyis khro zhal can rnams dang / gtsang khang nang gi mkhan po'i skur ling ser gyi sku chos/ chos rgyal la rdor sang sngo dmar spel ba'i stod le smad sham/nye sras brgyad dang rdor sems bcas su bzang gos tshos spel gyis stod le smad sham/ 'u shang rdo'i rten gtsor grags pa'i rnam snang byin can la bzang gos kyi stod le dang cod pan bcas phul/ lo ltar gyi sprel zla'i tshes bcu dang / zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la srong btsan du mchod pa sna lnga tshar re 'bul bshams dang / 'dus pa mdo'i sgrub mchod la mang ja 'phar ma gnyis re dang rtsam phogs bre re rgyag rgyur nas gad gtsang gshor khal lnga bcu nga bzhi rnams sbyar/ blo dkar ba'i btsun ma sum cu skor nas spyi 'dus kyi cho ga tshogs skong bcas la nyid 'khyodas zhabs rtog tsha gra bcas yon zho re/ bal sil skyon med gcig spyi rdzas su sbyar/ dpal ri rnying ma ba dud brgyad cu skor la ja gnyis thug pa bcas kyi thog sgo 'gyed skar phyed brgyad re dang dbul po'i tshogs la 'phar ma'i sbyin pa/ gzhi ba'i dud chung rnams la'ang grwa tshang gi sgrub mchod zhabs rtog gi rjes 'brel tu 31

nyin gcig gi ja thug gzabs pa dang / sgo 'gyed spyir ja sngag bcas don mkhar khul gyi yul mi ci yod sprang po bcas la ja chang thug pa gang 'thung ngos /rtsam bre do re dang sgo 'gyed ja bzhi khrigs re/ bla brang gi zho sha sogs la 'brel che ba dag la snam ras gos zas ja 'gyed 'phar ma bcas kyi ster phyin/dbul po dang sprang po rnams su rtsam dngul mchod ro rnams kyi sbyin gtong bar med/yar stong mda' bur brag gi slob dpon chen po'i gzim phug tu brgya mchod dang tshogs brgya/ bla bre chung ngu / ras sman gyi gnam rgyan zangs kyi maṇ+ḍal bcas phul/dgas po phra mo brag tu'ang brgya mchod snyan shal 'bul rgyu bskur/'phyos lam rim pa grwa grangs drug cu skor/bkra shis bde chen pa brgyad cu skor/thang po che pa sum cu/ spyan g.yas dgon stod sum cu skor/ dar rgyas gling pa nyis brgya skor bcas so sor mang ja gnyis re dang /'gyed skar phyed brgyad re/bsngo rten bcas/ sa skya gong ma rin po cher thugs dam 'dogs byed rten/nang mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ khom lha he ru ka bcas la lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba'i thang sku spus legs gsum dang nang mdzod/lha chen mkhan por bzang gos kha 'brel bar mdzod bcas/ rdo rje brag /lcags zam sprul sku/ dpal ri sprul sku/ mtsho sna dgon rtse/ kong po rgod tshang / lha lung sprul sku/ nyi grags sprul sku sogs bla ma rnams su/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs dang / na bza' kha sar/ rdor dril sogs ci rigs pa kha btags bcas mchod bsngo'i rten brda mtshon re gtsang theg mchog gling du sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i cho ga nyin gnyis gtong rgyu'i dgos cha dang / spyi rdzas su lpags byus sna lnga yug tshang las bsgrubs pa'i rgyal mtshan gsham bu bcu gcig brtsegs dang bden 3 2

rnam shing rta gnyis kyi glegs bam/ 'gyed ṭa kha re/ lo lo bzhin snga 'gyur sgyu 'phrul gyi cho ga nyin gnyis re tshugs thebs dngul rdo tshad gcig dang mkhan por mchod bsngo mtshon tsam/ ra lug bsdoms pa nyi shu skor dang nya stong phrag thal ba'i srog bslu/ mon du sbrang tshang bslu rgyur byu ru spos shel kha shas kyang song / sku gdung rin po cher nyin mtshan 'khor yug rgyun mi chad pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bshams ngos/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu dri bzang po'i chus khrus gsol zhing bzang po drug dang bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi phye mas phur zhing brlan bsher gyi skyon mi 'byung ba'i phyir lan tshas gcer zhing bzhugs pa na sku'i sha tshugs mi sdug pa med cing gzi byin lhag par che ba dang pags pa'i mdog gnag snum shel la 'ja' tshon 'khor ba lta bu'i 'od dang bkrag mdangs can kha dog gcig tu mi mtshon pa lta bu'i ngo mtshar dang ldan par snang / dpal ri nas grwa dmangs kyis mtshon gzhis byes nas gdung mjal zhu mi shin tu mang bas sku gdung rin po cher snyan shal mchod sprin gyi phyur bur spungs shing tshogs bskangs dang bdag 'jug len pa'ang bar mi chad du gyur/bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'gran gyi do zla med pas sa skyong sde dge rin po che'i phyogs su gang ba'i gnas tshul zhu 'os gzhir bcas kyang gnas kyis bskal pas 'phral du sku mdun du brtol ba'i mthu med kyang las dang smon lam dge ba'i dbang gis yum sras lcam gsum gyi snyan du brtol te sa dbang yum nyid gtsor bzhugs nang skor grwa tshogs nyung bsdus kyis nyin bzhin brgya mchod re re bshams gshegs dang bcas bla ma mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub cing mchod pa bdag 'jug len pa sogs rgyas spros dang tshogs brgya bcas nyin grangs 433

bstud ma/ sde dge rnam rgyal grwa tshang dang dgon sde gzhan la'ang rgyu 'gros kyis bla ma mchod pa dang tshogs brgya mang po bsgrub bskul/ rgya rong dgon du rgyud lugs phur pa'i sgrub mchod lo bstar tshugs rgyu'i rten du nas khal sum cu'i mal gyi sa zhing dang rig 'dzin 'phel rgyas gling du rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod rgyun 'dzugs thebs su dngul dang sa zhing bzang ba bzhag/zangs gser gyi mchod rten mda' tshad/ rje nyid kyi 'dra sku lugs ma mtho tshad/mchog sprul myur du 'byon pa dang bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen 'grub phyir skyes bu khog zhugs kyi brtag lung ltar zangs gser gyi rdor sems gru tshad gsum/ rdor sems stong sku gser thang gong gsham sgros ldan lnga/ sku ngo gsum gyis phyag bltar du sman 'jim las par sku khri khrag(phrag)gsum dang / gzhung ja 'khor drug nyer lnga yon sprad kyis dgon pa rnams nas 'bum zer/ gzhung ja bzhi bcu yon 'gros sgrol ma 'bum ther gsum/ bar skabs kun tu ma margon gyi gsol ka grangs med pa mang po bcas rgya cher bsgrubs snang / sku gdung rin po che 'di lho 'brug dang gtsang phyogs kyi bu slob rnams kyi rang rang gi phyogs su gdan 'dren gyi bsam pa mchis/ dpal ri nas grwa dmangs kyi'ang mgrin gcig pas zhu ba de bzhin dang de min gdan sa 'di khar bzhugs na las gzhan du mi bskur gsung pa sogs rang rang so sor bden mod kyi/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad ldan gyi gdung gi cha shas tsam la'ang phan yon dpag tu med pa rgyud sde mang po dang rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo sde las kyang gsungs na de nyid bcu ldan gyi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po'i gdung ril por bzhugs pa ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu dngos yin pas phyogs gang du 434

bzhugs kyang 'tshengs pa zhig ste zhal bzhugs dus nyid du brtag sgril gyis gsung ba'i don 'dir gda'/ de lta mod kyi las dang smon lam bzang po'i 'brel ba dus babs kyis dngos su mjal ba rnams dang / phyin chad du'ang dad pa dang dge ba'i rtsa ba can/ thar pa'i sa bon dang ldan pas gsol ba 'debs shing rjes su 'jug par byed pa'i gdul bya skal ba can kun la bstan par bya ba zhal chems kyi tshul du snang ba yang / sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dgra bcom pa rnams gdul bya de dag dang 'tshams pa'i lus kyi chos kyi snyigs ma'i dus su skye ba blangs te sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su sprul te 'khor bar 'khor ba rnams grol bar byed do//'di la dge sbyong ngam/ skye bo phal pa dang / blon po chen po'i rigs dang / rgyal rigs dang / sna chen po la gtogs pa'i rigs dang / bu dang bu mo yang rung / bud med 'phyon ma dang lugs sa mo dang / gang dag 'khrig pa spyod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / bshan pa dang / tshong pa dag gi gzugs su sprul nas de dag dang lhan cig tu mthun par spyod cing sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la bsngags pa brjod nas de dag gi lus sems ting nge 'dzin la sbyor bar byed kyi/ ci nas kyang rang nyid nges par byang chub sems dpa' dang / nges par dgra bcom pa yin no zhes sangs rgyas kyi gsung zab mo sgrog cing las dang po pa rnams kyi mdun du ci bder smra bar mi byed do/ /tshe 'pho ba na lkog tu tshul de kha chems kyi tshul du bsnyad par byed pa dag ni yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du rje nyid kyi phyag bris ngo ma ma mgon lcam dral gyi gtor sgam nang du 436

gsang rgyar btab ste 'jog pa gnang ba 'di lta ste//sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha chems tshig gsum bshad kyi nyon/kho bo rgyal kṛ ki'i bur gyur pa'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs la sems bskyed/ shākya thub pa'i gcung du gyur/ bod 'dir sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan gyi dus dge slong a ka ma tir gyur pa nas mkhan slob kyi dus bi ma la dang rgyal sras lha rjer bstan nas skye ba thams cad du bstan 'gro'i don byas shing byang chub kyi spyod pa la bslabs pas mthar bskal bzang 'di'i sangs rgyas rnam par rgyal ba can du 'tshang rgya ba'i lung bstan thob/ da res kyi skye ba 'dir yang 'bad pa chung ngus rang byung gi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/chos thams cad ma bslab par shes/ sems can la snying rje tshad med pa dang ldan zhing mi tshe dben pa 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar byas pas 'chi ba la 'tsher ngad cung zad kyang med/ bde ba nas bde ba ru 'gro ba la mya ngan ma byed par 'byung ba sdud pa'i tshe/da ni rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing dang pad+ma 'od la phebs pa'i dus la babs song ngo zhes rna lam du sgrogs/ gsal 'debs mi dgos/ dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo mchod 'bul dang tshogs bskang la gyis/phung po 'di skye ba bdun pa yin pas lo gcig la nya ba tshwa bsdam byas nas mchod rten gyi nang du ril por bzhag na sa bcud mi nyams pa dang / bstan rgyun la phan/ nye skor gyi skyebo blun po rnams kyis nga'i rgyud tshod ngo mi shes pas sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes par mi bgyid pa mang bas yang na gtsang por sbyongs/ bskyed rdzogs dang mi ldan pa'i sbyin sreg ma byed/ sprul pa sgyu ma lta bus 'dul ba'i skye ba mi 'ong ba'i nges pa med pas dbang chas rnams ma nyams 436

par gzhog /skye ba phar brtsad mi dgos/ ma mgon lcam dral gyi gsol gar 'bungs/ nga ni rtag tu chos nyid ngang / /nga la 'gro sdod gnyis su med/ /skye 'chir bstan pa rjes thob tsam//ye grol chen por rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes so//yang sku mdun gyi gsol cog srub du shog dril zhig la/ 'od snang mtha' yas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye ba zhes bya srid pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rgyun la rtag 'khor nas/ /nad sogs sdug bsngal bden pa'i nyer len can/ /'chi ba zhes bya don dam bden pa ste/ /sems kyi chos nyid rang bzhin med pa la/ /skye 'chi'i bar lag rnam par rtog pas bzos/ /yul lnga'i shes pa rnam mthar sgo gsum klong / /'dres 'di rang byung rdo rje'i gzhal med khang / /pad+ma 'od dang rang bzhin sprul pa ni/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i gnas mchog ste/ /rngo sa gus can dang 'brel thogs yid can kun/ /tshom bu gcig tu mngon 'tshang rgya bar shog /ces snang ba 'di dag las 'phro skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi dad gdung spro ba'i gsos su snying gi thig ler 'du 'bral med pa'i don dam gyi rang bzhin shes nas mos gus kyi dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i rten du 'tshal lo/ /sa lug gsar tshes kyi cho 'phrul dus chen dang bsnun nyin bdun gyi bar sku gdung rin po cher mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul ba dang bcas grwa grangs brgyad nas tshogs brgya dang / ma mgon gtsor gyur gyis chos srung rnams la gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i las bsgrub pa'i gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / chos kyi rje rdo je 'chang chen po de nyid bdag don chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i go 'phang mchog la bzhugs na'ang mkha' dbyings kyi zla ba la der 'jug pa'i rtog pa 437

med bzhin du chu nang du gzugs brnyan gnyis pa bde blas tu 'char ba'i nus stobs mi zad pa bzhin du thugs bskyed dang smon la ma gyi mthu phul byung gi bden 'bras mi bslu bas slar yang bdag cag gis mtshon ris med pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi mgon dang gling dang dpung gnyen mchos tu sprul pa'i sku gzhon nu'i sgyu 'phrul gsal dwangs myur ba nyid du 'byon pa'i 'phrin 'chol dang gsol 'debs kyi skabs phye nas gzungs par 'debs pa sogs kyi sta gon byas/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di nyid la gags thug bi dus mo ma 'tshol ba lta bu'i bsam sbyor 'ba' zhig pas brtag zhu sogs byed tshe thugs g.yeng gi rgyur gzigs te mi chos bla ma'i rdzun zer ba logs su gang yang med ces mi mkhyen pa'i tshul kho na lhur mdzad na'ang nges pa'i don du ni mngon par mkhyen pa la thogs pa mi mnga' bas/ ring mo'i gong nas byang chub mchod rten rgyug mtho bcu gcig pa'i shing bzo dang / chos 'khor tog bcas/ sgo khyim pa ṭa/ seng khri'i mdun la rgyal chen yul 'khor srung / phyogs gzhan gsum la nor bu 'bar ba/ 'khor lo/rdo rje rgya gram/zur bzhi'i ka ba dang / gdong chen sa 'dzin bcas kyi gra zur gyi pa ṭa rnams gser zangs 'phul ma legs pa/phra khung sa dpyad bcas tshad dang bzo dbyibs khyad par du 'phags pa sngon nas bsgrubs gnang bka' rgya'i tshul du 'jog par gnang ba ni dus gsum ma bsgrib par gzigs pa'i dbang las te/ slar yang lhu sgrigs cha byad rdzogs pa'i mchod rten dngos su rung bar bya ba la/ bzo pa mkhas min la ma ltos pa mang pos lag rub byed pa ni bzo 'bras kyi kho lag mi rdzogs shing ngang thung gi bsam par snang bas 'bri gung gi dkar bzo ba mkhas nges g.yar po zhus 438

don mi gnyis 'byor pas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i gza' skar legs pa nas bzo grwa btsugs/ zur bkag pa ṭa sogs dang ha 'dzol med ngos nas sku tshad 'phang thabs su zhing bzo la lhan thabs dang bum pa'i bzo dbyibs bskyar/ phra rgyan du sde dge sa dbang yum gyi mgul rgyan gyi byu ru spus shin tu gtsang ba bcu phrag lhag pa dang / sbyin bdag spu shud pa'i gtsug g.yu gser stegs phra ldan/ pad rag rgya sran tsam pa/ dpal sdings rje btsun mas nya lcibs dung gzugs khyad mtshar dang g.yu byur chung ngu sna tshogs/ sgom chen dam pas kha che spos shel mdangs legs dang dngul ṭa bcu/ rgyal yum nas a sgor gser kong cha spus shin tu gtsang ba/'tsho byed chu skyes kyi zhum mig 'khrul bral rnams kyi steng rje nyid la dad 'bul du byung ba'i g.yu byur spos shel sogs re zhig bar rnam dkar gyi rgyu 'bras gzhan du tshogs pa gang yod nas dngos gtsang gang yin dang /bdag gi pha ma'i rgyan chas kyi dngos 'bras che ba rnams bcas gang 'os su sbyor rgyu'i phra khung dang /zur bkag pa ṭa sogs sngon yod kyi steng / bum pa'i drwa phyed/ sked sdoms/ bum gdan pad+ma seng khri'i yul 'khor sung la 'od bskor gyi pa ṭa/ rmang dge'i pad+ma rnams mdzes cha'i dbang gis mnyen zangs la 'phul te tsha gser 'thug pa phyi byibs g.yogs kyi dngul sogs bca' ga rnams kyang rje 'di nyid ni rgyun gtan tshong so nam sogs kyi 'du 'khod dang dngos po'i gsog bskrun ci yang mi mdzad par phyag tu gang 'byor 'phral 'phral chos 'khor bsam yas sogs su rten bzhengs mchod 'bul mchod rdzas kyi bye brag sogs su sbyor ba mdzad pa kun shes de ltar yin kyang / dus 'di tsam na bdag cag gis khur bzung ba'i dngul skar ma gang 439

yang 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrub mi dgos par rje nyid la brten nas 'bad med du 'byor ba'i nor rdzas sa rdo la bya ba bzhin du bed spyad chog pa 'di bla sprul spyi'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gser gdung dngul gdung rnams thog tshad gser dngul gyi bsnyad gang thub byed pa la ltos na bdag cag la bla ma'i dkongs rdzogs kyi khral ma 'khris pa 'di gcig bu'i bka' drin kyang a la la/ bzo grwar 'dzugs ston dkar spro bcas nyin gang gzabs rgyas thog /dbu mdzad gnyis por dar/ tshan grangs/ dbu chen la dngul srang do dang / dbu chung la zho drug /de mtshungs sgang ston la'ang dkar spro sogs sngon las gzabs thog /dbu mdzad gnyis la dar mdzod btags dang dol snam spu phrugs rgya tshos legs pa gyon 'dengs bubs/ gzhan yang sbyin bdag spu shud/ dpal ri bla grwa/ grub dbang wa gan+d+ra/ gtsang dpal sdings pa sogs mchog dman bar pa'i rigs kyis zhal 'debs dang bzo ston sogs grangs mang bar byung / de dag gi dus su bzo bo gnyis kyang rtsed sna dang glu bro sogs kyi phyir las med du bshol bas ngal dub la brten ma dgos/ rgyun gtan gyi 'tsho ba'i phogs chas kyang bza bo la sri zhu'i yul du blta bas bsnyen bkur khyogs pa dang bcas las rgyun zla ba gnyis kyi khongs su byings grub/ bzhugs yul pad+ma 'od gling gi gtsang khang lte ba la thog 'phar gyi rgyab zhal 'debs su rnam snang gang chen mtsho la rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs kyis bskor ba'i log bris byas pa la/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang ba'i nyin nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i sa bzung rgyal tho 'dzugs pa sogs byas te/ nyin gsum gyi ring bzo bo dang 0

bstun nas gzungs gzhug phul/ de yang gzungs 'bul spyi'i khog ni slob dpon klu sgrub dang dze ta ri'i rgya gzhung lag tu len lugs dpyad pa gsum gyi sung la gzhal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po chos kyi rje nyid kyi gsung las ji ltar thos pa dang / gnod sbyin bang mdzod la gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo gzungs sgrub dang ldan pa garnod sbyin gyi zangs sku byin can dang bla rdo'i rigs mang po/khyad par du nad mtshon mu dge zhi ba/ tshe dpal 'byor tshogs rgyas pa/ mos bzhi dbang du bsdu ba/ byad phur gtad khram gyi nus pa 'joms pa la sogs pa'i man ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang mtshungs pa 'ga' zhig gi bca' ga yang la ga tu bstar/ bang rim nas bzung gzungs chen sde lnga dang rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam gyi snying po lhag par bla ma'i snying po dung phyur du ldang ba rnams go rim mi 'chol bar bzhugs pa'i gtso bor sku gdung rin po che longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas ldan phyag tu thugs dam rgyun gzhes kyi rdor dril bsnol ba dang bcas zangs las ched du byas pa'i za ma rtog dbyibs legs pa'i nang du bzang drug la sogs te dri zhim po'i phye mas bltams te bzhugs su gsol/srog shing la gser sbyangs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags mthar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus su dar ba'i 'dod gsol smon lam bcas bris shing dri med rnam gnyis la brten/ srog shing brtan pa'i cho ga dang bcas rgyal ba rig 'dzin gyi srog gi 'khor los bum pa'i dbyings gang ba dang /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa gser thub kyi yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/snga phyir byon pa'i gter byon gyi bde stong a rgya ril bu dang / shog ser 'khrul bral/ bsam yas kyi chos rgyal gser ga nas byung ba'i slob dpon chen po'i 4 1

dbu lo dang chos rgyal gyi na bza'/ gzhan yang rgya bod paṇa grub sel med brgyud pa'i sku bal gyi ring bsrel dang dam rdzas solas ring bsrel rnam pa bzhis phyur bur bltams/ de nas mchod sdong bi phyi zla ba zhun mas byug pa lta bur dngul dkar thur srang bdun brgya dang lnga bcu skor gyis byibs g.yogs byas pa'i steng gdung can la me tog gi ri mo sa 'dzin la sogs pa'i grwa zur rnams su gser zangs kyi pa ṭa sogs mdzes shing bkod legs par byas pa la phra tshom gyi rnam grangs ni/ be+eḍūr+ya ser po'am zhum mig 'khrul bral kham cig tsam/ nal sran ma tsam/ mu tis kham cig tsam gcig dang rgya sran tsam bzhi/drug g.yu sen gang pa/ mchongs dmar kham bu tsam/ ma na hu kham cig tsam gnyis/ sgyur shel che legs brgyad rnams la so sor yu 'dab kyis bskor ba'i tshom bu ngo grangs nyer gcig /drug g.yu'i a sgor gser long cha lnga/ dngul kong phra ldan cha bzhi/ drug gci zhe mtshungs kyi phra srungs che chung gsum gser gyi brang sgrog g.yu phra can/ gtsug g.yu gser stegs ma gsum/ dngul stegs ma bzhi/ gser dngul spel ma'i stegs can gcig drug dmar dang bar g.yu stegs yod bzhi/ su garnye rgya sran tsam gnyis/ nya lcibs gnyis/ byu ru che shos kham rlon tsam nas chung rgya sran tsam yod lnga bcu nga lnga skor/ spos shel spus legs che ba sgor mtho sang nas chung gra sor bzhi yan yod bcu gsum/ drug gci dang bar g.yu kham rlon tsam brgyad/ rgya g.yu gdong gtsang sbal gzugs dkyus sor gsum dang zheng sor do yod gcig /sgyur shel sna tshogs nyi shu rtsa bdun/ nya lcibs dung gzugs ngo mtshar ba bcas/ de ltar rin po che'i phung po gcig tu brtsegs pa la sku gdung rin po che ye shes sems dpa' dngos kyi ‘/4 2

tshul du bzhugs pa'i sgo khyim du dngul srang lnga bcu skor gyis bsgrubs pa'i rje nyid kyi 'dra sku mtho tshad lhag pa dang / mchod rdzas kyi bye brag dbu thog tu bum ldan dmar po'i bla bre dang rgya gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du bzang gos tshon sgrigs kyi phye phur/ mdun du dngul sung sum cus ting bdun tshar/ dngul sung nyi shu re yod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod kong sogs mchod sprin du ma dang bcas mthar phyin pa'i de ma thag pa'i tshes bco brgyad nas bzung dpal ldan grub pa ngag gi dbang pos rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad/ chog rogs su dpal ri nas sprul pa'i sku dpon slob bco lnga skor bcas nas snga thun dang po la dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa dang / bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang blang ba sogs/ thun gnyis pa la bgegs baspa da pa dang bzo po'i las kyi dri ma sogs bkru zhing 'phyi ba sngon du 'gro bas rten dam tshig sems dpa' la ye shes sems dpa' dgug cing rgyas gdab pa dang / de la ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid mchog tu dbang bskur zhing mchod cing bstod pa'i mthar snyan gsan gyi gsol ba btab ste sla ra yang ye shes kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod cing / nyin gnyis pa'i nang par snga ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i mthar ye shes pa nyid nam mkha' las spyan drangs pa rten la dngos kyi tshul du bzhugs pa la sogs te rab gnas kyi dbos pa tshang zhing don ma 'khrul ba bkra shis 'dod 'jo'i gzhung bzhin du cho ga 'khrugs nor meng pa nyin brgyad kyi bar dang / rla ra yang bla ma mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i thog rab gnas kyi cho ga'i ngo bo nyid kyang 4 3

tshang ba nyin lnga'i bar bcas nyin ltar mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar 'bul bshams mi chag pa khyen nyin bcu gsum song ba'i sprel zla'i tshes gcig shar ma thag pa'i nyin rgyas pa'i sreg blugs kyi thab tu rten gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la zhal bsro ba'i tshul du sreg blugs kyi mchod pas mnyes par byas nas slar yang rten gyi thugs dkar gshegs pa sogs kyi rjes thogs su bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams brjod pa na/ lha'i lam yang be+eḍūr+ya zhun ma'i kha dog lta bur shin tu dwangs pa la phra tshom gyi tshul du chu 'dzin bsgod pa dal zhing / dbyibs zlum po la sogs pa rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi tshul du khod snyoms pa das 'gul ba med par gnas shing /nyin mor byed pa yang 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba dang chabs gcig par lha rnams kyis kyang bden tshig brjod cing mchod pa'i sprin nam mkha' khyab par spros pa'i mtshan ma me tog gi char zim bur babs pas der 'dus pa rnams kyi mngon sum pa'i spyod yul du gyur pas yid la slar yang ngal bsos kyi bde ba byin te a la la zhes ngo mtshar bas phan tshun sbran par gyur to/ /de nas yon bdag stan gsar pa la gnas te gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po'i snyems pa bzung ba la bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad rnams ze re'i mgor rdo rje slob dpon gyis stong thun gyi bshad pa snyan 'jebs kyi mthar 'dus pa kun gyis mgrin gcig par shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs 'gyur khugs sbom phra 'degs 'jog bar ma rnams te yan lag gi nges pa bdun dang ldan pa rol mo bcas pas brjod cing / de bzhin du srung ma la bka' bsgo ba dang mthar yang rten la mchod pa

'bul ba sogs rab gnas kyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rgyas shing ma 'khrul ba grub pa'i mthar rdo rje slob dpon dang sprul pa'i sku la sku gsung thugs rten gyi dbus 'bul mtshon spam che ba/ chog rogs byings rnams la'ang rab yon lhag par smar ba dkar spro dang bcas dga' sto na rgyas par spel/ de mtshungs bzo bo gnyis la'ang bsnyen bkur gang khyog thog grol ston gyi dkar spro 'phar ma dang / tshar dga' dbu chen la 'go snam lo mdog gi gyon pa/ ras zom 'go snam gyi dpyang skor can/ nang mdzod dmar po'i ska rags/ mdzod ser gyi phor shubs gri chung 'byar ba/ zhwa mo brog zhwa bcas tshang ma kha gsar/dar nang mdzod bcas/ dbu chung la'ang 'go snam nam mdog gi gyon pa ska rags sogs dbu chen dang mtshungs cha 'grigs dang dar nang mdzod/ dngul dang zang ras gos sna sogs smar zong phyed khyer gyi nyin yon smar nges rnams dang / de bzhin 'go pa lag g.yog /de'i yang rogs byed tshun chod so sor gtang rag gi dngos po gang la gang 'os re dar bcas bzo bo las byed kyi bar du so sor mgu ba'i lugs su bsgrubs/ yul mi rnams la'ang rab ston du ja chang thug pa gang 'thung ngos/ rtsam bre lnga re/ de mtshungs tshes bcu ma ṇi ba bcas su'ang skal ba dang ting mchod cha'i rigs kyi sbyor 'jags/ 'phyongs rgyas zhol tshun gyi mu to ba'i rigs la'ang rab ston gong bzhin thog stong mchod kyi ro mas bkres pa bsal/ de nas dngul gdung rin po cher nyin ltar zhal zas lnga re dang dkar me nyin mtshan 'khyongs pa sdong gcig re ji srid du 'bul rtsis la lo gcig gi dkar me'i rten sbyin bdag lcags po chos mdzad nas byung /sbyin bdag spu shud nas kyi sngar rgyun mchod me sdong gcig zhal zas 445

re mi chag ngos gnas 'dzin pa mi gnyis la zla phogs len rgyu'i 'dzin yig /gdung chog gi dus zhabs tog pang len yon 'phar bcas zhal ngo spyi sger so gle nas mdzad cing / de bzhin du dngul gdung bzo gra rab gnas kyi bar so sor byung /sger gzhis phan tshun so so nas zhal 'debs spyir 'bru khal nyer lnga re snga phyir dgongs rdzogs kyi mi khal la sogs pa'i rogs dgos gong cir khur gzhes dang / dbon rtse sprul pa'i sku rin po ches dbongs rdzobs cha skyon dngul srang bco lnga/ dngul gdung rin po cher snyan shal mdzod sna lnga/ mchod me mar ltang gcig rnams dang / kong po rgod tshang rin po ches snyan shal nang mdzod rgya dngul srang bcu gnang zhing / bu chu gter gyi lha khang du stong mchod kyang bsgrubs par mdzad 'dug /theg mchog gling bla grwa so so nas dngul srang bco lnga re dang snyan shal/ dpal ri bla grwa yongs kyi gdung chog dang rab sanas sogs kyi pang len rgyas pa dang / dngul gdung rin po cher mchod sprin/ 'bru khal sum cu/ 'bri gung rin po che yab sras kyi dngul rdo tshad bzang ja 'khor drug /mar ltang gnyis/ tshan grangs bcas gnang zhing 'bri gung rang du'ang sga ra grwa tshang du ma ṇi bum sgrub bdun phrag dang thel sogs dbon khag la mang 'gyed gtsus lag rnams su ma/chod 'bul rgya chen po mdzad snang / gzhan yang mdo mkhar gnyer tshang gzhung sger gyis mtshon mchog dman bar pa'i rigs du ma nas zhal 'debs mchod 'bul/ dngul gdung la phra rgyan gyi rigs chang chung sogs dpag tu med pa byung ba rjes su yi rang ba'i sla da du 'bri bar rigs kyang yi ge'i khur gyi ma thub bo/ /phyi lo'i dus mchod snga nur tshul du sprel zla'i tshes bcu la slar yang bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i btsus 6

la ga khang phyi dang la stong mchod tshar gnyis dang / dkar khang du mar 'degs khal nyis brgya bco lnga skor bcas bzhu ste 'ag bco lnga'i mar bzhu phul/ 'di dus mar dkon dus kyi mar rin dngul srang bzhi brgya bzhi bcu skor song /gser rdo tshad dang gser btul brjes nga 'i gser chab kyis gtsug lag phyi nang gi lha tshogs kun la zhal gser legs par sgron/ nas gtsang la gser sil ma dang sman sna bsres pas jo bo rin po che'i gsol lhung la sogs pa 'geng zhing me tog tu 'thor rgyu dang snyan shal 'bor che ba bcas / bdas cag dam tshig gcig pa'i bu slob 'asas 'og khang du bde ba can gyi cho ga dang bcas mchod 'bul smon la ma rgyas pa/ bar khang du tshogs brgya bcas bsgrubs shing mchod khang spyir yang 'tshem sa med kyi snyan shal 'bul ba dang bcas rje rdo rje 'chang chen de nyid tshogs zhing rgya mtsho'i gtso bor bzhugs pa la yan la sa bdun gyi mchod pa'i sprin phung 'bul ba dang / zhal bzhes thugs dam bskul ba'i gsol 'debs gang shes bgyis/ de mtshungs sgrasas yang rdzong /zung phu lha sdings/ g.ya' ma lung / bsam yas mchims phu rnams su'ang mchod 'bul tshogs brgya grwa btsun la yang 'gyed bcas snga ma dang phyogs 'dra bsgrubs/ sku gdung rin po cher khrus dang sman sna tshogs kyi dril phyis yang yang byas pa'i khrus khu sa bzang la brlan pa dang sman sna bcas la sku 'dra bzhengs pa'i lha bzo ba mkhas su re ba zhig 'ong du re yang yun du ma lon pa na/ rje nyid kyi phrin las kyis bkug pa'i ched du bsgos pa ma yin pa'i lha bzo ba gnyis byung bas rdor sems kyi sku mi tshad phra rgyan g.yu byur sogs mang bas brgyan pa dang / rje nyid kyi sku 'dra sku tshad tsam pa gser byibs byugs bcas 7

bzhengs pa bzo bo mkhas pa'i grags pa can gyis snyems pa med bzhin du ye shes pa rang bzhin du bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyis mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i bzo sgros su byon pas kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/de dag la'ang chos li las grub pa'i gu ru'i sku tshab byin can dang rje nyid kyi dbu skra phon che/bsnyen phur/ na bza' sku dregs can lhu tshang / sangs rgyas gser thub kyi 'phel gdung sogs ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi'i gzungs gzhus legs par phul ba dang /dngul srang lnga bcu lhag bcas kyis bsgrubs pa'i rje nyid kyi 'dra thang 'khrungs rabs kyis bskor ba/sgyu 'phrul zhi ba/khro bo/pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang /bde chen pad+mo brtsegs pa'i zhing bkod sogs kyi thang ka song gsham dang bcas thog tshad grwa mtshungs lnga/ gsung rten bzheng rogs 'brug tu bskul ba bzhin slob dpon 'jigs med pas bden rnam shing rta gnyis po ma gtogs gsung 'bum cha tshang pod chen drug la dbu shog dang gnyis rnams gser bris glegs shing sgril tshas bcas gsar bzhengs 'phral mar mdzad pa rnams la'ang rab gnas dngos sta nyin gnyis ma rgyas par bsgrubs/ slob dngo na 'jigs med pas dgongs rdzogs kyi rkyen du dngul rdo tshad gcig /dngul gdung rin po cher smon tshig dang bcas pa'i nang mdzod dkar dmar 'bul rgyu dang /'brug rang du'ang badz+ra gu ru dung phyur sogs kyi dgongs rdzogs bla na med pa mdzad snang / mi ring bar zla ba bdun pa'i nang sa skyong sde dase nas rnying rgyud par bzhengs mthar chags su grub pa'i par phud pod chen nyi shu rtsa lnga/dkar chag mkhyen rab kyi lang tsho rmad du byung bas bskrun pa pod bcas cha tshang tshar gnyis dgongs rdzogs bsgrub rten dngul srang brgya dang gser rdo 48

tshad gnyis sogs gnang rten spam mtho ba dang bcas pa'i mi sna ched kyis 'byor pa bzhin du dngul gdung rin po cher stong mchod bshams thog grwa slob brgyad grwa zhig gis mchod 'bul tshogs bskangs/ srong btsan bam sor yang stong mchod tshogs bskangs bcas dmigs gsal du bsgrubs/ rang lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon pa 'og mar 'phel rgyas gling gi slob dpon pa dge rtse bla mas kyang dngul srang bdun dang snyan shal bcas byung / mi sna phyir log gi gdong du de ga'i dgon par bka' che ma sa kyi dgongs don ltar dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i thang chen thog tshad ma la tshar dgu dang / mang ja'i thebs dngul sung sum cu/ klong thang sgrol ma'i gtsug lag khang la snyan shal dang mchod dod dngul srang bcu gnyis rnams sde dge nas gnang rogs zhu rgyur phul ba dang / rnying rgyud mtshal par cha gcig de rgya gar gdung bsam kha ri bo dpal 'bar gling du sku gsung thugs rten gzhan dang bcas rten skal du phul/lhag par sa skyong sde dge nas dgongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen spam che ba dang slob dpon 'jigs med pas de bzhin dang bcas 'di ga'i bla brang gi yod dgu'i steng nas dpal gyi bsam yas dkar rur khyu bsnon lta bu zhig bsgrub par sprudod kyang legs par brtags tshe snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus dbangabis dge rtsar dngos po 'ga' dang 'ga' ni sdig pa'i rtsa bar yang mi 'gyur ba'i cha ma mchis shing mthong chos su'ang gnas pas rgyu 'bras gnyis ka gcig tu dkar bas sems can la sman par ma gyur na skyes bu chen po rnams kyi mdzad dbongs ni gzhan la phan pa kho na yin pas dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs su'ang e 'gyur mi shes snyam de'i spros pa bskyungs nas/ slar chos 4 9

'khor chen ngo nyid du stong mchod bcig dang mar bzhu 'as bco lnga bcas bsgrubs shing / phyin chad nas kyang rdo rje 'chang chen ngo de nyid kyi dbongs bzhed yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir du mchod pa'i rgyun rang re'i las si bstar nas ci 'grub 'bul ba dang / dngul sadung rin po cher nar ma 'i mchod 'bul dang zla re'i dus dran ma chod pa mi chas pa bcas bdag cag rjes su 'jug pa dag bi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yi dam 'cha' ba ni rdo la ri mor bachos pa bzhin du snying la brnalas pa la bri gang med do/ /de tsam yang rje bla ma nyid rang si rang bzhin gyi phrin las kyi babs la gzhis na ma dzad pa/ tha ma ma ngon du gyur nas rjes 'jug nas bsgrub par 'os pa'i bya ba rgya chen ngo grub pa 'ig ni ma yin te/ spyir dus kyi snyigs ma dang / sgo sa su tha ma 'i bka' chems kyi lung bstan yang ma ngon du gyur te sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes par mi bgyid pa'i skye bo bas ma sbyor tha dad pa'i tshosas dang yang gnas skabs kyis bgro bar bya dgos pa zhig pas bdag cag bya bral ba kun tu rgyu dag gi phrag pas bzung bas de tsam zhig rgo/ /mdor na chos kyi rje chen po 'di nyid mngon pa ra 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i dus nas tha ma ma dzad pa brtul ba'i dasongs rdzogs kyi dus tshun gyi rnam dasar gyi bya ba ji snyed pa de kun kyang dos dang rta 'ul la sogs pas sems can gzhan gyi khur du 'gro ba dang / tshod 'bun bskyed/ sems can srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdis dang cung zad tsam yang ma 'dres par las dang 'bras bu gnyis ka gcig tu dkar ba 'ba' zhig yin no/ /'on te go sa mthon po'i che 'gyings mnga' thang la spyod pa sogs gzhan gyi lad mo ma pher ba'ang min te/ rje bla ma 'di nyid 'jis 450

rten cho rigs kyis skyon dang rma med pa'i yab dang yum gyi lhums las srid pa'i sgyu 'phrul gzhon nu mngon pa bskyed bsring ba'i dus nas byis pa so so skye bo phal las rnam par 'das pa'i yo na tan gyi tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas te mkhas shing grub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa mi zad pa kho na'i rang stobs kyis rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i nor bu dbang bi rgyal po ltar gyur pas bod dbus 0tsang nas mdo smad khams kyi yul gru tshun gyi chen po kun gyis gtsug gi nor bu lta bur bkur ba ste sangs can bod khams skyo nga ba song sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos kyang ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes kyi tshul du tshur rjed pa ra mdzad pa'i bka' shog rgya ma rnams su'ang chabs yig gi bzos sgo chen po dang bcas te mkhas shing grub pa'i nges brjod can du phebs 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung rabs dri ma med pa nu tig i 'phreng ba rim byon dpal ldan sa skya chen po bdas chen ngag bi dbang po yab sras kyi'ang rtsa ba'i bla mar bkur ba'i phu dud chen po mdzad/ mdo smad khams kyi rgyal kham sa ma lus pa ra dbang bsgyur ba'i sa'i tshangs pa chen po sde dbe yab yu ma sras bcas kun gyi'ang ches khyad par 'pha gas pa'i rigs kyi bdag po chen por bkur zhing tshad med pa'i dad gus kyis zhabs nas 'degs par mdzad/mtha' dbus kyi dpon dang sa rong rtsub por gnas pa'i skye bo dbang bed kyi dpung pa btsan po ji snyed pa dag bi'ang grus pas btud cing / skyabs kyi mchos tu bzung ba yin na srid pa'i 'byor stobs bsgrub pa la tshegs sang yang med mo da de/ de la snying ngo ra gyur pa 'ga' yang med pas bzhugs gnas kyang bas ma tha'i ri khrod chung ngu 'di tsam las snyigs ma'i dus kyi sde dbon /du

yang chos brgyad dang chags snang nyag gcig 'phel ba las gzhan du 'bras bu ches che bas dbul bar gzigs te/ de dag 'du 'khod ma mdzad cing rjes su 'brang ba'i slob bu'i tshogs la'ang chos la tshul bzhin du spyod cig pa nyid bka' chems kyi don por phebs snang bas de las 'da' bar ma nus te bla ma'i bzhugs gnas stong pa tsam yang gces spras kyis 'dzin pa'i bya ba'ang gzhan dbang gi khur dang 'grogs pa 'di ltar gyur/ de yang slob ma blun pos bla ma zog por btang ba'i lo rgyus bzhin blun dad rmongs zhen gyi gtam 'grel med pa'ang ma yin te/ngo bo'i gnas tshul srong por med pa la rgyu mtshan dbos ched yod pa yin no//'dir smras pa/ e ma chos kyi rgyal po chen po de'i/ /rnam dkar phrin las rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ni/ /dus gsum mthar yang ches cher rab g.yos pas/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan can de dogs pas skrag /pha wang chu mtshor lhung yang rdo ba'i ngogs/ /rang drin dran pa sngon byung gtam tsam min/ /'dren mchog mtshungs med dbyings su gzims nas kyang //'ga' zhig rang gi tshul la yu sa te brgyal//chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i shes ldan ni/ /rang gi khro ba 'dul zhing de la gzo/ /'jig rten mun thor gyur pa'i sanas skabs kyang //'ga' la lkog tu gyur pas rang nyid skyo/ /mgon gyi bka' drin 'jal ba'i skabs med kyang / /snying gi ri mo bsrubs bya ma yin pas/ /rang blo lkog gyur chom pos btab bzhin du/ /brag cha'i sgra brnyan 'phongs par bzung ba min//mkha' lding rang gi ngo bo'i sgyu rtsal gyis/ /gnam 'phangs gcod la ltos pa ma mchis kyang / /srin bus lam gyi sgron me btegs pa bzhin/ /rnam dkar rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs yol ba med/ /e ma 45 2

rin chen chos kyi rgyal po gdod ma'i gzim khri shin tu rnam dag nam mkha'i dbyings su gzims pa'i mngon rtogs nyer bstan yang / /'gro la yid bzhin dgos dgu 'byung ba'i rin chen sku ni rtag pa'i chos su nye bar lhun grub ji srid nam mkha'i gnas nyid kyi/ /brtan pa de srid g.yo ba med par 'dod 'byung mchog tu rin chen gaṅga'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i mchod sdong chen por lhun gyis grub/ /'gro 'di'i bsod nams shin tu rmad byung rdzing bur yang ni sprul bsgyur rol pa gsar du tshes snyam yid la deng 'dir ngal bsos byin//de ltar gong du brjod pa de dag ni tshu rol mthong ba'i yid can gyi gdul bya spyi tsam pa'i snang ngor drang don gyi mdzad pa tshul bstan tsam du zad kyi/'di ltar skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang 'chi ba ste srid pa'i chu bo chen po bzhis nyam nyes su 'gyur ba'i tshor ba'i sdug bsngal dag las rnam par grol zhing pha rol tu ba la ba ni 'phags chen kho na'i khyad par rmad du byung ba yin pas bdag cag gi rje btsun mnyam med po 'dis kyang gang gi zhal gsung rnam thar yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe seng ge'i nga ro bzhin du bsgrags pa ni/ rang sems rnam thar sgo gsum dang sogs tshigs su bcad pa snga phyi rnams te/de la mthar thug gi grol sa dbyings dang ye shes sam ka dag dang lhun grub gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje gsang ba lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bo la rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur ba'am mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i ston pa kun tu bzang po ye shes lhun grub kyi ma gon po rdo rje 'chang zhes bya bar gyur pa'i go 'phang brnyes par mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i tshul bzhin zhal gyis 'ches te ngo bo'i che ba bstan par go bar bya ste/ de yang rig 453

pa rang shar chen po'i rgyud las / rtogs pa'i skyes bu blo rtsal can/ /mi 'gyur mnyam nyid ngang du thim/ /rtos med shes rab rang shar ro /bde byed brtsegs pa'i sa chen der/ /ma bkod nor bu'i phung po ltar /sna tshosas 'byung zhing ngang du jim/ /sa ngas rgyas kun gyi mes ngo mi 'od ri 'gyur bar kun tu grags / zhes so / /de bsan zag bcas du nga ngo 'i 'brel thab chad pa tsam la mya ngan las 'das so zhes bya ba'i tshig bla dgas tsam btags pa min par lam bden mtha' dag bi thob bya'i 'bras bu ma ngon du gyur cing 'bos bden ma lus mthar phyin pa 'i rang gzugs rnam kun ma chog ldan gyi chos kyi sku chen ngo 'am das pa gnyis ldan gyis sangs rgyas te dbyings dang ye shes sanyis su med pa'i chos sku 'i mthar thug pa ga das lhun grub sanyis su med pa 'i grol sa chen ngo ra dbongs pa bla na med par rdzogs pa'i ma thar thug pa nyid do/ /de yang kun tu bzang ngo thugs kyi me 'o nga las/ rin po che rnam par bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni ma bris par bkra/ ye shes brtan pa'i ri rgyal ni ma brtsibs pa ra dpangs mtho/ ye shes gdal ba'i pho brang ni ma byas par rgya che/ ye shes klong yangs kyi rgya mtsho ni ma rnyos par rang dwangs ye shes gsal ba'i nyi ma ni ma byas par 'char nub med/ stong nyid gdal ba'i thang ni ma bkod pa cha rnyo ma sa/ ye shes 'gyur med kyi la ma ni ma sbyangs par nye ring med/ rig pa 'gyur med kyi rta ni rgyusas kyang chad pa med/ rig pa dmigs med kyi chu rgyun la rgyun chad med/ ris pa ye shes kyi sa bon la 'phel 'grib med/ rig pa stong gsal gyi ye shes ni dbyer mi phyed/ rig pa 'dzin med kyi ye shes ni ngos bzung gi mtha' dang bral / rig pa rtogs med kyi ye shes ni ma 'gags la tsho 54
