yongs su gsal/ ris pa kun sgosal gyi ye shes ni ma 'dres la yongs su rdzosas/ris pa kun snang gi ye shes ni gas la la 'dzin pa med/ /rig pa kun gsal gyi ye shes ni gas la la lhun stug ces gsu ngas pas de lta bu'i don dam pa'i sku'am grol sa'i gzhal med khang chen po la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i sku ye shes kyi snying po can nyu na grub rin po che'i spubs khang pa lta bu la sa sku gsum gyi lam snang phyir mched pa'i gzugs sku phrin la sa dang bcas pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ni gdul bya'i smon lam dang 'brel ba'i dbang sis ji srid bdul bya yongs su ma rdzobs pa de srid du 'char ba ste/ 'jug pa las/ zhi sku dpas bsam shing lta ra gas la gyur la / /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog 'gro grol bar du 'jis rten 'byor slad rtag /'di ni spros dang bral la snang ba yin/ /zhes so / /de'i phyir rang cag tshur mthong can rnams kyi snang ngor mya ngan las 'das so zhes mngon gsum gyi spyod yu la du snang ba nub pa ltar gyur mod kyang / rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang das nga la gzugs su mthong / /gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log par spyod la zhugs pa ste/ /skye bo des ni nga mi mthong / /'dren pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku/ /chos nyid shes bya ma yin te/ /de ni shes par nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin ma ris pa 'thibs pos non pa'i log shes kyi snang ba las / don dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du sku gsum gyi rang snang rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi bdag nyid du 'char ba la 'gag pa med cing /rang snang de'i cha las gdul bya'i snang ngor longs sprul gyi sku dang mdzad pa phrin las ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'char ba chos nyid kyi bden pa 43 5

nam yang bslu ba med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir sku dngos su bzhugs pa dang ma bzhugs pa la thugs rje la bri gang dang / byin rlabs la 'phel 'grib ma chod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'bras bu la che chung med pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag par rig pa'i nges pa rnyed pas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen re sa gzhan du mi 'tshol bar kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur ba'i ngo bor rigs kyi bdag por 'bral ba med par mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa yin te/ khyad par rje nyid kyi zhal gsung rnam thar gsol 'debs las/ mnyam rjes kun tu chags sdang re dogs kyi/ /khyod sems 'khrugs pa ma yin dbang po la/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon bzhugs pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /'gro don 'khor ba dong sprugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /da dung sems can khams ni ma rdzogs par/ /gzhan don 'byung ba byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ /khyad chos bslu ba med pa yin pa'i phyir/ /gdul byar ma gyur sems can yod min kyang / /slob mar gyur nas dam tshig dag pa dang / /bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas thugs yid 'dres pa rnams/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rten 'brel 'grig /ces dang 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs las/ 'di 'og ye shes rdo rje'i rol pa yi/ /rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs blang nas slar/ /gshe zhing skur pa 'debs pa rnams kyi don/ /sprul pa sna tshogs ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di dag 'gyur med nges pa'i zhal 'ches bla na med pa yin pas ring mo nyid nas legs byas kyi bgo skal la spyod pa'i ska la ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag rin po che lta bu rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du shes par 'tshal lo/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos sku'i mkha' 56

dbyings brdal ba'i klong //ma bcos rtsol bral lhun grub rol pa thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /rnam mang sku yi bkod pa'i char rgyun bdul bya'i zhing la brtag 'bab pa//rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin yol ba med pa rgyal ba'i phrin las 'di rmad byung / /mtha' yas chos tshul rin chen kun kyang 'gro la phan bde'i rgyan gyur kyang / /ma byas rang byung sku gsum 'bras bu rgyu rkyen zhen pas ma sgrib par/ /mngon gsum thob pa'i gsang chen bstan mchog kun bzang dbongs pa'i thig le che//yid bzhin nor bur gang gyur de yang snyigs ma'i 'dam rdzab stug pos g.yogs/ /de lta mod kyang khyod kyi blo dang shes rab snying rje smon lam thabs/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos 'khor legs bshad nyal 'gro'i klung chen brdol ba yis/ lta ngan rdul gyi ljan ldin 'jig dang lhan cig zab don nor bu'i khams/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i byi dor 'grub pas skal ldan yid la ngal bso sbyin/ /da lta rtsod ldan lnga bdor dran pa brdzun/ /bden na 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi/ /bstan dang ston par bcas pas 'os min gyi/ /nges par rdzogs pa'i skal bzang 'di ce zhig /'on kyang nyi zla'i 'od kyis smag rum mun/ /sel ba'i kun rdzob bden par bston med kyang / /byang bstan phug par 'od snang mi 'jug pa/ /rten 'brel ngan pas sgrib par ci bya yod/ /gang zhig bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa rnams/ /lta ci mthong thos dran reg 'brel pas kyang / /thar ba'i sa bon 'jog pa'i gsang gsum gyi/ /mdzad pa'i mtha' ni bsam brjod yul las 'das/ /de lta na yang gaṅgā'i klung chen las/ /drongs pa'i chu rgyun phra mos zhing sa yi/ /ngal ba don ldan byed bzhin skal ldan gyi/ /yid sasos bskul ba'i rtogs brjod gtam du bas/ /zer gdangs 'od lnga'i sgyu 'phrul bkrag po 457

che/ /don dam dbyings kyi ma na thel dri med klong /phyogs gcig nye bar bsdus pa 'i ya mtshan gyi/ /bkod pa'i grags dasar srid gsum khongs la sa bskul /gang la sgrib sbyo ngas khur du ma bkod kyang / /bdas gzhan tshosas chen gso sa pa'i thabs ma khas 'phrul/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchod la sa lhas med phyir/ /sgo gsu ma brtson pa'i la sa la ma dkar pos bsgrubs/ /de tshul cha shas drang por brjod pa'i ngag /ngag 'khyal ma yin don ldan satam gyi tshul/ /tshul bzhin sbya ra la lus ngas yid gsu ma gyi/ /gyi na'i ngang tshul btang te brtson pa ra byas / de las thob pa'i rnam dkar dbe ba'i tshogs/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i lhun po ti si'i ri/ /lesas byas gangs ri'i bla na 'phags pa las/ /don gnyis klung bzhi'i rgyun bzang rtas 'bab thog /khyad par dwang byudwa 'od gas la dz+wa de'i dbyings/ /kun tu bzang po'i sprul par zlos pa'i gar/ /khyab bdas bla mas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /'bral med thugs kyi thib le rjes 'dzin shos /ces bdag cag gi rje btsun dam pa nges par don gyi rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa 'gran zla dang bral ba'i chos kyi rje bka' drin 'khor med chen po 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i mjug 'thud kyi rim pa bu chen gyi skyes bu dam 2/ rnams nas tshig sbyor lung rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa zhig brtsam par bskul 'dod kyis sku gshegs gdong dang / sku gdung rin po che'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa zad mi shes pa dag las cha shas tsam pa rang blos ji ltar dpogs pa dang rjes su 'jug pa'i dgongs rdzogs rnam dkar gyi rim pa ci nus bgyis pa'i zin thun rags pa tsam zhig yo da thog mdo khams sde 458

dge'i rgyal khab kyi sa'i tshangs pa chen po nas rnam thar yongs rdzobs par du 'khod pa'i dgongs bzhed bzang po bla na ma mchis pa dang bcas pa sa 'di lta bu zhig khyod kyi 'bri bar 'os so zhes pa'i bka' lung stsal ba'i khur lci ba dang lho pon ljongs kyi bstan pa'i ba dan sgreng ba po slob dpon 'jigs med pas kyang de bzhin gyi sasung nan che bas slar yang rgyas par gtan la phab ste rnam par thar pa'i gtam rin po che'i phreng ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa po ni rje bla ma mchos gi bka' drin gsum gyis nye bar bskyangs shing bka'i 'bangs kyi tha shal tsam du gyur pa rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi dkyil 'khor zab mor zhugs pa'i rigs kyi brda rtags pad+ma dbang chen rol pa rtsal lam ming gzhan 'od zer phrin las zhes 'bod pa'i rmongs pa byu su kus bgyis pa 'dis kyang tshe rabs kun tu ces don snying po'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang mjal te gdams pa tshul bzhin bsgrub pas mi ring bar kun tu bzang po 'od snang mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor 'gro ba kun gyi ded dpon mchog tu mngon par rdzogs pa ra 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur gyur cig/'dir smras pa/ e dbyings rang byung stong pa'i ye shes kun tu bzang mo shes rab ma/ /waṃ yig bde chen thabs mchog rdo rje 'jigs med kun bzang dpa' bo dang //rjes chags chos nyid gling bu'i sgras bskul dgyes rol phyag rgya sgyu dra'i gar/ /yo ngas bzhengs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso mchog khyab bdag bla ma dam par 'dud/ /gang thugs dgongs pa'i klong brdol thogs med rdo rje'i gnas kun mkhyen/ /rtsa khams yi ge'i tshosas smin gang gsung rdo rje'i rol mor 'khrol//gsang gter brda las sde sasum klong dgu rdo rje'i don zab ston//459

pad ma'i zhal skyin dbang chen rol pa'i rdo rje mkhyen brtse lha'i/ /gsang ba gsum las 'phros pa'i yon tan sgro/ /bsdu dngos bzhi dang snyin drug phrin las lnga/ /'khoralo gsum gyi mdzad pa'i rnam pa ni/ /thar chags brjod mtha' yi ge'i lam du min/ /'on tang rigs can thar 'dod gdul bya'i tshogs/ /bcos min dad pa'i them skas la 'dzegs te/ /thar pa dam pa'i khang bzang rtser bon nas/ /rnam mkhyen mgon de mjal phyir nyung ngur tsam/ /spel 'di sde ris dge bcus skyong ba'i khab//tshe ring gnam bskos sa dbang lha'i dpal mo//sras lcam rnam gsum thugs bskyed dge stobs kyis/ /chos sbyin mi zad 'phel phyir par du bsgrubs/ /der byung legs byas bsod nams skya rengs mas/ /ris med rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi gzhon khams/ /nyer drangs phan bde'i 'od zer 'bum spros pas/ /skye dgu'i bde skyid pad tshal rtag rgyas shog /khyad par 'jigs bral rnam rgyal khang bzang dbus/ /sku tshe mi shigs 'tsho gzhes sum rtsen dbang / /stobs rtsal thogs med rdo rje'i mthen non pos/ /mi mthun rigs bcom dge mtshan 'dzin gyur cig/'jig rten khams su su zhig gnas de srid/ /srid zhi'i dpal yon yon tan ma lus kun/ /kun nas ma 'bad 'bad med lhun gyis grub/grub gnyis dpal ston ston pa'ang mang mthong shog/'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba ji snyed kun//kun zlum thig le chen po'i klong du bsngo//bsngo ba de yis mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun//kun mkhyen bla ma'i dgongs don rtogs gyur cig /ces kun mkhyen bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar skor tsho gsum pa skye 'phreng rim par brgyud pa'i yongs 'dzin rnams dbu lhar bkod de rgyal 460

khab chen po lhun grub steng gi par khang chen mo bkra shis sgo mangs su par du bsgrub skabs par byang nyung zad 'di yang bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal ba rmongs /sna /na /sgo gā 'a//pa med blo gsal 'od zer gyis smras pa dge legs 'phel/

rdzogs chen pa rang byung rdo rje'i don kyi zam thar do ha'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs/༄gyi/ /sangs rgyas satso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa yi/ /chos nyid mngon du ma byas pa ra /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog rjes son pa'i/ /'khor ba'i rnam thar brjod mi lang / /kun gzhi lung ma bstan gyi kham sa / /dmisas pa dang ni mtshungs ldan gyis / /zas pa bskyed cing 'phel byas pa / rnam par shes pa'i tshogs dag dang / /kham sa dang skye ma ched 'dus byas la/ 'jig rten srid pa'i 'khor 'o ra grasas / /de la sa da res 'dod pa 'i khams/ /nga yar 'dzin pa'i sanas skabs kyi/ /yul ni shrī par+sha ta/ /rus ni chos rje rgya ya gas pa/ /ma nga' ris can du ma skyes pas/ /gzhan 'byor tshang ba'i shegs ma byas /rnam ris gtsang ba'i bur skyes pa sa/ /rang 'byor yan la sa kyang ma nyam/sa / bya ros dkrosas min bzhin nu la / /sdo ma pa skye ba ma yin kyang / drus pa 'i lo nas grwa khyur zhugs/ /chos spyod bslab pa'i brdung 'thag dang / /'bad rtsol chung ba'i thos bsam sgo ma/ /rgyu 'bras 'asal ba can du shar/ /bco lnga'i 'o la rab byung yang / rtsa ba bzhi tsam ma lags pa 'i/ /blang 'das shes pa'ang yo da min na/ /khrims kyi bslab pa sa la chags/ /lebs smon 'ba' zhis don sanyer la/ /nyes spyod sdo ma pa yin snyam nas/ /dkor la rang dasar spyod pa yi / /btsun bzusas rnam thar spyi ma thun bskyangs/ /de lta na yang skyo yas dang / /nges 'byung snyi nga rje chen ngo 'i blo/ /shugs 'byung dran tsam nyid nas yo da spyod pa bya 3 2

bral das la smon/ /ltar sna nga rig pa hur spyod can/ byis pa'i rnam thar bskyangs che yang / /byi la 'i brtul zhusas ngan pa yi /rnam thar khong na yo da mi srid/ /lus sems gnyis la nar son tshe/ /mi byed bsam sa kyang gzhan rkyen dang / /mthun par 'char ba'i grwa tshogs kyi /chasas snang gnas la skyo ba skyes/ /gcig du ra bsdad tshe dam/ chos dran/ /o rgyan gyi slo ba dpon chen ngo yi/ /rnam thar dang rten gsu ma/ la brten nas / /sa tshugs med pa 'i dad stobs 'bar/ /dus da lta zangs mdog dpal gyi rir/ sleb na snya ma pa 'i gdung ba 'phel de tshe bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs / rngon pas ri dwasas 'ded pa dang / /'brog pas lug khyu bda' ba dang / /khrims kyis 'jigs pas mnar ba gsu ma /mthong na lta ci thos na ya nga / /bzod blag med pa'i snying rje skyes/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa'i tshe/ 'du 'ji'i nyes dmigs 'ba' zhig dran/ /phyogs med du chos la bros na snyam/ /gcig pur 'u nga sto nga 'grims na snyam/ /rang yu la la zhen pa sacod 'dod blo/ /rgyun chad med pa yid la shar/ /snang ba dgra ru mi sdang bas/ /bla ma'i ming du chasas pa dang / /sgom chen bya ba zhung ba dang / /zhi dul bsam pa dge ba yi/ /chos dang gang zag thams cad la/ /rtog dpyod med pa'i rim gro bskyed/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi//dri mas gos pa ma lags kyang //khyim dang bsam sbyor tha dad cing / /skyo shas nges 'byung tshad med pas/ /shes rgyud so so thar pa dang / /cha mthun 'byor pa'i gnas ska bas der/ /sngags sdom gzugs brnyan tsam dang bcas/ /shrī pa r+sha ta dang ni/ /dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu ru/ /lo bdun bskyed rdzogs rtse gcig sgo ma/ /kun nas nyon mongs dbang po lnga'i/ /nyer len rnam byang rgyur gyur pas/ /shes pa nyams 'ur bas 463

phebs shing / /stong nying snying rje song nas gong / /'phel bas chags sdang re dogs kyi//rnam rtog rang grol lam du lhongs//rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang //rdo rje lam gyi nye rgyu las/ /rnam byang yon tan kun gyi mdzod/ /sku gdung 'bar ba mkha' 'gro'i brda/ /so so yang dag rig pa'i gter/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i lung gis phye/ /rtsa khams yi ge'i 'khor lo'i sprin/ /dam pa chos kyi rol mo ru/ /'khrol la sanas gsum mkha' 'gro dang / /kun tu thogs med spyan ldan gyis/ /dpang gyur mngon sum tshad ma'i phyir/ /rtog ge'i gnas la 'jigs pa dang / /bor ma'i ser ka 'dru ba dang / /chos bdag rkyen la re ba dang / /rten 'brel rdzas la 'chol pa yi/ /spang blang dgas bsgrub dbyings su sangs/ /bdag cag sa lam mthon po ru/ /son pa'i khas len mi 'grub kyang / /mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag nas/ /chos gter chen po brgyad gsungs pa'i/ /don la rton pa gang zhig ni/ /las dang dngos grub bsgrub pa la/ /bslu ba med pa'i khyad chos yin/ /khyad par sngon gyi smon la ma mthus/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i man ngag la/ /brten nas sems kyi gnas lugs shes/ /mchims phu'i dge'u 'og ma ru/ /dngos zhal mjal nas bden pa mthong / /grub mtha' rgya mtsho smos ci dgos/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad grangs nges dang / /skyes bu gsum gyi skyabs 'gro yan/ /'di la brten nas shes pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba bden par smra ba des/ /gang las chos ni rnam shes pas/ /de la gus pas phyag bya ste/ /bram ze gtsang mas me la bzhin//zhes pa'i don la rab sbyar bas/ /bstan pa kun gyi de nyid dang / /rdzogs pa chen po'i khyad chos rtogs/ /dngos nyams mi lam thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lung bstan thob/ /chos dang gzugs brnyan mi phyed cing / /blo gros 464

bdud sdes bcom pa dag /dbe spyod go'u ta ma ni/ /mu stegs can gyi dka' thub las/ /nyams pa'i sdig to can no zhes/ /'khu zhing gshung ba'i rnam thar bskyang / /e ma ma la snying re rje/ /sngon tshe 'od srungs rgyal ba las sems kyi dam pa thob pa nas/ /bde gshegs snying po'i mthong sgom gyi/ /sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i rgyal ba can/ /byang chub shing drung gshegs kyi bar/ /rgyal sras spyod pa mi nyams shing / /so so'i skye bo'i gzhan dbang la/ /ltos pa med pa'i mngon rtogs kyis/ /rang byung rdo rjer lhun gyis grub/ /de lta na yang blo gros ni/ /shin tu gzu bor gyur pa'i phyir/ /chos dang chos kyi gang zag sga/ /gzugs brnyan tsam la'ang mi bskur na/ /'brel ba can la smos ci dgos/ /rgya bod kun na dbang rnon gyi/ /gang zag chos kyi rjes 'brang ba'i/ /mtshan nyid rmongs pas ga la rig /srid rtse'i sems dang brjod med bdag /rnam 'byed shes rab kyi ldog pas/ /dpa' bo'i zhabs dang phyogs glang sogs/ /bstan pa'i nyin byed chen po ru/ /gyur pa'ang rgyal ba'i phrin las yin/ /bstan pa kun la dad gyur kyang //byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ni/ /sngags kyi gzhi ma ltar mthong nas/ /jo bo shākya mu de'i drung / /byang sdom zhu bar ched kyis phyin/ /rigs las sad pa'i smon 'jug blangs/ /snga 'gyur rang lugs nyams dmas par/ /mthong nas rgyud 'bum glegs bam bzhengs/ /lung mnyan chos 'byung dkar chag brtsams/ /log rtogs bsal ba'i thal 'gyur bkod/ /dpe lung gnyis na'i rgyun 'phel ba'i/ /rten 'brel mngon sum gnas la sbyar/ /mdo sgyu sems dang snying tig bzhi'i/ /don la mi rton gya tshom gyis/ /sngags gzhung rnyog mar gyur pa la/ /mkhas pa gzhan gyis gshung ba'i tshe/ /smin grol cho ga ma 'khrugs shing / /rgyud 465

dang man ngas snu 'gal la / /sbyang gzhi sbyo nga byed sand tshang bas/ /sku lnga'i 'bras bu 'byin nus pa/ /sang dag rnams dang bka' ma'i gzhung / /sangs rgyas mnyam/ sbyor yang phur dang / /dong sprugs bka' brgyad sashin rje so gas /nyan nas bshad sgrub ci nus bgyis/ /slob dpon shrī sernya yi/ /byin rlabs dbang gi nye brgyud la/ /brten nas phur ba brgyud lugs kyi/ /bka' yi bsdu ba gsar du byas/ /sangs ri'i khrod kyi ring lugs pa/ /ci yang rung ste sangs rgyas pa'i/ /grub mtha' 'dzin pa yin phyin chad/ /de yi bstan pa mdo sngags kyi/ /sde snod legs par shes dgos na/ /rgyal ba'i gsung dang dkon cos 'grel / /ming rta gsum dang mdzod bdun gyi/ /rjes su 'brangs la bka' bstan gyi/ /lu nga sasar mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /yon tan rin po che yi mdzod/ /'grel pa bden rnams shing rta gnyis/ /gsar du brtsams nas rang sde yi/ /grub mtha'i gzhung lam gsal bar byas/ /dam chos mngon pa'i sde snod kyi/ /rnam shes khams rnams legs phyed pas/ /skye 'gag stong par sgo ma pa'i lugs/ /dor nas 'phags lam rdzogs chen gyi/ /ye shes sgom stobs kyis thob la / /don dam byang chub sems su grags/ /kun rdzob smon 'jus rnam gnyis ni/ /bskyed la sa skyes pa gtso che ba'i/ /bslab bya gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ /phyugs lu ga brgya phrag gnyis tsam dang / /srog chags phra mo grangs med la/ /'jungs pa med pa'i srog sbyin byas/ /dad gshin rdzas rnams log 'tsho ru/ /sbyar nas gzi byin ma bsgrubs par/ /sde snod bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang / /pad+ma 'od kyi gling bskrun cing / /bdag sbyar sgom grwa 'dzugs pa dang / /stong dngul thal ba'i rgyu tshogs las/ /dkon mchog rten gsum bzhengs pa dang / /mes dbon gnas 66

la khri mchod dang / /bka' 'gyur yon gyis bsru sgrogs sogs / /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la bslabs/ /rtsa rlung khams gsum las rung nas /rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba dang / /sngags kyi tshul khrims dang du blangs/ /glen pa rnams kyis sgro skur la/ /nyam nga med pa'i gdeng thob cing / /zab mo'i don la bzod pa yi/ /rnam thar ngo lkog med par bskyangs/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo dang / /'jug pa'i spyod pa mtha' dag bi/ /grogs su brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /drangs pas bar ma dor ma 'khums/ /bskyed rdzogs spros pa rang zhig nas/ /bsam gtan ngang du yid bsdud kyang / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /lhas mthong rdzogs pa chen por song / /de ltas rnyed dang mi rnyed sogs/ /lo ma'i chos brgyad la thal pa 'i/ /chen po bsnyen la mi mkhas na/ /rgyal po'i bla mchod phrang dog cing / /rga dang nad kyi bar chad la'ang / /dpyad nas sa skyong sde dbe yi/ /spyan 'dren lan du springs yig byas/ /chos rje dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /spyan 'dren nan tan che ba'i steng / /mgon po zhal gyi brda don la/ /yang srid snga phyi'i rten 'brel mthong //shul ring lam thos khel ba yi//rten gsu ma ma jal zhing bsti stang byas/ /lha khang chen por mjal 'dzoms nas/ /bzung ste dgun zla gsum gyi bar/ /rten gsum spyi la rab gnas dang / /bye brag skyes bu'i lhag gnas ni/ /gsar rnying rgyud 'u nga dbang chen brgyad/ /rjes gnang sung ma'i srog satad dang / byang sdom thugs bskyed chen mo dang / 'brel bar 'khrid tshul nan tan gyis/ /thugs rgyud byang chub sems gnyis su/ /smin pa'i thabs la man tan byas/ /chen po das gi chos rgyun ni/ /bla la drang ba'i rten 'byung phyir/ /'os ma'i snod du 'bab dka' yang / /rgyal khams yo ngas kyi bla ma ru/ /bsku ra ba'i thusas rgyud 67

theg chen dang / /chos nyid don la rab sbyar nas/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon don mthun du/ /'gyur ba'i smon lam bzang po btab/ /dman pa rnams la che 'gying dang //nor ldan rjes su 'dzin pa yi//lhag bsam zol ma spangs byas te//bsdu dngos bzhi la sems bskyed nas/ /tshogs bshad mos slob tsam min par//brgya phrag gnyis thal khrid na yang / /da ni sgrub pa'i dus kyi mthar/ /nges 'byung ra ris rgyud bskul nas/ /chos don gnyer ba phal mo che/ /snyigs ma lnga yi gdon chen gyis/ /shes rgyud zil gyis non ches pas/ /lo zla dus kyi sgrub tshugs la//dpag pa'i yon tan skyes nas kyang //slar la thur du lhung ba'i phyir//lam du 'gro ba shin tu dkon/ /de ltas bdag nyid dben pa la/ /chi thang byed pa'i rgyu yang 'di/ /khyad par sngags kyi sde snod ni/ /lam ston byed pa phal la yang / /lhongs su gyur pa'i gnas nyung nas/ /rdzing na ma mchis wa nang du/ /'drong pa rgyu 'bras 'gal ba can/ /de phyir bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyang : /chos kyi de nyid rig pa dang / /chos bzhin spyod pa yod min la/ /dgongs kyis gang zag mang zhung dang / /rigs gzugs dbang phyug che chung la/ /'dzin pa rmongs pa'i 'khrul snang tsam/ /rgyan drug dbang phyug brgyad cu dang / /rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas dang / /dge bshes kha rag sgom chung dang / /rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams la'ang / /khyim chung spang ba'i khyim chen gyi/ /dgon gnas sdig pas 'dzin pa dang / /chags sdang chos su sgom pa yi/ /grwa slob rgyun chags ma mchis pas/ /rten gsum rnams la bsti stang dang / /chos la gus pa'i nyams len mdzod/ /'brel tshad dge la 'gyur ba yi/ /smon lam bzang po btab nas yod/ /kho bo'i rgyud ni nges 'byung dang / /dran snang ye shes rnam pa gnyis/ / 68

mnyam rjes can du 'char ba'i phyir/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i sems chos nyid don la yod min na/ /mngon dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal dang / /phyogs ris bdag stod gzhan smod dang / /khengs dang brtun ngas chos las 'das/ /rigs gzugs dbang phyug grags pa yi/ /che dang mngon rlom can dag la/ /smon dang zhum bcas re dogs kyi/ /gnas las kyang ni grol ba'i phyir/ /kun nas mthong ba tha dad pa/ /skyes bu so so'i las snang dang / /gnas skabs rten cing 'brel 'byung yin/ /gang zhig theg pa chen po yis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag ni//gang la phan pa'i mthu med kyang //de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya/ /gang la bsam pa de yod na/ /de ni de la don gyis zhugs/ /zhes pas gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu'i/ /rin chen sems la rtag gus pas/ /mi tshe'i lhag ma'ang don yod 'gyur/ /'di ni bla chen sa skya pa'i/ /gsung gis bskul nas bris pa yin/ /ṭā/ sdus mthong thos dran rig kun/ /rnam byang dam pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba 69
sang ba chen po nyam brjod chu zla'i krazhes bya ba ba

༄༅/ /dpal gdod ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma skyes mi 'gag rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /dmigs med rang grol 'od gsal 'dus ma byas//shin tu rnam dag tha mal rig pa la/ /dus gsum 'pho med dgongs pas phyag bgyi'o/ /kun bzang dge ba rdul tsam ma brten kyang / /zag med rang ngo shes pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mngon par byang chub khams gsum yid can rnams/ /sdig pa'i sa bon med bzhin 'khor bar 'khyams//de phyir rig dang ma rig cho 'phrul gyis/ /'khor 'das so sor phye ba'i mtshang rig kyang/ /'di na lhan skyes bag chags g.yo 'phrul pos/ /da dung blo brid byed pa sems pa skyo/ /gzhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan ma lags pa/ /thams cad rdzun pa'i rnam 'gyur chen po ru/ /go yang dad ldan gdul bya drang ba'i slad/ /nyams snang chu zla'i gar mkhan 'dir gsal bya/ /de yang mdo las/ rab 'byor chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos las lhag pa'i chos shig yod na de yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu zhes ngas bstan to/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad yang dag pa ma yin pa kun tu brtags pa med bzhin du snang ba rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ /stag dang seng ge glang chen dred/ /sbrul dang dgra rnams thams cad dang / /sems can dmyal ba'i srung ma dang / /byad ma de bzhin srin po rnams/ /sems 'di gcig pu brtags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad brtags par 'gyur/ /zhes 'khor 'das lam gsum thams cad rang snang kho na'i ldog chas phye ba nyid las don dam par bden par grub pa spu tsam ma mchis na/ de las kyang nying 'khrul du gyur pa'i rmi lam bag chags kyi snang cha ni shin tu ya ma brla ste 73

shān+ta de was/'gro ba mi lam lta bu ste//rnam par dpyad na chu shing 'dra//zhes so//de lta na'ang chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i rten de la dge mi dge'i 'jug ldog byed pa'i mkhan po ni las dang de'i rnam par smin pa kho na las byed po gzhan med pa ni o rgyan chen pos/gnod pa'i dmyal dpon chen po de//gal te sems can yin gyur na/ /de yi sdig pa gang du 'gro/ /zhes so/ /rgyu mtshan des na so so skye bo rmongs pa'i rab rib kyis ldongs pa dag gis phyin ci log gi las thabs sgrib pa'i phung po can la'ang gtan tshigs dang shog khrar byas te ngo mtshar gyi gleng gzhir byed na/ 'dir bla na med pa'ikhyang chub kyi spyod pa la bslabs shing / myur lam rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas rang rgyud la gdod nas bzhugs pa'i rdo rje bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum sad pa'i rten 'brel dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs rang gi kun rtog dang 'dres nas 'jug pa'i cho 'phrul chen po la snang cha'i gzugs brnyan ci yang srid pa'i phyir/ de nyid la dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i brdar btags pa ste/ de'ang nang dgongs pa'i brtul zhugs gyi na 'bar zhing 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du rtsal rdzogs pa'i phrin las kyi rol pa tshad med pas ma yin par/ tha mal gyi rtog pa la bral thob med bzhin du lha 'dres byin gyis brlabs pa'i dag snang dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la mchog tu rlom pa dag la gnas skabs su so so skye bo dga' ba'i nus pa dang / mthon po'i go sa la stegs pa'i rang stobs yod kyang mthar thug grol ba 'grub pa'i rten 'brel med pas tshul de dag dang bdag cag grub thob brgyud pa'i bu sbas pa'i rnal 'byor spyod yul mnyam par ni blta bar mi bya'o//e ma sprang 'jigs med nam 474

mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos 'di bya'i gza' gtad ma mthong bar/ /blo gang shar rang grol chen po'i klong / /nyams rtogs pa'i bag chags khong nas sad/ /pha rgyal sras pad+ma'i rang zhal mjal//don gdams pa zab dgu'i snying khu thob//de thob tsam ma lags rgyud la shar/ /tshig kha khyer ma yin sand la phebs tshe nges med snying la brnags pa yis/ /las 'khor bar yi chad drag po shar/ /don snying po'i sgrub pa lhur blangs tshe/ /yid shes kyi chu mtshor 'di ltar mngon/ /pha bka' drin 'khor med mtsho skyes rjes//mi las can gyi pha phogs su byin pa yi//chos pad+ma snying thig hū sgrub des/ /snang srid r+ghaṃ glur blangs pa'i tshe/ /shar nyin byed dbang po'i 'od zer de/ /sgrub khang gi thod la 'ching ba'i skabs/ /nyams snang shes zang thal gyi 'char sgo la/ /lho mon kha'i brag gi sku rjes mthong / /brag dbyibs ni mchims phu'i jag hug 'dra/ /brag kha dog gnag snum bag chags ngos/ /khyen zhags tshad tsam ber gyi sul dang bcas/ /shin tu gsal ba'i ngang tshul mjal/ /der mos gus bzod blag med pa'i ngang / /mig mchi ma'i dba' rlabs cir yang g.yo/ /pha u rgyan dran nas tshugs thabs med/ /gnas de ru da lta slebs na snyam/ /nyams bde stong gi rnam rol cir yang rtse/ /yang de nas mi ring zhag 'ga' na/ /brag ljang nag me long lta bu'i ngor/ /su waṇis byugs 'dra'i zhabs rjes gnyis/ /'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang nas mthong / /'di che chung blo yis dpyad ma bzod//spyir mthong snang rig pa'i rtsal yin par ma zad lho mon phyogs la brag la zang sogs sku rjes brgya tsam yod par bshad pas gang yin ngo ma 'tshal/ zhabs rjes ni phyogs bzhi'i brag la che ba bzhi dang /gzhan ni shin tu mang ngo / /dus de'i tshe 'khrul pa'i mi lam la /rang bem rig 75

bral du nye ba la/ /nye 'brel gyis bskor nas gdung bar byed/ /der 'chi brod kyi gdeng chen rnyed snyam pas/ /khong de dag la thim rim gshod pa'i ngang /chos nyid kyi ngang du dran pa stor/ /skabs shig tu dran pa rnyed tsa na/ /rang srid pa bar dor slebs nas gda'/ /phung po zhugs la sbar ba mthong / /kyai pha des mya ngan chen po byed/ /rang bag chags sha gzugs kyi yid ngo la/ /sems dngos med la skye 'chi'i ming 'dogs bral/ /ngas bden pa mthong bas bde sdug rdzun//pha kho rang snying rje bsams tsa na//gnyid sad nas bde gsal ngang la 'byams//rje pad+mas 'gro ba rigs drug gi/ /sa bon bsregs par lung bstan mdzad/ /dus 'di nas lus kyi shig sro rnams/ /gar song cha med du dag par gyur/ /spyir bar do la rnam grangs bzhir 'chad pa dang / la lar drug tu dbye ba sogs snang zhing / khyad par chos nyid dang srid pa'i bar do 'dir gsang sngags gsar rnying bzhed pa cung zad ma mthun zhing / de'i dbang gis rang lugs 'thad ldan du sgrub pa dang //gzhan phyogs tshul min du dgag pa sogs ji snyed cig 'chad snang ste/ skabs 'dir yang dgon pa'i bar do 'phrang sgrol du grags par/ ro bsreg pa la sogs byed na myur du tshig na dga'/ ma tshig na mi dga'/ myur du mi snang bar song na dga'/ yun ring du lus na yang kha snar 'tshangs/ rul ba dang dri snom na sdug bsngal chen po byed/ rang la gdung ba med pa kun la zhe sdang chen po byed cing mi dga' ba'i snang ba 'ong bar 'dug/sngar gyi khyim dang mal la sogs par 'khor zhing nye ba nye 'brel rnams kho rang zas za zhing bdas la mi ster ba dang / ming nas bton cing ngu ba dang / shi ba'i gtam brjod pa la sogs pas shin tu mi dga' bar gyur te/ gar 'gro 76

gtad med du 'gro bar 'dug /ces srid pa bar do'i rang bzhin rgyas par dbye ba ltar da lta'i mi lam dang phyin chad kyi bar do gnad gcig pas 'chad tshul sna tshogs la klan ka mi dgos par rtogs so/ /a ho/ dus de yi gnas skabs thams cad du/ /phyi bzung yul rags pa'i rnam rtog 'gags/ /nang 'dzin byed shes pa gtad med grol/ /sems bde stong gi nam mkha' dwangs pa'i klong / /lam mngon sum rig mdangs lhag mthong gis/ /dpal ma hā gu ru'i zhal skyin mjal/ /nyams rtogs 'bul zhib rgyas zhus pa na/ /sgom yal grabs yin 'dug gsungs pa thos/ /sgom byas tshad nyams zhen rnam rtog yin//de yal na nyams yal rtogs pa shar//don spros bral bden pa mthong ba'i brda//chos yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa yi/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor pha mthar phyin/ /mtshan ma rdzas kyi sku rten de/ /dngos grub len par 'gul ba snyam/ /nang rig pa dbyings kyi he ru ka /gsal brtan gyi yul gsum gyad du gyur/ /sems yi dam gyi phyag rgyar rtsal rdzogs pas/ /rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi ldang tshad shes/ /de nang ltar sgrub pa rta gdong zhal/ /phyag rgyar bsgyur nas bsgrubs pa'i tshe /gnyid mi rtog kun gzhi'i mun pa nas/ /yid gcig pur langs pa'i gsal snang la/ /gnas 'og min dpal gyi mchims phu yi/ /brag dmar gyi ke'u tshang du slobs/ /dbyibs rnam 'gyur ji bzhin ma yin pa'i/ /rang byung gis bras skyibs chen po'i nang / /pha mtsho skyes rdo rje'i snang brnyan la/ /'khor rgyal ba rigs lngas mdzes pa de'i/ /sku che chung mi tshad nyis 'gyur tsam/ /rigs gtso dang 6rgyan gnyis ma'i phyag /rat+na'i srog zhus mtshan par snang / /der rig 'dzin : chen 'gro 'dul dang / /mig 'phrul lta bur mjal ba na/ /brag 'di 477

la gu ru'i zhubs rjes yod/ /bdag cag gnyis 'tshol lo gsungs pa la/ /gnyis nas 'tshol ba'i 'du shes ngang / /gnas de'i dkon gnyer yin snyam pa'i/ /ban rgan song zhig khyams der 'dus pa des/ /mdzub ris dang bcas bstan byung bar/ /de na zhabs rjes khru do tsam/ /'dam la rgyab ltar shin tu gsal/ /der rang nyams bur te ting 'dzin gyis/ /dbang bzhi blangs pa'i nus pa de/ /tha mal gyi blo yis dpag par dka'/ /sems gya gyu'i kun rtog 'ching ba can/ /btsan thabs su gtad med chen por grol/ /gnyid mi lam gyi 'char sgo rdzun pa de/ /nang dbyings su nub pa'i zla ba ltar/ /mi rtos dbu ma'i gshis la thim/ /de lung ma bstan du ma 'byams par/ /rtsa shel sbug can du zhugs pa las/ /gnyid gti mug gi 'ching ba las brgal te/ /bum nang du mar me sbar ba bzhin/ /'od gsal gyi go yang ma 'gags la/ /'khor 'das so so'i mtshang rig cing / /blo der 'dzin gyi kun rtog dang bral ba'i/ /dbyings gzhin nu bum sku'i zhing khams mthong / /ngas sngon chad ma mthong dgu mthong yang / /'od gsal lhun grub kyi zhing ma mthong / /pha pad+ma'i thugs rje bsam mi khyab/ /don rang rig rtsal gyi dbang chen thob//de slar yang nam mkhar 'dres pa ltar//lhag mthong gi rig pa sad pa las//stong pa'i gsal mdangs cher 'bar nas//snang srid kun rtog med 'od gsal ngang //me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam//rgya mtshor gza' skar bkram pa bzhin//der 'dzin med pa'i bltad mo mthong //de phyir gsal phra mo'i kun rtog las/ /gnyis snang gi zhen pa shar ba na/ /yul dpal gyi gru 'dzin po ta la/ /sgo skar khung bsam las 'das pa dang / /de'i steng gi nam mkhar 'phags ma'i sku/ /be+eḍūr gyi mdangs can 'od kyi sku /ha 478

cang gsal 'tsher min pa zhig /snang bas de la der 'dzin gyi/ /sanyis snang du zhen pas rkyen byas te/ /'od gsal gyi snang ba rang sar 'gags/ /gnyid sad rgyu med la sad 'dra'i ngang / /da lta'i shes pa rjen par 'dug /e ma/ rje rang byung pad+ma'i byin rlabs mthus/ /ngas rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi dbyings don/ /nyams myong du rdo rus thug par mjal/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /rgyud sde dang zhus dag pher bar shes/ /'dir brjod bya'i gnas tshul ma lags te/ /dus ma 'ongs rig 'dzin sprul pa'i gar//dgongs pa rgyud kyi 'pho ba thob nges pa/ /'ga' srid na de dag ngo mtshar zhing / /nges shes kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /'dir rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag yi ber bzhag /spyir 'od gsal la 'chad tshul mang na yang / /kun gzhi'i dri ma dag cing gzhi'i gnas lugs lung ma bstan las khyad chos drug gis 'phags pa'i gdod ma'i nang dbyings gzhon nu bum pa'i skur grags pa 'di nges gsang rdzogs pa chen po snying thig thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ de lta na'ang kun tu bzang po dang zhal mi gnyis pa kun mkhyen klong chen pas dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis nyams su myong /bshad pa'i lam nas gtan la phab pas 'di dag gi bshad tshul gol 'phyugs med pa gang gi dgongs gter bstan bcos chen po rnams su snang ba ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum du bgrod ma myong ba'i gang zag che ge mo zhig la de'i dngos gnas zhib par bshad kyang de 'dra zhig go snyam pa'i 'ol spyi tsam las nges shes mi skye zhing yin tshul ji bzhin pa blo yul du snang dka' ba tsam du'ang ma zad/ phyi rabs kyi gang zag rnams tshig tsam dang grags pa'i rjes su 'brang bas gsang ba chen po 'di lta bu bshad pa las lha mthong 'dre mthong cung zhig smras na mgu 79

bar byed mod/ rgyu mtshan des da lta gangs can 'dir rtogs pa mthon por rlom zhing sgom nyin mtshan 'dres pa'i khas len spyi brtol du byed pa snang na'ang / nang dbyings grol sa chen po 'di'i gnad rtogs shing myong ba lta ci/go bas gtan la phebs pa'ang dkon par snang ngo / /de yang mkha' 'gro yang tig gi mthong snang rin po che 'od kyi drwa bar/ sang nyin tho rengs bla ma gzims dus thugs 'od gsal la 'byams te/ yar ka dag gi snang ba/ bar longs sku'i tshom bu/ mar 'gro drug gi 'char tshul/ sgra skad sna tshogs pa thos pa la thugs kyis rig cing rags par med par snang ba dang / de'i skad cig ma snga ma na dran pas na rgyun chad nas/ snang ba dmar la mthing pa tsam gyi ngang la brgyal ba bzhin 'byams so/ /dal gcig na rnal 'byor ma des 'ongs nas/snga ma'i de ni gdod ma'i ka dag tu nang gsal thim la ma rmugs par bzhugs pa'i ngo sprod yin no/ /brgyal ba zhes bya ste chos nyid kyi ngang du brgyal bas slong dgos pa yin no/ /phyi ma ni phyir gsal du sprul sku 'gyed tshul dang / 'khrul pa rim gyis snang tshul rang sar shar ba'i ngo sprod yin no gsungs so/ /zhes bshad pa dang don gnyis su med par 'byor pas rang gis myong ba la nges shes 'drongs shing kun mkhyen chen po la mos pa'i srog mkhar gzhig tu med pa tshugs par gyur to/ /lha de yi las sbyor la babs tshe/ /mas rmi lam dwangs pa'i me long ngor/ /kho gnod sbyin brag btsan dmar po de/ /mi gzhan gyis bdag la rbad pa mthong / /ngas stong nyid snying rjer khros pa'i ngang / /kho srid pa ru log snying kha ru/ /gnad rang gshed dbab pa'i mtshon chas gzir/ /zhag gnyis nas sgrub g.yog sa man+tas/ /rdo pha wong long bu star rlon tsam/ /mngon sum du 480

byin pa bla rdor bsngags/ /gcun pa dang shi sa bstan pa'i phyir/ /mal zhabs su zil gnon dgongs pas gzir/ /bka' nan chad mdo la gnas pa'i/ /srung ma'ang ngo srung zas phyir 'phreng / /'di dag la gtor ma byin pa las/ /gnam lcags spu gri'i gnad dbab zab/ /'dre gnod sbyin gyi kun spyod nyams re dga'/ /dus de tshe smin drug zla ba'i nub/ /dmyal ba yin no skad pa yi/ /zab sa ring por lhung ba'i snang ba la/ /tshe 'dir ni las ngan bsags pa med/ /bcas pa dang rang bzhin las 'das pa'i/ /phra mo'i sdig pa dag la yang / /stobs bzhi dang bcas pas bshags mod de/ /tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i rnam smin zhig /dus da res skabs su bab pa la/ /khong sangs rgyas byon kyang rang gis nongs/ /de 'on te dmyal ba'ang sems kyis bzos/ /nang dran rig gi ngo bor lha snyam tshe/ /'dis dmyal ba'i skal ba thengs pa yin/ /khyod de la ma song zer sgra zhig thos/ /gnyid sad de skyo shas ngang la 'byams/ /rkyen de yis nangs par sngon 'gro yi/ /lam zab mo bla ma 'i rnal 'byor tshe/ /las de 'dra myong ba'i sems can la/ /bzod blag dang bral ba'i snying rje skyes/ /dbang med du mchi ma'i char pa babs/ /skyo shas kyi snang ba sab pa'i tshe/ /brjod med kyi nyams rtogs gsar du 'khrungs/ /pha bla ma dran pa'i mgur yang blangs/ /sdug bsngal kun sgrib pa'i bud shing du/ /gsungs pas de ngo mtshar can du bda'/ /dpe gli lam tsam gyi duḥkhas kyang / /nyams rtogs 'gugs pa'i pho nyar byung / /de byin chad sdug bsngal dang gtam ngan la/ /dngos grub chen por lta ba yin/ /der sla ra yang cung zad mnal ba na/ /thugs rgyud rtogs pa'i byin rlabs mthus//kun gzhi'i rnam rtog chos skur sangs//gsal ba la rtog pa med pa yi/ /8/

stong pa'i 'od gsal gyi ltad mo ra 'byams/ /der mched pa phyir gsal du g.yos pa las/ /snang ba'i 'od gsal gyi rig sadangs su/ /bras nyi ma shar ba'i ldebs shis la/ /rang byon gyi bkod pa 'ga' zhig ma thong / /rkyen de nyid kyi yid shes la ngas pa las/ /gnyid yin min rtog dpyod phra mo shar/ /des sgo lnga'i rtsa nang rlung zhugs pas/ /gnyid sad rgyur snang yang 'khrul 'byams med/ /gshis mi rtos rjen pa'i ngang la sanas/ /phyis 'od gsal la slob pa'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /dran pa rgya 'byams kyi kun rtog dang / /nu na pa lta bu'i gti mug la/ /'od gsal gyi ming 'dogs ma byed par/ /gnad 'di dag khong du chud bar gyis/ /'di dgongs brgyud 'pho ba thob pa'i mthu/ /dus gtan du zin pa dka' ba ste/ /rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi/ /rtsal yongs su rdzogs las gzhan du min/ /de'i tho rengs lda ngas ba'i rnal 'byor tshe/ /gzhi snang ba'i 'od gsal dwangs pa'i ngor/ /rang gnas pa'i smin mtshams nam mkha'i thad/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga pa'i gur khyim nang / /skyabs kun 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje mjal/ /de blta bya dang lta mkhan dbyer med pas/ /re dogs kyi 'ching ba gang yang med/de'i ngang la de nyid gnas 'gyurate/ /yul sing ga la yi a tsar+ya/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen du lam gyis song / /sku dmar smug mchong ltar dwangs pa yi/ /phyag g.yas na be con khyad 'phags bsnams/ /g.yon bdag gi snying khar sdigs mdzub kyi/ /phyag rgyas brda thabs ston pa'i mod/ /phyag mtshan gyi be con bdas nyid la/ /byin te rang la dbyer med thim/ /sku sgyu ma lta bu'i gsal snang de/ /ka dag gi dbyings su gtad med yal/ /dus 'di nas dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod rdol//gsung rab kun gyi dgongs pa khrol/ /482

klong chen rig pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /snang yul brda dang dpe char shar/ /mchog gi dngos grub rgyud la bzhag /gang tshe longs sku'i chas gyon zhing / /lus rnam snang chos bdun drang po'i ngang / /nam mkhar bya ltar lding ba dang / /gcer bur rgod ltar 'phur ba sogs/ /(rgya gar yin rgyu ri sman ljongs shin tu khul yangs pa zhig tu slebs pa na/ ban de gtso bor gyur pa'i khrom dmar nag 'khyil ba mdun ngos nas yong bar snang ba la grwa ba rtog ge ba'i rigs gsang sngags zab mo la lhag par sdang sems dang ldan zhing grub pa'i cha lugs tsam la'ang log rtog mi bzad pa yod 'dug pas da lam snang ba sprul bsgyur zhig byed dbos bsamanas/) 'di skad du/nga rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa/ /nam mkhar 'phur na 'di ltar 'phur/ (zhes nam mkhar gzhu 'dom lnga brgya tsam shugs kyis 'phar zhing /) sa la 'dzul na 'di ltar 'dzul/ (sa la 'dzul dgos snyam pa na gnyid sad)mi lam gyi rang gzugs cir ya nga rtse/ /'di nam mkha'i rlung zin ltas su nges/ /sa non ces bshad pa'i gzhung yang yod/ /de yan chad rang lo nyer brgyad pa'i/ /'khrul snang sgyu ma'i me long ngo / /zhing bkod la ḍak+ki'i gsang gtam chen mo 'dir 'god/ me bos su bklubs pa'i glang i 'o 'i/ /dus cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ /pha rje btsun o rgyan snying nas dran/ /mig mchi ma'i dba' rlabs g.yo bzhin du/ /ngag bdung ba'i 'o dod lhang lhang snyel/ /pha sangs rgyas gnyis pa de nyid kyi/ /rnam thar dang bka' drin dran pa'i mod/ /tshes bcu'i dus dran gsol 'debs brtsams/ /des thun mtshams kun tu gsol btab pas/ /zhag gsum 'das pa'i tho rengs khar/ /sgo lnga'i gsal snang nub pa yis/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi me long ngor/ /ljongs 'di yin ngo mi 'tshal ba'i sa ra / 8 3

mdun ngos nas lhag par ltar snang ba'i/ /gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan 'phan phur sogs/ /blos dpag tu med pas sngon bsus te/ sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad rnams/ sku che chung mi tshad nyis 'gyur tsam/ /lham me lhan der 'byon pa mjal/ /der mig 'phrul lta bu'i gsal snang la/ /'ja' 'od skum 'khyil dwangs pa'i nang / /mas gdang bu lnga ldan btsan thabs su/ /nam mkha'i ngos su btsugs pa mthong / /der rtog med du 'jogs te bgro ba'i ngang / /pha o rgyan dang mjal lo snyam tsa na/ /bu ma chags pad+ma'i sa la shog /ces gsung pa rna bar lhang gyis lo/ /de'i mod la rang snang rnga yab gling / /dpal g.yo ru'i khra 'brug yin snyam pa'i/ /ngo mtshar gyi gzhal med khang du slebs/ /dbus 'ja' tshon gyi lding gur bkra ba'i klong / /yab rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas de/ /sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi rnam rol can/ /rten med du bar snang dbyings la bzhugs/ /g.yas g.yon na bi ma pa gor zhabs/ /'khor dpa' bo ḍak+ki'i tshom bus mdzes/ /dbus rdo yi bzhugs khri chen po'i steng / /rtog med la rang nyid slebs pa'i mod/ /mos gus kyis dran pa dbang med stor/ /rig pa skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin/ /rje btsun gu ru'i thugs kur thim/ /der rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob/ /lam rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad shes shing / /dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams de/ /rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med par mthong / /zhas gcig 'das pa'i nyams snang byung / /de sad pa'i shes pa skad cig mar/ /gsang mchog bde ba chen po ni/ /yum ye shes ḍak+ki mtsho rgyal ma/ /bu mo mdzes ma'i cha byad can/ /des mtshan ldan gyi bhan dha srubs med cig /bdas nyid kyi lag tu sprod pa dang / /'di chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi/ /dbu thod ngo ma yin 48

no gsungs/ /yang cung zhig dgongs nas thod pa de/ /re zhig phar la blangs pa'i mod//mig 'phrul lta bu'i snang cha la//snga ma dang dbye bar mi bzod pa'i//thod pa zhig de yi zla la sbyar/ /gnyis ka lhan cig stsol ba dang / /da 'di gnyis dbye ba e phyed gsungs//de dpyad du ma bzod nem nur ngang / /gsal snang de nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar yal//rje yab yum de snying la dran drags nas/ /skyo shas kyis gdung ba bzod thabs bral/ /ris pa 'dun pa'i tan+t+ra las/ brda dang brda mtshon go ba ni/ /dbang gi nang nas dbang /'o/ /zhes pa'i don la nges shes rnyed/ /lo de yi sa ga nya ba'i zur/ /lha dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /yan lag bzhi ldan gyi sgrub chen btsugs/ /srod thun dang po'i byin 'bebs tshe /nyams gtad med ngang nas shes pa 'ur/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ldan gyi ting 'dzin dang / /chos nyid kyi ngang du dran pa myos/ /der spros bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rje lha btsun mkha' 'gro'i dbang rgyug de/ /sku ha cang mi bgres dar yol tsam/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i ngang du mthong / /nyams rtogs kyi 'gro bas mnyes par byas/ /dus de tsho bkod mdzes kyi khang pa'i nang / /be+e ro'i rnam 'phrul gter bdag gling / /mjal te gsung las 'di ltar thos/ /'gro ba'i don du srid mas rda/ /bskul mkhan byung na skad snyan yod/ /ces gsung pa gang gi rten 'brel las/ /rig 'dzin de yi mgur phur du/ /grags pa'i phur pa ngo mtshar can/ /'di kod dngos grub kyi rdzas su 'byor/ /de'ang snyigs ma'i dus na rtsod pa dang bral ba'i gter ston chos rje gling pas kha reg mgo dgu bdud mtsho'i klong nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'i lung bstan las/dbus g.yor gzhung du byang sems pad+ma'i ming :(phyir bsod nams dang dbang thang gis brgyan 485

la so sa che ba zhig la ngos 'dzin pas/ bdag 'dra ba ma yin kyang / pad+ma'i ming tsam la ming 'dra dang rus 'dra'i the tshom bcad pa'i dbang po ni/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bka' brgya ma nas ma 'ongs pa'i tshe lung zin thams cad la mi 'gyuraba'i brda rtags gsu ma gyis gzer yod pa de nyid las gang yang mi 'gyur brda rtags gsum dang lda naḥlus la lte sme snying khar sha mtshan teḥngag gis snyan mgur sngags tshig rtsol ba canaḥpad+ma las byung pad+ma'i ming can gnyisaḥ yid ni rtse gcig gdung shugs nga nyid dran phur tshugs 'di min yid la mi byed gsumaḥ de gsum 'dzom na mchog yin gnyis 'dzom 'bring ཿ gcig 'dzom tha ma sang yang las can teḥ zhes pas bstan pa ltar kho bo'i snying khar phyi rdo rje'i dbyibs su mtshan pa'i sme ba dmar po'i thig le bcu phrag gsum dang / lte bar dril bu'i dbyibs kyis mtshan pa'i sme ba dmar po sum cu tsam yod pas 'dra tshod 'os tshod kyi zhe 'dod bsgrub na de tsam mo /)bka' rnying bstan skyong thabs mkhas 'gro ba 'dul ཿ zhes bka' rnying ma'i bstan pa bshad sgrub kyis 'dzin par lung gis bsngags pa ltar tshe 'di nyid la dase ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas tha snyad dang gzhung lugs la bcad brdar gyis ngal dub sogs ci yang ma dbos par sngon sbyangs kyi rang sto bas ston pa'i rtsal rdzogs pas rig pa phyogs yan du grol pas re dosas kyi 'phrang las grol / gang byung des chog tu la bzla bas zhe 'dod kyi mtshang brdol nas su'i kha la'ang mi nyan zhing gu yangs khyung rgyal chen por spyod la snang ba dpe char shar bas byas tshad man ngag tu so ba des bla ma dargongs 'dus kyi cho ga'i rnam bshad mkhyen brtse'i me long rtsom pa'i sgang yol la thus pa'i tshe/ tho rengs kyi cha zhig na gnyid sad de shes rig spros bral gyi ngang du la bzlo ba'i tshe/ smin mtshams kyi nam mkha' nas rta skad mngon sum du 'tsher ba thos pas skad cig ma dang po la shes pa dasa' yal 86

yal ba dang 'jigs chum chum pa gnyis ka byung ngo / /e ma/ 'di'i bstan pa 'dzin par lung bstan pa'i/ /khong pad+ma'i ljags ldan mched drug las/ /rje ma hā gu rus ming gi dbang / /pad+ma dbang chen du byin gyis brlabs/ /dbyings lhan cig skyes pa'i ḍāk+ki mas/ /lha dbang chen pad+ma'i srog gi snying / /mngon sum du lag pa'i ri mo (mthe bong g.yas la h+ya dang trī sogs mthong phyogs tha dad pa'i ri mo gsal bar 'dug) la/ /rtsod pa med par bzhugs zhes bshad/ /skabs de tshe dgongs 'dus srung ba'i ma/ /mi bsrun sha za hor mo che/ /gsung mtshims phu'i sanas nas lhags so snyam/ /sman btsun g.yu yi lan tshar can/ /dpag tu med pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /mi kho bo'i mdun du khrong gis byung / /ngag ci yang mi smra 'dzum pa'i ngang / /dung dkar po yid du 'ong ba zhig /nged la sprod par rtsom pa na/ /de 'gyel stabs su cung zad song ba las/ /dung chag gis dogs nas slong slong tshe/ /des har gyis langs nas slar la sprad/ /kho bos dpal gyi ri bo yi/ /gtsug lag gi steng nas 'bud snyam tshe/ /gnyid sad pas rten 'brel de tsam mo/ /dus re zhig bsnyen bsgrub dam po'i tshe/ /rang gzhug ma'i bste gnas yin snyam pa'i/ /khang pa bkod mdzes zhig gi nang / /rje rig 'dzin hūṃ chen kā ra de/ /zhal khyim zla ba lta bu la/ /sku sha yang rgyags pa ltar snang ba'i/ /gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa zhig /sgyu ma lta bu'i snang char mjal/ /nyams rtogs kyi gleng mo mang zhus mthar/ /da nged kyi sgrub khang 'di nyid du/ /blos blang bi dkyil 'khor zhig bzhengs zhus pas/ /da blos blang gsar du bzhengs pa las/ /chung ngu zhig gso dgos pa zhig /gnas gzhan du 'dug pa ngas blangs te/ /bu khyod la sprad kyi zhig gso gyis/ /zhes gsungs te mi snang gzhan 487

du tha' / yang mtsho sna phyogs nas yin snyam pa'i/ /bud med mon mo'i cha byad can/ /spa thams cad spos shel gyi lan tshar can/ /ngo shes shes 'dra ba gcig na re/ /gtam snyan pa'i ngag gis sngon bsus nas/ /dpe bam po 'ig lag tu sprad byung ba/ /kha phye bas gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma/ /kha gsar ba che chung gsum du snang / /sngar 'das pa'i srid pa mang po la/ /chos 'di yi bdag por gyur pa dang / /klong chen gyi rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i brdar/ /ma mkha' 'gros sanang ba byin nam snyam/ /kye hoḥ /lo de yi chu stod zla ba'i nyin//rje mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis/ /gter gnas gsum nas spyan drangs pa'i/ /btsan gnod sbyin ya ba skya bdun gyi/ /srog gtad dang rgyud lung nod pa'i nub/ /nam/ tho rengs thun gyi smad cha nas/ /gnyid yin min dpyad du ma bzod pa'i/ /nyams 'khrul pa'i snang ba rdzun po cher/ /khong gnod sbyin chen po ban dhe'i gzugs/ /na cher yol gyon pa snum bag can/ /'khor dang bcas pa bdas drung lhags/ /phyag phu dud chen pos 'tshal ba la/ /bdag kun rtog rang kha'i bas chags blong / /rang na tshod chung ngu'i phan gzhin la / /khong che bgres kyi gus phyag mi 'thad snyam/ :khyed de ltar bgyi bar mi 'os zhes /nan chen pos ldog kyang btsal ba na/ /de'i lke nas lub kyis bsdams pa las/ /yid gus pa'i tshul gyis 'ji skad zer/ /khyed la gter ston rin po ches/ (mnga' ris paṇa chen) gcung dga' bo'i skye ba yin gsungs pas/ (shākya thub pa'i mched du sgyu 'phrul ma'i bu/ lo rgyus dkon brtsegs las dga' bo mngal 'jug bi mdo dang / dga' bo mngal na gnas pa'i snyan pa sogs las gsal/) des gus pas lha phyag 'tshal ba yin/ /sngar byang pa rig 'dzin sprul pa'i skus/ /khyed dbu blar bzhes shing gus 488

'dud dang / /bdag rkyen de 'dra mdzad mod zer/ /der da lta'i rnam rtog rang sar yal/ /bag chags 'ga' zhig blo la snang / /shes pa btad med du yod tsa na//yang kho yis ngag nas 'di skad zer/ /khyed la gter ston rin po ches//lo bco lnga tshe tshad yin no gsungs/ /zhes smas te bdag la che re lta/ /phyis rtse chen brag gi bkod pa'ang bstan/ /skyabs rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /rje khri srong yang sprul mnga' ris pa/ /khong rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tha tshig la/ /lha 'di yis mi 'dar chad tho btsan/ /tshul de la brten nas 'di nyid kyi/ /gsol ka dus kyi pho nya'ang brtsams/ /tshe mi rtag lung bstan glog dang 'dra/ /gshis gdong nas dag pa'i dag pa la/ /dgra skye 'chi'i bag chags mi mnga' yang / /'du byed kyi rta bdun chu lhar phyogs/ /'di zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang //rten 'brel gyi bden pas ma zin na/ /mkha' dbyings la shar ba'i rgan thig 'dra/ /lo de yi smin drug zla ba'i nang / /dus yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i tho rengs khar/ /dbyings 'od gsal gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa la/ /bod gangs chen gyi lha gcig snying rje'i gter/ /lha 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma'i sku/ /(sdug bsngal rang grol/) shar nam mkhas gar khyab skus khyab pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan bzhengs stabs can//de mthong bas mos gus kyi mchi ma 'khrugs/ /gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad gsar du brtsams dus de nas rang lo sum cu pa/ /mgo zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nub/ /bdas gcung gzhon dang bsdebs nas byin pa'i mod/ /khang pa yin no snyam pa yi/ /sgo spus 'byed zhig phye nas song tsa na/ /dpal mchims phu'i lung pa skyid nyams can/ /ljongs rtsi shing nags tshal sman dris khengs/ /dbyar gung chen lta bur snang nyams spro/ /dbus 89

dge'u 'og gi sa 'dzin de/ /dbyibs phur pa btsugs pa lta bu la/ /gcong rong zab pa'i rnam par snang / /brag de'i shar sgo'i sked pa na/ /ma mtsho rgyal gzims phug yin snyam pa'i/ /sgrub phug gi sgo khung ha re mthong / /der 'gro ba'i lam po yin rgyu ba'i/ /rdo ring lta bu'i them mas la/ mi dkyus mas thar sa med par mngon/ /der shes pa gtad med de kha'i ngang / /rdo skas la 'dzesas te 'gro snyam tshe/ /thar ba'i re ba ma byung bas/ /yid skyo shas kyi snang bar 'di ltar sems/ /sngar yin na 'di 'drar 'gro bzhin la/ /da thar pa'i re ba zad pa 'di/ /las nyon mongs kyi sgrib pas yin no snyam/ /sems ma dga' nyid de yod pa'i ngang / /rig pa phug pa'i nang du gtad/ /'od gsal gyi dgongs pas bltas tsa na/ /rje lha gcig tshangs pa lha'i me tog /sku rdos bcas ma yin 'od kyi lus/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ /gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa zhig /rang snang 'od gsal gyi ngang du mjal/ /'di mnga' bdag gis myang ban ting 'dzin la/ /chos rdzogs chen zhus nas bsgoms pa'i phug /yin snyam pa'i bag chags wa ler dran/ /phyis brag sgo se bas 'gags pa yis/ /mi kun gyi snang ngor ma gyur zhing / /mdun ngos kyi brag la byang sems kyi/ /sku dong brkos 'dug pa sas non nas/ /dbu rib rib tsam yang mi 'dug mod/ /nye 'dabs na rdo yi gtun khung dang / /nang ngos la du ba'i dreg pa sogs/ /sngar sgrub phug yu na ring byas pa'i shul/ /'di gsang chen phug par 'dug pa'i phyir//sa mo yos la gnas sgo phye/ /(stag tshang phur ba'i lung bstan lasaḥ bi ma'i sprul pa pad+ma'i ming 'dzin laḥye shes rtsal rdol dag snang gnas sgo 'byedaḥ ces so/ /)ming yang me tog phug par btags/ /lo gsum sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /mi kho 490

pos 'od gsal bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /phyis su bsdad mi la ting 'dzin 'char//bkra shis byin chags kyi sgrub phug yin/ /de 'on kyang yu la der rang phyogs pa/ /sngar 'dris kyi mnyam 'grogs tshod yod dang / /'ga' 'ga'i sdang zhen mthus che bas/ /phyugs rdzis char yibs rnyed pa bzhin/ /stabs legs tsam du 'dzin pa las/ /med phyir bden dang rdzun pa yi/ /das sangs ni ci yang bya don med/ /dus de tshe 'khrul pa'i snang cha la/ /dpa la mchims phu'i nang nas 'ongs skad pa'i/ /skye mched dwangs pa'i gzhon nu 'ig /shin tu 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas/ /thos dril zhig lag par sprod du byung / /kha phye nas de nyid bklags pa na/ /yi ge le tshan gnyis snang ba'i /yig phreng gcig 'byar gyi sked pa na/ /khyod sprul pa'i dge slong a mar ma'i/ /(chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i smin mtshams las sprul te tsan dan gor shi sha len du rgya gar 'phalas pa'i yul la bgrod/ rgyal sras lha rje dang thugs rgyud gcig pa yin par go/) skya ba yin no zhes pa dang / /gzhan lung bstan gyi rnam pa 'ga' zhig snang / /de nas rang lo so gcig pa/ /sa mo yos kyi bgrang bya la/ /lo gsum gyi sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin/ /dpal gyi bsam yas ma chims phu ru/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs su phyin/ /mtshungs med rig 'dzin bla ma'i drung / /smin grol zab mo'i bcud 'thungs shing / /rigs bsdus pa d+ma gu ru yi/ /byin rlabs nye brgyud thob pa la/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i phrin las sgo / /dpal mgon ris 'dzin bla ma sa phye/ /de tshe bla ma'i gzims khang gi/ /yang thog nyid du mnal ba la/ /gnyan zur phud lnga pa yin snyam pa'i/ /khye'u dar gyi rgo zu can/ /yid du 'ong ba gcig na re/ /khyed chos rgyal phun tshogs yin a zer/ /ngas bkra this stobs rgyal e yin byas/ /des 'o 'o chos rgyal 9

phun tshogs zer/ /gtam de ko gnyis gas lan gsum bskyar/ /dam chos grol ba'i thig le yi/ /bka' yi srung ma yin par rtog /rje btsun pad+ma'i bka' lung bzhin/ /chos 'di nam mkha'i pha mtha' ru/ /brdal ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs na yang //smon lam mi bsrun skye bo 'gas/ /'dun pa gzhin du bsgyur ba las /re zhig phrin las de tsam mo/ /de nas dpal gyi mchims phu yi/ /'og min rdo rje'i ke'u tshang du/ /lo gsum sgrub pa'i dam bca' bzung / /mu to'i brtul zhugs la gnas tshe/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i bkod pa la/ /ne tsho 'dra ba'i 'dab chags kyis/ /dkyil 'khor yid 'ong bzhengs pa mthong / /dkyil 'khor grub ma thag pa la/ /cho ga btang ba'i sems bskyed der/ /sangs rgyas med la sems can med/ /yin pa med la min pa med/ /so ma rang gdangs lhug pa'i ngang /rang grol chen por sems bskyed do/ /zer mur mi lam nyams de sad/ /yang gsang bla ma'i sgrub pa de/ /snying gi dbus na lham mer gsal/ /yang gcig sha za ḍāk+ki ma//bu mo gzhon nu'i rnam 'gyur can//lag tu zab lam pho nya'i skor//dpe cha shog ldebs gcig khyer nas/ /'di yi bde stong chen po'i nyams/ /gang yin rgyud la ma 'tshal bas/ /tshig gis ma yin rgyud thog tu/ /ngo sprod gnad smin zhu zer bar/ /don dam shes rab ye shes kyi/ /dbang bskur byas pa'i rjes thog tu/ /zab mo'i snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di/ /klong chen nyams kyi tshul du gdams/ /kye hoḥ brjod med blo 'das kyi khang mdzes na/ /dbyings chen rnam dag gi lus phra mo/ /mtha' brgyad spros bral gyi bzhin ras mdzes/ /ye grol mnyam nyid kyi rgyan cha btags/ /ma bcos rang byung sga spyod lam dal/ /sman de la bdag gir su yis byed/ /spyir grub thob yongs kyi mdza' na mo/ /sgos rig 9 2

pa'i dpa' bo gzhon nu ngas/ /sbyor tshe zung 'jug yangs par sbyor/ /sgrol tshe dug lnga'i rnam rtog sgrol/ /ta na ga na'i gsang spyod 'di/ /mdzad mkhan zhin tu mang lags te/ /mkhyen mkhan me long rdo rje tsam/ /nga me long rdo rje'i brgyud pa 'dzin/ /dbyangs de la bskyar bzlos byed snying 'dod/ /tsit+ta rang byung gi gur khang nang / /bu rig pa'i rgyal po dpa' brtul che/ /rtsa yo 'khyog med pa dbu ma'i nang / /'bangs srog rtsol gnyis po rang brtson 'dzin/ /nor nyi zla so sos bdag gir byed/ /rlung nus pa can gnyis ma 'chams pas/ /nad 'du ba rnams bzhi'i kha rlangs gtong / /dus ma yin par srog la hur thum byed//rlung phra mo'i tshogs rnams yan drag pas/ /'od gsal 'ja' sprin gyi khang mdzes bshig /'gyu dran mtha' med kyi rdul phran g.yo/ /rnam mkhyen byang chub kyi zhal ras bsgribs/ /dus de tshe rig pa'i rgyal po ngas/ /snyan brgyud man ngag gi pho nya btang / /rtsa a wa dhu ti'i khri mun du/ /rlung nus pa can gnyis btson la bcug /khong rgyal po'i dpa' zil ma bzod nas/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis zla sgril byed par 'chams/ /der mi dbang gis blon po ro rkyang gnyis/ /khri mun du zhal lce gcod la mngags/ /btson pa gnyis gcig tu kha 'dril bas/ /rtsa phran gyi rlung rnams dbang med 'dus/ /khong thams cad 'dod pa gcig tu dril/ /rtsol bas gtum mo'i me sbar zhing / /srog gi bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gtigs/ /de lugs 'byung bzhi yi pho nyas phab/ /chos dbyings ye shes kyi rdzing du bskyis/ /lugs ldog bzhi yi gnas su skyol/ /'gram par sor rtog ye shes slebs/ /des zag bcas kyi sdom pa rnam pa gsum/ /rdo rje gsum du rnam par dag /'khor 'das ye grol gyi mna' gan phul/ /snang sems ro gcig gi rten 'brel 493

bsgrigs/ /dus min gyi 'chi ba pha mthar bskrad/ /lam rtags kyi yo na tan mtha' nas rgyas/ /dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro tshogs kyis mnyes/ /sgom gsal 'grib med pa'i mar me sbar/ /snang sems dbyer med kyi srog mkhar tshugs/ /de seng ge'i 'o ma mngar po yin/ /myong mkhan u dum wa ra tsam/ /dbang rim pa gsum pa'i gsob gyon te//nyon mongs byung rgyal du spyod pa dang / /thur ma'i phyag rgya rnom pa rnams/ /'byung 'jug rlung bi rten 'brel gyis/ /kun+da btsan thabs su 'chings na yang / /'bras bu dbyung ba'i shugs 'gro dang / /dbye ba med par rgyud las bshad/ /kye ma dus mthar de 'dra mang / /shal ma ri yis 'jigs pa che/ /mi bdag la 'dri ba'i don gnyer ma/ /dbyings kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' klong du/ /rig pa brjod bral gyi dpa' bos sbyor/ /bde sto nga blo 'das kyi ngang la zhogs/ /'jig rten pa'i snying sdug la re ma dgos/ /khyim thabs dang zang zing med pa la/ /skal pa dang man ngas med do snyam/ /de mno mkhan 'du shes 'khrul tshabs che/ /myur lam rdo rje'i theg pa la/ /'jug sgo'i dbang ni rnam bzhi yod/ /de kun la gsang lam khyad 'phags re/ /nyams len lhod med kyi gnam ru 'gugs/ /dam tshig zol med kyi gzhu rgyud sgron/ /rten 'brel smon lam gyi mtheb ltong sprod//mda' 'phen pa rgyal khams kun la 'phen/ //'phog pa las 'brel can la 'phog/'tshengs pa gtan 'dun 'tshengs pa yis //'grub pa tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub/ /kun gyis spyod yul ma lags pas/ /rkun nor bzhin du a tham rgya//zhes smras pas mo yi sems dasa' nas/ /skyes rab 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan brtsams//dasa' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin du//rang snang stong pa'i ngang la yal/ /de tshe rlangs chen dpal seng gi/ /yang srid 494

pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ ('di rlangs dpal seng dngos kyi phur pa rgyud lugs gyi don dbang bskur ba yin kyang / /de dus bka' rgya ma grol zhing gzhan snang dang bstun pa'i gsang rgya'i rdzu 'phrul gyi ngag yin no/ /)mjal te rang gter stag tshang gi/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dbang bskur mis/ /e dbyings nyi gzhon 'char ku'i pho brang cher/ /waṃ yig zla zhun 'khyil pa rdo rje'i khams/ /zung 'jug dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas su/ /bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel smon lam 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer 'dzam gling dbus/ /sgra gcan sa yi thig ler byang chub sems/ /bde stong gnyis med chen por sangs rgyas pa/ /gti mug chos dbyings ye shes ngo bor grub/ /de tshe tha mal rang kha'i kun rtog kun/ /mtha' bral gnyug ma'i rgyal sar 'jogs pa la/ /'gyur dran snang ba'i 'char sgos phyag byas shing / /lnga bcur 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel srog shing tshugs/ /gdod ma'i gsang lam ston pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /dam tshig sems dpa' g.yung drung 'khyil ba la/ /dbyings phyug e ka dza ti'i srog 'dres nas/ /slob brgyud zla ba nya ba'i tshom bu bkod/ /lo dmar ser can gyi dbyug gu'i zla'i/ /dus yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nub mo de/ /yid kun rtog gi me long dwangs pa'i ngos/ /dpal o ḍā ya na'i sangs rgyas che//sku gzhon mdzes g.yas na rgyu kā ra//g.yon phyogs na rang nyid 'dug pa'i mod//des phyag rgya'i brda thabs nam mkhar gdengs/ /ma dbyings phyug bde chen 'tsho rgyal dang / /rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin rdu kā ra/ /thugs ye shes chen por gnyis su med/ /rgyu kā ra gsang 'dzin rdo rje 'chang / /bdag nyid ni 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /nged rnam gsum rigs gsum sprul pa'i gar/ /zhes gsung pa'i mod la gtad med yal/ /yang khyu mchog dbyug gu'i zla ba la/ /'og 495

min gyi ljon pa'i bsil grib 'og /la wa'i lding gur la brten nas/ /dgongs 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /bdud rtsi'i sgrub chen btsugs pa'i tshe/ /shin tu grang ba'i nam zla la/ /me tog pad sdong kha bye zhing / /tho rengs 'od gsal gyi snang cha la/ /ri do chad cig gi rtse mo ru/ /rgya gar gyi dzo ki gnyis dang phrad/ /de la bdag gis 'di skad du/ /ri 'di la bskor ba byas pa na/ /grub thob brgyad cu mjal yong smras/ /dzo ki des cung zhig bsams nas su/ /ri 'di 'dra'i rgyus la nga rang zhib/ /grub thob brgyad cu dang 'o sa kyang mjal/ /khyed g.yas kyi phyag na ne'u le 'dzin/ /mtshan na mtshan ldan gzungs ma brten/ /g.yon gyis bgram pa gzengs bstod nas/ /mgur yid kha 'phrog par len pa mthong //dus da res ji bzhin ngo sprod kyang //mi gzhan gyi blo la ma shong dogs//kha rog 'dug pa lags so zer/ /der nged kyis lan du grub thob de'i/ /mtshan ci 'dra bya ba lags dris pas/ /brag khung pa zhes par grags so lo/ /sha ba khyi khrid kyi gdams pa'i gnad/ /der nged la zhu bo zer ba na/ /ngas de 'dra'i dpe cha med kyang med/ /spyir rnal 'byor gyi ri khrod 'grim pa la/ /mthu ngan sngags kyi bsam pa mi rig byas/ /der rnal 'byor zla'o zhig byung nas/ /des bstan la phan na dgos so zer/ci /de'i rngo da la nyams snang de sad do/ /gang tshe rdo rje g.yu yis sgrol ma des/ /snam dkar yid du 'ong ba rnam pa gnyis/ /shin tu brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis sngon bsus nas/ /bdag la byin nas rig 'dzin bu khyod kyi/ /gyon pa'i bsnon ma gyis zhes zer ba dang / /brtse dung mos par ldan pa'i glu 'di blangs/ /rgyal sras lha rje'i sprul pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /ya gyal sacig ni yar rje o rgyan gling / /'od gsal bla ma o rgyan bsam gtan gling /zhal 96

mjal 'brel ba thogs pa kun la mdzod/ /ces pa'i mod la gtad med chos skur 'khyil/ re zhig gi tshe thor thun gyi sgang la gnyid du cung zad shor ba'i snang ba la/ /gnas bskor du 'ongs pa yin snyam pa'i bud med lnga dang sbrags nas phyin pa las/ de'i khrod nas rang gi ma yin snyam pa'i bud med rgan song zhig si ngo tsha dang tshul 'chos bshig nas nged la shin tu brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur mas bu chung la byed pa ltar bzhin gtugs pa dang / /kha sbya ra ba mang po byed pa'i ngang nas brag phug yid du 'ong ba o rgyan chen po'i dbu rjes yod pa zhig tu khrid/ der gnas bshad kyi tshul du 'di mtsho rgyal gyis phur pa bsgrubs pa'i gzims phug yin zer/ khong rang rnams kyis skad sgra snya na pos maṇ+ḍal dang /gsol 'debs yid 'phrog pa zhig byas song / de'i mod la bud med cung gzugs mi sdug pa zhig 'dug pa des bskul nas nged rang la kha gtad nas/bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs /zhes pa'i sho lo ka tshar gsum rgya gling las snyan pa'i dbyangs rta la drangs nas zer byung bas snang ba zi bun pa zhig byung / de'i tshe lhan skyes kyi shes pa skad cig mar/ /da khong rnams yar klung rten gsum mjal du 'gro yong bas smon lam 'debs lugs shig bslab dbos bsams pa dang / /skad cig la rang gi phu bo yin snyam pa zhis khrong nge byung nas des byang drangs te/ chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka brjod mthar nam mkha' la bya khyu 'grogs pa bzhin co dir gyis gyes song /der spun yin snyam pa'i bud med gcig da rung bsdad nas bslab don zhu rgyu 'dra yod de 'bol 'thol zhig satan nas ma byung zer zhing / nged kyi rna ba g.yo na pa la kha sbyar nas gtam shab shub thos rgyu rang med pa mang zhig zer 197

ba'i thos pa zhig la mi chen tsho la'ang ngo 'dzin rang cher gnang zhan 'dra zer ba dang / yang shab bi shub bi kho na zer ba'i sgra ma go /yang thos pa zhis la/nyid rang lus dben par bzhugs dang / ston dpyid la sogs pa'i 'tsho chas ni 'bad med du yo nga / ngag dben par bzhugs dang zer ba'i mod la skad shugs chung du rang btang byung bas/ de dag ma go /de las sgra das par gyis dang byas pas da dung skad shugs de bas kyang je chung du song bas kho bos mi lam yin par shes te dgongs pa dbyings la gtad pas gnyid las sad de/dran pa bde stong chen po'i ngang du ring zhig 'das/ lung bstan de la brten nas mi chen sdig to can rnams kyis ngo srung ma bgyis so/ /de'i tshe zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin sgrub gnas chen po nyid la gnas bstod cig brtsams te 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa'i ngang du mnal ba na/ dbang bo yul lnga'i tha mal gyi 'dzin pa dwangs/ gzung yu la rags pa yid shes kyi chu mtshor thim/ kun gzhi mi rtog pa'i ngang du snang cha'i rten 'brel nub pa dang / lhag mthong gsal ba'i ye shes kyi snang ba'i 'od gsal gyi me long phyis pa'i ngos shin tu dwangs par ma byon bde gshegs snying po ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan snang ba'i grong khyer du khams drug ldan gyi mi'i zol la brten pa/ dpal bsam yas pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang bo sku gzugs bzang la na bza' chos bos rnam gsum gyis mdzes shing / sku na cung zad smin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lke ltar mthong na mi mthun pa med pa zhig dang mig 'phrul lta bur mjal te/brjod bya don gyi thugs rgyud 'pho bar gyur cig /'pho bar gyur cig /rjod byed tshig gi brgyud pa rdzogs par gyur cig /rdzogs par gyur cig /ces gsung 498

sgra lhang lhang zhal 'don mdzad pa thos/ /der dran pa 'thor 'gro ba lta bu'i dad pa dang mos gus bzod blas med pa zhig skyes/ phyag 'tshal long med par kun mkhyen bla ma'i phyag gnyis nas lub kyis 'jus/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i cod pan du btags nas/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po mkhyen/ kun mekhyen chos kyi rgyal po mkhyen/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po mkhyen/ zhes mos gus kyis brgyal ba tsam du gsol ba btab/ kho bo la dus phyis de skad zer mkhan yong phebs/ der snang ba la/ khams 'dus me tog phreng ldan la sogs par gsungs pa ltar sems can bsod nams dman pas sku dngos su bzhugs dus dad mos med cing log sgrub che ba'i shugs kyis bulas mug par byung 'dug pa'i gsung cong yin par ko ste/ ngos nas khyod kyi mdzod bdun dang / snying thig rnams kyi dbongs gter gcig pu'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan btags pa'i bka' drin dran cing / che ba'i yon tan sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs pa'i mos gus rgyun gtan phyed bzhin par lags mo da zhus pas/ nga la spyan hur gyis gzigs nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod la da ci smon lam gtad rgya'i sgo nas don rgyud kyi dbongs pa 'phos pa yin pas sgrub pa'i srog mkhar tshugs la skal ldan la rgya cher ston cig /khyod rang gi mgur ma yang shin tu legs pa byung 'dug gsung pa'i mod la bslab ston 'dra zhu snyam pa dang / sku gsum gyi snang cha mig 'phrul lta bur dbyings su nub ste/kun mkhyen bla ma dran pa la tshugs thabs med pa zhis byung ngo/ /bral phug 'grim pa'i sprang btsun bhu su ku/ /dben par gnas nas na tshod ma rgas pa sa/ /rtogs pa skye ba shes byar mi srid snyam/ /dregs rlom can gyis ga 'a byed na yang //rgyal sras pad+ma dge 499

ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /rdzu la zhugs pa klong gsal dri med kyi/ /zhal mthong tsam gyis bag chags sdig sgrib zad/gsung thos tsam gyis rtogs pa'i klong chen rdol/ //tha snya da chos la bslab gnyer ma bgyis kyang / /dpe mthong tsam gyis gdams ba'i gnad mtshang rig /nyin zhag gcig la sems can sangs rgyas su/ /bsgyur ba'i bka' drin bsam kyin bla ma dran//phyi ltar r+ghaṃ chen 'gro 'dul dri med rje//nang ltar siṅga'i slob dpon mañju thi/ /gsang ba ye shes sku can klong chen pas/ /brda thabs rten 'brel du mas don rgyud byin/ /mthong snang za zi nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /rdo la zhabs rjes mu stegs nag pos 'jog /nyams rtogs dbang po'i yu la du mi snang bas/ /gzhan la rtag brten ther zug smra don ci/ /sku yi byin gyis brlabs pa ste dang po'o/ /'di gnas yig rnying par nyang phug gong mar grags pa'i don la nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i sgrub phug bya g.yabs phug pa lta bu'i sgo logs g.yas zur na da lta brag gseng du shing sgro dkar skyes shing / brag logs la mchod rten gyi ri mo gsum yod pa'i brag zhol 'debs der 'jag ma'i lhags skyobs tsam la brten nas 'dug pa'i skabs yin no/ /de nas nyang phug 'og ma'i tha snyad grags pa la brten nas snga rabs pa dag gis lho phyogs kyi phyis byung gi brag phug de la nyang phug gi kha byang bris 'dug kyang / sngar bshad pa ltar gsal snang gi bden pas nges shes rnyed pa'i sngon chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tos dang /de rjesamanga' bdag nyang gi(mnga' bdag nyang gi skye ba bcu gsum dran/) sgrub phug yin pas nyang phug 'og mar grags pa nged rang gis/ ngos bzung zhing me tog phug tu btags pa'i gnas su bcad mtshams shin tu dam zhing 500

nges 'byung bis rgyud brlan pa zhig bi tshe/ a 'thas gzung yul gyi 'dzin cha zhig pa'i snang ngor yang gcig ku na mkhyen sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang mjal ba na/ dpe cha bam po zhis sanang nas 'dis shing rta chen mo na gab pa'i tshul du yo da pa mtha' das gsal ba yod/ ces dang / gsang mdzod chen mo'i brda 'grol gyi skor skabs 'dir gsungs pa yin/ yang 'di khyod rang gi skye brgyud 'u nga byang yin no zhes shog dril zhis gnang byung ba kha phye bas/ yi ge gong 'os rim pa gnyis kyi rnam par 'dug pa'i gong mar/ skye ba sngon ma ni kun mkhyen chos rje'o/ /zhes 'dug /phyi ma rnams klos par com pa na/ gsal snang de nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin song la / 'di'i tshe sku'i byad dbyibs sogs 'di ltar 'dug snyam pa'i 'dzin shes rags pa gang yang ma byung ngo / /gsung bi byin gyis brlabs nas bstan bcos brtsam par rjes su gnang ba ste zhal mthong gnyis pa'o//de nas zla shas song tsa na/ kun mkhyen bla ma nyid paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha byad snum bas dang ldan zhing / shin tu gzhon sha chags pa dgung lo nyi shu rtsa grangs pa'i sku na can/ dbu la paṇa zhwa rna ring bzhes pa zhis dang mjal te/ rdo rje phung po'i dkyil 'khor (lus dkyil) rmad du byung ba'i rta babs gong ma gnyis kyi 'phyang 'phrul la brten/lhun grub risas lnga yab yum zung du 'jug pa'i brdas/'od gsal dag pa rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur nas/ ci yang mi gsung bar shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i zhal 'dzum mu le ba'i ngang la/ dag chen ye shes kyi snang cha dbyings su thim par gyur pa ni thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs nas don rgyud rtogs pa'i bdag por rjes su gnang ba ste zhal mthong gsum pa'o/5/01

de'i tshe phyi yul gyi snang ba gtad med du grol te mnyam bzhag bi dgongs pa la phyogs lhung gi ris med/ /nang 'dzin pa'i 'du shes pa la rtsis gdab kyi ris med pas rang grol phyogs yan du sangs/ rjes thob shes rab kyi snang char dasa' ba dang skyo ba'i yid kyis dus 'das te/ dad pa dang gdung shugs drag po'i rkyen gyis bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i rgyang glu zhes bya ba de yang brtsams/shing rta gsum dang mdzod chen bdun gyi brjod bya'i don snying la shar bas kun mkhyen zhal lung / pad+ma dkar po/ gol shor tshar gcod sogs man ngag gi lta sgom gyi bcud/ nyams len gyi mtshang lta bu'i gnad lag bcangs ma tshig zhung don gsal mang po yang bris/de yang sgom chen pa ni bshad ral dang rtog dpyod la gtsor 'don mi byed cing / khyad par du thos bsam tsam la brten pa'i tha snyad dang gnas lugs brjod bral gyi don go ba'i pho tshod tsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i bsta na bcos dang mi 'dra bar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / o rgyan chos rje/ bi ma la/ masgon po klu sgrub ltar dbang sgyur nus pa'i brtul zhugs kyis bstan pa'i sro ga shing du bsgrubs pa kun mkhyen chen po'i bstan bcos nyi zla'i snang ba lta bu rtsod pa dang rgol ngan gis glags lta bar mi bzod pa 'di dag yod bzhin du/ rang cag gi srin bu'i me 'od lta bu'i glegs bam chen po bcos pa la dgos pa med snyam nas lhod de sdod pa la 'dun no/ /'on kyang dargongs gter chen po de dag gi don la thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa dang / bkur sti dang / ri mor bya ba dang /bshad pa dang / sgrub pa 'i sgo nas rang rgyud smin grol du bsgrub cing gzhan das la'ang bsngags par brjod pa dang / rgyacher 'di sa pa'i 50 2

spyod pa la bslab par dam bcas shing /de yang gzhon nu nor bzang gis byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa smon lam du btab par/ lan bcig tsam yang dad pa skyes pa ni/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ bdul bar bya ba gang zag bi dad pa'i myu gu gsar du bskyed pa dang / byin rlabs don gyi nye brgyud lag pa'i mthil du zin pa'i rten 'brel gyi bden pa mi 'gog pa'i phyir du/chos kyi rnam grangs de dag sga don zab pa dang rgya che ba ji snyed cig dgongs pa'i klong nas rang shar ba'i tshul du bkod pa man ngag gi bsta na bcos rin po che lung ji sater mdzod la sdu/ lha pa'ang bgyis nas rdo rje'i gnas chen po rnams gsal bar bgyis pa 503

rtsom sgrig 'gan khur ba/ bkra shis/mdun shog mdzes ris pa/ kurma dang chos nyid/dpe deb 'char 'god pa/ shang yong /'jigs med gling pa'i rnam thar/'jigs med gling pas mdzad/ṭ+wāṃ dzā/ ṭ+wāṃ / k+ṣiṃ r+sha/ / /ṭā ༵ pyi kāX /dri/ brgyud bkram byas/lho nub lcags bzhu sa gshis par 'debs bzo grwas dpar//shā // //ci/glu/75409—1921—375 161
(1//)so0 002 ṭ+wāṃ//sdi// lta mi /snyisdurno swā ཿ/ sa tram̐ ༵༵༵ 70 ( mas mcha kyi15sa lta〈com rta (hra /dekhu 1//stu/bye 68 shā pa/325003/rdo 6 ṭā rdzutā ba bya ma7—5409—92—375 /6/ sa 950cha
twa /5207—2ཿrwa/sbyi:/1khu375
